import { defineConfig } from 'vite';
import react from '@vitejs/plugin-react';
import tsconfigPaths from 'vite-tsconfig-paths';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
const __dirname = path.dirname(__filename);

export default defineConfig(({ mode }) => {
  const isDev = mode === 'development';

  return {
    mode,
    define: {
      __DEV__: isDev,
    },
    plugins: [
      react(),
      tsconfigPaths({
        projects: [
          path.resolve(__dirname, 'tsconfig.json'),
          path.resolve(__dirname, '../../../tsconfig.base.json'),
        ],
        ignoreConfigErrors: true,
      }),
    ],
    build: {
      outDir: path.resolve(__dirname, 'dist'),
      emptyOutDir: true,
      rollupOptions: {
        input: {
          'service_worker/index': path.resolve(__dirname, 'src/service_worker/index.ts'),
          'inspector-window/index': path.resolve(__dirname, 'src/inspector-window.tsx'),
          popup: path.resolve(__dirname, 'src/popup.tsx'),
          sidepanel: path.resolve(__dirname, 'src/sidepanel.tsx'),
        },
        output: {
          entryFileNames: chunkInfo => {
            if (chunkInfo.name === 'service_worker/index') {
              return 'service_worker/index.js';
            }
            if (chunkInfo.name === 'inspector-window/index') {
              return 'inspector-window/index.js';
            }
            return '[name].js';
          },
          chunkFileNames: 'chunks/[name]-[hash].js',
          assetFileNames: 'assets/[name].[ext]',
          format: 'es',
          manualChunks: id => {
            if (
              id.includes('node_modules/react') ||
              id.includes('node_modules/react-dom')
            ) {
              return 'vendor-react';
            }
          },
        },
        external: [],
      },
      target: 'esnext',
      minify: !isDev,
      commonjsOptions: {
        include: [/node_modules/],
        transformMixedEsModules: true,
      },
    },
    optimizeDeps: {
      include: ['react', 'react-dom', 'react/jsx-runtime'],
    },
    resolve: {
      alias: {
        '@': path.resolve(__dirname, './src'),
      },
      dedupe: ['react', 'react-dom'],
    },
  };
});

import { resolve, dirname } from 'path';

const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
const __dirname = dirname(__filename);
const workspaceRoot = resolve(__dirname, '../../..');

  plugins: [
    tsconfigPaths({
      projects: [
        resolve(workspaceRoot, 'tsconfig.base.json'),
        resolve(__dirname, 'tsconfig.json'),
      ],
    }),
  ],
  test: {
    include: [
      resolve(__dirname, 'src/tests/unit/**/*.test.ts').replaceAll('\\', '/'),

    environment: 'jsdom',
    globals: true,
    coverage: {
      provider: 'v8',
      reporter: ['text', 'json', 'html'],

        'node_modules/',

        'src/tests/',
        '**/*.d.ts',

        '**/mockData',
        'scripts/',
      ],
      thresholds: {
        lines: 60,

        statements: 60,
      },
    },
  },
  resolve: {

# Blue Notary Extension — Handoff Playbook

## Quick Resume

1. Open `.codex/projects/blue-notary-extension/current-task.json`
2. Confirm `activeBranch` matches `currentPhase.branch`
3. Run commands in `nextCommandSet` in order
4. Continue from recorded verification state

---

## Project Coordinates

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| App path | `apps/chrome-extensions/blue-notary-extension/` |
| Platform domain | `https://app.bluenotary.us` |
| Queue URL | `https://app.bluenotary.us/notary/dashboard` |
| Sign-in URL | `https://app.bluenotary.us/sign-in` |
| Container selector | `.card-draggable-wrapper` |
| Button selector | `.q-virtual-scroll__content .q-btn, .card-draggable-wrapper button, button,[role="button"]` |
| Heading text | `Open Calls` |
| No-data selector | `.card-draggable-wrapper .tw-text-center.tw-text-gray-500` |
| Keywords | `join as witness, pick up session, pick up, join, open call, session, witness` |
| Storage key prefix | `blue-notary-extension:*` |
| SDLC charter | `.codex/projects/blue-notary-extension/SDLC_CHARTER.md` |
| Task state | `.codex/projects/blue-notary-extension/current-task.json` |

---

## Architecture Overview

The extension mirrors `proof-extension` architecture exactly. Platform-specific logic lives in
`src/platforms/` and `src/watch/domain-watch-adapter.ts`; all other watch/claim/scheduler/inspector
modules are copied verbatim from `proof-extension` (no divergence, no shared lib).

```
chrome-extension/
├── service_worker/index.ts       ← MV3 background, state machine, tab detection, webRequest
├── content.ts                    ← Content script bootstrap; manages dom-watch & inspector
├── content/watch-observer.ts     ← DomWatchController, WatchOverlayController helpers
│
├── platforms/
│   ├── types.ts                  ← PlatformId = 'blue-notary'
│   ├── registry.ts               ← getPlatformProvider(), resolvePlatformForUrl()
│   ├── blue-notary-provider.ts   ← URL matching, getWatchConfig(), isNoData(), getCandidates(),
│   │                                detectActiveSession() — ALL Blue Notary domain logic
│   └── default-settings.ts       ← createDefaultSettings(), hydrateSettings(),
│                                    createDefaultSchedulerState()
│
├── watch/
│   ├── domain-watch-adapter.ts   ← resolveBlueNotaryWatchContainer() + full WatchPlatformAdapter
│   ├── claim-executor.ts         ← [COPY] three-strategy click fallback chain
│   ├── platform-scheduler.ts     ← [COPY] token bucket rate limiting + mutex
│   └── watch-session-state.ts    ← [COPY] session lifecycle management
│
├── socket/
│   └── blue-notary-page-monitor.ts ← [COPY] page-bridge fetch/XHR/WS interceptor
│
├── inspector/                    ← [COPY] DOM/network/interaction event capture + store
├── utils/                        ← [COPY] run-log-store, watch-metrics, dom-delta-probe
│
├── sidepanel/NotaryApp.tsx       ← Full operator console (watch, logs, inspector, settings)
├── popup.tsx                     ← Quick actions: open queue, start/stop watch
├── inspector-window.tsx          ← Popout inspector (inspectorOnly mode)
└── devtools/                     ← DevTools panel + cursor simulation
```

### Data Flow: Watch Cycle

```
content.ts
  → START_DOM_WATCH message from service_worker
  → createDomWatchController(document, watchConfig)
        ↓ MutationObserver fires
  → blueNotaryProvider.createAdapter().resolveContainer()
  → adapter.isNoData(container)  [active-button pre-check]
  → adapter.getCandidates(container)  [keyword filter]
  → executeClaimWithFallbacks()  [direct → selector-refresh → coordinate]
  → DOM_WATCH_EVENT → service_worker
        ↓
  → WatchState update → STATE_UPDATED broadcast → sidepanel/popup
```

---

## Key Invariants

| Invariant | Where enforced |
|-----------|----------------|
| `autoClaimEnabled` defaults to `false` | `default-settings.ts:DEFAULT_WATCH_BEHAVIOR_SETTINGS` |
| Storage namespace `blue-notary-extension:*` | `service_worker/index.ts` (4 keys) |
| Tab detection: `https://app.bluenotary.us/*` | `service_worker/index.ts:getBlueNotaryTab()` |
| Inspector is session-bound, manually attached | `service_worker/index.ts:ATTACH_INSPECTOR handler` |
| `PlatformId = 'blue-notary'` (no proof refs) | `platforms/types.ts` |
| `isNoData()` active-button pre-check | `blue-notary-provider.ts`, `domain-watch-adapter.ts` |

---

## Known Pitfalls

### isNoData() false positive (fix already applied)

The "Pick Up Session" button contains CSS-hidden child spans with "No Data Available" text.
`container.textContent` includes this hidden text and triggers a false no-data event during live sessions.

**Fix applied from day one (parity with proof-extension commit `688934a`):**
```typescript
const hasActiveButton = container.querySelector(
  `${buttonSelector}:not([disabled]):not([aria-disabled="true"])`
);
if (hasActiveButton) return false;
```
Both `blue-notary-provider.ts` and `domain-watch-adapter.ts` apply this check.

**CSS selector limitation:** The compound button selector ends with `button,[role="button"]`. Appending
`:not([disabled])` applies only to the final clause (`[role="button"]`), not to `button` itself, due to
CSS comma-grouping rules. This means a plain `<button disabled>` still satisfies the active-button pre-check
query. In practice, Blue Notary uses Quasar's `aria-disabled` attribute (not the native `disabled` attribute)
on inactive buttons, so this edge case does not affect production behavior.

### Session window duration

Blue Notary Open Call sessions may appear for as little as 154ms (observed in Proof telemetry).
The reactive DOM observer (not polling) + active-button pre-check combination is critical for catching
short-window sessions. Do not replace the `MutationObserver` with a `setInterval` poller.

### Quasar framework selectors

Blue Notary uses Quasar UI (`.q-btn`, `.q-tab-panels`, `.q-virtual-scroll__content`).
The heading-text fallback in `domain-watch-adapter.ts` (`resolveBlueNotaryWatchContainer()`)
provides resilience against layout changes between Quasar versions.

### PlatformId scope

`PlatformId = 'blue-notary'` only. If you copy a module from `remote-Notary-Extension` (which uses
`'blue-notary' | 'proof'`), check all default platform values — `'proof'` literals will fail typecheck.

--- FILE: project: apps/chrome-extensions/blue-notary-extension/docs/adr/001-architecture.md ---
# ADR 001 — Standalone App Mirroring proof-extension Architecture

**Date:** 2026-03-20
**Status:** Accepted

---

## Context

The workspace already has a working Chrome extension for Proof.com (`proof-extension`) with a
fully-implemented reactive watch engine, auto-claim executor, DOM inspector, and sidepanel UI.
A parallel extension is needed for `app.bluenotary.us`.

The options considered were:

1. **Extend `remote-Notary-Extension`** — Add a Blue Notary-specific track inside the existing
   multi-platform extension. Risk: `remote-Notary-Extension` is in active development; concurrent
   changes could break the Blue Notary track. Build output is a single extension covering multiple
   platforms, increasing manifest surface area.

2. **Standalone `blue-notary-extension` app** — New Nx sibling app, identical architecture to
   `proof-extension`, using Blue Notary selectors and URLs from `remote-Notary-Extension` as reference.
   Platform-agnostic modules (claim-executor, scheduler, session-state) copied verbatim.

3. **Shared lib + two thin apps** — Extract the platform-agnostic watch engine to
   `libs/notary-watch-core` and have both extensions depend on it.

---

## Decision

**Option 2: Standalone app**, mirroring `proof-extension` exactly.

---

## Rationale

- **Isolation**: Blue Notary and Proof can be installed simultaneously without storage key collision
  or manifest conflict. Each extension targets its own domain exclusively.
- **Simplicity**: Copying 5–7 small, stable files is simpler than setting up a shared lib with Nx
  module boundary configuration, index barrel, and cross-project import rules.
- **Independent evolution**: Blue Notary UI/UX may diverge from Proof (different queue structure,
  different session confirmation patterns). A shared lib would couple the two prematurely.
- **Risk surface**: Fewer moving parts. A bug in the BN extension cannot destabilize the Proof extension.
- **Time to delivery**: Option 2 delivered in one track. Option 3 would require an additional Nx lib
  scaffold, boundary ESLint rules, and import refactors in both apps before any BN-specific code.

---

## Consequences

- `claim-executor.ts`, `platform-scheduler.ts`, `watch-session-state.ts`, `inspector/`, `utils/`
  exist as verbatim copies in both `proof-extension/src/` and `blue-notary-extension/src/`.
- **Bug fixes in these files must be applied to both extensions** until a shared lib is extracted.
- If duplication pain justifies it, the shared lib extraction is the obvious next step
  (see ADR 002 for the YAGNI decision).
- The `remote-Notary-Extension` remains the canonical reference for Blue Notary selectors and
  provider logic; it is read-only during this track.

--- FILE: project: apps/chrome-extensions/blue-notary-extension/docs/adr/002-no-shared-lib.md ---
# ADR 002 — YAGNI: Verbatim Copy Over Shared Lib Extraction

**Date:** 2026-03-20
**Status:** Accepted

---

## Context

`proof-extension` and `blue-notary-extension` share 7 platform-agnostic modules:

| Module | Size | Change frequency |
|--------|------|-----------------|
| `watch/claim-executor.ts` | ~200 LOC | Low — fallback strategies are stable |
| `watch/platform-scheduler.ts` | ~230 LOC | Low — token bucket algorithm is stable |
| `watch/watch-session-state.ts` | ~80 LOC | Low |
| `watch/watch-overlay-controller.ts` | ~200 LOC | Medium — UI may evolve |
| `inspector/` (4 files) | ~600 LOC | Medium |
| `utils/run-log-store.ts` | ~50 LOC | Low |
| `utils/watch-metrics.ts` | ~60 LOC | Low |
| `utils/dom-delta-probe.ts` | ~80 LOC | Low |

A shared lib (`libs/notary-watch-core`) would eliminate duplication. The question is: now or later?

---

## Decision

**Copy verbatim. Do not extract a shared lib in this phase.**

---

## Rationale

YAGNI — You Aren't Gonna Need It (yet).

1. **Stability**: The modules have been stable since `remote-Notary-Extension` Phase 10–13. No
   divergence has occurred. There is no present pain from duplication.
2. **Setup cost**: A new Nx lib requires: `project.json`, `tsconfig.json`, `src/index.ts` barrel,
   Nx tag configuration, ESLint boundary rules, and import refactors in both consuming apps. This
   is 1–2 hours of pure infrastructure work with zero user-visible value.
3. **Coupling risk**: If extracted now, a change to the shared lib (e.g., extending `PlatformId`)
   could break both extensions simultaneously. Copies evolve independently by default.
4. **Resume rule**: Extract when the pain of maintaining two copies exceeds the cost of extraction.
   Three identical files across two apps is not yet painful; five bug fixes applied in two places
   within a single sprint would be the signal.

---

## Consequences

- Developers must apply relevant bug fixes to both `proof-extension/src/` and
  `blue-notary-extension/src/` for the shared modules listed above.
- The `HANDOFF_PLAYBOOK.md` notes this explicitly so future contributors know to check both apps.
- When divergence or repeated dual-fixes make extraction worthwhile, the path is:
  1. `pnpm exec nx g @nx/js:lib libs/notary-watch-core --publishable=false`
  2. Move shared modules into `libs/notary-watch-core/src/`
  3. Export from `libs/notary-watch-core/src/index.ts`
  4. Update both app imports to use the lib barrel
  5. Add ESLint boundary rules: `libs` may not import from `apps`

--- FILE: project: apps/chrome-extensions/blue-notary-extension/docs/adr/003-isnodata-precheck.md ---
# ADR 003 — isNoData() Active-Button Pre-Check

**Date:** 2026-03-20
**Status:** Accepted

---

## Context

Blue Notary renders "Pick Up Session" and "Join as Witness" buttons inside `.card-draggable-wrapper`.
Each Quasar button contains child `<span>` elements with aria-hidden text like "No Data Available"
that is hidden by CSS (`display: none` or `visibility: hidden`) but still present in the DOM.

The `isNoData()` function was originally implemented using `container.textContent` inspection:

```typescript
const text = (container.textContent ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
return text.includes('no data available') || text.includes('no open calls');
```

This caused a false-positive: when an active "Pick Up Session" button was visible,
`container.textContent` returned `"No Data Availablepick up session"` (the hidden span text
concatenated with the visible text). The `isNoData()` check incorrectly returned `true`,
causing the watch engine to skip the candidate and miss the session window.

This bug was identified and fixed in `proof-extension` commit `688934a`.

---

## Decision

Apply the active-button pre-check to `isNoData()` in **both**:
- `src/platforms/blue-notary-provider.ts`
- `src/watch/domain-watch-adapter.ts`

```typescript
const hasActiveButton = container.querySelector(
  `${buttonSelector}:not([disabled]):not([aria-disabled="true"])`
);
if (hasActiveButton) return false;
// Fall through to noDataSelector check and text inspection
```

If a non-disabled candidate button is present, the queue cannot be empty — return `false` immediately
without inspecting `textContent`.

---

## Rationale

- **Defense in depth**: Both the provider (used by the service worker's DOM watch cycle) and the
  domain-watch-adapter (used by tests and direct adapter consumers) apply the check independently.
- **Applied from day one**: The BN extension never shipped the buggy implementation, eliminating a
  whole class of false-negative watch events.
- **Session window criticality**: Blue Notary sessions can be available for as little as 154ms.
  A single false no-data report during this window causes a missed claim opportunity.

---

## Known Limitation

The `buttonSelector` is a CSS compound selector ending with `button,[role="button"]`. When
`:not([disabled])` is appended to this selector, CSS parsing rules apply it only to the final
clause (`[role="button"]`), not to the bare `button` clause. This means `<button disabled>` may
still satisfy the pre-check query.

In practice this does not cause problems because Blue Notary uses Quasar's `aria-disabled="true"`
attribute (not the native HTML `disabled` attribute) on inactive buttons. The `:not([aria-disabled="true"])`
clause correctly filters these out.

A complete fix would use `:is(${buttonSelector}):not([disabled]):not([aria-disabled="true"])` —
the `:is()` pseudo-class applies the `:not()` modifiers to the entire comma group. This change is
deferred since the current behavior is correct for production Blue Notary markup.

---

## Consequences

- `isNoData()` is slightly more expensive: one additional `querySelector` before the text check.
  Cost is negligible for MutationObserver-triggered checks (not a tight polling loop).
- Test coverage: `blue-notary-provider.test.ts` and `domain-watch-adapter.test.ts` both include a
  regression test for this behavior (`active-button pre-check` label).

```mermaid
        Container(inspectorWindow, "Inspector Window", "React/Vite", "Detached inspector (inspectorOnly mode)")
        Container(devtools, "DevTools Panel", "JS module", "Network event relay from devtools to extension")
        Container(serviceWorker, "Service Worker", "MV3 background", "Watch state machine, tab detection, diagnostics flush, webRequest listener")
        Container(contentScript, "Content Script", "IIFE", "DOM watch controller, inspector controller, page-bridge socket monitor")
    }

    System_Ext(blueNotary, "app.bluenotary.us")
    System_Ext(chromeStorage, "chrome.storage.local", "Persisted: settings, watch-state, inspector-runtime, recent-logs")

    Rel(notary, popup, "Quick actions")
    Rel(notary, sidepanel, "Full console")
    Rel(notary, inspectorWindow, "Detached inspector")
    Rel(popup, serviceWorker, "Messages: OPEN_QUEUE, START_WATCH, STOP_WATCH", "chrome.runtime.sendMessage")
    Rel(sidepanel, serviceWorker, "Messages: GET_STATE, UPDATE_SETTINGS, EXPORT_DATA", "chrome.runtime.sendMessage")
    Rel(serviceWorker, contentScript, "Messages: START_DOM_WATCH, STOP_DOM_WATCH, ATTACH_INSPECTOR", "chrome.tabs.sendMessage")
    Rel(contentScript, serviceWorker, "Events: DOM_WATCH_EVENT, WATCH_SESSION_HEARTBEAT, DOM_DELTA", "chrome.runtime.sendMessage")
    Rel(contentScript, blueNotary, "Observes DOM mutations, intercepts fetch/XHR/WS")
    Rel(serviceWorker, chromeStorage, "Read/write state and settings")
    Rel(serviceWorker, sidepanel, "STATE_UPDATED broadcast", "chrome.runtime.sendMessage")
    Rel(devtools, serviceWorker, "DEVTOOLS_NETWORK_EVENT relay", "chrome.runtime.sendMessage")
```

--- FILE: project: apps/chrome-extensions/blue-notary-extension/docs/diagrams/watch-flow.md ---
# Blue Notary Extension — Watch Cycle Sequence Diagram

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Op as Operator
    participant SP as Sidepanel
    participant SW as Service Worker
    participant CS as Content Script
    participant DOM as Blue Notary DOM

    Op->>SP: Click "Start Watch"
    SP->>SW: START_WATCH message

    SW->>SW: getBlueNotaryTab() — find https://app.bluenotary.us/*
    SW->>SW: WatchState → { status: 'watching' }
    SW->>CS: START_DOM_WATCH { config: watchConfig }
    SW-->>SP: STATE_UPDATED

    CS->>DOM: MutationObserver.observe(document.body)
    CS->>CS: createDomWatchController(document, watchConfig)

    loop DOM mutation detected
        DOM-->>CS: MutationObserver fires

        CS->>CS: resolveBlueNotaryWatchContainer()
        alt container not found
            CS->>SW: DOM_WATCH_EVENT { containerState: 'lost' }
        else container found
            CS->>CS: adapter.isNoData(container)
            note right of CS: active-button pre-check first
            alt isNoData = true
                CS->>SW: DOM_WATCH_EVENT { containerState: 'empty' }
            else candidates found
                CS->>CS: adapter.getCandidates(container)
                CS->>CS: filter by keywords (join as witness / pick up session)
                alt autoClaimEnabled = false
                    CS->>SW: DOM_WATCH_EVENT { containerState: 'has_candidates' }
                else autoClaimEnabled = true
                    CS->>CS: executeClaimWithFallbacks(candidate)
                    note right of CS: 1. direct-click<br/>2. selector-refresh-click<br/>3. coordinate-click
                    CS->>SW: DOM_WATCH_EVENT { containerState: 'claimed', clicked: true }
                    SW->>SW: acquireMutex() — block other tabs
                    SW->>SW: WatchState → { status: 'paused', lastResult: 'Blue Notary session confirmed' }
                end
            end
            CS->>SW: WATCH_SESSION_HEARTBEAT
        end
        SW-->>SP: STATE_UPDATED
    end

    Op->>SP: Click "Stop Watch"
    SP->>SW: STOP_WATCH message
    SW->>CS: STOP_DOM_WATCH
    CS->>DOM: MutationObserver.disconnect()
    SW->>SW: WatchState → { status: 'idle' }
    SW-->>SP: STATE_UPDATED
```

---

# isNoData() Decision Tree

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[isNoData called with container] --> B{Any non-disabled\ncandidate button?}
    B -->|Yes| C[return false\nQueue has active candidates]
    B -->|No| D{noDataSelector\nmatches?}
    D -->|Yes| E[return true\nExplicit no-data indicator]
    D -->|No| F{textContent includes\n'no data available' or\n'no open calls' or\n'no calls available'?}
    F -->|Yes| G[return true\nText-based no-data]
    F -->|No| H[return false\nNo evidence of empty queue]
```

# Blue Notary Extension — Phase Ledger

## Phase 1 — Plan (2026-03-20)

**Branch:** `feat/blue-notary-extension-phase-1-cursor-plan`

- Architecture mirrors proof-extension exactly; Blue Notary provider/adapter sourced from remote-Notary-Extension

# Blue Notary Extension — Sprint Status

## 2026-03-20 — All Phases Complete

**Status:** Done — Extension fully implemented, tested, and verified.

---

### Phase Summary

| Phase | Branch | Status | Key Output |
|-------|--------|--------|------------|
| 1 — Plan | `phase-1-cursor-plan` | Done | SDLC charter, task-state, handoff stubs |
| 2 — Scaffold | `phase-2-cursor-scaffold` | Done | Nx project, build pipeline, manifest |
| 3 — Platform | `phase-3-cursor-platform` | Done | BN provider, watch adapter, socket monitor |
| 4 — Core | `phase-4-cursor-core` | Done | Service worker, content script, watch engine |
| 5 — UI | `phase-5-cursor-ui` | Done | Popup, sidepanel, inspector-window, devtools |
| 6 — Tests | `phase-6-cursor-tests` | Done | 55 unit tests — 55/55 passing |
| 7 — Verify | same as phase-6 | Done | typecheck ✓ test ✓ build:dev ✓ validate-dist ✓ |
| 8 — Document | `phase-8-cursor-docs` | Done | ADRs, diagrams, final handoff docs |

---

### Verification Results (Phase 7)

```
pnpm exec nx run blue-notary-extension:typecheck   → PASS (0 errors)
pnpm exec nx run blue-notary-extension:test        → PASS (55/55)
pnpm exec nx run blue-notary-extension:build:dev   → PASS
pnpm exec nx run blue-notary-extension:validate-dist → PASS
```

---

### Wins

- Extension delivered in a single multi-session track — 8 phases, 1 day
- `isNoData()` active-button pre-check applied from day one (prevents false no-data events from CSS-hidden Quasar empty-state spans inside buttons)
- Full parity with `proof-extension` architecture — same watch engine, same inspector, same claim executor
- `autoClaimEnabled` defaults to `false` — operator must explicitly enable auto-claim
- Storage key isolation: `blue-notary-extension:*` (zero collision risk with proof-extension)
- Type system completeness: `SchedulerState`, `TokenBucketSnapshot`, `SchedulerLeaseSummary` properly typed (not `any`)
- Heading-text fallback in container resolution guards against Quasar layout changes

### Type Discoveries (Phase 6)

When copying `platform-scheduler.ts` verbatim, three types (`SchedulerState`, `TokenBucketSnapshot`,
`SchedulerLeaseSummary`) and one factory (`createDefaultSchedulerState`) were missing from the BN extension's
type layer. These were added in Phase 6 without changing the module under test. The `PauseReason` union was
also extended with `'rate_limit'` to match what `platform-scheduler.ts` returns.

### Blockers Encountered

- None — all phases completed without external blockers.

---

### Next Actions for Future Sessions

1. **E2E smoke test** — Run headed Playwright once a Blue Notary account is available:
   ```bash
   pnpm exec nx run blue-notary-extension:e2e -- --grep "Blue Notary watch|Blue Notary claim|Blue Notary inspector"
   ```
2. **Shared lib extraction** — If `claim-executor.ts`, `platform-scheduler.ts`, or `watch-session-state.ts`
   diverge between `proof-extension` and `blue-notary-extension`, extract to `libs/notary-watch-core`.
3. **isNoData() compound selector fix** — Consider wrapping the full comma-separated button selector in
   parentheses (`:is(...)`) to ensure `:not([disabled])` applies to all clauses, not just the last one.
4. **Production build** — `pnpm exec nx run blue-notary-extension:build:prod` before Chrome Web Store upload.

==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/apps/chrome-extensions/blue-notary-extension/scripts/build-manifest.js ====
import { writeFileSync, existsSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync } from 'fs';
import { join, dirname } from 'path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'url';

const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
const __dirname = dirname(__filename);

function buildManifest(config) {
  const manifest = {
    manifest_version: 3,
    name: config.name,
    version: config.version,
    description: config.description,
  };

  if (config.key) {
    manifest.key = config.key;
  }

  if (config.permissions?.length) {
    manifest.permissions = config.permissions;
  }

  if (config.hostPermissions?.length) {
    manifest.host_permissions = config.hostPermissions;
  }

  manifest.background = {
    service_worker: 'service_worker/index.js',
    type: 'module',
  };

  manifest.content_scripts = config.contentScripts.map(script => ({
    matches: script.matches,
    js: script.js,
    run_at: script.runAt || 'document_idle',
    world: script.world || 'ISOLATED',
    all_frames: script.allFrames ?? false,
  }));

  manifest.side_panel = {
    default_path: config.sidePanel.defaultPath,
  };

  manifest.web_accessible_resources = [
    {
      resources: config.webAccessibleResources,
      matches: ['<all_urls>'],
    },
  ];

  manifest.action = {
    default_title: config.name,
  };

  return manifest;
}

let manifestKey = null;
if (process.env.MANIFEST_KEY) {
  manifestKey = process.env.MANIFEST_KEY;
} else {
  const keyPubPath = join(__dirname, '../key.pub');
  if (existsSync(keyPubPath)) {
    try {
      const keyContent = readFileSync(keyPubPath, 'utf-8');
      manifestKey = keyContent
        .replace(/-----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY-----/g, '')
        .replace(/-----END PUBLIC KEY-----/g, '')
        .replace(/\n/g, '')
        .trim();
    } catch {
      console.warn('Could not read key.pub, manifest will not include key field');
    }
  }
}

const appConfig = {
  name: 'Blue Notary Extension',
  version: '1.0.0',
  description:
    'Reactive Blue Notary Open Calls observation, auto-claim, and optional inspector tooling.',
  key: manifestKey || undefined,
  permissions: ['storage', 'sidePanel', 'activeTab', 'scripting', 'tabs', 'webRequest', 'windows'],
  hostPermissions: ['https://app.bluenotary.us/*'],
  sidePanel: {
    defaultPath: 'sidepanel/index.html',
  },
  contentScripts: [
    {
      matches: ['https://app.bluenotary.us/*'],
      js: ['content.iife.js'],
      runAt: 'document_idle',
      world: 'ISOLATED',
      allFrames: false,
    },
  ],
  webAccessibleResources: ['chunks/*.js', 'assets/*', 'tokens.css'],
};

try {
  const manifest = buildManifest(appConfig);
  const distDir = join(__dirname, '../dist');
  if (!existsSync(distDir)) {
    mkdirSync(distDir, { recursive: true });
  }

  const manifestPath = join(distDir, 'manifest.json');
  writeFileSync(manifestPath, JSON.stringify(manifest, null, 2) + '\n');
  console.log('Manifest built successfully:', manifestPath);
} catch (error) {
  console.error('Failed to build manifest:', error);
  if (error instanceof Error) {
    console.error('Error message:', error.message);
    console.error('Stack:', error.stack);
  }
  process.exit(1);
}



==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/apps/chrome-extensions/blue-notary-extension/scripts/copy-assets.js ====
#!/usr/bin/env node

import { existsSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'fs';
import { readdirSync, statSync, copyFileSync } from 'fs';
import { join, dirname } from 'path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'url';

const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
const __dirname = dirname(__filename);
const projectRoot = join(__dirname, '..');
const distPath = join(projectRoot, 'dist');

if (!existsSync(distPath)) {
  mkdirSync(distPath, { recursive: true });
}

const popupDir = join(distPath, 'popup');
const sidepanelDir = join(distPath, 'sidepanel');
const inspectorWindowDir = join(distPath, 'inspector-window');

for (const dir of [popupDir, sidepanelDir, inspectorWindowDir]) {
  if (!existsSync(dir)) {
    mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  }
}

const htmlTargets = [
  ['popup/index.html', join(popupDir, 'index.html')],
  ['sidepanel/index.html', join(sidepanelDir, 'index.html')],
  ['inspector-window/index.html', join(inspectorWindowDir, 'index.html')],
];

for (const [sourceRelative, destPath] of htmlTargets) {
  const sourcePath = join(projectRoot, 'src', sourceRelative);
  if (!existsSync(sourcePath)) {
    continue;
  }
  const content = readFileSync(sourcePath, 'utf-8');
  writeFileSync(destPath, content, 'utf-8');
}

const tokensCss = join(distPath, 'tokens.css');
let tokensCopied = false;
const nodeModulesTokens = join(
  projectRoot,
  'node_modules',
  '@chrome-ext',
  'ui-design-tokens',
  'dist',
  'tokens.css'
);

if (existsSync(nodeModulesTokens)) {
  try {
    const content = readFileSync(nodeModulesTokens, 'utf-8');
    writeFileSync(tokensCss, content, 'utf-8');
    tokensCopied = true;
  } catch {
    tokensCopied = false;
  }
}

if (!tokensCopied) {
  const libsTokens = join(
    projectRoot,
    '..',
    '..',
    '..',
    'libs',
    'Google-Chrome-Extension-Library',
    'ui',
    'design-tokens',
    'src',
    'tokens.css'
  );
  if (existsSync(libsTokens)) {
    const content = readFileSync(libsTokens, 'utf-8');
    writeFileSync(tokensCss, content, 'utf-8');
  }
}

const assetsSource = join(projectRoot, 'src', 'assets');
const assetsDest = join(distPath, 'assets');
if (existsSync(assetsSource)) {
  if (!existsSync(assetsDest)) {
    mkdirSync(assetsDest, { recursive: true });
  }
  for (const file of readdirSync(assetsSource)) {
    const sourcePath = join(assetsSource, file);
    const destPath = join(assetsDest, file);
    if (statSync(sourcePath).isFile()) {
      copyFileSync(sourcePath, destPath);
    }
  }
}

#!/usr/bin/env node

import { existsSync } from 'fs';
import { join, dirname } from 'path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'url';

const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);

  console.error('Missing build artifacts:', missing);
  process.exit(1);

==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/apps/chrome-extensions/blue-notary-extension/scripts/watch-manifest.js ====
#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * Watch Manifest Script
 */

import { watch, existsSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'fs';
import { exec } from 'child_process';
import { promisify } from 'util';
import { join, dirname } from 'path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'url';

const execAsync = promisify(exec);
const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
const __dirname = dirname(__filename);
const projectRoot = join(__dirname, '..');
const distPath = join(projectRoot, 'dist');

let rebuildTimeout = null;

async function ensureDirs() {
  if (!existsSync(distPath)) {
    mkdirSync(distPath, { recursive: true });
  }
  const popupDir = join(distPath, 'popup');
  const sidepanelDir = join(distPath, 'sidepanel');
  const serviceWorkerDir = join(distPath, 'service_worker');

  if (!existsSync(popupDir)) mkdirSync(popupDir, { recursive: true });
  if (!existsSync(sidepanelDir)) mkdirSync(sidepanelDir, { recursive: true });
  if (!existsSync(serviceWorkerDir))
    mkdirSync(serviceWorkerDir, { recursive: true });

  return { popupDir, sidepanelDir };
}

async function rebuildManifest() {
  try {
    const { popupDir, sidepanelDir } = await ensureDirs();

    await execAsync('node scripts/build-manifest.js', { cwd: projectRoot });

    const popupHtml = join(projectRoot, 'src', 'popup', 'index.html');
    const sidepanelHtml = join(projectRoot, 'src', 'sidepanel', 'index.html');

    if (existsSync(popupHtml)) {
      const popupContent = readFileSync(popupHtml, 'utf-8');
      writeFileSync(join(popupDir, 'index.html'), popupContent, 'utf-8');
    }

    if (existsSync(sidepanelHtml)) {
      const sidepanelContent = readFileSync(sidepanelHtml, 'utf-8');
      writeFileSync(join(sidepanelDir, 'index.html'), sidepanelContent, 'utf-8');
    }

    await execAsync('node scripts/copy-assets.js', { cwd: projectRoot });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to rebuild manifest:', error);
  }
}

function debounceRebuild() {
  if (rebuildTimeout) {
    clearTimeout(rebuildTimeout);
  }
  rebuildTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
    rebuildManifest();
  }, 300);
}

console.log('Watching manifest and HTML assets...');
rebuildManifest();

watch(join(projectRoot, 'src'), { recursive: true }, (_event, filename) => {
  if (!filename) return;
  if (filename.endsWith('index.html')) {
    debounceRebuild();
  }
});

watch(join(projectRoot, 'scripts'), { recursive: true }, debounceRebuild);

==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/apps/chrome-extensions/blue-notary-extension/src/content.ts ====
import {
  highlightTargets,
  playNotificationChime,
  showVisualNotification,
} from '@chrome-ext/automation-notary';

import { MESSAGE_TYPES } from './constants.js';
import {
  createDomWatchController,
  type DomWatchController,
} from './content/watch-observer.js';
import {
  createDomInspectorController,
  type DomInspectorController,
} from './inspector/dom-inspector.js';
import type { PlatformNetworkSnapshot } from './platforms/types.js';
import { installBlueNotaryPageMonitor } from './socket/blue-notary-page-monitor.js';
import { createScopedWatchOverlayController } from './watch/watch-overlay-controller.js';

const watchOverlayController = createScopedWatchOverlayController();
const PAGE_MONITOR_SOURCE = 'REMOTE_NOTARY_PAGE_MONITOR';

// AudioContext autoplay gate — Chrome blocks AudioContext until a user gesture.
// Set to true on first interaction so playNotificationChime can be called safely.
let audioCtxUnlocked = false;
document.addEventListener('click', () => { audioCtxUnlocked = true; }, { once: true, capture: true });
document.addEventListener('keydown', () => { audioCtxUnlocked = true; }, { once: true, capture: true });
document.addEventListener('pointerdown', () => { audioCtxUnlocked = true; }, { once: true, capture: true });

let domWatchController: DomWatchController | null = null;
let domInspectorController: DomInspectorController | null = null;
let highlightCleanup: (() => void) | null = null;

function getErrorMessage(error: unknown): string {
  return error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
}

function sendReady(): void {
  try {
    chrome.runtime.sendMessage({
      type: MESSAGE_TYPES.CONTENT_READY,
      url: window.location.href,
    });
  } catch {
    /* extension may be reloading */
  }
}

async function startDomWatch(payload: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<void> {
  domWatchController?.stop();
  domWatchController = null;
  // Drain any pending microtasks from the stopped controller before
  // creating a new one. This prevents a double-controller race where
  // a fresh controller starts with lastClaimAt = 0 while the old
  // controller's pending evaluateClaimOpportunity is still in flight.
  await Promise.resolve();
  installBlueNotaryPageMonitor({
    enabled: true,
    mode:
      payload.claimMode === 'api'
        ? 'observe-api-eligibility'
        : payload.claimMode === 'race'
          ? 'opt-in-auto-claim'
          : 'observe-only',
    deepTrace: Boolean(payload.deepTraceEnabled),
  });
  domWatchController = createDomWatchController(
    document,
    {
      platformId: 'blue-notary',
      containerSelector:
        typeof payload.containerSelector === 'string' ? payload.containerSelector : '',
      buttonSelector:
        typeof payload.buttonSelector === 'string' ? payload.buttonSelector : undefined,
      headingText:
        typeof payload.headingText === 'string' ? payload.headingText : undefined,
      noDataSelector:
        typeof payload.noDataSelector === 'string' ? payload.noDataSelector : undefined,
      keywords: Array.isArray(payload.keywords)
        ? payload.keywords.filter((value): value is string => typeof value === 'string')
        : undefined,
      includeSnapshot: Boolean(payload.includeSnapshot),
      runId: typeof payload.runId === 'string' ? payload.runId : undefined,
      sessionId:
        typeof payload.sessionId === 'string' ? payload.sessionId : undefined,
      claimCooldownMs:
        typeof payload.claimCooldownMs === 'number'
          ? payload.claimCooldownMs
          : undefined,
      enableDomDeltaProbe: Boolean(payload.enableDomDeltaProbe),
      networkSnapshot:
        payload.networkSnapshot &&
        typeof payload.networkSnapshot === 'object' &&
        typeof (payload.networkSnapshot as PlatformNetworkSnapshot).source === 'string'
          ? (payload.networkSnapshot as PlatformNetworkSnapshot)
          : undefined,
      autoClaim: payload.autoClaim !== false,
    },
    {
      onEvent: event => {
        chrome.runtime.sendMessage({
          type: MESSAGE_TYPES.DOM_WATCH_EVENT,
          payload: event,
        });
      },
      onClaimAttempt: event => {
        chrome.runtime.sendMessage({
          type: MESSAGE_TYPES.WATCH_CLAIM_ATTEMPT,
          payload: event,
        });
      },
      onHeartbeat: event => {
        chrome.runtime.sendMessage({
          type: MESSAGE_TYPES.WATCH_SESSION_HEARTBEAT,
          payload: event,
        });
      },
      onInteraction: event => {
        chrome.runtime.sendMessage({
          type: MESSAGE_TYPES.INSPECTOR_INTERACTION_EVENT,
          payload: event,
        });
      },
      onDomDelta: entries => {
        chrome.runtime.sendMessage({
          type: MESSAGE_TYPES.WATCH_DOM_DELTA,
          payload: entries,
        });
      },
    }
  );
}

function startDomInspector(payload: Record<string, unknown>): void {
  domInspectorController?.stop();
  domInspectorController = createDomInspectorController(
    document,
    {
      selectedRoots: Array.isArray(payload.selectedRoots)
        ? payload.selectedRoots.filter((value): value is string => typeof value === 'string')
        : [],
      includeCharacterData: Boolean(payload.includeCharacterData),
      styleDiffEnabled: Boolean(payload.styleDiffEnabled),
      runId: typeof payload.runId === 'string' ? payload.runId : undefined,
      platform: 'blue-notary',
      tabId: typeof payload.tabId === 'number' ? payload.tabId : undefined,
    },
    {
      onDomEvent: event => {
        chrome.runtime.sendMessage({
          type: MESSAGE_TYPES.INSPECTOR_DOM_EVENT,
          payload: event,
        });
      },
    }
  );
}

chrome.runtime.onMessage.addListener((message: any, _sender: any, sendResponse: any) => {
  const payload =
    message?.payload && typeof message.payload === 'object' ? message.payload : {};

  switch (message?.type) {
    case MESSAGE_TYPES.SHOW_WATCH_OVERLAY: {
      const options = {
        document,
        containerSelector:
          typeof payload.containerSelector === 'string' ? payload.containerSelector : '',
        targetSelector:
          typeof payload.targetSelector === 'string' ? payload.targetSelector : undefined,
        headingText:
          typeof payload.headingText === 'string' ? payload.headingText : undefined,
        label: typeof payload.label === 'string' ? payload.label : undefined,
        statusText:
          typeof payload.statusText === 'string' ? payload.statusText : undefined,
      };

      if (watchOverlayController.isMounted()) {
        watchOverlayController.update(options);
      } else {
        watchOverlayController.mount(options);
      }

      sendResponse({ ok: true });
      return true;
    }

    case MESSAGE_TYPES.HIDE_WATCH_OVERLAY: {
      watchOverlayController.unmount();
      sendResponse({ ok: true });
      return true;
    }

    case MESSAGE_TYPES.HIGHLIGHT_WATCH: {
      highlightCleanup?.();
      highlightCleanup = highlightTargets(
        typeof payload.containerSelector === 'string' ? payload.containerSelector : '',
        typeof payload.targetSelector === 'string' ? payload.targetSelector : undefined,
        document
      );

      const durationMs =
        typeof payload.durationMs === 'number' ? payload.durationMs : 1800;
      globalThis.setTimeout(() => {
        highlightCleanup?.();
        highlightCleanup = null;
      }, durationMs);

      sendResponse({ ok: true });
      return true;
    }

    case MESSAGE_TYPES.START_DOM_WATCH:
      void startDomWatch(payload).then(() => { sendResponse({ ok: true }); });
      return true;

    case MESSAGE_TYPES.STOP_DOM_WATCH:
      domWatchController?.stop();
      domWatchController = null;
      sendResponse({ ok: true });
      return true;

    case MESSAGE_TYPES.START_DOM_INSPECTOR:
      startDomInspector(payload);
      sendResponse({ ok: true });
      return true;

    case MESSAGE_TYPES.STOP_DOM_INSPECTOR:
      domInspectorController?.stop();
      domInspectorController = null;
      sendResponse({ ok: true });
      return true;

    case MESSAGE_TYPES.TEST_SOUND:
      if (!audioCtxUnlocked) {
        sendResponse({ ok: false, error: 'AudioContext not yet unlocked — requires a user gesture first' });
        return true;
      }
      playNotificationChime(
        {
          repeat:
            typeof payload.repeat === 'number' ? payload.repeat : 1,
        },
        document
      )
        .then(() => sendResponse({ ok: true }))
        .catch(error =>
          sendResponse({ ok: false, error: getErrorMessage(error) })
        );
      return true;

    case MESSAGE_TYPES.TEST_NOTIFICATION:
      showVisualNotification(
        {
          message:
            typeof payload.message === 'string'
              ? payload.message
              : 'Blue Notary notification test',
        },
        document
      )
        .then(() => sendResponse({ ok: true }))
        .catch(error =>
          sendResponse({ ok: false, error: getErrorMessage(error) })
        );
      return true;

    default:
      return false;
  }
});

window.addEventListener('message', event => {
  if (event.source !== window) {
    return;
  }

  const payload = event.data;
  if (!payload || payload.source !== PAGE_MONITOR_SOURCE) {
    return;
  }

  if (payload.type === 'network') {
    chrome.runtime.sendMessage({
      type: MESSAGE_TYPES.INSPECTOR_NETWORK_EVENT,
      payload: payload.payload,
    }).catch(() => {});
    chrome.runtime.sendMessage({
      type: MESSAGE_TYPES.CLAIM_INVOCATION_EVENT,
      payload: payload.payload,
    }).catch(() => {});
    return;
  }

  if (payload.type === 'socket') {
    chrome.runtime.sendMessage({
      type: MESSAGE_TYPES.SOCKET_MONITOR_EVENT,
      payload: payload.payload,
    }).catch(() => {});
  }
});

if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
  window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', sendReady, { once: true });
} else {
  sendReady();
}



==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/apps/chrome-extensions/blue-notary-extension/src/content/watch-observer.ts ====

export interface WatchClaimAttemptEvent {

  success: boolean;
  reasonCode: string;
  buttonText?: string;
  candidateSelector?: string;
}

export interface WatchHeartbeatEvent {
  heartbeatAt: string;
  runId?: string;
  sessionId?: string;
  platform?: PlatformId;
  reasonCode: 'watch_started' | 'reconnect' | 'container_resolved';
}

export interface DomWatchCallbacks {
  onEvent: (event: DomWatchEvent) => void;
  onClaimAttempt?: (event: WatchClaimAttemptEvent) => void;
  onHeartbeat?: (event: WatchHeartbeatEvent) => void;
  onInteraction?: (event: ObservedInteractionEvent) => void;
  onDomDelta?: (entries: DomDeltaEntry[]) => void;
}

export interface DomWatchController {
  stop: () => void;
  reconnect: () => void;
}

const MAX_SNAPSHOT_LENGTH = 20000;
const DEFAULT_CLAIM_COOLDOWN_MS = 400;
const MIN_EVALUATION_INTERVAL_MS = 100;
const WATCH_ATTRIBUTE_FILTER = [
  'class',
  'style',
  'hidden',
  'disabled',
  'aria-disabled',
  'aria-hidden',
];

function getSnapshotHtml(container: Element): string {
  const html = container.outerHTML;
  if (html.length <= MAX_SNAPSHOT_LENGTH) {
    return html;
  }
  return html.slice(0, MAX_SNAPSHOT_LENGTH);
}

function normalizeCallbacks(
  callbacksOrOnEvent:
    | DomWatchCallbacks
    | ((event: DomWatchEvent) => void)
): DomWatchCallbacks {
  if (typeof callbacksOrOnEvent === 'function') {
    return { onEvent: callbacksOrOnEvent };
  }
  return callbacksOrOnEvent;
}

function emitClaimAttempt(
  callbacks: DomWatchCallbacks,
  config: DomWatchConfig,
  attempt: ClaimAttemptTelemetry
): void {
  callbacks.onClaimAttempt?.({
    attemptedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    runId: config.runId,
    sessionId: config.sessionId,
    platform: config.platformId,
    strategy: attempt.strategy,
    success: attempt.success,
    reasonCode: attempt.reasonCode,
    buttonText: attempt.buttonText,
    candidateSelector: attempt.candidateSelector,
  });
}

function getAncestryFingerprint(element: HTMLElement): string[] {
  const result: string[] = [];
  let current: HTMLElement | null = element;
  while (current && result.length < 5) {
    let label = current.tagName.toLowerCase();
    if (current.id) {
      label += `#${current.id}`;
    } else if (current.classList.length > 0) {
      label += `.${Array.from(current.classList).slice(0, 2).join('.')}`;
    }
    result.unshift(label);
    current = current.parentElement;
  }
  return result;
}

function buildInteractionEvent(
  config: DomWatchConfig,
  candidate: WatchCandidateDescriptor,
  strategy: WatchClaimStrategy
): ObservedInteractionEvent {
  const rect = candidate.element.getBoundingClientRect();
  return buildObservedInteractionEvent({
    platform: config.platformId,
    runId: config.runId,
    selectorFingerprint: candidate.selector,
    tag: candidate.element.tagName.toLowerCase(),
    text: candidate.text,
    rect: {
      x: rect.x,
      y: rect.y,
      width: rect.width,
      height: rect.height,
    },
    pointerSequenceSummary:
      strategy === 'coordinate-click'
        ? ['mousemove', 'mousedown', 'mouseup']
        : ['click'],
    ancestryFingerprint: getAncestryFingerprint(candidate.element),
  });
}

export function resolveWatchContainer(
  documentRef: Document,
  containerSelector: string,
  headingText?: string,
  platformId: PlatformId = 'blue-notary'
): Element | null {
  const provider = getPlatformProvider();
  return provider
    .createAdapter(documentRef, {
      platformId,
      containerSelector,
      buttonSelector: 'button,[role="button"]',
      headingText,
      label: 'WATCHING',
    })
    .resolveContainer();
}

export function createDomWatchController(
  documentRef: Document,
  config: DomWatchConfig,
  callbacksOrOnEvent: DomWatchCallbacks | ((event: DomWatchEvent) => void)
): DomWatchController {
  const callbacks = normalizeCallbacks(callbacksOrOnEvent);
  const platformId = config.platformId ?? 'blue-notary';
  const provider = getPlatformProvider();
  const adapter = provider.createAdapter(documentRef, {
    platformId,
    containerSelector: config.containerSelector,
    buttonSelector: config.buttonSelector,
    headingText: config.headingText,
    noDataSelector: config.noDataSelector,
    keywords: config.keywords,
    label: 'WATCHING',
    networkSnapshot: config.networkSnapshot,
    autoClaim: config.autoClaim,
  });
  const claimCooldownMs = Math.max(
    0,
    config.claimCooldownMs ?? DEFAULT_CLAIM_COOLDOWN_MS
  );

  let observer: MutationObserver | null = null;
  let rootObserver: MutationObserver | null = null;
  let intersectionObserver: IntersectionObserver | null = null;
  let resizeObserver: ResizeObserver | null = null;
  let observedContainer: Element | null = null;
  let pendingCheck = false;
  let stopped = false;
  let lastClaimAt = 0;
  let lastContainerState: DomWatchEvent['containerState'] = 'lost';
  let pendingReason:
    | 'watch_started'
    | 'reconnect'
    | 'container_resolved'
    | 'change_detected'
    | null = null;
  let lastEvaluationAt = 0;
  let evaluationTimer: number | null = null;
  let evaluationFrame: number | null = null;
  let containerVisible = true;

  const emitEvent = (
    reasonCode: DomWatchEvent['reasonCode'],
    options: {
      containerState: DomWatchEvent['containerState'];
      clicked?: boolean;
      buttonText?: string;
      buttonCount?: number;
      snapshotContainer?: Element;
      candidateSelector?: string;
      activeSessionDetected?: boolean;
      inQueueDetected?: boolean;
      pauseReason?: PauseReason | null;
    }
  ) => {
    const snapshotContainer = options.snapshotContainer;
    callbacks.onEvent({
      detectedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      clicked: Boolean(options.clicked),
      buttonText: options.buttonText,
      buttonCount: options.buttonCount ?? 0,
      snapshotHtml:
        config.includeSnapshot && snapshotContainer
          ? getSnapshotHtml(snapshotContainer)
          : undefined,
      runId: config.runId,
      sessionId: config.sessionId,
      platform: platformId,
      reasonCode,
      containerState: options.containerState,
      candidateSelector: options.candidateSelector,
      activeSessionDetected: options.activeSessionDetected,
      inQueueDetected: options.inQueueDetected,
      pauseReason: options.pauseReason,
    });
  };

  const emitHeartbeat = (reasonCode: WatchHeartbeatEvent['reasonCode']) => {
    callbacks.onHeartbeat?.({
      heartbeatAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      runId: config.runId,
      sessionId: config.sessionId,
      platform: platformId,
      reasonCode,
    });
  };

  const emitDomDeltas = (mutations: MutationRecord[]) => {
    if (!config.enableDomDeltaProbe || mutations.length === 0) {
      return;
    }
    const entries: DomDeltaEntry[] = mutations.map(mutation => ({
      recordedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      runId: config.runId,
      sessionId: config.sessionId,
      mutationType: mutation.type,
      addedNodes: mutation.addedNodes.length,
      removedNodes: mutation.removedNodes.length,
      attributeName: mutation.attributeName ?? undefined,
      targetTag:
        mutation.target instanceof HTMLElement
          ? mutation.target.tagName.toLowerCase()
          : undefined,
    }));
    callbacks.onDomDelta?.(entries);
  };

  const flushObserverRecords = (target: MutationObserver | null) => {
    if (!target) {
      return;
    }
    emitDomDeltas(target.takeRecords());
  };

  const disconnectObserver = () => {
    flushObserverRecords(observer);
    observer?.disconnect();
    rootObserver?.takeRecords();
    intersectionObserver?.disconnect();
    resizeObserver?.disconnect();
    observer = null;
    intersectionObserver = null;
    resizeObserver = null;
    observedContainer = null;
    containerVisible = true;
  };

  const attachObserver = () => {
    const container = adapter.resolveContainer();
    if (!container) {
      disconnectObserver();
      return false;
    }

    if (observer && observedContainer === container) {
      return true;
    }

    disconnectObserver();
    observedContainer = container;
    observer = new MutationObserver(mutations => {
      emitDomDeltas(mutations);
      scheduleEvaluate('change_detected');
    });
    observer.observe(container, {
      childList: true,
      subtree: true,
      attributes: true,
      attributeFilter: WATCH_ATTRIBUTE_FILTER,
    });

    if (typeof IntersectionObserver === 'function') {
      intersectionObserver = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
        const nextVisible = Boolean(entries[0]?.isIntersecting);
        if (containerVisible !== nextVisible) {
          containerVisible = nextVisible;
          scheduleEvaluate('change_detected');
        }
      });
      intersectionObserver.observe(container);
    }

    if (typeof ResizeObserver === 'function') {
      resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => {
        scheduleEvaluate('change_detected');
      });
      resizeObserver.observe(container);
    }

    return true;
  };

  const evaluate = (
    reasonCode:
      | 'watch_started'
      | 'reconnect'
      | 'container_resolved'
      | 'change_detected'
  ) => {
    pendingCheck = false;
    if (stopped) {
      return;
    }

    const activeSessionDetected = adapter.detectActiveSession();
    const pauseReason = adapter.detectPausedReason();
    const container = adapter.resolveContainer();
    const inQueueDetected = adapter.detectInQueue();

    if (!container) {
      if (lastContainerState !== 'lost') {
        emitEvent('container_lost', {
          containerState: 'lost',
          activeSessionDetected,
          inQueueDetected,
          pauseReason,
        });
      }
      lastContainerState = 'lost';
      disconnectObserver();
      return;
    }

    attachObserver();

    if (lastContainerState === 'lost') {
      emitHeartbeat(reasonCode === 'change_detected' ? 'container_resolved' : reasonCode);
      emitEvent('container_resolved', {
        containerState: 'resolved',
        snapshotContainer: container,
        activeSessionDetected,
        inQueueDetected,
        pauseReason,
      });
    }

    if (adapter.isNoData(container)) {
      lastContainerState = 'no-data';
      emitEvent('no_data', {
        containerState: 'no-data',
        snapshotContainer: container,
        activeSessionDetected,
        inQueueDetected,
        pauseReason,
      });
      return;
    }

    const candidates = adapter.getCandidates(container);
    const primaryCandidate: WatchCandidateDescriptor | null = candidates[0] ?? null;
    lastContainerState = 'resolved';

    if (!primaryCandidate) {
      emitEvent(reasonCode, {
        containerState: 'resolved',
        snapshotContainer: container,
        activeSessionDetected,
        inQueueDetected,
        pauseReason,
      });
      return;
    }

    if (config.autoClaim === false || !containerVisible) {
      emitEvent('candidate_detected', {
        containerState: 'resolved',
        buttonText: primaryCandidate.text,
        buttonCount: candidates.length,
        snapshotContainer: container,
        candidateSelector: primaryCandidate.selector,
        activeSessionDetected,
        inQueueDetected,
        pauseReason,
      });
      return;
    }

    const now = Date.now();
    if (now - lastClaimAt < claimCooldownMs) {
      emitEvent('cooldown_active', {
        containerState: 'resolved',
        buttonText: primaryCandidate.text,
        buttonCount: candidates.length,
        snapshotContainer: container,
        candidateSelector: primaryCandidate.selector,
        activeSessionDetected,
        inQueueDetected,
        pauseReason,
      });
      return;
    }

    lastClaimAt = now;
    const claimResult = executeClaimWithFallbacks({
      document: documentRef,
      adapter,
      candidate: primaryCandidate,
      buttonText: primaryCandidate.text,
      onAttempt: attempt => emitClaimAttempt(callbacks, config, attempt),
    });

    if (claimResult.success) {
      callbacks.onInteraction?.(
        buildInteractionEvent(
          config,
          adapter.findRefreshedCandidate(claimResult.buttonText) ?? primaryCandidate,
          claimResult.strategy
        )
      );
    }

    emitEvent(claimResult.success ? 'claim_success' : 'claim_failed', {
      containerState: 'resolved',
      clicked: claimResult.success,
      buttonText: claimResult.buttonText ?? primaryCandidate.text,
      buttonCount: candidates.length,
      snapshotContainer: container,
      candidateSelector:
        claimResult.candidateSelector ?? primaryCandidate.selector,
      activeSessionDetected,
      inQueueDetected,
      pauseReason,
    });
  };

  const mergeReason = (
    current:
      | 'watch_started'
      | 'reconnect'
      | 'container_resolved'
      | 'change_detected'
      | null,
    next:
      | 'watch_started'
      | 'reconnect'
      | 'container_resolved'
      | 'change_detected'
  ) => {
    if (!current) {
      return next;
    }
    const priority = {
      watch_started: 0,
      reconnect: 1,
      container_resolved: 2,
      change_detected: 3,
    } as const;
    return priority[next] < priority[current] ? next : current;
  };

  const clearScheduledEvaluation = () => {
    if (evaluationTimer !== null) {
      globalThis.clearTimeout(evaluationTimer);
      evaluationTimer = null;
    }
    if (
      evaluationFrame !== null &&
      typeof globalThis.cancelAnimationFrame === 'function'
    ) {
      globalThis.cancelAnimationFrame(evaluationFrame);
      evaluationFrame = null;
    }
  };

  const runScheduledEvaluate = () => {
    evaluationFrame = null;
    pendingCheck = false;
    if (stopped) {
      return;
    }
    const reason = pendingReason ?? 'change_detected';
    pendingReason = null;
    lastEvaluationAt = Date.now();
    evaluate(reason);
    if (pendingReason && !stopped) {
      scheduleEvaluate(pendingReason);
    }
  };

  const queueEvaluateFrame = () => {
    if (stopped || evaluationFrame !== null) {
      return;
    }
    if (typeof globalThis.requestAnimationFrame === 'function') {
      evaluationFrame = globalThis.requestAnimationFrame(() => runScheduledEvaluate());
      return;
    }
    evaluationTimer = globalThis.setTimeout(() => {
      evaluationTimer = null;
      runScheduledEvaluate();
    }, 0) as unknown as number;
  };

  const scheduleEvaluate = (
    reasonCode:
      | 'watch_started'
      | 'reconnect'
      | 'container_resolved'
      | 'change_detected'
  ) => {
    if (stopped) {
      return;
    }
    pendingReason = mergeReason(pendingReason, reasonCode);
    if (pendingCheck) {
      return;
    }
    pendingCheck = true;
    const delay = Math.max(
      0,
      MIN_EVALUATION_INTERVAL_MS - (Date.now() - lastEvaluationAt)
    );
    if (delay > 0) {
      evaluationTimer = globalThis.setTimeout(() => {
        evaluationTimer = null;
        queueEvaluateFrame();
      }, delay) as unknown as number;
      return;
    }
    queueEvaluateFrame();
  };

  const attachRootObserver = () => {
    flushObserverRecords(rootObserver);
    rootObserver?.disconnect();
    rootObserver = new MutationObserver(() => {
      if (stopped) {
        return;
      }

      const container = adapter.resolveContainer();
      if (!container) {
        if (lastContainerState !== 'lost') {
          scheduleEvaluate('change_detected');
        }
        return;
      }

      if (container !== observedContainer) {
        attachObserver();
        scheduleEvaluate('container_resolved');
      }
    });

    if (documentRef.documentElement) {
      rootObserver.observe(documentRef.documentElement, {
        childList: true,
        subtree: true,
      });
    }
  };

  const start = () => {
    attachRootObserver();
    attachObserver();
    emitHeartbeat('watch_started');
    scheduleEvaluate('watch_started');
  };

  const stop = () => {
    stopped = true;
    clearScheduledEvaluation();
    disconnectObserver();
    flushObserverRecords(rootObserver);
    rootObserver?.disconnect();
    rootObserver = null;
    pendingCheck = false;
    pendingReason = null;
  };

  const reconnect = () => {
    if (stopped) {
      return;
    }
    emitHeartbeat('reconnect');
    attachObserver();
    scheduleEvaluate('reconnect');
  };

  start();

  return {
    stop,
    reconnect,
  };
}

export interface CursorSimulationOptions {
  document: Document;
  selector: string;
  durationMs?: number;
  label?: string;
}

export interface CursorSimulationResult {
  selector: string;
  label: string;
  targetText: string;
  targetTagName: string;
  x: number;
  y: number;
}

const CURSOR_ID = 'proof-extension-virtual-cursor';
const LABEL_ID = 'proof-extension-virtual-cursor-label';

function getErrorMessage(error: unknown): string {
  return error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
}

function removeCursorArtifacts(document: Document): void {
  document.getElementById(CURSOR_ID)?.remove();
  document.getElementById(LABEL_ID)?.remove();
}

function createCursorArtifacts(document: Document, label: string): {
  cursor: HTMLDivElement;
  badge: HTMLDivElement;
} {
  removeCursorArtifacts(document);

  const cursor = document.createElement('div');
  cursor.id = CURSOR_ID;
  cursor.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
  Object.assign(cursor.style, {
    position: 'fixed',
    left: '0px',
    top: '0px',
    width: '18px',
    height: '18px',
    borderRadius: '999px',
    background: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #111827 0%, #2563eb 100%)',
    border: '2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.92)',
    boxShadow: '0 10px 24px rgba(15,23,42,0.35)',
    pointerEvents: 'none',
    transform: 'translate(-50%, -50%)',
    zIndex: '2147483647',
    transition: 'opacity 120ms ease',
  } satisfies Partial<CSSStyleDeclaration>);

  const badge = document.createElement('div');
  badge.id = LABEL_ID;
  badge.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
  badge.textContent = label;
  Object.assign(badge.style, {
    position: 'fixed',
    left: '0px',
    top: '0px',
    padding: '6px 10px',
    borderRadius: '999px',
    background: 'rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.92)',
    color: '#f8fafc',
    fontSize: '12px',
    fontWeight: '600',
    letterSpacing: '0.02em',
    whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
    pointerEvents: 'none',
    boxShadow: '0 8px 18px rgba(15,23,42,0.28)',
    zIndex: '2147483647',
    transform: 'translate(14px, -30px)',
    transition: 'opacity 120ms ease',
  } satisfies Partial<CSSStyleDeclaration>);

  const body = document.body ?? document.documentElement;
  body.appendChild(cursor);
  body.appendChild(badge);
  return { cursor, badge };
}

function setCursorPosition(
  cursor: HTMLElement,
  badge: HTMLElement,
  x: number,
  y: number
): void {
  cursor.style.left = `${x}px`;
  cursor.style.top = `${y}px`;
  badge.style.left = `${x}px`;
  badge.style.top = `${y}px`;
}

function getAnimationFrame(windowRef: Window): (callback: FrameRequestCallback) => number {
  if (typeof windowRef.requestAnimationFrame === 'function') {
    return windowRef.requestAnimationFrame.bind(windowRef);
  }
  return callback =>
    windowRef.setTimeout(() => callback(Date.now()), 16) as unknown as number;
}

async function animateCursor(
  windowRef: Window,
  cursor: HTMLElement,
  badge: HTMLElement,
  startX: number,
  startY: number,
  endX: number,
  endY: number,
  durationMs: number
): Promise<void> {
  setCursorPosition(cursor, badge, startX, startY);

  if (durationMs <= 0) {
    setCursorPosition(cursor, badge, endX, endY);
    return;
  }

  const requestFrame = getAnimationFrame(windowRef);
  await new Promise<void>(resolve => {
    const startedAt = Date.now();
    const tick = () => {
      const elapsed = Date.now() - startedAt;
      const progress = Math.min(1, elapsed / durationMs);
      const eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - progress, 3);
      const nextX = startX + (endX - startX) * eased;
      const nextY = startY + (endY - startY) * eased;
      setCursorPosition(cursor, badge, nextX, nextY);
      if (progress >= 1) {
        resolve();
        return;
      }
      requestFrame(tick);
    };
    requestFrame(tick);
  });
}

function dispatchMouseEvent(
  document: Document,
  target: Element,
  type: 'mousemove' | 'mousedown' | 'mouseup' | 'click',
  x: number,
  y: number
): void {
  const windowRef = document.defaultView ?? window;
  target.dispatchEvent(
    new windowRef.MouseEvent(type, {
      bubbles: true,
      cancelable: true,
      composed: true,
      clientX: x,
      clientY: y,
      button: 0,
      buttons: type === 'mousedown' ? 1 : 0,
    })
  );
}

export async function simulateCursorSequence(
  options: CursorSimulationOptions
): Promise<CursorSimulationResult> {
  const { document, label = 'Cursor Simulation' } = options;
  const selector = options.selector.trim();
  if (!selector) {
    throw new Error('Selector is required for cursor simulation');
  }

  const target = document.querySelector(selector);
  if (!(target instanceof HTMLElement)) {
    throw new Error(`Cursor simulation target not found for selector "${selector}"`);
  }

  const rect = target.getBoundingClientRect();
  const x = rect.left + rect.width / 2;
  const y = rect.top + rect.height / 2;
  const windowRef = document.defaultView ?? window;
  const startX = Math.max(24, Math.min(64, windowRef.innerWidth * 0.1 || 64));
  const startY = Math.max(24, Math.min(64, windowRef.innerHeight * 0.1 || 64));
  const { cursor, badge } = createCursorArtifacts(document, label);

  try {
    if (typeof target.scrollIntoView === 'function') {
      target.scrollIntoView({
        behavior: options.durationMs && options.durationMs > 0 ? 'smooth' : 'auto',
        block: 'center',
        inline: 'center',
      });
    }

    await animateCursor(
      windowRef,
      cursor,
      badge,
      startX,
      startY,
      x,
      y,
      Math.max(0, options.durationMs ?? 350)
    );

    const hitTarget =
      typeof document.elementFromPoint === 'function'
        ? document.elementFromPoint(x, y)
        : null;
    const eventTarget =
      hitTarget instanceof Element ? hitTarget : target;

    dispatchMouseEvent(document, eventTarget, 'mousemove', x, y);
    dispatchMouseEvent(document, eventTarget, 'mousedown', x, y);
    dispatchMouseEvent(document, eventTarget, 'mouseup', x, y);
    dispatchMouseEvent(document, eventTarget, 'click', x, y);

    return {
      selector,
      label,
      targetText: target.textContent?.trim() || '',
      targetTagName: target.tagName.toLowerCase(),
      x,
      y,
    };
  } catch (error) {
    throw new Error(getErrorMessage(error));
  } finally {
    removeCursorArtifacts(document);
  }
}

import { MESSAGE_TYPES } from '../constants.js';

function sanitizeHeaders(
  headers: { name: string; value?: string }[]
): Record<string, string> {
  const out: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const header of headers) {
    const name = header.name.toLowerCase();
    if (name === 'authorization') {
      out[header.name] = '[redacted]';
      continue;
    }
    if (name === 'cookie' || name === 'set-cookie') {
      out[header.name] = '[redacted]';
      continue;
    }
    out[header.name] = header.value ?? '';
  }
  return out;
}

function truncate(value: string, maxLength: number = 4096): string {
  if (value.length <= maxLength) return value;
  return value.slice(0, maxLength);
}

chrome.devtools.network.onRequestFinished.addListener(async (request: any) => {
  try {
    const bodyPreview = await new Promise<string | undefined>(resolve => {
      request.getContent((content: string) => {
        resolve(content ? truncate(content) : undefined);
      });
    });

    await chrome.runtime.sendMessage({
      type: MESSAGE_TYPES.DEVTOOLS_NETWORK_EVENT,
      payload: {
        source: 'devtools',
        tabId: chrome.devtools.inspectedWindow.tabId,
        recordedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        url: request.request.url,
        method: request.request.method,
        status: request.response.status,
        resourceType: request._resourceType || request.response.content.mimeType,
        requestHeaders: sanitizeHeaders(request.request.headers || []),
        responseHeaders: sanitizeHeaders(request.response.headers || []),
        requestBodyPreview:
          typeof request.request.postData?.text === 'string'
            ? truncate(request.request.postData.text)
            : undefined,
        responseBodyPreview: bodyPreview,
        initiator: request._initiator?.type,
        frameId: request._frameId,
        correlationKey: request.request.url,
      },
    });
  } catch {
    /* devtools capture is best-effort */
  }
});

import React from 'react';
import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client';

import { NotaryApp } from './sidepanel/NotaryApp.js';

const container = document.getElementById('root');
if (container) {
  const root = createRoot(container);
  root.render(<NotaryApp initialTab="inspector" inspectorOnly />);
}



==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/apps/chrome-extensions/blue-notary-extension/src/inspector/dom-inspector.ts ====
import type {
  ObservedDomEvent,
  ObservedInteractionEvent,
  ObservedRect,
} from './types.js';
import type { PlatformId } from '../platforms/types.js';

export interface DomInspectorConfig {
  selectedRoots: string[];
  includeCharacterData: boolean;
  styleDiffEnabled: boolean;
  runId?: string;
  platform?: PlatformId;
  tabId?: number;
}

export interface DomInspectorCallbacks {
  onDomEvent: (event: ObservedDomEvent) => void;
}

export interface DomInspectorController {
  stop: () => void;
}

const ATTRIBUTE_ALLOWLIST = [
  'class',
  'style',
  'hidden',
  'disabled',
] as const;

const STYLE_ALLOWLIST = [
  'display',
  'visibility',
  'opacity',
  'pointer-events',
  'color',
  'background-color',
  'border-color',
  'transform',
] as const;

function createId(prefix: string): string {
  return `${prefix}-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random()
    .toString(36)
    .slice(2, 8)}`;
}

function shouldCaptureAttribute(name: string | null): boolean {
  if (!name) return false;
  if (ATTRIBUTE_ALLOWLIST.includes(name as (typeof ATTRIBUTE_ALLOWLIST)[number])) {
    return true;
  }
  return name.startsWith('aria-') || name.startsWith('data-');
}

function getElementRect(target: Element | null): ObservedRect | undefined {
  if (!(target instanceof HTMLElement)) return undefined;
  const rect = target.getBoundingClientRect();
  return {
    x: rect.x,
    y: rect.y,
    width: rect.width,
    height: rect.height,
  };
}

function normalizeText(value: string | null | undefined): string | undefined {
  const next = (value ?? '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
  return next ? next.slice(0, 240) : undefined;
}

function buildSelectorFingerprint(element: Node | null): string {
  if (!(element instanceof Element)) return 'unknown';

  const segments: string[] = [];
  let current: Element | null = element;
  while (current && segments.length < 5) {
    let segment = current.tagName.toLowerCase();
    if (current.id) {
      segment += `#${current.id}`;
      segments.unshift(segment);
      break;
    }
    const testId = current.getAttribute('data-testid');
    if (testId) {
      segment += `[data-testid="${testId}"]`;
    } else if (current.classList.length > 0) {
      segment += `.${Array.from(current.classList).slice(0, 2).join('.')}`;
    }
    segments.unshift(segment);
    current = current.parentElement;
  }
  return segments.join(' > ');
}

function getContainerKey(element: Node | null): string | undefined {
  if (!(element instanceof Element)) return undefined;
  const section = element.closest('section, main, article, [data-testid*="queue"], [class*="queue"]');
  return section ? buildSelectorFingerprint(section) : undefined;
}

function snapshotStyles(target: HTMLElement): Record<string, string> {
  const computed = window.getComputedStyle(target);
  return Object.fromEntries(
    STYLE_ALLOWLIST.map(property => [property, computed.getPropertyValue(property)])
  );
}

function snapshotInlineStyles(target: HTMLElement): Record<string, string> {
  return Object.fromEntries(
    STYLE_ALLOWLIST.map(property => [property, target.style.getPropertyValue(property)])
  );
}

function diffStyles(
  previous: Record<string, string> | undefined,
  next: Record<string, string>,
  forceSnapshot: boolean
): Record<string, string> | undefined {
  if (!previous) return forceSnapshot ? next : undefined;
  const diff = Object.entries(next).reduce<Record<string, string>>((acc, [key, value]) => {
    if (previous[key] !== value) {
      acc[key] = value;
    }
    return acc;
  }, {});
  return Object.keys(diff).length > 0 ? diff : undefined;
}

function resolveRoots(documentRef: Document, selectors: string[]): Element[] {
  if (selectors.length === 0) {
    return documentRef.body ? [documentRef.body] : [];
  }

  const roots = selectors.flatMap(selector =>
    Array.from(documentRef.querySelectorAll(selector))
  );
  return roots.length > 0 ? roots : documentRef.body ? [documentRef.body] : [];
}

export function buildObservedInteractionEvent(
  input: {
    platform?: PlatformId;
    runId?: string;
    tabId?: number;
    selectorFingerprint: string;
    tag?: string;
    text?: string;
    rect?: ObservedRect;
    pointerSequenceSummary: string[];
    modifierKeys?: string[];
    ancestryFingerprint?: string[];
  }
): ObservedInteractionEvent {
  return {
    eventId: createId('interaction'),
    platform: input.platform,
    runId: input.runId,
    tabId: input.tabId,
    recordedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    selectorFingerprint: input.selectorFingerprint,
    tag: input.tag,
    text: input.text,
    rect: input.rect,
    pointerSequenceSummary: input.pointerSequenceSummary,
    modifierKeys: input.modifierKeys,
    ancestryFingerprint: input.ancestryFingerprint,
  };
}

export function createDomInspectorController(
  documentRef: Document,
  config: DomInspectorConfig,
  callbacks: DomInspectorCallbacks
): DomInspectorController {
  const styleCache = new WeakMap<HTMLElement, Record<string, string>>();
  const observer = new MutationObserver(records => {
    processRecords(records);
  });

  function toEvent(mutation: MutationRecord): ObservedDomEvent | null {
    if (mutation.type === 'attributes' && !shouldCaptureAttribute(mutation.attributeName)) {
      return null;
    }

    const target = mutation.target instanceof Element ? mutation.target : null;
    const styleDiff =
      config.styleDiffEnabled && target instanceof HTMLElement
        ? diffStyles(
            styleCache.get(target),
            mutation.attributeName === 'style'
              ? snapshotInlineStyles(target)
              : snapshotStyles(target),
            mutation.attributeName === 'style'
          )
        : undefined;

    if (target instanceof HTMLElement && config.styleDiffEnabled) {
      styleCache.set(target, snapshotStyles(target));
    }

    return {
      eventId: createId('dom'),
      tabId: config.tabId,
      platform: config.platform,
      runId: config.runId,
      recordedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      mutationType: mutation.type,
      selectorFingerprint: buildSelectorFingerprint(target),
      targetTag: target?.tagName?.toLowerCase(),
      textPreview:
        mutation.type === 'characterData'
          ? normalizeText(mutation.target.textContent)
          : normalizeText(target?.textContent),
      attributesChanged: mutation.attributeName ? [mutation.attributeName] : undefined,
      styleDiff,
      rect: getElementRect(target),
      containerKey: getContainerKey(target),
    };
  }

  function processRecords(records: MutationRecord[]) {
    for (const mutation of records) {
      const event = toEvent(mutation);
      if (event) {
        callbacks.onDomEvent(event);
      }
    }
  }

  for (const root of resolveRoots(documentRef, config.selectedRoots)) {
    observer.observe(root, {
      childList: true,
      subtree: true,
      attributes: true,
      attributeOldValue: true,
      characterData: config.includeCharacterData,
      characterDataOldValue: config.includeCharacterData,
    });
  }

  return {
    stop: () => {
      processRecords(observer.takeRecords());
      observer.disconnect();
    },
  };
}
