export interface NetworkAttributionInput {
  url: string;
  requestBodyPreview?: string;
  responseBodyPreview?: string;
  transport?: 'http' | 'websocket';
}

function normalizeText(value: string | undefined): string {
  return (value ?? '').toLowerCase();
}

export function truncateAttributionPreview(
  value: string,
  maxLength: number = 4096
): string {
  if (value.length <= maxLength) return value;
  return value.slice(0, maxLength);
}

export function buildNetworkFilterTags({
  url,
  requestBodyPreview,
  responseBodyPreview,
  transport,
}: NetworkAttributionInput): string[] {
  const text = `${normalizeText(url)} ${normalizeText(requestBodyPreview)} ${normalizeText(
    responseBodyPreview
  )}`;
  const tags = new Set<string>();

  if (transport === 'websocket') {
    tags.add('websocket');
  }
  if (text.includes('graphql')) {
    tags.add('graphql');
  }
  if (
    text.includes('pick up session') ||
    text.includes('pickup session') ||
    text.includes('claim') ||
    text.includes('acceptmeetingrequest') ||
    text.includes('accept')
  ) {
    tags.add('claim');
  }
  if (
    text.includes('active session') ||
    text.includes('meeting in progress') ||
    text.includes('session in progress') ||
    text.includes('notarymeeting')
  ) {
    tags.add('active-session');
  }
  if (
    text.includes('queue') ||
    text.includes('ondemandqueue') ||
    text.includes('viewerqueuespoller')
  ) {
    tags.add('queue');
  }

  return Array.from(tags);
}

function previewRawRequestBody(rawBody: { bytes?: ArrayBuffer | Uint8Array | number[] }[]): string | undefined {
  for (const entry of rawBody) {
    if (!entry?.bytes) continue;
    try {
      const bytes =
        entry.bytes instanceof ArrayBuffer
          ? new Uint8Array(entry.bytes)
          : entry.bytes instanceof Uint8Array
            ? entry.bytes
            : Uint8Array.from(entry.bytes);
      return truncateAttributionPreview(new TextDecoder().decode(bytes));
    } catch {
      continue;
    }
  }
  return undefined;
}

export function requestBodyToPreview(
  requestBody:
    | {
        formData?: Record<string, string[] | string>;
        raw?: Array<{ bytes?: ArrayBuffer | Uint8Array | number[] }>;
      }
    | undefined
): string | undefined {
  if (!requestBody) {
    return undefined;
  }

  if (requestBody.formData && Object.keys(requestBody.formData).length > 0) {
    return truncateAttributionPreview(JSON.stringify(requestBody.formData, null, 2));
  }

  if (Array.isArray(requestBody.raw) && requestBody.raw.length > 0) {
    return previewRawRequestBody(requestBody.raw);
  }

  return undefined;
}

const INSPECTOR_DOM_EVENTS_KEY = 'proof-extension:inspector:dom-events';
const INSPECTOR_NETWORK_EVENTS_KEY = 'proof-extension:inspector:network-events';
const INSPECTOR_INTERACTION_EVENTS_KEY =
  'proof-extension:inspector:interaction-events';
const INSPECTOR_SOCKET_EVENTS_KEY = 'proof-extension:inspector:socket-events';
const INSPECTOR_SIGNATURES_KEY = 'proof-extension:inspector:signatures';

const MAX_DOM_EVENTS = 750;
const MAX_NETWORK_EVENTS = 750;
const MAX_INTERACTION_EVENTS = 500;
const MAX_SOCKET_EVENTS = 500;
const MAX_SIGNATURES = 200;

async function appendEntries<T>(
  key: string,
  entries: T[],
  limit: number
): Promise<void> {
  if (entries.length === 0) return;
  const stored = await chrome.storage.session.get(key);
  const existing = Array.isArray(stored[key]) ? (stored[key] as T[]) : [];
  existing.unshift(...entries.slice().reverse());
  if (existing.length > limit) {
    existing.length = limit;
  }
  await chrome.storage.session.set({ [key]: existing });
}

async function getEntries<T>(key: string): Promise<T[]> {
  const stored = await chrome.storage.session.get(key);
  return Array.isArray(stored[key]) ? (stored[key] as T[]) : [];
}

export async function appendObservedDomEvent(
  event: ObservedDomEvent
): Promise<void> {
  await appendObservedDomEvents([event]);
}

export async function appendObservedDomEvents(
  events: ObservedDomEvent[]
): Promise<void> {
  await appendEntries(INSPECTOR_DOM_EVENTS_KEY, events, MAX_DOM_EVENTS);
}

export async function appendObservedNetworkEvent(
  event: ObservedNetworkEvent
): Promise<void> {
  await appendObservedNetworkEvents([event]);
}

export async function appendObservedNetworkEvents(
  events: ObservedNetworkEvent[]
): Promise<void> {
  await appendEntries(INSPECTOR_NETWORK_EVENTS_KEY, events, MAX_NETWORK_EVENTS);
}

export async function appendObservedInteractionEvent(
  event: ObservedInteractionEvent
): Promise<void> {
  await appendObservedInteractionEvents([event]);
}

export async function appendObservedInteractionEvents(
  events: ObservedInteractionEvent[]
): Promise<void> {
  await appendEntries(
    INSPECTOR_INTERACTION_EVENTS_KEY,
    events,
    MAX_INTERACTION_EVENTS
  );
}

  return getEntries(INSPECTOR_DOM_EVENTS_KEY);
}

  ObservedNetworkEvent[]

  return getEntries(INSPECTOR_NETWORK_EVENTS_KEY);

): Promise<void> {
  const next = signatures.slice(0, MAX_SIGNATURES);
  await chrome.storage.session.set({ [INSPECTOR_SIGNATURES_KEY]: next });

    await Promise.all([

      getInspectorSocketEvents(),
      getEventSignatures(),

    interactionEvents,
    socketEvents,

import type {
  PauseReason,
  PlatformNetworkSnapshot,
  PlatformProvider,
  PlatformSettingsShape,
  PlatformWatchConfig,
  WatchCandidateDescriptor,
} from './types.js';

const DEFAULT_BUTTON_SELECTOR = '.q-virtual-scroll__content .q-btn, .card-draggable-wrapper button, button,[role="button"]';

function escapeSelectorValue(value: string): string {
  if (typeof CSS !== 'undefined' && typeof CSS.escape === 'function') {
    return CSS.escape(value);
  }
  return value.replace(/["\\.#:[\]]/g, '\\$&');
}

function normalizeText(value: string | null | undefined): string {
  return (value ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
}

function matchesKeywords(text: string, keywords?: string[]): boolean {
  if (!keywords || keywords.length === 0) return true;
  const normalized = normalizeText(text);
  if (!normalized) return false;
  return keywords.some(keyword => normalized.includes(normalizeText(keyword)));
}

function isClickable(element: HTMLElement): boolean {
  if (element instanceof HTMLButtonElement && element.disabled) return false;
  if (element.getAttribute('aria-disabled') === 'true') return false;
  const style = window.getComputedStyle(element);
  return style.display !== 'none' && style.visibility !== 'hidden';
}

function buildSelector(element: HTMLElement, fallbackSelector: string): string {
  if (element.id) {
    return `#${escapeSelectorValue(element.id)}`;
  }
  const testId = element.getAttribute('data-testid');
  if (testId) {
    return `[data-testid="${escapeSelectorValue(testId)}"]`;
  }
  const classes = Array.from(element.classList).slice(0, 2);
  if (classes.length > 0) {
    return `${element.tagName.toLowerCase()}.${classes
      .map(cls => escapeSelectorValue(cls))
      .join('.')}`;
  }
  return fallbackSelector;
}

function createDescriptor(
  element: HTMLElement,
  fallbackSelector: string
): WatchCandidateDescriptor {
  const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect();
  return {
    element,
    text: (element.textContent ?? '').trim(),
    selector: buildSelector(element, fallbackSelector),
    x: rect.left + rect.width / 2,
    y: rect.top + rect.height / 2,
  };
}

/**
 * Resolves the Blue Notary Open Calls container with heading-text fallback.
 * If the containerSelector matches multiple elements, the one inside a section
 * whose <h2> contains the headingText wins. Falls back to heading-only search.
 */
function resolveBlueNotaryContainer(
  documentRef: Document,
  containerSelector: string,
  headingText?: string
): Element | null {
  if (containerSelector.trim()) {
    const candidates = Array.from(documentRef.querySelectorAll(containerSelector));
    if (candidates.length === 1) return candidates[0];
    if (candidates.length > 1 && headingText) {
      const heading = normalizeText(headingText);
      for (const candidate of candidates) {
        const section = candidate.closest('section');
        if (!section) continue;
        const headingEl = section.querySelector('h2');
        if (normalizeText(headingEl?.textContent).includes(heading)) {
          return candidate;
        }
      }
    }
    if (candidates.length > 0) return candidates[0];
  }

  if (headingText) {
    const heading = normalizeText(headingText);
    for (const element of Array.from(documentRef.querySelectorAll('h2'))) {
      if (!normalizeText(element.textContent).includes(heading)) continue;
      const section = element.closest('section');
      if (!section) continue;
      if (containerSelector.trim()) {
        const within = section.querySelector(containerSelector);
        if (within) return within;
      }
      return section;
    }
  }

  return null;
}

function detectBlueNotaryActiveSession(documentRef: Document): boolean {
  const url = documentRef.defaultView?.location.href ?? '';
  // Active session URL patterns — exclude dashboard and open-call listing pages
  if (
    /meeting|session/i.test(url) &&
    !/dashboard|open-call|notary\/calls/i.test(url)
  ) {
    return true;
  }
  const bodyText = normalizeText(documentRef.body?.textContent);
  return (
    bodyText.includes('meeting in progress') ||
    bodyText.includes('return to meeting') ||
    bodyText.includes('session in progress')
  );
}

function detectBlueNotaryInQueue(documentRef: Document): boolean {
  const url = documentRef.defaultView?.location.href ?? '';
  return /dashboard|open-call|notary\/calls/i.test(url);
}

function detectBlueNotaryPausedReason(documentRef: Document): PauseReason | null {
  if (detectBlueNotaryActiveSession(documentRef)) {
    return 'active_session';
  }
  const bodyText = normalizeText(documentRef.body?.textContent);
  if (bodyText.includes('unavailable') || bodyText.includes('try again')) {
    return 'platform_error';
  }
  return null;
}

function createWatchConfig(settings: PlatformSettingsShape): PlatformWatchConfig {
  return {
    platformId: 'blue-notary',
    containerSelector: settings.selectors.openCallsSection,
    buttonSelector: settings.selectors.openCallsButtons,
    headingText: 'Open Calls',
    noDataSelector: settings.selectors.openCallsNoData,
    keywords: settings.joinKeywords,
    label: 'WATCHING BLUE NOTARY',
    statusText: 'ACTIVE',
    queueUrl: settings.queueUrl,
    authenticatedTabOnly: settings.authenticatedTabOnly,
  };
}

export const blueNotaryProvider: PlatformProvider = {
  id: 'blue-notary',
  label: 'Blue Notary',
  matches: url => /bluenotary\.us/.test(url),
  getWatchConfig: createWatchConfig,
  createAdapter: (documentRef, config) => {
    const resolveContainer = () =>
      resolveBlueNotaryContainer(
        documentRef,
        config.containerSelector,
        config.headingText
      );
    const buttonSelector =
      config.buttonSelector?.trim() || DEFAULT_BUTTON_SELECTOR;

    return {
      resolveContainer,
      isNoData: (container: Element) => {
        // If a non-disabled candidate button is present the queue is not empty.
        // Guards against textContent false-positives from CSS-hidden empty-state
        // spans inside disabled buttons (ported from proof-extension fix 688934a).
        const hasActiveButton = container.querySelector(
          `${buttonSelector}:not([disabled]):not([aria-disabled="true"])`
        );
        if (hasActiveButton) return false;

        if (
          config.noDataSelector &&
          container.querySelector(config.noDataSelector)
        ) {
          return true;
        }
        const text = normalizeText(container.textContent);
        return (
          text.includes('no data available') ||
          text.includes('no open calls') ||
          text.includes('no calls available')
        );
      },
      getCandidates: (container: Element) =>
        Array.from(container.querySelectorAll(buttonSelector))
          .filter(
            element => element instanceof HTMLElement && isClickable(element)
          )
          .map(element =>
            createDescriptor(element as HTMLElement, buttonSelector)
          )
          .filter(candidate => matchesKeywords(candidate.text, config.keywords)),
      findRefreshedCandidate: (buttonText?: string) => {
        const container = resolveContainer();
        if (!container) return null;
        const candidates = Array.from(container.querySelectorAll(buttonSelector))
          .filter(
            element => element instanceof HTMLElement && isClickable(element)
          )
          .map(element =>
            createDescriptor(element as HTMLElement, buttonSelector)
          )
          .filter(candidate => matchesKeywords(candidate.text, config.keywords));
        if (buttonText) {
          const normalized = normalizeText(buttonText);
          const exact = candidates.find(
            candidate => normalizeText(candidate.text) === normalized
          );
          if (exact) return exact;
        }
        return candidates[0] ?? null;
      },
      detectActiveSession: () => detectBlueNotaryActiveSession(documentRef),
      detectInQueue: () => detectBlueNotaryInQueue(documentRef),
      detectPausedReason: () => detectBlueNotaryPausedReason(documentRef),
      getNetworkSnapshot: () => config.networkSnapshot,
    };
  },
};

function mergePlatformSettings(stored: unknown): PlatformSettingsShape {
  const defaults = createDefaultPlatformSettings();
  if (!stored || typeof stored !== 'object') {
    return defaults;
  }

  const raw = stored as Partial<PlatformSettingsShape>;
  return {
    ...defaults,
    ...raw,
    id: 'blue-notary',
    selectors: {
      ...defaults.selectors,
      ...(raw.selectors || {}),
    },
    joinKeywords: Array.isArray(raw.joinKeywords)
      ? [
          ...new Set([
            ...raw.joinKeywords.map(value => String(value)),
            ...defaults.joinKeywords,
          ]),
        ]
      : defaults.joinKeywords,
  };
}

export function hydrateSettings(
  stored: Partial<NotarySettings> | null | undefined
): NotarySettings {
  const defaults = createDefaultSettings();
  const rawWatch = (stored?.watch as Record<string, unknown> | undefined) ?? {};
  const legacyAutoClaimEnabled =
    typeof rawWatch.autoClaimEnabled === 'boolean'
      ? rawWatch.autoClaimEnabled
      : undefined;
  return {
    ...defaults,
    ...stored,
    platform: mergePlatformSettings(stored?.platform),
    watch: {
      ...DEFAULT_WATCH_BEHAVIOR_SETTINGS,
      ...rawWatch,
      claimMode:
        typeof rawWatch.claimMode === 'string'
          ? (rawWatch.claimMode as 'button' | 'race' | 'api')
          : legacyAutoClaimEnabled === false
            ? 'button'
            : 'race',
    },
    inspector: {
      ...DEFAULT_INSPECTOR_SETTINGS,
      ...(stored?.inspector || {}),
      selectedRoots: Array.isArray(stored?.inspector?.selectedRoots)
        ? stored.inspector.selectedRoots.filter(Boolean)
        : defaults.inspector.selectedRoots,
    },
    telemetry: {
      ...DEFAULT_TELEMETRY_SETTINGS,
      ...(stored?.telemetry || {}),
    },
    ui: {
      ...DEFAULT_UI_SETTINGS,
      ...(stored?.ui || {}),
    },
    metricsEnabled: stored?.metricsEnabled ?? defaults.metricsEnabled,
  };
}

import React from 'react';
import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client';

import { MESSAGE_TYPES } from './constants.js';
import type { NotaryAppState } from './types/notary.js';
import './assets/popup.css';

function PopupApp() {
  const [state, setState] = React.useState<NotaryAppState | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = React.useState(false);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    async function refresh() {
      try {
        const response = await chrome.runtime.sendMessage({
          type: MESSAGE_TYPES.GET_STATE,
        });
        if (response?.ok && response.state) {
          setState(response.state as NotaryAppState);
        }
      } catch {
        // Service worker not yet ready — will retry on next STATE_UPDATED
      }
    }

    void refresh();
    const listener = (message: { type?: string; state?: NotaryAppState }) => {
      if (message?.type === MESSAGE_TYPES.STATE_UPDATED && message.state) {
        setState(message.state);
      }
    };
    chrome.runtime.onMessage.addListener(listener);
    return () => {
      chrome.runtime.onMessage.removeListener(listener);
    };
  }, []);

  async function runAction(type: string) {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await chrome.runtime.sendMessage({ type });
      const response = await chrome.runtime.sendMessage({
        type: MESSAGE_TYPES.GET_STATE,
      });
      if (response?.ok && response.state) {
        setState(response.state as NotaryAppState);
      }
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="popup-container">
        <div className="popup-eyebrow">Blue Notary Extension</div>
        <div className="popup-title">Open Calls Console</div>
        <div className="popup-status">
          <span className={`popup-dot ${state?.watch.status === 'watching' ? 'active' : ''}`} />
          <div>
            <div className="popup-status-label">{state?.watch.status ?? 'idle'}</div>
            <div className="popup-status-copy">
              {state?.watch.lastResult ?? 'Ready to open the Blue Notary queue.'}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="popup-actions">
          <button
            className="popup-button"
            data-testid="popup-open-queue"
            disabled={busy}
            onClick={() => void runAction(MESSAGE_TYPES.OPEN_QUEUE)}
          >
            Open Blue Notary Queue
          </button>
          <button
            className="popup-button secondary"
            data-testid="popup-start-watch"
            disabled={busy}
            onClick={() => void runAction(MESSAGE_TYPES.START_WATCH)}
          >
            Start Watch
          </button>
          <button
            className="popup-button muted"
            data-testid="popup-stop-watch"
            disabled={busy}
            onClick={() => void runAction(MESSAGE_TYPES.STOP_WATCH)}
          >
            Stop Watch
          </button>
          <button
            className="popup-button muted"
            data-testid="popup-attach-inspector"
            disabled={busy}
            onClick={() => void runAction(MESSAGE_TYPES.ATTACH_INSPECTOR)}
          >
            Attach Inspector
          </button>
        </div>
        <p className="popup-note">
          The full operator console lives in the sidepanel. The popup is only for quick queue and watch actions.
        </p>
    </div>
  );
}

const container = document.getElementById('root');
if (container) {
  const root = createRoot(container);
  root.render(<PopupApp />);
}
