import type { SocketMonitorMode } from '../types/notary.js';

export interface BlueNotaryPageMonitorConfig {
  enabled: boolean;
  mode: SocketMonitorMode;
  deepTrace: boolean;
}

export function installBlueNotaryPageMonitor(
  nextConfig: BlueNotaryPageMonitorConfig
): void {
  const monitorKey = '__REMOTE_NOTARY_BLUE_MONITOR__';
  const channel = 'REMOTE_NOTARY_PAGE_MONITOR';
  const globalWindow = window as typeof window & Record<string, any>;

  function truncate(value: string | undefined, maxLength: number = 4096): string | undefined {
    if (!value) return undefined;
    return value.length <= maxLength ? value : value.slice(0, maxLength);
  }

  function safeStringify(value: unknown): string | undefined {
    if (typeof value === 'string') return truncate(value);
    if (value == null) return undefined;
    try {
      return truncate(JSON.stringify(value, null, 2));
    } catch {
      return truncate(String(value));
    }
  }

  function normalizeText(value: string | undefined): string {
    return (value ?? '').toLowerCase();
  }

  function now(): string {
    return new Date().toISOString();
  }

  function detectSocketEventName(payload: string): string | undefined {
    const normalized = payload.trim();
    const stripped = normalized.replace(/^[0-9]+/, '');
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(stripped);
      if (Array.isArray(parsed) && typeof parsed[0] === 'string') {
        return parsed[0];
      }
      if (typeof parsed?.event === 'string') {
        return parsed.event;
      }
    } catch {
      /* fall through */
    }
    return undefined;
  }

  function hasClaimSignal(value: string | undefined): boolean {
    const text = normalizeText(value);
    return (
      text.includes('pick up session') ||
      text.includes('pickup session') ||
      text.includes('pickupsession') ||
      text.includes('opencallfortaking') ||
      text.includes('pick up') ||
      text.includes('open call') ||
      text.includes('join as witness') ||
      text.includes('claim') ||
      text.includes('eligible') ||
      text.includes('accept')
    );
  }

  function hasSessionNameEndpoint(url: string): boolean {
    const u = normalizeText(url);
    return (
      u.includes('/sessions') ||
      u.includes('/queue') ||
      u.includes('/on-demand') ||
      u.includes('/getsession') ||
      u.includes('/viewerqueue') ||
      u.includes('/notarysession')
    );
  }

  function extractSessionName(body: string | undefined): string | undefined {
    if (!body) return undefined;
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(body) as unknown;
      // Walk the parsed value looking for a name-like string field
      const candidates = findSessionNameFields(parsed);
      return candidates[0];
    } catch {
      return undefined;
    }
  }

  function findSessionNameFields(value: unknown, depth: number = 0): string[] {
    if (depth > 5) return [];
    if (typeof value === 'string' && value.trim().length > 0) return [];
    if (Array.isArray(value)) {
      return value.flatMap(item => findSessionNameFields(item, depth + 1));
    }
    if (value !== null && typeof value === 'object') {
      const obj = value as Record<string, unknown>;
      const results: string[] = [];
      for (const key of ['name', 'sessionName', 'clientName', 'clientFullName', 'title', 'fullName']) {
        if (typeof obj[key] === 'string' && (obj[key] as string).trim().length > 0) {
          results.push((obj[key] as string).trim());
        }
      }
      if (results.length > 0) return results;
      for (const child of Object.values(obj)) {
        const nested = findSessionNameFields(child, depth + 1);
        if (nested.length > 0) return nested;
      }
    }
    return [];
  }

  function hasActiveSessionSignal(value: string | undefined): boolean {
    const text = normalizeText(value);
    return (
      text.includes('active session') ||
      text.includes('meeting in progress') ||
      text.includes('session in progress') ||
      text.includes('meeting started') ||
      text.includes('return to meeting')
    );
  }

  function normalizeHeaders(
    headers: HeadersInit | undefined,
    preserveSensitive: boolean
  ): Record<string, string> {
    const normalized: Record<string, string> = {};
    if (!headers) return normalized;

    const append = (name: string, value: string) => {
      const lower = name.toLowerCase();
      if (!preserveSensitive && (lower === 'authorization' || lower === 'cookie')) {
        normalized[name] = '[redacted]';
        return;
      }
      normalized[name] = value;
    };

    if (headers instanceof Headers) {
      headers.forEach((value, name) => append(name, value));
      return normalized;
    }

    if (Array.isArray(headers)) {
      for (const [name, value] of headers) {
        append(name, value);
      }
      return normalized;
    }

    for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(headers)) {
      append(name, String(value));
    }
    return normalized;
  }

  function buildFilterTags(
    url: string,
    bodyPreview: string | undefined,
    transport: 'http' | 'websocket'
  ): string[] {
    const text = `${normalizeText(url)} ${normalizeText(bodyPreview)}`;
    const tags = new Set<string>();
    if (transport === 'websocket') {
      tags.add('websocket');
    }
    if (text.includes('graphql')) {
      tags.add('graphql');
    }
    if (hasClaimSignal(text)) {
      tags.add('claim');
    }
    if (hasActiveSessionSignal(text)) {
      tags.add('active-session');
    }
    if (text.includes('queue')) {
      tags.add('queue');
    }
    return Array.from(tags);
  }

  function emit(type: 'network' | 'socket', payload: Record<string, unknown>): void {
    globalWindow.postMessage(
      {
        source: channel,
        type,
        payload,
      },
      '*'
    );
  }

  if (!globalWindow[monitorKey]) {
    const state = {
      enabled: false,
      config: {
        enabled: false,
        mode: 'observe-only' as SocketMonitorMode,
        deepTrace: false,
      },
      lastClaimTemplate: null as null | {
        url: string;
        method: string;
        headers: Record<string, string>;
        body: string | undefined;
      },
      lastSeenSessionName: undefined as string | undefined,
      originalFetch: typeof globalWindow.fetch === 'function'
        ? globalWindow.fetch.bind(globalWindow)
        : undefined,
      OriginalWebSocket: globalWindow.WebSocket,
      originalXHROpen: XMLHttpRequest.prototype.open,
      originalXHRSend: XMLHttpRequest.prototype.send,
      originalXHRSetRequestHeader: XMLHttpRequest.prototype.setRequestHeader,
    };

    if (typeof state.originalFetch === 'function') {
      globalWindow.fetch = async function patchedFetch(
        input: RequestInfo | URL,
        init?: RequestInit
      ): Promise<Response> {
        const current = globalWindow[monitorKey];
        const request = input instanceof Request ? input : undefined;
        const url = request?.url ?? String(input);
        const method = (init?.method ?? request?.method ?? 'GET').toUpperCase();
        const requestHeaders = normalizeHeaders(
          init?.headers ?? request?.headers,
          false
        );
        const replayHeaders = normalizeHeaders(
          init?.headers ?? request?.headers,
          true
        );
        const requestBody =
          typeof init?.body === 'string'
            ? init.body
            : request
              ? undefined
              : undefined;
        const requestBodyPreview = truncate(requestBody);
        const filterTags = buildFilterTags(url, requestBodyPreview, 'http');
        const requestId = `page-fetch-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random()
          .toString(36)
          .slice(2, 8)}`;
        const initiatorStack =
          current?.config.deepTrace === true ? new Error().stack : undefined;

        if (filterTags.includes('claim')) {
          current.lastClaimTemplate = {
            url,
            method,
            headers: replayHeaders,
            body: requestBody,
          };
        }

        try {
          const response = await current.originalFetch(input as any, init);
          if (current.enabled) {
            const responseHandlerStack =
              current.config.deepTrace === true ? new Error().stack : undefined;
            let responseBodyPreview: string | undefined;
            try {
              if (current.config.deepTrace === true) {
                responseBodyPreview = truncate(await response.clone().text());
              }
            } catch {
              responseBodyPreview = undefined;
            }

            emit('network', {
              eventId: requestId,
              requestId,
              recordedAt: now(),
              url,
              method,
              transport: 'http',
              resourceType: 'fetch',
              status: response.status,
              requestHeaders,
              responseHeaders: {},
              requestBodyPreview,
              responseBodyPreview,
              correlationKey: requestId,
              filterTags,
              source: 'page-bridge',
              traceSource: 'page-bridge',
              initiator: 'fetch',
              initiatorStack,
              responseHandlerStack,
            });

            if (
              current.config.mode !== 'observe-only' &&
              hasActiveSessionSignal(responseBodyPreview)
            ) {
              emit('socket', {
                eventId: `${requestId}-active`,
                recordedAt: now(),
                direction: 'state',
                transport: 'fetch',
                eventName: 'active-session-detected',
                payloadPreview: responseBodyPreview,
                activeSessionSignal: true,
                correlationKey: requestId,
              });
            }

            if (
              (current.config.mode === 'observe-api-eligibility' ||
                current.config.mode === 'opt-in-auto-claim') &&
              filterTags.includes('claim')
            ) {
              emit('socket', {
                eventId: `${requestId}-eligibility`,
                recordedAt: now(),
                direction: 'state',
                transport: 'fetch',
                eventName: 'claim-eligibility',
                payloadPreview: `${method} ${url}`,
                claimEligibilitySignal: true,
                correlationKey: requestId,
              });
            }

            if (hasSessionNameEndpoint(url) && response.ok) {
              try {
                const sessionBody = await response.clone().text();
                const sessionName = extractSessionName(sessionBody);
                if (sessionName) {
                  current.lastSeenSessionName = sessionName;
                  emit('socket', {
                    eventId: `${requestId}-session-name`,
                    recordedAt: now(),
                    direction: 'state',
                    transport: 'fetch',
                    eventName: 'session-name-observed',
                    sessionName,
                    correlationKey: requestId,
                  });
                }
              } catch {
                /* response body read failed — ignore */
              }
            }

            // Sessions API eligibility detection — POST /api/notary/sessions
            // Response: { sessionData: [{ session: { _id }, canPickSessionAsNotary, openCallAlreadyPicked }] }
            if (url.includes('/api/notary/sessions') && method === 'POST' && response.ok) {
              try {
                const sessionsBody = await response.clone().text();
                const parsed = JSON.parse(sessionsBody) as unknown;
                const sessionData = (parsed as Record<string, unknown>)?.sessionData;
                if (Array.isArray(sessionData)) {
                  const eligibleIds = (sessionData as unknown[])
                    .filter(
                      (entry: unknown) =>
                        (entry as Record<string, unknown>)?.canPickSessionAsNotary === true &&
                        !(entry as Record<string, unknown>)?.openCallAlreadyPicked
                    )
                    .map((entry: unknown) => {
                      const session = (entry as Record<string, unknown>)?.session;
                      const id = (session as Record<string, unknown> | undefined)?._id;
                      return typeof id === 'string' ? id : null;
                    })
                    .filter((id): id is string => id !== null);
                  if (eligibleIds.length > 0) {
                    emit('socket', {
                      eventId: `${requestId}-sessions-api`,
                      recordedAt: now(),
                      direction: 'incoming',
                      transport: 'fetch',
                      eventName: 'sessions-api-eligibility',
                      payloadPreview: `${eligibleIds.length} eligible session(s)`,
                      sessionsApiSignal: true,
                      extractedSessionIds: eligibleIds,
                      correlationKey: requestId,
                    });
                  }
                }
              } catch {
                /* sessions body parse failed — ignore */
              }
            }
          }
          return response;
        } catch (error) {
          if (current.enabled) {
            emit('network', {
              eventId: requestId,
              requestId,
              recordedAt: now(),
              url,
              method,
              transport: 'http',
              resourceType: 'fetch',
              status: 0,
              requestHeaders,
              requestBodyPreview,
              responseBodyPreview: truncate(String(error)),
              correlationKey: requestId,
              filterTags,
              source: 'page-bridge',
              traceSource: 'page-bridge',
              initiator: 'fetch',
              initiatorStack,
            });
          }
          throw error;
        }
      };
    }

    XMLHttpRequest.prototype.open = function patchedOpen(
      method: string,
      url: string,
      async?: boolean,
      username?: string | null,
      password?: string | null
    ): void {
      (this as XMLHttpRequest & Record<string, any>).__remoteNotaryMonitor = {
        method: method.toUpperCase(),
        url,
        headers: {} as Record<string, string>,
      };
      return state.originalXHROpen.call(this, method, url, async ?? true, username ?? null, password ?? null);
    };

    XMLHttpRequest.prototype.setRequestHeader = function patchedSetRequestHeader(
      name: string,
      value: string
    ): void {
      const monitor = (this as XMLHttpRequest & Record<string, any>).__remoteNotaryMonitor;
      if (monitor) {
        monitor.headers[name] = value;
      }
      return state.originalXHRSetRequestHeader.call(this, name, value);
    };

    XMLHttpRequest.prototype.send = function patchedSend(
      body?: Document | XMLHttpRequestBodyInit | null
    ): void {
      const xhr = this as XMLHttpRequest & Record<string, any>;
      const current = globalWindow[monitorKey];
      const monitor = xhr.__remoteNotaryMonitor || {
        method: 'GET',
        url: '',
        headers: {},
      };
      const bodyPreview =
        typeof body === 'string' ? truncate(body) : safeStringify(body);
      const requestId = `page-xhr-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random()
        .toString(36)
        .slice(2, 8)}`;
      const filterTags = buildFilterTags(monitor.url, bodyPreview, 'http');
      const initiatorStack =
        current?.config.deepTrace === true ? new Error().stack : undefined;

      if (filterTags.includes('claim')) {
        current.lastClaimTemplate = {
          url: monitor.url,
          method: monitor.method,
          headers: { ...monitor.headers },
          body: typeof body === 'string' ? body : undefined,
        };
      }

      const finalize = () => {
        if (!current.enabled) return;
        const responseText =
          typeof xhr.responseText === 'string' ? truncate(xhr.responseText) : undefined;
        emit('network', {
          eventId: requestId,
          requestId,
          recordedAt: now(),
          url: monitor.url,
          method: monitor.method,
          transport: 'http',
          resourceType: 'xhr',
          status: xhr.status || 0,
          requestHeaders: normalizeHeaders(monitor.headers, false),
          requestBodyPreview: bodyPreview,
          responseBodyPreview: current.config.deepTrace ? responseText : undefined,
          correlationKey: requestId,
          filterTags,
          source: 'page-bridge',
          traceSource: 'page-bridge',
          initiator: 'xhr',
          initiatorStack,
          responseHandlerStack:
            current.config.deepTrace === true ? new Error().stack : undefined,
        });

        if (
          current.config.mode !== 'observe-only' &&
          hasActiveSessionSignal(responseText)
        ) {
          emit('socket', {
            eventId: `${requestId}-active`,
            recordedAt: now(),
            direction: 'state',
            transport: 'xhr',
            eventName: 'active-session-detected',
            payloadPreview: responseText,
            activeSessionSignal: true,
            correlationKey: requestId,
          });
        }
      };

      xhr.addEventListener('loadend', finalize, { once: true });
      return state.originalXHRSend.call(this, body ?? null);
    };

    if (typeof state.OriginalWebSocket === 'function') {
      const WrappedWebSocket = function wrappedWebSocket(
        this: WebSocket,
        url: string | URL,
        protocols?: string | string[]
      ): WebSocket {
        const socket = protocols === undefined
          ? new state.OriginalWebSocket(url)
          : new state.OriginalWebSocket(url, protocols);
        const socketId = `page-ws-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random()
          .toString(36)
          .slice(2, 8)}`;

        socket.addEventListener('open', () => {
          const current = globalWindow[monitorKey];
          if (!current.enabled) return;
          emit('socket', {
            eventId: `${socketId}-open`,
            recordedAt: now(),
            direction: 'state',
            transport: 'websocket',
            wsConnectionEvent: 'open',
            wsUrl: String(url),
            correlationKey: socketId,
          });
        });

        socket.addEventListener('close', (event: Event) => {
          const current = globalWindow[monitorKey];
          if (!current.enabled) return;
          const closeEvent = event as CloseEvent;
          emit('socket', {
            eventId: `${socketId}-close`,
            recordedAt: now(),
            direction: 'state',
            transport: 'websocket',
            wsConnectionEvent: 'close',
            wsUrl: String(url),
            wsCloseCode: closeEvent.code,
            wsCloseReason: closeEvent.reason,
            correlationKey: socketId,
          });
        });

        socket.addEventListener('message', event => {
          const current = globalWindow[monitorKey];
          if (!current.enabled) return;
          const payloadPreview = truncate(
            typeof event.data === 'string'
              ? event.data
              : safeStringify(event.data)
          );
          emit('socket', {
            eventId: `${socketId}-incoming-${Date.now().toString(36)}`,
            recordedAt: now(),
            direction: 'incoming',
            transport: 'websocket',
            eventName:
              typeof event.data === 'string'
                ? detectSocketEventName(event.data)
                : undefined,

              current.config.mode !== 'observe-only' &&

              (current.config.mode === 'observe-api-eligibility' ||
                current.config.mode === 'opt-in-auto-claim') &&
              hasClaimSignal(payloadPreview),
            correlationKey: socketId,
          });
        });

        const originalSend = socket.send.bind(socket);
        socket.send = function patchedSend(data: string | ArrayBufferLike | Blob | ArrayBufferView): void {
          const current = globalWindow[monitorKey];
          if (current.enabled) {
            const payloadPreview = truncate(
              typeof data === 'string' ? data : safeStringify(data)
            );
            emit('socket', {
              eventId: `${socketId}-outgoing-${Date.now().toString(36)}`,
              recordedAt: now(),
              direction: 'outgoing',
              transport: 'websocket',
              eventName:
                typeof data === 'string' ? detectSocketEventName(data) : undefined,
              payloadPreview,
              claimEligibilitySignal:
                (current.config.mode === 'observe-api-eligibility' ||
                  current.config.mode === 'opt-in-auto-claim') &&
                hasClaimSignal(payloadPreview),
              correlationKey: socketId,
            });
          }
          return originalSend(data);
        };

        return socket;
      } as unknown as typeof WebSocket;

      WrappedWebSocket.prototype = state.OriginalWebSocket.prototype;
      Object.setPrototypeOf(WrappedWebSocket, state.OriginalWebSocket);
      globalWindow.WebSocket = WrappedWebSocket;
    }

    globalWindow[monitorKey] = state;
  }

  const state = globalWindow[monitorKey];
  state.enabled = Boolean(nextConfig.enabled);
  state.config = {
    ...state.config,
    ...nextConfig,
  };

  emit('socket', {
    eventId: `monitor-state-${Date.now().toString(36)}`,
    recordedAt: now(),
    direction: 'state',
    transport: 'fetch',
    eventName: state.enabled ? 'socket-monitor-started' : 'socket-monitor-stopped',
    payloadPreview: JSON.stringify(state.config),
    correlationKey: 'socket-monitor',
  });
}

export async function runBlueNotaryApiClaimAssist(): Promise<{
  ok: boolean;
  status?: number;
  preview?: string;
  error?: string;
  notarySessionId?: string;
}> {
  const monitorKey = '__REMOTE_NOTARY_BLUE_MONITOR__';
  const channel = 'REMOTE_NOTARY_PAGE_MONITOR';
  const globalWindow = window as typeof window & Record<string, any>;
  const state = globalWindow[monitorKey];

  if (!state?.lastClaimTemplate || typeof state.originalFetch !== 'function') {
    return {
      ok: false,
      error: 'No claim template captured yet',
    };
  }

  function truncate(value: string | undefined, maxLength: number = 4096): string | undefined {
    if (!value) return undefined;
    return value.length <= maxLength ? value : value.slice(0, maxLength);
  }

  const requestId = `claim-assist-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random()
    .toString(36)
    .slice(2, 8)}`;

  const urlPathMatch = /pickUpSession\/([a-f0-9]{24})/i.exec(state.lastClaimTemplate.url);
  const notarySessionId = urlPathMatch?.[1];

  try {
    const response = await state.originalFetch(state.lastClaimTemplate.url, {
      method: state.lastClaimTemplate.method,
      headers: state.lastClaimTemplate.headers,
      body: state.lastClaimTemplate.body,
      credentials: 'include',
    });
    const preview = truncate(await response.clone().text());
    globalWindow.postMessage(
      {
        source: channel,
        type: 'network',
        payload: {
          eventId: requestId,
          requestId,
          recordedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          url: state.lastClaimTemplate.url,
          method: state.lastClaimTemplate.method,
          transport: 'http',
          resourceType: 'claim-assist',
          status: response.status,
          requestHeaders: {},
          responseHeaders: {},
          requestBodyPreview: truncate(state.lastClaimTemplate.body),
          responseBodyPreview: preview,
          correlationKey: requestId,
          filterTags: ['claim', 'claim-assist'],
          source: 'page-bridge',
          traceSource: 'page-bridge',
          initiator: 'manual-claim-assist',
          initiatorStack: state.config.deepTrace === true ? new Error().stack : undefined,
          responseHandlerStack:
            state.config.deepTrace === true ? new Error().stack : undefined,
        },
      },
      '*'
    );
    globalWindow.postMessage(
      {
        source: channel,
        type: 'socket',
        payload: {
          eventId: `${requestId}-result`,
          recordedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          direction: 'state',
          transport: 'fetch',
          eventName: 'claim-assist-result',
          payloadPreview: preview,
          claimEligibilitySignal: response.ok,
          notarySessionId,
          correlationKey: requestId,
        },
      },
      '*'
    );

    return {
      ok: response.ok,
      status: response.status,
      preview,
      notarySessionId,
    };
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      error: String(error),
    };
  }
}

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from 'vitest';

// Mirrors the audioCtxUnlocked gate logic in content.ts.
// Verifies playNotificationChime is not called before a user gesture.

describe('AudioContext unlock gate', () => {
  let audioCtxUnlocked: boolean;
  let playNotificationChime: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>;
  let sendResponse: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>;

  function handleTestSound(unlocked: boolean, repeat: number) {
    if (!unlocked) {
      sendResponse({ ok: false, error: 'AudioContext not yet unlocked — requires a user gesture first' });
      return;
    }
    void playNotificationChime({ repeat });
    sendResponse({ ok: true });
  }

  beforeEach(() => {
    audioCtxUnlocked = false;
    playNotificationChime = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined);
    sendResponse = vi.fn();
  });

  it('does not call playNotificationChime before user gesture', () => {
    handleTestSound(audioCtxUnlocked, 1);
    expect(playNotificationChime).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(sendResponse).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
      ok: false,

import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'vitest';

type WatchStatus = 'idle' | 'watching' | 'paused' | 'error';

interface WatchState {
  status: WatchStatus;
  lastCheckedAt?: string;
  lastResult?: string;
  tabId?: number;
  lastError?: string;
  platform: 'blue-notary';
}

interface LogEntry {
  timestamp: string;
  level: 'debug' | 'info' | 'warn' | 'error';
  message: string;
  data?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

describe('Service Worker State Management — Blue Notary', () => {
  let watchState: WatchState;
  let logEntries: LogEntry[];

  const MAX_LOGS = 100;

  beforeEach(() => {
    watchState = { status: 'idle', platform: 'blue-notary' };
    logEntries = [];
  });

  describe('Default State Initialization', () => {
    it('initializes with idle watch state', () => {
      expect(watchState.status).toBe('idle');
      expect(watchState.platform).toBe('blue-notary');
      expect(watchState.tabId).toBeUndefined();
      expect(watchState.lastError).toBeUndefined();
    });

    it('initializes with empty log entries', () => {
      expect(logEntries).toEqual([]);
    });
  });

  describe('Watch State Transitions', () => {
    it('transitions from idle to watching', () => {
      watchState = {
        ...watchState,
        status: 'watching',
        tabId: 123,
        lastCheckedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      };
      expect(watchState.status).toBe('watching');
      expect(watchState.tabId).toBe(123);
    });

    it('transitions from watching to paused with Blue Notary session message', () => {
      watchState = { ...watchState, status: 'watching', tabId: 123 };
      watchState = {
        ...watchState,
        status: 'paused',
        lastResult: 'Blue Notary session confirmed. Watch paused.',
      };
      expect(watchState.status).toBe('paused');
      expect(watchState.lastResult).toContain('Blue Notary');
      expect(watchState.tabId).toBe(123);
    });

    it('transitions from paused back to watching', () => {
      watchState = { ...watchState, status: 'paused', tabId: 123 };
      watchState = {
        ...watchState,
        status: 'watching',
        lastCheckedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      };
      expect(watchState.status).toBe('watching');
    });

    it('transitions from watching to idle, clearing tabId', () => {
      watchState = { status: 'idle', platform: 'blue-notary' };
      expect(watchState.tabId).toBeUndefined();
    });

    it('stores error message when transitioning to error state', () => {
      watchState = { ...watchState, status: 'error', lastError: 'Blue Notary tab closed' };
      expect(watchState.status).toBe('error');
      expect(watchState.lastError).toContain('Blue Notary');
    });

    it('clears error when recovering to idle', () => {
      watchState = { ...watchState, status: 'error', lastError: 'Some error' };
      watchState = { status: 'idle', platform: 'blue-notary', lastError: undefined };
      expect(watchState.status).toBe('idle');
      expect(watchState.lastError).toBeUndefined();
    });
  });

  describe('Log Management', () => {
    const createLogEntry = (
      level: LogEntry['level'],
      message: string,
      data?: Record<string, unknown>
    ): LogEntry => ({
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      level,
      message,
      data,
    });

    it('adds log entries', () => {
      logEntries.push(createLogEntry('info', 'Blue Notary watch started'));
      logEntries.push(createLogEntry('debug', 'Checking for open calls'));
      expect(logEntries.length).toBe(2);
      expect(logEntries[0].level).toBe('info');
    });

    it('limits log entries to MAX_LOGS', () => {
      for (let i = 0; i < MAX_LOGS + 50; i++) {
        logEntries.push(createLogEntry('info', `Log ${i}`));
      }
      logEntries = logEntries.slice(-MAX_LOGS);
      expect(logEntries.length).toBe(MAX_LOGS);
      expect(logEntries[0].message).toContain('Log 50');
    });

    it('clears all log entries', () => {
      logEntries.push(createLogEntry('info', 'Log 1'));
      logEntries.push(createLogEntry('info', 'Log 2'));
      logEntries = [];
      expect(logEntries.length).toBe(0);
    });

    it('includes Blue Notary-specific data in log entries', () => {
      logEntries.push(
        createLogEntry('info', 'Blue Notary button clicked', {
          tabId: 123,
          buttonText: 'Pick Up Session',
          platform: 'blue-notary',
        })
      );
      expect(logEntries[0].data?.['platform']).toBe('blue-notary');
      expect(logEntries[0].data?.['buttonText']).toBe('Pick Up Session');
    });

    it('supports all log levels', () => {
      logEntries.push(createLogEntry('debug', 'Debug'));
      logEntries.push(createLogEntry('info', 'Info'));
      logEntries.push(createLogEntry('warn', 'Warning'));
      logEntries.push(createLogEntry('error', 'Error'));
      expect(logEntries.map(e => e.level)).toEqual(['debug', 'info', 'warn', 'error']);
    });
  });

  describe('Platform Isolation', () => {
    it('platform field is always blue-notary', () => {
      expect(watchState.platform).toBe('blue-notary');
      watchState = { ...watchState, status: 'watching', tabId: 42 };
      expect(watchState.platform).toBe('blue-notary');
    });

    it('handles rapid state transitions correctly', () => {
      watchState = { status: 'idle', platform: 'blue-notary' };
      watchState = { ...watchState, status: 'watching', tabId: 123 };
      watchState = { ...watchState, status: 'paused' };
      watchState = { ...watchState, status: 'watching' };
      watchState = { status: 'idle', platform: 'blue-notary' };
      expect(watchState.status).toBe('idle');
    });
  });

  describe('Blocked Session Guard — notarySessionId key correctness', () => {
    type BlockedEntry = { blockedAt: string; reason: string; attemptCount: number };

    function applyBlockKey(
      blockedSessions: Map<string, BlockedEntry>,
      notarySessionId: string | undefined,
      watchSessionId: string
    ): void {
      const blockKey = notarySessionId ?? watchSessionId;
      const existing = blockedSessions.get(blockKey);
      blockedSessions.set(blockKey, {
        blockedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        reason: 'claim_assist_result_failed',
        attemptCount: (existing?.attemptCount ?? 0) + 1,
      });
    }

    it('keys blockedSessions on notarySessionId when present, not the watch session ID', () => {
      const blockedSessions = new Map<string, BlockedEntry>();
      const notarySessionId = '507f1f77bcf86cd799439011';
      const watchSessionId = 'session-mmz7vgfw-utjtq0';

      applyBlockKey(blockedSessions, notarySessionId, watchSessionId);

      expect(blockedSessions.has(notarySessionId)).toBe(true);
      expect(blockedSessions.has(watchSessionId)).toBe(false);
      expect(blockedSessions.get(notarySessionId)?.attemptCount).toBe(1);
    });

    it('falls back to watchSessionId when notarySessionId is undefined', () => {
      const blockedSessions = new Map<string, BlockedEntry>();
      const watchSessionId = 'session-mmz7vgfw-utjtq0';

      applyBlockKey(blockedSessions, undefined, watchSessionId);

      expect(blockedSessions.has(watchSessionId)).toBe(true);
      expect(blockedSessions.get(watchSessionId)?.attemptCount).toBe(1);
    });

    it('increments attemptCount on repeated failures for same notarySessionId', () => {
      const blockedSessions = new Map<string, BlockedEntry>();
      const notarySessionId = '507f1f77bcf86cd799439011';
      const watchSessionId = 'session-mmz7vgfw-utjtq0';

      applyBlockKey(blockedSessions, notarySessionId, watchSessionId);
      applyBlockKey(blockedSessions, notarySessionId, watchSessionId);

      expect(blockedSessions.get(notarySessionId)?.attemptCount).toBe(2);
      expect(blockedSessions.size).toBe(1);
    });

    it('allows two different notarySessions to be blocked independently', () => {
      const blockedSessions = new Map<string, BlockedEntry>();

      applyBlockKey(blockedSessions, '507f1f77bcf86cd799439011', 'session-run1');
      applyBlockKey(blockedSessions, '507f1f77bcf86cd799439022', 'session-run1');

      expect(blockedSessions.size).toBe(2);
      expect(blockedSessions.has('507f1f77bcf86cd799439011')).toBe(true);
      expect(blockedSessions.has('507f1f77bcf86cd799439022')).toBe(true);
    });
  });

  describe('Session Name Dedup Gate', () => {
    // Mirrors the seenSessionNames logic in the service worker candidate_detected handler
    function checkDedup(
      seenSessionNames: Map<string, string>,
      sessionKey: string,
      dedupWindowMs: number
    ): 'suppressed_duplicate' | 'proceed' {
      const previouslySeen = seenSessionNames.get(sessionKey);
      if (previouslySeen) {
        const ageMs = Date.now() - new Date(previouslySeen).getTime();
        if (ageMs < dedupWindowMs) return 'suppressed_duplicate';
      }
      seenSessionNames.set(sessionKey, new Date().toISOString());
      return 'proceed';
    }

    it('allows first occurrence of a session key', () => {
      const seenSessionNames = new Map<string, string>();
      const result = checkDedup(seenSessionNames, 'selector|Accept Request', 180_000);
      expect(result).toBe('proceed');
      expect(seenSessionNames.size).toBe(1);
    });

    it('suppresses duplicate within the dedup window', () => {
      const seenSessionNames = new Map<string, string>();
      const key = 'selector|Accept Request';
      // Record first seen 30 seconds ago
      seenSessionNames.set(key, new Date(Date.now() - 30_000).toISOString());
      const result = checkDedup(seenSessionNames, key, 180_000);
      expect(result).toBe('suppressed_duplicate');
    });

    it('allows recurrence after the dedup window expires', () => {
      const seenSessionNames = new Map<string, string>();
      const key = 'selector|Accept Request';
      // Record first seen 4 minutes ago (240s > 180s window)
      seenSessionNames.set(key, new Date(Date.now() - 240_000).toISOString());
      const result = checkDedup(seenSessionNames, key, 180_000);
      expect(result).toBe('proceed');
    });

    it('two different session keys are tracked independently', () => {
      const seenSessionNames = new Map<string, string>();
      const result1 = checkDedup(seenSessionNames, 'selector|Accept Request - Alice', 180_000);
      const result2 = checkDedup(seenSessionNames, 'selector|Accept Request - Bob', 180_000);
      expect(result1).toBe('proceed');
      expect(result2).toBe('proceed');
      expect(seenSessionNames.size).toBe(2);
    });

    it('clears seenSessionNames map on watch stop', () => {
      const seenSessionNames = new Map<string, string>();
      seenSessionNames.set('selector|Session A', new Date().toISOString());
      seenSessionNames.set('selector|Session B', new Date().toISOString());
      seenSessionNames.clear();
      expect(seenSessionNames.size).toBe(0);
    });
  });
});



==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/apps/chrome-extensions/blue-notary-extension/src/tests/unit/sidepanel/notary-app-send-message.test.ts ====
import { describe, it, expect, vi } from 'vitest';

// Simulate the refreshState / refreshInspectorBundle pattern used in NotaryApp.tsx.
// These tests verify the try/catch guard prevents unhandled promise rejections
// when the service worker is not yet ready (startup race condition).

describe('NotaryApp sendMessage guard', () => {
  it('refreshState swallows connection error and does not throw', async () => {
    const setState = vi.fn();
    const sendMessage = vi.fn().mockRejectedValue(
      new Error('Could not establish connection. Receiving end does not exist.')
    );

    async function refreshState() {
      try {
        const response = await sendMessage({ type: 'GET_STATE' });
        if (response?.ok && response.state) {
          setState(response.state);
        }
      } catch {
        // Service worker not yet ready — will retry on next STATE_UPDATED
      }
    }

    await expect(refreshState()).resolves.toBeUndefined();
    expect(setState).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('refreshInspectorBundle swallows connection error and does not throw', async () => {
    const setBundle = vi.fn();
    const sendMessage = vi.fn().mockRejectedValue(
      new Error('Could not establish connection. Receiving end does not exist.')
    );

    async function refreshInspectorBundle() {
      try {
        const response = await sendMessage({ type: 'GET_INSPECTOR_DATA' });
        if (response?.ok && response.bundle) {
          setBundle(response.bundle);
        }
      } catch {
        // Service worker not yet ready
      }
    }

    await expect(refreshInspectorBundle()).resolves.toBeUndefined();
    expect(setBundle).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('refreshState sets state on successful response', async () => {
    const setState = vi.fn();
    const mockState = { watch: { status: 'idle' } };
    const sendMessage = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ ok: true, state: mockState });

    async function refreshState() {
      try {
        const response = await sendMessage({ type: 'GET_STATE' });
        if (response?.ok && response.state) {
          setState(response.state);
        }
      } catch {
        // Service worker not yet ready
      }
    }

    await refreshState();
    expect(setState).toHaveBeenCalledWith(mockState);
  });
});

import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';

import {
  installBlueNotaryPageMonitor,
  runBlueNotaryApiClaimAssist,
} from '../../../socket/blue-notary-page-monitor.js';

const MONITOR_KEY = '__REMOTE_NOTARY_BLUE_MONITOR__';
const CHANNEL = 'REMOTE_NOTARY_PAGE_MONITOR';

function restoreMonitor() {
  const state = (window as typeof window & Record<string, unknown>)[MONITOR_KEY];
  if (!state || typeof state !== 'object') return;
  const s = state as Record<string, unknown>;
  if (s['originalFetch']) {
    (window as typeof window & Record<string, unknown>)['fetch'] = s['originalFetch'];
  }
  if (s['OriginalWebSocket']) {
    (window as typeof window & Record<string, unknown>)['WebSocket'] = s['OriginalWebSocket'];
  }
  XMLHttpRequest.prototype.open = s['originalXHROpen'] as typeof XMLHttpRequest.prototype.open;
  XMLHttpRequest.prototype.send = s['originalXHRSend'] as typeof XMLHttpRequest.prototype.send;
  XMLHttpRequest.prototype.setRequestHeader = s['originalXHRSetRequestHeader'] as typeof XMLHttpRequest.prototype.setRequestHeader;
  delete (window as typeof window & Record<string, unknown>)[MONITOR_KEY];
}

describe('blue-notary-page-monitor', () => {
  afterEach(() => {
    restoreMonitor();
    vi.restoreAllMocks();
  });

  it('emits network and socket signals for claim-eligible fetch activity', async () => {
    const postMessageSpy = vi.spyOn(window, 'postMessage');

    (window as typeof window & Record<string, unknown>)['fetch'] = vi.fn(async () =>
      new Response('Meeting in progress for this session', {
        status: 200,
        headers: {
          'content-type': 'application/json',
        },
      })
    );

    installBlueNotaryPageMonitor({
      enabled: true,
      mode: 'observe-api-eligibility',
      deepTrace: true,
    });

    await window.fetch('/api/open-call/claim', {
      method: 'POST',
      body: JSON.stringify({ action: 'pick up session' }),
      headers: {
        'content-type': 'application/json',
      },
    });

    const emittedPayloads = postMessageSpy.mock.calls
      .map(call => call[0] as { source?: string; type?: string; payload?: Record<string, unknown> })
      .filter(payload => payload?.source === CHANNEL);

    expect(emittedPayloads.some(payload => payload.type === 'network')).toBe(true);
    expect(
      emittedPayloads.some(
        payload =>
          payload.type === 'socket' &&
          payload.payload?.['claimEligibilitySignal'] === true
      )
    ).toBe(true);
    expect(
      emittedPayloads.some(
        payload =>
          payload.type === 'socket' &&
          payload.payload?.['activeSessionSignal'] === true
      )
    ).toBe(true);
  });

  it('captures lastClaimTemplate for pickUpSession URL path (no spaces)', async () => {
    const NOTARY_SESSION_ID = '507f1f77bcf86cd799439011';
    let fetchCount = 0;
    (window as typeof window & Record<string, unknown>)['fetch'] = vi.fn(async () => {
      fetchCount += 1;
      return new Response('ok', { status: 200 });
    });

    installBlueNotaryPageMonitor({
      enabled: true,
      mode: 'observe-api-eligibility',
      deepTrace: false,
    });

    await window.fetch(`/api/session/pickUpSession/${NOTARY_SESSION_ID}`, {

    expect(result.error).not.toBe('No claim template captured yet');
    expect(fetchCount).toBe(2);

import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, vi } from 'vitest';
import {
  createBlueNotaryWatchAdapter,
  type WatchCandidateDescriptor,
} from '../../../watch/domain-watch-adapter.js';
import { executeClaimWithFallbacks } from '../../../watch/claim-executor.js';

function getCandidate(): WatchCandidateDescriptor {
  const button = document.querySelector('button') as HTMLButtonElement;
  const rect = button.getBoundingClientRect();
  return {
    element: button,
    text: button.textContent || '',
    selector: 'button',
    x: rect.left + rect.width / 2,
    y: rect.top + rect.height / 2,
  };
}

describe('claim-executor', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    document.body.innerHTML = `
      <div class="card-draggable-wrapper">
        <button>Join as Witness</button>
      </div>
    `;
  });

  it('succeeds with direct-click when the target is still connected', () => {
    const button = document.querySelector('button') as HTMLButtonElement;
    const clickSpy = vi.spyOn(button, 'click');
    const attempts: string[] = [];
    const adapter = createBlueNotaryWatchAdapter(document, {
      containerSelector: '.card-draggable-wrapper',
      buttonSelector: 'button',
      keywords: ['join'],
    });

    const result = executeClaimWithFallbacks({
      document,
      adapter,
      candidate: getCandidate(),
      buttonText: 'Join as Witness',
      onAttempt: attempt => attempts.push(`${attempt.strategy}:${attempt.success}`),
    });

    expect(result.strategy).toBe('direct-click');
    expect(result.success).toBe(true);
    expect(clickSpy).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(attempts).toEqual(['direct-click:true']);
  });

  it('falls back to selector-refresh-click when the original target disconnects', () => {
    const original = document.querySelector('button') as HTMLButtonElement;
    const replacement = document.createElement('button');
    replacement.textContent = 'Join as Witness';
    const adapter = createBlueNotaryWatchAdapter(document, {
      containerSelector: '.card-draggable-wrapper',
      buttonSelector: 'button',
      keywords: ['join'],
    });
    const attempts: string[] = [];

    vi.spyOn(original, 'click').mockImplementation(() => {
      original.remove();
      document.querySelector('.card-draggable-wrapper')?.appendChild(replacement);
      throw new Error('stale element');
    });
    const replacementClick = vi.spyOn(replacement, 'click');

    const result = executeClaimWithFallbacks({
      document,
      adapter,
      candidate: getCandidate(),
      buttonText: 'Join as Witness',
      onAttempt: attempt => attempts.push(`${attempt.strategy}:${attempt.success}`),
    });

    expect(result.strategy).toBe('selector-refresh-click');
    expect(result.success).toBe(true);
    expect(replacementClick).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(attempts).toEqual([
      'direct-click:false',
      'selector-refresh-click:true',
    ]);
  });

  it('falls back to coordinate-click when click-based strategies fail', () => {
    const button = document.querySelector('button') as HTMLButtonElement;
    const adapter = createBlueNotaryWatchAdapter(document, {
      containerSelector: '.card-draggable-wrapper',
      buttonSelector: 'button',
      keywords: ['join'],
    });
    const attempts: string[] = [];

    vi.spyOn(button, 'click').mockImplementation(() => {
      throw new Error('click failed');
    });
    Object.defineProperty(document, 'elementFromPoint', {
      configurable: true,
      value: vi.fn().mockReturnValue(button),
    });
    const dispatchSpy = vi.spyOn(button, 'dispatchEvent');

    const result = executeClaimWithFallbacks({
      document,
      adapter,
      candidate: getCandidate(),
      buttonText: 'Join as Witness',
      onAttempt: attempt => attempts.push(`${attempt.strategy}:${attempt.success}`),
    });

    expect(result.strategy).toBe('coordinate-click');
    expect(result.success).toBe(true);
    expect(dispatchSpy).toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(attempts).toEqual([
      'direct-click:false',
      'selector-refresh-click:false',
      'coordinate-click:true',
    ]);
  });
});

function makeSection(headingText: string, containerClass = 'card-draggable-wrapper'): HTMLElement {
  const section = document.createElement('section');
  const h2 = document.createElement('h2');
  h2.textContent = headingText;
  const container = document.createElement('div');
  container.className = containerClass;
  section.appendChild(h2);
  section.appendChild(container);
  document.body.appendChild(section);
  return section;
}

describe('resolveBlueNotaryWatchContainer', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    document.body.innerHTML = '';
  });

  it('returns the single matching container directly', () => {
    const div = document.createElement('div');
    div.className = 'card-draggable-wrapper';
    document.body.appendChild(div);

    const result = resolveBlueNotaryWatchContainer(document, {
      containerSelector: '.card-draggable-wrapper',
    });
    expect(result).toBe(div);
  });

  it('uses heading text to disambiguate when multiple containers match', () => {
    makeSection('Scheduled Meetings', 'card-draggable-wrapper');
    const targetSection = makeSection('Open Calls', 'card-draggable-wrapper');
    const targetContainer = targetSection.querySelector('.card-draggable-wrapper')!;

    const result = resolveBlueNotaryWatchContainer(document, {
      containerSelector: '.card-draggable-wrapper',
      headingText: 'Open Calls',
    });
    expect(result).toBe(targetContainer);
  });

  it('falls back to heading-only search when containerSelector yields nothing', () => {
    const section = makeSection('Open Calls', 'card-draggable-wrapper');

    const result = resolveBlueNotaryWatchContainer(document, {
      containerSelector: '.non-existent-selector',
      headingText: 'Open Calls',
    });
    // Falls back to the section element since containerSelector didn't match within it
    expect(result).not.toBeNull();
    expect(result === section || section.contains(result)).toBe(true);
  });

  it('returns null when nothing matches', () => {
    const result = resolveBlueNotaryWatchContainer(document, {
      containerSelector: '.card-draggable-wrapper',
    });
    expect(result).toBeNull();
  });
});

==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/apps/chrome-extensions/blue-notary-extension/src/tests/unit/watch/platform-scheduler.test.ts ====
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { createDefaultSchedulerState } from '../../../platforms/default-settings.js';
import {
  acquireMutex,
  getPauseReasonForSession,
  noteSuccessfulClaim,
  releaseMutexIfClear,
  setOperatorOverride,
} from '../../../watch/platform-scheduler.js';
import { createNewSession } from '../../../watch/watch-session-state.js';

describe('platform scheduler', () => {
  it('pauses other sessions when a mutex is active', () => {
    const state = acquireMutex(createDefaultSchedulerState(), 'blue-notary', 22);
    const blockedSession = createNewSession(11, 'blue-notary');

    expect(getPauseReasonForSession(state, blockedSession)).toBe('active_session');
  });

  it('allows override to bypass mutex but not rate limits', () => {
    let state = acquireMutex(createDefaultSchedulerState(), 'blue-notary', 22);
    state = setOperatorOverride(state, true, 15 * 60 * 1000);

    const otherSession = createNewSession(11, 'blue-notary');
    expect(getPauseReasonForSession(state, otherSession)).toBeNull();

    for (let index = 0; index < 6; index += 1) {
      state = noteSuccessfulClaim(state, 'blue-notary').state;
    }

    expect(getPauseReasonForSession(state, otherSession)).toBe('rate_limit');
  });

  it('releases the mutex after two clear heartbeats', () => {
    let state = acquireMutex(createDefaultSchedulerState(), 'blue-notary', 22);
    state = releaseMutexIfClear(state, false);
    expect(state.mutex.active).toBe(true);
    expect(state.mutex.releaseChecks).toBe(1);

    state = releaseMutexIfClear(state, false);
    expect(state.mutex.active).toBe(false);
    expect(state.mutex.releaseChecks).toBe(0);
  });

  it('same-tab session is not blocked by its own mutex', () => {
    const state = acquireMutex(createDefaultSchedulerState(), 'blue-notary', 42);
    const sameTabSession = createNewSession(42, 'blue-notary');

    expect(getPauseReasonForSession(state, sameTabSession)).toBeNull();
  });

  it('resets releaseChecks when active session is still detected', () => {
    let state = acquireMutex(createDefaultSchedulerState(), 'blue-notary', 22);
    state = releaseMutexIfClear(state, false);
    expect(state.mutex.releaseChecks).toBe(1);

    // Active session still detected — reset
    state = releaseMutexIfClear(state, true);
    expect(state.mutex.releaseChecks).toBe(0);
    expect(state.mutex.active).toBe(true);
  });
});

==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/apps/chrome-extensions/blue-notary-extension/src/utils/claim-trace-store.ts ====
import type { ClaimAttemptTrace } from '../types/notary.js';

const CLAIM_TRACE_PREFIX = 'claim-trace:';
const MAX_CLAIM_TRACE_ENTRIES = 200;

function getClaimTraceKey(runId: string): string {
  return `${CLAIM_TRACE_PREFIX}${runId}`;
}

export async function appendClaimTraceEntries(
  runId: string,
  entries: ClaimAttemptTrace[]
): Promise<void> {
  if (entries.length === 0) return;
  const key = getClaimTraceKey(runId);
  const stored = await chrome.storage.session.get(key);
  const existing = Array.isArray(stored[key])
    ? (stored[key] as ClaimAttemptTrace[])
    : [];
  existing.unshift(...entries.slice().reverse());
  if (existing.length > MAX_CLAIM_TRACE_ENTRIES) {
    existing.length = MAX_CLAIM_TRACE_ENTRIES;
  }
  await chrome.storage.session.set({ [key]: existing });
}

export async function getClaimTraceEntries(
  runId?: string
): Promise<ClaimAttemptTrace[]> {
  if (!runId) {
    return [];
  }
  const key = getClaimTraceKey(runId);
  const stored = await chrome.storage.session.get(key);
  return Array.isArray(stored[key]) ? (stored[key] as ClaimAttemptTrace[]) : [];
}

export async function clearClaimTraceEntries(runId?: string): Promise<void> {
  if (runId) {
    await chrome.storage.session.remove(getClaimTraceKey(runId));
    return;
  }
  const stored = await chrome.storage.session.get(null);
  const keys = Object.keys(stored).filter(key => key.startsWith(CLAIM_TRACE_PREFIX));
  if (keys.length > 0) {

}

const RUN_LOG_PREFIX = 'run-log:';

function getRunLogKey(runId: string): string {
  return `${RUN_LOG_PREFIX}${runId}`;
}

export async function appendRunLog(
  runId: string,
  entry: LogEntry
): Promise<void> {
  await appendRunLogs(runId, [entry]);
}

export async function appendRunLogs(
  runId: string,
  entries: LogEntry[]
): Promise<void> {
  if (entries.length === 0) return;
  const key = getRunLogKey(runId);
  const stored = await chrome.storage.session.get(key);
  const existing = stored[key];
  const logs = Array.isArray(existing) ? (existing as LogEntry[]) : [];
  logs.unshift(...entries.slice().reverse());
  if (logs.length > MAX_RUN_LOG_ENTRIES) {
    logs.length = MAX_RUN_LOG_ENTRIES;
  }
  await chrome.storage.session.set({ [key]: logs });
}

export async function getRunLog(runId: string): Promise<LogEntry[]> {
  const key = getRunLogKey(runId);
  const stored = await chrome.storage.session.get(key);
  const logs = stored[key];
  return Array.isArray(logs) ? (logs as LogEntry[]) : [];
}

export async function clearRunLogs(runId?: string): Promise<void> {
  if (runId) {
    await chrome.storage.session.remove(getRunLogKey(runId));
    return;
  }

  const stored = await chrome.storage.session.get(null);
  const keys = Object.keys(stored).filter(key => key.startsWith(RUN_LOG_PREFIX));
  if (keys.length > 0) {
    await chrome.storage.session.remove(keys);
  }
}
