==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/apps/chrome-extensions/blue-notary-extension/src/watch/claim-executor.ts ====
import type { WatchClaimStrategy } from '../types/notary.js';
import type {
  WatchCandidateDescriptor,
  WatchPlatformAdapter,
} from '../platforms/types.js';

export interface ClaimAttemptTelemetry {
  strategy: WatchClaimStrategy;
  success: boolean;
  reasonCode: string;
  buttonText?: string;
  candidateSelector?: string;
}

export interface ClaimExecutionOptions {
  document: Document;
  adapter: WatchPlatformAdapter;
  candidate: WatchCandidateDescriptor | null;
  buttonText?: string;
  onAttempt?: (attempt: ClaimAttemptTelemetry) => void;
}

export interface ClaimExecutionResult extends ClaimAttemptTelemetry {}

function emitAttempt(
  options: ClaimExecutionOptions,
  attempt: ClaimAttemptTelemetry
): ClaimAttemptTelemetry {
  options.onAttempt?.(attempt);
  return attempt;
}

function scrollIntoView(target: HTMLElement): void {
  try {
    target.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center', inline: 'center' });
  } catch {
    /* ignore */
  }
}

function dispatchMouseSequence(target: HTMLElement): void {
  const rect = target.getBoundingClientRect();
  const clientX = rect.left + rect.width / 2;
  const clientY = rect.top + rect.height / 2;

  for (const type of ['mousedown', 'mouseup', 'click']) {
    target.dispatchEvent(
      new MouseEvent(type, {
        bubbles: true,
        cancelable: true,
        clientX,
        clientY,
      })
    );
  }
}

function attemptDirectClick(
  options: ClaimExecutionOptions
): ClaimExecutionResult {
  const candidate = options.candidate;
  if (!candidate?.element) {
    return emitAttempt(options, {
      strategy: 'direct-click',
      success: false,
      reasonCode: 'candidate_missing',
      buttonText: options.buttonText,
    });
  }

  if (!candidate.element.isConnected) {
    return emitAttempt(options, {
      strategy: 'direct-click',
      success: false,
      reasonCode: 'disconnected_target',
      buttonText: candidate.text || options.buttonText,
      candidateSelector: candidate.selector,
    });
  }

  try {
    scrollIntoView(candidate.element);
    candidate.element.click();
    return emitAttempt(options, {
      strategy: 'direct-click',
      success: true,
      reasonCode: 'clicked',
      buttonText: candidate.text || options.buttonText,
      candidateSelector: candidate.selector,
    });
  } catch {
    return emitAttempt(options, {
      strategy: 'direct-click',
      success: false,
      reasonCode: 'direct_click_failed',
      buttonText: candidate.text || options.buttonText,
      candidateSelector: candidate.selector,
    });
  }
}

function attemptSelectorRefreshClick(
  options: ClaimExecutionOptions
): ClaimExecutionResult {
  const refreshed = options.adapter.findRefreshedCandidate(options.buttonText);
  if (!refreshed) {
    return emitAttempt(options, {
      strategy: 'selector-refresh-click',
      success: false,
      reasonCode: 'refreshed_candidate_missing',
      buttonText: options.buttonText,
    });
  }

  try {
    scrollIntoView(refreshed.element);
    dispatchMouseSequence(refreshed.element);
    refreshed.element.click();
    return emitAttempt(options, {
      strategy: 'selector-refresh-click',
      success: true,
      reasonCode: 'clicked',
      buttonText: refreshed.text || options.buttonText,
      candidateSelector: refreshed.selector,
    });
  } catch {
    return emitAttempt(options, {
      strategy: 'selector-refresh-click',
      success: false,
      reasonCode: 'selector_refresh_failed',
      buttonText: refreshed.text || options.buttonText,
      candidateSelector: refreshed.selector,
    });
  }
}

function attemptCoordinateClick(
  options: ClaimExecutionOptions
): ClaimExecutionResult {
  const candidate =
    options.adapter.findRefreshedCandidate(options.buttonText) ?? options.candidate;
  if (!candidate?.element) {
    return emitAttempt(options, {
      strategy: 'coordinate-click',
      success: false,
      reasonCode: 'coordinate_target_missing',
      buttonText: options.buttonText,
    });
  }

  const hitTarget = options.document.elementFromPoint(candidate.x, candidate.y);
  if (!(hitTarget instanceof HTMLElement)) {
    return emitAttempt(options, {
      strategy: 'coordinate-click',
      success: false,
      reasonCode: 'hit_target_missing',
      buttonText: candidate.text || options.buttonText,
      candidateSelector: candidate.selector,
    });
  }

  try {
    scrollIntoView(hitTarget);
    dispatchMouseSequence(hitTarget);
    return emitAttempt(options, {
      strategy: 'coordinate-click',
      success: true,
      reasonCode: 'clicked',
      buttonText: candidate.text || options.buttonText,
      candidateSelector: candidate.selector,
    });
  } catch {
    return emitAttempt(options, {
      strategy: 'coordinate-click',
      success: false,
      reasonCode: 'coordinate_dispatch_failed',
      buttonText: candidate.text || options.buttonText,
      candidateSelector: candidate.selector,
    });
  }
}

export function executeClaimWithFallbacks(
  options: ClaimExecutionOptions
): ClaimExecutionResult {
  const direct = attemptDirectClick(options);
  if (direct.success) return direct;

  const refreshed = attemptSelectorRefreshClick(options);
  if (refreshed.success) return refreshed;

  const coordinate = attemptCoordinateClick(options);
  return coordinate ?? {
    strategy: 'coordinate-click',
    success: false,
    reasonCode: 'no_attempts',
    buttonText: options.buttonText,
  };
}



==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/apps/chrome-extensions/blue-notary-extension/src/watch/domain-watch-adapter.ts ====
import type {
  WatchCandidateDescriptor,
  WatchPlatformAdapter,
} from '../platforms/types.js';

export interface BlueNotaryWatchAdapterOptions {
  containerSelector: string;
  buttonSelector?: string;
  headingText?: string;
  noDataSelector?: string;
  keywords?: string[];
}

export interface BlueNotaryWatchAdapter extends WatchPlatformAdapter {}

const DEFAULT_BUTTON_SELECTOR =
  '.q-virtual-scroll__content .q-btn, .card-draggable-wrapper button, button,[role="button"]';

function escapeSelectorValue(value: string): string {
  return value.replace(/["\\.#:[\]]/g, '\\$&');
}

function normalizeText(value: string | null | undefined): string {
  return (value ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
}

function matchesKeywords(text: string, keywords?: string[]): boolean {
  if (!keywords || keywords.length === 0) return true;
  const normalized = normalizeText(text);
  if (!normalized) return false;
  return keywords.some(keyword => normalized.includes(normalizeText(keyword)));
}

function isClickable(element: HTMLElement): boolean {
  if (element instanceof HTMLButtonElement && element.disabled) return false;
  if (element.getAttribute('aria-disabled') === 'true') return false;
  const style = window.getComputedStyle(element);
  if (style.display === 'none' || style.visibility === 'hidden') return false;
  return true;
}

function buildElementSelector(element: HTMLElement, fallbackSelector: string): string {
  if (element.id) {
    return `#${escapeSelectorValue(element.id)}`;
  }

  const testId = element.getAttribute('data-testid');
  if (testId) {
    return `[data-testid="${escapeSelectorValue(testId)}"]`;
  }

  const classes = Array.from(element.classList).slice(0, 2);
  if (classes.length > 0) {
    return `${element.tagName.toLowerCase()}.${classes
      .map(cls => escapeSelectorValue(cls))
      .join('.')}`;
  }

  return fallbackSelector;
}

function createDescriptor(
  element: HTMLElement,
  fallbackSelector: string
): WatchCandidateDescriptor {
  const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect();
  return {
    element,
    text: (element.textContent ?? '').trim(),
    selector: buildElementSelector(element, fallbackSelector),
    x: rect.left + rect.width / 2,
    y: rect.top + rect.height / 2,
  };
}

export function resolveBlueNotaryWatchContainer(
  documentRef: Document,
  options: Pick<BlueNotaryWatchAdapterOptions, 'containerSelector' | 'headingText'>
): Element | null {
  if (options.containerSelector) {
    const candidates = Array.from(
      documentRef.querySelectorAll(options.containerSelector)
    );
    if (candidates.length === 1) {
      return candidates[0];
    }
    if (candidates.length > 1 && options.headingText) {
      const heading = normalizeText(options.headingText);
      for (const candidate of candidates) {
        const section = candidate.closest('section');
        if (!section) continue;
        const headingEl = section.querySelector('h2');
        const headingText = normalizeText(headingEl?.textContent);
        if (headingText.includes(heading)) {
          return candidate;
        }
      }
    }
    if (candidates.length > 0) {
      return candidates[0];
    }
  }

  if (options.headingText) {
    const heading = normalizeText(options.headingText);
    const headings = Array.from(documentRef.querySelectorAll('h2'));
    for (const element of headings) {
      const text = normalizeText(element.textContent);
      if (!text.includes(heading)) continue;
      const section = element.closest('section');
      if (!section) continue;
      if (options.containerSelector) {
        const within = section.querySelector(options.containerSelector);
        if (within) return within;
      }
      return section;
    }
  }

  return null;
}

export function createBlueNotaryWatchAdapter(
  documentRef: Document,
  options: BlueNotaryWatchAdapterOptions
): BlueNotaryWatchAdapter {
  const selector = options.buttonSelector?.trim() || DEFAULT_BUTTON_SELECTOR;

  const resolveContainer = () =>
    resolveBlueNotaryWatchContainer(documentRef, {
      containerSelector: options.containerSelector,
      headingText: options.headingText,
    });

  const isNoData = (container: Element): boolean => {
    // If a non-disabled candidate button is present the queue is not empty.
    // Guards against textContent false-positives from CSS-hidden empty-state
    // spans inside disabled buttons (ported from proof-extension fix 688934a).
    const hasActiveButton = container.querySelector(
      `${selector}:not([disabled]):not([aria-disabled="true"])`
    );
    if (hasActiveButton) return false;

    if (options.noDataSelector) {
      const noData = container.querySelector(options.noDataSelector);
      if (noData) return true;
    }

    const text = normalizeText(container.textContent);
    return (
      text.includes('no data available') ||
      text.includes('no open calls') ||
      text.includes('no calls available')
    );
  };

  const getCandidates = (container: Element): WatchCandidateDescriptor[] =>
    Array.from(container.querySelectorAll(selector))
      .filter(element => element instanceof HTMLElement && isClickable(element))
      .map(element => createDescriptor(element as HTMLElement, selector))
      .filter(candidate => matchesKeywords(candidate.text, options.keywords));

  const findRefreshedCandidate = (
    buttonText?: string
  ): WatchCandidateDescriptor | null => {
    const container = resolveContainer();
    if (!container || isNoData(container)) return null;
    const candidates = getCandidates(container);
    if (candidates.length === 0) return null;

    if (buttonText) {
      const normalized = normalizeText(buttonText);
      const exact = candidates.find(
        candidate => normalizeText(candidate.text) === normalized
      );
      if (exact) return exact;
    }

    return candidates[0] ?? null;
  };

  return {
    resolveContainer,
    isNoData,
    getCandidates,
    findRefreshedCandidate,
    detectActiveSession: () => false,
    detectInQueue: () => false,
    detectPausedReason: () => null,
    getNetworkSnapshot: () => undefined,
  };
}



==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/apps/chrome-extensions/blue-notary-extension/src/watch/platform-scheduler.ts ====
import type { SchedulerState, SchedulerLeaseSummary, TokenBucketSnapshot } from '../types/notary.js';
import type { PauseReason, PlatformId } from '../platforms/types.js';
import type { WatchSessionState } from './watch-session-state.js';

function cloneBucket(bucket: TokenBucketSnapshot): TokenBucketSnapshot {
  return { ...bucket };
}

export function refillBucket(
  bucket: TokenBucketSnapshot,
  nowMs: number = Date.now()
): TokenBucketSnapshot {
  const lastRefillMs = Date.parse(bucket.lastRefillAt);
  if (Number.isNaN(lastRefillMs)) {
    return {
      ...bucket,
      tokens: bucket.capacity,
      lastRefillAt: new Date(nowMs).toISOString(),
    };
  }

  const elapsedHours = Math.max(0, nowMs - lastRefillMs) / 3_600_000;
  const replenished = Math.min(
    bucket.capacity,
    bucket.tokens + elapsedHours * bucket.refillPerHour
  );

  return {
    ...bucket,
    tokens: replenished,
    lastRefillAt: new Date(nowMs).toISOString(),
  };
}

export function consumeBucketToken(
  bucket: TokenBucketSnapshot,
  nowMs: number = Date.now()
): { bucket: TokenBucketSnapshot; allowed: boolean } {
  const refilled = refillBucket(bucket, nowMs);
  if (refilled.tokens < 1) {
    return { bucket: refilled, allowed: false };
  }
  return {
    allowed: true,
    bucket: {
      ...refilled,
      tokens: Math.max(0, refilled.tokens - 1),
      lastRefillAt: new Date(nowMs).toISOString(),
    },
  };
}

export function snapshotLeases(
  sessions: Iterable<WatchSessionState>
): SchedulerLeaseSummary[] {
  return Array.from(sessions).map(session => ({
    tabId: session.tabId,
    platform: session.platform,
    sessionId: session.sessionId,
    status: session.status,
    heartbeatAt: session.heartbeatAt,
    pauseReason: session.pauseReason,
  }));
}

export function withLeaseSnapshot(
  state: SchedulerState,
  sessions: Iterable<WatchSessionState>
): SchedulerState {
  return {
    ...state,
    leases: snapshotLeases(sessions),
  };
}

export function withSchedulerStatus(
  state: SchedulerState,
  status: SchedulerState['status'],
  runId?: string | null
): SchedulerState {
  return {
    ...state,
    status,
    runId: runId === undefined ? state.runId : runId,
  };
}

export function setOperatorOverride(
  state: SchedulerState,
  enabled: boolean,
  windowMs: number,
  nowMs: number = Date.now()
): SchedulerState {
  return {
    ...state,
    operatorOverride: enabled,
    overrideUntil: enabled ? new Date(nowMs + windowMs).toISOString() : undefined,
  };
}

export function isOverrideActive(
  state: SchedulerState,
  nowMs: number = Date.now()
): boolean {
  if (!state.operatorOverride || !state.overrideUntil) {
    return false;
  }
  const until = Date.parse(state.overrideUntil);
  return !Number.isNaN(until) && until > nowMs;
}

export function acquireMutex(
  state: SchedulerState,
  platform: PlatformId,
  tabId: number,
  reason: PauseReason = 'active_session'
): SchedulerState {
  return {
    ...state,
    mutex: {
      active: true,
      platform,
      tabId,
      reason,
      acquiredAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      releaseChecks: 0,
    },
  };
}

export function releaseMutexIfClear(
  state: SchedulerState,
  activeSessionStillDetected: boolean
): SchedulerState {
  if (!state.mutex.active) {
    return state;
  }

  if (activeSessionStillDetected) {
    return {
      ...state,
      mutex: {
        ...state.mutex,
        releaseChecks: 0,
      },
    };
  }

  const releaseChecks = (state.mutex.releaseChecks || 0) + 1;
  if (releaseChecks >= 2) {
    return {
      ...state,
      mutex: {
        active: false,
        releaseChecks: 0,
      },
    };
  }

  return {
    ...state,
    mutex: {
      ...state.mutex,
      releaseChecks,
    },
  };
}

export function noteSuccessfulClaim(
  state: SchedulerState,
  platform: PlatformId,
  nowMs: number = Date.now()
): { state: SchedulerState; rateLimited: boolean } {
  const platformBucket = consumeBucketToken(state.platformBuckets[platform], nowMs);
  const globalBucket = consumeBucketToken(state.globalBucket, nowMs);
  const nextState: SchedulerState = {
    ...state,
    globalBucket: cloneBucket(globalBucket.bucket),
    platformBuckets: {
      ...state.platformBuckets,
      [platform]: cloneBucket(platformBucket.bucket),
    },
  };

  return {
    state: nextState,
    rateLimited: !platformBucket.allowed || !globalBucket.allowed,
  };
}

export function getPauseReasonForSession(
  state: SchedulerState,
  session: WatchSessionState,
  nowMs: number = Date.now()
): PauseReason | null {
  const platformBucket = refillBucket(state.platformBuckets[session.platform], nowMs);
  const globalBucket = refillBucket(state.globalBucket, nowMs);

  if (
    state.mutex.active &&
    state.mutex.tabId !== session.tabId &&
    !isOverrideActive(state, nowMs)
  ) {
    return 'active_session';
  }

  if (platformBucket.tokens < 1 || globalBucket.tokens < 1) {
    return 'rate_limit';
  }

  return null;
}



==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/apps/chrome-extensions/blue-notary-extension/src/watch/watch-overlay-controller.ts ====
/**
 * Phase 2: Scoped watch overlay controller.
 * Renders overlay only when container (and optional candidate) are resolved; never full viewport.
 * Idempotent mount/update/unmount; one instance per watch session.
 */
import { resolveWatchContainer } from '../content/watch-observer.js';

export interface ScopedWatchOverlayOptions {
  document?: Document;
  containerSelector: string;
  targetSelector?: string;
  headingText?: string;
  label?: string;
  statusText?: string;
  color?: string;
}

export interface ScopedWatchOverlayController {
  mount(options: ScopedWatchOverlayOptions): void;
  update(options: Partial<ScopedWatchOverlayOptions>): void;
  unmount(): void;
  isMounted(): boolean;
}

const OVERLAY_ID = 'notary-watch-overlay-scoped';
const STYLE_ID = 'notary-watch-style-scoped';

function getRect(el: Element): DOMRect {
  return el.getBoundingClientRect();
}

/**
 * Create a scoped watch overlay controller. Only draws when container (and optional target) resolve.
 * Never falls back to full viewport.
 */
export function createScopedWatchOverlayController(): ScopedWatchOverlayController {
  const doc = document;
  let mounted = false;
  let options: ScopedWatchOverlayOptions = {
    containerSelector: '',
  };
  let overlayEl: HTMLDivElement | null = null;
  let containerOutline: HTMLDivElement | null = null;
  let candidateOutline: HTMLDivElement | null = null;
  let indicatorEl: HTMLDivElement | null = null;
  let statusEl: HTMLDivElement | null = null;
  let styleEl: HTMLStyleElement | null = null;
  let rafId = 0;
  let resizeObserver: ResizeObserver | null = null;

  function clearDom(): void {
    if (rafId && doc.defaultView) {
      doc.defaultView.cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
      rafId = 0;
    }
    resizeObserver?.disconnect();
    resizeObserver = null;
    containerOutline?.remove();
    containerOutline = null;
    candidateOutline?.remove();
    candidateOutline = null;
    indicatorEl?.remove();
    indicatorEl = null;
    statusEl?.remove();
    statusEl = null;
    overlayEl?.remove();
    overlayEl = null;
    styleEl?.remove();
    styleEl = null;
    mounted = false;
  }

  function applyRect(): void {
    if (!overlayEl || !containerOutline) return;
    const docRef = options.document ?? doc;
    const container = resolveWatchContainer(
      docRef,
      options.containerSelector,
      options.headingText,
      'blue-notary'
    );
    if (!container) {
      containerOutline.style.display = 'none';
      containerOutline.style.width = '0';
      containerOutline.style.height = '0';
      if (candidateOutline) {
        candidateOutline.style.display = 'none';
      }
      return;
    }
    const containerRect = getRect(container);
    containerOutline.style.display = 'block';
    containerOutline.style.top = `${containerRect.top}px`;
    containerOutline.style.left = `${containerRect.left}px`;
    containerOutline.style.width = `${containerRect.width}px`;
    containerOutline.style.height = `${containerRect.height}px`;

    const buttonSelector = (options.targetSelector ?? '').trim() || 'button,[role="button"]';
    const buttons = Array.from(container.querySelectorAll(buttonSelector));
    const firstCandidate: Element | null = buttons[0] ?? null;
    if (candidateOutline) {
      if (firstCandidate) {
        const candidateRect = getRect(firstCandidate);
        candidateOutline.style.display = 'block';
        candidateOutline.style.top = `${candidateRect.top}px`;
        candidateOutline.style.left = `${candidateRect.left}px`;
        candidateOutline.style.width = `${candidateRect.width}px`;
        candidateOutline.style.height = `${candidateRect.height}px`;
        if (indicatorEl) {
          indicatorEl.style.top = `${containerRect.top - 28}px`;
          indicatorEl.style.left = `${containerRect.left}px`;
        }
        if (statusEl) {
          statusEl.style.top = `${containerRect.top + 8}px`;
          statusEl.style.left = `${containerRect.left + containerRect.width - 56}px`;
        }
      } else {
        candidateOutline.style.display = 'none';
        if (indicatorEl) {
          indicatorEl.style.top = `${containerRect.top - 28}px`;
          indicatorEl.style.left = `${containerRect.left}px`;
        }
        if (statusEl) {
          statusEl.style.top = `${containerRect.top + 8}px`;
          statusEl.style.left = `${containerRect.left + containerRect.width - 56}px`;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  function tick(): void {
    applyRect();
    rafId = doc.defaultView?.requestAnimationFrame(tick) ?? 0;
  }

  return {
    isMounted() {
      return mounted;
    },

    mount(opts: ScopedWatchOverlayOptions): void {
      if (mounted) {
        this.update(opts);
        return;
      }
      options = { ...opts };
      const color = options.color ?? 'rgba(15, 118, 110, 0.78)';

      styleEl = doc.createElement('style');
      styleEl.id = STYLE_ID;
      styleEl.textContent = `
        @keyframes notaryWatchPulseScoped {
          0%, 100% { opacity: 0.4; }
          50% { opacity: 0.9; }
        }
      `;
      doc.head.appendChild(styleEl);

      overlayEl = doc.createElement('div');
      overlayEl.id = OVERLAY_ID;
      overlayEl.style.position = 'fixed';
      overlayEl.style.left = '0';
      overlayEl.style.top = '0';
      overlayEl.style.width = '0';
      overlayEl.style.height = '0';
      overlayEl.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
      overlayEl.style.zIndex = '2147483646';
      doc.body.appendChild(overlayEl);

      containerOutline = doc.createElement('div');
      containerOutline.style.position = 'fixed';
      containerOutline.style.background = 'rgba(15,118,110,0.08)';
      containerOutline.style.border = `2px solid ${color}`;
      containerOutline.style.borderRadius = '8px';
      containerOutline.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
      containerOutline.style.boxShadow = '0 0 14px rgba(15,118,110,0.3)';
      containerOutline.style.animation = 'notaryWatchPulseScoped 2s infinite';
      overlayEl.appendChild(containerOutline);

      candidateOutline = doc.createElement('div');
      candidateOutline.style.position = 'fixed';
      candidateOutline.style.background = 'rgba(217,119,6,0.12)';
      candidateOutline.style.border = `2px solid ${color}`;
      candidateOutline.style.borderRadius = '4px';
      candidateOutline.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
      candidateOutline.style.animation = 'notaryWatchPulseScoped 1.5s infinite';
      overlayEl.appendChild(candidateOutline);

      indicatorEl = doc.createElement('div');
      indicatorEl.style.position = 'fixed';
      indicatorEl.style.background = 'rgba(15,118,110,0.94)';
      indicatorEl.style.color = 'white';
      indicatorEl.style.padding = '4px 8px';
      indicatorEl.style.borderRadius = '4px';
      indicatorEl.style.fontSize = '11px';
      indicatorEl.style.fontWeight = 'bold';
      indicatorEl.style.zIndex = '2147483647';
      indicatorEl.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
      indicatorEl.textContent = options.label ?? 'WATCHING PROOF QUEUE';
      doc.body.appendChild(indicatorEl);

      statusEl = doc.createElement('div');
      statusEl.style.position = 'fixed';
      statusEl.style.background = 'rgba(217,119,6,0.94)';
      statusEl.style.color = 'white';
      statusEl.style.padding = '3px 6px';
      statusEl.style.borderRadius = '10px';
      statusEl.style.fontSize = '9px';
      statusEl.style.fontWeight = 'bold';
      statusEl.style.zIndex = '2147483647';
      statusEl.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
      statusEl.textContent = options.statusText ?? 'ACTIVE';
      doc.body.appendChild(statusEl);

      mounted = true;
      applyRect();
      rafId = doc.defaultView?.requestAnimationFrame(tick) ?? 0;
      doc.defaultView?.addEventListener('resize', applyRect);
      doc.defaultView?.addEventListener('scroll', applyRect, true);
      if (doc.defaultView?.ResizeObserver) {
        resizeObserver = new doc.defaultView.ResizeObserver(applyRect);
        resizeObserver.observe(doc.documentElement);
      }
    },

    update(opts: Partial<ScopedWatchOverlayOptions>): void {
      if (!mounted) return;
      if (opts.containerSelector !== undefined) options.containerSelector = opts.containerSelector;
      if (opts.targetSelector !== undefined) options.targetSelector = opts.targetSelector;
      if (opts.headingText !== undefined) options.headingText = opts.headingText;
      if (opts.label !== undefined && indicatorEl) indicatorEl.textContent = opts.label;
      if (opts.statusText !== undefined && statusEl) statusEl.textContent = opts.statusText;
      if (opts.color !== undefined) options.color = opts.color;
      applyRect();
    },

    unmount(): void {
      if (!mounted) return;
      doc.defaultView?.removeEventListener('resize', applyRect);
      doc.defaultView?.removeEventListener('scroll', applyRect, true);
      clearDom();
    },
  };
}



==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/apps/chrome-extensions/blue-notary-extension/src/watch/watch-session-state.ts ====
/**
 * Watch session state types and helpers for Phase 1 singleton runtime.
 * Persisted by the service worker to chrome.storage.session; content script
 * does not access storage directly.
 */

import type { WatchOverlayMode } from '../types/notary.js';
import type { PauseReason, PlatformId } from '../platforms/types.js';

export type WatchSessionStatus = 'watching' | 'paused' | 'stopped';

export interface WatchSessionState {
  tabId: number;
  runId: string;
  sessionId: string;
  leaseOwner: number;
  heartbeatAt: string;
  stopReason?: string;
  rehydratedAt?: string;
  overlayMode?: WatchOverlayMode;
  platform: PlatformId;
  pauseReason?: PauseReason;
  status: WatchSessionStatus;
}

export const WATCH_SESSION_STORAGE_KEY = 'proof-extension:watch-sessions';

export type PersistedWatchSessions = Record<string, WatchSessionState>;

function genId(): string {
  return `${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10)}`;
}

/**
 * Create a new watch session for the given tab. Caller should persist to storage.
 */
export function createNewSession(
  tabId: number,
  platform: PlatformId = 'blue-notary'
): WatchSessionState {
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  return {
    tabId,
    runId: genId(),
    sessionId: genId(),
    leaseOwner: tabId,
    heartbeatAt: now,
    platform,
    status: 'watching',
  };
}

/**
 * Update heartbeat timestamp. Returns a new state object.
 */
export function updateHeartbeat(state: WatchSessionState): WatchSessionState {
  return {
    ...state,
    heartbeatAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  };
}

/**
 * Mark session as paused. Returns a new state object.
 */
export function markPaused(
  state: WatchSessionState,
  reason?: string,
  pauseReason?: PauseReason
): WatchSessionState {
  return {
    ...state,
    status: 'paused',
    ...(reason !== undefined && { stopReason: reason }),
    ...(pauseReason !== undefined && { pauseReason }),
    heartbeatAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  };
}

/**
 * Mark session as stopped. Returns a new state object.
 */
export function markStopped(
  state: WatchSessionState,
  reason?: string,
  pauseReason?: PauseReason
): WatchSessionState {
  return {
    ...state,
    status: 'stopped',
    stopReason: reason ?? state.stopReason,
    pauseReason: pauseReason ?? state.pauseReason,
    heartbeatAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  };
}

/**
 * Mark session as rehydrated after worker wake. Returns a new state object.
 */
export function markRehydrated(state: WatchSessionState): WatchSessionState {
  return {
    ...state,
    rehydratedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    heartbeatAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  };
}

/**
 * Serialize sessions map for chrome.storage. Session keys are stringified tab IDs.
 */
export function serializeSessions(sessions: Map<number, WatchSessionState>): PersistedWatchSessions {
  const out: PersistedWatchSessions = {};
  for (const [tabId, state] of sessions) {
    out[String(tabId)] = state;
  }
  return out;
}

/**
 * Deserialize from chrome.storage into a Map. Invalid entries are skipped.
 */
export function deserializeSessions(raw: unknown): Map<number, WatchSessionState> {
  const map = new Map<number, WatchSessionState>();
  if (raw === null || typeof raw !== 'object') return map;
  const obj = raw as Record<string, unknown>;
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(obj)) {
    const tabId = parseInt(key, 10);
    if (Number.isNaN(tabId) || value === null || typeof value !== 'object') continue;
    const v = value as Record<string, unknown>;
    if (
      typeof v.tabId === 'number' &&
      typeof v.runId === 'string' &&
      typeof v.sessionId === 'string' &&
      typeof v.leaseOwner === 'number' &&
      typeof v.heartbeatAt === 'string' &&
      (v.platform === undefined ||
        v.platform === 'blue-notary' ||
        v.platform === 'proof') &&
      (v.status === 'watching' || v.status === 'paused' || v.status === 'stopped')
    ) {
      map.set(tabId, {
        tabId: v.tabId,
        runId: v.runId,
        sessionId: v.sessionId,
        leaseOwner: v.leaseOwner,
        heartbeatAt: v.heartbeatAt,
        stopReason: typeof v.stopReason === 'string' ? v.stopReason : undefined,
        rehydratedAt: typeof v.rehydratedAt === 'string' ? v.rehydratedAt : undefined,
        overlayMode:
          v.overlayMode === 'scoped' || v.overlayMode === 'disabled'
            ? v.overlayMode
            : undefined,
        platform: (v.platform as PlatformId | undefined) ?? 'blue-notary',
        pauseReason:
          v.pauseReason === 'active_session' ||
          v.pauseReason === 'rate_limit' ||
          v.pauseReason === 'operator_pause' ||
          v.pauseReason === 'platform_error' ||
          v.pauseReason === 'tab_unavailable'
            ? (v.pauseReason as PauseReason)
            : undefined,
        status: v.status as WatchSessionStatus,
      });
    }
  }
  return map;
}

==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/apps/chrome-extensions/proof-extension/scripts/build-manifest.js ====
import { writeFileSync, existsSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync } from 'fs';
import { join, dirname } from 'path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'url';

const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
const __dirname = dirname(__filename);

function buildManifest(config) {
  const manifest = {
    manifest_version: 3,
    name: config.name,
    version: config.version,
    description: config.description,
  };

  if (config.key) {
    manifest.key = config.key;
  }

  if (config.permissions?.length) {
    manifest.permissions = config.permissions;
  }

  if (config.hostPermissions?.length) {
    manifest.host_permissions = config.hostPermissions;
  }

  manifest.background = {
    service_worker: 'service_worker/index.js',
    type: 'module',
  };

  manifest.content_scripts = config.contentScripts.map(script => ({
    matches: script.matches,
    js: script.js,
    run_at: script.runAt || 'document_idle',
    world: script.world || 'ISOLATED',
    all_frames: script.allFrames ?? false,
  }));

  manifest.side_panel = {
    default_path: config.sidePanel.defaultPath,
  };

  manifest.web_accessible_resources = [
    {
      resources: config.webAccessibleResources,
      matches: ['<all_urls>'],
    },
  ];

  manifest.action = {
    default_title: config.name,
  };

  return manifest;
}

let manifestKey = null;
if (process.env.MANIFEST_KEY) {
  manifestKey = process.env.MANIFEST_KEY;
} else {
  const keyPubPath = join(__dirname, '../key.pub');
  if (existsSync(keyPubPath)) {
    try {
      const keyContent = readFileSync(keyPubPath, 'utf-8');
      manifestKey = keyContent
        .replace(/-----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY-----/g, '')
        .replace(/-----END PUBLIC KEY-----/g, '')
        .replace(/\n/g, '')
        .trim();
    } catch {
      console.warn('Could not read key.pub, manifest will not include key field');
    }
  }
}

const appConfig = {
  name: 'Proof Extension',
  version: '1.0.0',
  description:
    'Reactive Proof queue observation, auto-claim, and optional inspector tooling.',
  key: manifestKey || undefined,
  permissions: ['storage', 'sidePanel', 'activeTab', 'scripting', 'tabs', 'webRequest', 'windows'],
  hostPermissions: ['https://business.proof.com/*', 'https://api.proof.com/*'],
  sidePanel: {
    defaultPath: 'sidepanel/index.html',
  },
  contentScripts: [
    {
      matches: ['https://business.proof.com/*'],
      js: ['content.iife.js'],
      runAt: 'document_idle',
      world: 'ISOLATED',
      allFrames: false,
    },
  ],
  webAccessibleResources: ['chunks/*.js', 'assets/*', 'tokens.css'],
};

try {
  const manifest = buildManifest(appConfig);
  const distDir = join(__dirname, '../dist');
  if (!existsSync(distDir)) {
    mkdirSync(distDir, { recursive: true });
  }

  const manifestPath = join(distDir, 'manifest.json');
  writeFileSync(manifestPath, JSON.stringify(manifest, null, 2) + '\n');
  console.log('Manifest built successfully:', manifestPath);
} catch (error) {
  console.error('Failed to build manifest:', error);
  if (error instanceof Error) {
    console.error('Error message:', error.message);
    console.error('Stack:', error.stack);
  }
  process.exit(1);
}



==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/apps/chrome-extensions/proof-extension/scripts/copy-assets.js ====
#!/usr/bin/env node

import { existsSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'fs';
import { readdirSync, statSync, copyFileSync } from 'fs';
import { join, dirname } from 'path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'url';

const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
const __dirname = dirname(__filename);
const projectRoot = join(__dirname, '..');
const distPath = join(projectRoot, 'dist');

if (!existsSync(distPath)) {
  mkdirSync(distPath, { recursive: true });
}

const popupDir = join(distPath, 'popup');
const sidepanelDir = join(distPath, 'sidepanel');
const inspectorWindowDir = join(distPath, 'inspector-window');

for (const dir of [popupDir, sidepanelDir, inspectorWindowDir]) {
  if (!existsSync(dir)) {
    mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  }
}

const htmlTargets = [
  ['popup/index.html', join(popupDir, 'index.html')],
  ['sidepanel/index.html', join(sidepanelDir, 'index.html')],
  ['inspector-window/index.html', join(inspectorWindowDir, 'index.html')],
];

for (const [sourceRelative, destPath] of htmlTargets) {
  const sourcePath = join(projectRoot, 'src', sourceRelative);
  if (!existsSync(sourcePath)) {
    continue;
  }
  const content = readFileSync(sourcePath, 'utf-8');
  writeFileSync(destPath, content, 'utf-8');
}

const tokensCss = join(distPath, 'tokens.css');
let tokensCopied = false;
const nodeModulesTokens = join(
  projectRoot,
  'node_modules',
  '@chrome-ext',
  'ui-design-tokens',
  'dist',
  'tokens.css'
);

if (existsSync(nodeModulesTokens)) {
  try {
    const content = readFileSync(nodeModulesTokens, 'utf-8');
    writeFileSync(tokensCss, content, 'utf-8');
    tokensCopied = true;
  } catch {
    tokensCopied = false;
  }
}

if (!tokensCopied) {
  const libsTokens = join(
    projectRoot,
    '..',
    '..',
    '..',
    'libs',
    'Google-Chrome-Extension-Library',
    'ui',
    'design-tokens',
    'src',
    'tokens.css'
  );
  if (existsSync(libsTokens)) {
    const content = readFileSync(libsTokens, 'utf-8');
    writeFileSync(tokensCss, content, 'utf-8');
  }
}

const assetsSource = join(projectRoot, 'src', 'assets');
const assetsDest = join(distPath, 'assets');
if (existsSync(assetsSource)) {
  if (!existsSync(assetsDest)) {
    mkdirSync(assetsDest, { recursive: true });
  }
  for (const file of readdirSync(assetsSource)) {
    const sourcePath = join(assetsSource, file);
    const destPath = join(assetsDest, file);
    if (statSync(sourcePath).isFile()) {
      copyFileSync(sourcePath, destPath);
    }
  }
}



==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/apps/chrome-extensions/proof-extension/scripts/extract-summary.mjs ====
#!/usr/bin/env node

/**
 * Simple, self-contained extractor for Chrome extension projects.
 *
 * Usage (from repo root):
 *   node apps/chrome-extensions/remote-Notary-Extension/scripts/extract-summary.mjs \
 *     apps/chrome-extensions/remote-Notary-Extension \
 *     remote-notary-extension-extract.txt
 *
 * Defaults:
 *   - appDir: parent of this script
 *   - output: <appDir>/remote-notary-extension-extract.txt
 */

import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';

const scriptDir = path.dirname(
  // Decode URL-encoded characters like spaces in workspace paths
  decodeURIComponent(new URL(import.meta.url).pathname)
);

const appDir = path.resolve(
  process.cwd(),
  process.argv[2] || path.resolve(scriptDir, '..')
);

const outputPath = path.resolve(
  process.cwd(),
  process.argv[3] || path.join(appDir, 'remote-notary-extension-extract.txt')
);

// Treat this as the workspace root (Nx monorepo) and include shared libs.
const workspaceRoot = path.resolve(appDir, '../../..');
const libsDir = path.join(workspaceRoot, 'libs');

const EXCLUDE_DIRS = new Set(['dist', 'node_modules', '.git', '.turbo', 'coverage']);
const TEXT_EXTENSIONS = new Set([
  '.ts',
  '.tsx',
  '.js',
  '.jsx',
  '.json',
  '.mjs',
  '.cjs',
  '.md',
  '.html',
  '.css',
  '.txt',
]);

function isTextFile(filePath) {
  const ext = path.extname(filePath).toLowerCase();
  return TEXT_EXTENSIONS.has(ext);
}

function shouldSkipDir(dirName) {
  return EXCLUDE_DIRS.has(dirName);
}

function readFileSafe(filePath) {
  try {
    return fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf8');
  } catch {
    return '';
  }
}

function listFiles(rootDir) {
  /** @type {string[]} */
  const files = [];
  /** @type {string[]} */
  const stack = [rootDir];

  while (stack.length > 0) {
    const current = stack.pop();
    if (!current) continue;
    const entries = fs.readdirSync(current, { withFileTypes: true });
    for (const entry of entries) {
      const full = path.join(current, entry.name);
      if (entry.isDirectory()) {
        if (!shouldSkipDir(entry.name)) {
          stack.push(full);
        }
      } else if (entry.isFile()) {
        if (isTextFile(full)) {
          files.push(full);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  files.sort();
  return files;
}

function minifyText(content, filePath) {
  const ext = path.extname(filePath).toLowerCase();

  // For JSON we can safely stringify back to a single line.
  if (ext === '.json') {
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(content);
      return JSON.stringify(parsed);
    } catch {
      // Fall through if invalid JSON
    }
  }

  // Lightweight whitespace reduction for code / markup:
  // - normalize newlines
  // - trim each line
  // - collapse multiple blank lines
  const lines = content.split(/\r?\n/);
  const trimmed = [];
  let blankStreak = 0;
  for (const line of lines) {
    const t = line.trimEnd();
    if (t.trim() === '') {
      blankStreak += 1;
      if (blankStreak > 1) continue;
      trimmed.push('');
    } else {
      blankStreak = 0;
      trimmed.push(t);
    }
  }
  return trimmed.join('\n').trim();
}

function redactSensitive(content) {
  let result = content;

  // Common secret-ish keys in code: replace values with placeholder.
  const keyPatterns = [
    /(API[_-]?KEY)\s*[:=]\s*['"`][^'"`]+['"`]/gi,
    /(TOKEN)\s*[:=]\s*['"`][^'"`]+['"`]/gi,
    /(SECRET)\s*[:=]\s*['"`][^'"`]+['"`]/gi,
    /(PASSWORD|PASS)\s*[:=]\s*['"`][^'"`]+['"`]/gi,
  ];

  for (const re of keyPatterns) {
    result = result.replace(re, (m, key) => `${key}:"REDACTED_SECRET"`);
  }

  // Heuristic: redact obvious bearer tokens
  result = result.replace(
    /(Bearer\s+)[A-Za-z0-9\-._~+/]+=*/g,
    '$1REDACTED_BEARER_TOKEN'
  );

  return result;
}

function relativeToRoot(rootDir, p) {
  return path.relative(rootDir, p) || '.';
}

function buildHierarchySection(allFilesByRoot) {
  const lines = [];
  lines.push('== SECTION A: DIRECTORY & FILE LIST ==');
  lines.push('');
  for (const { label, rootDir, files } of allFilesByRoot) {
    const dirs = new Set();
    for (const file of files) {
      const rel = relativeToRoot(rootDir, file);
      const dir = path.dirname(rel);
      dirs.add(dir);
    }
    lines.push(`- ROOT: ${label}`);
    const sortedDirs = Array.from(dirs).sort();
    for (const dir of sortedDirs) {
      lines.push(`  - ${dir}/`);
      const children = files
        .filter(f => path.dirname(relativeToRoot(rootDir, f)) === dir)
        .map(f => path.basename(f))
        .sort();
      for (const child of children) {
        lines.push(`    - ${child}`);
      }
    }
    lines.push('');
  }
  lines.push('');
  return lines.join('\n');
}

function main() {
  if (!fs.existsSync(appDir) || !fs.statSync(appDir).isDirectory()) {
    console.error(`App directory does not exist or is not a directory: ${appDir}`);
    process.exit(1);
  }

  /** @type {{label:string, rootDir:string, files:string[]}[]} */
  const roots = [];

  const appFiles = listFiles(appDir);
  roots.push({ label: 'app', rootDir: appDir, files: appFiles });

  if (fs.existsSync(libsDir) && fs.statSync(libsDir).isDirectory()) {
    const libFiles = listFiles(libsDir);
    roots.push({ label: 'libs', rootDir: libsDir, files: libFiles });
  }

  /** @type {string[]} */
  const out = [];

  // Simple header
  out.push(`PROJECT_ROOT: ${path.relative(workspaceRoot, appDir) || '.'}`);
  out.push('');

  // Lightweight architecture overview snippet (best-effort, static text)
  const hasServiceWorker = fs.existsSync(path.join(appDir, 'src', 'service_worker', 'index.ts'));
  const hasContent = fs.existsSync(path.join(appDir, 'src', 'content.ts'));
  const hasSidepanel = fs.existsSync(path.join(appDir, 'src', 'sidepanel', 'NotaryApp.tsx'));
  const hasPopup = fs.existsSync(path.join(appDir, 'src', 'popup.tsx'));

  out.push('== SECTION ARCHITECTURE OVERVIEW (AUTO-GENERATED) ==');
  out.push('');
  out.push('- App type: Chrome MV3 extension with web automation.');
  if (hasServiceWorker) out.push('- Service worker entry: src/service_worker/index.ts (background orchestration, messaging, recipes, state).');
  if (hasContent) out.push('- Content script entry: src/content.ts (DOM integration, overlays, watchers, recipe bridge).');
  if (hasSidepanel) out.push('- Side panel UI: src/sidepanel/NotaryApp.tsx (React app for controls, status, and logs).');
  if (hasPopup) out.push('- Popup UI: src/popup.tsx (quick launch actions).');
  if (fs.existsSync(libsDir)) out.push('- Shared libraries: libs/** (e.g., @chrome-ext/* telemetry, storage, recipes, UI).');
  out.push('');
  out.push(buildHierarchySection(roots));
  out.push('');
  out.push('== SECTION B: FILE CONTENTS (MINIFIED & REDACTED) ==');
  out.push('');

  for (const { label, rootDir, files } of roots) {
    for (const filePath of files) {
      const rel = relativeToRoot(rootDir, filePath);
      const raw = readFileSafe(filePath);
      if (!raw) continue;
      const minified = minifyText(raw, filePath);
      const redacted = redactSensitive(minified);

      out.push(`--- FILE [${label}]: ${rel} ---`);
      out.push(redacted);
      out.push('');
    }
  }

  fs.writeFileSync(outputPath, out.join('\n'), 'utf8');
  // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
  console.log(`Extraction written to: ${outputPath}`);
}

main();

==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/apps/chrome-extensions/proof-extension/scripts/package-extension.js ====
#!/usr/bin/env node

import { execSync } from 'child_process';
import { join, dirname } from 'path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'url';

const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
const __dirname = dirname(__filename);
const projectRoot = join(__dirname, '..');
const distPath = join(projectRoot, 'dist');
const zipPath = join(projectRoot, 'proof-extension.zip');

try {

#!/usr/bin/env node

import { mkdirSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'fs';
import path from 'path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'url';

const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
const __dirname = path.dirname(__filename);
const projectRoot = path.join(__dirname, '..');
const outputDir = path.join(projectRoot, 'data', 'proof-fixtures');

const HAR_SOURCES = {
  queue: '/Users/evanmccall/Projects/Notarization-OpenCall-Automation/data/proof/hars/business.proof.com-Open-ondemand-que.har',
  acceptedClient:
    '/Users/evanmccall/Projects/Notarization-OpenCall-Automation/data/proof/hars/business.proof.com-Open-ondemand-accepted-client.har',
  acceptedWitness:
    '/Users/evanmccall/Projects/Notarization-OpenCall-Automation/data/proof/hars/business.proof.com-Open-ondemand-accepted-witness.har',
};

function safeParseJson(value) {
  try {
    return JSON.parse(value);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function sanitizeHarFixture(sourcePath, scenario) {
  const har = JSON.parse(readFileSync(sourcePath, 'utf8'));
  const entries = Array.isArray(har?.log?.entries) ? har.log.entries : [];
  const graphqlEntries = entries.filter(entry =>
    String(entry?.request?.url || '').includes('api.proof.com/graphql')
  );
  const operationNames = Array.from(
    new Set(
      graphqlEntries
        .map(entry => safeParseJson(entry?.request?.postData?.text || ''))
        .map(body => body?.operationName)
        .filter(Boolean)
    )
  );

  return {
    sourceHar: path.basename(sourcePath),
    scenario,
    generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    platform: 'proof',
    requestCount: entries.length,
    graphqlRequestCount: graphqlEntries.length,
    operationNames,
    apiHosts: Array.from(
      new Set(
        graphqlEntries.map(entry => {
          try {
            return new URL(entry.request.url).host;
          } catch {
            return '';
          }
        })
      )
    ).filter(Boolean),
    networkSnapshot: {
      source: 'fixture',
      operationNames,
      hints: graphqlEntries.slice(0, 20).map(entry => entry.request.url),
    },
  };
}

function writeJsonFixture(name, payload) {
  const filepath = path.join(outputDir, name);
  writeFileSync(filepath, JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2) + '\n', 'utf8');
  console.log(`Wrote ${path.relative(projectRoot, filepath)}`);
}

mkdirSync(outputDir, { recursive: true });

writeJsonFixture('queue-state.json', sanitizeHarFixture(HAR_SOURCES.queue, 'queue'));
writeJsonFixture(
  'accepted-client-state.json',
  sanitizeHarFixture(HAR_SOURCES.acceptedClient, 'accepted-client')
);

let acceptedWitnessStatus = 'missing';
try {
  sanitizeHarFixture(HAR_SOURCES.acceptedWitness, 'accepted-witness');
  acceptedWitnessStatus = 'available';
} catch {
  acceptedWitnessStatus = 'malformed';
}

writeJsonFixture('README.json', {
  generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  fixtures: ['queue-state.json', 'accepted-client-state.json'],
  acceptedWitnessStatus,
  note:
    acceptedWitnessStatus === 'available'
      ? 'Accepted witness HAR parsed successfully but is not yet promoted as a canonical fixture.'
      : 'Accepted witness HAR is malformed or unavailable and is intentionally excluded from canonical fixtures.',
});

==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/apps/chrome-extensions/proof-extension/scripts/validate-selectors.ts ====
import fs from 'fs';
import { JSDOM } from 'jsdom';

import { notaryConfig } from '../src/config.js';

const FIXTURES = [
  '/Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/apps/chrome-extensions/proof-extension/data/blue-notary-html-elements/dashboard/Dashboard Open Call.html',
  '/Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/apps/chrome-extensions/proof-extension/data/blue-notary-html-elements/dashboard/Dashboard-main.html',
  '/Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/apps/chrome-extensions/proof-extension/data/blue-notary-html-elements/dashboard/Join-As-Witeness-Blue-Notary.html',
  '/Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/apps/chrome-extensions/proof-extension/data/blue-notary-html-elements/dashboard/open-calls-container.html',
  '/Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/apps/chrome-extensions/proof-extension/data/blue-notary-html-elements/dashboard/scheduled-meetings.html',
];

const { selectors, joinKeywords } = notaryConfig;

function findOpenCallsSection(document: Document): Element | null {
  const headings = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('h2'));
  for (const heading of headings) {
    const text = heading.textContent?.trim().toLowerCase() ?? '';
    if (text.includes('open calls')) {
      return heading.closest('section');
    }
  }
  return null;
}

function getKeywordMatches(container: Element | null): string[] {
  if (!container) return [];
  const nodes = Array.from(
    container.querySelectorAll('button, [role="button"], a, [tabindex], div, span')
  );
  const matches: string[] = [];
  for (const node of nodes) {
    const raw = node.textContent ?? '';
    const text = raw.trim();
    if (!text) continue;
    const lower = text.toLowerCase();
    if (joinKeywords.some(keyword => lower.includes(keyword))) {
      matches.push(text);
    }
  }
  return matches;
}

function evaluateFixture(path: string) {
  const html = fs.readFileSync(path, 'utf8');
  const dom = new JSDOM(html);
  const document = dom.window.document;
  const openCallsSection = findOpenCallsSection(document);
  const scopedRoot = openCallsSection ?? document;
  const openCallsSectionCount = document.querySelectorAll(
    selectors.openCallsSection
  ).length;
  const buttonsCount = scopedRoot.querySelectorAll(
    selectors.openCallsButtons
  ).length;
  const noDataCount = scopedRoot.querySelectorAll(
    selectors.openCallsNoData
  ).length;
  const keywordMatches = getKeywordMatches(openCallsSection);

  return {
    fixture: path,
    openCallsSectionFound: Boolean(openCallsSection),
    openCallsSectionCount,
    buttonsCount,
    noDataCount,
    keywordMatchCount: keywordMatches.length,
    keywordMatches: keywordMatches.slice(0, 10),
  };
}

function main() {
  const results = FIXTURES.map(evaluateFixture);
  const payload = {
    selectors,
    joinKeywords,
    results,
  };
  process.stdout.write(`${JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2)}\n`);
}

main();




==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/apps/chrome-extensions/proof-extension/scripts/watch-manifest.js ====
#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * Watch Manifest Script
 */

import { watch, existsSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'fs';
import { exec } from 'child_process';
import { promisify } from 'util';
import { join, dirname } from 'path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'url';

const execAsync = promisify(exec);
const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
const __dirname = dirname(__filename);
const projectRoot = join(__dirname, '..');
const distPath = join(projectRoot, 'dist');

let rebuildTimeout = null;

async function ensureDirs() {
  if (!existsSync(distPath)) {
    mkdirSync(distPath, { recursive: true });
  }
  const popupDir = join(distPath, 'popup');
  const sidepanelDir = join(distPath, 'sidepanel');
  const serviceWorkerDir = join(distPath, 'service_worker');

  if (!existsSync(popupDir)) mkdirSync(popupDir, { recursive: true });
  if (!existsSync(sidepanelDir)) mkdirSync(sidepanelDir, { recursive: true });
  if (!existsSync(serviceWorkerDir))
    mkdirSync(serviceWorkerDir, { recursive: true });

  return { popupDir, sidepanelDir };
}

async function rebuildManifest() {
  try {
    const { popupDir, sidepanelDir } = await ensureDirs();

    await execAsync('node scripts/build-manifest.js', { cwd: projectRoot });

    const popupHtml = join(projectRoot, 'src', 'popup', 'index.html');
    const sidepanelHtml = join(projectRoot, 'src', 'sidepanel', 'index.html');

    if (existsSync(popupHtml)) {
      const popupContent = readFileSync(popupHtml, 'utf-8');
      writeFileSync(join(popupDir, 'index.html'), popupContent, 'utf-8');
    }

    if (existsSync(sidepanelHtml)) {
      const sidepanelContent = readFileSync(sidepanelHtml, 'utf-8');
      writeFileSync(join(sidepanelDir, 'index.html'), sidepanelContent, 'utf-8');
    }

    await execAsync('node scripts/copy-assets.js', { cwd: projectRoot });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to rebuild manifest:', error);
  }
}

function debounceRebuild() {
  if (rebuildTimeout) {
    clearTimeout(rebuildTimeout);
  }
  rebuildTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
    rebuildManifest();
  }, 300);
}

console.log('Watching manifest and HTML assets...');
rebuildManifest();

watch(join(projectRoot, 'src'), { recursive: true }, (_event, filename) => {
  if (!filename) return;
  if (filename.endsWith('index.html')) {
    debounceRebuild();
  }
});

watch(join(projectRoot, 'scripts'), { recursive: true }, debounceRebuild);

// AudioContext autoplay policy: Chrome blocks audio until a user gesture.
// Track whether the user has interacted with the page so we can safely play sounds.
let audioCtxUnlocked = false;
const unlockAudio = () => {
  audioCtxUnlocked = true;
  document.removeEventListener('click', unlockAudio, true);
  document.removeEventListener('keydown', unlockAudio, true);
  document.removeEventListener('pointerdown', unlockAudio, true);
};
document.addEventListener('click', unlockAudio, true);
document.addEventListener('keydown', unlockAudio, true);
document.addEventListener('pointerdown', unlockAudio, true);

function getErrorMessage(error: unknown): string {
  return error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
}

function sendReady(): void {
  try {
    chrome.runtime.sendMessage({
      type: MESSAGE_TYPES.CONTENT_READY,
      url: window.location.href,
    });
  } catch {
    /* extension may be reloading */
  }
}

function truncatePreview(value: string | undefined, maxLength: number = 1000): string | undefined {
  if (!value) {
    return undefined;
  }
  return value.length <= maxLength ? value : value.slice(0, maxLength);
}

function installClaimInvocationMonitor(payload: Record<string, unknown>): () => void {
  if (!payload.claimInvocationDiagnosticsEnabled) {
    return () => undefined;
  }

  const originalFetch =
    typeof window.fetch === 'function' ? window.fetch.bind(window) : undefined;
  const originalXHROpen = XMLHttpRequest.prototype.open;
  const originalXHRSend = XMLHttpRequest.prototype.send;
  const originalXHRSetRequestHeader = XMLHttpRequest.prototype.setRequestHeader;

  function shouldTrack(url: string, bodyPreview?: string): boolean {
    const text = `${url} ${bodyPreview ?? ''}`.toLowerCase();
    return (
      text.includes('proof.com') ||
      text.includes('graphql') ||
      text.includes('meeting') ||
      text.includes('session') ||
      text.includes('accept')
    );
  }

  if (originalFetch) {
    window.fetch = async function patchedFetch(
      input: RequestInfo | URL,
      init?: RequestInit
    ): Promise<Response> {
      const request = input instanceof Request ? input : undefined;
      const url = request?.url ?? String(input);
      const method = (init?.method ?? request?.method ?? 'GET').toUpperCase();
      const bodyPreview =
        typeof init?.body === 'string' ? truncatePreview(init.body) : undefined;
      const startedAt = Date.now();
      const response = await originalFetch(input as never, init);

      if (shouldTrack(url, bodyPreview)) {
        chrome.runtime.sendMessage({
          type: MESSAGE_TYPES.CLAIM_INVOCATION_EVENT,
          payload: {
            requestId: `proof-fetch-${startedAt.toString(36)}`,
            url,
            method,
            transport: 'fetch',
            requestBodyPreview: bodyPreview,
            status: response.status,
            latencyMs: Date.now() - startedAt,
          },
        });
      }

      return response;
    };
  }

  XMLHttpRequest.prototype.open = function patchedOpen(
    method: string,
    url: string | URL,
    async?: boolean,
    username?: string | null,
    password?: string | null
  ): void {
    (this as XMLHttpRequest & Record<string, unknown>).__proofInvocation = {
      method: method.toUpperCase(),
      url: String(url),
      startedAt: Date.now(),
      headers: {},
    };
    originalXHROpen.call(this, method, url, async ?? true, username ?? null, password ?? null);
  };

  XMLHttpRequest.prototype.setRequestHeader = function patchedSetRequestHeader(
    name: string,
    value: string
  ): void {
    const invocation = (this as XMLHttpRequest & Record<string, any>).__proofInvocation;
    if (invocation) {
      invocation.headers[name] = value;
    }
    originalXHRSetRequestHeader.call(this, name, value);
  };

  XMLHttpRequest.prototype.send = function patchedSend(
    body?: Document | XMLHttpRequestBodyInit | null
  ): void {
    const xhr = this as XMLHttpRequest & Record<string, any>;
    const invocation = xhr.__proofInvocation ?? {
      method: 'GET',
      url: '',
      startedAt: Date.now(),
    };
    const bodyPreview = typeof body === 'string' ? truncatePreview(body) : undefined;
    const handleLoadEnd = () => {
      if (shouldTrack(invocation.url, bodyPreview)) {
        chrome.runtime.sendMessage({
          type: MESSAGE_TYPES.CLAIM_INVOCATION_EVENT,
          payload: {
            requestId: `proof-xhr-${invocation.startedAt.toString(36)}`,
            url: invocation.url,
            method: invocation.method,
            transport: 'xhr',
            requestBodyPreview: bodyPreview,
            status: xhr.status,
            latencyMs: Date.now() - invocation.startedAt,
          },
        });
      }
      xhr.removeEventListener('loadend', handleLoadEnd);
    };
    xhr.addEventListener('loadend', handleLoadEnd);
    originalXHRSend.call(this, body ?? null);
  };

  return () => {
    if (originalFetch) {
      window.fetch = originalFetch;
    }
    XMLHttpRequest.prototype.open = originalXHROpen;
    XMLHttpRequest.prototype.send = originalXHRSend;
    XMLHttpRequest.prototype.setRequestHeader = originalXHRSetRequestHeader;
  };
}

function startDomWatch(payload: Record<string, unknown>): void {
  domWatchController?.stop();
  claimInvocationCleanup?.();
  claimInvocationCleanup = installClaimInvocationMonitor(payload);
  domWatchController = createDomWatchController(
    document,
    {
      platformId: 'proof',
      containerSelector:
        typeof payload.containerSelector === 'string' ? payload.containerSelector : '',
      buttonSelector:
        typeof payload.buttonSelector === 'string' ? payload.buttonSelector : undefined,
      headingText:
        typeof payload.headingText === 'string' ? payload.headingText : undefined,
      noDataSelector:
        typeof payload.noDataSelector === 'string' ? payload.noDataSelector : undefined,
      keywords: Array.isArray(payload.keywords)
        ? payload.keywords.filter((value): value is string => typeof value === 'string')
        : undefined,
      includeSnapshot: Boolean(payload.includeSnapshot),
      runId: typeof payload.runId === 'string' ? payload.runId : undefined,
      sessionId:
        typeof payload.sessionId === 'string' ? payload.sessionId : undefined,
      claimCooldownMs:
        typeof payload.claimCooldownMs === 'number'
          ? payload.claimCooldownMs
          : undefined,
      claimRetryDelaysMs: Array.isArray(payload.claimRetryDelaysMs)
        ? payload.claimRetryDelaysMs.filter(
            (value): value is number => typeof value === 'number'
          )
        : undefined,
      enableDomDeltaProbe: Boolean(payload.enableDomDeltaProbe),
      networkSnapshot:
        payload.networkSnapshot &&
        typeof payload.networkSnapshot === 'object' &&
        typeof (payload.networkSnapshot as PlatformNetworkSnapshot).source === 'string'
          ? (payload.networkSnapshot as PlatformNetworkSnapshot)
          : undefined,
      autoClaim: payload.autoClaim !== false,
    },
    {
      onEvent: event => {
        chrome.runtime.sendMessage({
          type: MESSAGE_TYPES.DOM_WATCH_EVENT,
          payload: event,
        });
      },
      onClaimAttempt: event => {
        chrome.runtime.sendMessage({
          type: MESSAGE_TYPES.WATCH_CLAIM_ATTEMPT,
          payload: event,
        });
      },
      onClaimTrace: event => {
        chrome.runtime.sendMessage({
          type: MESSAGE_TYPES.CLAIM_TRACE_EVENT,
          payload: event,
        });
      },
      onHeartbeat: event => {
        chrome.runtime.sendMessage({
          type: MESSAGE_TYPES.WATCH_SESSION_HEARTBEAT,
          payload: event,
        });
      },
      onInteraction: event => {
        chrome.runtime.sendMessage({
          type: MESSAGE_TYPES.INSPECTOR_INTERACTION_EVENT,
          payload: event,
        });
      },
      onDomDelta: entries => {
        chrome.runtime.sendMessage({
          type: MESSAGE_TYPES.WATCH_DOM_DELTA,
          payload: entries,
        });
      },
    }
  );
}

function startDomInspector(payload: Record<string, unknown>): void {
  domInspectorController?.stop();
  domInspectorController = createDomInspectorController(
    document,
    {
      selectedRoots: Array.isArray(payload.selectedRoots)
        ? payload.selectedRoots.filter((value): value is string => typeof value === 'string')
        : [],
      includeCharacterData: Boolean(payload.includeCharacterData),
      styleDiffEnabled: Boolean(payload.styleDiffEnabled),
      runId: typeof payload.runId === 'string' ? payload.runId : undefined,
      platform: 'proof',
      tabId: typeof payload.tabId === 'number' ? payload.tabId : undefined,
    },
    {
      onDomEvent: event => {
        chrome.runtime.sendMessage({
          type: MESSAGE_TYPES.INSPECTOR_DOM_EVENT,
          payload: event,
        });
      },
    }
  );
}

chrome.runtime.onMessage.addListener((message: any, _sender: any, sendResponse: any) => {
  const payload =
    message?.payload && typeof message.payload === 'object' ? message.payload : {};

  switch (message?.type) {
    case MESSAGE_TYPES.SHOW_WATCH_OVERLAY: {
      const options = {
        document,
        containerSelector:
          typeof payload.containerSelector === 'string' ? payload.containerSelector : '',
        targetSelector:
          typeof payload.targetSelector === 'string' ? payload.targetSelector : undefined,
        headingText:
          typeof payload.headingText === 'string' ? payload.headingText : undefined,
        label: typeof payload.label === 'string' ? payload.label : undefined,
        statusText:
          typeof payload.statusText === 'string' ? payload.statusText : undefined,
      };

      if (watchOverlayController.isMounted()) {
        watchOverlayController.update(options);
      } else {
        watchOverlayController.mount(options);
      }

      sendResponse({ ok: true });
      return true;
    }

    case MESSAGE_TYPES.HIDE_WATCH_OVERLAY: {
      watchOverlayController.unmount();
      sendResponse({ ok: true });
      return true;
    }

    case MESSAGE_TYPES.HIGHLIGHT_WATCH: {
      highlightCleanup?.();
      highlightCleanup = highlightTargets(
        typeof payload.containerSelector === 'string' ? payload.containerSelector : '',
        typeof payload.targetSelector === 'string' ? payload.targetSelector : undefined,
        document
      );

      const durationMs =
        typeof payload.durationMs === 'number' ? payload.durationMs : 1800;
      globalThis.setTimeout(() => {
        highlightCleanup?.();
        highlightCleanup = null;
      }, durationMs);

      sendResponse({ ok: true });
      return true;
    }

    case MESSAGE_TYPES.START_DOM_WATCH:
      startDomWatch(payload);
      sendResponse({ ok: true });
      return true;

    case MESSAGE_TYPES.STOP_DOM_WATCH:
      domWatchController?.stop();
      domWatchController = null;
      claimInvocationCleanup?.();
      claimInvocationCleanup = null;
      sendResponse({ ok: true });
      return true;

    case MESSAGE_TYPES.START_DOM_INSPECTOR:
      startDomInspector(payload);
      sendResponse({ ok: true });
      return true;

    case MESSAGE_TYPES.STOP_DOM_INSPECTOR:
      domInspectorController?.stop();
      domInspectorController = null;
      sendResponse({ ok: true });
      return true;

    case MESSAGE_TYPES.TEST_SOUND:
      if (!audioCtxUnlocked) {
        // No user gesture yet — silently skip to avoid AudioContext autoplay rejection
        sendResponse({ ok: true, skipped: true });
        return true;
      }
      playNotificationChime(
        {
          repeat:
            typeof payload.repeat === 'number' ? payload.repeat : 1,
        },
        document
      )
        .then(() => sendResponse({ ok: true }))
        .catch(error =>
          sendResponse({ ok: false, error: getErrorMessage(error) })
        );
      return true;

    case MESSAGE_TYPES.TEST_NOTIFICATION:
      showVisualNotification(
        {
          message:
            typeof payload.message === 'string'
              ? payload.message
              : 'Proof notification test',
        },
        document
      )
        .then(() => sendResponse({ ok: true }))
        .catch(error =>
          sendResponse({ ok: false, error: getErrorMessage(error) })
        );
      return true;

    default:
      return false;
  }
});

if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
  window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', sendReady, { once: true });
} else {
  sendReady();
}
