const MAX_SNAPSHOT_LENGTH = 20000;
const DEFAULT_CLAIM_COOLDOWN_MS = 400;
const DEFAULT_CLAIM_RETRY_DELAYS_MS = [50, 150, 300];
const MIN_EVALUATION_INTERVAL_MS = 100;
const WATCH_ATTRIBUTE_FILTER = [
  'class',
  'style',
  'hidden',
  'disabled',
  'aria-disabled',
  'aria-hidden',
];

function getSnapshotHtml(container: Element): string {
  const html = container.outerHTML;
  if (html.length <= MAX_SNAPSHOT_LENGTH) {
    return html;
  }
  return html.slice(0, MAX_SNAPSHOT_LENGTH);
}

function normalizeCallbacks(
  callbacksOrOnEvent:
    | DomWatchCallbacks
    | ((event: DomWatchEvent) => void)
): DomWatchCallbacks {
  if (typeof callbacksOrOnEvent === 'function') {
    return { onEvent: callbacksOrOnEvent };
  }
  return callbacksOrOnEvent;
}

function emitClaimAttempt(
  callbacks: DomWatchCallbacks,
  config: DomWatchConfig,
  attempt: ClaimAttemptTelemetry
): void {
  callbacks.onClaimAttempt?.({
    attemptedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    runId: config.runId,
    sessionId: config.sessionId,
    platform: config.platformId,
    strategy: attempt.strategy,
    success: attempt.success,
    reasonCode: attempt.reasonCode,
    buttonText: attempt.buttonText,
    candidateSelector: attempt.candidateSelector,
  });
}

function normalizeText(value: string | null | undefined): string {
  return (value ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
}

function createId(prefix: string): string {
  return `${prefix}-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random()
    .toString(36)
    .slice(2, 8)}`;
}

function buildCandidateFingerprint(
  candidate: WatchCandidateDescriptor,
  container: Element
): string {
  const rowText = normalizeText(
    candidate.element.closest('article,li,tr,section,div')?.textContent ??
      container.textContent
  )
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .slice(0, 240);
  return [
    candidate.selector,
    normalizeText(candidate.text),
    rowText,
  ].join(' | ');
}

function getClaimReadiness(
  candidate: WatchCandidateDescriptor | null,
  containerVisible: boolean,
  candidateCount: number
): ClaimReadinessSnapshot {
  const element = candidate?.element;
  const style = element ? window.getComputedStyle(element) : null;
  return {
    isConnected: Boolean(element?.isConnected),
    disabled: Boolean(element instanceof HTMLButtonElement && element.disabled),
    ariaDisabled: element?.getAttribute('aria-disabled') === 'true',
    display: style?.display ?? 'none',
    visibility: style?.visibility ?? 'hidden',
    containerVisible,
    candidateCount,
  };
}

function emitClaimTrace(
  callbacks: DomWatchCallbacks,
  config: DomWatchConfig,
  trace: Omit<ClaimAttemptTrace, 'traceId' | 'platform' | 'runId' | 'recordedAt' | 'mode'>
): void {
  callbacks.onClaimTrace?.({
    traceId: createId('claim-trace'),
    platform: config.platformId ?? 'proof',
    runId: config.runId,
    recordedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    mode: 'button',
    ...trace,
  });
}

function getAncestryFingerprint(element: HTMLElement): string[] {
  const result: string[] = [];
  let current: HTMLElement | null = element;
  while (current && result.length < 5) {
    let label = current.tagName.toLowerCase();
    if (current.id) {
      label += `#${current.id}`;
    } else if (current.classList.length > 0) {
      label += `.${Array.from(current.classList).slice(0, 2).join('.')}`;
    }
    result.unshift(label);
    current = current.parentElement;
  }
  return result;
}

function buildInteractionEvent(
  config: DomWatchConfig,
  candidate: WatchCandidateDescriptor,
  strategy: WatchClaimStrategy
): ObservedInteractionEvent {
  const rect = candidate.element.getBoundingClientRect();
  return buildObservedInteractionEvent({
    platform: config.platformId,
    runId: config.runId,
    selectorFingerprint: candidate.selector,
    tag: candidate.element.tagName.toLowerCase(),
    text: candidate.text,
    rect: {
      x: rect.x,
      y: rect.y,
      width: rect.width,
      height: rect.height,
    },
    pointerSequenceSummary:
      strategy === 'coordinate-click'
        ? ['mousemove', 'mousedown', 'mouseup']
        : ['click'],
    ancestryFingerprint: getAncestryFingerprint(candidate.element),
  });
}

export function resolveWatchContainer(
  documentRef: Document,
  containerSelector: string,
  headingText?: string,
  platformId: PlatformId = 'proof'
): Element | null {
  const provider = getPlatformProvider();
  return provider
    .createAdapter(documentRef, {
      platformId,
      containerSelector,
      buttonSelector: 'button,[role="button"]',
      headingText,
      label: 'WATCHING',
    })
    .resolveContainer();
}

export function createDomWatchController(
  documentRef: Document,
  config: DomWatchConfig,
  callbacksOrOnEvent: DomWatchCallbacks | ((event: DomWatchEvent) => void)
): DomWatchController {
  const callbacks = normalizeCallbacks(callbacksOrOnEvent);
  const platformId = config.platformId ?? 'proof';
  const provider = getPlatformProvider();
  const adapter = provider.createAdapter(documentRef, {
    platformId,
    containerSelector: config.containerSelector,
    buttonSelector: config.buttonSelector,
    headingText: config.headingText,
    noDataSelector: config.noDataSelector,
    keywords: config.keywords,
    label: 'WATCHING',
    networkSnapshot: config.networkSnapshot,
    autoClaim: config.autoClaim,
  });
  const claimCooldownMs = Math.max(
    0,
    config.claimCooldownMs ?? DEFAULT_CLAIM_COOLDOWN_MS
  );
  const claimRetryDelaysMs = (config.claimRetryDelaysMs?.length
    ? config.claimRetryDelaysMs
    : DEFAULT_CLAIM_RETRY_DELAYS_MS
  )
    .map(delay => Math.max(0, delay))
    .sort((left, right) => left - right);

  let observer: MutationObserver | null = null;
  let rootObserver: MutationObserver | null = null;
  let intersectionObserver: IntersectionObserver | null = null;
  let resizeObserver: ResizeObserver | null = null;
  let observedContainer: Element | null = null;
  let pendingCheck = false;
  let stopped = false;
  let lastClaimAt = 0;
  let lastContainerState: DomWatchEvent['containerState'] = 'lost';
  let lastAttemptedFingerprint: string | null = null;
  let pendingRetryFingerprint: string | null = null;
  let pendingRetryCandidate: {
    text: string;
    selector: string;
    element: Element;
    readiness: ClaimReadinessSnapshot;
  } | null = null;
  let claimRetryTimer: number | null = null;
  let pendingReason:
    | 'watch_started'
    | 'reconnect'
    | 'container_resolved'
    | 'change_detected'
    | null = null;
  let lastEvaluationAt = 0;
  let evaluationTimer: number | null = null;
  let evaluationFrame: number | null = null;
  let containerVisible = true;

  const emitEvent = (
    reasonCode: DomWatchEvent['reasonCode'],
    options: {
      containerState: DomWatchEvent['containerState'];
      clicked?: boolean;
      buttonText?: string;
      buttonCount?: number;
      snapshotContainer?: Element;
      candidateSelector?: string;
      activeSessionDetected?: boolean;
      inQueueDetected?: boolean;
      pauseReason?: PauseReason | null;
    }
  ) => {
    const snapshotContainer = options.snapshotContainer;
    callbacks.onEvent({
      detectedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      clicked: Boolean(options.clicked),
      buttonText: options.buttonText,
      buttonCount: options.buttonCount ?? 0,
      snapshotHtml:
        config.includeSnapshot && snapshotContainer
          ? getSnapshotHtml(snapshotContainer)
          : undefined,
      runId: config.runId,
      sessionId: config.sessionId,
      platform: platformId,
      reasonCode,
      containerState: options.containerState,
      candidateSelector: options.candidateSelector,
      activeSessionDetected: options.activeSessionDetected,
      inQueueDetected: options.inQueueDetected,
      pauseReason: options.pauseReason,
    });
  };

  const emitHeartbeat = (reasonCode: WatchHeartbeatEvent['reasonCode']) => {
    callbacks.onHeartbeat?.({
      heartbeatAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      runId: config.runId,
      sessionId: config.sessionId,
      platform: platformId,
      reasonCode,
    });
  };

  const emitDomDeltas = (mutations: MutationRecord[]) => {
    if (!config.enableDomDeltaProbe || mutations.length === 0) {
      return;
    }
    const entries: DomDeltaEntry[] = mutations.map(mutation => ({
      recordedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      runId: config.runId,
      sessionId: config.sessionId,
      mutationType: mutation.type,
      addedNodes: mutation.addedNodes.length,
      removedNodes: mutation.removedNodes.length,
      attributeName: mutation.attributeName ?? undefined,
      targetTag:
        mutation.target instanceof HTMLElement
          ? mutation.target.tagName.toLowerCase()
          : undefined,
    }));
    callbacks.onDomDelta?.(entries);
  };

  const clearClaimRetry = () => {
    if (claimRetryTimer !== null) {
      globalThis.clearTimeout(claimRetryTimer);
      claimRetryTimer = null;
    }
    pendingRetryFingerprint = null;
    pendingRetryCandidate = null;
  };

  const flushObserverRecords = (target: MutationObserver | null) => {
    if (!target) {
      return;
    }
    emitDomDeltas(target.takeRecords());
  };

  const disconnectObserver = () => {
    flushObserverRecords(observer);
    observer?.disconnect();
    rootObserver?.takeRecords();
    intersectionObserver?.disconnect();
    resizeObserver?.disconnect();
    observer = null;
    intersectionObserver = null;
    resizeObserver = null;
    observedContainer = null;
    containerVisible = true;
  };

  const attachObserver = () => {
    const container = adapter.resolveContainer();
    if (!container) {
      disconnectObserver();
      return false;
    }

    if (observer && observedContainer === container) {
      return true;
    }

    disconnectObserver();
    observedContainer = container;
    observer = new MutationObserver(mutations => {
      emitDomDeltas(mutations);

      // Fast path: if a button just transitioned from disabled → enabled,
      // call evaluate() immediately — bypassing the MIN_EVALUATION_INTERVAL_MS
      // debounce. The Proof platform enables the claim button for a very short
      // window (<200ms) so every millisecond counts.
      const hasEnabledTransition = mutations.some(
        m =>
          m.type === 'attributes' &&
          m.attributeName === 'disabled' &&
          m.target instanceof HTMLButtonElement &&
          !m.target.disabled
      );
      if (hasEnabledTransition) {
        evaluate('change_detected');
        return;
      }

      scheduleEvaluate('change_detected');
    });
    observer.observe(container, {
      childList: true,
      subtree: true,
      attributes: true,
      attributeFilter: WATCH_ATTRIBUTE_FILTER,
    });

    if (typeof IntersectionObserver === 'function') {
      intersectionObserver = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
        const nextVisible = Boolean(entries[0]?.isIntersecting);
        if (containerVisible !== nextVisible) {
          containerVisible = nextVisible;
          scheduleEvaluate('change_detected');
        }
      });
      intersectionObserver.observe(container);
    }

    if (typeof ResizeObserver === 'function') {
      resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => {
        scheduleEvaluate('change_detected');
      });
      resizeObserver.observe(container);
    }

    return true;
  };

  const evaluate = (
    reasonCode:
      | 'watch_started'
      | 'reconnect'
      | 'container_resolved'
      | 'change_detected'
  ) => {
    pendingCheck = false;
    if (stopped) {
      return;
    }

    const activeSessionDetected = adapter.detectActiveSession();
    const pauseReason = adapter.detectPausedReason();
    const container = adapter.resolveContainer();
    const inQueueDetected = adapter.detectInQueue();

    if (!container) {
      if (lastContainerState !== 'lost') {
        emitEvent('container_lost', {
          containerState: 'lost',
          activeSessionDetected,
          inQueueDetected,
          pauseReason,
        });
      }
      lastContainerState = 'lost';
      disconnectObserver();
      clearClaimRetry();
      return;
    }

    attachObserver();

    if (lastContainerState === 'lost') {
      emitHeartbeat(reasonCode === 'change_detected' ? 'container_resolved' : reasonCode);
      emitEvent('container_resolved', {
        containerState: 'resolved',
        snapshotContainer: container,
        activeSessionDetected,
        inQueueDetected,
        pauseReason,
      });
    }

    if (adapter.isNoData(container)) {
      clearClaimRetry();
      lastAttemptedFingerprint = null;
      lastContainerState = 'no-data';
      emitEvent('no_data', {
        containerState: 'no-data',
        snapshotContainer: container,
        activeSessionDetected,
        inQueueDetected,
        pauseReason,
      });
      return;
    }

    const candidates = adapter.getCandidates(container);
    const primaryCandidate: WatchCandidateDescriptor | null = candidates[0] ?? null;
    lastContainerState = 'resolved';

    if (!primaryCandidate) {
      if (
        pendingRetryFingerprint !== null &&
        pendingRetryCandidate !== null &&
        !pendingRetryCandidate.element.isConnected
      ) {
        emitClaimTrace(callbacks, config, {
          candidateFingerprint: pendingRetryFingerprint,
          sessionId: config.sessionId,
          decision: 'suppressed_disappeared',
          buttonText: pendingRetryCandidate.text,
          candidateSelector: pendingRetryCandidate.selector,
          readiness: pendingRetryCandidate.readiness,
          requestObserved: false,
        });
      }
      clearClaimRetry();
      lastAttemptedFingerprint = null;
      emitEvent(reasonCode, {
        containerState: 'resolved',
        snapshotContainer: container,
        activeSessionDetected,
        inQueueDetected,
        pauseReason,
      });
      return;
    }

    const fingerprint = buildCandidateFingerprint(primaryCandidate, container);
    const readiness = getClaimReadiness(
      primaryCandidate,
      containerVisible,
      candidates.length
    );

    emitClaimTrace(callbacks, config, {
      candidateFingerprint: fingerprint,
      sessionId: config.sessionId,
      decision: 'candidate_detected',
      buttonText: primaryCandidate.text,
      candidateSelector: primaryCandidate.selector,
      readiness,
      requestObserved: false,
      detail: reasonCode,
    });

    if (config.autoClaim === false || !containerVisible) {
      clearClaimRetry();
      emitEvent('candidate_detected', {
        containerState: 'resolved',
        buttonText: primaryCandidate.text,
        buttonCount: candidates.length,
        snapshotContainer: container,
        candidateSelector: primaryCandidate.selector,
        activeSessionDetected,
        inQueueDetected,
        pauseReason,
      });
      emitClaimTrace(callbacks, config, {
        candidateFingerprint: fingerprint,
        sessionId: config.sessionId,
        decision: 'suppressed_invisible',
        buttonText: primaryCandidate.text,
        candidateSelector: primaryCandidate.selector,
        readiness,
        requestObserved: false,
        detail:
          config.autoClaim === false
            ? 'auto_claim_disabled'
            : 'container_not_visible',
      });
      return;
    }

    const now = Date.now();
    if (now - lastClaimAt < claimCooldownMs) {
      clearClaimRetry();
      emitEvent('cooldown_active', {
        containerState: 'resolved',
        buttonText: primaryCandidate.text,
        buttonCount: candidates.length,
        snapshotContainer: container,
        candidateSelector: primaryCandidate.selector,
        activeSessionDetected,
        inQueueDetected,
        pauseReason,
      });
      emitClaimTrace(callbacks, config, {
        candidateFingerprint: fingerprint,
        sessionId: config.sessionId,
        decision: 'suppressed_cooldown',
        buttonText: primaryCandidate.text,
        candidateSelector: primaryCandidate.selector,
        readiness,
        requestObserved: false,
      });
      return;
    }

    if (lastAttemptedFingerprint === fingerprint) {
      return;
    }

    const attemptClaim = (retryIndex: number) => {
      const refreshedCandidate =
        adapter.findRefreshedCandidate(primaryCandidate.text) ?? primaryCandidate;
      const refreshedFingerprint = refreshedCandidate
        ? buildCandidateFingerprint(refreshedCandidate, container)
        : fingerprint;
      const refreshedReadiness = getClaimReadiness(
        refreshedCandidate,
        containerVisible,
        candidates.length
      );

      if (!refreshedCandidate?.element?.isConnected) {
        if (retryIndex < claimRetryDelaysMs.length) {
          pendingRetryFingerprint = refreshedFingerprint;
          pendingRetryCandidate = refreshedCandidate?.element
            ? {
                text: refreshedCandidate.text,
                selector: refreshedCandidate.selector,
                element: refreshedCandidate.element,
                readiness: refreshedReadiness,
              }
            : null;
          claimRetryTimer = globalThis.setTimeout(() => {
            claimRetryTimer = null;
            attemptClaim(retryIndex + 1);
          }, claimRetryDelaysMs[retryIndex] ?? 0) as unknown as number;
          return;
        }

        emitClaimTrace(callbacks, config, {
          candidateFingerprint: refreshedFingerprint,
          sessionId: config.sessionId,
          decision: 'suppressed_disappeared',
          buttonText: primaryCandidate.text,
          candidateSelector: primaryCandidate.selector,
          readiness: refreshedReadiness,
          requestObserved: false,
        });
        return;
      }

      if (
        refreshedReadiness.disabled ||
        refreshedReadiness.ariaDisabled ||
        refreshedReadiness.display === 'none' ||
        refreshedReadiness.visibility === 'hidden'
      ) {
        if (retryIndex < claimRetryDelaysMs.length) {
          pendingRetryFingerprint = refreshedFingerprint;
          pendingRetryCandidate = {
            text: refreshedCandidate.text,
            selector: refreshedCandidate.selector,
            element: refreshedCandidate.element,
            readiness: refreshedReadiness,
          };
          claimRetryTimer = globalThis.setTimeout(() => {
            claimRetryTimer = null;
            attemptClaim(retryIndex + 1);
          }, claimRetryDelaysMs[retryIndex] ?? 0) as unknown as number;
          return;
        }

        emitClaimTrace(callbacks, config, {
          candidateFingerprint: refreshedFingerprint,
          sessionId: config.sessionId,
          decision:
            refreshedReadiness.display === 'none' ||
            refreshedReadiness.visibility === 'hidden'
              ? 'suppressed_invisible'
              : 'suppressed_disabled',
          buttonText: refreshedCandidate.text,
          candidateSelector: refreshedCandidate.selector,
          readiness: refreshedReadiness,
          requestObserved: false,
        });
        return;
      }

      clearClaimRetry();
      lastClaimAt = Date.now();
      lastAttemptedFingerprint = refreshedFingerprint;
      const claimResult = executeClaimWithFallbacks({
        document: documentRef,
        adapter,
        candidate: refreshedCandidate,
        buttonText: refreshedCandidate.text,
        onAttempt: attempt => emitClaimAttempt(callbacks, config, attempt),
      });

      emitClaimTrace(callbacks, config, {
        candidateFingerprint: refreshedFingerprint,
        sessionId: config.sessionId,
        decision: claimResult.success ? 'click_sent' : 'click_failed',
        buttonText: claimResult.buttonText ?? refreshedCandidate.text,
        candidateSelector:
          claimResult.candidateSelector ?? refreshedCandidate.selector,
        readiness: refreshedReadiness,
        requestObserved: false,
      });

      if (claimResult.success) {
        callbacks.onInteraction?.(
          buildInteractionEvent(
            config,
            adapter.findRefreshedCandidate(claimResult.buttonText) ??
              refreshedCandidate,
            claimResult.strategy
          )
        );
      }

      emitEvent(claimResult.success ? 'claim_success' : 'claim_failed', {
        containerState: 'resolved',
        clicked: claimResult.success,
        buttonText: claimResult.buttonText ?? refreshedCandidate.text,
        buttonCount: candidates.length,
        snapshotContainer: container,
        candidateSelector:
          claimResult.candidateSelector ?? refreshedCandidate.selector,
        activeSessionDetected,
        inQueueDetected,
        pauseReason,
      });
    };

    if (pendingRetryFingerprint && pendingRetryFingerprint === fingerprint) {
      return;
    }

    attemptClaim(0);
  };

  const mergeReason = (
    current:
      | 'watch_started'
      | 'reconnect'
      | 'container_resolved'
      | 'change_detected'
      | null,
    next:
      | 'watch_started'
      | 'reconnect'
      | 'container_resolved'
      | 'change_detected'
  ) => {
    if (!current) {
      return next;
    }
    const priority = {
      watch_started: 0,
      reconnect: 1,
      container_resolved: 2,
      change_detected: 3,
    } as const;
    return priority[next] < priority[current] ? next : current;
  };

  const clearScheduledEvaluation = () => {
    if (evaluationTimer !== null) {
      globalThis.clearTimeout(evaluationTimer);
      evaluationTimer = null;
    }
    if (
      evaluationFrame !== null &&
      typeof globalThis.cancelAnimationFrame === 'function'
    ) {
      globalThis.cancelAnimationFrame(evaluationFrame);
      evaluationFrame = null;
    }
  };

  const runScheduledEvaluate = () => {
    evaluationFrame = null;
    pendingCheck = false;
    if (stopped) {
      return;
    }
    const reason = pendingReason ?? 'change_detected';
    pendingReason = null;
    lastEvaluationAt = Date.now();
    evaluate(reason);
    if (pendingReason && !stopped) {
      scheduleEvaluate(pendingReason);
    }
  };

  const queueEvaluateFrame = () => {
    if (stopped || evaluationFrame !== null) {
      return;
    }
    if (typeof globalThis.requestAnimationFrame === 'function') {
      evaluationFrame = globalThis.requestAnimationFrame(() => runScheduledEvaluate());
      return;
    }
    evaluationTimer = globalThis.setTimeout(() => {
      evaluationTimer = null;
      runScheduledEvaluate();
    }, 0) as unknown as number;
  };

  const scheduleEvaluate = (
    reasonCode:
      | 'watch_started'
      | 'reconnect'
      | 'container_resolved'
      | 'change_detected'
  ) => {
    if (stopped) {
      return;
    }
    pendingReason = mergeReason(pendingReason, reasonCode);
    if (pendingCheck) {
      return;
    }
    pendingCheck = true;
    const delay = Math.max(
      0,
      MIN_EVALUATION_INTERVAL_MS - (Date.now() - lastEvaluationAt)
    );
    if (delay > 0) {
      evaluationTimer = globalThis.setTimeout(() => {
        evaluationTimer = null;
        queueEvaluateFrame();
      }, delay) as unknown as number;
      return;
    }
    queueEvaluateFrame();
  };

  const attachRootObserver = () => {
    flushObserverRecords(rootObserver);
    rootObserver?.disconnect();
    rootObserver = new MutationObserver(() => {
      if (stopped) {
        return;
      }

      const container = adapter.resolveContainer();
      if (!container) {
        if (lastContainerState !== 'lost') {
          scheduleEvaluate('change_detected');
        }
        return;
      }

      if (container !== observedContainer) {
        attachObserver();
        scheduleEvaluate('container_resolved');
      }
    });

    if (documentRef.documentElement) {
      rootObserver.observe(documentRef.documentElement, {
        childList: true,
        subtree: true,
      });
    }
  };

  const start = () => {
    attachRootObserver();
    attachObserver();
    emitHeartbeat('watch_started');
    scheduleEvaluate('watch_started');
  };

  const stop = () => {
    stopped = true;
    clearScheduledEvaluation();
    if (
      pendingRetryFingerprint !== null &&
      pendingRetryCandidate !== null &&
      !pendingRetryCandidate.element.isConnected
    ) {
      emitClaimTrace(callbacks, config, {
        candidateFingerprint: pendingRetryFingerprint,
        sessionId: config.sessionId,
        decision: 'suppressed_disappeared',
        buttonText: pendingRetryCandidate.text,
        candidateSelector: pendingRetryCandidate.selector,
        readiness: pendingRetryCandidate.readiness,
        requestObserved: false,
      });
    }
    clearClaimRetry();
    disconnectObserver();
    flushObserverRecords(rootObserver);
    rootObserver?.disconnect();
    rootObserver = null;
    pendingCheck = false;
    pendingReason = null;
  };

  const reconnect = () => {
    if (stopped) {
      return;
    }
    emitHeartbeat('reconnect');
    attachObserver();
    scheduleEvaluate('reconnect');
  };

  start();

  return {
    stop,
    reconnect,
  };
}

export interface CursorSimulationOptions {
  document: Document;
  selector: string;
  durationMs?: number;
  label?: string;
}

export interface CursorSimulationResult {
  selector: string;
  label: string;
  targetText: string;
  targetTagName: string;
  x: number;
  y: number;
}

const CURSOR_ID = 'proof-extension-virtual-cursor';
const LABEL_ID = 'proof-extension-virtual-cursor-label';

function getErrorMessage(error: unknown): string {
  return error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
}

function removeCursorArtifacts(document: Document): void {
  document.getElementById(CURSOR_ID)?.remove();
  document.getElementById(LABEL_ID)?.remove();
}

function createCursorArtifacts(document: Document, label: string): {
  cursor: HTMLDivElement;
  badge: HTMLDivElement;
} {
  removeCursorArtifacts(document);

  const cursor = document.createElement('div');
  cursor.id = CURSOR_ID;
  cursor.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
  Object.assign(cursor.style, {
    position: 'fixed',
    left: '0px',
    top: '0px',
    width: '18px',
    height: '18px',
    borderRadius: '999px',
    background: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #111827 0%, #2563eb 100%)',
    border: '2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.92)',
    boxShadow: '0 10px 24px rgba(15,23,42,0.35)',
    pointerEvents: 'none',
    transform: 'translate(-50%, -50%)',
    zIndex: '2147483647',
    transition: 'opacity 120ms ease',
  } satisfies Partial<CSSStyleDeclaration>);

  const badge = document.createElement('div');
  badge.id = LABEL_ID;
  badge.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
  badge.textContent = label;
  Object.assign(badge.style, {
    position: 'fixed',
    left: '0px',
    top: '0px',
    padding: '6px 10px',
    borderRadius: '999px',
    background: 'rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.92)',
    color: '#f8fafc',
    fontSize: '12px',
    fontWeight: '600',
    letterSpacing: '0.02em',
    whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
    pointerEvents: 'none',
    boxShadow: '0 8px 18px rgba(15,23,42,0.28)',
    zIndex: '2147483647',
    transform: 'translate(14px, -30px)',
    transition: 'opacity 120ms ease',
  } satisfies Partial<CSSStyleDeclaration>);

  const body = document.body ?? document.documentElement;
  body.appendChild(cursor);
  body.appendChild(badge);
  return { cursor, badge };
}

function setCursorPosition(
  cursor: HTMLElement,
  badge: HTMLElement,
  x: number,
  y: number
): void {
  cursor.style.left = `${x}px`;
  cursor.style.top = `${y}px`;
  badge.style.left = `${x}px`;
  badge.style.top = `${y}px`;
}

function getAnimationFrame(windowRef: Window): (callback: FrameRequestCallback) => number {
  if (typeof windowRef.requestAnimationFrame === 'function') {
    return windowRef.requestAnimationFrame.bind(windowRef);
  }
  return callback =>
    windowRef.setTimeout(() => callback(Date.now()), 16) as unknown as number;
}

async function animateCursor(
  windowRef: Window,
  cursor: HTMLElement,
  badge: HTMLElement,
  startX: number,
  startY: number,
  endX: number,
  endY: number,
  durationMs: number
): Promise<void> {
  setCursorPosition(cursor, badge, startX, startY);

  if (durationMs <= 0) {
    setCursorPosition(cursor, badge, endX, endY);
    return;
  }

  const requestFrame = getAnimationFrame(windowRef);
  await new Promise<void>(resolve => {
    const startedAt = Date.now();
    const tick = () => {
      const elapsed = Date.now() - startedAt;
      const progress = Math.min(1, elapsed / durationMs);
      const eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - progress, 3);
      const nextX = startX + (endX - startX) * eased;
      const nextY = startY + (endY - startY) * eased;
      setCursorPosition(cursor, badge, nextX, nextY);
      if (progress >= 1) {
        resolve();
        return;
      }
      requestFrame(tick);
    };
    requestFrame(tick);
  });
}

function dispatchMouseEvent(
  document: Document,
  target: Element,
  type: 'mousemove' | 'mousedown' | 'mouseup' | 'click',
  x: number,
  y: number
): void {
  const windowRef = document.defaultView ?? window;
  target.dispatchEvent(
    new windowRef.MouseEvent(type, {
      bubbles: true,
      cancelable: true,
      composed: true,
      clientX: x,
      clientY: y,
      button: 0,
      buttons: type === 'mousedown' ? 1 : 0,
    })
  );
}

export async function simulateCursorSequence(
  options: CursorSimulationOptions
): Promise<CursorSimulationResult> {
  const { document, label = 'Cursor Simulation' } = options;
  const selector = options.selector.trim();
  if (!selector) {
    throw new Error('Selector is required for cursor simulation');
  }

  const target = document.querySelector(selector);
  if (!(target instanceof HTMLElement)) {
    throw new Error(`Cursor simulation target not found for selector "${selector}"`);
  }

  const rect = target.getBoundingClientRect();
  const x = rect.left + rect.width / 2;
  const y = rect.top + rect.height / 2;
  const windowRef = document.defaultView ?? window;
  const startX = Math.max(24, Math.min(64, windowRef.innerWidth * 0.1 || 64));
  const startY = Math.max(24, Math.min(64, windowRef.innerHeight * 0.1 || 64));
  const { cursor, badge } = createCursorArtifacts(document, label);

  try {
    if (typeof target.scrollIntoView === 'function') {
      target.scrollIntoView({
        behavior: options.durationMs && options.durationMs > 0 ? 'smooth' : 'auto',
        block: 'center',
        inline: 'center',
      });
    }

    await animateCursor(
      windowRef,
      cursor,
      badge,
      startX,
      startY,
      x,
      y,
      Math.max(0, options.durationMs ?? 350)
    );

    const hitTarget =
      typeof document.elementFromPoint === 'function'
        ? document.elementFromPoint(x, y)
        : null;
    const eventTarget =
      hitTarget instanceof Element ? hitTarget : target;

    dispatchMouseEvent(document, eventTarget, 'mousemove', x, y);
    dispatchMouseEvent(document, eventTarget, 'mousedown', x, y);
    dispatchMouseEvent(document, eventTarget, 'mouseup', x, y);
    dispatchMouseEvent(document, eventTarget, 'click', x, y);

    return {
      selector,
      label,
      targetText: target.textContent?.trim() || '',
      targetTagName: target.tagName.toLowerCase(),
      x,
      y,
    };
  } catch (error) {
    throw new Error(getErrorMessage(error));
  } finally {
    removeCursorArtifacts(document);
  }
}

import { MESSAGE_TYPES } from '../constants.js';

function sanitizeHeaders(
  headers: { name: string; value?: string }[]
): Record<string, string> {
  const out: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const header of headers) {
    const name = header.name.toLowerCase();
    if (name === 'authorization') {
      out[header.name] = '[redacted]';
      continue;
    }
    if (name === 'cookie' || name === 'set-cookie') {
      out[header.name] = '[redacted]';
      continue;
    }
    out[header.name] = header.value ?? '';
  }
  return out;
}

function truncate(value: string, maxLength: number = 4096): string {
  if (value.length <= maxLength) return value;
  return value.slice(0, maxLength);
}

chrome.devtools.network.onRequestFinished.addListener(async (request: any) => {
  try {
    const bodyPreview = await new Promise<string | undefined>(resolve => {
      request.getContent((content: string) => {
        resolve(content ? truncate(content) : undefined);
      });
    });

    await chrome.runtime.sendMessage({
      type: MESSAGE_TYPES.DEVTOOLS_NETWORK_EVENT,
      payload: {
        source: 'devtools',
        tabId: chrome.devtools.inspectedWindow.tabId,
        recordedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        url: request.request.url,
        method: request.request.method,
        status: request.response.status,
        resourceType: request._resourceType || request.response.content.mimeType,
        requestHeaders: sanitizeHeaders(request.request.headers || []),
        responseHeaders: sanitizeHeaders(request.response.headers || []),
        requestBodyPreview:
          typeof request.request.postData?.text === 'string'
            ? truncate(request.request.postData.text)
            : undefined,
        responseBodyPreview: bodyPreview,
        initiator: request._initiator?.type,
        frameId: request._frameId,
        correlationKey: request.request.url,
      },
    });
  } catch {
    /* devtools capture is best-effort */
  }
});

import type {
  ObservedDomEvent,
  ObservedInteractionEvent,
  ObservedRect,
} from './types.js';
import type { PlatformId } from '../platforms/types.js';

export interface DomInspectorConfig {
  selectedRoots: string[];
  includeCharacterData: boolean;
  styleDiffEnabled: boolean;
  runId?: string;
  platform?: PlatformId;
  tabId?: number;
}

export interface DomInspectorCallbacks {
  onDomEvent: (event: ObservedDomEvent) => void;
}

export interface DomInspectorController {
  stop: () => void;
}

const ATTRIBUTE_ALLOWLIST = [
  'class',
  'style',
  'hidden',
  'disabled',
] as const;

const STYLE_ALLOWLIST = [
  'display',
  'visibility',
  'opacity',
  'pointer-events',
  'color',
  'background-color',
  'border-color',
  'transform',
] as const;

function createId(prefix: string): string {
  return `${prefix}-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random()
    .toString(36)
    .slice(2, 8)}`;
}

function shouldCaptureAttribute(name: string | null): boolean {
  if (!name) return false;
  if (ATTRIBUTE_ALLOWLIST.includes(name as (typeof ATTRIBUTE_ALLOWLIST)[number])) {
    return true;
  }
  return name.startsWith('aria-') || name.startsWith('data-');
}

function getElementRect(target: Element | null): ObservedRect | undefined {
  if (!(target instanceof HTMLElement)) return undefined;
  const rect = target.getBoundingClientRect();
  return {
    x: rect.x,
    y: rect.y,
    width: rect.width,
    height: rect.height,
  };
}

function normalizeText(value: string | null | undefined): string | undefined {
  const next = (value ?? '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
  return next ? next.slice(0, 240) : undefined;
}

function buildSelectorFingerprint(element: Node | null): string {
  if (!(element instanceof Element)) return 'unknown';

  const segments: string[] = [];
  let current: Element | null = element;
  while (current && segments.length < 5) {
    let segment = current.tagName.toLowerCase();
    if (current.id) {
      segment += `#${current.id}`;
      segments.unshift(segment);
      break;
    }
    const testId = current.getAttribute('data-testid');
    if (testId) {
      segment += `[data-testid="${testId}"]`;
    } else if (current.classList.length > 0) {
      segment += `.${Array.from(current.classList).slice(0, 2).join('.')}`;
    }
    segments.unshift(segment);
    current = current.parentElement;
  }
  return segments.join(' > ');
}

function getContainerKey(element: Node | null): string | undefined {
  if (!(element instanceof Element)) return undefined;
  const section = element.closest('section, main, article, [data-testid*="queue"], [class*="queue"]');
  return section ? buildSelectorFingerprint(section) : undefined;
}

function snapshotStyles(target: HTMLElement): Record<string, string> {
  const computed = window.getComputedStyle(target);
  return Object.fromEntries(
    STYLE_ALLOWLIST.map(property => [property, computed.getPropertyValue(property)])
  );
}

function snapshotInlineStyles(target: HTMLElement): Record<string, string> {
  return Object.fromEntries(
    STYLE_ALLOWLIST.map(property => [property, target.style.getPropertyValue(property)])
  );
}

function diffStyles(
  previous: Record<string, string> | undefined,
  next: Record<string, string>,
  forceSnapshot: boolean
): Record<string, string> | undefined {
  if (!previous) return forceSnapshot ? next : undefined;
  const diff = Object.entries(next).reduce<Record<string, string>>((acc, [key, value]) => {
    if (previous[key] !== value) {
      acc[key] = value;
    }
    return acc;
  }, {});
  return Object.keys(diff).length > 0 ? diff : undefined;
}

function resolveRoots(documentRef: Document, selectors: string[]): Element[] {
  if (selectors.length === 0) {
    return documentRef.body ? [documentRef.body] : [];
  }

  const roots = selectors.flatMap(selector =>
    Array.from(documentRef.querySelectorAll(selector))
  );
  return roots.length > 0 ? roots : documentRef.body ? [documentRef.body] : [];
}

export function buildObservedInteractionEvent(
  input: {
    platform?: PlatformId;
    runId?: string;
    tabId?: number;
    selectorFingerprint: string;
    tag?: string;
    text?: string;
    rect?: ObservedRect;
    pointerSequenceSummary: string[];
    modifierKeys?: string[];
    ancestryFingerprint?: string[];
  }
): ObservedInteractionEvent {
  return {
    eventId: createId('interaction'),
    platform: input.platform,
    runId: input.runId,
    tabId: input.tabId,
    recordedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    selectorFingerprint: input.selectorFingerprint,
    tag: input.tag,
    text: input.text,
    rect: input.rect,
    pointerSequenceSummary: input.pointerSequenceSummary,
    modifierKeys: input.modifierKeys,
    ancestryFingerprint: input.ancestryFingerprint,
  };
}

export function createDomInspectorController(
  documentRef: Document,
  config: DomInspectorConfig,
  callbacks: DomInspectorCallbacks
): DomInspectorController {
  const styleCache = new WeakMap<HTMLElement, Record<string, string>>();
  const observer = new MutationObserver(records => {
    processRecords(records);
  });

  function toEvent(mutation: MutationRecord): ObservedDomEvent | null {
    if (mutation.type === 'attributes' && !shouldCaptureAttribute(mutation.attributeName)) {
      return null;
    }

    const target = mutation.target instanceof Element ? mutation.target : null;
    const styleDiff =
      config.styleDiffEnabled && target instanceof HTMLElement
        ? diffStyles(
            styleCache.get(target),
            mutation.attributeName === 'style'
              ? snapshotInlineStyles(target)
              : snapshotStyles(target),
            mutation.attributeName === 'style'
          )
        : undefined;

    if (target instanceof HTMLElement && config.styleDiffEnabled) {
      styleCache.set(target, snapshotStyles(target));
    }

    return {
      eventId: createId('dom'),
      tabId: config.tabId,
      platform: config.platform,
      runId: config.runId,
      recordedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      mutationType: mutation.type,
      selectorFingerprint: buildSelectorFingerprint(target),
      targetTag: target?.tagName?.toLowerCase(),
      textPreview:
        mutation.type === 'characterData'
          ? normalizeText(mutation.target.textContent)
          : normalizeText(target?.textContent),
      attributesChanged: mutation.attributeName ? [mutation.attributeName] : undefined,
      styleDiff,
      rect: getElementRect(target),
      containerKey: getContainerKey(target),
    };
  }

  function processRecords(records: MutationRecord[]) {
    for (const mutation of records) {
      const event = toEvent(mutation);
      if (event) {
        callbacks.onDomEvent(event);
      }
    }
  }

  for (const root of resolveRoots(documentRef, config.selectedRoots)) {
    observer.observe(root, {
      childList: true,
      subtree: true,
      attributes: true,
      attributeOldValue: true,
      characterData: config.includeCharacterData,
      characterDataOldValue: config.includeCharacterData,
    });
  }

  return {
    stop: () => {
      processRecords(observer.takeRecords());
      observer.disconnect();
    },
  };
}

export interface NetworkAttributionInput {
  url: string;
  requestBodyPreview?: string;
  responseBodyPreview?: string;
  transport?: 'http' | 'websocket';
}

function normalizeText(value: string | undefined): string {
  return (value ?? '').toLowerCase();
}

export function truncateAttributionPreview(
  value: string,
  maxLength: number = 4096
): string {
  if (value.length <= maxLength) return value;
  return value.slice(0, maxLength);
}

export function buildNetworkFilterTags({
  url,
  requestBodyPreview,
  responseBodyPreview,
  transport,
}: NetworkAttributionInput): string[] {
  const text = `${normalizeText(url)} ${normalizeText(requestBodyPreview)} ${normalizeText(
    responseBodyPreview
  )}`;
  const tags = new Set<string>();

  if (transport === 'websocket') {
    tags.add('websocket');
  }
  if (text.includes('graphql')) {
    tags.add('graphql');
  }
  if (
    text.includes('pick up session') ||
    text.includes('pickup session') ||
    text.includes('claim') ||
    text.includes('acceptmeetingrequest') ||
    text.includes('accept')
  ) {
    tags.add('claim');
  }
  if (
    text.includes('active session') ||
    text.includes('meeting in progress') ||
    text.includes('session in progress') ||
    text.includes('notarymeeting')
  ) {
    tags.add('active-session');
  }
  if (
    text.includes('queue') ||
    text.includes('ondemandqueue') ||
    text.includes('viewerqueuespoller')
  ) {
    tags.add('queue');
  }

  return Array.from(tags);
}

function previewRawRequestBody(rawBody: { bytes?: ArrayBuffer | Uint8Array | number[] }[]): string | undefined {
  for (const entry of rawBody) {
    if (!entry?.bytes) continue;
    try {
      const bytes =
        entry.bytes instanceof ArrayBuffer
          ? new Uint8Array(entry.bytes)
          : entry.bytes instanceof Uint8Array
            ? entry.bytes
            : Uint8Array.from(entry.bytes);
      return truncateAttributionPreview(new TextDecoder().decode(bytes));
    } catch {
      continue;
    }
  }
  return undefined;
}

export function requestBodyToPreview(
  requestBody:
    | {
        formData?: Record<string, string[] | string>;
        raw?: Array<{ bytes?: ArrayBuffer | Uint8Array | number[] }>;
      }
    | undefined
): string | undefined {
  if (!requestBody) {
    return undefined;
  }

  if (requestBody.formData && Object.keys(requestBody.formData).length > 0) {
    return truncateAttributionPreview(JSON.stringify(requestBody.formData, null, 2));
  }

  if (Array.isArray(requestBody.raw) && requestBody.raw.length > 0) {
    return previewRawRequestBody(requestBody.raw);
  }

  return undefined;
}

const INSPECTOR_DOM_EVENTS_KEY = 'proof-extension:inspector:dom-events';
const INSPECTOR_NETWORK_EVENTS_KEY = 'proof-extension:inspector:network-events';
const INSPECTOR_INTERACTION_EVENTS_KEY =
  'proof-extension:inspector:interaction-events';
const INSPECTOR_SOCKET_EVENTS_KEY = 'proof-extension:inspector:socket-events';
const INSPECTOR_SIGNATURES_KEY = 'proof-extension:inspector:signatures';

const MAX_DOM_EVENTS = 750;
const MAX_NETWORK_EVENTS = 750;
const MAX_INTERACTION_EVENTS = 500;
const MAX_SOCKET_EVENTS = 500;
const MAX_SIGNATURES = 200;

async function appendEntries<T>(
  key: string,
  entries: T[],
  limit: number
): Promise<void> {
  if (entries.length === 0) return;
  const stored = await chrome.storage.session.get(key);
  const existing = Array.isArray(stored[key]) ? (stored[key] as T[]) : [];
  existing.unshift(...entries.slice().reverse());
  if (existing.length > limit) {
    existing.length = limit;
  }
  await chrome.storage.session.set({ [key]: existing });
}

async function getEntries<T>(key: string): Promise<T[]> {
  const stored = await chrome.storage.session.get(key);
  return Array.isArray(stored[key]) ? (stored[key] as T[]) : [];
}

export async function appendObservedDomEvent(
  event: ObservedDomEvent
): Promise<void> {
  await appendObservedDomEvents([event]);
}

export async function appendObservedDomEvents(
  events: ObservedDomEvent[]
): Promise<void> {
  await appendEntries(INSPECTOR_DOM_EVENTS_KEY, events, MAX_DOM_EVENTS);
}

export async function appendObservedNetworkEvent(
  event: ObservedNetworkEvent

}

}

): Promise<void> {
  await appendObservedInteractionEvents([event]);
}

  events: ObservedInteractionEvent[]
): Promise<void> {
  await appendEntries(
    INSPECTOR_INTERACTION_EVENTS_KEY,
    events,
    MAX_INTERACTION_EVENTS
  );
}

  await chrome.storage.session.set({ [INSPECTOR_SIGNATURES_KEY]: next });

    await Promise.all([

import type {
  PauseReason,
  PlatformNetworkSnapshot,
  PlatformProvider,
  PlatformSettingsShape,
  PlatformWatchConfig,
  WatchCandidateDescriptor,
} from './types.js';

const DEFAULT_BUTTON_SELECTOR = 'button,[role="button"],a[role="button"]';

function escapeSelectorValue(value: string): string {
  if (typeof CSS !== 'undefined' && typeof CSS.escape === 'function') {
    return CSS.escape(value);
  }
  return value.replace(/["\\.#:[\]]/g, '\\$&');
}

function normalizeText(value: string | null | undefined): string {
  return (value ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
}

function matchesKeywords(text: string, keywords?: string[]): boolean {
  if (!keywords || keywords.length === 0) return true;
  const normalized = normalizeText(text);
  if (!normalized) return false;
  return keywords.some(keyword => normalized.includes(normalizeText(keyword)));
}

function isClickable(element: HTMLElement): boolean {
  if (element.getAttribute('aria-disabled') === 'true') return false;
  const style = window.getComputedStyle(element);
  return style.display !== 'none' && style.visibility !== 'hidden';
}

function buildSelector(element: HTMLElement, fallbackSelector: string): string {
  if (element.id) {
    return `#${escapeSelectorValue(element.id)}`;
  }
  const testId = element.getAttribute('data-testid');
  if (testId) {
    return `[data-testid="${escapeSelectorValue(testId)}"]`;
  }
  const classes = Array.from(element.classList).slice(0, 2);
  if (classes.length > 0) {
    return `${element.tagName.toLowerCase()}.${classes
      .map(cls => escapeSelectorValue(cls))
      .join('.')}`;
  }
  return fallbackSelector;
}

function createDescriptor(
  element: HTMLElement,
  fallbackSelector: string
): WatchCandidateDescriptor {
  const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect();
  return {
    element,
    text: (element.textContent ?? '').trim(),
    selector: buildSelector(element, fallbackSelector),
    x: rect.left + rect.width / 2,
    y: rect.top + rect.height / 2,
  };
}

function getOperationNames(snapshot?: PlatformNetworkSnapshot): string[] {
  return snapshot?.operationNames ?? [];
}

function resolveProofContainer(
  documentRef: Document,
  selector: string
): Element | null {
  if (selector.trim()) {
    return documentRef.querySelector(selector);
  }

  const fallbacks = [
    '[data-testid="queue-shell"]',
    '[data-testid*="queue"]',
    '[class*="queue-panel"]',
    '[class*="queue-list"]',
    'main',
  ];
  for (const fallback of fallbacks) {
    const candidate = documentRef.querySelector(fallback);
    if (candidate) {
      return candidate;
    }
  }

  return null;
}

function detectProofActiveSession(
  documentRef: Document,
  snapshot?: PlatformNetworkSnapshot
): boolean {
  const url = documentRef.defaultView?.location.href ?? '';
  if (/meeting|session/i.test(url) && !/queue/i.test(url)) {
    return true;
  }
  const bodyText = normalizeText(documentRef.body?.textContent);
  if (
    bodyText.includes('meeting in progress') ||
    bodyText.includes('return to meeting')
  ) {
    return true;
  }
  const operationNames = getOperationNames(snapshot);
  return operationNames.some(operation =>
    ['AcceptMeetingRequest', 'NotaryMeeting', 'NotaryMeetingPoller'].includes(
      operation
    )
  );
}

function detectProofInQueue(
  documentRef: Document,
  snapshot?: PlatformNetworkSnapshot,
  container?: Element | null
): boolean {
  const url = documentRef.defaultView?.location.href ?? '';
  if (/queue|on-?demand/i.test(url)) {
    return true;
  }
  const operationNames = getOperationNames(snapshot);
  if (
    operationNames.some(operation =>
      ['ViewerQueuesPoller', 'OnDemandQueue'].includes(operation)
    )
  ) {
    return true;
  }
  if (!container) return false;
  const text = normalizeText(container.textContent);
  return text.includes('queue') || text.includes('on demand');
}

function detectProofPausedReason(
  documentRef: Document,
  snapshot?: PlatformNetworkSnapshot
): PauseReason | null {
  if (detectProofActiveSession(documentRef, snapshot)) {
    return 'active_session';
  }
  const bodyText = normalizeText(documentRef.body?.textContent);
  if (bodyText.includes('unavailable') || bodyText.includes('try again')) {
    return 'platform_error';
  }
  return null;
}

function createWatchConfig(settings: PlatformSettingsShape): PlatformWatchConfig {
  return {
    platformId: 'proof',
    containerSelector: settings.selectors.openCallsSection,
    buttonSelector: settings.selectors.openCallsButtons,
    headingText: 'On Demand Queue',
    noDataSelector: settings.selectors.openCallsNoData,
    keywords: settings.joinKeywords,
    label: 'WATCHING PROOF QUEUE',
    statusText: 'ACTIVE',
    queueUrl: settings.queueUrl,
    authenticatedTabOnly: settings.authenticatedTabOnly,
  };
}

export const proofProvider: PlatformProvider = {
  id: 'proof',
  label: 'Proof',
  matches: url => /business\.proof\.com/.test(url),
  getWatchConfig: createWatchConfig,
  createAdapter: (documentRef, config) => {
    const resolveContainer = () =>
      resolveProofContainer(documentRef, config.containerSelector);
    const buttonSelector = config.buttonSelector?.trim() || DEFAULT_BUTTON_SELECTOR;

    return {
      resolveContainer,
      isNoData: (container: Element) => {
        // If a non-disabled candidate button is present the queue is not empty.
        // This guards against textContent false-positives caused by CSS-hidden
        // "queue is empty" text embedded inside a button's disabled-state child
        // elements (confirmed via telemetry: Ryan Joshua Hotaling missed at 05:04:08).
        // NOTE: apply :not([disabled]) to each sub-selector so compound
        // selectors like "button, [role='button']" work correctly.
        const activeSelector = buttonSelector
          .split(',')
          .map(s => `${s.trim()}:not([disabled]):not([aria-disabled="true"])`)
          .join(', ');
        const hasActiveButton = container.querySelector(activeSelector);
        if (hasActiveButton) return false;

        if (config.noDataSelector && container.querySelector(config.noDataSelector)) {
          return true;
        }
        const text = normalizeText(container.textContent);
        return (
          text.includes('no requests available') ||
          text.includes('no meeting requests') ||
          text.includes('queue is empty')
        );
      },
      getCandidates: (container: Element) =>
        Array.from(container.querySelectorAll(buttonSelector))
          .filter(
            element => element instanceof HTMLElement && isClickable(element)
          )
          .map(element =>
            createDescriptor(element as HTMLElement, buttonSelector)
          )
          .filter(candidate => matchesKeywords(candidate.text, config.keywords)),
      findRefreshedCandidate: (buttonText?: string) => {
        const container = resolveContainer();
        if (!container) return null;
        const candidates = Array.from(container.querySelectorAll(buttonSelector))
          .filter(
            element => element instanceof HTMLElement && isClickable(element)
          )
          .map(element =>
            createDescriptor(element as HTMLElement, buttonSelector)
          )
          .filter(candidate => matchesKeywords(candidate.text, config.keywords));
        if (buttonText) {
          const normalized = normalizeText(buttonText);
          const exact = candidates.find(
            candidate => normalizeText(candidate.text) === normalized
          );
          if (exact) return exact;
        }
        return candidates[0] ?? null;
      },
      detectActiveSession: () =>
        detectProofActiveSession(documentRef, config.networkSnapshot),
      detectInQueue: () =>
        detectProofInQueue(
          documentRef,
          config.networkSnapshot,
          resolveContainer()
        ),
      detectPausedReason: () =>
        detectProofPausedReason(documentRef, config.networkSnapshot),
      getNetworkSnapshot: () => config.networkSnapshot,
    };
  },
};

==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/apps/chrome-extensions/proof-extension/src/popup.tsx ====
import React from 'react';
import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client';

import { MESSAGE_TYPES } from './constants.js';
import type { NotaryAppState } from './types/notary.js';
import './assets/popup.css';

function PopupApp() {
  const [state, setState] = React.useState<NotaryAppState | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = React.useState(false);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    async function refresh() {
      try {
        const response = await chrome.runtime.sendMessage({
          type: MESSAGE_TYPES.GET_STATE,
        });
        if (response?.ok && response.state) {
          setState(response.state as NotaryAppState);
        }
      } catch {
        // Service worker not yet ready
      }
    }

    void refresh();
    const listener = (message: { type?: string; state?: NotaryAppState }) => {
      if (message?.type === MESSAGE_TYPES.STATE_UPDATED && message.state) {
        setState(message.state);
      }
    };
    chrome.runtime.onMessage.addListener(listener);
    return () => {
      chrome.runtime.onMessage.removeListener(listener);
    };
  }, []);

  async function runAction(type: string) {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      try {
        await chrome.runtime.sendMessage({ type });
        const response = await chrome.runtime.sendMessage({
          type: MESSAGE_TYPES.GET_STATE,
        });
        if (response?.ok && response.state) {
          setState(response.state as NotaryAppState);
        }
      } catch {
        // Service worker unavailable
      }
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="popup-container">
        <div className="popup-eyebrow">Proof Extension</div>
        <div className="popup-title">Queue Console</div>
        <div className="popup-status">
          <span className={`popup-dot ${state?.watch.status === 'watching' ? 'active' : ''}`} />
          <div>
            <div className="popup-status-label">{state?.watch.status ?? 'idle'}</div>
            <div className="popup-status-copy">
              {state?.watch.lastResult ?? 'Ready to open the Proof queue.'}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="popup-actions">
          <button
            className="popup-button"
            data-testid="popup-open-queue"
            disabled={busy}
            onClick={() => void runAction(MESSAGE_TYPES.OPEN_QUEUE)}
          >
            Open Proof Queue
          </button>
          <button
            className="popup-button secondary"
            data-testid="popup-start-watch"
            disabled={busy}
            onClick={() => void runAction(MESSAGE_TYPES.START_WATCH)}
          >
            Start Watch
          </button>
          <button
            className="popup-button muted"
            data-testid="popup-stop-watch"
            disabled={busy}
            onClick={() => void runAction(MESSAGE_TYPES.STOP_WATCH)}
          >
            Stop Watch
          </button>
          <button
            className="popup-button muted"
            data-testid="popup-attach-inspector"
            disabled={busy}
            onClick={() => void runAction(MESSAGE_TYPES.ATTACH_INSPECTOR)}
          >
            Attach Inspector
          </button>
        </div>
        <p className="popup-note">
          The full operator console lives in the sidepanel. The popup is only for quick queue and watch actions.
        </p>
    </div>
  );
}

const container = document.getElementById('root');
if (container) {
  const root = createRoot(container);
  root.render(<PopupApp />);
}

import {
  executeRecipe as executeSharedRecipe,
  type ExecutionContext,
  type ExecutionResult,
  type RecipeExecutorOptions,
  type Recipe,
} from '@chrome-ext/automation-recipes';
import { createContentRuntime } from './content-runtime.js';

export async function executeRecipe(
  recipe: Recipe,
  tabId: number,
  context?: Partial<ExecutionContext>,
  options?: RecipeExecutorOptions
): Promise<ExecutionResult> {
  const runtime = createContentRuntime(tabId, {
    baseDownloadFolder: context?.baseDownloadFolder,
    variables: context?.variables,
    recipeKey: context?.recipeKey,
  });

  const executionContext: ExecutionContext = {
    tabId,
    credentials: context?.credentials,
    correlationId: context?.correlationId,
    variables: context?.variables,
    baseDownloadFolder: context?.baseDownloadFolder,
    recipeKey: context?.recipeKey,
  };

  return executeSharedRecipe(recipe, runtime, executionContext, undefined, options);
}

import { validateRecipe } from '@chrome-ext/automation-recipes';
import { registerRecipe } from './registry.js';

import signIn from './jsons/blue-notary-sign-in.json' with { type: 'json' };
import dashboard from './jsons/blue-notary-dashboard.json' with { type: 'json' };
import scanOpenCalls from './jsons/blue-notary-open-calls-scan.json' with { type: 'json' };
import clickOpenCall from './jsons/blue-notary-open-calls-click.json' with { type: 'json' };

export function loadRecipes(): void {
  if (validateRecipe(signIn)) {
    registerRecipe('blue-notary', 'sign-in', signIn);
  } else {
    console.error('Invalid recipe: blue-notary-sign-in.json');
  }

  if (validateRecipe(dashboard)) {
    registerRecipe('blue-notary', 'dashboard', dashboard);
  } else {
    console.error('Invalid recipe: blue-notary-dashboard.json');
  }

  if (validateRecipe(scanOpenCalls)) {
    registerRecipe('blue-notary', 'open-calls-scan', scanOpenCalls);
  } else {
    console.error('Invalid recipe: blue-notary-open-calls-scan.json');
  }

  if (validateRecipe(clickOpenCall)) {
    registerRecipe('blue-notary', 'open-calls-click', clickOpenCall);
  } else {
    console.error('Invalid recipe: blue-notary-open-calls-click.json');
  }
}
