const WATCH_START_GRACE_PERIOD_MS = 3000;

const networkSnapshotByTab = new Map<number, PlatformNetworkSnapshot>();
const pendingNetworkRequests = new Map<string, PendingNetworkRequest>();
const diagnosticsBuffer: DiagnosticsBufferState = {
  runLogs: [],
  metrics: [],
  domDelta: [],
  domEvents: [],
  networkEvents: [],
  interactionEvents: [],
};

function createDefaultWatchState(): WatchState {
  return {
    status: 'idle',
    platform: 'proof',
  };
}

function createId(prefix: string): string {
  return `${prefix}-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random()
    .toString(36)
    .slice(2, 8)}`;
}

function getErrorMessage(error: unknown): string {
  return error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
}

function buildAppState(): NotaryAppState {
  return {
    settings,
    watch: watchState,
    logs: [...recentLogs],
    claimTrace: [...recentClaimTrace],
    inspector: inspectorState,
  };
}

function updateClaimState(entry: ClaimAttemptTrace): void {
  recentClaimTrace = [entry, ...recentClaimTrace].slice(0, 20);
  watchState = {
    ...watchState,
    lastClaimDecision: entry.decision,
    lastClaimDecisionAt: entry.recordedAt,
    claimTraceCount: (watchState.claimTraceCount ?? 0) + 1,
  };
}

async function recordClaimTrace(entry: ClaimAttemptTrace): Promise<void> {
  updateClaimState(entry);
  if (watchState.runId) {
    await appendClaimTraceEntries(watchState.runId, [entry]);
  }
  if (entry.decision === 'click_sent') {
    lastClickSentTrace = entry;
  }
  queueStateBroadcast();
}

function buildClaimSummary(claimTrace: ClaimAttemptTrace[]) {
  return claimTrace.reduce(
    (summary, entry) => {
      if (entry.decision.startsWith('suppressed')) {
        summary.suppressedCount += 1;
      }
      if (entry.decision === 'click_sent') {
        summary.clickedCount += 1;
      }
      if (entry.decision === 'invocation_observed') {
        summary.invocationObservedCount += 1;
      }
      if (entry.decision === 'invocation_missing') {
        summary.invocationMissingCount += 1;
      }
      return summary;
    },
    {
      suppressedCount: 0,
      clickedCount: 0,
      invocationObservedCount: 0,
      invocationMissingCount: 0,
      blockedCount: 0,
    }
  );
}

function normalizeUrl(url: string): string {
  try {
    const parsed = new URL(url);
    return `${parsed.origin}${parsed.pathname}`;
  } catch {
    return url;
  }
}

function extractOperationNames(preview?: string): string[] {
  if (!preview) {
    return [];
  }

  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(preview);
    const payloads = Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : [parsed];
    const operationNames = payloads
      .map(payload =>
        payload && typeof payload.operationName === 'string'
          ? payload.operationName
          : undefined
      )
      .filter((value): value is string => Boolean(value));

    if (operationNames.length > 0) {
      return Array.from(new Set(operationNames));
    }
  } catch {
    /* fall through */
  }

  return Array.from(
    new Set(
      [...preview.matchAll(/"operationName"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"/g)].map(
        match => match[1] ?? ''
      )
    )
  ).filter(Boolean);
}

function headersToRecord(
  headers: Array<{ name?: string; value?: string }> | undefined
): Record<string, string> | undefined {
  if (!Array.isArray(headers) || headers.length === 0) {
    return undefined;
  }

  const result: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const header of headers) {
    const name = header?.name?.toLowerCase();
    const value = header?.value;
    if (!name || !value || name === 'cookie' || name === 'set-cookie') {
      continue;
    }
    result[name] = truncateAttributionPreview(value, 160);
  }

  return Object.keys(result).length > 0 ? result : undefined;
}

function mergeUniqueStrings(
  existing: string[] | undefined,
  incoming: string[] | undefined,
  limit: number
): string[] | undefined {
  const values = [...(existing ?? [])];
  for (const item of incoming ?? []) {
    if (!item || values.includes(item)) {
      continue;
    }
    values.push(item);
  }
  return values.length > 0 ? values.slice(-limit) : undefined;
}

function updateDiagnosticsCounters(): void {
  watchState = {
    ...watchState,
    diagnosticsBuffered:
      diagnosticsBuffer.runLogs.length +
      diagnosticsBuffer.metrics.length +
      diagnosticsBuffer.domDelta.length +
      diagnosticsBuffer.domEvents.length +
      diagnosticsBuffer.networkEvents.length +
      diagnosticsBuffer.interactionEvents.length,
  };
}

async function persistSettings(): Promise<void> {
  await chrome.storage.local.set({
    [SETTINGS_STORAGE_KEY]: settings,
  });
}

async function persistRuntimeState(): Promise<void> {
  await chrome.storage.session.set({
    [WATCH_STORAGE_KEY]: watchState,
    [INSPECTOR_STORAGE_KEY]: inspectorState,
    [RECENT_LOGS_STORAGE_KEY]: recentLogs,
  });
}

function queueStateBroadcast(): void {
  if (stateBroadcastTimer !== undefined) {
    return;
  }

  stateBroadcastTimer = globalThis.setTimeout(() => {
    stateBroadcastTimer = undefined;
    updateDiagnosticsCounters();
    void persistRuntimeState();
    try {
      chrome.runtime.sendMessage({
        type: MESSAGE_TYPES.STATE_UPDATED,
        state: buildAppState(),
      });
    } catch {
      /* sidepanel or popup may not be open */
    }
  }, 80) as unknown as number;
}

function clearScheduledTimer(timer: number | undefined): void {
  if (timer !== undefined) {
    globalThis.clearTimeout(timer);
  }
}

function scheduleLogFlush(): void {
  if (logFlushTimer !== undefined || diagnosticsBuffer.runLogs.length === 0) {
    return;
  }

  logFlushTimer = globalThis.setTimeout(() => {
    logFlushTimer = undefined;
    void flushRunLogs();
  }, settings.telemetry.logFlushIntervalMs) as unknown as number;
}

function scheduleMetricFlush(): void {
  if (
    metricFlushTimer !== undefined ||
    (diagnosticsBuffer.metrics.length === 0 &&
      diagnosticsBuffer.domDelta.length === 0)
  ) {
    return;
  }

  metricFlushTimer = globalThis.setTimeout(() => {
    metricFlushTimer = undefined;
    void flushMetrics();
  }, settings.telemetry.metricFlushIntervalMs) as unknown as number;
}

function scheduleEventFlush(): void {
  if (
    eventFlushTimer !== undefined ||
    (diagnosticsBuffer.domEvents.length === 0 &&
      diagnosticsBuffer.networkEvents.length === 0 &&
      diagnosticsBuffer.interactionEvents.length === 0)
  ) {
    return;
  }

  eventFlushTimer = globalThis.setTimeout(() => {
    eventFlushTimer = undefined;
    void flushInspectorEvents();
  }, settings.telemetry.eventFlushIntervalMs) as unknown as number;
}

function pushLog(
  level: LogEntry['level'],
  message: string,
  data?: Record<string, unknown>
): void {
  const entry: LogEntry = {
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    level,
    message,
    data,
  };

  recentLogs = [entry, ...recentLogs].slice(0, MAX_RECENT_LOGS);
  if (watchState.runId) {
    diagnosticsBuffer.runLogs.push(entry);
    scheduleLogFlush();
  }
  queueStateBroadcast();
}

function bufferMetrics(entries: WatchMetricEntry[]): void {
  if (!settings.metricsEnabled || entries.length === 0) {
    return;
  }

  diagnosticsBuffer.metrics.push(...entries);
  if (diagnosticsBuffer.metrics.length > settings.telemetry.maxBufferedMetrics) {
    diagnosticsBuffer.metrics.splice(
      0,
      diagnosticsBuffer.metrics.length - settings.telemetry.maxBufferedMetrics
    );
  }
  scheduleMetricFlush();
  queueStateBroadcast();
}

function bufferDomDelta(entries: DomDeltaEntry[]): void {
  if (
    entries.length === 0 ||
    (!settings.metricsEnabled &&
      !(inspectorState.attached && inspectorState.domActive))
  ) {
    return;
  }

  diagnosticsBuffer.domDelta.push(...entries);
  if (diagnosticsBuffer.domDelta.length > settings.telemetry.maxBufferedDomDeltas) {
    diagnosticsBuffer.domDelta.splice(
      0,
      diagnosticsBuffer.domDelta.length -
        settings.telemetry.maxBufferedDomDeltas
    );
  }
  scheduleMetricFlush();
  queueStateBroadcast();
}

function bufferInspectorDomEvents(events: ObservedDomEvent[]): void {
  if (events.length === 0 || !inspectorState.attached || !inspectorState.domActive) {
    return;
  }

  diagnosticsBuffer.domEvents.push(...events);
  if (
    diagnosticsBuffer.domEvents.length >
    settings.telemetry.maxBufferedInspectorEvents
  ) {
    diagnosticsBuffer.domEvents.splice(
      0,
      diagnosticsBuffer.domEvents.length -
        settings.telemetry.maxBufferedInspectorEvents
    );
  }

  inspectorState = {
    ...inspectorState,
    domEventCount: inspectorState.domEventCount + events.length,
  };
  scheduleEventFlush();
  queueStateBroadcast();
}

function bufferInspectorNetworkEvents(events: ObservedNetworkEvent[]): void {
  if (
    events.length === 0 ||
    !inspectorState.attached ||
    !inspectorState.networkActive
  ) {
    return;
  }

  diagnosticsBuffer.networkEvents.push(...events);
  if (
    diagnosticsBuffer.networkEvents.length >
    settings.telemetry.maxBufferedInspectorEvents
  ) {
    diagnosticsBuffer.networkEvents.splice(
      0,
      diagnosticsBuffer.networkEvents.length -
        settings.telemetry.maxBufferedInspectorEvents
    );
  }

  inspectorState = {
    ...inspectorState,
    networkEventCount: inspectorState.networkEventCount + events.length,
  };
  scheduleEventFlush();
  queueStateBroadcast();
}

function bufferInspectorInteractionEvents(
  events: ObservedInteractionEvent[]
): void {
  if (events.length === 0 || !inspectorState.attached) {
    return;
  }

  diagnosticsBuffer.interactionEvents.push(...events);
  if (
    diagnosticsBuffer.interactionEvents.length >
    settings.telemetry.maxBufferedInspectorEvents
  ) {
    diagnosticsBuffer.interactionEvents.splice(
      0,
      diagnosticsBuffer.interactionEvents.length -
        settings.telemetry.maxBufferedInspectorEvents
    );
  }

  inspectorState = {
    ...inspectorState,
    interactionEventCount: inspectorState.interactionEventCount + events.length,
  };
  scheduleEventFlush();
  queueStateBroadcast();
}

async function flushRunLogs(): Promise<void> {
  if (!watchState.runId || diagnosticsBuffer.runLogs.length === 0) {
    return;
  }

  const entries = diagnosticsBuffer.runLogs.splice(0, diagnosticsBuffer.runLogs.length);
  await appendRunLogs(watchState.runId, entries);
  watchState = {
    ...watchState,
    lastFlushAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  };
  queueStateBroadcast();
}

async function flushMetrics(): Promise<void> {
  const metrics = diagnosticsBuffer.metrics.splice(0, diagnosticsBuffer.metrics.length);
  const domDelta = diagnosticsBuffer.domDelta.splice(
    0,
    diagnosticsBuffer.domDelta.length
  );

  if (metrics.length > 0) {
    await appendWatchMetrics(metrics);
  }
  if (domDelta.length > 0) {
    await appendDomDeltaEntries(domDelta);
  }
  if (metrics.length > 0 || domDelta.length > 0) {
    watchState = {
      ...watchState,
      lastFlushAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
    queueStateBroadcast();
  }
}

async function flushInspectorEvents(): Promise<void> {
  const domEvents = diagnosticsBuffer.domEvents.splice(
    0,
    diagnosticsBuffer.domEvents.length
  );
  const networkEvents = diagnosticsBuffer.networkEvents.splice(
    0,
    diagnosticsBuffer.networkEvents.length
  );
  const interactionEvents = diagnosticsBuffer.interactionEvents.splice(
    0,
    diagnosticsBuffer.interactionEvents.length
  );

  if (domEvents.length > 0) {
    await appendObservedDomEvents(domEvents);
  }
  if (networkEvents.length > 0) {
    await appendObservedNetworkEvents(networkEvents);
  }
  if (interactionEvents.length > 0) {
    await appendObservedInteractionEvents(interactionEvents);
  }

  if (
    domEvents.length > 0 ||
    networkEvents.length > 0 ||
    interactionEvents.length > 0
  ) {
    watchState = {
      ...watchState,
      lastFlushAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
    queueStateBroadcast();
  }
}

async function flushAllDiagnostics(): Promise<void> {
  clearScheduledTimer(logFlushTimer);
  clearScheduledTimer(metricFlushTimer);
  clearScheduledTimer(eventFlushTimer);
  logFlushTimer = undefined;
  metricFlushTimer = undefined;
  eventFlushTimer = undefined;

  await flushRunLogs();
  await flushMetrics();
  await flushInspectorEvents();
}

async function getActiveTab(): Promise<BrowserTab | null> {
  const tabs = await chrome.tabs.query({
    active: true,
    lastFocusedWindow: true,
  });
  return tabs[0] ?? null;
}

async function getProofTab(tabId?: number): Promise<BrowserTab | null> {
  if (typeof tabId === 'number') {
    try {
      const tab = await chrome.tabs.get(tabId);
      if (tab?.id && resolvePlatformForUrl(tab.url ?? '')) {
        return tab;
      }
    } catch {
      /* tab may be gone */
    }
  }

  const activeTab = await getActiveTab();
  if (activeTab?.id && resolvePlatformForUrl(activeTab.url ?? '')) {
    return activeTab;
  }

  const proofTabs = await chrome.tabs.query({
    url: ['https://business.proof.com/*'],
  });
  return proofTabs[0] ?? null;
}

async function focusTab(tabId: number | undefined): Promise<void> {
  if (typeof tabId !== 'number') {
    return;
  }

  try {
    const tab = await chrome.tabs.get(tabId);
    if (typeof tab.windowId === 'number') {
      await chrome.windows.update(tab.windowId, { focused: true });
    }
    await chrome.tabs.update(tabId, { active: true });
  } catch {
    /* tab may be gone */
  }
}

function getWatchPayload() {
  const provider = getPlatformProvider();
  const watchConfig = provider.getWatchConfig(settings.platform);
  return {
    ...watchConfig,
    runId: watchState.runId,
    sessionId: watchState.sessionId,
    claimCooldownMs: settings.watch.claimCooldownMs,
    claimRetryDelaysMs: settings.watch.claimRetryDelaysMs,
    claimInvocationDiagnosticsEnabled:
      settings.watch.claimInvocationDiagnosticsEnabled,
    includeSnapshot: settings.metricsEnabled,
    enableDomDeltaProbe:
      settings.metricsEnabled ||
      (inspectorState.attached &&
        inspectorState.attachedTabId === watchState.tabId &&
        inspectorState.domActive),
    networkSnapshot:
      typeof watchState.tabId === 'number'
        ? networkSnapshotByTab.get(watchState.tabId)
        : undefined,
    autoClaim: settings.watch.autoClaimEnabled,
  };
}

async function sendTabMessage(
  tabId: number | undefined,
  message: Record<string, unknown>
): Promise<void> {
  if (typeof tabId !== 'number') {
    return;
  }

  try {
    await chrome.tabs.sendMessage(tabId, message);
  } catch {
    /* content script may not be ready yet */
  }
}

async function syncWatchToContent(): Promise<void> {
  if (typeof watchState.tabId !== 'number') {
    return;
  }

  if (watchState.status !== 'watching') {
    await Promise.allSettled([
      sendTabMessage(watchState.tabId, {
        type: MESSAGE_TYPES.STOP_DOM_WATCH,
      }),
      sendTabMessage(watchState.tabId, {
        type: MESSAGE_TYPES.HIDE_WATCH_OVERLAY,
      }),
    ]);
    return;
  }

  const payload = getWatchPayload();
  await sendTabMessage(watchState.tabId, {
    type: MESSAGE_TYPES.START_DOM_WATCH,
    payload,
  });

  if (settings.watch.overlayEnabled) {
    await sendTabMessage(watchState.tabId, {
      type: MESSAGE_TYPES.SHOW_WATCH_OVERLAY,
      payload: {
        containerSelector: payload.containerSelector,
        targetSelector: payload.buttonSelector,
        headingText: payload.headingText,
        label: payload.label,
        statusText: payload.statusText ?? 'ACTIVE',
      },
    });
  }

  if (settings.watch.highlightEnabled) {
    await sendTabMessage(watchState.tabId, {
      type: MESSAGE_TYPES.HIGHLIGHT_WATCH,
      payload: {
        containerSelector: payload.containerSelector,
        targetSelector: payload.buttonSelector,
        durationMs: 1600,
      },
    });
  }
}

async function syncInspectorToContent(): Promise<void> {
  const tabId = inspectorState.attachedTabId;
  if (typeof tabId !== 'number') {
    return;
  }

  if (!inspectorState.attached || !inspectorState.domActive) {
    await sendTabMessage(tabId, {
      type: MESSAGE_TYPES.STOP_DOM_INSPECTOR,
    });
    return;
  }

  await sendTabMessage(tabId, {
    type: MESSAGE_TYPES.START_DOM_INSPECTOR,
    payload: {
      selectedRoots: inspectorState.selectedRoots,
      includeCharacterData: settings.inspector.includeCharacterData,
      styleDiffEnabled: settings.inspector.styleDiffEnabled,
      runId: inspectorState.attachedRunId,
      tabId,
      platformId: 'proof',
    },
  });
}

function clearClaimConfirmationTimer(): void {
  clearScheduledTimer(claimConfirmationTimer);
  claimConfirmationTimer = undefined;
}

function scheduleClaimConfirmationTimeout(): void {
  clearClaimConfirmationTimer();
  claimConfirmationTimer = globalThis.setTimeout(() => {
    claimConfirmationTimer = undefined;
    if (!awaitingClaimConfirmation || watchState.status !== 'watching') {
      return;
    }
    awaitingClaimConfirmation = false;
    if (lastClickSentTrace) {
      void recordClaimTrace({
        ...lastClickSentTrace,
        traceId: createId('claim-trace'),
        recordedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        decision: 'invocation_missing',
        requestObserved: false,
        detail: 'claim_confirmation_timeout',
      });
    }
    void pauseWatch(
      'operator_pause',
      'Claim attempted. Verification is pending in the Proof tab.'
    );
  }, settings.watch.claimInvocationTimeoutMs || CLAIM_CONFIRM_TIMEOUT_MS) as unknown as number;
}

async function confirmActiveSession(source: 'dom' | 'network'): Promise<void> {
  if (!awaitingClaimConfirmation && watchState.status !== 'watching') {
    return;
  }

  awaitingClaimConfirmation = false;
  clearClaimConfirmationTimer();
  if (lastClickSentTrace) {
    await recordClaimTrace({
      ...lastClickSentTrace,
      traceId: createId('claim-trace'),
      recordedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      decision: 'session_confirmed',
      requestObserved: true,
      detail: source,
    });
  }
  await focusTab(watchState.tabId);

  if (typeof watchState.tabId === 'number') {
    if (settings.watch.audioEnabled) {
      await sendTabMessage(watchState.tabId, {
        type: MESSAGE_TYPES.TEST_SOUND,
        payload: {
          repeat: settings.watch.notificationRepeats,
        },
      });
    }
    await sendTabMessage(watchState.tabId, {
      type: MESSAGE_TYPES.TEST_NOTIFICATION,
      payload: {
        message: 'Proof meeting confirmed. Watch paused.',
      },
    });
  }

  await pauseWatch(
    'active_session',
    `Proof active session confirmed from ${source}.`
  );
}

async function pauseWatch(
  reason: PauseReason,
  lastResult: string
): Promise<WatchState> {
  clearClaimConfirmationTimer();
  awaitingClaimConfirmation = false;

  watchState = {
    ...watchState,
    status: 'paused',
    pauseReason: reason,
    lastResult,
    lastCheckedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  };

  await syncWatchToContent();
  pushLog('info', 'Proof watch paused', {
    reason,
    tabId: watchState.tabId,
  });
  queueStateBroadcast();
  return watchState;
}

async function stopWatch(lastResult: string = 'Watch stopped'): Promise<WatchState> {
  clearClaimConfirmationTimer();
  awaitingClaimConfirmation = false;
  lastClickSentTrace = null;

  watchState = {
    ...watchState,
    status: 'idle',
    pauseReason: undefined,
    lastResult,
    lastCheckedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  };

  await syncWatchToContent();
  pushLog('info', 'Proof watch stopped', {
    tabId: watchState.tabId,
  });
  queueStateBroadcast();
  return watchState;
}

async function startWatch(tabId?: number): Promise<WatchState> {
  const tab = await getProofTab(tabId);
  if (!tab?.id) {
    watchState = {
      ...watchState,
      status: 'error',
      lastError: 'No authenticated Proof tab is available.',
      lastResult: 'Open a Proof business tab before starting the watch.',
      lastCheckedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      platform: 'proof',
    };
    queueStateBroadcast();
    return watchState;
  }

  if (watchState.status === 'watching' && watchState.tabId === tab.id) {
    watchState = {
      ...watchState,
      lastResult: 'Already watching this Proof tab.',
      lastCheckedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
    queueStateBroadcast();
    return watchState;
  }

  clearClaimConfirmationTimer();
  awaitingClaimConfirmation = false;
  lastClickSentTrace = null;
  recentClaimTrace = [];

  watchState = {
    ...watchState,
    status: 'watching',
    tabId: tab.id,
    runId: createId('proof-watch'),
    sessionId: createId('session'),
    lastError: undefined,
    pauseReason: undefined,
    lastResult: 'Reactive watch armed.',
    lastCheckedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    inQueueDetected: true,
    activeSessionDetected: false,
    platform: 'proof',
  };

  pushLog('info', 'Proof watch started', {
    tabId: tab.id,
    url: normalizeUrl(tab.url ?? ''),
  });

  // Clear any stale network snapshot so the first content-script evaluation
  // uses only URL and body text for active-session detection.  Prior claim
  // operations (AcceptMeetingRequest, NotaryMeeting, etc.) lingering in the
  // snapshot would otherwise cause an immediate phantom active_session pause.
  networkSnapshotByTab.delete(tab.id);
  watchStartedAt = Date.now();

  await syncWatchToContent();
  if (inspectorState.attached && inspectorState.attachedTabId === tab.id) {
    await syncInspectorToContent();
  }

  queueStateBroadcast();
  return watchState;
}

async function resumeWatch(): Promise<WatchState> {
  const tab = await getProofTab(watchState.tabId);
  if (!tab?.id) {
    return pauseWatch(
      'tab_unavailable',
      'The watched Proof tab is no longer available.'
    );
  }

  watchState = {
    ...watchState,
    status: 'watching',
    tabId: tab.id,
    pauseReason: undefined,
    lastResult: 'Reactive watch resumed.',
    lastCheckedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  };
  pushLog('info', 'Proof watch resumed', {
    tabId: tab.id,
  });
  await syncWatchToContent();
  queueStateBroadcast();
  return watchState;
}

async function attachInspector(tabId?: number): Promise<InspectorRuntimeState> {
  const tab = await getProofTab(tabId ?? watchState.tabId);
  if (!tab?.id) {
    throw new Error('Open a Proof business tab before attaching the inspector.');
  }

  await clearInspectorState();
  const attachedRunId =
    watchState.tabId === tab.id && watchState.runId
      ? watchState.runId
      : createId('proof-inspector');

  inspectorState = {
    ...createDefaultInspectorRuntimeState(),
    attached: true,
    attachedTabId: tab.id,
    attachedRunId,
    domActive: settings.inspector.domEnabled,
    networkActive: settings.inspector.networkEnabled,
    deepTraceActive: settings.inspector.deepTraceEnabled,
    selectedRoots: [...settings.inspector.selectedRoots],
    activePane: settings.ui.lastPane,
    filterState: { ...inspectorState.filterState },
    sessionKey: `${tab.id}:${attachedRunId}`,
  };

  pushLog('info', 'Inspector attached to Proof tab', {
    tabId: tab.id,
  });
  await syncInspectorToContent();
  queueStateBroadcast();
  return inspectorState;
}

async function detachInspector(): Promise<InspectorRuntimeState> {
  const tabId = inspectorState.attachedTabId;
  inspectorState = {
    ...createDefaultInspectorRuntimeState(),
    activePane: inspectorState.activePane,
    filterState: { ...inspectorState.filterState },
  };
  await clearInspectorState();
  await sendTabMessage(tabId, {
    type: MESSAGE_TYPES.STOP_DOM_INSPECTOR,
  });
  pushLog('info', 'Inspector detached', {
    tabId,
  });
  queueStateBroadcast();
  return inspectorState;
}

async function getInspectorData(): Promise<InspectorStateBundle> {
  await flushInspectorEvents();
  const bundle = await getInspectorExportBundle();
  return {
    domEvents: bundle.domEvents,
    networkEvents: bundle.networkEvents,
    interactionEvents: bundle.interactionEvents,
    signatures: bundle.signatures,
  };
}

async function exportWatchLogs(): Promise<WatchLogExportBundle> {
  await flushAllDiagnostics();
  const inspector = await getInspectorExportBundle();
  const logs = watchState.runId ? await getRunLog(watchState.runId) : [];
  const metrics = await getWatchMetrics();
  const domDelta = await getDomDeltaEntries();
  const claimTrace = await getClaimTraceEntries(watchState.runId);
  const exportedAt = new Date().toISOString();
  const claimSummary = buildClaimSummary(claimTrace);

  return {
    exportedAt,
    watch: watchState,
    settings,
    logs,
    metrics,
    domDelta,
    claimTrace,
    inspector,
    summary: {
      exportedAt,
      currentStatus: watchState.status,
      runId: watchState.runId,
      sessionId: watchState.sessionId,
      lastResult: watchState.lastResult,
      logCount: logs.length,
      metricCount: metrics.length,
      domDeltaCount: domDelta.length,
      domEventCount: inspector.domEvents.length,
      networkEventCount: inspector.networkEvents.length,
      interactionEventCount: inspector.interactionEvents.length,
      claimTraceCount: claimTrace.length,
      suppressedCount: claimSummary.suppressedCount,
      clickedCount: claimSummary.clickedCount,
      invocationObservedCount: claimSummary.invocationObservedCount,
      invocationMissingCount: claimSummary.invocationMissingCount,
      blockedCount: claimSummary.blockedCount,
    },
  };
}

async function clearLogs(): Promise<void> {
  diagnosticsBuffer.runLogs.length = 0;
  diagnosticsBuffer.metrics.length = 0;
  diagnosticsBuffer.domDelta.length = 0;
  diagnosticsBuffer.domEvents.length = 0;
  diagnosticsBuffer.networkEvents.length = 0;
  diagnosticsBuffer.interactionEvents.length = 0;
  recentLogs = [];
  recentClaimTrace = [];
  lastClickSentTrace = null;
  inspectorState = {
    ...inspectorState,
    domEventCount: 0,
    networkEventCount: 0,
    interactionEventCount: 0,
  };
  await Promise.all([
    clearRunLogs(),
    clearWatchMetrics(),
    clearDomDeltaEntries(),
    clearClaimTraceEntries(),
    clearInspectorState(),
  ]);
  queueStateBroadcast();
}

async function resetState(): Promise<void> {
  await stopWatch('State reset');
  await detachInspector().catch(() => inspectorState);
  await clearLogs();
  settings = createDefaultSettings();
  watchState = createDefaultWatchState();
  inspectorState = createDefaultInspectorRuntimeState();
  await persistSettings();
  await persistRuntimeState();
  queueStateBroadcast();
}

function mergeSettings(partial: Partial<NotarySettings>): NotarySettings {
  return hydrateSettings({
    ...settings,
    ...partial,
    platform: partial.platform
      ? {
          ...settings.platform,
          ...partial.platform,
          selectors: {
            ...settings.platform.selectors,
            ...(partial.platform.selectors ?? {}),
          },
          joinKeywords: Array.isArray(partial.platform.joinKeywords)
            ? partial.platform.joinKeywords
            : settings.platform.joinKeywords,
        }
      : settings.platform,
    watch: partial.watch
      ? { ...settings.watch, ...partial.watch }
      : settings.watch,
    inspector: partial.inspector
      ? {
          ...settings.inspector,
          ...partial.inspector,
          selectedRoots: Array.isArray(partial.inspector.selectedRoots)
            ? partial.inspector.selectedRoots.filter(Boolean)
            : settings.inspector.selectedRoots,
        }
      : settings.inspector,
    telemetry: partial.telemetry
      ? { ...settings.telemetry, ...partial.telemetry }
      : settings.telemetry,
    ui: partial.ui ? { ...settings.ui, ...partial.ui } : settings.ui,
    metricsEnabled: partial.metricsEnabled ?? settings.metricsEnabled,
  });
}

async function updateSettings(partial: Partial<NotarySettings>): Promise<NotarySettings> {
  settings = mergeSettings(partial);
  inspectorState = {
    ...inspectorState,
    deepTraceActive: inspectorState.attached
      ? settings.inspector.deepTraceEnabled
      : false,
    networkActive: inspectorState.attached
      ? settings.inspector.networkEnabled
      : false,
    domActive: inspectorState.attached ? settings.inspector.domEnabled : false,
    selectedRoots: inspectorState.attached
      ? [...settings.inspector.selectedRoots]
      : inspectorState.selectedRoots,
  };

  await persistSettings();
  if (watchState.status === 'watching') {
    await syncWatchToContent();
  }
  if (inspectorState.attached) {
    await syncInspectorToContent();
  }
  queueStateBroadcast();
  return settings;
}

function updateNetworkSnapshot(
  tabId: number,
  operationNames: string[],
  hint: string
): PlatformNetworkSnapshot {
  const previous = networkSnapshotByTab.get(tabId) ?? {
    source: 'webRequest',
    operationNames: [],
    hints: [],
  };

  const snapshot: PlatformNetworkSnapshot = {
    source: 'webRequest',
    operationNames: mergeUniqueStrings(previous.operationNames, operationNames, 24),
    hints: mergeUniqueStrings(previous.hints, [hint], 24),
    updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  };

  networkSnapshotByTab.set(tabId, snapshot);
  return snapshot;
}

async function maybeHandleWatchOperations(
  tabId: number,
  operationNames: string[],
  url: string
): Promise<void> {
  if (watchState.tabId !== tabId || watchState.status === 'idle') {
    return;
  }

  if (operationNames.some(operation => QUEUE_OPERATIONS.has(operation))) {
    watchState = {
      ...watchState,
      inQueueDetected: true,
      lastCheckedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
    queueStateBroadcast();
  }

  if (operationNames.some(operation => ACTIVE_SESSION_OPERATIONS.has(operation))) {
    watchState = {
      ...watchState,
      activeSessionDetected: true,
      lastCheckedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
    pushLog('info', 'Proof network hint detected an active session', {
      operationNames,
      url: normalizeUrl(url),
    });
    await confirmActiveSession('network');
  }
}

function createObservedNetworkEvent(
  details: any,
  requestBodyPreview: string | undefined,
  operationNames: string[]
): ObservedNetworkEvent {
  return {
    eventId: createId('network'),
    requestId: details.requestId,
    tabId: details.tabId,
    platform: 'proof',
    runId:
      inspectorState.attachedTabId === details.tabId
        ? inspectorState.attachedRunId
        : watchState.tabId === details.tabId
          ? watchState.runId
          : undefined,
    recordedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    url: normalizeUrl(details.url),
    method: details.method ?? 'GET',
    transport: 'http',
    requestHeaders: headersToRecord(details.requestHeaders),
    responseHeaders: headersToRecord(details.responseHeaders),
    requestBodyPreview,
    initiator:
      inspectorState.deepTraceActive && typeof details.initiator === 'string'
        ? truncateAttributionPreview(details.initiator, 240)
        : undefined,
    correlationKey: `${details.method ?? 'GET'}:${normalizeUrl(details.url)}`,
    filterTags: buildNetworkFilterTags({
      url: details.url,
      requestBodyPreview,
      transport: 'http',
    }).concat(operationNames),
    source: 'webRequest',
    traceSource: 'webRequest',
  };
}

function registerWebRequestListeners(): void {
  if (webRequestListenersRegistered || !chrome.webRequest) {
    return;
  }
  webRequestListenersRegistered = true;

  chrome.webRequest.onBeforeRequest.addListener(
    (details: any) => {
      if (typeof details.tabId !== 'number' || details.tabId < 0) {
        return;
      }

      const preview = requestBodyToPreview(details.requestBody);
      const operationNames = extractOperationNames(preview);
      updateNetworkSnapshot(details.tabId, operationNames, normalizeUrl(details.url));
      void maybeHandleWatchOperations(details.tabId, operationNames, details.url);

      if (
        inspectorState.attached &&
        inspectorState.attachedTabId === details.tabId &&
        inspectorState.networkActive
      ) {
        pendingNetworkRequests.set(details.requestId, {
          event: createObservedNetworkEvent(details, preview, operationNames),
          operationNames,
        });
      }
    },
    { urls: ['https://api.proof.com/*'] },
    ['requestBody']
  );

  chrome.webRequest.onCompleted.addListener(
    (details: any) => {
      const pending = pendingNetworkRequests.get(details.requestId);
      if (!pending) {
        return;
      }
      pendingNetworkRequests.delete(details.requestId);
      bufferInspectorNetworkEvents([
        {
          ...pending.event,
          status: details.statusCode,
          recordedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          responseHeaders: headersToRecord(details.responseHeaders),
        },
      ]);
    },
    { urls: ['https://api.proof.com/*'] },
    ['responseHeaders']
  );

  chrome.webRequest.onErrorOccurred.addListener(
    (details: any) => {
      const pending = pendingNetworkRequests.get(details.requestId);
      if (!pending) {
        return;
      }
      pendingNetworkRequests.delete(details.requestId);
      bufferInspectorNetworkEvents([
        {
          ...pending.event,
          status: 0,
          responseBodyPreview: truncateAttributionPreview(
            String(details.error ?? 'request_error'),
            160
          ),
          recordedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        },
      ]);
    },
    { urls: ['https://api.proof.com/*'] }
  );
}

async function openQueue(): Promise<BrowserTab> {
  const existing = await getProofTab();
  if (existing?.id) {
    await focusTab(existing.id);
    if (settings.platform.queueUrl && existing.url !== settings.platform.queueUrl) {
      await chrome.tabs.update(existing.id, { url: settings.platform.queueUrl });
    }
    return existing;
  }

  return chrome.tabs.create({
    url: settings.platform.queueUrl ?? settings.platform.dashboardUrl,
    active: true,
  });
}

function ensureSidePanelBehavior(): void {
  if (chrome.sidePanel?.setPanelBehavior) {
    void chrome.sidePanel.setPanelBehavior({
      openPanelOnActionClick: true,
    });
  }
}

function registerRuntimeListeners(): void {
  if (runtimeListenersRegistered) {
    return;
  }
  runtimeListenersRegistered = true;

  chrome.runtime.onMessage.addListener((message: any, sender: any, sendResponse: any) => {
    void handleRuntimeMessage(message, sender)
      .then(response => sendResponse(response))
      .catch(error =>
        sendResponse({
          ok: false,
          error: getErrorMessage(error),
        })
      );
    return true;
  });

  chrome.tabs?.onRemoved?.addListener((tabId: number) => {
    if (watchState.tabId === tabId && watchState.status === 'watching') {
      void pauseWatch('tab_unavailable', 'The watched Proof tab was closed.');
    }
    if (inspectorState.attachedTabId === tabId) {
      void detachInspector();
    }
  });

  chrome.windows?.onRemoved?.addListener((windowId: number) => {
    if (inspectorState.popoutWindowId === windowId) {
      inspectorState = {
        ...inspectorState,
        popoutWindowId: undefined,
      };
      queueStateBroadcast();
    }
  });
}

async function initialize(): Promise<void> {
  if (initialized) {
    return;
  }
  if (initPromise) {
    return initPromise;
  }

  initPromise = (async () => {
    const localState = await chrome.storage.local.get(SETTINGS_STORAGE_KEY);
    settings = hydrateSettings(localState[SETTINGS_STORAGE_KEY] ?? DEFAULT_SETTINGS);

    const sessionState = await chrome.storage.session.get([
      WATCH_STORAGE_KEY,
      INSPECTOR_STORAGE_KEY,
      RECENT_LOGS_STORAGE_KEY,
    ]);

    watchState = {
      ...createDefaultWatchState(),
      ...(sessionState[WATCH_STORAGE_KEY] ?? {}),
      platform: 'proof',
    };

    const storedInspector = sessionState[
      INSPECTOR_STORAGE_KEY
    ] as InspectorRuntimeState | undefined;
    inspectorState = {
      ...createDefaultInspectorRuntimeState(),
      ...(storedInspector ?? {}),
      filterState: {
        ...createDefaultInspectorRuntimeState().filterState,
        ...(storedInspector?.filterState ?? {}),
      },
    };

    recentLogs = Array.isArray(sessionState[RECENT_LOGS_STORAGE_KEY])
      ? (sessionState[RECENT_LOGS_STORAGE_KEY] as LogEntry[])
      : watchState.runId
        ? await getRunLog(watchState.runId)
        : [];
    recentClaimTrace = watchState.runId
      ? (await getClaimTraceEntries(watchState.runId)).slice(0, 20)
      : [];

    ensureSidePanelBehavior();
    registerRuntimeListeners();
    registerWebRequestListeners();

    initialized = true;
  })();

  return initPromise;
}

async function handleDomWatchEvent(payload: any, sender: any): Promise<void> {
  if (sender.tab?.id !== watchState.tabId) {
    return;
  }

  watchState = {
    ...watchState,
    lastCheckedAt: payload.detectedAt ?? new Date().toISOString(),
    activeSessionDetected: Boolean(payload.activeSessionDetected),
    inQueueDetected: Boolean(payload.inQueueDetected),
    lastOpportunityText:
      typeof payload.buttonText === 'string'
        ? payload.buttonText
        : watchState.lastOpportunityText,
    lastQueueCount:
      typeof payload.buttonCount === 'number'
        ? payload.buttonCount
        : watchState.lastQueueCount,
  };

  bufferMetrics([
    {
      recordedAt: payload.detectedAt ?? new Date().toISOString(),
      runId: watchState.runId,
      sessionId: watchState.sessionId,
      tabId: sender.tab?.id,
      buttonText:
        typeof payload.buttonText === 'string' ? payload.buttonText : undefined,
      buttonCount:
        typeof payload.buttonCount === 'number' ? payload.buttonCount : 0,
      snapshotHtml:
        typeof payload.snapshotHtml === 'string' ? payload.snapshotHtml : undefined,
      reasonCode:
        typeof payload.reasonCode === 'string' ? payload.reasonCode : undefined,
      candidateSelector:
        typeof payload.candidateSelector === 'string'
          ? payload.candidateSelector
          : undefined,
    },
  ]);

  const reasonCode = String(payload.reasonCode ?? 'change_detected');
  switch (reasonCode) {
    case 'no_data':
      watchState = {
        ...watchState,
        lastResult: 'Proof queue is currently empty.',
      };
      break;

    case 'candidate_detected':
      watchState = {
        ...watchState,
        lastResult: settings.watch.autoClaimEnabled
          ? 'Claimable Proof request detected.'
          : 'Claimable Proof request detected. Auto-claim is off.',
      };
      if (settings.watch.highlightEnabled) {
        await sendTabMessage(watchState.tabId, {
          type: MESSAGE_TYPES.HIGHLIGHT_WATCH,
          payload: {
            containerSelector: getWatchPayload().containerSelector,
            targetSelector:
              typeof payload.candidateSelector === 'string'
                ? payload.candidateSelector
                : getWatchPayload().buttonSelector,
            durationMs: 1800,
          },
        });
      }
      break;

    case 'claim_success':
      watchState = {
        ...watchState,
        lastResult: 'Claim attempt sent. Verifying Proof session.',
      };
      awaitingClaimConfirmation = true;
      scheduleClaimConfirmationTimeout();
      await focusTab(watchState.tabId);
      pushLog('info', 'Proof claim attempt sent', {
        buttonText: payload.buttonText,
        candidateSelector: payload.candidateSelector,
      });
      break;

    case 'claim_failed':
      watchState = {
        ...watchState,
        lastResult: 'Claim attempt failed.',
      };
      pushLog('warn', 'Proof claim attempt failed', {
        buttonText: payload.buttonText,
        candidateSelector: payload.candidateSelector,
      });
      break;

    case 'container_lost':
      watchState = {
        ...watchState,
        lastResult: 'Proof queue container temporarily unavailable.',
      };
      break;

    case 'cooldown_active':
      watchState = {
        ...watchState,
        lastResult: 'Claim cooldown is active.',
      };
      break;

    default:
      break;
  }

  if (payload.activeSessionDetected || payload.pauseReason === 'active_session') {
    // Suppress confirmActiveSession during the grace window after startWatch to
    // avoid phantom pauses caused by stale network-operation names or transient
    // page state immediately after rearming the watcher.
    const inGracePeriod =
      watchStartedAt !== null &&
      Date.now() - watchStartedAt < WATCH_START_GRACE_PERIOD_MS;
    if (!inGracePeriod) {
      await confirmActiveSession('dom');
    }
  }

  queueStateBroadcast();
}

async function handleRuntimeMessage(message: any, sender: any): Promise<any> {
  await initialize();

  switch (message?.type) {
    case MESSAGE_TYPES.GET_STATE:
      return {
        ok: true,
        state: buildAppState(),
      };

    case MESSAGE_TYPES.GET_INSPECTOR_DATA:
      return {
        ok: true,
        bundle: await getInspectorData(),
      };

    case MESSAGE_TYPES.UPDATE_SETTINGS: {
      const nextSettings = await updateSettings(
        (message.settings ?? {}) as Partial<NotarySettings>
      );
      return {
        ok: true,
        settings: nextSettings,
        state: buildAppState(),
      };
    }

    case MESSAGE_TYPES.OPEN_QUEUE: {
      const tab = await openQueue();
      return {
        ok: true,
        tabId: tab.id,
      };
    }

    case MESSAGE_TYPES.START_WATCH:
      return {
        ok: true,
        watch: await startWatch(message.tabId),
      };

    case MESSAGE_TYPES.STOP_WATCH:
      return {
        ok: true,
        watch: await stopWatch(),
      };

    case MESSAGE_TYPES.PAUSE_WATCH:
      return {
        ok: true,
        watch: await pauseWatch(
          'operator_pause',
          'Watch paused by the operator.'
        ),
      };

    case MESSAGE_TYPES.RESUME_WATCH:
      return {
        ok: true,
        watch: await resumeWatch(),
      };

    case MESSAGE_TYPES.ATTACH_INSPECTOR:
      return {
        ok: true,
        inspector: await attachInspector(message.tabId),
      };

    case MESSAGE_TYPES.DETACH_INSPECTOR:
      return {
        ok: true,
        inspector: await detachInspector(),
      };

    case MESSAGE_TYPES.INSPECTOR_ACTIVE_PANE_SET:
      inspectorState = {
        ...inspectorState,
        activePane:
          message.pane === 'network' || message.pane === 'interactions'
            ? message.pane
            : 'dom',
      };
      settings = mergeSettings({
        ui: {
          ...settings.ui,
          lastPane: inspectorState.activePane,
        },
      });
      await persistSettings();
      queueStateBroadcast();
      return { ok: true, inspector: inspectorState };

    case MESSAGE_TYPES.INSPECTOR_FILTERS_UPDATE:
      inspectorState = {
        ...inspectorState,
        filterState: {
          ...inspectorState.filterState,
          ...(message.filters as Partial<InspectorFilterState>),
        },
      };
      queueStateBroadcast();
      return { ok: true, inspector: inspectorState };

    case MESSAGE_TYPES.INSPECTOR_OPEN_POPOUT: {
      const windowRef = await chrome.windows.create({
        url: chrome.runtime.getURL('inspector-window/index.html'),
        type: 'popup',
        width: 1280,
        height: 860,
      });
      inspectorState = {
        ...inspectorState,
        popoutWindowId: windowRef.id,
      };
      queueStateBroadcast();
      return { ok: true, windowId: windowRef.id };
    }

    case MESSAGE_TYPES.WATCH_LOG_EXPORT:
      return {
        ok: true,
        bundle: await exportWatchLogs(),
      };

    case MESSAGE_TYPES.CLEAR_LOGS:
      await clearLogs();
      return { ok: true };

    case MESSAGE_TYPES.RESET_STATE:
      await resetState();
      return { ok: true, state: buildAppState() };

    case MESSAGE_TYPES.TEST_SOUND: {
      const tab = await getProofTab(message.tabId ?? watchState.tabId);
      await sendTabMessage(tab?.id, {
        type: MESSAGE_TYPES.TEST_SOUND,
        payload: {
          repeat: settings.watch.notificationRepeats,
        },
      });
      return { ok: true };
    }

    case MESSAGE_TYPES.TEST_NOTIFICATION: {
      const tab = await getProofTab(message.tabId ?? watchState.tabId);
      await sendTabMessage(tab?.id, {
        type: MESSAGE_TYPES.TEST_NOTIFICATION,
        payload: {
          message: 'Proof notification test',
        },
      });
      return { ok: true };
    }

    case MESSAGE_TYPES.CONTENT_READY:
      if (sender.tab?.id === watchState.tabId && watchState.status === 'watching') {
        await syncWatchToContent();
      }
      if (sender.tab?.id === inspectorState.attachedTabId && inspectorState.attached) {
        await syncInspectorToContent();
      }
      return { ok: true };

    case MESSAGE_TYPES.DOM_WATCH_EVENT:
      await handleDomWatchEvent(message.payload ?? {}, sender);
      return { ok: true };

    case MESSAGE_TYPES.WATCH_CLAIM_ATTEMPT:
      if (sender.tab?.id === watchState.tabId && message.payload?.success) {
        watchState = {
          ...watchState,
          lastClaimStrategy: message.payload.strategy,
        };
        queueStateBroadcast();
      }
      return { ok: true };

    case MESSAGE_TYPES.CLAIM_TRACE_EVENT:
      if (sender.tab?.id === watchState.tabId && message.payload) {
        await recordClaimTrace(message.payload as ClaimAttemptTrace);
      }
      return { ok: true };

    case MESSAGE_TYPES.CLAIM_INVOCATION_EVENT:
      if (
        sender.tab?.id === watchState.tabId &&
        message.payload &&
        lastClickSentTrace &&
        settings.watch.claimInvocationDiagnosticsEnabled
      ) {
        await recordClaimTrace({
          ...lastClickSentTrace,
          traceId: createId('claim-trace'),
          recordedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          decision: 'invocation_observed',
          requestObserved: true,
          responseStatus:
            typeof message.payload.status === 'number'
              ? message.payload.status
              : undefined,
          latencyMs:
            typeof message.payload.latencyMs === 'number'
              ? message.payload.latencyMs
              : undefined,
          detail:
            typeof message.payload.url === 'string'
              ? message.payload.url
              : undefined,
        });
      }
      return { ok: true };

    case MESSAGE_TYPES.WATCH_SESSION_HEARTBEAT:
      if (sender.tab?.id === watchState.tabId) {
        watchState = {
          ...watchState,
          heartbeatAt:
            message.payload?.heartbeatAt ?? new Date().toISOString(),
        };
        queueStateBroadcast();
      }
      return { ok: true };

    case MESSAGE_TYPES.WATCH_DOM_DELTA:
      if (sender.tab?.id === watchState.tabId && Array.isArray(message.payload)) {
        bufferDomDelta(message.payload as DomDeltaEntry[]);
      }
      return { ok: true };

    case MESSAGE_TYPES.INSPECTOR_DOM_EVENT:
      if (
        sender.tab?.id === inspectorState.attachedTabId &&
        inspectorState.attached
      ) {
        bufferInspectorDomEvents([message.payload as ObservedDomEvent]);
      }
      return { ok: true };

    case MESSAGE_TYPES.INSPECTOR_INTERACTION_EVENT:
      if (
        sender.tab?.id === inspectorState.attachedTabId &&
        inspectorState.attached
      ) {
        bufferInspectorInteractionEvents([
          message.payload as ObservedInteractionEvent,
        ]);
      }
      return { ok: true };

    default:
      return {
        ok: false,
        error: `Unhandled message type: ${String(message?.type)}`,
      };
  }
}

void initialize();

import React from 'react';
import { BatchControls } from '@chrome-ext/ui-shared-components';
import type { NotaryAppState } from '../../types/notary.js';
import { MESSAGE_TYPES } from '../../constants.js';

interface HomeTabProps {
  state: NotaryAppState | null;
  onAction: (type: string, payload?: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
  actionLocked: boolean;
  onInterrupt: () => void;
  onExportLogs: () => void;
}

export function HomeTab({
  state,
  onAction,
  actionLocked,
  onInterrupt,
  onExportLogs,
}: HomeTabProps) {
  if (!state) {
    return <div className="notary-card">Loading state...</div>;
  }

  const isWatching = state.watch.status === 'watching';
  const statusClass =
    state.watch.status === 'watching'
      ? 'active'
      : state.watch.status === 'error'
        ? 'error'
        : '';
  const logs = state.logs ?? [];
  const visibleLogs = logs.slice(0, 15);

              onAction(MESSAGE_TYPES.START_WATCH, {

        <p className="notary-muted">
          Interactions: {state.inspector.interactionEventCount}
        </p>
      </div>

      <div className="notary-card">
        <h3>Open Calls Snapshot</h3>
        <div className="notary-muted">
          {state.watch.lastOpenCalls && state.watch.lastOpenCalls.length > 0
            ? state.watch.lastOpenCalls.join(', ')
            : 'No open calls captured yet.'}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="notary-card">
        <div className="notary-log-header">
          <h3>Recent Activity</h3>
          <div className="notary-actions">
            <button
              className="notary-button ghost small"
              disabled={actionLocked}
              onClick={onExportLogs}
            >
              Export Logs
            </button>
            <button
              className="notary-button ghost small"
              disabled={actionLocked}
              onClick={() => onAction(MESSAGE_TYPES.CLEAR_LOGS)}
            >
              Clear Logs
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
        {visibleLogs.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="notary-muted">No logs yet.</div>
        ) : (
          <div className="notary-log-list">
            {visibleLogs.map((entry, index) => (
              <div key={`${entry.timestamp}-${index}`} className={`notary-log-item ${entry.level}`}>
                <div className="notary-log-line">
                  <span className="notary-log-time">{formatTime(entry.timestamp)}</span>
                  <span className="notary-log-level">{entry.level}</span>
                  <span className="notary-log-message">{entry.message}</span>
                </div>
                {entry.data && (
                  <pre className="notary-log-data">
                    {JSON.stringify(entry.data, null, 2)}
                  </pre>
                )}
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React from 'react';

import { MESSAGE_TYPES } from '../../constants.js';
import type {
  InspectorFilterState,
  InspectorPane,
  NotaryAppState,
  NotarySettings,
} from '../../types/notary.js';
import type { InspectorExportBundle } from '../../inspector/types.js';

const EMPTY_BUNDLE: InspectorExportBundle = {
  domEvents: [],
  networkEvents: [],
  interactionEvents: [],
  socketEvents: [],
  signatures: [],
};

const EMPTY_FILTERS: InspectorFilterState = {
  domSearch: '',
  domMutationType: '',
  networkSearch: '',
  networkMethod: '',
  networkStatus: '',
  networkTraceSource: '',
  networkErrorsOnly: false,
  networkCookiesOnly: false,
  networkGraphqlOnly: false,
  networkHasStacksOnly: false,
  networkWebsocketOnly: false,
  interactionSearch: '',
  socketSearch: '',
};

interface InspectorTabProps {
  state: NotaryAppState | null;
  onAction: (type: string, payload?: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
  onUpdateSettings: (settings: Partial<NotarySettings>) => void;
  actionLocked: boolean;
  popoutMode?: boolean;
}

function normalize(value: string | undefined): string {
  return (value ?? '').toLowerCase();
}

function formatPreview(value: unknown): string {
  if (value == null) return '';
  if (typeof value === 'string') return value;
  try {
    return JSON.stringify(value, null, 2);
  } catch {
    return String(value);
  }
}

function matchesDomFilters(
  event: InspectorExportBundle['domEvents'][number],
  filters: InspectorFilterState
): boolean {
  const query = normalize(filters.domSearch);
  const mutationMatch =
    !filters.domMutationType || event.mutationType === filters.domMutationType;
  const text = `${event.selectorFingerprint} ${event.textPreview ?? ''} ${
    event.containerKey ?? ''
  }`.toLowerCase();
  return mutationMatch && (!query || text.includes(query));
}

function matchesNetworkFilters(
  event: InspectorExportBundle['networkEvents'][number],
  filters: InspectorFilterState
): boolean {
  const query = normalize(filters.networkSearch);
  const status = filters.networkStatus.trim();
  const method = filters.networkMethod.trim().toUpperCase();
  const searchTarget = `${event.url} ${event.correlationKey} ${
    event.initiator ?? ''
  } ${event.filterTags?.join(' ') ?? ''}`.toLowerCase();

  if (query && !searchTarget.includes(query)) return false;
  if (method && (event.method ?? '').toUpperCase() !== method) return false;
  if (status && String(event.status ?? '') !== status) return false;
  if (
    filters.networkTraceSource &&
    (event.traceSource ?? event.source) !== filters.networkTraceSource
  ) {
    return false;
  }
  if (filters.networkErrorsOnly && (event.status ?? 200) < 400 && event.status !== 0) {
    return false;
  }
  if (
    filters.networkCookiesOnly &&
    !event.hasCookieHeader &&
    !(event.cookieNamesObserved?.length ?? 0)
  ) {
    return false;
  }
  if (
    filters.networkGraphqlOnly &&
    !normalize(event.url).includes('graphql') &&
    !(event.filterTags ?? []).includes('graphql')
  ) {
    return false;
  }
  if (
    filters.networkWebsocketOnly &&
    event.transport !== 'websocket' &&
    !(event.filterTags ?? []).includes('websocket')
  ) {
    return false;
  }
  if (
    filters.networkHasStacksOnly &&
    !event.initiatorStack &&
    !event.responseHandlerStack
  ) {
    return false;
  }

  return true;
}

function matchesInteractionFilters(
  event: InspectorExportBundle['interactionEvents'][number],
  filters: InspectorFilterState
): boolean {
  const query = normalize(filters.interactionSearch);
  if (!query) return true;
  return normalize(
    `${event.selectorFingerprint} ${event.tag ?? ''} ${event.text ?? ''}`
  ).includes(query);
}

function matchesSocketFilters(
  event: InspectorExportBundle['socketEvents'][number],
  filters: InspectorFilterState
): boolean {
  const query = normalize(filters.socketSearch);
  if (!query) return true;
  return normalize(
    `${event.eventName ?? ''} ${event.payloadPreview ?? ''} ${
      event.sessionId ?? ''
    } ${event.direction} ${event.transport}`
  ).includes(query);
}

function renderStack(value: string | undefined, unavailableLabel: string): string {
  return value?.trim() ? value : unavailableLabel;
}

export function InspectorTab({

      });

        setBundle(response.bundle as InspectorExportBundle);
      }

      // Service worker not yet ready
    }
  }, []);

  React.useEffect(() => {

                        <pre className="notary-log-data">
                          {renderStack(
                            event.responseHandlerStack,
                            'Response stack unavailable for this request.'
                          )}
                        </pre>
                      </>
                    )}
                  </article>
                ))
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {activePane === 'interactions' && (
          <div className="notary-grid" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
            <div>
              <label className="notary-muted">Search</label>
              <input
                className="notary-input"
                value={filters.interactionSearch}
                onChange={event =>
                  updateFilters({ interactionSearch: event.target.value })
                }
              />
            </div>
            <div className="notary-event-list">
              {filteredInteractionEvents.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="notary-muted">
                  No interaction events match the current filters.
                </div>
              ) : (
                filteredInteractionEvents.slice(0, 120).map(event => (
                  <article key={event.eventId} className="notary-event-card">
                    <div className="notary-event-meta">
                      <span>{event.tag || 'unknown'}</span>
                      <span>{event.recordedAt}</span>
                    </div>
                    <strong>{event.selectorFingerprint}</strong>
                    {event.text ? <p className="notary-muted">{event.text}</p> : null}
                    <pre className="notary-log-data">
                      {formatPreview(event.pointerSequenceSummary)}
                    </pre>
                  </article>
                ))
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {activePane === 'socket' && (
          <div className="notary-grid" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>

              <div className="notary-muted">
                Socket monitoring is available only for Blue Notary workspaces.
              </div>
            ) : (
              <>
                <div className="notary-row">
                  <div>
                    <label className="notary-muted">Socket Mode</label>
                    <select
                      className="notary-input"
                      value={socketMonitor?.mode ?? 'observe-only'}
                      onChange={event =>
                        onAction(MESSAGE_TYPES.SOCKET_MONITOR_MODE_SET, {
                          mode: event.target.value,
                          autoClaimEnabled:
                            event.target.value === 'opt-in-auto-claim',
                          activeSessionPollingEnabled:
                            event.target.value !== 'observe-only',
                        })
                      }
                    >
                      <option value="observe-only">Observe Only</option>
                      <option value="observe-active-session">
                        Observe + Active Session
                      </option>
                      <option value="observe-api-eligibility">
                        Observe + API Eligibility
                      </option>
                      <option value="opt-in-auto-claim">Opt-in Auto Claim</option>
                    </select>
                  </div>

                        updateFilters({ socketSearch: event.target.value })

                    />
                  </div>

                    className="notary-button"

                    onClick={() => onAction(MESSAGE_TYPES.SOCKET_MONITOR_START)}

                    onClick={() => onAction(MESSAGE_TYPES.SOCKET_MONITOR_STOP)}
                  >
                    Stop Socket Monitor
                  </button>
                  <button
                    className="notary-button ghost"
                    disabled={actionLocked || !inspector.socketActive}
                    onClick={() => onAction(MESSAGE_TYPES.SOCKET_MONITOR_API_CLAIM)}
                  >
                    Manual API Claim Assist
                  </button>
                </div>
                <p className="notary-muted">
                  Mode: {socketMonitor?.mode ?? 'observe-only'} | Auto claim:{' '}
                  {socketMonitor?.autoClaimEnabled ? 'enabled' : 'disabled'} |
                  Active-session polling:{' '}
                  {socketMonitor?.activeSessionPollingEnabled
                    ? 'enabled'
                    : 'disabled'}
                </p>
              </>
            )}
            <div className="notary-event-list">
              {filteredSocketEvents.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="notary-muted">
                  No socket events captured for the current session.
                </div>
              ) : (
                filteredSocketEvents.slice(0, 120).map(event => (
                  <article key={event.eventId} className="notary-event-card">
                    <div className="notary-event-meta">
                      <span>
                        {event.transport} {event.direction}
                      </span>
                      <span>{event.recordedAt}</span>
                    </div>
                    <strong>{event.eventName || 'socket event'}</strong>
                    <p className="notary-muted">
                      {event.activeSessionSignal ? 'Active session signal' : 'No active signal'}
                      {' | '}
                      {event.claimEligibilitySignal
                        ? 'Claim eligible'
                        : 'No claim eligibility'}
                    </p>
                    {event.payloadPreview && (
                      <pre className="notary-log-data">{event.payloadPreview}</pre>
                    )}
                  </article>
                ))
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );

==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/apps/chrome-extensions/proof-extension/src/sidepanel/components/SettingsTab.tsx ====
import React from 'react';
import type { NotaryAppState, NotarySettings } from '../../types/notary.js';
import { MESSAGE_TYPES } from '../../constants.js';
import { getCredentials, saveCredentials } from '../../utils/credential-storage.js';
import type { PlatformId } from '../../platforms/types.js';

interface SettingsTabProps {
  state: NotaryAppState | null;
  onUpdateSettings: (settings: Partial<NotarySettings>) => void;
  featureFlags: Record<string, unknown>;
  onToggleFlag: (flag: string) => void;
}

export function SettingsTab({ state, onUpdateSettings, featureFlags, onToggleFlag }: SettingsTabProps) {
  const settings = state?.settings;
  const [selectedPlatform, setSelectedPlatform] = React.useState<PlatformId>(
    settings?.activePlatform ?? 'blue-notary'
  );
  const [username, setUsername] = React.useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = React.useState('');
  const [credentialsLoaded, setCredentialsLoaded] = React.useState(false);
  const [emailInput, setEmailInput] = React.useState('');
  const [passwordInput, setPasswordInput] = React.useState('');
  const [submitButton, setSubmitButton] = React.useState('');
  const [dashboardReady, setDashboardReady] = React.useState('');

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!settings) return;
    setSelectedPlatform(settings.activePlatform);
  }, [settings?.activePlatform]);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    async function loadPlatformCredentials() {
      try {
        const creds = await getCredentials(selectedPlatform);
        setUsername(creds?.username ?? '');
        setPassword(creds?.password ?? '');
      } catch {
        setUsername('');
        setPassword('');
      } finally {
        setCredentialsLoaded(true);
      }
    }
    void loadPlatformCredentials();
  }, [selectedPlatform]);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!settings || !credentialsLoaded) return;
    const platformSettings = settings.platforms[selectedPlatform];
    setEmailInput(platformSettings.selectors.emailInput);
    setPasswordInput(platformSettings.selectors.passwordInput);
    setSubmitButton(platformSettings.selectors.submitButton);
    setDashboardReady(platformSettings.selectors.dashboardReady);
  }, [settings, selectedPlatform, credentialsLoaded]);

  return (
    <div className="notary-grid">
      <div className="notary-card">
        <h3>Platform</h3>
        <select
          className="notary-input"
          value={selectedPlatform}
          onChange={event => setSelectedPlatform(event.target.value as PlatformId)}
        >
          <option value="blue-notary">Blue Notary</option>
          <option value="proof">Proof</option>
        </select>
        <div className="notary-actions" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
          <button
            className="notary-button ghost"
            onClick={() => onUpdateSettings({ activePlatform: selectedPlatform })}
          >
            Set Active Platform
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="notary-card">
        <h3>Credentials</h3>
        <div className="notary-grid">
          <input
            className="notary-input"
            placeholder="Email / Username"
            value={username}
            onChange={event => setUsername(event.target.value)}
          />
          <input
            className="notary-input"
            placeholder="Password"
            type="password"
            value={password}
            onChange={event => setPassword(event.target.value)}
          />
        </div>
        <div className="notary-actions" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
          <button
            className="notary-button"
            onClick={async () => {
              try {
                await saveCredentials({ username, password }, selectedPlatform);
                alert(`Credentials saved securely for ${selectedPlatform}`);
              } catch (error) {
                alert(`Failed to save credentials: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}`);
              }
            }}
          >
            Save Credentials
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="notary-card">
        <h3>Login Selectors</h3>
        <div className="notary-grid">
          <input
            className="notary-input"
            placeholder="Email Input Selector"
            value={emailInput}
            onChange={event => setEmailInput(event.target.value)}
          />
          <input
            className="notary-input"
            placeholder="Password Input Selector"
            value={passwordInput}
            onChange={event => setPasswordInput(event.target.value)}
          />
          <input
            className="notary-input"
            placeholder="Submit Button Selector"
            value={submitButton}
            onChange={event => setSubmitButton(event.target.value)}
          />
          <input
            className="notary-input"
            placeholder="Dashboard Ready Selector"
            value={dashboardReady}
            onChange={event => setDashboardReady(event.target.value)}
          />
        </div>
        <div className="notary-actions" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
          <button
            className="notary-button"
            onClick={() =>
              onUpdateSettings({
                activePlatform: selectedPlatform,
                platforms: {
                  [selectedPlatform]: {
                    ...settings?.platforms[selectedPlatform],
                    selectors: {
                      ...settings?.platforms[selectedPlatform].selectors,
                      emailInput,
                      passwordInput,
                      submitButton,
                      dashboardReady,
                    },
                  },
                } as any,
              })
            }
          >
            Save Login Selectors
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="notary-card">
        <h3>Feature Flags</h3>
        <div className="notary-grid">
          {Object.entries(featureFlags).map(([flag, value]) => (
            <label key={flag} className="notary-muted">
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                checked={Boolean(value)}
                onChange={() => onToggleFlag(flag)}
              />{' '}
              {flag}
            </label>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="notary-card">
        <h3>Cache Management</h3>
        <p style={{ fontSize: '14px', color: '#666', marginBottom: '16px' }}>
          Clear extension cache and reset state. This can help free up memory and resolve issues with stale data.
        </p>
        <div className="notary-actions" style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '12px' }}>
          <button
            className="notary-button"
            onClick={async () => {
              if (
                !confirm(
                  'Stop all running operations and reset the UI? This will stop the watch, clear logs, and reset recording state. This action cannot be undone.'
                )
              ) {
                return;
              }

              try {
                const response = await chrome.runtime.sendMessage({ type: MESSAGE_TYPES.RESET_STATE });
                if (response?.ok) {
                  alert('State reset successfully. Reloading the side panel.');
                  window.location.reload();
                } else {
                  throw new Error(response?.error || 'Failed to reset state');
                }
              } catch (error) {
                alert(`Failed to reset state: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}`);
              }
            }}
            style={{
              background: '#f59e0b',
              color: '#111827',
              minHeight: '48px',
            }}
          >
            Reset State & Reload UI
          </button>
          <button
            className="notary-button"
            onClick={async () => {
              if (
                !confirm(
                  'Are you sure you want to clear all extension cache? This will clear all log files and recording data. Settings will be preserved. This action cannot be undone.'
                )
              ) {
                return;
              }

              try {
                const response = await chrome.runtime.sendMessage({ type: MESSAGE_TYPES.CLEAR_CACHE });
                if (response?.ok) {
                  alert('Extension cache cleared successfully.');
                } else {
                  throw new Error(response?.error || 'Failed to clear cache');
                }
              } catch (error) {
                alert(`Failed to clear cache: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}`);
              }
            }}
            style={{
              background: '#ef4444',
              color: '#ffffff',
              minHeight: '48px',
            }}
          >
            Clear Extension Cache
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React from 'react';
import { MESSAGE_TYPES } from '../../constants.js';
import type { NotaryAppState } from '../../types/notary.js';

interface TestTabProps {
  state: NotaryAppState | null;
  onAction: (type: string, payload?: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
  actionLocked: boolean;
  featureFlags: Record<string, unknown>;
}

interface TestResult {
  timestamp: string;
  test: string;
  status: 'success' | 'error' | 'warning';
  message: string;
  details?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

export function TestTab({ state, onAction, actionLocked, featureFlags }: TestTabProps) {
  const [testResults, setTestResults] = React.useState<TestResult[]>([]);
  const [selectorInput, setSelectorInput] = React.useState('button');
  const [selectedRecipe, setSelectedRecipe] = React.useState<string>('blue-notary:sign-in');
  const [expandedResults, setExpandedResults] = React.useState<Set<number>>(new Set());
  const cursorSimulationEnabled = Boolean(featureFlags['devtools:cursor-simulation']);

  const addTestResult = (test: string, status: TestResult['status'], message: string, details?: Record<string, unknown>) => {
    const result: TestResult = {
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      test,
      status,
      message,
      details,
    };
    setTestResults(prev => [result, ...prev].slice(0, 50)); // Keep last 50 results
  };

  const handleTestSound = async () => {
    try {
      await onAction(MESSAGE_TYPES.TEST_SOUND, { repeat: state?.settings.notificationRepeats || 1 });
      addTestResult('Test Sound', 'success', 'Audio notification triggered successfully');
    } catch (error) {
      addTestResult('Test Sound', 'error', `Failed: ${String(error)}`);
    }
  };

  const handleTestNotification = async () => {
    try {
      await onAction(MESSAGE_TYPES.TEST_NOTIFICATION);
      addTestResult('Test Notification', 'success', 'Visual notification triggered successfully');
    } catch (error) {
      addTestResult('Test Notification', 'error', `Failed: ${String(error)}`);
    }
  };

  const handleTestSelector = async () => {
    if (!selectorInput.trim()) {
      addTestResult('Test Selector', 'warning', 'Please enter a CSS selector');
      return;
    }
    try {
      const response = await chrome.runtime.sendMessage({
        type: MESSAGE_TYPES.TEST_SELECTOR,
        selector: selectorInput,
      });
      if (response?.ok) {
        addTestResult(
          'Test Selector',
          response.count > 0 ? 'success' : 'warning',
          `Found ${response.count} element(s) matching "${selectorInput}"`,
          { count: response.count, selector: selectorInput }
        );
      } else {
        addTestResult('Test Selector', 'error', response?.error || 'Test failed');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      addTestResult('Test Selector', 'error', `Failed: ${String(error)}`);
    }
  };

  const handleTestButtonClick = async () => {
    try {
      const response = await chrome.runtime.sendMessage({
        type: MESSAGE_TYPES.TEST_BUTTON_CLICK,
      });
      if (response?.ok) {
        addTestResult('Test Button Click', 'success', response.message || 'Button click sequence completed');
      } else {
        addTestResult('Test Button Click', 'error', response?.error || 'Test failed');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      addTestResult('Test Button Click', 'error', `Failed: ${String(error)}`);
    }
  };

  const handleCursorSimulation = async () => {
    if (!cursorSimulationEnabled) {
      addTestResult(
        'Simulate Cursor Click',
        'warning',
        'Enable the devtools:cursor-simulation flag in Settings before running this test'
      );
      return;
    }

    const selector = selectorInput.trim() || state?.settings.selectors.openCallsButtons || 'button';
    try {
      const response = await chrome.runtime.sendMessage({
        type: MESSAGE_TYPES.TEST_CURSOR_SIMULATION,
        selector,
      });
      if (response?.ok) {
        addTestResult(
          'Simulate Cursor Click',
          'success',
          response.message || `Cursor simulation completed for "${selector}"`,
          {
            selector,
            result: response.result,
          }
        );
      } else {
        addTestResult(
          'Simulate Cursor Click',
          'error',
          response?.error || 'Cursor simulation failed',
          { selector }
        );
      }
    } catch (error) {
      addTestResult('Simulate Cursor Click', 'error', `Failed: ${String(error)}`, { selector });
    }
  };

  const handleTestFullWorkflow = async () => {
    addTestResult('Test Full Workflow', 'warning', 'Starting full workflow test (this may take 30-60 seconds)...');
    try {
      const response = await chrome.runtime.sendMessage({
        type: MESSAGE_TYPES.TEST_FULL_WORKFLOW,
      });
      if (response?.ok) {
        addTestResult('Test Full Workflow', 'success', response.message || 'Full workflow completed successfully');
      } else {
        addTestResult('Test Full Workflow', 'error', response?.error || 'Workflow test failed');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      addTestResult('Test Full Workflow', 'error', `Failed: ${String(error)}`);
    }
  };

  const handleDebugPageState = async () => {
    try {
      const response = await chrome.runtime.sendMessage({
        type: MESSAGE_TYPES.DEBUG_PAGE_STATE,
      });
      if (response?.ok && response.state) {
        addTestResult(
          'Debug Page State',
          'success',
          `Page: ${response.state.title}`,
          response.state
        );
      } else {
        addTestResult('Debug Page State', 'error', response?.error || 'Failed to get page state');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      addTestResult('Debug Page State', 'error', `Failed: ${String(error)}`);
    }
  };

  const handleDebugSelectors = async () => {
    try {
      const response = await chrome.runtime.sendMessage({
        type: MESSAGE_TYPES.DEBUG_SELECTORS,
      });
      if (response?.ok && response.results) {
        const total = Object.keys(response.results).length;
        const found = Object.values(response.results).filter((r: any) => r.found > 0).length;
        addTestResult(
          'Debug Selectors',
          'success',
          `Tested ${total} selectors, ${found} found elements`,
          response.results
        );
      } else {
        addTestResult('Debug Selectors', 'error', response?.error || 'Failed to test selectors');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      addTestResult('Debug Selectors', 'error', `Failed: ${String(error)}`);
    }
  };

  const handleDebugWatchState = async () => {
    try {
      const response = await chrome.runtime.sendMessage({
        type: MESSAGE_TYPES.DEBUG_WATCH_STATE,
      });
      if (response?.ok && response.state) {
        addTestResult(
          'Debug Watch State',
          'success',
          `Watch status: ${response.state.watchState?.status || 'unknown'}`,
          response.state
        );
      } else {
        addTestResult('Debug Watch State', 'error', response?.error || 'Failed to get watch state');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      addTestResult('Debug Watch State', 'error', `Failed: ${String(error)}`);
    }
  };

  const handleDebugRecipeContext = async () => {
    try {
      const response = await chrome.runtime.sendMessage({
        type: MESSAGE_TYPES.DEBUG_RECIPE_CONTEXT,
      });
      if (response?.ok && response.context) {
        addTestResult(
          'Debug Recipe Context',
          'success',
          `Credentials: ${response.context.hasCredentials ? 'configured' : 'not configured'}`,
          response.context
        );
      } else {
        addTestResult('Debug Recipe Context', 'error', response?.error || 'Failed to get recipe context');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      addTestResult('Debug Recipe Context', 'error', `Failed: ${String(error)}`);
    }
  };

  const handleTestRecipe = async () => {
    const [app, id] = selectedRecipe.split(':');
    if (!app || !id) {
      addTestResult('Test Recipe', 'warning', 'Invalid recipe selection');
      return;
    }
    try {
      const response = await chrome.runtime.sendMessage({
        type: MESSAGE_TYPES.TEST_RECIPE,
        app,
        id,
      });
      if (response?.ok) {
        addTestResult('Test Recipe', 'success', response.message || `Recipe ${selectedRecipe} executed successfully`);
      } else {
        addTestResult('Test Recipe', 'error', response?.message || 'Recipe test failed');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      addTestResult('Test Recipe', 'error', `Failed: ${String(error)}`);
    }
  };

  const toggleResultExpansion = (index: number) => {
    setExpandedResults(prev => {
      const newSet = new Set(prev);
      if (newSet.has(index)) {
        newSet.delete(index);
      } else {
        newSet.add(index);
      }
      return newSet;
    });
  };

  const clearResults = () => {
    setTestResults([]);
    setExpandedResults(new Set());
  };

  return (
    <div className="test-tab" style={{ padding: '16px', maxWidth: '800px' }}>
      <h2 style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>Test Harness</h2>

      {/* In-Page Tests Section */}
      <section style={{ marginBottom: '24px', padding: '16px', border: '1px solid #e0e0e0', borderRadius: '8px' }}>
        <h3 style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>In-Page Tests</h3>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '12px' }}>
          <div>
            <button
              onClick={handleTestSound}
              disabled={actionLocked}
              style={{
                padding: '8px 16px',
