import React from 'react';
import type { NotaryAppState, NotarySettings } from '../../types/notary.js';
import { MESSAGE_TYPES } from '../../constants.js';
import type { PlatformId } from '../../platforms/types.js';

interface WatchTabProps {
  state: NotaryAppState | null;
  onAction: (type: string, payload?: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
  onUpdateSettings: (settings: Partial<NotarySettings>) => void;
  actionLocked: boolean;
}

export function WatchTab({ state, onAction, onUpdateSettings, actionLocked }: WatchTabProps) {
  const current = state?.settings;
  const [activePlatform, setActivePlatform] = React.useState<PlatformId>(
    current?.activePlatform ?? 'blue-notary'
  );
  const [watchIntervalMs, setWatchIntervalMs] = React.useState(
    current?.watchIntervalMs ?? 2000
  );
  const [overlayEnabled, setOverlayEnabled] = React.useState(
    current?.overlayEnabled ?? true
  );
  const [highlightEnabled, setHighlightEnabled] = React.useState(
    current?.highlightEnabled ?? true
  );
  const [audioEnabled, setAudioEnabled] = React.useState(
    current?.audioEnabled ?? true
  );
  const [notificationRepeats, setNotificationRepeats] = React.useState(
    current?.notificationRepeats ?? 5
  );
  const [autoLogin, setAutoLogin] = React.useState(
    current?.autoLogin ?? false
  );
  const [metricsEnabled, setMetricsEnabled] = React.useState(
    current?.metricsEnabled ?? false
  );
  const [governorEnabled, setGovernorEnabled] = React.useState(
    current?.governor.enabled ?? true
  );
  const [globalClaimsPerHour, setGlobalClaimsPerHour] = React.useState(
    current?.governor.globalClaimsPerHour ?? 10
  );
  const [blueClaimsPerHour, setBlueClaimsPerHour] = React.useState(
    current?.governor.platformClaimsPerHour['blue-notary'] ?? 6
  );
  const [proofClaimsPerHour, setProofClaimsPerHour] = React.useState(
    current?.governor.platformClaimsPerHour.proof ?? 6
  );
  const platformSettings = current?.platforms?.[activePlatform];
  const [openCallsSection, setOpenCallsSection] = React.useState(
    platformSettings?.selectors.openCallsSection ?? ''
  );
  const [openCallsButtons, setOpenCallsButtons] = React.useState(
    platformSettings?.selectors.openCallsButtons ?? ''
  );
  const [openCallsNoData, setOpenCallsNoData] = React.useState(
    platformSettings?.selectors.openCallsNoData ?? ''
  );

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!current) return;
    setActivePlatform(current.activePlatform);
    setWatchIntervalMs(current.watchIntervalMs);
    setOverlayEnabled(current.overlayEnabled);
    setHighlightEnabled(current.highlightEnabled);
    setAudioEnabled(current.audioEnabled);
    setNotificationRepeats(current.notificationRepeats ?? 5);
    setAutoLogin(current.autoLogin ?? false);
    setMetricsEnabled(current.metricsEnabled ?? false);
    setGovernorEnabled(current.governor.enabled);
    setGlobalClaimsPerHour(current.governor.globalClaimsPerHour);
    setBlueClaimsPerHour(current.governor.platformClaimsPerHour['blue-notary']);
    setProofClaimsPerHour(current.governor.platformClaimsPerHour.proof);
  }, [current]);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    const nextPlatform = current?.platforms?.[activePlatform];
    setOpenCallsSection(nextPlatform?.selectors.openCallsSection ?? '');
    setOpenCallsButtons(nextPlatform?.selectors.openCallsButtons ?? '');
    setOpenCallsNoData(nextPlatform?.selectors.openCallsNoData ?? '');
  }, [activePlatform, current]);

  const persistWatchToggle = React.useCallback(
    (patch: Partial<NotarySettings>) => {
      onUpdateSettings({
        activePlatform,
        ...patch,
      });
    },
    [activePlatform, onUpdateSettings]
  );

  const persistGovernorSettings = React.useCallback(
    (patch: Partial<NotarySettings['governor']>) => {
      onUpdateSettings({
        governor: {
          enabled: governorEnabled,
          platformClaimsPerHour: {
            'blue-notary': blueClaimsPerHour,
            proof: proofClaimsPerHour,
          },
          globalClaimsPerHour,
          overrideWindowMs:
            current?.governor.overrideWindowMs ?? 15 * 60 * 1000,
          operatorOverride: current?.governor.operatorOverride ?? false,
          ...patch,
        },
      });
    },
    [
      blueClaimsPerHour,
      current?.governor.operatorOverride,
      current?.governor.overrideWindowMs,
      globalClaimsPerHour,
      governorEnabled,
      onUpdateSettings,
      proofClaimsPerHour,
    ]
  );

  return (
    <div className="notary-grid">
      <div className="notary-card">
        <h3>Watch Settings</h3>
        <div className="notary-row">
          <div>
            <label className="notary-muted">Active Platform</label>
            <select
              className="notary-input"
              value={activePlatform}
              onChange={event => {
                const nextPlatform = event.target.value as PlatformId;
                setActivePlatform(nextPlatform);
                onUpdateSettings({ activePlatform: nextPlatform });
              }}
            >
              <option value="blue-notary">Blue Notary</option>
              <option value="proof">Proof</option>
            </select>
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="notary-muted">Interval (ms)</label>
            <input
              className="notary-input"
              type="number"
              value={watchIntervalMs}
              onChange={event => setWatchIntervalMs(Number(event.target.value))}
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="notary-muted">Sound Repeats</label>
            <input
              className="notary-input"
              type="number"
              value={notificationRepeats}
              onChange={event =>
                setNotificationRepeats(Number(event.target.value))
              }
            />
          </div>
          <label className="notary-muted">
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              checked={overlayEnabled}
              onChange={event => {
                setOverlayEnabled(event.target.checked);
                persistWatchToggle({ overlayEnabled: event.target.checked });
              }}
            />{' '}
            Overlay
          </label>
          <label className="notary-muted">
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              checked={highlightEnabled}
              onChange={event => {
                setHighlightEnabled(event.target.checked);
                persistWatchToggle({ highlightEnabled: event.target.checked });
              }}
            />{' '}
            Highlight
          </label>
          <label className="notary-muted">
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              checked={audioEnabled}
              onChange={event => {
                setAudioEnabled(event.target.checked);
                persistWatchToggle({ audioEnabled: event.target.checked });
              }}
            />{' '}
            Audio
          </label>
          <label className="notary-muted">
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              checked={autoLogin}
              onChange={event => {
                setAutoLogin(event.target.checked);
                persistWatchToggle({ autoLogin: event.target.checked });
              }}
            />{' '}
            Auto Login
          </label>
          <label className="notary-muted">
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              checked={metricsEnabled}
              onChange={event => {
                setMetricsEnabled(event.target.checked);
                persistWatchToggle({ metricsEnabled: event.target.checked });
              }}
            />{' '}
            Save Metrics
          </label>
        </div>
        <div className="notary-actions" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
          <button
            className="notary-button"
            disabled={actionLocked}
            onClick={() =>
              onUpdateSettings({
                activePlatform,
                watchIntervalMs,
                overlayEnabled,
                highlightEnabled,
                audioEnabled,
                notificationRepeats,
                autoLogin,
                metricsEnabled,
              })
            }
          >
            Save Watch Settings
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="notary-card">
        <h3>{activePlatform === 'proof' ? 'Proof Queue Selectors' : 'Open Calls Selectors'}</h3>
        <div className="notary-grid">
          <div>

              value={openCallsSection}
              onChange={event => setOpenCallsSection(event.target.value)}
            />
          </div>

            <label className="notary-muted">Button Selector</label>

              onChange={event => setOpenCallsButtons(event.target.value)}
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="notary-muted">No Data Selector</label>
            <input
              className="notary-input"
              value={openCallsNoData}

            />

          <button

import React from 'react';

import { appConfig } from '../config.js';
import { MESSAGE_TYPES } from '../constants.js';
import type {
  InspectorStateBundle,
  NotaryAppState,
  NotarySettings,
  WatchStatus,
} from '../types/notary.js';

type NotaryTab = 'overview' | 'watch' | 'inspector' | 'settings' | 'tests';

interface NotaryAppProps {
  initialTab?: NotaryTab;
  inspectorOnly?: boolean;
}

const EMPTY_INSPECTOR_BUNDLE: InspectorStateBundle = {
  domEvents: [],
  networkEvents: [],
  interactionEvents: [],
  signatures: [],
};

function formatTimestamp(value?: string): string {
  if (!value) {
    return 'Not yet';
  }

  try {
    return new Date(value).toLocaleString();
  } catch {
    return value;
  }
}

function parseKeywords(value: string): string[] {
  return value
    .split('\n')
    .map(item => item.trim())
    .filter(Boolean);
}

function getStatusLabel(status: WatchStatus | undefined): string {
  switch (status) {
    case 'watching':
      return 'Watching';
    case 'paused':
      return 'Paused';
    case 'error':
      return 'Error';
    default:
      return 'Idle';
  }
}

function getStatusDotClass(status: WatchStatus | undefined): string {
  if (status === 'watching') {
    return 'notary-dot active';
  }
  if (status === 'error') {
    return 'notary-dot error';
  }
  return 'notary-dot';
}

export function NotaryApp({
  initialTab = 'overview',
  inspectorOnly = false,
}: NotaryAppProps) {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = React.useState<NotaryTab>(
    inspectorOnly ? 'inspector' : initialTab
  );
  const [appState, setAppState] = React.useState<NotaryAppState | null>(null);
  const [inspectorBundle, setInspectorBundle] =
    React.useState<InspectorStateBundle>(EMPTY_INSPECTOR_BUNDLE);
  const [busy, setBusy] = React.useState(false);
  const [watchForm, setWatchForm] = React.useState({
    openCallsSection: '',
    openCallsNoData: '',
    openCallsButtons: '',
    joinKeywords: '',
    autoClaimEnabled: true,
    claimCooldownMs: 600,
    claimRetryDelaysMs: '50,150,300',
    claimInvocationDiagnosticsEnabled: true,
    claimInvocationTimeoutMs: 1200,
    overlayEnabled: true,
    highlightEnabled: true,
    audioEnabled: true,
    notificationRepeats: 3,
  });
  const [inspectorForm, setInspectorForm] = React.useState({
    selectedRoots: '',
    domEnabled: true,
    networkEnabled: true,
    deepTraceEnabled: false,
    includeCharacterData: false,
    styleDiffEnabled: false,
  });
  const [telemetryForm, setTelemetryForm] = React.useState({
    logFlushIntervalMs: 2000,
    eventFlushIntervalMs: 2000,
    metricFlushIntervalMs: 5000,
    maxBufferedLogs: 200,
    maxBufferedInspectorEvents: 400,
    maxBufferedMetrics: 200,
    maxBufferedDomDeltas: 200,
    preferInspectorPopout: false,
    metricsEnabled: false,
  });

  const refreshState = React.useRef(async () => {
    try {
      const response = await chrome.runtime.sendMessage({
        type: MESSAGE_TYPES.GET_STATE,
      });
      if (response?.ok && response.state) {
        setAppState(response.state as NotaryAppState);
      }
    } catch {
      // Service worker not yet ready — will sync on next STATE_UPDATED
    }
  });

  const refreshInspectorBundle = React.useRef(async () => {
    try {
      const response = await chrome.runtime.sendMessage({
        type: MESSAGE_TYPES.GET_INSPECTOR_DATA,
      });
      if (response?.ok && response.bundle) {
        setInspectorBundle(response.bundle as InspectorStateBundle);
      }
    } catch {
      // Service worker not yet ready
    }
  });

  React.useEffect(() => {
    void refreshState.current();
    void refreshInspectorBundle.current();

    const handleRuntimeMessage = (message: { type?: string; state?: NotaryAppState }) => {
      if (message?.type !== MESSAGE_TYPES.STATE_UPDATED || !message.state) {
        return;
      }
      setAppState(message.state);
      void refreshInspectorBundle.current();
    };

    chrome.runtime.onMessage.addListener(handleRuntimeMessage);
    return () => {
      chrome.runtime.onMessage.removeListener(handleRuntimeMessage);
    };
  }, []);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    const settings = appState?.settings;
    if (!settings) {
      return;
    }

    setWatchForm({
      openCallsSection: settings.platform.selectors.openCallsSection,
      openCallsNoData: settings.platform.selectors.openCallsNoData,
      openCallsButtons: settings.platform.selectors.openCallsButtons,
      joinKeywords: settings.platform.joinKeywords.join('\n'),
      autoClaimEnabled: settings.watch.autoClaimEnabled,
      claimCooldownMs: settings.watch.claimCooldownMs,
      claimRetryDelaysMs: settings.watch.claimRetryDelaysMs.join(','),
      claimInvocationDiagnosticsEnabled:
        settings.watch.claimInvocationDiagnosticsEnabled,
      claimInvocationTimeoutMs: settings.watch.claimInvocationTimeoutMs,
      overlayEnabled: settings.watch.overlayEnabled,
      highlightEnabled: settings.watch.highlightEnabled,
      audioEnabled: settings.watch.audioEnabled,
      notificationRepeats: settings.watch.notificationRepeats,
    });
    setInspectorForm({
      selectedRoots: settings.inspector.selectedRoots.join('\n'),
      domEnabled: settings.inspector.domEnabled,
      networkEnabled: settings.inspector.networkEnabled,
      deepTraceEnabled: settings.inspector.deepTraceEnabled,
      includeCharacterData: settings.inspector.includeCharacterData,
      styleDiffEnabled: settings.inspector.styleDiffEnabled,
    });
    setTelemetryForm({
      logFlushIntervalMs: settings.telemetry.logFlushIntervalMs,
      eventFlushIntervalMs: settings.telemetry.eventFlushIntervalMs,
      metricFlushIntervalMs: settings.telemetry.metricFlushIntervalMs,
      maxBufferedLogs: settings.telemetry.maxBufferedLogs,
      maxBufferedInspectorEvents: settings.telemetry.maxBufferedInspectorEvents,
      maxBufferedMetrics: settings.telemetry.maxBufferedMetrics,
      maxBufferedDomDeltas: settings.telemetry.maxBufferedDomDeltas,
      preferInspectorPopout: settings.ui.preferInspectorPopout,
      metricsEnabled: settings.metricsEnabled,
    });
  }, [appState?.settings]);

  // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
  async function runAction(
    type: string,
    payload?: Record<string, unknown>,
    options: { skipRefresh?: boolean } = {}
  ): Promise<any> {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      let response: unknown;
      try {
        response = await chrome.runtime.sendMessage({
          type,
          ...(payload ?? {}),
        });
      } catch {
        // Service worker unavailable — skip refresh
        return;
      }

      if (!options.skipRefresh) {
        await refreshState.current();
        await refreshInspectorBundle.current();
      }

      return response;
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  async function updateSettings(nextSettings: Partial<NotarySettings>) {
    return runAction(MESSAGE_TYPES.UPDATE_SETTINGS, {
      settings: nextSettings,
    });
  }

  async function exportLogs() {
    const response = await runAction(
      MESSAGE_TYPES.WATCH_LOG_EXPORT,
      undefined,
      { skipRefresh: true }
    );
    if (!response?.ok || !response.bundle) {
      throw new Error(response?.error || 'Unable to export diagnostics.');
    }

    const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(response.bundle, null, 2)], {
      type: 'application/json',
    });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const anchor = document.createElement('a');
    anchor.href = url;
    anchor.download = `proof-extension-export-${Date.now()}.json`;
    anchor.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  }

  async function saveWatchSettings() {
    const currentPlatform = appState?.settings.platform;
    if (!currentPlatform) {
      return;
    }

    await updateSettings({
      platform: {
        ...currentPlatform,
        selectors: {
          ...currentPlatform.selectors,
          openCallsSection: watchForm.openCallsSection,
          openCallsNoData: watchForm.openCallsNoData,
          openCallsButtons: watchForm.openCallsButtons,
        },
        joinKeywords: parseKeywords(watchForm.joinKeywords),
      },
      watch: {
        autoClaimEnabled: watchForm.autoClaimEnabled,
        claimCooldownMs: Number(watchForm.claimCooldownMs),
        claimRetryDelaysMs: watchForm.claimRetryDelaysMs
          .split(',')
          .map(value => Number(value.trim()))
          .filter(value => Number.isFinite(value) && value >= 0),
        claimInvocationDiagnosticsEnabled:
          watchForm.claimInvocationDiagnosticsEnabled,
        claimInvocationTimeoutMs: Number(watchForm.claimInvocationTimeoutMs),
        overlayEnabled: watchForm.overlayEnabled,
        highlightEnabled: watchForm.highlightEnabled,
        audioEnabled: watchForm.audioEnabled,
        notificationRepeats: Number(watchForm.notificationRepeats),
      },
    });
  }

  async function saveInspectorSettings() {
    await updateSettings({
      inspector: {
        domEnabled: inspectorForm.domEnabled,
        networkEnabled: inspectorForm.networkEnabled,
        deepTraceEnabled: inspectorForm.deepTraceEnabled,
        includeCharacterData: inspectorForm.includeCharacterData,
        selectedRoots: parseKeywords(inspectorForm.selectedRoots),
        styleDiffEnabled: inspectorForm.styleDiffEnabled,
      },
    });
  }

  async function saveTelemetrySettings() {
    await updateSettings({
      telemetry: {
        logFlushIntervalMs: Number(telemetryForm.logFlushIntervalMs),
        eventFlushIntervalMs: Number(telemetryForm.eventFlushIntervalMs),
        metricFlushIntervalMs: Number(telemetryForm.metricFlushIntervalMs),
        maxBufferedLogs: Number(telemetryForm.maxBufferedLogs),
        maxBufferedInspectorEvents: Number(telemetryForm.maxBufferedInspectorEvents),
        maxBufferedMetrics: Number(telemetryForm.maxBufferedMetrics),
        maxBufferedDomDeltas: Number(telemetryForm.maxBufferedDomDeltas),
      },
      ui: {
        preferInspectorPopout: telemetryForm.preferInspectorPopout,
        lastPane: appState?.settings.ui.lastPane ?? 'dom',
      },
      metricsEnabled: telemetryForm.metricsEnabled,
    });
  }

  const state = appState;
  const watch = state?.watch;
  const inspector = state?.inspector;
  const claimTrace = state?.claimTrace ?? [];
  const filterState = inspector?.filterState;

  const activePane = inspector?.activePane ?? 'dom';
  const filteredDomEvents = inspectorBundle.domEvents.filter(event => {
    if (!filterState) {
      return true;
    }
    const search = filterState.domSearch.trim().toLowerCase();
    const matchesSearch =
      search.length === 0 ||
      `${event.selectorFingerprint} ${event.textPreview ?? ''}`.toLowerCase().includes(search);
    const matchesMutation =
      !filterState.domMutationType ||
      event.mutationType === filterState.domMutationType;
    return matchesSearch && matchesMutation;
  });
  const filteredNetworkEvents = inspectorBundle.networkEvents.filter(event => {
    if (!filterState) {
      return true;
    }
    const search = filterState.networkSearch.trim().toLowerCase();
    const matchesSearch =
      search.length === 0 ||
      `${event.url} ${event.requestBodyPreview ?? ''}`.toLowerCase().includes(search);
    const matchesMethod =
      !filterState.networkMethod || event.method === filterState.networkMethod;
    const matchesStatus =
      !filterState.networkStatus ||
      String(event.status ?? '') === filterState.networkStatus;
    const matchesGraphql =
      !filterState.networkGraphqlOnly ||
      (event.filterTags ?? []).includes('graphql');
    const matchesStacks =
      !filterState.networkHasStacksOnly ||
      Boolean(event.initiator || event.initiatorStack);
    return (
      matchesSearch &&
      matchesMethod &&
      matchesStatus &&
      matchesGraphql &&
      matchesStacks
    );
  });
  const filteredInteractionEvents = inspectorBundle.interactionEvents.filter(event => {
    if (!filterState) {
      return true;
    }
    const search = filterState.interactionSearch.trim().toLowerCase();
    return (
      search.length === 0 ||
      `${event.selectorFingerprint} ${event.text ?? ''}`.toLowerCase().includes(search)
    );
  });

  const tabs: NotaryTab[] = inspectorOnly
    ? ['inspector']
    : ['overview', 'watch', 'inspector', 'settings', 'tests'];

  return (
    <div className="notary-container" data-testid="proof-app">
        <div className="notary-hero">
          <div>
            <div className="notary-eyebrow">Proof Extension</div>
            <h1 className="notary-title">{appConfig.name}</h1>
            <p className="notary-muted">
              Reactive Proof queue observation, optional inspector attach, and sparse batched telemetry.
            </p>
          </div>
          <div className="notary-status">
            <span className={getStatusDotClass(watch?.status)} />
            <div>
              <div className="notary-status-label" data-testid="watch-status-value">
                {getStatusLabel(watch?.status)}
              </div>
              <div className="notary-muted">
                {watch?.lastResult ?? 'No active watch session.'}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {!inspectorOnly && (
          <div className="notary-tab-row">
            {tabs.map(tab => (
              <button
                key={tab}
                className={`notary-tab-button${activeTab === tab ? ' active' : ''}`}
                onClick={() => setActiveTab(tab)}
                disabled={busy}
              >
                {tab}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}

        {inspectorOnly && (
          <div className="notary-popout-banner">
            Inspector popout bound to the current attached Proof tab session.
          </div>
        )}

        {(activeTab === 'overview' || inspectorOnly) && !inspectorOnly && (
          <>
            <div className="notary-card">
              <div className="notary-workspace-header">
                <div>
                  <h3>Overview</h3>
                  <p className="notary-muted">
                    Watch the active Proof tab without polling and only attach deep inspection when you need it.
                  </p>
                </div>
                <div className="notary-summary-pill">
                  Tab {watch?.tabId ?? 'n/a'}
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="notary-grid notary-grid-2">
                <div className="notary-stat">
                  <span className="notary-stat-label">Last Check</span>
                  <strong>{formatTimestamp(watch?.lastCheckedAt)}</strong>
                </div>
                <div className="notary-stat">
                  <span className="notary-stat-label">Heartbeat</span>
                  <strong>{formatTimestamp(watch?.heartbeatAt)}</strong>
                </div>
                <div className="notary-stat">
                  <span className="notary-stat-label">Last Opportunity</span>
                  <strong>{watch?.lastOpportunityText ?? 'None yet'}</strong>
                </div>
                <div className="notary-stat">
                  <span className="notary-stat-label">Pause Reason</span>
                  <strong>{watch?.pauseReason ?? 'n/a'}</strong>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="notary-actions">
                <button
                  className="notary-button"
                  data-testid="open-queue"
                  disabled={busy}
                  onClick={() => void runAction(MESSAGE_TYPES.OPEN_QUEUE)}
                >
                  Open Proof Queue
                </button>
                <button
                  className="notary-button secondary"
                  data-testid="start-watch"
                  disabled={busy}
                  onClick={() => void runAction(MESSAGE_TYPES.START_WATCH)}
                >
                  Start Watch
                </button>
                <button
                  className="notary-button ghost"
                  data-testid="pause-watch"
                  disabled={busy || watch?.status !== 'watching'}
                  onClick={() => void runAction(MESSAGE_TYPES.PAUSE_WATCH)}
                >
                  Pause
                </button>
                <button
                  className="notary-button ghost"
                  data-testid="resume-watch"
                  disabled={busy || watch?.status !== 'paused'}
                  onClick={() => void runAction(MESSAGE_TYPES.RESUME_WATCH)}
                >
                  Resume
                </button>
                <button
                  className="notary-button ghost"
                  data-testid="stop-watch"
                  disabled={busy}
                  onClick={() => void runAction(MESSAGE_TYPES.STOP_WATCH)}
                >
                  Stop
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="notary-card">
              <div className="notary-workspace-header">
                <div>
                  <h3>Inspector Session</h3>
                  <p className="notary-muted">
                    Manual attach only. The inspector stays off until you bind it to the current Proof tab.
                  </p>
                </div>
                <div className="notary-summary-pill" data-testid="inspector-attached-value">
                  {inspector?.attached ? 'Attached' : 'Detached'}
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="notary-inspector-summary">
                <div className="notary-summary-pill">DOM {inspector?.domEventCount ?? 0}</div>
                <div className="notary-summary-pill">
                  Network {inspector?.networkEventCount ?? 0}
                </div>
                <div className="notary-summary-pill">
                  Interactions {inspector?.interactionEventCount ?? 0}
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="notary-actions">
                <button
                  className="notary-button"
                  data-testid="attach-inspector"
                  disabled={busy}
                  onClick={() => void runAction(MESSAGE_TYPES.ATTACH_INSPECTOR)}
                >
                  Attach Inspector
                </button>
                <button
                  className="notary-button ghost"
                  data-testid="detach-inspector"
                  disabled={busy || !inspector?.attached}
                  onClick={() => void runAction(MESSAGE_TYPES.DETACH_INSPECTOR)}
                >
                  Detach Inspector
                </button>
                <button
                  className="notary-button ghost"
                  data-testid="open-inspector-popout"
                  disabled={busy || !inspector?.attached}
                  onClick={() => void runAction(MESSAGE_TYPES.INSPECTOR_OPEN_POPOUT)}
                >
                  Open Popout
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="notary-card">
              <div className="notary-log-header">
                <h3>Recent Logs</h3>
                <button
                  className="notary-button small ghost"
                  onClick={() => void exportLogs()}
                  disabled={busy}
                >
                  Export
                </button>
              </div>
              <div className="notary-log-list">
                {(state?.logs ?? []).slice(0, 20).map(entry => (
                  <div
                    key={`${entry.timestamp}-${entry.message}`}
                    className={`notary-log-item ${entry.level}`}
                  >
                    <div className="notary-log-line">
                      <span className="notary-log-time">{formatTimestamp(entry.timestamp)}</span>
                      <span className="notary-log-level">{entry.level}</span>
                      <span className="notary-log-message">{entry.message}</span>
                    </div>
                    {entry.data && (
                      <pre className="notary-log-data">
                        {JSON.stringify(entry.data, null, 2)}
                      </pre>
                    )}
                  </div>
                ))}
                {(state?.logs?.length ?? 0) === 0 && (
                  <div className="notary-muted">No logs recorded yet.</div>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </>
        )}

        {activeTab === 'watch' && (
          <div className="notary-card">
            <h3>Watch Settings</h3>
            <div className="notary-grid notary-grid-2">
              <label className="notary-field">
                <span className="notary-field-label">Queue Root Selector</span>
                <input
                  className="notary-input"
                  value={watchForm.openCallsSection}
                  onChange={event =>
                    setWatchForm(current => ({
                      ...current,
                      openCallsSection: event.target.value,
                    }))
                  }
                />
              </label>
              <label className="notary-field">
                <span className="notary-field-label">No Data Selector</span>
                <input
                  className="notary-input"
                  value={watchForm.openCallsNoData}
                  onChange={event =>
                    setWatchForm(current => ({
                      ...current,
                      openCallsNoData: event.target.value,
                    }))
                  }
                />
              </label>
              <label className="notary-field">
                <span className="notary-field-label">Action Button Selector</span>
                <input
                  className="notary-input"
                  value={watchForm.openCallsButtons}
                  onChange={event =>
                    setWatchForm(current => ({
                      ...current,
                      openCallsButtons: event.target.value,
                    }))
                  }
                />
              </label>
              <label className="notary-field">
                <span className="notary-field-label">Claim Cooldown (ms)</span>
                <input
                  className="notary-input"
                  type="number"
                  value={watchForm.claimCooldownMs}
                  onChange={event =>
                    setWatchForm(current => ({
                      ...current,
                      claimCooldownMs: Number(event.target.value),
                    }))
                  }
                />
              </label>
              <label className="notary-field">
                <span className="notary-field-label">Retry Delays (ms CSV)</span>
                <input
                  className="notary-input"
                  value={watchForm.claimRetryDelaysMs}
                  onChange={event =>
                    setWatchForm(current => ({
                      ...current,
                      claimRetryDelaysMs: event.target.value,
                    }))
                  }
                />
              </label>
              <label className="notary-field">
                <span className="notary-field-label">Invocation Timeout (ms)</span>
                <input
                  className="notary-input"
                  type="number"
                  value={watchForm.claimInvocationTimeoutMs}
                  onChange={event =>
                    setWatchForm(current => ({
                      ...current,
                      claimInvocationTimeoutMs: Number(event.target.value),
                    }))
                  }
                />
              </label>
            </div>
            <label className="notary-field">
              <span className="notary-field-label">Join Keywords</span>
              <textarea
                className="notary-input notary-textarea"
                value={watchForm.joinKeywords}
                onChange={event =>
                  setWatchForm(current => ({
                    ...current,
                    joinKeywords: event.target.value,
                  }))
                }
              />
            </label>
            <div className="notary-grid notary-grid-2">
              <label className="notary-toggle">
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={watchForm.autoClaimEnabled}
                  onChange={event =>
                    setWatchForm(current => ({
                      ...current,
                      autoClaimEnabled: event.target.checked,
                    }))
                  }
                />
                <span>Enable auto-claim</span>
              </label>
              <label className="notary-toggle">
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={watchForm.claimInvocationDiagnosticsEnabled}
                  onChange={event =>
                    setWatchForm(current => ({
                      ...current,
                      claimInvocationDiagnosticsEnabled: event.target.checked,
                    }))
                  }
                />
                <span>Enable invocation diagnostics</span>
              </label>
              <label className="notary-toggle">
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={watchForm.overlayEnabled}
                  onChange={event =>
                    setWatchForm(current => ({
                      ...current,
                      overlayEnabled: event.target.checked,
                    }))
                  }
                />
                <span>Show queue overlay</span>
              </label>
              <label className="notary-toggle">
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={watchForm.highlightEnabled}
                  onChange={event =>
                    setWatchForm(current => ({
                      ...current,
                      highlightEnabled: event.target.checked,
                    }))
                  }
                />
                <span>Highlight detected candidates</span>
              </label>
              <label className="notary-toggle">
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={watchForm.audioEnabled}
                  onChange={event =>
                    setWatchForm(current => ({
                      ...current,
                      audioEnabled: event.target.checked,
                    }))
                  }
                />
                <span>Play confirmation chime</span>
              </label>
              <label className="notary-field">
                <span className="notary-field-label">Notification Repeats</span>
                <input
                  className="notary-input"
                  type="number"
                  value={watchForm.notificationRepeats}
                  onChange={event =>
                    setWatchForm(current => ({
                      ...current,
                      notificationRepeats: Number(event.target.value),
                    }))
                  }
                />
              </label>
            </div>
            <div className="notary-actions">
              <button
                className="notary-button"
                data-testid="save-watch-settings"
                disabled={busy}
                onClick={() => void saveWatchSettings()}
              >
                Save Watch Settings
              </button>
            </div>
            <div className="notary-card" style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
              <div className="notary-log-header">
                <h3>Claim Trace</h3>
                <div className="notary-summary-pill">
                  {watch?.claimTraceCount ?? claimTrace.length} recorded
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="notary-log-list">
                {claimTrace.slice(0, 20).map(entry => (
                  <div
                    key={entry.traceId}
                    className={`notary-log-item ${
                      entry.decision.includes('suppressed') ||
                      entry.decision === 'invocation_missing'
                        ? 'warn'
                        : 'info'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className="notary-log-line">
                      <span className="notary-log-time">
                        {formatTimestamp(entry.recordedAt)}
                      </span>
                      <span className="notary-log-level">{entry.decision}</span>
                      <span className="notary-log-message">
                        {entry.buttonText ?? entry.candidateSelector ?? 'claim trace'}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <pre className="notary-log-data">
                      {JSON.stringify(
                        {
                          fingerprint: entry.candidateFingerprint,
                          readiness: entry.readiness,
                          requestObserved: entry.requestObserved,
                          responseStatus: entry.responseStatus,
                          latencyMs: entry.latencyMs,
                          detail: entry.detail,
                        },
                        null,
                        2
                      )}
                    </pre>
                  </div>
                ))}
                {claimTrace.length === 0 && (
                  <div className="notary-muted">
                    No claim-trace entries recorded yet.
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {(activeTab === 'inspector' || inspectorOnly) && (
          <>
            <div className="notary-card">
              <div className="notary-workspace-header">
                <div>
                  <h3>Inspector Controls</h3>
                  <p className="notary-muted">
                    Attached tab: {inspector?.attachedTabId ?? 'none'} | Session:{' '}
                    {inspector?.attachedRunId ?? 'n/a'}
                  </p>

import type { SocketMonitorMode } from '../types/notary.js';

export interface BlueNotaryPageMonitorConfig {
  enabled: boolean;
  mode: SocketMonitorMode;
  deepTrace: boolean;
}

export function installBlueNotaryPageMonitor(
  nextConfig: BlueNotaryPageMonitorConfig
): void {
  const monitorKey = '__REMOTE_NOTARY_BLUE_MONITOR__';
  const channel = 'REMOTE_NOTARY_PAGE_MONITOR';
  const globalWindow = window as typeof window & Record<string, any>;

  function truncate(value: string | undefined, maxLength: number = 4096): string | undefined {
    if (!value) return undefined;
    return value.length <= maxLength ? value : value.slice(0, maxLength);
  }

  function safeStringify(value: unknown): string | undefined {
    if (typeof value === 'string') return truncate(value);
    if (value == null) return undefined;
    try {
      return truncate(JSON.stringify(value, null, 2));
    } catch {
      return truncate(String(value));
    }
  }

  function normalizeText(value: string | undefined): string {
    return (value ?? '').toLowerCase();
  }

  function now(): string {
    return new Date().toISOString();
  }

  function detectSocketEventName(payload: string): string | undefined {
    const normalized = payload.trim();
    const stripped = normalized.replace(/^[0-9]+/, '');
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(stripped);
      if (Array.isArray(parsed) && typeof parsed[0] === 'string') {
        return parsed[0];
      }
      if (typeof parsed?.event === 'string') {
        return parsed.event;
      }
    } catch {
      /* fall through */
    }
    return undefined;
  }

  function hasClaimSignal(value: string | undefined): boolean {
    const text = normalizeText(value);
    return (
      text.includes('pick up session') ||
      text.includes('pickup session') ||
      text.includes('pick up') ||
      text.includes('open call') ||
      text.includes('join as witness') ||
      text.includes('claim') ||
      text.includes('eligible') ||
      text.includes('accept')
    );
  }

  function hasActiveSessionSignal(value: string | undefined): boolean {
    const text = normalizeText(value);
    return (
      text.includes('active session') ||
      text.includes('meeting in progress') ||
      text.includes('session in progress') ||
      text.includes('meeting started') ||
      text.includes('return to meeting')
    );
  }

  function normalizeHeaders(
    headers: HeadersInit | undefined,
    preserveSensitive: boolean
  ): Record<string, string> {
    const normalized: Record<string, string> = {};
    if (!headers) return normalized;

    const append = (name: string, value: string) => {
      const lower = name.toLowerCase();
      if (!preserveSensitive && (lower === 'authorization' || lower === 'cookie')) {
        normalized[name] = '[redacted]';
        return;
      }
      normalized[name] = value;
    };

    if (headers instanceof Headers) {
      headers.forEach((value, name) => append(name, value));
      return normalized;
    }

    if (Array.isArray(headers)) {
      for (const [name, value] of headers) {
        append(name, value);
      }
      return normalized;
    }

    for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(headers)) {
      append(name, String(value));
    }
    return normalized;
  }

  function buildFilterTags(
    url: string,
    bodyPreview: string | undefined,
    transport: 'http' | 'websocket'
  ): string[] {
    const text = `${normalizeText(url)} ${normalizeText(bodyPreview)}`;
    const tags = new Set<string>();
    if (transport === 'websocket') {
      tags.add('websocket');
    }
    if (text.includes('graphql')) {
      tags.add('graphql');
    }
    if (hasClaimSignal(text)) {
      tags.add('claim');
    }
    if (hasActiveSessionSignal(text)) {
      tags.add('active-session');
    }
    if (text.includes('queue')) {
      tags.add('queue');
    }
    return Array.from(tags);
  }

  function emit(type: 'network' | 'socket', payload: Record<string, unknown>): void {
    globalWindow.postMessage(
      {
        source: channel,
        type,
        payload,
      },
      '*'
    );
  }

  if (!globalWindow[monitorKey]) {
    const state = {
      enabled: false,
      config: {
        enabled: false,
        mode: 'observe-only' as SocketMonitorMode,
        deepTrace: false,
      },
      lastClaimTemplate: null as null | {
        url: string;
        method: string;
        headers: Record<string, string>;
        body: string | undefined;
      },
      originalFetch: typeof globalWindow.fetch === 'function'
        ? globalWindow.fetch.bind(globalWindow)
        : undefined,
      OriginalWebSocket: globalWindow.WebSocket,
      originalXHROpen: XMLHttpRequest.prototype.open,
      originalXHRSend: XMLHttpRequest.prototype.send,
      originalXHRSetRequestHeader: XMLHttpRequest.prototype.setRequestHeader,
    };

    if (typeof state.originalFetch === 'function') {
      globalWindow.fetch = async function patchedFetch(
        input: RequestInfo | URL,
        init?: RequestInit
      ): Promise<Response> {
        const current = globalWindow[monitorKey];
        const request = input instanceof Request ? input : undefined;
        const url = request?.url ?? String(input);
        const method = (init?.method ?? request?.method ?? 'GET').toUpperCase();
        const requestHeaders = normalizeHeaders(
          init?.headers ?? request?.headers,
          false
        );
        const replayHeaders = normalizeHeaders(
          init?.headers ?? request?.headers,
          true
        );
        const requestBody =
          typeof init?.body === 'string'
            ? init.body
            : request
              ? undefined
              : undefined;
        const requestBodyPreview = truncate(requestBody);
        const filterTags = buildFilterTags(url, requestBodyPreview, 'http');
        const requestId = `page-fetch-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random()
          .toString(36)
          .slice(2, 8)}`;
        const initiatorStack =
          current?.config.deepTrace === true ? new Error().stack : undefined;

        if (filterTags.includes('claim')) {
          current.lastClaimTemplate = {
            url,
            method,
            headers: replayHeaders,
            body: requestBody,
          };
        }

        try {
          const response = await current.originalFetch(input as any, init);
          if (current.enabled) {
            const responseHandlerStack =
              current.config.deepTrace === true ? new Error().stack : undefined;
            let responseBodyPreview: string | undefined;
            try {
              if (current.config.deepTrace === true) {
                responseBodyPreview = truncate(await response.clone().text());
              }
            } catch {
              responseBodyPreview = undefined;
            }

            emit('network', {
              eventId: requestId,
              requestId,
              recordedAt: now(),
              url,
              method,
              transport: 'http',
              resourceType: 'fetch',
              status: response.status,
              requestHeaders,
              responseHeaders: {},
              requestBodyPreview,
              responseBodyPreview,
              correlationKey: requestId,
              filterTags,
              source: 'page-bridge',
              traceSource: 'page-bridge',
              initiator: 'fetch',
              initiatorStack,
              responseHandlerStack,
            });

            if (
              current.config.mode !== 'observe-only' &&
              hasActiveSessionSignal(responseBodyPreview)
            ) {
              emit('socket', {
                eventId: `${requestId}-active`,
                recordedAt: now(),
                direction: 'state',
                transport: 'fetch',
                eventName: 'active-session-detected',
                payloadPreview: responseBodyPreview,
                activeSessionSignal: true,
                correlationKey: requestId,
              });
            }

            if (
              (current.config.mode === 'observe-api-eligibility' ||
                current.config.mode === 'opt-in-auto-claim') &&
              filterTags.includes('claim')
            ) {
              emit('socket', {
                eventId: `${requestId}-eligibility`,
                recordedAt: now(),
                direction: 'state',
                transport: 'fetch',
                eventName: 'claim-eligibility',
                payloadPreview: `${method} ${url}`,
                claimEligibilitySignal: true,
                correlationKey: requestId,
              });
            }
          }
          return response;
        } catch (error) {
          if (current.enabled) {
            emit('network', {
              eventId: requestId,
              requestId,
              recordedAt: now(),
              url,
              method,
              transport: 'http',
              resourceType: 'fetch',
              status: 0,
              requestHeaders,
              requestBodyPreview,
              responseBodyPreview: truncate(String(error)),
              correlationKey: requestId,
              filterTags,
              source: 'page-bridge',
              traceSource: 'page-bridge',
              initiator: 'fetch',
              initiatorStack,
            });
          }
          throw error;
        }
      };
    }

    XMLHttpRequest.prototype.open = function patchedOpen(
      method: string,
      url: string,
      async?: boolean,
      username?: string | null,
      password?: string | null
    ): void {
      (this as XMLHttpRequest & Record<string, any>).__remoteNotaryMonitor = {
        method: method.toUpperCase(),
        url,
        headers: {} as Record<string, string>,
      };
      return state.originalXHROpen.call(this, method, url, async ?? true, username ?? null, password ?? null);
    };

    XMLHttpRequest.prototype.setRequestHeader = function patchedSetRequestHeader(
      name: string,
      value: string
    ): void {
      const monitor = (this as XMLHttpRequest & Record<string, any>).__remoteNotaryMonitor;
      if (monitor) {
        monitor.headers[name] = value;
      }
      return state.originalXHRSetRequestHeader.call(this, name, value);
    };

    XMLHttpRequest.prototype.send = function patchedSend(
      body?: Document | XMLHttpRequestBodyInit | null
    ): void {
      const xhr = this as XMLHttpRequest & Record<string, any>;
      const current = globalWindow[monitorKey];
      const monitor = xhr.__remoteNotaryMonitor || {
        method: 'GET',
        url: '',
        headers: {},
      };
      const bodyPreview =
        typeof body === 'string' ? truncate(body) : safeStringify(body);
      const requestId = `page-xhr-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random()
        .toString(36)
        .slice(2, 8)}`;
      const filterTags = buildFilterTags(monitor.url, bodyPreview, 'http');
      const initiatorStack =
        current?.config.deepTrace === true ? new Error().stack : undefined;

      if (filterTags.includes('claim')) {
        current.lastClaimTemplate = {
          url: monitor.url,
          method: monitor.method,
          headers: { ...monitor.headers },
          body: typeof body === 'string' ? body : undefined,
        };
      }

      const finalize = () => {
        if (!current.enabled) return;
        const responseText =
          typeof xhr.responseText === 'string' ? truncate(xhr.responseText) : undefined;
        emit('network', {
          eventId: requestId,
          requestId,
          recordedAt: now(),
          url: monitor.url,
          method: monitor.method,
          transport: 'http',
          resourceType: 'xhr',
          status: xhr.status || 0,
          requestHeaders: normalizeHeaders(monitor.headers, false),
          requestBodyPreview: bodyPreview,
          responseBodyPreview: current.config.deepTrace ? responseText : undefined,
          correlationKey: requestId,
          filterTags,
          source: 'page-bridge',
          traceSource: 'page-bridge',
          initiator: 'xhr',
          initiatorStack,
          responseHandlerStack:
            current.config.deepTrace === true ? new Error().stack : undefined,
        });

        if (
          current.config.mode !== 'observe-only' &&
          hasActiveSessionSignal(responseText)
        ) {
          emit('socket', {
            eventId: `${requestId}-active`,
            recordedAt: now(),
            direction: 'state',
            transport: 'xhr',
            eventName: 'active-session-detected',
            payloadPreview: responseText,
            activeSessionSignal: true,
            correlationKey: requestId,
          });
        }
      };

      xhr.addEventListener('loadend', finalize, { once: true });
      return state.originalXHRSend.call(this, body ?? null);
    };

    if (typeof state.OriginalWebSocket === 'function') {
      const WrappedWebSocket = function wrappedWebSocket(
        this: WebSocket,
        url: string | URL,
        protocols?: string | string[]
      ): WebSocket {
        const socket = protocols === undefined
          ? new state.OriginalWebSocket(url)
          : new state.OriginalWebSocket(url, protocols);
        const socketId = `page-ws-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random()
          .toString(36)
          .slice(2, 8)}`;

        socket.addEventListener('message', event => {
          const current = globalWindow[monitorKey];
          if (!current.enabled) return;
          const payloadPreview = truncate(
            typeof event.data === 'string'
              ? event.data
              : safeStringify(event.data)
          );
          emit('socket', {
            eventId: `${socketId}-incoming-${Date.now().toString(36)}`,
            recordedAt: now(),
            direction: 'incoming',
            transport: 'websocket',
            eventName:
              typeof event.data === 'string'
                ? detectSocketEventName(event.data)
                : undefined,
            payloadPreview,
            activeSessionSignal:
              current.config.mode !== 'observe-only' &&
              hasActiveSessionSignal(payloadPreview),
            claimEligibilitySignal:
              (current.config.mode === 'observe-api-eligibility' ||
                current.config.mode === 'opt-in-auto-claim') &&
              hasClaimSignal(payloadPreview),
            correlationKey: socketId,
          });
        });

        const originalSend = socket.send.bind(socket);
        socket.send = function patchedSend(data: string | ArrayBufferLike | Blob | ArrayBufferView): void {
          const current = globalWindow[monitorKey];
          if (current.enabled) {
            const payloadPreview = truncate(
              typeof data === 'string' ? data : safeStringify(data)
            );
            emit('socket', {
              eventId: `${socketId}-outgoing-${Date.now().toString(36)}`,
              recordedAt: now(),
              direction: 'outgoing',
              transport: 'websocket',
              eventName:
                typeof data === 'string' ? detectSocketEventName(data) : undefined,
              payloadPreview,
              claimEligibilitySignal:
                (current.config.mode === 'observe-api-eligibility' ||
                  current.config.mode === 'opt-in-auto-claim') &&
                hasClaimSignal(payloadPreview),
              correlationKey: socketId,
            });
          }
          return originalSend(data);
        };

        return socket;
      } as unknown as typeof WebSocket;

      WrappedWebSocket.prototype = state.OriginalWebSocket.prototype;
      Object.setPrototypeOf(WrappedWebSocket, state.OriginalWebSocket);
      globalWindow.WebSocket = WrappedWebSocket;
    }

    globalWindow[monitorKey] = state;
  }

  const state = globalWindow[monitorKey];
  state.enabled = Boolean(nextConfig.enabled);
  state.config = {
    ...state.config,
    ...nextConfig,
  };

  emit('socket', {
    eventId: `monitor-state-${Date.now().toString(36)}`,
    recordedAt: now(),
    direction: 'state',
    transport: 'fetch',
    eventName: state.enabled ? 'socket-monitor-started' : 'socket-monitor-stopped',
    payloadPreview: JSON.stringify(state.config),
    correlationKey: 'socket-monitor',
  });
}

export async function runBlueNotaryApiClaimAssist(): Promise<{
  ok: boolean;
  status?: number;
  preview?: string;
  error?: string;
}> {
  const monitorKey = '__REMOTE_NOTARY_BLUE_MONITOR__';
  const channel = 'REMOTE_NOTARY_PAGE_MONITOR';
  const globalWindow = window as typeof window & Record<string, any>;
  const state = globalWindow[monitorKey];

  if (!state?.lastClaimTemplate || typeof state.originalFetch !== 'function') {
    return {
      ok: false,
      error: 'No claim template captured yet',
    };
  }

  function truncate(value: string | undefined, maxLength: number = 4096): string | undefined {
    if (!value) return undefined;
    return value.length <= maxLength ? value : value.slice(0, maxLength);
  }

  const requestId = `claim-assist-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random()
    .toString(36)
    .slice(2, 8)}`;

  try {
    const response = await state.originalFetch(state.lastClaimTemplate.url, {
      method: state.lastClaimTemplate.method,
      headers: state.lastClaimTemplate.headers,
      body: state.lastClaimTemplate.body,
      credentials: 'include',
    });
    const preview = truncate(await response.clone().text());
    globalWindow.postMessage(
      {
        source: channel,
        type: 'network',
        payload: {
          eventId: requestId,
          requestId,
          recordedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          url: state.lastClaimTemplate.url,
          method: state.lastClaimTemplate.method,
          transport: 'http',
          resourceType: 'claim-assist',
          status: response.status,
          requestHeaders: {},
          responseHeaders: {},
          requestBodyPreview: truncate(state.lastClaimTemplate.body),
          responseBodyPreview: preview,
          correlationKey: requestId,
          filterTags: ['claim', 'claim-assist'],
          source: 'page-bridge',
          traceSource: 'page-bridge',
          initiator: 'manual-claim-assist',
          initiatorStack: state.config.deepTrace === true ? new Error().stack : undefined,
          responseHandlerStack:
            state.config.deepTrace === true ? new Error().stack : undefined,
        },
      },
      '*'
    );
    globalWindow.postMessage(
      {
        source: channel,
        type: 'socket',
        payload: {
          eventId: `${requestId}-result`,
          recordedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          direction: 'state',
          transport: 'fetch',
          eventName: 'claim-assist-result',
          payloadPreview: preview,
          claimEligibilitySignal: response.ok,
          correlationKey: requestId,
        },
      },
      '*'
    );

    return {
      ok: response.ok,
      status: response.status,
      preview,
    };
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      error: String(error),
    };
  }
}

import { test, expect, chromium, BrowserContext, Page } from '@playwright/test';
import path from 'path';
import { existsSync, readFileSync } from 'fs';

import {
  getExtensionId,
  openSidepanel,

const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
const __dirname = path.dirname(__filename);

const extensionPath = path.resolve(__dirname, '../../../../dist');
const proofFixtureRoot = path.resolve(__dirname, '../../../../data/proof-fixtures');

function readFixture(name: string): string {
  return readFileSync(path.join(proofFixtureRoot, name), 'utf8');
}

function wrapFixtureDocument(bodyHtml: string, scripts: string = ''): string {
  return `<!doctype html>
    <html lang="en">
      <head>
        <meta charset="utf-8" />
        <title>Proof Fixture</title>
      </head>
      <body>
        ${bodyHtml}
        <script>
          ${scripts}
        </script>
      </body>
    </html>`;
}

async function openFixturePage(
  context: BrowserContext,
  url: string,
  html: string,
  scripts: string = ''
): Promise<Page> {
  const page = await context.newPage();
  await page.route(url, async route => {
    await route.fulfill({
      status: 200,
      contentType: 'text/html',
      body: wrapFixtureDocument(html, scripts),
    });
  });
  await page.goto(url);
  await page.waitForLoadState('domcontentloaded');
  await page.bringToFront();
  return page;
}

async function wireGraphqlFixture(page: Page) {
  await page.route('https://api.proof.com/graphql', async route => {
    await route.fulfill({
      status: 200,
      contentType: 'application/json',
      body: JSON.stringify({
        data: {
          ok: true,
        },
      }),
    });
  });
}

async function pollState(
  sidepanel: Page,
  predicate: (state: any) => boolean,
  timeoutMs: number = 12000
) {
  const startedAt = Date.now();
  let lastState: any;

  while (Date.now() - startedAt < timeoutMs) {
    const response = await sendMessageToServiceWorker(sidepanel, {
      type: 'NOTARY_GET_STATE',
    });
    lastState = response?.state;
    if (lastState && predicate(lastState)) {
      return lastState;
    }
    await sidepanel.waitForTimeout(250);
  }

  throw new Error(`Timed out waiting for state. Last state: ${JSON.stringify(lastState)}`);
}

async function pollInspectorBundle(
  sidepanel: Page,
  predicate: (bundle: any) => boolean,
  timeoutMs: number = 12000
) {
  const startedAt = Date.now();
  let lastBundle: any;

  while (Date.now() - startedAt < timeoutMs) {
    const response = await sendMessageToServiceWorker(sidepanel, {
      type: 'NOTARY_GET_INSPECTOR_DATA',
    });
    lastBundle = response?.bundle;
    if (lastBundle && predicate(lastBundle)) {
      return lastBundle;
    }
    await sidepanel.waitForTimeout(250);
  }

  throw new Error(
    `Timed out waiting for inspector bundle. Last bundle: ${JSON.stringify(lastBundle)}`
  );
}

    });

          operationName: 'ViewerQueuesPoller',
        }),
      });
    });

    const state = await pollState(
      sidepanel,
      snapshot =>

        snapshot.inspector.deepTraceActive === false
    );
    const bundle = await pollInspectorBundle(

      data => data.domEvents.length > 0
    );

    expect(state.inspector.attached).toBe(true);
    expect(state.inspector.deepTraceActive).toBe(false);
    expect(bundle.domEvents.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);

    );

    expect(state.watch.lastClaimStrategy).toBeTruthy();
    await expect
      .poll(async () => fixturePage.evaluate(() => document.hasFocus()))

) {

test.describe('Recipe Execution Tests', () => {
  let context: BrowserContext;
  let sidepanel: Page;
  let extensionId: string;

  test.beforeAll(async () => {
    if (!existsSync(extensionPath)) {
      throw new Error(
        `Extension not built: ${extensionPath}. Run 'pnpm nx run proof-extension:build:dev' first.`
      );
    }

    context = await chromium.launchPersistentContext('', {
      headless: false,
      args: [
        `--disable-extensions-except=${extensionPath}`,

      ],
    });

    sidepanel = await openSidepanel(context, extensionId);
  });

import { test, expect, chromium, BrowserContext, Page } from '@playwright/test';
import path from 'path';
import { existsSync, readFileSync } from 'fs';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'url';
import {
  getExtensionId,
  openSidepanel,
  sendMessageToServiceWorker,
} from '../utils/extension-helpers.js';

const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
const __dirname = path.dirname(__filename);

const extensionPath = path.resolve(__dirname, '../../../../dist');
const fixtureRoot = path.resolve(
  __dirname,
  '../../../../data/blue-notary-html-elements/dashboard'
);

const MESSAGE_TYPES = {
  GET_STATE: 'NOTARY_GET_STATE',
  UPDATE_SETTINGS: 'NOTARY_UPDATE_SETTINGS',
  START_WATCH: 'NOTARY_START_WATCH',
  STOP_WATCH: 'NOTARY_STOP_WATCH',
  RESET_STATE: 'NOTARY_RESET_STATE',
  WATCH_LOG_EXPORT: 'NOTARY_WATCH_LOG_EXPORT',
} as const;

function readFixture(name: string): string {
  return readFileSync(path.join(fixtureRoot, name), 'utf8');
}

function wrapFixtureDocument(bodyHtml: string): string {
  return `<!doctype html><html><head><title>Blue Notary Fixture</title></head><body>${bodyHtml}</body></html>`;
}

async function pollWatchState(
  sidepanel: Page,
  predicate: (watch: any) => boolean,
  timeoutMs: number = 10000
) {
  const startedAt = Date.now();
  let lastWatch: any;

  while (Date.now() - startedAt < timeoutMs) {
    const response = await sendMessageToServiceWorker(sidepanel, {
      type: MESSAGE_TYPES.GET_STATE,
    });
    lastWatch = response?.state?.watch;
    if (lastWatch && predicate(lastWatch)) {
      return lastWatch;
    }
    await sidepanel.waitForTimeout(250);
  }

  throw new Error(`Watch state did not reach expected condition: ${JSON.stringify(lastWatch)}`);
}

async function pollExportBundle(
  sidepanel: Page,
  predicate: (bundle: any) => boolean,
  timeoutMs: number = 10000
) {
  const startedAt = Date.now();
  let lastBundle: any;

  while (Date.now() - startedAt < timeoutMs) {
    const response = await sendMessageToServiceWorker(sidepanel, {
      type: MESSAGE_TYPES.WATCH_LOG_EXPORT,
    });
    lastBundle = response?.bundle;
    if (response?.ok && lastBundle && predicate(lastBundle)) {
      return lastBundle;
    }
    await sidepanel.waitForTimeout(250);
  }

  throw new Error(`Watch export bundle did not reach expected condition: ${JSON.stringify(lastBundle)}`);
}

async function openFixturePage(
  context: BrowserContext,
  url: string,
  html: string
): Promise<Page> {
  const page = await context.newPage();
  await page.route(url, async route => {
    await route.fulfill({
      status: 200,
      contentType: 'text/html',
      body: wrapFixtureDocument(html),
    });
  });
  await page.goto(url);
  await page.waitForLoadState('domcontentloaded');
  await page.bringToFront();
  return page;
}

test.describe('Watch observability regression (Phase 4)', () => {
  let context: BrowserContext;
  let sidepanel: Page;

  test.beforeAll(async () => {
    if (!existsSync(extensionPath)) {
      throw new Error(
        `Extension not built: ${extensionPath}. Run 'pnpm nx run proof-extension:build:dev' first.`
      );
    }

    context = await chromium.launchPersistentContext('', {
      headless: false,
      args: [
        `--disable-extensions-except=${extensionPath}`,
        `--load-extension=${extensionPath}`,
      ],
    });

    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 2000));

    const extensionId = await getExtensionId(context);
    sidepanel = await openSidepanel(context, extensionId);
  });

  test.afterAll(async () => {
    await context?.close();
  });

  test('exports a coherent bundle after no-data fixture replay', async () => {
    const fixturePage = await openFixturePage(
      context,
      'https://app.bluenotary.us/notary/dashboard?fixture=phase4-container-rebind',
      readFixture('open-calls-container.html')
    );

    await sendMessageToServiceWorker(sidepanel, { type: MESSAGE_TYPES.RESET_STATE });
    await sendMessageToServiceWorker(sidepanel, {
      type: MESSAGE_TYPES.UPDATE_SETTINGS,
      settings: {
        metricsEnabled: true,
        overlayEnabled: false,
        highlightEnabled: false,
        audioEnabled: false,
      },
    });

    await fixturePage.bringToFront();
    const startResponse = await sendMessageToServiceWorker(sidepanel, {
      type: MESSAGE_TYPES.START_WATCH,
    });
    expect(startResponse.ok).toBe(true);

    await pollWatchState(
      sidepanel,
      watch => watch.status === 'watching' && watch.lastResult === 'No open calls available'
    );

    const exportBundle = await pollExportBundle(
      sidepanel,
      bundle =>
        bundle.metrics?.some((entry: any) => entry.reasonCode === 'no_data') &&
        bundle.logs.some((entry: any) => entry.message === 'Watch started')
    );

    expect(exportBundle.summary.currentStatus).toBe('watching');
    expect(exportBundle.summary.metricCount).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(Array.isArray(exportBundle.domDelta)).toBe(true);
    expect(exportBundle.settings.credentials).toEqual({});
    expect(
      exportBundle.metrics.some((entry: any) => entry.reasonCode === 'no_data')
    ).toBe(true);

    await sendMessageToServiceWorker(sidepanel, { type: MESSAGE_TYPES.STOP_WATCH });
    await fixturePage.close();
  });

  test('exports failure diagnostics for an unavailable watch tab', async () => {
    await sendMessageToServiceWorker(sidepanel, { type: MESSAGE_TYPES.RESET_STATE });

    const startResponse = await sendMessageToServiceWorker(sidepanel, {
      type: MESSAGE_TYPES.START_WATCH,
      tabId: 999999,
    });

    expect(startResponse.ok).toBe(true);
    expect(startResponse.watch.status).toBe('error');
    expect(startResponse.watch.lastError).toContain('no longer available');

    const exportResponse = await sendMessageToServiceWorker(sidepanel, {
      type: MESSAGE_TYPES.WATCH_LOG_EXPORT,
    });

    expect(exportResponse.ok).toBe(true);
    expect(exportResponse.bundle.summary.currentStatus).toBe('error');
    expect(exportResponse.bundle.watch.lastError).toContain('no longer available');
    expect(
      exportResponse.bundle.logs.some(
        (entry: any) => entry.message === 'Watch stopped because the tab was unavailable'
      )
    ).toBe(true);
  });
});

/**
 * Phase 1: Watch session runtime E2E tests.
 * Verifies watch start/stop messaging and idempotent start (no duplicate sessions).
 */
import { test, expect, chromium, BrowserContext, Page } from '@playwright/test';
import path from 'path';
import { existsSync } from 'fs';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'url';
import {
  getExtensionId,
  openSidepanel,
  sendMessageToServiceWorker,
} from '../utils/extension-helpers.js';

const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
const __dirname = path.dirname(__filename);

const extensionPath = path.resolve(__dirname, '../../../../dist');

const MESSAGE_TYPES = {
  GET_STATE: 'NOTARY_GET_STATE',
  START_WATCH: 'NOTARY_START_WATCH',
  STOP_WATCH: 'NOTARY_STOP_WATCH',
  PAUSE_WATCH: 'NOTARY_PAUSE_WATCH',
  RESUME_WATCH: 'NOTARY_RESUME_WATCH',
} as const;

test.describe('Watch session runtime (Phase 1)', () => {
  let context: BrowserContext;
  let sidepanel: Page;

  test.beforeAll(async () => {
    if (!existsSync(extensionPath)) {
      throw new Error(
        `Extension not built: ${extensionPath}. Run 'pnpm nx run proof-extension:build:dev' first.`
      );
    }

    context = await chromium.launchPersistentContext('', {
      headless: false,
      args: [
        `--disable-extensions-except=${extensionPath}`,
        `--load-extension=${extensionPath}`,
      ],
    });

    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 2000));

    const extensionId = await getExtensionId(context);
    sidepanel = await openSidepanel(context, extensionId);
  });

  test.afterAll(async () => {
    await context?.close();
  });

  test('GET_STATE returns watch state', async () => {
    const response = await sendMessageToServiceWorker(sidepanel, {
      type: MESSAGE_TYPES.GET_STATE,
    });
    expect(response).toBeDefined();
    expect(response.ok).toBe(true);
    expect(response.state).toBeDefined();
    expect(response.state.watch).toBeDefined();
    expect(['idle', 'watching', 'paused', 'error']).toContain(response.state.watch.status);
  });

  test('START_WATCH and STOP_WATCH return ok and watch state', async () => {
    const startRes = await sendMessageToServiceWorker(sidepanel, {
      type: MESSAGE_TYPES.START_WATCH,
    });
    expect(startRes.ok).toBe(true);
    expect(startRes.watch).toBeDefined();
    expect(['watching', 'error']).toContain(startRes.watch.status);

    const stopRes = await sendMessageToServiceWorker(sidepanel, {
      type: MESSAGE_TYPES.STOP_WATCH,
    });
    expect(stopRes.ok).toBe(true);
    expect(stopRes.watch.status).toBe('idle');
  });

  test('repeated START_WATCH is accepted and second can be Already watching', async () => {
    const first = await sendMessageToServiceWorker(sidepanel, {
      type: MESSAGE_TYPES.START_WATCH,
    });
    expect(first.ok).toBe(true);
    expect(first.watch).toBeDefined();

    const second = await sendMessageToServiceWorker(sidepanel, {
      type: MESSAGE_TYPES.START_WATCH,
    });
    expect(second.ok).toBe(true);
    if (first.watch.status === 'watching' && second.watch.status === 'watching') {
      expect(second.watch.lastResult).toBe('Already watching');
    }

    await sendMessageToServiceWorker(sidepanel, { type: MESSAGE_TYPES.STOP_WATCH });
  });

  test('STOP_WATCH then START_WATCH is clean (Phase 2 teardown idempotency)', async () => {
    await sendMessageToServiceWorker(sidepanel, { type: MESSAGE_TYPES.STOP_WATCH });
    const startRes = await sendMessageToServiceWorker(sidepanel, {
      type: MESSAGE_TYPES.START_WATCH,
    });
    expect(startRes.ok).toBe(true);
    expect(startRes.watch).toBeDefined();
    expect(['watching', 'error']).toContain(startRes.watch.status);
    await sendMessageToServiceWorker(sidepanel, { type: MESSAGE_TYPES.STOP_WATCH });
  });
});

/**
 * Extension Helper Utilities
 *
 * Utilities for interacting with Chrome extension in Playwright tests
 */

import { BrowserContext, Page } from '@playwright/test';

/**
 * Get extension ID from manifest
 */
export async function getExtensionId(context: BrowserContext): Promise<string> {
  const extractExtensionId = (url: string): string | null => {
    const match = url.match(/^chrome-extension:\/\/([a-z]{32})/);
    return match ? match[1] : null;
  };

  const tryGetExtensionId = (): string | null => {
    for (const page of context.pages()) {
      const id = extractExtensionId(page.url());
      if (id) return id;
    }

    if (typeof context.backgroundPages === 'function') {
      for (const page of context.backgroundPages()) {
        const id = extractExtensionId(page.url());
        if (id) return id;
      }
    }

    for (const worker of context.serviceWorkers()) {
      const id = extractExtensionId(worker.url());
      if (id) return id;
    }

    return null;
  };

  const startTime = Date.now();
  const timeoutMs = 8000;
  while (Date.now() - startTime < timeoutMs) {
    const id = tryGetExtensionId();
    if (id) return id;
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 250));
  }

  throw new Error('Could not determine extension ID');
}

/**
 * Open sidepanel by navigating to sidepanel/index.html
 */
export async function openSidepanel(
  context: BrowserContext,
  extensionId: string
): Promise<Page> {
  const sidepanelUrl = `chrome-extension://${extensionId}/sidepanel/index.html`;
  const page = await context.newPage();
  await page.goto(sidepanelUrl);

  await Promise.race([
    page.waitForSelector('header.app-header', { timeout: 10000 }),
    page.waitForSelector('[data-testid="proof-app"]', { timeout: 10000 }),
  ]);

  return page;
}

/**
 * Get storage data from extension
 */
export async function getStorageData(
  page: Page,
  storageKey: string
): Promise<any> {
  return await page.evaluate((key) => {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      chrome.storage.local.get(key, (result: Record<string, unknown>) => {
        resolve(result[key]);
      });
    });
  }, storageKey);
}

/**
 * Set storage data in extension
 */
export async function setStorageData(
  page: Page,
  storageKey: string,
  data: any
): Promise<void> {
  await page.evaluate(
    ({ key, value }) => {
      return new Promise((resolve) => {
        chrome.storage.local.set({ [key]: value }, () => {
          resolve(undefined);
        });
      });
    },
    { key: storageKey, value: data }
  );
}

/**
 * Clear all storage data
 */
export async function clearStorage(page: Page): Promise<void> {
  await page.evaluate(() => {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      chrome.storage.local.clear(() => {
        resolve(undefined);
      });
    });
  });
}

/**
 * Send message to service worker and wait for response
 */
export async function sendMessageToServiceWorker(
  page: Page,
  message: any
): Promise<any> {
  return await page.evaluate((msg) => {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      chrome.runtime.sendMessage(msg, (response: unknown) => {
        if (chrome.runtime.lastError) {
          reject(chrome.runtime.lastError);
        } else {
          resolve(response);
        }
      });
    });
  }, message);
}
