import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';

import {
  createDomWatchController,
  type DomWatchEvent,
  type WatchClaimAttemptEvent,
} from '../../../content/watch-observer.js';
import type { ClaimAttemptTrace } from '../../../types/notary.js';

async function flushObserver(): Promise<void> {
  await Promise.resolve();
  await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 180));
}

describe('proof watch observer', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    document.body.innerHTML = '';
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    document.body.innerHTML = '';
    vi.restoreAllMocks();
  });

  it('auto-claims a Proof queue item when a candidate is present', async () => {
    document.body.innerHTML = `
      <main>
        <section data-testid="queue-shell">
          <div data-testid="queue-list">
            <article data-testid="queue-item">
              <button data-testid="accept-request">Accept Meeting Request</button>
            </article>
          </div>
        </section>
      </main>
    `;

    const events: DomWatchEvent[] = [];
    const attempts: WatchClaimAttemptEvent[] = [];

    const controller = createDomWatchController(
      document,
      {
        containerSelector: '[data-testid="queue-shell"]',
        buttonSelector: '[data-testid="accept-request"]',
        keywords: ['accept meeting request'],
      },
      {
        onEvent: event => events.push(event),
        onClaimAttempt: event => attempts.push(event),
      }
    );

    await flushObserver();
    controller.stop();

    expect(attempts).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(attempts[0]?.strategy).toBe('direct-click');
    expect(attempts[0]?.success).toBe(true);
    expect(events.some(event => event.reasonCode === 'claim_success')).toBe(true);
  });

  it('emits candidate_detected without attempting a click when auto-claim is disabled', async () => {
    document.body.innerHTML = `
      <main>
        <section data-testid="queue-shell">
          <div data-testid="queue-list">
            <article data-testid="queue-item">
              <button data-testid="accept-request">Accept Meeting Request</button>
            </article>
          </div>
        </section>
      </main>
    `;

    const events: DomWatchEvent[] = [];
    const attempts: WatchClaimAttemptEvent[] = [];

    const controller = createDomWatchController(
      document,
      {
        containerSelector: '[data-testid="queue-shell"]',
        buttonSelector: '[data-testid="accept-request"]',
        keywords: ['accept'],
        autoClaim: false,
      },
      {
        onEvent: event => events.push(event),
        onClaimAttempt: event => attempts.push(event),
      }
    );

    await flushObserver();
    controller.stop();

    expect(attempts).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(events.some(event => event.reasonCode === 'candidate_detected')).toBe(true);
  });

  it('rebinds when the Proof queue container is removed and reinserted', async () => {
    document.body.innerHTML = `
      <main>
        <section data-testid="queue-shell"></section>
      </main>
    `;

    const events: DomWatchEvent[] = [];
    const controller = createDomWatchController(
      document,
      {
        containerSelector: '[data-testid="queue-shell"]',
      },
      event => events.push(event)
    );

    await flushObserver();
    document.querySelector('[data-testid="queue-shell"]')?.remove();
    await flushObserver();

    const replacement = document.createElement('section');
    replacement.setAttribute('data-testid', 'queue-shell');
    document.body.appendChild(replacement);
    await flushObserver();
    controller.stop();

    expect(events.map(event => event.reasonCode)).toContain('container_lost');
    expect(events.map(event => event.reasonCode)).toContain('container_resolved');
  });

  it('coalesces a mutation burst into a single claim attempt', async () => {
    document.body.innerHTML = `
      <main>
        <section data-testid="queue-shell">
          <div data-testid="queue-list"></div>
        </section>
      </main>
    `;

    const attempts: WatchClaimAttemptEvent[] = [];
    const controller = createDomWatchController(
      document,
      {
        containerSelector: '[data-testid="queue-shell"]',
        buttonSelector: '[data-testid="accept-request"]',
        keywords: ['accept'],
      },
      {
        onEvent: () => undefined,
        onClaimAttempt: attempt => attempts.push(attempt),
      }
    );

    const queueList = document.querySelector('[data-testid="queue-list"]');
    for (let index = 0; index < 3; index += 1) {
      const button = document.createElement('button');
      button.setAttribute('data-testid', 'accept-request');
      button.textContent = 'Accept Meeting Request';
      queueList?.appendChild(button);
    }

    await flushObserver();
    controller.stop();

    expect(attempts).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(attempts[0]?.success).toBe(true);
  });

  it('retries a transient disabled candidate and clicks once when it becomes enabled', async () => {
    document.body.innerHTML = `
      <main>
        <section data-testid="queue-shell">
          <div data-testid="queue-list">
            <article>
              <button data-testid="accept-request" disabled>Start Retail Session</button>
            </article>
          </div>
        </section>
      </main>
    `;

    const attempts: WatchClaimAttemptEvent[] = [];
    const traces: ClaimAttemptTrace[] = [];
    const button = document.querySelector(
      '[data-testid="accept-request"]'
    ) as HTMLButtonElement;

    globalThis.setTimeout(() => {
      button.disabled = false;
    }, 60);

    const controller = createDomWatchController(
      document,
      {
        containerSelector: '[data-testid="queue-shell"]',
        buttonSelector: '[data-testid="accept-request"]',
        keywords: ['start retail session'],
        claimRetryDelaysMs: [50, 100],
      },
      {
        onEvent: () => undefined,
        onClaimAttempt: attempt => attempts.push(attempt),
        onClaimTrace: trace => traces.push(trace),
      }
    );

    await flushObserver();
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 120));
    controller.stop();

    expect(attempts).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(attempts[0]?.success).toBe(true);
    expect(traces.some(trace => trace.decision === 'click_sent')).toBe(true);
  });

  it('claims immediately when a disabled button becomes enabled via attribute mutation', async () => {
    // Verifies Fix A: the disabled→enabled fast path bypasses the 100ms
    // MIN_EVALUATION_INTERVAL debounce so the claim fires in the same tick
    // the button is enabled.
    document.body.innerHTML = `
      <main>
        <section data-testid="queue-shell">
          <div data-testid="queue-list">
            <article>
              <button data-testid="accept-request" disabled>Start Witness Session</button>
            </article>
          </div>
        </section>
      </main>
    `;

    const attempts: WatchClaimAttemptEvent[] = [];
    const traces: ClaimAttemptTrace[] = [];
    const button = document.querySelector(
      '[data-testid="accept-request"]'
    ) as HTMLButtonElement;

    // Enable the button after a very short delay — well under the
    // MIN_EVALUATION_INTERVAL_MS (100ms) to confirm the fast path fires.
    globalThis.setTimeout(() => {
      button.disabled = false;
    }, 20);

    const controller = createDomWatchController(
      document,
      {
        containerSelector: '[data-testid="queue-shell"]',
        buttonSelector: '[data-testid="accept-request"]',
        keywords: ['start witness session'],
        claimRetryDelaysMs: [50, 150, 400, 900, 1800],
      },
      {
        onEvent: () => undefined,
        onClaimAttempt: attempt => attempts.push(attempt),
        onClaimTrace: trace => traces.push(trace),
      }
    );

    await flushObserver();
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 80));
    controller.stop();

    expect(attempts).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(attempts[0]?.success).toBe(true);
    expect(traces.some(trace => trace.decision === 'click_sent')).toBe(true);
  });

  it('exhausts all retry delays before emitting suppressed_disabled for a persistently-disabled button', async () => {
    // Verifies Fix B: 5 retry entries are consumed before the trace is emitted.
    document.body.innerHTML = `
      <main>
        <section data-testid="queue-shell">
          <div data-testid="queue-list">
            <article>
              <button data-testid="accept-request" disabled>Start Retail Session</button>
            </article>
          </div>
        </section>
      </main>
    `;

    const traces: ClaimAttemptTrace[] = [];
    const retryDelays = [50, 100, 150, 200, 250];

    const controller = createDomWatchController(
      document,
      {
        containerSelector: '[data-testid="queue-shell"]',
        buttonSelector: '[data-testid="accept-request"]',
        keywords: ['start retail session'],
        claimRetryDelaysMs: retryDelays,
      },
      {
        onEvent: () => undefined,
        onClaimTrace: trace => traces.push(trace),
      }
    );

    await flushObserver();
    // Wait for all 5 retries: 50+100+150+200+250 = 750ms, give buffer
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 900));
    controller.stop();

    const suppressedTrace = traces.find(t => t.decision === 'suppressed_disabled');
    expect(suppressedTrace).toBeDefined();
    // candidate_detected trace emitted before the retries are exhausted
    const detectedTraces = traces.filter(t => t.decision === 'candidate_detected');
    expect(detectedTraces.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
  });

  it('records suppressed_disappeared when a candidate vanishes before becoming clickable', async () => {
    document.body.innerHTML = `
      <main>
        <section data-testid="queue-shell">
          <div data-testid="queue-list">
            <article data-testid="queue-item">
              <button data-testid="accept-request" disabled>Start Retail Session</button>
            </article>
          </div>
        </section>
      </main>
    `;

    const traces: ClaimAttemptTrace[] = [];
    const queueItem = document.querySelector('[data-testid="queue-item"]');

    globalThis.setTimeout(() => {
      queueItem?.remove();
    }, 60);

    const controller = createDomWatchController(
      document,
      {
        containerSelector: '[data-testid="queue-shell"]',
        buttonSelector: '[data-testid="accept-request"]',
        keywords: ['start retail session'],
        claimRetryDelaysMs: [50, 100],
      },
      {
        onEvent: () => undefined,
        onClaimTrace: trace => traces.push(trace),
      }
    );

    await flushObserver();
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 120));
    controller.stop();

    expect(
      traces.some(trace => trace.decision === 'suppressed_disappeared')
    ).toBe(true);
  });
});

import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { simulateCursorSequence } from '../../../devtools/cursor-simulation';

describe('cursor-simulation', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    document.body.innerHTML = '';
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    document.body.innerHTML = '';
    vi.restoreAllMocks();
  });

  it('dispatches a visible cursor sequence and removes the overlay artifacts', async () => {
    const target = document.createElement('button');
    target.id = 'target';
    target.textContent = 'Claim Session';

    const events: string[] = [];
    for (const type of ['mousemove', 'mousedown', 'mouseup', 'click']) {
      target.addEventListener(type, () => {
        events.push(type);
      });
    }

    Object.defineProperty(target, 'getBoundingClientRect', {
      configurable: true,
      value: () => ({
        left: 120,
        top: 240,
        width: 80,
        height: 32,
        right: 200,
        bottom: 272,
        x: 120,
        y: 240,
        toJSON: () => ({}),
      }),
    });
    Object.defineProperty(document, 'elementFromPoint', {
      configurable: true,
      value: vi.fn().mockReturnValue(target),
    });
    Object.defineProperty(target, 'scrollIntoView', {
      configurable: true,
      value: vi.fn(),
    });

    document.body.appendChild(target);

    const result = await simulateCursorSequence({
      document,
      selector: '#target',
      durationMs: 0,
      label: 'Cursor Simulation',
    });

    expect(result.selector).toBe('#target');
    expect(result.targetText).toBe('Claim Session');
    expect(result.targetTagName).toBe('button');
    expect(events).toEqual(['mousemove', 'mousedown', 'mouseup', 'click']);
    expect(document.getElementById('proof-extension-virtual-cursor')).toBeNull();
    expect(document.getElementById('proof-extension-virtual-cursor-label')).toBeNull();
  });

  it('throws when the selector does not resolve to an element', async () => {
    await expect(
      simulateCursorSequence({
        document,
        selector: '.missing-target',
        durationMs: 0,
      })
    ).rejects.toThrow('Cursor simulation target not found');
  });
});



==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/apps/chrome-extensions/proof-extension/src/tests/unit/inspector/dom-inspector.test.ts ====
import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { createDomInspectorController } from '../../../inspector/dom-inspector.js';
import type { ObservedDomEvent } from '../../../inspector/types.js';

async function flushObserver(): Promise<void> {
  await Promise.resolve();
  await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 0));
}

describe('dom inspector', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    document.body.innerHTML = `
      <main data-testid="queue-shell">
        <div data-testid="queue-list">
          <button>Observe me</button>
        </div>
      </main>
    `;
  });

  it('captures allowed mutations within selected roots', async () => {
    const events: ObservedDomEvent[] = [];
    const controller = createDomInspectorController(
      document,
      {
        selectedRoots: ['[data-testid="queue-list"]'],
        includeCharacterData: false,
        styleDiffEnabled: true,
        platform: 'proof',
      },
      {
        onDomEvent: event => events.push(event),
      }
    );

    const button = document.querySelector('button') as HTMLButtonElement;
    button.setAttribute('disabled', 'true');
    button.style.opacity = '0.5';
    await flushObserver();
    controller.stop();

    expect(events.some(event => event.attributesChanged?.includes('disabled'))).toBe(
      true
    );
    expect(
      events.some(
        event =>
          event.attributesChanged?.includes('style') === true ||
          Boolean(event.styleDiff)
      )
    ).toBe(true);
  });

  it('flushes queued records via takeRecords on stop', () => {
    const events: ObservedDomEvent[] = [];
    const controller = createDomInspectorController(
      document,
      {
        selectedRoots: ['[data-testid="queue-list"]'],
        includeCharacterData: false,
        styleDiffEnabled: false,
        platform: 'proof',
      },
      {
        onDomEvent: event => events.push(event),
      }
    );

    const node = document.createElement('div');
    node.textContent = 'queued mutation';
    document.querySelector('[data-testid="queue-list"]')?.appendChild(node);

    controller.stop();

    expect(events.some(event => event.mutationType === 'childList')).toBe(true);
  });
});

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';

  buildNetworkFilterTags,

describe('network-attribution', () => {
  it('derives consistent filter tags from url, body, and transport hints', () => {
    expect(
      buildNetworkFilterTags({
        url: 'https://api.proof.com/graphql?operationName=ViewerQueuesPoller',
        requestBodyPreview: '{"operationName":"AcceptMeetingRequest"}',
        responseBodyPreview: '{"status":"Meeting in progress"}',
        transport: 'websocket',
      })
    ).toEqual(
      expect.arrayContaining([
        'graphql',
        'claim',
        'active-session',
        'queue',
        'websocket',
      ])
    );
  });

  it('normalizes requestBody previews from form data and raw bytes', () => {
    const formPreview = requestBodyToPreview({
      formData: {
        action: ['pick up session'],
      },
    });
    expect(formPreview).toContain('pick up session');

    const rawPreview = requestBodyToPreview({
      raw: [
        {
          bytes: Array.from(
            new TextEncoder().encode('{"operationName":"OnDemandQueue"}')
          ),
        },
      ],
    });
    expect(rawPreview).toContain('OnDemandQueue');
  });
});



==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/apps/chrome-extensions/proof-extension/src/tests/unit/platforms/proof-provider.test.ts ====
import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { readFileSync } from 'fs';
import path from 'path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'url';
import { platformConfigs } from '../../../config.js';
import { proofProvider } from '../../../platforms/proof-provider.js';
import { hydrateSettings } from '../../../platforms/default-settings.js';

const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
const __dirname = path.dirname(__filename);

function loadFixture(name: string): string {
  const filepath = path.resolve(
    __dirname,
    '../../../../data/proof-fixtures',
    name
  );
  return readFileSync(filepath, 'utf8');
}

function loadJsonFixture(name: string): any {
  return JSON.parse(loadFixture(name));
}

describe('settings migration — joinKeywords union', () => {
  it('merges new default keywords into existing stored keywords on hydrateSettings', () => {
    // Regression: before the fix, mergePlatformSettings replaced stored joinKeywords wholesale.
    // Existing users with ['accept'] stored would lose new defaults on extension update.
    const result = hydrateSettings({
      platform: { joinKeywords: ['accept'] } as any,
    });
    const keywords = result.platform.joinKeywords;
    expect(keywords).toContain('accept');           // stored keyword preserved
    expect(keywords).toContain('start retail session'); // new default present
    expect(keywords).toContain('start business session');
    expect(keywords).toContain('witness');
    expect(keywords).toContain('session');
  });

  it('does not duplicate keywords when stored already has default values', () => {
    const defaults = platformConfigs.proof.joinKeywords;
    const result = hydrateSettings({
      platform: { joinKeywords: [...defaults] } as any,
    });
    const keywords = result.platform.joinKeywords;
    const uniqueKeywords = [...new Set(keywords)];
    expect(uniqueKeywords).toHaveLength(keywords.length);
  });
});

describe('proof provider', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    document.body.innerHTML = '';
    window.history.replaceState({}, '', '/on-demand');
  });

  it('normalizes queue items into the shared candidate shape', () => {
    document.body.innerHTML = loadFixture('queue.html');
    const config = proofProvider.getWatchConfig(platformConfigs.proof);
    const adapter = proofProvider.createAdapter(document, {
      ...config,
      networkSnapshot: loadJsonFixture('queue-state.json').networkSnapshot,
    });

    const container = adapter.resolveContainer();
    expect(container).not.toBeNull();
    expect(adapter.detectInQueue()).toBe(true);
    expect(adapter.detectActiveSession()).toBe(false);
    expect(adapter.detectPausedReason()).toBeNull();

    const candidates = adapter.getCandidates(container!);
    expect(candidates).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(candidates[0]?.text).toContain('Accept');
    expect(candidates[0]?.selector).toContain('accept-request');
  });

  it('detects active accepted-session state from the accepted fixture', () => {
    document.body.innerHTML = loadFixture('accepted-client.html');
    const config = proofProvider.getWatchConfig(platformConfigs.proof);
    const adapter = proofProvider.createAdapter(document, {
      ...config,
      networkSnapshot: loadJsonFixture('accepted-client-state.json').networkSnapshot,
    });

    expect(adapter.detectActiveSession()).toBe(true);
    expect(adapter.detectPausedReason()).toBe('active_session');
  });

  describe('isNoData — false positive regression', () => {
    it('returns false when a live session button is present even if hidden empty-state text is in DOM', () => {
      // Regression: telemetry (proof-extension-export-1773983074440.json) showed
      // isNoData() fired during a 154ms session window because container.textContent
      // includes CSS-hidden child elements — the "This queue is empty right now." text
      // inside the button's disabled-state span was still present in textContent even
      // when the button was enabled and a session was in the queue.
      // Fix: use container.innerText which only returns visible text.
      document.body.innerHTML = `
        <main id="main-content">
          <button class="JJpL5HZeaLv8T2CwtdDg SPG1laluCt2Az6SzbLtr">
            Start Retail Session
            <span>1 person in the queue</span>
            <span>Ryan Joshua Hotaling</span>
            <span>00:00</span>
            <span style="display:none">This queue is empty right now.</span>
          </button>
        </main>
      `;
      window.history.replaceState({}, '', '/on-demand-queue');
      const config = proofProvider.getWatchConfig(platformConfigs.proof);
      const adapter = proofProvider.createAdapter(document, config);
      const container = adapter.resolveContainer();
      expect(container).not.toBeNull();
      // textContent would include the hidden span → false positive
      // innerText skips it → should NOT report no-data
      expect(adapter.isNoData(container!)).toBe(false);
    });

    it('returns true when the queue genuinely has no visible content', () => {
      document.body.innerHTML = `
        <main id="main-content">
          <p>No requests available</p>
        </main>
      `;
      window.history.replaceState({}, '', '/on-demand-queue');
      const config = proofProvider.getWatchConfig(platformConfigs.proof);
      const adapter = proofProvider.createAdapter(document, config);
      const container = adapter.resolveContainer();
      expect(container).not.toBeNull();
      expect(adapter.isNoData(container!)).toBe(true);
    });
  });

  describe('getCandidates keyword matching — retail session button', () => {
    it('matches "Start Retail Session" button text with default joinKeywords', () => {
      // Regression: telemetry confirmed this button text when a session enters the Proof
      // on-demand queue. The old keywords ['accept','meeting request','start session','on demand']
      // all failed because 'start retail session'.includes('start session') === false.
      document.body.innerHTML = `
        <main id="main-content">
          <button class="JJpL5HZeaLv8T2CwtdDg SPG1laluCt2Az6SzbLtr">
            Start Retail Session
            <span>1 person in the queue</span>
            <span>Wendy Lai Feng</span>
            <span>00:01</span>
          </button>
        </main>
      `;
      window.history.replaceState({}, '', '/on-demand-queue');
      const config = proofProvider.getWatchConfig(platformConfigs.proof);
      const adapter = proofProvider.createAdapter(document, config);
      const container = adapter.resolveContainer();
      expect(container).not.toBeNull();
      const candidates = adapter.getCandidates(container!);
      expect(candidates.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
      expect(candidates[0]?.text).toContain('Start Retail Session');
    });

    it('matches "Start Business Session" button text with default joinKeywords', () => {
      document.body.innerHTML = `
        <main id="main-content">
          <button class="JJpL5HZeaLv8T2CwtdDg SPG1laluCt2Az6SzbLtr">
            Start Business Session
            <span>1 person in the queue</span>
          </button>
        </main>
      `;
      window.history.replaceState({}, '', '/on-demand-queue');
      const config = proofProvider.getWatchConfig(platformConfigs.proof);
      const adapter = proofProvider.createAdapter(document, config);
      const container = adapter.resolveContainer();
      expect(container).not.toBeNull();
      const candidates = adapter.getCandidates(container!);
      expect(candidates.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    });

    it('does not claim from empty-queue disabled button — isNoData detects it', () => {
      document.body.innerHTML = `
        <main id="main-content">
          <button class="JJpL5HZeaLv8T2CwtdDg" disabled>
            Start Retail Session
            <span>This queue is empty right now.</span>
          </button>
        </main>
      `;
      window.history.replaceState({}, '', '/on-demand-queue');
      const config = proofProvider.getWatchConfig(platformConfigs.proof);
      const adapter = proofProvider.createAdapter(document, config);
      const container = adapter.resolveContainer();
      expect(container).not.toBeNull();
      // The disabled button may appear in getCandidates, but isNoData correctly
      // detects the empty queue state and prevents any claim attempt.
      expect(adapter.isNoData(container!)).toBe(true);
    });
  });
});

==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/apps/chrome-extensions/proof-extension/src/tests/unit/service_worker/message-handlers.test.ts ====
import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, vi } from 'vitest';

// Mock message types
const MESSAGE_TYPES = {
  GET_STATE: 'NOTARY_GET_STATE',
  START_WATCH: 'NOTARY_START_WATCH',
  STOP_WATCH: 'NOTARY_STOP_WATCH',
  PAUSE_WATCH: 'NOTARY_PAUSE_WATCH',
  TEST_SOUND: 'NOTARY_TEST_SOUND',
  TEST_NOTIFICATION: 'NOTARY_TEST_NOTIFICATION',
  TEST_BUTTON_CLICK: 'NOTARY_TEST_BUTTON_CLICK',
  DEBUG_PAGE_STATE: 'NOTARY_DEBUG_PAGE_STATE',
} as const;

type WatchStatus = 'idle' | 'watching' | 'paused' | 'error';

interface WatchState {
  status: WatchStatus;
  tabId?: number;
  lastError?: string;
}

interface MessageResponse {
  ok: boolean;
  error?: string;
  watch?: WatchState;
  [key: string]: unknown;
}

describe('Service Worker Message Handlers', () => {
  let watchState: WatchState;
  let mockSendResponse: vi.Mock;

  beforeEach(() => {
    watchState = { status: 'idle' };
    mockSendResponse = vi.fn();
  });

  describe('GET_STATE Handler', () => {
    it('should return current state', () => {
      // Arrange
      const message = { type: MESSAGE_TYPES.GET_STATE };

      // Act
      const response: MessageResponse = {
        ok: true,
        state: {
          settings: {},
          watch: watchState,
          logs: [],
        },
      };

      mockSendResponse(response);

      // Assert
      expect(mockSendResponse).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          ok: true,
          state: expect.any(Object),
        })
      );
    });

    it('should exclude credentials from state response', () => {
      // Arrange
      const settings = {
        credentials: {
          username: 'test@example.com',
          password: 'secret123',
        },
        watchIntervalMs: 2000,
      };

      // Act
      const safeSettings = { ...settings, credentials: {} };
      const response: MessageResponse = {
        ok: true,
        state: {
          settings: safeSettings,
          watch: watchState,
          logs: [],

      // Act
      const successResponse: MessageResponse = { ok: true };

      // Assert
      expect(successResponse.ok).toBeDefined();
      expect(errorResponse.ok).toBeDefined();
    });

    it('should include error field when ok is false', () => {
      // Act
      const response: MessageResponse = {
        ok: false,
        error: 'Something went wrong',

  describe('Async Message Handling', () => {

        await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 10));
        return { ok: true, result: 'Success' };
      };

      // Act
      const response = await asyncOperation();

      // Assert
      expect(response.ok).toBe(true);
      expect(response.result).toBe('Success');
    });

    it('should timeout long-running operations', async () => {
      // Arrange
      const timeout = 100;
      const longOperation = new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 200));

      // Act
      const timeoutPromise = new Promise((_, reject) =>
        setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('Timeout')), timeout)
      );

      // Assert
      await expect(Promise.race([longOperation, timeoutPromise])).rejects.toThrow('Timeout');
    });
  });
});

// Mock types based on the service worker
type WatchStatus = 'idle' | 'watching' | 'paused' | 'error';

interface WatchState {
  status: WatchStatus;
  lastCheckedAt?: string;
  lastResult?: string;
  tabId?: number;
  lastOpenCalls?: string[];
  lastError?: string;
}

interface NotarySettings {
  watchIntervalMs: number;
  overlayEnabled: boolean;
  highlightEnabled: boolean;
  audioEnabled: boolean;
  notificationRepeats: number;
  autoLogin: boolean;
  metricsEnabled: boolean;
  selectors: {
    emailInput: string;
    passwordInput: string;
    submitButton: string;
    dashboardReady: string;
    openCallsSection: string;
    openCallsNoData: string;
    openCallsButtons: string;
  };
}

interface LogEntry {
  timestamp: string;
  level: 'debug' | 'info' | 'warn' | 'error';
  message: string;
  data?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

  let settings: NotarySettings;

      highlightEnabled: true,

      autoLogin: false,
      metricsEnabled: false,

        emailInput: '#email',

        dashboardReady: '.dashboard',

        openCallsNoData: '.no-data',
        openCallsButtons: 'button',
      },
    };
    logEntries = [];
  });

      expect(settings.highlightEnabled).toBe(true);
      expect(settings.audioEnabled).toBe(true);
      expect(settings.notificationRepeats).toBe(5);
      expect(settings.autoLogin).toBe(false);
      expect(settings.metricsEnabled).toBe(false);
    });

    it('should initialize with idle watch state', () => {
      expect(watchState.status).toBe('idle');

  describe('Watch State Transitions', () => {

    });

      // Arrange

        tabId: 123,

      // Act
      watchState = {
        ...watchState,
        status: 'paused',
        lastResult: 'Button clicked, watch paused',
      };

      // Assert
      expect(watchState.status).toBe('paused');
      expect(watchState.lastResult).toContain('paused');
      expect(watchState.tabId).toBe(123); // Preserves tab ID
    });

    it('should transition from paused to watching', () => {
      // Arrange
      watchState = {
        status: 'paused',
        tabId: 123,
        lastResult: 'Paused',
      };

      // Act

      // Act

      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),

      // Assert

    });

    it('should clear all log entries', () => {

  describe('Phase 16 — Phantom Session Fixes', () => {
    it('startWatch clears the stale network snapshot before arming watch (Fix C)', () => {
      // Models the Fix C behaviour: networkSnapshotByTab.delete(tabId) is called
      // during startWatch so stale AcceptMeetingRequest operation names cannot
      // trigger an immediate active_session pause on the next evaluate cycle.
      const networkSnapshotByTab = new Map<number, { operationNames: string[] }>();
      networkSnapshotByTab.set(1, { operationNames: ['AcceptMeetingRequest'] });

      // Simulate startWatch clearing the snapshot
      const tabId = 1;
      networkSnapshotByTab.delete(tabId);

      expect(networkSnapshotByTab.has(tabId)).toBe(false);
    });

    it('active_session events arriving within the grace window do not trigger confirmActiveSession (Fix D)', () => {
      // Models the Fix D grace-period guard.
      const GRACE_PERIOD_MS = 3000;
      let confirmCalled = false;
      const confirmActiveSession = () => { confirmCalled = true; };

      // Simulate startWatch setting watchStartedAt
      const watchStartedAt = Date.now();

      // Simulate a DOM event arriving 500ms later (within grace window)
      const eventArrivalOffset = 500;
      const inGracePeriod =
        watchStartedAt !== null &&
        watchStartedAt + eventArrivalOffset - watchStartedAt < GRACE_PERIOD_MS;

      if (!inGracePeriod) {
        confirmActiveSession();
      }

      expect(confirmCalled).toBe(false);
    });

    it('active_session events arriving after the grace window do trigger confirmActiveSession (Fix D)', () => {
      // The guard must allow genuine active-session pauses once the grace period elapses.
      const GRACE_PERIOD_MS = 3000;
      let confirmCalled = false;
      const confirmActiveSession = () => { confirmCalled = true; };

      // Simulate watchStartedAt 4 seconds ago
      const watchStartedAt = Date.now() - 4000;

      const inGracePeriod =
        watchStartedAt !== null &&
        Date.now() - watchStartedAt < GRACE_PERIOD_MS;

      if (!inGracePeriod) {
        confirmActiveSession();
      }

      expect(confirmCalled).toBe(true);
    });
  });
});

function createState(): NotaryAppState {

function getButtonByText(container: HTMLElement, labelText: string): HTMLButtonElement {
  const button = Array.from(container.querySelectorAll('button')).find(node =>
    node.textContent?.includes(labelText)
  );
  if (!(button instanceof HTMLButtonElement)) {
    throw new Error(`Missing button: ${labelText}`);
  }
  return button;
}

import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';

import {
  installBlueNotaryPageMonitor,
  runBlueNotaryApiClaimAssist,
} from '../../../socket/blue-notary-page-monitor.js';

const MONITOR_KEY = '__REMOTE_NOTARY_BLUE_MONITOR__';
const CHANNEL = 'REMOTE_NOTARY_PAGE_MONITOR';

function restoreMonitor() {
  const state = (window as typeof window & Record<string, any>)[MONITOR_KEY];
  if (!state) return;
  if (state.originalFetch) {
    (window as typeof window & Record<string, any>).fetch = state.originalFetch;
  }
  if (state.OriginalWebSocket) {
    (window as typeof window & Record<string, any>).WebSocket = state.OriginalWebSocket;
  }
  XMLHttpRequest.prototype.open = state.originalXHROpen;
  XMLHttpRequest.prototype.send = state.originalXHRSend;
  XMLHttpRequest.prototype.setRequestHeader = state.originalXHRSetRequestHeader;
  delete (window as typeof window & Record<string, any>)[MONITOR_KEY];
}

describe('blue-notary-page-monitor', () => {
  afterEach(() => {
    restoreMonitor();
    vi.restoreAllMocks();
  });

  it('emits network and socket signals for claim-eligible fetch activity', async () => {
    const postMessageSpy = vi.spyOn(window, 'postMessage');

    (window as typeof window & Record<string, any>).fetch = vi.fn(async () =>
      new Response('Meeting in progress for this session', {
        status: 200,
        headers: {
          'content-type': 'application/json',
        },
      })
    );

    installBlueNotaryPageMonitor({
      enabled: true,
      mode: 'observe-api-eligibility',
      deepTrace: true,
    });

    await window.fetch('/api/open-call/claim', {
      method: 'POST',
      body: JSON.stringify({ action: 'pick up session' }),
      headers: {
        'content-type': 'application/json',
      },
    });

    const emittedPayloads = postMessageSpy.mock.calls
      .map(call => call[0] as { source?: string; type?: string; payload?: Record<string, unknown> })
      .filter(payload => payload?.source === CHANNEL);

    expect(emittedPayloads.some(payload => payload.type === 'network')).toBe(true);
    expect(
      emittedPayloads.some(
        payload =>
          payload.type === 'socket' &&
          payload.payload?.claimEligibilitySignal === true
      )
    ).toBe(true);
    expect(
      emittedPayloads.some(
        payload =>
          payload.type === 'socket' &&
          payload.payload?.activeSessionSignal === true
      )
    ).toBe(true);
  });

  it('replays the last captured claim template through API claim assist', async () => {
    let fetchCount = 0;
    (window as typeof window & Record<string, any>).fetch = vi.fn(async () => {
      fetchCount += 1;
      return new Response(`claim-response-${fetchCount}`, {
        status: 200,
        headers: {
          'content-type': 'application/json',
        },
      });
    });

    installBlueNotaryPageMonitor({
      enabled: true,
      mode: 'opt-in-auto-claim',
      deepTrace: false,
    });

    await window.fetch('/api/open-call/claim', {
      method: 'POST',
      body: 'pick up session',
    });

    const result = await runBlueNotaryApiClaimAssist();

    expect(result.ok).toBe(true);
    expect(result.status).toBe(200);
    expect(fetchCount).toBe(2);
  });
});



==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/apps/chrome-extensions/proof-extension/src/tests/unit/utils/diagnostics-stores.test.ts ====
import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';

import {
  appendRunLog,
  appendRunLogs,
  clearRunLogs,
  getRunLog,
} from '../../../utils/run-log-store.js';
import {
  appendWatchMetric,
  appendWatchMetrics,
  clearWatchMetrics,
  getWatchMetrics,
} from '../../../utils/watch-metrics.js';
import {
  appendDomDeltaEntry,
  appendDomDeltaEntries,
  clearDomDeltaEntries,
  getDomDeltaEntries,
} from '../../../utils/dom-delta-probe.js';

type StorageArea = Record<string, unknown>;

function createChromeStorage() {
  const localStore: StorageArea = {};
  const sessionStore: StorageArea = {};

  const getArea = (area: StorageArea) => async (key?: string | string[] | null) => {
    if (key === null || key === undefined) {
      return { ...area };
    }
    if (Array.isArray(key)) {
      return key.reduce<Record<string, unknown>>((acc, item) => {
        acc[item] = area[item];
        return acc;
      }, {});
    }
    return { [key]: area[key] };
  };

  const setArea = (area: StorageArea) => async (value: Record<string, unknown>) => {
    Object.assign(area, value);
  };

  const removeArea = (area: StorageArea) => async (key: string | string[]) => {
    const keys = Array.isArray(key) ? key : [key];
    for (const item of keys) {
      delete area[item];
    }
  };

  return {
    localStore,
    sessionStore,
    chrome: {
      storage: {
        local: {
          get: getArea(localStore),
          set: setArea(localStore),
          remove: removeArea(localStore),
        },
        session: {
          get: getArea(sessionStore),
          set: setArea(sessionStore),
          remove: removeArea(sessionStore),
        },
      },
    },
  };
}

describe('diagnostics stores', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    const { chrome } = createChromeStorage();
    vi.stubGlobal('chrome', chrome);
  });

  it('stores and clears run logs by run id', async () => {
    await appendRunLog('run-a', {
      timestamp: '2026-03-17T20:00:00.000Z',
      level: 'info',
      message: 'first',
    });
    await appendRunLog('run-b', {
      timestamp: '2026-03-17T20:00:01.000Z',
      level: 'warn',
      message: 'second',
    });

    expect(await getRunLog('run-a')).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(await getRunLog('run-b')).toHaveLength(1);

    await clearRunLogs('run-a');

    expect(await getRunLog('run-a')).toEqual([]);
    expect(await getRunLog('run-b')).toHaveLength(1);

    await clearRunLogs();
    expect(await getRunLog('run-b')).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('stores and clears watch metrics', async () => {
    await appendWatchMetric({
      recordedAt: '2026-03-17T20:01:00.000Z',
      buttonCount: 1,
      buttonText: 'Join as Witness',
      reasonCode: 'change_detected',
    });

    const metrics = await getWatchMetrics();
    expect(metrics).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(metrics[0]?.buttonText).toBe('Join as Witness');

    await clearWatchMetrics();
    expect(await getWatchMetrics()).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('stores and clears DOM delta entries', async () => {
    await appendDomDeltaEntry({
      recordedAt: '2026-03-17T20:02:00.000Z',
      mutationType: 'childList',
      addedNodes: 1,
      removedNodes: 0,
      targetTag: 'DIV',
    });

    const entries = await getDomDeltaEntries();
    expect(entries).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(entries[0]?.mutationType).toBe('childList');

    await clearDomDeltaEntries();
    expect(await getDomDeltaEntries()).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('prepends batched diagnostics entries in newest-first order', async () => {
    await appendRunLogs('run-batch', [
      {
        timestamp: '2026-03-18T15:00:00.000Z',
        level: 'info',
        message: 'first',
      },
      {
        timestamp: '2026-03-18T15:00:01.000Z',
        level: 'warn',
        message: 'second',
      },
    ]);
    await appendWatchMetrics([
      {
        recordedAt: '2026-03-18T15:01:00.000Z',
        buttonCount: 1,
        buttonText: 'older',
      },
      {
        recordedAt: '2026-03-18T15:01:01.000Z',
        buttonCount: 2,
        buttonText: 'newer',
      },
    ]);
    await appendDomDeltaEntries([
      {
        recordedAt: '2026-03-18T15:02:00.000Z',
        mutationType: 'attributes',
        addedNodes: 0,
        removedNodes: 0,
        attributeName: 'disabled',
      },
      {
        recordedAt: '2026-03-18T15:02:01.000Z',
        mutationType: 'childList',
        addedNodes: 1,
        removedNodes: 0,
      },
    ]);

    expect((await getRunLog('run-batch')).map(entry => entry.message)).toEqual([
      'second',
      'first',
    ]);
    expect((await getWatchMetrics()).map(entry => entry.buttonText)).toEqual([
      'newer',
      'older',
    ]);
    expect((await getDomDeltaEntries()).map(entry => entry.mutationType)).toEqual([
      'childList',
      'attributes',
    ]);
  });
});



==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/apps/chrome-extensions/proof-extension/src/tests/unit/watch/claim-executor.test.ts ====
import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, vi } from 'vitest';
import {
  createBlueNotaryWatchAdapter,
  type WatchCandidateDescriptor,
} from '../../../watch/domain-watch-adapter';
import { executeClaimWithFallbacks } from '../../../watch/claim-executor';

function getCandidate(): WatchCandidateDescriptor {
  const button = document.querySelector('button') as HTMLButtonElement;
  const rect = button.getBoundingClientRect();
  return {
    element: button,
    text: button.textContent || '',
    selector: 'button',
    x: rect.left + rect.width / 2,
    y: rect.top + rect.height / 2,
  };
}

describe('claim-executor', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    document.body.innerHTML = `
      <div class="card-draggable-wrapper">
        <button>Join as Witness</button>
      </div>
    `;
  });

  it('succeeds with direct-click when the target is still connected', () => {
    const button = document.querySelector('button') as HTMLButtonElement;
    const clickSpy = vi.spyOn(button, 'click');
    const attempts: string[] = [];
    const adapter = createBlueNotaryWatchAdapter(document, {
      containerSelector: '.card-draggable-wrapper',
      buttonSelector: 'button',
      keywords: ['join'],
    });

    const result = executeClaimWithFallbacks({
      document,
      adapter,
      candidate: getCandidate(),
      buttonText: 'Join as Witness',
      onAttempt: attempt => attempts.push(`${attempt.strategy}:${attempt.success}`),
    });

    expect(result.strategy).toBe('direct-click');
    expect(result.success).toBe(true);
    expect(clickSpy).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(attempts).toEqual(['direct-click:true']);
  });

  it('falls back to selector-refresh-click when the original target disconnects', () => {
    const original = document.querySelector('button') as HTMLButtonElement;
    const replacement = document.createElement('button');
    replacement.textContent = 'Join as Witness';
    const adapter = createBlueNotaryWatchAdapter(document, {
      containerSelector: '.card-draggable-wrapper',
      buttonSelector: 'button',
      keywords: ['join'],
    });
    const attempts: string[] = [];

    vi.spyOn(original, 'click').mockImplementation(() => {
      original.remove();
      document.querySelector('.card-draggable-wrapper')?.appendChild(replacement);
      throw new Error('stale element');
    });
    const replacementClick = vi.spyOn(replacement, 'click');

    const result = executeClaimWithFallbacks({
      document,
      adapter,
      candidate: getCandidate(),
      buttonText: 'Join as Witness',
      onAttempt: attempt => attempts.push(`${attempt.strategy}:${attempt.success}`),
    });

    expect(result.strategy).toBe('selector-refresh-click');
    expect(result.success).toBe(true);
    expect(replacementClick).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(attempts).toEqual([
      'direct-click:false',
      'selector-refresh-click:true',
    ]);
  });

  it('falls back to coordinate-click when click-based strategies fail', () => {
    const button = document.querySelector('button') as HTMLButtonElement;
    const adapter = createBlueNotaryWatchAdapter(document, {
      containerSelector: '.card-draggable-wrapper',
      buttonSelector: 'button',
      keywords: ['join'],
    });
    const attempts: string[] = [];

    vi.spyOn(button, 'click').mockImplementation(() => {
      throw new Error('click failed');
    });
    Object.defineProperty(document, 'elementFromPoint', {
      configurable: true,
      value: vi.fn().mockReturnValue(button),
    });
    const dispatchSpy = vi.spyOn(button, 'dispatchEvent');

    const result = executeClaimWithFallbacks({
      document,
      adapter,
      candidate: getCandidate(),
      buttonText: 'Join as Witness',
      onAttempt: attempt => attempts.push(`${attempt.strategy}:${attempt.success}`),
    });

    expect(result.strategy).toBe('coordinate-click');
    expect(result.success).toBe(true);
    expect(dispatchSpy).toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(attempts).toEqual([
      'direct-click:false',
      'selector-refresh-click:false',
      'coordinate-click:true',
    ]);
  });
});

==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/apps/chrome-extensions/proof-extension/src/tests/unit/watch/platform-scheduler.test.ts ====
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { createDefaultSchedulerState } from '../../../platforms/default-settings.js';
import {
  acquireMutex,
  getPauseReasonForSession,
  noteSuccessfulClaim,
  releaseMutexIfClear,
  setOperatorOverride,
} from '../../../watch/platform-scheduler.js';
import { createNewSession } from '../../../watch/watch-session-state.js';

describe('platform scheduler', () => {
  it('pauses other sessions when a mutex is active', () => {
    const state = acquireMutex(createDefaultSchedulerState(), 'proof', 22);
    const blockedSession = createNewSession(11, 'blue-notary');

    expect(getPauseReasonForSession(state, blockedSession)).toBe('active_session');
  });

  it('allows override to bypass mutex but not rate limits', () => {
    let state = acquireMutex(createDefaultSchedulerState(), 'proof', 22);
    state = setOperatorOverride(state, true, 15 * 60 * 1000);

    const otherSession = createNewSession(11, 'blue-notary');
    expect(getPauseReasonForSession(state, otherSession)).toBeNull();

    for (let index = 0; index < 6; index += 1) {
      state = noteSuccessfulClaim(state, 'blue-notary').state;
    }

    expect(getPauseReasonForSession(state, otherSession)).toBe('rate_limit');
  });

  it('releases the mutex after two clear heartbeats', () => {
    let state = acquireMutex(createDefaultSchedulerState(), 'proof', 22);
    state = releaseMutexIfClear(state, false);
    expect(state.mutex.active).toBe(true);
    expect(state.mutex.releaseChecks).toBe(1);

    state = releaseMutexIfClear(state, false);
    expect(state.mutex.active).toBe(false);
    expect(state.mutex.releaseChecks).toBe(0);
  });
});

import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { readFileSync } from 'fs';
import path from 'path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'url';

import {
  createDomWatchController,
  type DomWatchEvent,
  type WatchClaimAttemptEvent,
} from '../../../content/watch-observer.js';

const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
const __dirname = path.dirname(__filename);

function loadFixture(name: string): string {
  const fixturePath = path.resolve(
    __dirname,
    '../../../../data/blue-notary-html-elements/dashboard',
    name
  );
  return readFileSync(fixturePath, 'utf8');
}

async function flushObserver(): Promise<void> {
  await Promise.resolve();
  await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 150));
}

describe('watch fixture replay', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    document.body.innerHTML = '';
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    document.body.innerHTML = '';
    vi.restoreAllMocks();
  });

  it('replays the no-data dashboard fixture without claim attempts', async () => {
    document.body.innerHTML = loadFixture('open-calls-container.html');

    const events: DomWatchEvent[] = [];
    const attempts: WatchClaimAttemptEvent[] = [];

    const controller = createDomWatchController(
      document,
      {
        containerSelector: '.card-draggable-wrapper',
        buttonSelector: 'button',
        headingText: 'Open Calls',
        noDataSelector: '.tw-text-center.tw-text-gray-500',
        keywords: ['join', 'pick up'],
      },
      {
        onEvent: event => events.push(event),
        onClaimAttempt: attempt => attempts.push(attempt),
      }
    );

    await flushObserver();
    controller.stop();

    expect(events.map(event => event.reasonCode)).toContain('no_data');
    expect(attempts).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('replays the populated dashboard fixture and records one claim path', async () => {
    document.body.innerHTML = loadFixture('open-calls-table-populated.html');

    const events: DomWatchEvent[] = [];
    const attempts: WatchClaimAttemptEvent[] = [];

    const controller = createDomWatchController(
      document,
      {
        containerSelector: '.card-draggable-wrapper',
        buttonSelector: 'button',
        headingText: 'Open Calls',
        noDataSelector: '.tw-text-center.tw-text-gray-500',
        keywords: ['pick up session', 'join as witness'],
      },
      {
        onEvent: event => events.push(event),
        onClaimAttempt: attempt => attempts.push(attempt),
      }
    );

    await flushObserver();
    controller.stop();

    expect(events.some(event => event.clicked)).toBe(true);
    expect(attempts).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(attempts[0]?.strategy).toBe('direct-click');
    expect(attempts[0]?.success).toBe(true);
  });
});

      expect(outline?.style.width).toBe('0px');
      expect(outline?.style.height).toBe('0px');
    });

    it('shows scoped outline when container is resolved', () => {
      controller.mount({
        document,
        containerSelector: '.open-calls-section',
        label: 'WATCHING',
        statusText: 'ACTIVE',
      });
      const overlayRoot = document.getElementById('notary-watch-overlay-scoped');
      expect(overlayRoot).toBeTruthy();

      expect(outline?.style.height).toBeDefined();
    });
  });

  describe('idempotent mount', () => {

      controller.mount({
        document,
        containerSelector: '.open-calls-section',
        label: 'W1',
        statusText: 'ACTIVE',
      });
      const countBefore = document.querySelectorAll('#notary-watch-overlay-scoped').length;
      controller.mount({
        document,
        containerSelector: '.open-calls-section',
        label: 'W2',
        statusText: 'ACTIVE',
      });
      const countAfter = document.querySelectorAll('#notary-watch-overlay-scoped').length;
      expect(countAfter).toBe(1);
      expect(countBefore).toBe(1);
    });

    it('isMounted returns true after mount and false after unmount', () => {
      expect(controller.isMounted()).toBe(false);
      controller.mount({
        document,
        containerSelector: '.open-calls-section',
        label: 'W',
        statusText: 'A',
      });
      expect(controller.isMounted()).toBe(true);
      controller.unmount();
      expect(controller.isMounted()).toBe(false);
    });

  describe('idempotent unmount', () => {

        label: 'W',

      });

      });

      expect(outlines?.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2);
    });
  });

  describe('update', () => {

      controller.mount({

        label: 'INIT',

==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/apps/chrome-extensions/proof-extension/src/tests/unit/watch/watch-session-state.test.ts ====
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import {
  createNewSession,
  updateHeartbeat,
  markPaused,
  markStopped,
  markRehydrated,
  serializeSessions,
  deserializeSessions,
  type WatchSessionState,
} from '../../../watch/watch-session-state';

describe('watch-session-state', () => {
  describe('createNewSession', () => {
    it('creates a session with required fields for the given tab', () => {
      const state = createNewSession(123);
      expect(state.tabId).toBe(123);
      expect(state.runId).toBeDefined();
      expect(state.sessionId).toBeDefined();
      expect(state.leaseOwner).toBe(123);
      expect(state.heartbeatAt).toBeDefined();
      expect(state.status).toBe('watching');
      expect(typeof state.runId).toBe('string');
      expect(typeof state.sessionId).toBe('string');
    });

    it('generates distinct runId and sessionId per call', () => {
      const a = createNewSession(1);
      const b = createNewSession(1);
      expect(a.runId).not.toBe(b.runId);
      expect(a.sessionId).not.toBe(b.sessionId);
    });
  });

  describe('updateHeartbeat', () => {
    it('returns a new state with heartbeatAt set', () => {
      const state = createNewSession(1);
      const updated = updateHeartbeat(state);
      expect(updated).not.toBe(state);
      expect(updated.heartbeatAt).toBeDefined();
      expect(typeof updated.heartbeatAt).toBe('string');
      expect(updated.tabId).toBe(state.tabId);
      expect(updated.sessionId).toBe(state.sessionId);
    });
  });

  describe('markPaused', () => {
    it('sets status to paused and optionally stopReason', () => {
      const state = createNewSession(1);
      const paused = markPaused(state, 'User paused');
      expect(paused.status).toBe('paused');
      expect(paused.stopReason).toBe('User paused');
      expect(paused.tabId).toBe(1);
    });
  });

  describe('markStopped', () => {
    it('sets status to stopped and stopReason', () => {
      const state = createNewSession(1);
      const stopped = markStopped(state, 'Stopped');
      expect(stopped.status).toBe('stopped');
      expect(stopped.stopReason).toBe('Stopped');
    });
  });

  describe('markRehydrated', () => {
    it('sets rehydratedAt and updates heartbeat', () => {
      const state = createNewSession(1);
      const rehydrated = markRehydrated(state);
      expect(rehydrated.rehydratedAt).toBeDefined();
      expect(rehydrated.heartbeatAt).toBeDefined();
    });
  });

  describe('serializeSessions / deserializeSessions', () => {
    it('round-trips a map of sessions', () => {
      const state1 = createNewSession(1);
      const state2 = createNewSession(2);
      const map = new Map<number, WatchSessionState>();
      map.set(1, state1);
      map.set(2, state2);
      const serialized = serializeSessions(map);
      expect(serialized['1']).toEqual(state1);
      expect(serialized['2']).toEqual(state2);
      const deserialized = deserializeSessions(serialized);
      expect(deserialized.size).toBe(2);
      expect(deserialized.get(1)).toEqual(state1);
      expect(deserialized.get(2)).toEqual(state2);
    });

    it('deserializeSessions returns empty map for null or non-object', () => {
      expect(deserializeSessions(null).size).toBe(0);
      expect(deserializeSessions(undefined).size).toBe(0);
      expect(deserializeSessions('').size).toBe(0);
      expect(deserializeSessions([]).size).toBe(0);
    });

    it('deserializeSessions skips invalid entries', () => {
      const raw = {
        '1': {
          tabId: 1,
          runId: 'r1',
          sessionId: 's1',
          leaseOwner: 1,
          heartbeatAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          status: 'watching',
        },
        '2': { bad: 'entry' },
        'x': { tabId: 2, runId: 'r2', sessionId: 's2', leaseOwner: 2, heartbeatAt: new Date().toISOString(), status: 'watching' },
      };
      const map = deserializeSessions(raw);
      expect(map.size).toBe(1);
      expect(map.get(1)?.sessionId).toBe('s1');
    });
  });

  describe('idempotent session semantics', () => {
    it('only one session per tab in a map', () => {
      const session = createNewSession(42);
      const map = new Map<number, WatchSessionState>();
      map.set(42, session);
      const existing = map.get(42);
      expect(existing?.status).toBe('watching');
      expect(map.size).toBe(1);
    });

    it('paused then resumed is still single session', () => {
      const state = createNewSession(1);
      const paused = markPaused(state, 'Paused');
      expect(paused.status).toBe('paused');
      const resumed = { ...paused, status: 'watching' as const, heartbeatAt: new Date().toISOString() };
      expect(resumed.status).toBe('watching');
      expect(resumed.sessionId).toBe(state.sessionId);
    });
  });
});

import type { ClaimAttemptTrace } from '../types/notary.js';

const CLAIM_TRACE_PREFIX = 'claim-trace:';
const MAX_CLAIM_TRACE_ENTRIES = 200;

function getClaimTraceKey(runId: string): string {
  return `${CLAIM_TRACE_PREFIX}${runId}`;
}

export async function appendClaimTraceEntries(
  runId: string,
  entries: ClaimAttemptTrace[]
): Promise<void> {
  if (entries.length === 0) return;
  const key = getClaimTraceKey(runId);
  const stored = await chrome.storage.session.get(key);
  const existing = Array.isArray(stored[key])
    ? (stored[key] as ClaimAttemptTrace[])
    : [];
  existing.unshift(...entries.slice().reverse());
  if (existing.length > MAX_CLAIM_TRACE_ENTRIES) {
    existing.length = MAX_CLAIM_TRACE_ENTRIES;
  }
  await chrome.storage.session.set({ [key]: existing });
}

export async function getClaimTraceEntries(
  runId?: string
): Promise<ClaimAttemptTrace[]> {
  if (!runId) {
    return [];
  }
  const key = getClaimTraceKey(runId);
  const stored = await chrome.storage.session.get(key);
  return Array.isArray(stored[key]) ? (stored[key] as ClaimAttemptTrace[]) : [];
}

export async function clearClaimTraceEntries(runId?: string): Promise<void> {
  if (runId) {
    await chrome.storage.session.remove(getClaimTraceKey(runId));
    return;
  }
  const stored = await chrome.storage.session.get(null);
  const keys = Object.keys(stored).filter(key => key.startsWith(CLAIM_TRACE_PREFIX));
  if (keys.length > 0) {
    await chrome.storage.session.remove(keys);
  }
}



==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/apps/chrome-extensions/proof-extension/src/utils/credential-storage.ts ====
/**
 * Secure Credential Storage
 *
 * Handles secure storage of credentials with encryption.
 * Credentials are never logged or exposed in telemetry.
 */

import { getSecureStorage } from '@chrome-ext/core-secure-storage';
import { logger } from '@chrome-ext/core-telemetry';
import type { NotaryCredentials } from '../types/notary.js';
import type { PlatformId } from '../platforms/types.js';

const LEGACY_CREDENTIAL_STORAGE_KEY = 'creds:blue-notary';

function getCredentialStorageKey(platform: PlatformId): string {
  return `creds:${platform}`;
}

/**
 * Redact username for logging (show first 2 chars, rest as *)
 */
function redactUsername(username: string): string {
  if (!username || username.length <= 2) {
    return '***';
  }
  return `${username.substring(0, 2)}${'*'.repeat(username.length - 2)}`;
}

/**
 * Get credentials from secure storage
 */
export async function getCredentials(
  platform: PlatformId = 'blue-notary'
): Promise<NotaryCredentials | null> {
  try {
    const storage = getSecureStorage();
    await storage.init();
    let creds = await storage.get<NotaryCredentials>(getCredentialStorageKey(platform));
    if (!creds && platform === 'blue-notary') {
      creds = await storage.get<NotaryCredentials>(LEGACY_CREDENTIAL_STORAGE_KEY);
      if (creds) {
        await storage.set(getCredentialStorageKey(platform), creds);
        await storage.remove(LEGACY_CREDENTIAL_STORAGE_KEY);
      }
    }
    return creds || null;
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Failed to get credentials', error as Error);
    return null;
  }
}

/**
 * Save credentials to secure storage
 */
export async function saveCredentials(
  credentials: NotaryCredentials,
  platform: PlatformId = 'blue-notary'
): Promise<void> {
  try {
    // Redact credentials before logging (never log passwords)
    logger.info('Saving credentials', {
      username: credentials.username ? redactUsername(credentials.username) : undefined,
    });

    const storage = getSecureStorage();
    await storage.init();
    await storage.set(getCredentialStorageKey(platform), credentials);
    if (platform === 'blue-notary') {
      await storage.remove(LEGACY_CREDENTIAL_STORAGE_KEY);
    }
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Failed to save credentials', error as Error);
    throw error;
  }
}

/**
 * Delete credentials from secure storage
 */
export async function deleteCredentials(
  platform: PlatformId = 'blue-notary'
): Promise<void> {
  try {
    logger.info('Deleting credentials');

    const storage = getSecureStorage();
    await storage.init();
    await storage.remove(getCredentialStorageKey(platform));
    if (platform === 'blue-notary') {
      await storage.remove(LEGACY_CREDENTIAL_STORAGE_KEY);
    }
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Failed to delete credentials', error as Error);
    throw error;
  }
}
