==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/apps/chrome-extensions/proof-extension/src/watch/claim-executor.ts ====
import type { WatchClaimStrategy } from '../types/notary.js';
import type {
  WatchCandidateDescriptor,
  WatchPlatformAdapter,
} from '../platforms/types.js';

export interface ClaimAttemptTelemetry {
  strategy: WatchClaimStrategy;
  success: boolean;
  reasonCode: string;
  buttonText?: string;
  candidateSelector?: string;
}

export interface ClaimExecutionOptions {
  document: Document;
  adapter: WatchPlatformAdapter;
  candidate: WatchCandidateDescriptor | null;
  buttonText?: string;
  onAttempt?: (attempt: ClaimAttemptTelemetry) => void;
}

export interface ClaimExecutionResult extends ClaimAttemptTelemetry {}

function emitAttempt(
  options: ClaimExecutionOptions,
  attempt: ClaimAttemptTelemetry
): ClaimAttemptTelemetry {
  options.onAttempt?.(attempt);
  return attempt;
}

function scrollIntoView(target: HTMLElement): void {
  try {
    target.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center', inline: 'center' });
  } catch {
    /* ignore */
  }
}

function dispatchMouseSequence(target: HTMLElement): void {
  const rect = target.getBoundingClientRect();
  const clientX = rect.left + rect.width / 2;
  const clientY = rect.top + rect.height / 2;

  for (const type of ['mousedown', 'mouseup', 'click']) {
    target.dispatchEvent(
      new MouseEvent(type, {
        bubbles: true,
        cancelable: true,
        clientX,
        clientY,
      })
    );
  }
}

function attemptDirectClick(
  options: ClaimExecutionOptions
): ClaimExecutionResult {
  const candidate = options.candidate;
  if (!candidate?.element) {
    return emitAttempt(options, {
      strategy: 'direct-click',
      success: false,
      reasonCode: 'candidate_missing',
      buttonText: options.buttonText,
    });
  }

  if (!candidate.element.isConnected) {
    return emitAttempt(options, {
      strategy: 'direct-click',
      success: false,
      reasonCode: 'disconnected_target',
      buttonText: candidate.text || options.buttonText,
      candidateSelector: candidate.selector,
    });
  }

  try {
    scrollIntoView(candidate.element);
    candidate.element.click();
    return emitAttempt(options, {
      strategy: 'direct-click',
      success: true,
      reasonCode: 'clicked',
      buttonText: candidate.text || options.buttonText,
      candidateSelector: candidate.selector,
    });
  } catch {
    return emitAttempt(options, {
      strategy: 'direct-click',
      success: false,
      reasonCode: 'direct_click_failed',
      buttonText: candidate.text || options.buttonText,
      candidateSelector: candidate.selector,
    });
  }
}

function attemptSelectorRefreshClick(
  options: ClaimExecutionOptions
): ClaimExecutionResult {
  const refreshed = options.adapter.findRefreshedCandidate(options.buttonText);
  if (!refreshed) {
    return emitAttempt(options, {
      strategy: 'selector-refresh-click',
      success: false,
      reasonCode: 'refreshed_candidate_missing',
      buttonText: options.buttonText,
    });
  }

  try {
    scrollIntoView(refreshed.element);
    dispatchMouseSequence(refreshed.element);
    refreshed.element.click();
    return emitAttempt(options, {
      strategy: 'selector-refresh-click',
      success: true,
      reasonCode: 'clicked',
      buttonText: refreshed.text || options.buttonText,
      candidateSelector: refreshed.selector,
    });
  } catch {
    return emitAttempt(options, {
      strategy: 'selector-refresh-click',
      success: false,
      reasonCode: 'selector_refresh_failed',
      buttonText: refreshed.text || options.buttonText,
      candidateSelector: refreshed.selector,
    });
  }
}

function attemptCoordinateClick(
  options: ClaimExecutionOptions
): ClaimExecutionResult {
  const candidate =
    options.adapter.findRefreshedCandidate(options.buttonText) ?? options.candidate;
  if (!candidate?.element) {
    return emitAttempt(options, {
      strategy: 'coordinate-click',
      success: false,
      reasonCode: 'coordinate_target_missing',
      buttonText: options.buttonText,
    });
  }

  const hitTarget = options.document.elementFromPoint(candidate.x, candidate.y);
  if (!(hitTarget instanceof HTMLElement)) {
    return emitAttempt(options, {
      strategy: 'coordinate-click',
      success: false,
      reasonCode: 'hit_target_missing',
      buttonText: candidate.text || options.buttonText,
      candidateSelector: candidate.selector,
    });
  }

  try {
    scrollIntoView(hitTarget);
    dispatchMouseSequence(hitTarget);
    return emitAttempt(options, {
      strategy: 'coordinate-click',
      success: true,
      reasonCode: 'clicked',
      buttonText: candidate.text || options.buttonText,
      candidateSelector: candidate.selector,
    });
  } catch {
    return emitAttempt(options, {
      strategy: 'coordinate-click',
      success: false,
      reasonCode: 'coordinate_dispatch_failed',
      buttonText: candidate.text || options.buttonText,
      candidateSelector: candidate.selector,
    });
  }
}

export function executeClaimWithFallbacks(
  options: ClaimExecutionOptions
): ClaimExecutionResult {
  const direct = attemptDirectClick(options);
  if (direct.success) return direct;

  const refreshed = attemptSelectorRefreshClick(options);
  if (refreshed.success) return refreshed;

  const coordinate = attemptCoordinateClick(options);
  return coordinate ?? {
    strategy: 'coordinate-click',
    success: false,
    reasonCode: 'no_attempts',
    buttonText: options.buttonText,
  };
}



==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/apps/chrome-extensions/proof-extension/src/watch/domain-watch-adapter.ts ====
import type {
  WatchCandidateDescriptor,
  WatchPlatformAdapter,
} from '../platforms/types.js';

export interface BlueNotaryWatchAdapterOptions {
  containerSelector: string;
  buttonSelector?: string;
  headingText?: string;
  noDataSelector?: string;
  keywords?: string[];
}

export interface BlueNotaryWatchAdapter extends WatchPlatformAdapter {}

const DEFAULT_BUTTON_SELECTOR = 'button,[role="button"],.q-btn';

function escapeSelectorValue(value: string): string {
  return value.replace(/["\\.#:[\]]/g, '\\$&');
}

function normalizeText(value: string | null | undefined): string {
  return (value ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
}

function matchesKeywords(text: string, keywords?: string[]): boolean {
  if (!keywords || keywords.length === 0) return true;
  const normalized = normalizeText(text);
  if (!normalized) return false;
  return keywords.some(keyword => normalized.includes(normalizeText(keyword)));
}

function isClickable(element: HTMLElement): boolean {
  if (element instanceof HTMLButtonElement && element.disabled) return false;
  if (element.getAttribute('aria-disabled') === 'true') return false;
  const style = window.getComputedStyle(element);
  if (style.display === 'none' || style.visibility === 'hidden') return false;
  return true;
}

function buildElementSelector(element: HTMLElement, fallbackSelector: string): string {
  if (element.id) {
    return `#${escapeSelectorValue(element.id)}`;
  }

  const testId = element.getAttribute('data-testid');
  if (testId) {
    return `[data-testid="${escapeSelectorValue(testId)}"]`;
  }

  const classes = Array.from(element.classList).slice(0, 2);
  if (classes.length > 0) {
    return `${element.tagName.toLowerCase()}.${classes
      .map(cls => escapeSelectorValue(cls))
      .join('.')}`;
  }

  return fallbackSelector;
}

function createDescriptor(
  element: HTMLElement,
  fallbackSelector: string
): WatchCandidateDescriptor {
  const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect();
  return {
    element,
    text: (element.textContent ?? '').trim(),
    selector: buildElementSelector(element, fallbackSelector),
    x: rect.left + rect.width / 2,
    y: rect.top + rect.height / 2,
  };
}

export function resolveBlueNotaryWatchContainer(
  documentRef: Document,
  options: Pick<BlueNotaryWatchAdapterOptions, 'containerSelector' | 'headingText'>
): Element | null {
  if (options.containerSelector) {
    const candidates = Array.from(
      documentRef.querySelectorAll(options.containerSelector)
    );
    if (candidates.length === 1) {
      return candidates[0];
    }
    if (candidates.length > 1 && options.headingText) {
      const heading = normalizeText(options.headingText);
      for (const candidate of candidates) {
        const section = candidate.closest('section');
        if (!section) continue;
        const headingEl = section.querySelector('h2');
        const headingText = normalizeText(headingEl?.textContent);
        if (headingText.includes(heading)) {
          return candidate;
        }
      }
    }
    if (candidates.length > 0) {
      return candidates[0];
    }
  }

  if (options.headingText) {
    const heading = normalizeText(options.headingText);
    const headings = Array.from(documentRef.querySelectorAll('h2'));
    for (const element of headings) {
      const text = normalizeText(element.textContent);
      if (!text.includes(heading)) continue;
      const section = element.closest('section');
      if (!section) continue;
      if (options.containerSelector) {
        const within = section.querySelector(options.containerSelector);
        if (within) return within;
      }
      return section;
    }
  }

  return null;
}

export function createBlueNotaryWatchAdapter(
  documentRef: Document,
  options: BlueNotaryWatchAdapterOptions
): BlueNotaryWatchAdapter {
  const resolveContainer = () =>
    resolveBlueNotaryWatchContainer(documentRef, {
      containerSelector: options.containerSelector,
      headingText: options.headingText,
    });

  const isNoData = (container: Element): boolean => {
    if (options.noDataSelector) {
      const noData = container.querySelector(options.noDataSelector);
      if (noData) return true;
    }

    const text = normalizeText(container.textContent);
    return text.includes('no data available');
  };

  const getCandidates = (container: Element): WatchCandidateDescriptor[] => {
    const selector = options.buttonSelector?.trim() || DEFAULT_BUTTON_SELECTOR;
    return Array.from(container.querySelectorAll(selector))
      .filter(
        element => element instanceof HTMLElement && isClickable(element)
      )
      .map(element =>
        createDescriptor(element as HTMLElement, selector)
      )
      .filter(candidate => matchesKeywords(candidate.text, options.keywords));
  };

  const findRefreshedCandidate = (
    buttonText?: string
  ): WatchCandidateDescriptor | null => {
    const container = resolveContainer();
    if (!container || isNoData(container)) return null;
    const candidates = getCandidates(container);
    if (candidates.length === 0) return null;

    if (buttonText) {
      const normalized = normalizeText(buttonText);
      const exact = candidates.find(candidate =>
        normalizeText(candidate.text) === normalized
      );
      if (exact) return exact;
    }

    return candidates[0] ?? null;
  };

  return {
    resolveContainer,
    isNoData,
    getCandidates,
    findRefreshedCandidate,
    detectActiveSession: () => false,
    detectInQueue: () => false,
    detectPausedReason: () => null,
    getNetworkSnapshot: () => undefined,
  };
}



==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/apps/chrome-extensions/proof-extension/src/watch/platform-scheduler.ts ====
import type { SchedulerState, SchedulerLeaseSummary, TokenBucketSnapshot } from '../types/notary.js';
import type { PauseReason, PlatformId } from '../platforms/types.js';
import type { WatchSessionState } from './watch-session-state.js';

function cloneBucket(bucket: TokenBucketSnapshot): TokenBucketSnapshot {
  return { ...bucket };
}

export function refillBucket(
  bucket: TokenBucketSnapshot,
  nowMs: number = Date.now()
): TokenBucketSnapshot {
  const lastRefillMs = Date.parse(bucket.lastRefillAt);
  if (Number.isNaN(lastRefillMs)) {
    return {
      ...bucket,
      tokens: bucket.capacity,
      lastRefillAt: new Date(nowMs).toISOString(),
    };
  }

  const elapsedHours = Math.max(0, nowMs - lastRefillMs) / 3_600_000;
  const replenished = Math.min(
    bucket.capacity,
    bucket.tokens + elapsedHours * bucket.refillPerHour
  );

  return {
    ...bucket,
    tokens: replenished,
    lastRefillAt: new Date(nowMs).toISOString(),
  };
}

export function consumeBucketToken(
  bucket: TokenBucketSnapshot,
  nowMs: number = Date.now()
): { bucket: TokenBucketSnapshot; allowed: boolean } {
  const refilled = refillBucket(bucket, nowMs);
  if (refilled.tokens < 1) {
    return { bucket: refilled, allowed: false };
  }
  return {
    allowed: true,
    bucket: {
      ...refilled,
      tokens: Math.max(0, refilled.tokens - 1),
      lastRefillAt: new Date(nowMs).toISOString(),
    },
  };
}

export function snapshotLeases(
  sessions: Iterable<WatchSessionState>
): SchedulerLeaseSummary[] {
  return Array.from(sessions).map(session => ({
    tabId: session.tabId,
    platform: session.platform,
    sessionId: session.sessionId,
    status: session.status,
    heartbeatAt: session.heartbeatAt,
    pauseReason: session.pauseReason,
  }));
}

export function withLeaseSnapshot(
  state: SchedulerState,
  sessions: Iterable<WatchSessionState>
): SchedulerState {
  return {
    ...state,
    leases: snapshotLeases(sessions),
  };
}

export function withSchedulerStatus(
  state: SchedulerState,
  status: SchedulerState['status'],
  runId?: string | null
): SchedulerState {
  return {
    ...state,
    status,
    runId: runId === undefined ? state.runId : runId,
  };
}

export function setOperatorOverride(
  state: SchedulerState,
  enabled: boolean,
  windowMs: number,
  nowMs: number = Date.now()
): SchedulerState {
  return {
    ...state,
    operatorOverride: enabled,
    overrideUntil: enabled ? new Date(nowMs + windowMs).toISOString() : undefined,
  };
}

export function isOverrideActive(
  state: SchedulerState,
  nowMs: number = Date.now()
): boolean {
  if (!state.operatorOverride || !state.overrideUntil) {
    return false;
  }
  const until = Date.parse(state.overrideUntil);
  return !Number.isNaN(until) && until > nowMs;
}

export function acquireMutex(
  state: SchedulerState,
  platform: PlatformId,
  tabId: number,
  reason: PauseReason = 'active_session'
): SchedulerState {
  return {
    ...state,
    mutex: {
      active: true,
      platform,
      tabId,
      reason,
      acquiredAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      releaseChecks: 0,
    },
  };
}

export function releaseMutexIfClear(
  state: SchedulerState,
  activeSessionStillDetected: boolean
): SchedulerState {
  if (!state.mutex.active) {
    return state;
  }

  if (activeSessionStillDetected) {
    return {
      ...state,
      mutex: {
        ...state.mutex,
        releaseChecks: 0,
      },
    };
  }

  const releaseChecks = (state.mutex.releaseChecks || 0) + 1;
  if (releaseChecks >= 2) {
    return {
      ...state,
      mutex: {
        active: false,
        releaseChecks: 0,
      },
    };
  }

  return {
    ...state,
    mutex: {
      ...state.mutex,
      releaseChecks,
    },
  };
}

export function noteSuccessfulClaim(
  state: SchedulerState,
  platform: PlatformId,
  nowMs: number = Date.now()
): { state: SchedulerState; rateLimited: boolean } {
  const platformBucket = consumeBucketToken(state.platformBuckets[platform], nowMs);
  const globalBucket = consumeBucketToken(state.globalBucket, nowMs);
  const nextState: SchedulerState = {
    ...state,
    globalBucket: cloneBucket(globalBucket.bucket),
    platformBuckets: {
      ...state.platformBuckets,
      [platform]: cloneBucket(platformBucket.bucket),
    },
  };

  return {
    state: nextState,
    rateLimited: !platformBucket.allowed || !globalBucket.allowed,
  };
}

export function getPauseReasonForSession(
  state: SchedulerState,
  session: WatchSessionState,
  nowMs: number = Date.now()
): PauseReason | null {
  const platformBucket = refillBucket(state.platformBuckets[session.platform], nowMs);
  const globalBucket = refillBucket(state.globalBucket, nowMs);

  if (
    state.mutex.active &&
    state.mutex.tabId !== session.tabId &&
    !isOverrideActive(state, nowMs)
  ) {
    return 'active_session';
  }

  if (platformBucket.tokens < 1 || globalBucket.tokens < 1) {
    return 'rate_limit';
  }

  return null;
}



==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/apps/chrome-extensions/proof-extension/src/watch/watch-overlay-controller.ts ====
/**
 * Phase 2: Scoped watch overlay controller.
 * Renders overlay only when container (and optional candidate) are resolved; never full viewport.
 * Idempotent mount/update/unmount; one instance per watch session.
 */
import { resolveWatchContainer } from '../content/watch-observer.js';

export interface ScopedWatchOverlayOptions {
  document?: Document;
  containerSelector: string;
  targetSelector?: string;
  headingText?: string;
  label?: string;
  statusText?: string;
  color?: string;
}

export interface ScopedWatchOverlayController {
  mount(options: ScopedWatchOverlayOptions): void;
  update(options: Partial<ScopedWatchOverlayOptions>): void;
  unmount(): void;
  isMounted(): boolean;
}

const OVERLAY_ID = 'notary-watch-overlay-scoped';
const STYLE_ID = 'notary-watch-style-scoped';

function getRect(el: Element): DOMRect {
  return el.getBoundingClientRect();
}

/**
 * Create a scoped watch overlay controller. Only draws when container (and optional target) resolve.
 * Never falls back to full viewport.
 */
export function createScopedWatchOverlayController(): ScopedWatchOverlayController {
  const doc = document;
  let mounted = false;
  let options: ScopedWatchOverlayOptions = {
    containerSelector: '',
  };
  let overlayEl: HTMLDivElement | null = null;
  let containerOutline: HTMLDivElement | null = null;
  let candidateOutline: HTMLDivElement | null = null;
  let indicatorEl: HTMLDivElement | null = null;
  let statusEl: HTMLDivElement | null = null;
  let styleEl: HTMLStyleElement | null = null;
  let rafId = 0;
  let resizeObserver: ResizeObserver | null = null;

  function clearDom(): void {
    if (rafId && doc.defaultView) {
      doc.defaultView.cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
      rafId = 0;
    }
    resizeObserver?.disconnect();
    resizeObserver = null;
    containerOutline?.remove();
    containerOutline = null;
    candidateOutline?.remove();
    candidateOutline = null;
    indicatorEl?.remove();
    indicatorEl = null;
    statusEl?.remove();
    statusEl = null;
    overlayEl?.remove();
    overlayEl = null;
    styleEl?.remove();
    styleEl = null;
    mounted = false;
  }

  function applyRect(): void {
    if (!overlayEl || !containerOutline) return;
    const docRef = options.document ?? doc;
    const container = resolveWatchContainer(
      docRef,
      options.containerSelector,
      options.headingText,
      'proof'
    );
    if (!container) {
      containerOutline.style.display = 'none';
      containerOutline.style.width = '0';
      containerOutline.style.height = '0';
      if (candidateOutline) {
        candidateOutline.style.display = 'none';
      }
      return;
    }
    const containerRect = getRect(container);
    containerOutline.style.display = 'block';
    containerOutline.style.top = `${containerRect.top}px`;
    containerOutline.style.left = `${containerRect.left}px`;
    containerOutline.style.width = `${containerRect.width}px`;
    containerOutline.style.height = `${containerRect.height}px`;

    const buttonSelector = (options.targetSelector ?? '').trim() || 'button,[role="button"]';
    const buttons = Array.from(container.querySelectorAll(buttonSelector));
    const firstCandidate: Element | null = buttons[0] ?? null;
    if (candidateOutline) {
      if (firstCandidate) {
        const candidateRect = getRect(firstCandidate);
        candidateOutline.style.display = 'block';
        candidateOutline.style.top = `${candidateRect.top}px`;
        candidateOutline.style.left = `${candidateRect.left}px`;
        candidateOutline.style.width = `${candidateRect.width}px`;
        candidateOutline.style.height = `${candidateRect.height}px`;
        if (indicatorEl) {
          indicatorEl.style.top = `${containerRect.top - 28}px`;
          indicatorEl.style.left = `${containerRect.left}px`;
        }
        if (statusEl) {
          statusEl.style.top = `${containerRect.top + 8}px`;
          statusEl.style.left = `${containerRect.left + containerRect.width - 56}px`;
        }
      } else {
        candidateOutline.style.display = 'none';
        if (indicatorEl) {
          indicatorEl.style.top = `${containerRect.top - 28}px`;
          indicatorEl.style.left = `${containerRect.left}px`;
        }
        if (statusEl) {
          statusEl.style.top = `${containerRect.top + 8}px`;
          statusEl.style.left = `${containerRect.left + containerRect.width - 56}px`;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  function tick(): void {
    applyRect();
    rafId = doc.defaultView?.requestAnimationFrame(tick) ?? 0;
  }

  return {
    isMounted() {
      return mounted;
    },

    mount(opts: ScopedWatchOverlayOptions): void {
      if (mounted) {
        this.update(opts);
        return;
      }
      options = { ...opts };
      const color = options.color ?? 'rgba(15, 118, 110, 0.78)';

      styleEl = doc.createElement('style');
      styleEl.id = STYLE_ID;
      styleEl.textContent = `
        @keyframes notaryWatchPulseScoped {
          0%, 100% { opacity: 0.4; }
          50% { opacity: 0.9; }
        }
      `;
      doc.head.appendChild(styleEl);

      overlayEl = doc.createElement('div');
      overlayEl.id = OVERLAY_ID;
      overlayEl.style.position = 'fixed';
      overlayEl.style.left = '0';
      overlayEl.style.top = '0';
      overlayEl.style.width = '0';
      overlayEl.style.height = '0';
      overlayEl.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
      overlayEl.style.zIndex = '2147483646';
      doc.body.appendChild(overlayEl);

      containerOutline = doc.createElement('div');
      containerOutline.style.position = 'fixed';
      containerOutline.style.background = 'rgba(15,118,110,0.08)';
      containerOutline.style.border = `2px solid ${color}`;
      containerOutline.style.borderRadius = '8px';
      containerOutline.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
      containerOutline.style.boxShadow = '0 0 14px rgba(15,118,110,0.3)';
      containerOutline.style.animation = 'notaryWatchPulseScoped 2s infinite';
      overlayEl.appendChild(containerOutline);

      candidateOutline = doc.createElement('div');
      candidateOutline.style.position = 'fixed';
      candidateOutline.style.background = 'rgba(217,119,6,0.12)';
      candidateOutline.style.border = `2px solid ${color}`;
      candidateOutline.style.borderRadius = '4px';
      candidateOutline.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
      candidateOutline.style.animation = 'notaryWatchPulseScoped 1.5s infinite';
      overlayEl.appendChild(candidateOutline);

      indicatorEl = doc.createElement('div');
      indicatorEl.style.position = 'fixed';
      indicatorEl.style.background = 'rgba(15,118,110,0.94)';
      indicatorEl.style.color = 'white';
      indicatorEl.style.padding = '4px 8px';
      indicatorEl.style.borderRadius = '4px';
      indicatorEl.style.fontSize = '11px';
      indicatorEl.style.fontWeight = 'bold';
      indicatorEl.style.zIndex = '2147483647';
      indicatorEl.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
      indicatorEl.textContent = options.label ?? 'WATCHING PROOF QUEUE';
      doc.body.appendChild(indicatorEl);

      statusEl = doc.createElement('div');
      statusEl.style.position = 'fixed';
      statusEl.style.background = 'rgba(217,119,6,0.94)';
      statusEl.style.color = 'white';
      statusEl.style.padding = '3px 6px';
      statusEl.style.borderRadius = '10px';
      statusEl.style.fontSize = '9px';
      statusEl.style.fontWeight = 'bold';
      statusEl.style.zIndex = '2147483647';
      statusEl.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
      statusEl.textContent = options.statusText ?? 'ACTIVE';
      doc.body.appendChild(statusEl);

      mounted = true;
      applyRect();
      rafId = doc.defaultView?.requestAnimationFrame(tick) ?? 0;
      doc.defaultView?.addEventListener('resize', applyRect);
      doc.defaultView?.addEventListener('scroll', applyRect, true);
      if (doc.defaultView?.ResizeObserver) {
        resizeObserver = new doc.defaultView.ResizeObserver(applyRect);
        resizeObserver.observe(doc.documentElement);
      }
    },

    update(opts: Partial<ScopedWatchOverlayOptions>): void {
      if (!mounted) return;
      if (opts.containerSelector !== undefined) options.containerSelector = opts.containerSelector;
      if (opts.targetSelector !== undefined) options.targetSelector = opts.targetSelector;
      if (opts.headingText !== undefined) options.headingText = opts.headingText;
      if (opts.label !== undefined && indicatorEl) indicatorEl.textContent = opts.label;
      if (opts.statusText !== undefined && statusEl) statusEl.textContent = opts.statusText;
      if (opts.color !== undefined) options.color = opts.color;
      applyRect();
    },

    unmount(): void {
      if (!mounted) return;
      doc.defaultView?.removeEventListener('resize', applyRect);
      doc.defaultView?.removeEventListener('scroll', applyRect, true);
      clearDom();
    },
  };
}

/**
 * Watch session state types and helpers for Phase 1 singleton runtime.
 * Persisted by the service worker to chrome.storage.session; content script
 * does not access storage directly.
 */

import type { WatchOverlayMode } from '../types/notary.js';
import type { PauseReason, PlatformId } from '../platforms/types.js';

export type WatchSessionStatus = 'watching' | 'paused' | 'stopped';

export interface WatchSessionState {
  tabId: number;
  runId: string;
  sessionId: string;
  leaseOwner: number;
  heartbeatAt: string;
  stopReason?: string;
  rehydratedAt?: string;
  overlayMode?: WatchOverlayMode;
  platform: PlatformId;
  pauseReason?: PauseReason;
  status: WatchSessionStatus;
}

export const WATCH_SESSION_STORAGE_KEY = 'proof-extension:watch-sessions';

export type PersistedWatchSessions = Record<string, WatchSessionState>;

function genId(): string {
  return `${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10)}`;
}

/**
 * Create a new watch session for the given tab. Caller should persist to storage.
 */
export function createNewSession(
  tabId: number,
  platform: PlatformId = 'blue-notary'
): WatchSessionState {
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  return {
    tabId,
    runId: genId(),
    sessionId: genId(),
    leaseOwner: tabId,
    heartbeatAt: now,
    platform,
    status: 'watching',
  };
}

/**
 * Update heartbeat timestamp. Returns a new state object.
 */
export function updateHeartbeat(state: WatchSessionState): WatchSessionState {
  return {
    ...state,
    heartbeatAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  };
}

/**
 * Mark session as paused. Returns a new state object.
 */
export function markPaused(
  state: WatchSessionState,
  reason?: string,
  pauseReason?: PauseReason
): WatchSessionState {
  return {
    ...state,
    status: 'paused',
    ...(reason !== undefined && { stopReason: reason }),
    ...(pauseReason !== undefined && { pauseReason }),
    heartbeatAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  };
}

/**
 * Mark session as stopped. Returns a new state object.
 */
export function markStopped(
  state: WatchSessionState,
  reason?: string,
  pauseReason?: PauseReason
): WatchSessionState {
  return {
    ...state,
    status: 'stopped',
    stopReason: reason ?? state.stopReason,
    pauseReason: pauseReason ?? state.pauseReason,
    heartbeatAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  };
}

/**
 * Mark session as rehydrated after worker wake. Returns a new state object.
 */
export function markRehydrated(state: WatchSessionState): WatchSessionState {
  return {
    ...state,
    rehydratedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    heartbeatAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  };
}

/**
 * Serialize sessions map for chrome.storage. Session keys are stringified tab IDs.
 */
export function serializeSessions(sessions: Map<number, WatchSessionState>): PersistedWatchSessions {
  const out: PersistedWatchSessions = {};
  for (const [tabId, state] of sessions) {
    out[String(tabId)] = state;
  }
  return out;
}

/**
 * Deserialize from chrome.storage into a Map. Invalid entries are skipped.
 */
export function deserializeSessions(raw: unknown): Map<number, WatchSessionState> {
  const map = new Map<number, WatchSessionState>();
  if (raw === null || typeof raw !== 'object') return map;
  const obj = raw as Record<string, unknown>;
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(obj)) {
    const tabId = parseInt(key, 10);
    if (Number.isNaN(tabId) || value === null || typeof value !== 'object') continue;
    const v = value as Record<string, unknown>;
    if (
      typeof v.tabId === 'number' &&
      typeof v.runId === 'string' &&
      typeof v.sessionId === 'string' &&
      typeof v.leaseOwner === 'number' &&
      typeof v.heartbeatAt === 'string' &&
      (v.platform === undefined ||
        v.platform === 'blue-notary' ||
        v.platform === 'proof') &&
      (v.status === 'watching' || v.status === 'paused' || v.status === 'stopped')
    ) {
      map.set(tabId, {
        tabId: v.tabId,
        runId: v.runId,
        sessionId: v.sessionId,
        leaseOwner: v.leaseOwner,
        heartbeatAt: v.heartbeatAt,
        stopReason: typeof v.stopReason === 'string' ? v.stopReason : undefined,
        rehydratedAt: typeof v.rehydratedAt === 'string' ? v.rehydratedAt : undefined,
        overlayMode:
          v.overlayMode === 'scoped' || v.overlayMode === 'disabled'
            ? v.overlayMode
            : undefined,
        platform: (v.platform as PlatformId | undefined) ?? 'blue-notary',
        pauseReason:
          v.pauseReason === 'active_session' ||
          v.pauseReason === 'rate_limit' ||
          v.pauseReason === 'operator_pause' ||
          v.pauseReason === 'platform_error' ||
          v.pauseReason === 'tab_unavailable'
            ? (v.pauseReason as PauseReason)
            : undefined,
        status: v.status as WatchSessionStatus,
      });
    }
  }
  return map;
}

==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/apps/documentation-scraper/src/main.ts ====
import { CloudLogger } from '@org/common/logger'
import { BrowserService, BrowserType, ensureCursorOverlay } from '@org/common/browser'
import { getDevOverlayScript } from '@org/common/ui'
import * as fs from 'fs/promises'
import * as path from 'path'
import { spawn } from 'child_process'

// Supported sources map to documentation-scrapers configs
const SUPPORTED_SOURCES = [
  { id: 'elevenlabs', label: 'ElevenLabs', homepage: 'https://elevenlabs.io/docs' },
  { id: 'freshworks', label: 'Freshworks', homepage: 'https://developers.freshworks.com/docs' },
  { id: 'playwright', label: 'Playwright', homepage: 'https://playwright.dev/docs/intro' }
]

async function run(): Promise<void> {
  const logger = new CloudLogger({ serviceName: 'documentation-scraper', namespace: 'app' })
  const browser = new BrowserService(logger, false, {
    defaultTimeout: 30000,
    retryAttempts: 3,
    retryDelay: 1000
  })

  try {
    await browser.initialize(BrowserType.CHROMIUM, {
      headless: process.env.BROWSER_HEADLESS === 'true'
    })

    if (!browser.isHeadless()) {
      const ctx = browser.getContext()
      const page = browser.getPage()
      if (ctx && page) {
        // Attach verbose page listeners for diagnostics
        try {
          page.on('console', msg => {
            try { logger.debug('page.console', { type: msg.type(), text: msg.text() }) } catch {}
          })
          page.on('pageerror', err => {
            try { logger.error('page.pageerror', err as Error) } catch {}
          })
          page.on('requestfailed', req => {
            try { logger.warn('page.requestfailed', { url: req.url(), failure: req.failure() }) } catch {}
          })

          // Add navigation event listeners to re-inject overlays
          page.on('framenavigated', async (frame) => {
            if (frame === page.mainFrame()) {
              logger.info('Page navigation detected, re-injecting overlays')
              await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 500)) // Wait for page to settle

              // Re-inject Dev overlay
              try {
                const devScript = getDevOverlayScript('documentation-scraper', 'about:blank')
                await page.addScriptTag({ content: devScript })
                logger.debug('DevOverlay: re-injected after navigation')
              } catch (e) {
                logger.warn('DevOverlay: re-injection failed', e as Error)
              }

              // Re-inject Cursor overlay
              try {
                await ensureCursorOverlay(ctx, page, logger, 'documentation-scraper', 3, 500)
                logger.debug('CursorOverlay: re-injected after navigation')
              } catch (e) {
                logger.warn('CursorOverlay: re-injection failed', e as Error)
              }

              // Verify overlays are present after re-injection
              try {
                const presence = await page.evaluate(() => ({
                  dev: !!document.getElementById('automation-overlay-root'),
                  cursor: !!document.getElementById('cursor-flow-ui')
                }))
                logger.info('Overlay presence after navigation re-injection', presence as any)
              } catch (e) {
                logger.warn('Overlay presence check after re-injection failed', e as Error)
              }
            }
          })
        } catch {}

        // Expose a richer automationBridge for saving steps and triggering scrapers
        await ctx.exposeFunction('automationBridge', async (event: string, payload: unknown) => {
          try {
            if (event === 'saveSteps') {
              const stepsDir = path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'apps/documentation-scraper/flows/drafts')
              await fs.mkdir(stepsDir, { recursive: true })
              const ts = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, '-')
              const appName = typeof payload === 'object' && payload && 'app' in payload ? (payload as { app?: string }).app || 'documentation-scraper' : 'documentation-scraper'
              const steps = typeof payload === 'object' && payload && 'steps' in payload ? (payload as { steps?: unknown }).steps || [] : []
              const filePath = path.join(stepsDir, `${appName}-${ts}.json`)
              await fs.writeFile(filePath, JSON.stringify(steps, null, 2), 'utf8')
              return { ok: true, path: filePath } as const
            }

            if (event === 'startScrape') {
              const data = (payload || {}) as { sourceId?: string }
              const sourceId = data.sourceId || ''
              if (!SUPPORTED_SOURCES.some(s => s.id === sourceId)) {
                return { ok: false, error: 'unsupported_source' } as const
              }
              // Run the multi-doc scraper script with node
              const script = path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'documentation-scrapers/scrape-multi-docs.ts')
              const child = spawn('tsx', [script, '--source', sourceId], { stdio: 'inherit' })
              child.on('error', err => logger.error('Scraper spawn error', err))
              return { ok: true } as const
            }

            if (event === 'navigateHome') {
              const data = (payload || {}) as { sourceId?: string }
              const src = SUPPORTED_SOURCES.find(s => s.id === data.sourceId)
              if (src) {
                await browser.navigateWithRetry(src.homepage, { maxRetries: 2, timeout: 30000 })
                return { ok: true } as const
              }
              return { ok: false, error: 'unknown_source' } as const
            }

            return { ok: false, error: 'unknown_event' } as const
          } catch (err) {
            logger.error('automationBridge error', err as Error)
            return { ok: false, error: (err as Error).message } as const
          }
        })

        // Shared Dev Overlay injection with diagnostics
        const devOverlayScript = getDevOverlayScript('documentation-scraper', 'about:blank')
        logger.info('DevOverlay: attempting addInitScript on context and page')
        try { await ctx.addInitScript(devOverlayScript) } catch (e) { logger.warn('DevOverlay: ctx.addInitScript failed', e as Error) }
        try { await page.addInitScript(devOverlayScript) } catch (e) { logger.warn('DevOverlay: page.addInitScript failed', e as Error) }
        try {
          await page.addScriptTag({ content: devOverlayScript })
          logger.debug('DevOverlay: addScriptTag injected')
        } catch (e) {
          logger.warn('DevOverlay: addScriptTag failed, trying eval', e as Error)
          try {
            await page.evaluate((s) => { try { eval(s as any) } catch {} }, devOverlayScript)
            logger.debug('DevOverlay: eval fallback executed')
          } catch (err) { logger.warn('DevOverlay: eval fallback failed', err as Error) }
        }

        await ensureCursorOverlay(ctx, page, logger, 'documentation-scraper', 6, 1500)

        // Wait a bit for scripts to execute
        await page.waitForTimeout(1000)

        // Verify presence of overlays
        try {
          const presence = await page.evaluate(() => ({
            dev: !!document.getElementById('automation-overlay-root'),
            cursor: !!document.getElementById('cursor-flow-ui')
          }))
          logger.info('Overlay presence after injection', presence as any)
          if (!presence.dev || !presence.cursor) {
            await page.evaluate(() => {
              try {
                const id = 'diagnostic-banner'
                if (!document.getElementById(id)) {
                  const b = document.createElement('div')
                  b.id = id
                  b.setAttribute('style', 'position:fixed;bottom:12px;right:12px;z-index:2147483647;background:#b54708;color:#fff;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:6px;font:13px/1.4 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,Segoe UI,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.35)')
                  b.textContent = 'Diagnostics: overlay not loaded yet'
                  document.documentElement.appendChild(b)
                }
              } catch {}
            })
            logger.warn('Diagnostic banner injected (overlay missing)')
          } else {
            logger.info('✓ All overlays successfully injected!')
          }
        } catch (e) {
          logger.warn('Overlay presence check failed', e as Error)
        }
      }
    }

    // Idle on a landing page to allow user to choose source
    const initialUrl = 'https://example.com'
    logger.info('Navigating to initial URL', { url: initialUrl })
    await browser.navigateWithRetry(initialUrl, { maxRetries: 2, timeout: 20000 })

    // Note: Overlay re-injection is now handled by the framenavigated event listener

    if (!browser.isHeadless()) {
      const pageNow = browser.getPage()
      if (pageNow) {
        await pageNow.waitForTimeout(120000)
      }
    }
  } finally {
    if (browser.isHeadless()) {
      await browser.close().catch(() => {})
    }
  }
}

run().catch(err => {
  console.error('Fatal error in documentation-scraper:', err)
  process.exit(1)
})

import type { BrowserContext, Page } from 'playwright'
import { CloudLogger } from '@org/common/logger'

export function getCursorOverlayScript(app: string = 'kareo'): string {
  return `
    (function(){
      'use strict';
      try {
        console.log('CursorFlow: Initializing for', ${JSON.stringify(app)});

        // Safety check for document availability
        if (typeof document === 'undefined' || !document.documentElement) {
          console.warn('CursorFlow: Document not ready, skipping');
          return;
        }

        // Wait for DOM ready
        if (document.readyState !== 'complete' && document.readyState !== 'interactive') {
          console.log('CursorFlow: Waiting for DOM ready');
          document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', arguments.callee);
          return;
        }

        // Check if already exists (support both overlay host IDs)
        const existingElement =
          document.getElementById('__cursorflow_host__') ||
          document.getElementById('cursor-flow-ui');
        if (existingElement) {
          console.log('CursorFlow: Already exists, skipping');
          return;
        }

        if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
          window.__cursorApp = window.__cursorApp || ${JSON.stringify(app)};
        }

        // Create root container
        var root = document.createElement('div');
        root.id = 'cursor-flow-ui';
        root.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;z-index:2147483647;top:12px;right:12px;width:320px;max-height:70vh;background:#0b0f17;color:#e6edf3;border:1px solid #30363d;border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.4);font:13px/1.4 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,Segoe UI,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;overflow:hidden';

        var header = document.createElement('div');
        header.textContent = 'Cursor Flow';
        header.style.cssText = 'padding:8px 12px;font-weight:600;background:#0d1117;border-bottom:1px solid #30363d';

        var panel = document.createElement('div');
        panel.style.cssText = 'padding:10px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px';

        var pickBtn = document.createElement('button');
        pickBtn.textContent = '🔎 Pick Element';
        pickBtn.style.cssText = 'padding:6px 8px;border:1px solid #30363d;background:#161b22;color:#e6edf3;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;text-align:left';

        var sendBtn = document.createElement('button');
        sendBtn.textContent = '⇢ Send to Cursor';
        sendBtn.style.cssText = 'padding:6px 8px;border:1px solid #30363d;background:#1f6feb;color:#fff;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;text-align:left';

        var testBtn = document.createElement('button');
        testBtn.textContent = '🧪 Test';
        testBtn.style.cssText = 'padding:6px 8px;border:1px solid #30363d;background:#238636;color:#fff;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;text-align:left';

        var promoteBtn = document.createElement('button');
        promoteBtn.textContent = '⬆️ Promote';
        promoteBtn.style.cssText = 'padding:6px 8px;border:1px solid #30363d;background:#8b949e;color:#0d1117;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;text-align:left';

        var desc = document.createElement('textarea');
        desc.placeholder = 'Describe the change to apply…';
        desc.rows = 3;
        desc.style.cssText = 'resize:vertical;min-height:60px;padding:6px 8px;border:1px solid #30363d;background:#0d1117;color:#e6edf3;border-radius:6px';

        var selectorField = document.createElement('input');
        selectorField.placeholder = 'Selected CSS selector will appear here';
        selectorField.readOnly = true;
        selectorField.style.cssText = 'padding:6px 8px;border:1px solid #30363d;background:#0d1117;color:#9da7b1;border-radius:6px';

        var log = document.createElement('pre');
        log.id = 'cursor-flow-log';
        log.style.cssText = 'margin:0;padding:8px;background:#0d1117;color:#9da7b1;border-top:1px solid #30363d;max-height:180px;overflow:auto;border-radius:0 0 8px 8px';

        // Simple event handlers
        var picking = false;
        var lastHover = null;

        pickBtn.onclick = function(){
          picking = true;
          console.log('CursorFlow: Element picking enabled');
        };

        window.__cursorFlowLog = function(msg){
          try{
            var time = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[1].replace('Z','');
            log.textContent += '[' + time + '] ' + msg + '\\n';
            log.scrollTop = log.scrollHeight;
          } catch(e) {
            console.error('CursorFlow: Log error', e);
          }
        };

        /* Bridge hookup: do NOT override if the platform already exposed it.
           Keep a two-arg signature and provide an HTTP fallback for demos. */
        if (typeof window.__cursorBridgePost !== 'function') {
          window.__cursorBridgePost = async function(event, payload) {
            try {
              // Attempt HTTP bridge fallback if platform didn't expose a handler.
              const base = (window.__cursorBridgeUrl || 'http://localhost:4488');
              await fetch(base + '/post', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({ event, payload }),
                keepalive: true
              });
            } catch (e) {
              try { console.warn('[cursor-flow] no bridge handler; event dropped:', event, e); } catch(_) {}
            }
          };
        }

        function currentPayload(type){
          return {
            type: type,
            selector: selectorField.value,
            description: desc.value,
            app: (window.__cursorApp || ${JSON.stringify(app)}),
            cwd: window.__cursorCwd
          };
        }

        sendBtn.onclick = function(){
          window.__cursorBridgePost(currentPayload('cursor.apply'));
        };

        testBtn.onclick = function(){
          window.__cursorBridgePost(currentPayload('cursor.test'));
        };

        promoteBtn.onclick = function(){
          window.__cursorBridgePost(currentPayload('cursor.promote'));
        };

        // Assemble UI
        panel.appendChild(pickBtn);
        panel.appendChild(selectorField);
        panel.appendChild(desc);
        panel.appendChild(sendBtn);
        panel.appendChild(testBtn);
        panel.appendChild(promoteBtn);

        root.appendChild(header);
        root.appendChild(panel);
        root.appendChild(log);

        document.documentElement.appendChild(root);

        console.log('CursorFlow: Successfully initialized');
      } catch (e) {
        console.error('CursorFlow: Initialization error', e);
      }
    })();
  `
}

export async function ensureCursorOverlay(
  context: BrowserContext,
  page: Page,
  logger: CloudLogger,
  app: string = 'kareo',
  attempts: number = 5,
  intervalMs: number = 2000,
): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    const script = getCursorOverlayScript(app)
    logger.debug('CursorFlow: adding init script to context')
    await context.addInitScript(script)
  } catch (e) {
    logger.warn('CursorFlow: failed to add init script', e as Error)
  }

  logger.info('CursorFlow: ensuring overlay injection', { attempts, intervalMs, app })

  for (let i = 1; i <= attempts; i++) {
    try {
      const present = await page.evaluate(() => !!document.getElementById('cursor-flow-ui'))
      logger.debug('CursorFlow: overlay present check', { attempt: i, present })
      if (present) {
        const snippet = await page.evaluate(() => {
          const el = document.getElementById('cursor-flow-ui')
          return el ? el.outerHTML.slice(0, 200) : 'not-found'
        })
        logger.info('CursorFlow: overlay detected', { snippet })
        return true
      }
    } catch (e) {
      logger.warn('CursorFlow: present check failed', e as Error)
    }

    try {
      const s = getCursorOverlayScript(app)
      logger.debug('CursorFlow: injecting overlay scripts', { attempt: i, length: s.length })
      try { await page.addInitScript(s) } catch {}
      try {
        const b64 = Buffer.from(s, 'utf8').toString('base64')
        await page.addScriptTag({ url: `data:text/javascript;base64,${b64}` })
        logger.debug('CursorFlow: addScriptTag data-url injected', { attempt: i })
      } catch (e) {
        logger.warn('CursorFlow: data-url addScriptTag failed, trying inline content', e as Error)
        try { await page.addScriptTag({ content: s }); logger.debug('CursorFlow: addScriptTag content injected', { attempt: i }) } catch (e2) {
          logger.warn('CursorFlow: addScriptTag content failed, trying eval', e2 as Error)
          await page.evaluate((raw) => { try { eval(raw as any) } catch (e) { console.error('cursor-overlay eval error', e) } }, s)
        }
      }
      logger.debug('CursorFlow: injection attempted', { attempt: i })
    } catch (e) {
      logger.warn('CursorFlow: injection attempt failed', e as Error)
    }

    await page.waitForTimeout(intervalMs)
  }

  // Final check
  try {
    const present = await page.evaluate(() => !!document.getElementById('cursor-flow-ui'))
    logger.info('CursorFlow: final overlay presence', { present })
    return present
  } catch (e) {
    logger.warn('CursorFlow: final presence check failed', e as Error)
    return false
  }
}

export function getCursorOverlayScript(app = 'kareo') {
    return `
    (function(){
      try {
        if (typeof window !== 'undefined') { window.__cursorApp = window.__cursorApp || ${JSON.stringify(app)}; }
        if (typeof document === 'undefined') return;
        if (document.getElementById('cursor-flow-ui')) return;
        const root = document.createElement('div');
        root.id = 'cursor-flow-ui';
        root.setAttribute('style', 'position:fixed;z-index:2147483647;top:12px;right:12px;width:320px;max-height:70vh;background:#0b0f17;color:#e6edf3;border:1px solid #30363d;border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.4);font:13px/1.4 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,Segoe UI,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;overflow:hidden');
        const header = document.createElement('div');
        header.textContent = 'Cursor Flow';
        header.setAttribute('style', 'padding:8px 12px;font-weight:600;background:#0d1117;border-bottom:1px solid #30363d');
        const panel = document.createElement('div');
        panel.setAttribute('style', 'padding:10px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px');
        const pickBtn = document.createElement('button'); pickBtn.textContent = '🔎 Pick Element';
        const sendBtn = document.createElement('button'); sendBtn.textContent = '⇢ Send to Cursor';
        const testBtn = document.createElement('button'); testBtn.textContent = '🧪 Test';
        const promoteBtn = document.createElement('button'); promoteBtn.textContent = '⬆️ Promote';
        const btnStyle = 'padding:6px 8px;border:1px solid #30363d;background:#161b22;color:#e6edf3;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;text-align:left';
        pickBtn.setAttribute('style', btnStyle); sendBtn.setAttribute('style', btnStyle); testBtn.setAttribute('style', btnStyle); promoteBtn.setAttribute('style', btnStyle);
        const desc = document.createElement('textarea'); desc.placeholder = 'Describe the change to apply…'; desc.rows = 3; desc.setAttribute('style', 'resize:vertical;min-height:60px;padding:6px 8px;border:1px solid #30363d;background:#0d1117;color:#e6edf3;border-radius:6px');
        const selectorField = document.createElement('input'); selectorField.placeholder = 'Selected CSS selector will appear here'; selectorField.readOnly = true; selectorField.setAttribute('style', 'padding:6px 8px;border:1px solid #30363d;background:#0d1117;color:#9da7b1;border-radius:6px');
        const log = document.createElement('pre'); log.id = 'cursor-flow-log'; log.setAttribute('style', 'margin:0;padding:8px;background:#0d1117;color:#9da7b1;border-top:1px solid #30363d;max-height:180px;overflow:auto;border-radius:0 0 8px 8px');
        panel.appendChild(pickBtn); panel.appendChild(selectorField); panel.appendChild(desc); panel.appendChild(sendBtn); panel.appendChild(testBtn); panel.appendChild(promoteBtn);
        root.appendChild(header); root.appendChild(panel); root.appendChild(log); document.documentElement.appendChild(root);
        const highlight = document.createElement('div'); highlight.id='cursor-flow-highlight'; highlight.setAttribute('style','position:absolute;z-index:2147483646;pointer-events:none;border:2px solid #58a6ff;border-radius:4px;background:rgba(56,139,253,0.12);display:none'); document.documentElement.appendChild(highlight);
        function robustSelector(el){
          const prefer=['data-testid','aria-label','id','data-cy','data-e2e','data-qa'];
          for(const attr of prefer){
            const val=el.getAttribute(attr);
            if(val){
              if(attr==='id') return '#' + CSS.escape(val);
              const sel='['+attr+'='+JSON.stringify(val)+']';
              if(document.querySelectorAll(sel).length===1) return sel;
            }
          }
          const parts=[]; let node=el;
          while(node && parts.length<4){
            const tag=node.tagName.toLowerCase();
            const parent=node.parentElement;
            if(!parent){ parts.push(tag); break;}
            const siblings=Array.from(parent.children).filter(c=>c.tagName.toLowerCase()===tag);
            const idx=siblings.indexOf(node)+1;
            parts.push(tag+':nth-of-type('+idx+')');
            node=parent;
          }
          return parts.reverse().join(' > ');
        }

        function updateHighlight(target){
          if(!target){
            highlight.style.display='none';
            return;
          }
          const rect=target.getBoundingClientRect();
          highlight.style.display='block';
          highlight.style.left=String(window.scrollX+rect.left-2)+'px';
          highlight.style.top=String(window.scrollY+rect.top-2)+'px';
          highlight.style.width=String(rect.width+4)+'px';
          highlight.style.height=String(rect.height+4)+'px';
          highlight.style.position='absolute';
        }

        let picking=false;
        let lastHover=null;

        const onMove=(e)=>{
          if(!picking) return;
          const t=e.target;
          if(t && t!==root && !root.contains(t)){
            lastHover=t;
            updateHighlight(t);
          }
        };

        const onClick=(e)=>{
          if(!picking) return;
          e.preventDefault();
          e.stopPropagation();
          if(lastHover){
            const sel=robustSelector(lastHover);
            selectorField.value=sel;
            picking=false;
            updateHighlight(null);
            window.removeEventListener('mousemove',onMove,true);
            window.removeEventListener('click',onClick,true);
            if(window.__cursorFlowLog){
              window.__cursorFlowLog('Selected: '+sel);
            }
          }
        };
        pickBtn.onclick=()=>{
          picking=true;
          window.addEventListener('mousemove',onMove,true);
          window.addEventListener('click',onClick,true);
        };

        window.__cursorFlowLog=(msg)=>{
          try{
            const time=new Date().toISOString().split('T')[1].replace('Z','');
            log.textContent+='['+time+'] '+msg+'\n';
            log.scrollTop=log.scrollHeight;
          }catch{}
        };

        window.__cursorBridgePost=async (payload)=>{
          try{
            const res=await fetch('http://localhost:4488/post',{
              method:'POST',
              headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},
              body:JSON.stringify(payload)
            });
            const txt=await res.text();
            if(window.__cursorFlowLog){
              window.__cursorFlowLog('Bridge: '+txt);
            }
          }catch(err){
            if(window.__cursorFlowLog){
              window.__cursorFlowLog('Bridge error: '+(err && err.message || String(err)));
            }
          }
        };

        function currentPayload(type){
          return {
            type,
            selector: selectorField.value,
            description: desc.value,
            app: (window.__cursorApp||${JSON.stringify(app)}),
            cwd: window.__cursorCwd
          };
        }

        sendBtn.onclick=()=>window.__cursorBridgePost(currentPayload('cursor.apply'));
        testBtn.onclick=()=>window.__cursorBridgePost(currentPayload('cursor.test'));
        promoteBtn.onclick=()=>window.__cursorBridgePost(currentPayload('cursor.promote'));

        try{
          const es=new EventSource('http://localhost:4488/events');
          es.onmessage=(ev)=>window.__cursorFlowLog && window.__cursorFlowLog(ev.data);
          es.onerror=()=>window.__cursorFlowLog && window.__cursorFlowLog('SSE connection error');
        }catch{}
      } catch {}
    })();
  `;
}
export async function ensureCursorOverlay(context, page, logger, app = 'kareo', attempts = 5, intervalMs = 2000) {
    try {
        const script = getCursorOverlayScript(app);
        logger.debug('CursorFlow: adding init script to context');
        await context.addInitScript(script);
    }
    catch (e) {
        logger.warn('CursorFlow: failed to add init script', e);
    }
    logger.info('CursorFlow: ensuring overlay injection', { attempts, intervalMs, app });
    for (let i = 1; i <= attempts; i++) {
        try {
            const present = await page.evaluate(() => !!document.getElementById('cursor-flow-ui'));
            logger.debug('CursorFlow: overlay present check', { attempt: i, present });
            if (present) {
                const snippet = await page.evaluate(() => {
                    const el = document.getElementById('cursor-flow-ui');
                    return el ? el.outerHTML.slice(0, 200) : 'not-found';
                });
                logger.info('CursorFlow: overlay detected', { snippet });
                return true;
            }
        }
        catch (e) {
            logger.warn('CursorFlow: present check failed', e);
        }
        try {
            const s = getCursorOverlayScript(app);
            logger.debug('CursorFlow: injecting overlay scripts', { attempt: i, length: s.length });
            try {
                await page.addInitScript(s);
            }
            catch { }
            try {
                const b64 = Buffer.from(s, 'utf8').toString('base64');
                await page.addScriptTag({ url: `data:text/javascript;base64,${b64}` });
                logger.debug('CursorFlow: addScriptTag data-url injected', { attempt: i });
            }
            catch (e) {
                logger.warn('CursorFlow: data-url addScriptTag failed, trying inline content', e);
                try {
                    await page.addScriptTag({ content: s });
                    logger.debug('CursorFlow: addScriptTag content injected', { attempt: i });
                }
                catch (e2) {
                    logger.warn('CursorFlow: addScriptTag content failed, trying eval', e2);
                    await page.evaluate((raw) => { try {
                        eval(raw);
                    }
                    catch (e) {
                        console.error('cursor-overlay eval error', e);
                    } }, s);
                }
            }
            logger.debug('CursorFlow: injection attempted', { attempt: i });
        }
        catch (e) {
            logger.warn('CursorFlow: injection attempt failed', e);
        }
        await page.waitForTimeout(intervalMs);
    }
    // Final check
    try {
        const present = await page.evaluate(() => !!document.getElementById('cursor-flow-ui'));
        logger.info('CursorFlow: final overlay presence', { present });
        return present;
    }
    catch (e) {
        logger.warn('CursorFlow: final presence check failed', e);
        return false;
    }
}
