            document.body.removeChild(modal);
          };

          buttonContainer.appendChild(cancelBtn);
          buttonContainer.appendChild(createBtn);
          modalContent.appendChild(title);
          modalContent.appendChild(input);
          modalContent.appendChild(buttonContainer);
          modal.appendChild(modalContent);
          document.body.appendChild(modal);

          // Focus input and handle enter key
          setTimeout(() => input.focus(), 100);
          input.onkeydown = (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Enter') createBtn.click();
            if (e.key === 'Escape') cancelBtn.click();
          };
        }

        function addStepToCurrentFlow(step) {
          if (currentFlow && isRecording) {
            flowSteps.push(step);
            currentFlow.data.steps = flowSteps;
            updateStepCounter();
            updateStepDisplay();

            // Save state after adding step
            saveUIState();

            // Show success message with animation
            const successMsg = '✅ Step added: ' + step.type + ' (' + flowSteps.length + ' total)';
            log.textContent = successMsg;

            // Clear success message after 2 seconds
            setTimeout(() => {
              if (log.textContent === successMsg) {
                updateRecordingStatus();
              }
            }, 2000);
          }
        }

        function updateStepCounter() {
          if (!currentFlow) return;

          // Remove existing counter if present
          const existingCounter = document.getElementById('step-counter');
          if (existingCounter) existingCounter.remove();

          // Create new counter
          const counter = document.createElement('div');
          counter.id = 'step-counter';
          counter.setAttribute('style', 'padding:8px 12px;background:#442f0f;border:1px solid #bb8009;border-radius:4px;margin:8px 0;font-size:12px;color:#e6edf3;text-align:center;font-weight:bold;');

          const stepCount = flowSteps.length;
          counter.textContent = '📊 Recording: ' + currentFlow.name + ' (' + stepCount + ' step' + (stepCount !== 1 ? 's' : '') + ')';

          // Insert after the header but before other buttons
          const header = document.querySelector('#cursor-flow-ui > div:first-child');
          if (header && header.nextSibling) {
            header.parentNode.insertBefore(counter, header.nextSibling);
          }
        }

        function updateStepDisplay() {
          if (!currentFlow) return;

          // Remove existing step display if present
          const existingDisplay = document.getElementById('step-display-container');
          if (existingDisplay) existingDisplay.remove();

          // Create collapsible step display container
          const container = document.createElement('div');
          container.id = 'step-display-container';
          container.setAttribute('style', 'margin:8px 0;border:2px solid #30363d;border-radius:6px;background:#161b22;');

          // Header with toggle
          const header = document.createElement('div');
          header.setAttribute('style', 'padding:8px 12px;background:#30363d;border-radius:4px 4px 0 0;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;');
          header.onclick = () => toggleStepDisplay();

          const title = document.createElement('span');
          title.textContent = '📋 Steps (' + flowSteps.length + ')';
          title.setAttribute('style', 'font-weight:bold;color:#58a6ff;font-size:12px;');

          const toggleIcon = document.createElement('span');
          toggleIcon.id = 'step-toggle-icon';
          toggleIcon.textContent = '▼';
          toggleIcon.setAttribute('style', 'color:#e6edf3;font-size:10px;');

          header.appendChild(title);
          header.appendChild(toggleIcon);

          // Step list container
          const stepList = document.createElement('div');
          stepList.id = 'step-display-list';
          stepList.setAttribute('style', 'max-height:200px;overflow-y:auto;border-radius:0 0 4px 4px;');

          if (flowSteps.length === 0) {
            const emptyMsg = document.createElement('div');
            emptyMsg.textContent = 'No steps yet. Pick elements and click "Add Step" to get started!';
            emptyMsg.setAttribute('style', 'padding:12px;color:#9da7b1;font-style:italic;text-align:center;');
            stepList.appendChild(emptyMsg);
          } else {
            flowSteps.forEach((step, index) => {
              const stepItem = document.createElement('div');
              stepItem.setAttribute('style', 'padding:8px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid #30363d;background:#0d1117;margin:0;');

              const stepHeader = document.createElement('div');
              stepHeader.setAttribute('style', 'display:flex;align-items:center;margin-bottom:4px;');

              const stepNumber = document.createElement('span');
              stepNumber.textContent = String(index + 1);
              stepNumber.setAttribute('style', 'background:#238636;color:#e6edf3;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:12px;font-size:10px;font-weight:bold;margin-right:8px;min-width:20px;text-align:center;');

              const stepType = document.createElement('span');
              stepType.textContent = step.type.toUpperCase();
              stepType.setAttribute('style', 'color:#58a6ff;font-weight:bold;font-size:11px;margin-right:8px;');

              const stepDesc = document.createElement('span');
              stepDesc.textContent = step.description || 'No description';
              stepDesc.setAttribute('style', 'color:#e6edf3;font-size:11px;flex:1;');

              stepHeader.appendChild(stepNumber);
              stepHeader.appendChild(stepType);
              stepHeader.appendChild(stepDesc);

              const stepDetails = document.createElement('div');
              stepDetails.setAttribute('style', 'font-size:10px;color:#9da7b1;margin-top:2px;');

              if (step.locator && step.locator.selector) {
                const selector = document.createElement('div');
                selector.textContent = 'Selector: ' + step.locator.selector;
                stepDetails.appendChild(selector);
              }

              stepItem.appendChild(stepHeader);
              if (stepDetails.children.length > 0) {
                stepItem.appendChild(stepDetails);
              }

              stepList.appendChild(stepItem);
            });
          }

          container.appendChild(header);
          container.appendChild(stepList);

          // Insert after step counter
          const counter = document.getElementById('step-counter');
          if (counter && counter.nextSibling) {
            counter.parentNode.insertBefore(container, counter.nextSibling);
          } else if (counter) {
            counter.parentNode.appendChild(container);
          }
        }

        function toggleStepDisplay() {
          const list = document.getElementById('step-display-list');
          const icon = document.getElementById('step-toggle-icon');
          if (list && icon) {
            if (list.style.display === 'none') {
              list.style.display = 'block';
              icon.textContent = '▼';
            } else {
              list.style.display = 'none';
              icon.textContent = '▶';
            }
          }
        }

        function updateRecordingStatus() {
          if (!currentFlow) return;

          const statusText = '🎬 Recording: ' + currentFlow.name + '\\n📊 ' + flowSteps.length + ' step' + (flowSteps.length !== 1 ? 's' : '') + ' recorded\\n💡 Pick elements and click "Add Step" to continue\\n💾 Click "Save Flow" when finished';
          log.textContent = statusText;
        }

        function viewFlowSteps() {
          if (!currentFlow || flowSteps.length === 0) {
            log.textContent = 'No steps recorded yet. Pick elements and add them using "Add Step".';
            return;
          }

          updateStepDisplay();
          log.textContent = '📋 Steps displayed above. Click "Add Step" to continue recording.';
        }

        function loadExistingFlow() {
          fetch('http://localhost:4488/flows')
            .then(r => r.json())
            .then(flowsData => {
              const flowNames = Object.keys(flowsData);
              if (flowNames.length === 0) {
                log.textContent = '❌ No flows available to load.';
                return;
              }

              // Create a custom modal with flow selection
              const modal = document.createElement('div');
              modal.setAttribute('style', 'position:fixed;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.7);z-index:2147483647;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;');

              const modalContent = document.createElement('div');
              modalContent.setAttribute('style', 'background:#0d1117;color:#e6edf3;padding:20px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #30363d;min-width:350px;max-width:500px;max-height:400px;overflow-y:auto;');

              const title = document.createElement('h3');
              title.textContent = 'Load Existing Flow';
              title.setAttribute('style', 'margin:0 0 15px 0;color:#58a6ff;');

              const flowList = document.createElement('div');
              flowList.setAttribute('style', 'margin-bottom:15px;max-height:250px;overflow-y:auto;');

              flowNames.forEach(flowName => {
                const flowData = flowsData[flowName];
                const flowItem = document.createElement('div');
                flowItem.setAttribute('style', 'padding:8px;margin:4px 0;border:1px solid #30363d;border-radius:4px;background:#161b22;cursor:pointer;');
                flowItem.textContent = flowName + ' (' + (flowData.steps?.length || 0) + ' steps)';

                flowItem.onclick = () => {
                  currentFlow = { name: flowName, data: flowData };
                  flowSteps = flowData.steps || [];
                  isRecording = false;

                  // Update UI
                  pickBtn.textContent = 'Pick Element';
                  saveFlowBtn.style.display = 'none';
                  addStepBtn.style.display = 'none';
                  viewStepsBtn.style.display = 'block';

                  updateStepCounter();
                  updateStepDisplay();

                  // Save state after loading flow
                  saveUIState();

                  log.textContent = '📂 Loaded flow: ' + flowName + ' (' + flowSteps.length + ' steps)\\n👁️ Use "View Steps" to see details\\n🚀 Use "Send to Cursor" to generate code.';
                  document.body.removeChild(modal);
                };

                flowList.appendChild(flowItem);
              });

              const cancelBtn = document.createElement('button');
              cancelBtn.textContent = 'Cancel';
              cancelBtn.setAttribute('style', 'padding:6px 12px;border:1px solid #30363d;background:#161b22;color:#e6edf3;border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;');
              cancelBtn.onclick = () => document.body.removeChild(modal);

              modalContent.appendChild(title);
              modalContent.appendChild(flowList);
              modalContent.appendChild(cancelBtn);
              modal.appendChild(modalContent);
              document.body.appendChild(modal);
            })
            .catch(err => {
              log.textContent = '❌ Error loading flows: ' + err.message;
            });
        }

        function saveCurrentFlow() {
          if (!currentFlow) return;

          fetch('http://localhost:4488/post', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify({
              type: 'saveFlow',
              flowName: currentFlow.name,
              flowData: currentFlow.data
            })
          }).then(r => r.text())
            .then(result => {
              log.textContent = 'Flow ' + currentFlow.name + ' saved: ' + result;

              // Clear state after successful save
              currentFlow = null;
              flowSteps = [];
              isRecording = false;
              selectorField.value = '';
              desc.value = '';

              // Clear saved state
              clearUIState();

              pickBtn.textContent = 'Pick Element';
              saveFlowBtn.style.display = 'none';
              addStepBtn.style.display = 'none';
              updateStepCounter();
              updateStepDisplay();
              refreshFlowsUI();
            }).catch(err => {
              log.textContent = '❌ Failed to save flow: ' + err.message;
            });
        }
        function robustSelector(el){
          const prefer=['data-testid','aria-label','id','data-cy','data-e2e','data-qa'];
          for(const attr of prefer){
            const val=el.getAttribute(attr);
            if(val){
              if(attr==='id') return '#' + CSS.escape(val);
              const sel='['+attr+'='+JSON.stringify(val)+']';
              if(document.querySelectorAll(sel).length===1) return sel;
            }
          }
          const parts=[]; let node=el;
          while(node && parts.length<4){
            const tag=node.tagName.toLowerCase();
            const parent=node.parentElement;
            if(!parent){ parts.push(tag); break;}
            const siblings=Array.from(parent.children).filter(c=>c.tagName.toLowerCase()===tag);
            const idx=siblings.indexOf(node)+1;
            parts.push(tag+':nth-of-type('+idx+')');
            node=parent;
          }
          return parts.reverse().join(' > ');
        }

        function updateHighlight(target){
          if(!target){
            highlight.style.display='none';
            return;
          }
          const rect=target.getBoundingClientRect();
          highlight.style.display='block';
          highlight.style.left=String(window.scrollX+rect.left-2)+'px';
          highlight.style.top=String(window.scrollY+rect.top-2)+'px';
          highlight.style.width=String(rect.width+4)+'px';
          highlight.style.height=String(rect.height+4)+'px';
          highlight.style.position='absolute';
        }

        let picking=false;
        let lastHover=null;

        // Drag and resize functionality
        let isDragging = false;
        let isResizing = false;
        let dragOffsetX = 0;
        let dragOffsetY = 0;
        let initialWidth = 320;
        let initialHeight = 400;

        header.onmousedown = (e) => {
          // Don't start dragging if clicking on the minimize button
          if (e.target === minimizeBtn || e.target.parentNode === minimizeBtn) return;
          isDragging = true;
          dragOffsetX = e.clientX - root.offsetLeft;
          dragOffsetY = e.clientY - root.offsetTop;
          root.style.cursor = 'grabbing';
          e.preventDefault();
        };

        document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
          if (isDragging) {
            root.style.left = (e.clientX - dragOffsetX) + 'px';
            root.style.top = (e.clientY - dragOffsetY) + 'px';
            root.style.right = 'auto';
          }
        });

        document.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
          if (isDragging) {
            root.style.cursor = '';
          }
          isDragging = false;
        });

        const onMove=(e)=>{
          if(!picking) return;
          const t=e.target;
          if(t && t!==root && !root.contains(t)){
            lastHover=t;
            updateHighlight(t);
          }
        };

        const onClick=(e)=>{
          if(!picking) return;
          e.preventDefault();
          e.stopPropagation();
          if(lastHover){
            const sel=robustSelector(lastHover);
            selectorField.value=sel;
            picking=false;
            updateHighlight(null);
            window.removeEventListener('mousemove',onMove,true);
            window.removeEventListener('click',onClick,true);
            if(window.__cursorFlowLog){
              window.__cursorFlowLog('Selected: '+sel);
            }
          }
        };
        pickBtn.onclick=()=>{
          picking=true;
          window.addEventListener('mousemove',onMove,true);
          window.addEventListener('click',onClick,true);
        };

        window.__cursorFlowLog=(msg)=>{
          try{
            const time=new Date().toISOString().split('T')[1].replace('Z','');
            log.textContent+='['+time+'] '+msg+String.fromCharCode(10);
            log.scrollTop=log.scrollHeight;
          }catch(e){}
        };

        window.__cursorBridgePost=async (payload)=>{
          try{
            const res=await fetch('http://localhost:4488/post',{
              method:'POST',
              headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},
              body:JSON.stringify(payload)
            });
            const txt=await res.text();
            if(window.__cursorFlowLog){
              window.__cursorFlowLog('Bridge: '+txt);
            }
          }catch(err){
            if(window.__cursorFlowLog){
              window.__cursorFlowLog('Bridge error: '+(err && err.message || String(err)));
            }
          }
        };

        function currentPayload(type){
          return {
            type,
            selector: selectorField.value,
            description: desc.value,
            app: (window.__cursorApp||${JSON.stringify(app)}),
            cwd: window.__cursorCwd
          };
        }

        let textWrap = false;
        wrapBtn.onclick=()=>{
          textWrap = !textWrap;
          wrapBtn.textContent = textWrap ? 'Unwrap' : 'Wrap';
          log.style.whiteSpace = textWrap ? 'pre-wrap' : 'pre';
          log.style.wordWrap = textWrap ? 'break-word' : 'normal';
        };

        historyBtn.onclick=async ()=>{
          try {
            const response = await fetch('http://localhost:4488/session');
            const session = await response.json();
            let historyText = 'Session History (' + session.sessionId + ')\\n';
            historyText += 'Status: ' + session.status + '\\n';
            historyText += 'Last Activity: ' + new Date(session.lastActivity).toLocaleString() + '\\n';
            historyText += 'Total Submissions: ' + session.submissions.length + '\\n\\n';

            if (session.submissions.length > 0) {
              session.submissions.forEach((sub, idx) => {
                historyText += (idx + 1) + '. [' + new Date(sub.timestamp).toLocaleTimeString() + '] ' + sub.type + '\\n';
                if (sub.selector) historyText += '   Selector: ' + sub.selector + '\\n';
                if (sub.description) historyText += '   Description: ' + sub.description + '\\n';
                if (sub.app) historyText += '   App: ' + sub.app + '\\n';
                historyText += '\\n';
              });
            } else {
              historyText += 'No submissions yet. Make some changes to see them here!\\n';
            }

            log.textContent = historyText;
            log.scrollTop = 0;
          } catch (error) {
            log.textContent = '❌ Failed to load session history: ' + error.message + '\\n\\nMake sure Cursor Flow bridge is running.';
          }
        };

        createFlowBtn.onclick = () => {
          createNewFlow();
        };

        refreshFlowsBtn.onclick = () => {
          refreshFlowsUI();
        };

        saveFlowBtn.onclick = () => {
          saveCurrentFlow();
        };

        loadFlowBtn.onclick = () => {
          loadExistingFlow();
        };

        clearStateBtn.onclick = () => {
          if (confirm('Are you sure you want to clear the saved UI state? This will reset your current recording session.')) {
            clearUIState();
            // Reset UI to initial state
            currentFlow = null;
            flowSteps = [];
            isRecording = false;
            isRecordingMode = false;
            isPaused = false;
            selectorField.value = '';
            desc.value = '';
            pickBtn.textContent = 'Pick Element';
            recordBtn.style.display = 'block';
            pauseBtn.style.display = 'none';
            stopBtn.style.display = 'none';
            saveFlowBtn.style.display = 'none';
            addStepBtn.style.display = 'none';
            clearStateBtn.style.display = 'none';
            updateStepCounter();
            updateStepDisplay();
            log.textContent = 'UI state cleared. Ready to start fresh.';
          }
        };

        recordBtn.onclick = () => {
          startRecording();
        };

        pauseBtn.onclick = () => {
          pauseRecording();
        };

        stopBtn.onclick = () => {
          stopRecording();
        };

        addStepBtn.onclick = () => {
          if (!currentFlow || !isRecording) {
            log.textContent = '❌ Create a flow first using "Create Flow"';
            return;
          }
          if (!selectorField.value) {
            log.textContent = '❌ Pick an element first using "Pick Element"';
            return;
          }
          if (!desc.value.trim()) {
            log.textContent = '❌ Add a description for this step in the text area';
            return;
          }

          const step = {
            type: 'click',
            locator: { by: 'css', selector: selectorField.value },
            description: desc.value.trim()
          };

          addStepToCurrentFlow(step);
          selectorField.value = '';
          desc.value = '';

          // Focus back on description for next step
          setTimeout(() => desc.focus(), 100);
        };

        viewStepsBtn.onclick = () => {
          viewFlowSteps();
        };

        sendToCursorBtn.onclick = () => {
          if (!currentFlow || flowSteps.length === 0) {
            log.textContent = 'No flow to send. Create a flow and add steps first.';
            return;
          }

          // Send the flow data to Cursor for processing
          fetch('http://localhost:4488/post', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify({
              type: 'generateFlow',
              flowName: currentFlow.name,
              flowData: currentFlow.data
            })
          }).then(r => r.text())
            .then(result => {
              log.textContent = 'Flow sent to Cursor for generation: ' + currentFlow.name + '\\nStatus: ' + result;
            }).catch(err => {
              log.textContent = 'Error sending flow to Cursor: ' + err.message;
            });
        };

        // Recording event handlers
        let originalEventHandlers = {};

        function startRecording() {
          if (!currentFlow) {
            log.textContent = '❌ Please create a flow first using "Create Flow"';
            return;
          }

          isRecordingMode = true;
          isPaused = false;
          recordBtn.style.display = 'none';
          pauseBtn.style.display = 'block';
          stopBtn.style.display = 'block';
          pickBtn.textContent = '🎬 Recording...';
          log.textContent = '🎬 Recording started! Interact with the page to add steps.\\nSelect action type above, then click elements to record them.\\nUse "Pause" to temporarily stop recording.';

          // Store original event handlers
          originalEventHandlers = {};

          // Add recording event listeners to document
          document.addEventListener('click', handleRecordingClick, true);
          document.addEventListener('input', handleRecordingInput, true);
          document.addEventListener('change', handleRecordingChange, true);

          saveUIState();
        }

        function pauseRecording() {
          isPaused = !isPaused;
          if (isPaused) {
            pauseBtn.textContent = '▶️ Resume';
            pickBtn.textContent = '⏸️ Paused';
            log.textContent = '⏸️ Recording paused. Click "Resume" to continue.';
          } else {
            pauseBtn.textContent = '⏸️ Pause';
            pickBtn.textContent = '🎬 Recording...';
            log.textContent = '▶️ Recording resumed! Continue interacting with the page.';
          }
          saveUIState();
        }

        function stopRecording() {
          isRecordingMode = false;
          isPaused = false;
          recordBtn.style.display = 'block';
          pauseBtn.style.display = 'none';
          stopBtn.style.display = 'none';
          pickBtn.textContent = 'Pick Element';

          // Remove recording event listeners
          document.removeEventListener('click', handleRecordingClick, true);
          document.removeEventListener('input', handleRecordingInput, true);
          document.removeEventListener('change', handleRecordingChange, true);

          log.textContent = '⏹️ Recording stopped. Flow has ' + flowSteps.length + ' steps.\\nUse "View Steps" to see recorded actions or "Save Flow" to persist.';
          saveUIState();
        }

        function handleRecordingClick(e) {
          if (isPaused || !isRecordingMode) return;

          // Don't record clicks on our overlay
          if (root.contains(e.target)) return;

          const selector = robustSelector(e.target);
          if (!selector) return;

          // Only record if it's a clickable element
          const tagName = e.target.tagName.toLowerCase();
          if (['input', 'textarea', 'select', 'button', 'a'].includes(tagName) ||
              e.target.getAttribute('role') === 'button' ||
              e.target.onclick ||
              e.target.getAttribute('onclick')) {

            selectorField.value = selector;
            const step = {
              type: actionType === 'fill' ? 'fill' : 'click',
              locator: { by: 'css', selector: selector },
              description: 'Auto-recorded ' + actionType + ' on ' + selector
            };

            addStepToCurrentFlow(step);
            log.textContent = '✅ Recorded ' + actionType + ' on: ' + selector;
          }
        }

        function handleRecordingInput(e) {
          if (isPaused || !isRecordingMode || actionType !== 'fill') return;

          // Don't record inputs on our overlay
          if (root.contains(e.target)) return;

          const selector = robustSelector(e.target);
          if (!selector) return;

          selectorField.value = selector;
          const step = {
            type: 'fill',
            locator: { by: 'css', selector: selector },
            value: e.target.value || '',
            description: 'Auto-recorded input on ' + selector
          };

          addStepToCurrentFlow(step);
          log.textContent = '✅ Recorded input on: ' + selector;
        }

        function handleRecordingChange(e) {
          if (isPaused || !isRecordingMode || actionType !== 'fill') return;

          // Don't record changes on our overlay
          if (root.contains(e.target)) return;

          const selector = robustSelector(e.target);
          if (!selector) return;

          selectorField.value = selector;
          const step = {
            type: 'select',
            locator: { by: 'css', selector: selector },
            value: e.target.value || '',
            description: 'Auto-recorded selection on ' + selector
          };

          addStepToCurrentFlow(step);
          log.textContent = '✅ Recorded selection on: ' + selector;
        }

        // Initialize flows on startup
        refreshFlowsUI();

        // Restore UI state if available
        const stateRestored = restoreUIState();
        if (stateRestored && currentFlow) {
          // Show clear state button since we have saved state
          clearStateBtn.style.display = 'block';

          // Update UI to reflect restored state
          pickBtn.textContent = isRecordingMode ? (isPaused ? '⏸️ Paused' : '🎬 Recording...') : 'Pick Element';

          // Show/hide recording buttons
          recordBtn.style.display = isRecordingMode ? 'none' : 'block';
          pauseBtn.style.display = isRecordingMode ? 'block' : 'none';
          stopBtn.style.display = isRecordingMode ? 'block' : 'none';
          saveFlowBtn.style.display = isRecording ? 'block' : 'none';
          addStepBtn.style.display = isRecording ? 'block' : 'none';
          viewStepsBtn.style.display = 'block';

          // Update displays
          updateStepCounter();
          updateStepDisplay();
          updateRecordingStatus();

          if (window.__cursorFlowLog) {
            window.__cursorFlowLog('Restored recording session for: ' + currentFlow.name);
          }
        }

        sendBtn.onclick=()=>{
          if (isRecording && currentFlow) {
            if (selectorField.value && desc.value) {
              // Add step to current flow
              const step = {
                type: 'click',
                locator: { by: 'css', selector: selectorField.value },
                description: desc.value.trim()
              };
              addStepToCurrentFlow(step);
              desc.value = '';
              selectorField.value = '';

              // Focus back on description for next step
              setTimeout(() => desc.focus(), 100);
            } else {
              log.textContent = '❌ Pick an element and add a description first';
            }
          } else {
            // Send to Cursor as usual
            window.__cursorBridgePost(currentPayload('cursor.apply'));
          }
        };
        testBtn.onclick=()=>window.__cursorBridgePost(currentPayload('cursor.test'));
        promoteBtn.onclick=()=>window.__cursorBridgePost(currentPayload('cursor.promote'));

        // Add keyboard shortcuts
        document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
          // Only handle shortcuts when not typing in input fields
          if (e.target.tagName === 'INPUT' || e.target.tagName === 'TEXTAREA') return;

          if (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) {
            switch (e.key) {
              case 'p':
                e.preventDefault();
                pickBtn.click();
                break;
              case 'a':
                e.preventDefault();
                addStepBtn.click();
                break;
              case 's':
                e.preventDefault();
                saveFlowBtn.click();
                break;
              case 'v':
                e.preventDefault();
                viewStepsBtn.click();
                break;
            }
          }
        });

        // Add helpful tooltips
        pickBtn.title = 'Pick Element (Ctrl+P)';
        addStepBtn.title = 'Add Step (Ctrl+A)';
        saveFlowBtn.title = 'Save Flow (Ctrl+S)';
        viewStepsBtn.title = 'View Steps (Ctrl+V)';
        clearStateBtn.title = 'Clear Saved State';

        // Add state persistence for input fields
        let saveTimeout;
        function debouncedSaveState() {
          clearTimeout(saveTimeout);
          saveTimeout = setTimeout(saveUIState, 500); // Save after 500ms of no changes
        }

        selectorField.addEventListener('input', debouncedSaveState);
        desc.addEventListener('input', debouncedSaveState);

        // Save state on page visibility changes (tab switching, etc.)
        document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
          if (document.visibilityState === 'hidden' && currentFlow) {
            saveUIState();
          }
        });

        // Save state before page unload
        window.addEventListener('beforeunload', () => {
          if (currentFlow) {
            saveUIState();
          }
        });

        // Save state when overlay is resized
        let resizeTimeout;
        const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => {
          clearTimeout(resizeTimeout);
          resizeTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
            if (currentFlow) {
              saveUIState();
            }
          }, 500); // Debounce resize events
        });
        resizeObserver.observe(root);

        // Cleanup function
        function cleanup() {
          clearTimeout(saveTimeout);
          // Remove event listeners if needed
        }

        // Expose cleanup for external use
        window.__cursorFlowCleanup = cleanup;

        try{
          const es=new EventSource('http://localhost:4488/events');
          es.onmessage=(ev)=>window.__cursorFlowLog && window.__cursorFlowLog(ev.data);
          es.onerror=()=>window.__cursorFlowLog && window.__cursorFlowLog('SSE connection error');
        }catch(e){}
      
    })();
  `
}

export async function ensureCursorOverlay(
  context: BrowserContext,
  page: Page,
  logger: CloudLogger,
  app: string = 'kareo',
  attempts: number = 5,
  intervalMs: number = 2000,
): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    logger.info('CursorFlow: Generating overlay script for app:', app)
    const script = getCursorOverlayScript(app)
    logger.info('CursorFlow: Script generated, length:', script.length)
    logger.debug('CursorFlow: Script preview (first 200 chars):', script.substring(0, 200))

    logger.debug('CursorFlow: Adding init script to context')
    await context.addInitScript(script)
    logger.info('CursorFlow: Init script added to context successfully')
  } catch (e) {
    logger.error('CursorFlow: Failed to add init script', e as Error)
    logger.error('CursorFlow: Init script error details:', e as Error)
  }

  logger.info('CursorFlow: ensuring overlay injection', { attempts, intervalMs, app })

  for (let i = 1; i <= attempts; i++) {
    logger.info('CursorFlow: Starting injection attempt', { attempt: i, total: attempts })

    try {
      logger.debug('CursorFlow: Checking if overlay element exists in DOM')
      const present = await page.evaluate(() => !!document.getElementById('cursor-flow-ui'))
      logger.info('CursorFlow: Overlay presence check result', { attempt: i, present })

      if (present) {
        logger.info('CursorFlow: Overlay element found! Retrieving details')
        const snippet = await page.evaluate(() => {
          const el = document.getElementById('cursor-flow-ui')
          if (!el) return 'element-not-found'
          return {
            id: el.id,
            tagName: el.tagName,
            outerHTML: el.outerHTML.slice(0, 300),
            style: el.getAttribute('style'),
            childCount: el.children.length
          }
        })
        logger.info('CursorFlow: Overlay element details', { attempt: i, snippet })
        return true
      } else {
        logger.warn('CursorFlow: Overlay element NOT found in DOM', { attempt: i })
      }
    } catch (e) {
      logger.error('CursorFlow: Presence check failed with exception', e as Error, { attempt: i })
      logger.error('CursorFlow: Exception details', e as Error, { attempt: i })
    }

    try {
      const s = getCursorOverlayScript(app)
      logger.debug('CursorFlow: injecting overlay scripts', { attempt: i, length: s.length })
      try { await page.addInitScript(s) } catch {}
      try {
        const b64 = Buffer.from(s, 'utf8').toString('base64')
        await page.addScriptTag({ url: 'data:text/javascript;base64,' + b64 })
        logger.debug('CursorFlow: addScriptTag data-url injected', { attempt: i })
      } catch (e) {
        logger.warn('CursorFlow: data-url addScriptTag failed, trying inline content', e as Error)
        try { await page.addScriptTag({ content: s }); logger.debug('CursorFlow: addScriptTag content injected', { attempt: i }) } catch (e2) {
          logger.warn('CursorFlow: addScriptTag content failed, trying eval', e2 as Error)
          await page.evaluate((raw) => { try { eval(raw) } catch (e) { console.error('cursor-overlay eval error', e) } }, s)
        }
      }
      logger.debug('CursorFlow: injection attempted', { attempt: i })
    } catch (e) {
      logger.warn('CursorFlow: injection attempt failed', e as Error)
    }

    await page.waitForTimeout(intervalMs)
  }

  // Final check
  logger.info('CursorFlow: Starting final injection check')
  try {
    logger.debug('CursorFlow: Executing final presence check')
    const present = await page.evaluate(() => !!document.getElementById('cursor-flow-ui'))
    logger.info('CursorFlow: Final overlay presence result', { present })

    if (present) {
      logger.info('CursorFlow: SUCCESS - Overlay injected successfully!')
      const finalDetails = await page.evaluate(() => {
        const el = document.getElementById('cursor-flow-ui')
        if (!el) return 'final-check-failed'
        return {
          id: el.id,
          dimensions: el.getBoundingClientRect(),
          visible: el.offsetWidth > 0 && el.offsetHeight > 0,
          children: el.children.length
        }
      })
      logger.info('CursorFlow: Final overlay details', finalDetails)
    } else {
      logger.error('CursorFlow: FAILURE - Overlay injection failed after all attempts')
      logger.error('CursorFlow: Checking if script executed at all by looking for debug logs')

      // Check if our debug logs are present in console
      const consoleLogs = await page.evaluate(() => {
        // This is a simple way to check if our script ran
        return !!window.__cursorApp
      })
      logger.info('CursorFlow: Script execution check', { scriptExecuted: consoleLogs })
    }

    return present
  } catch (e) {
    logger.error('CursorFlow: Final presence check failed with exception', e as Error)
    logger.error('CursorFlow: Final check stack trace', e as Error)
    return false
  }
}

import { chromium, firefox, webkit } from 'playwright';
export { ensureCursorOverlay, getCursorOverlayScript } from './cursor-overlay.js';
export var BrowserType;
(function (BrowserType) {
    BrowserType["CHROMIUM"] = "chromium";
    BrowserType["WEBKIT"] = "webkit";
    BrowserType["FIREFOX"] = "firefox";
})(BrowserType || (BrowserType = {}));
export class BrowserService {
    constructor(logger, defaultHeadless = false, config) {
        this.browser = null;
        this.context = null;
        this.page = null;
        this.logger = logger;
        this.headlessMode = defaultHeadless;
        this.defaultTimeout = config?.defaultTimeout ?? 30000;
        this.maxRetries = config?.retryAttempts ?? 3;
        this.retryDelay = config?.retryDelay ?? 1000;
    }
    async initializeStealthPlugin() {
        try {
            const StealthPlugin = await import('puppeteer-extra-plugin-stealth').then(m => m.default);
            // Apply stealth plugin to playwright-extra if available
            this.logger.debug('Stealth plugin initialized');
        }
        catch (error) {
            this.logger.warn('Failed to initialize stealth plugin, continuing without it', error);
        }
    }
    async initialize(type = BrowserType.CHROMIUM, opts = {}) {
        try {
            const headless = opts.headless ?? this.headlessMode;
            // Initialize stealth plugin
            await this.initializeStealthPlugin();
            // Enhanced launch arguments for better stealth
            const baseArgs = [
                '--disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled',
                '--disable-features=IsolateOrigins,site-per-process',
                '--disable-site-isolation-trials',
                '--disable-web-security',
                '--no-sandbox',
                '--disable-setuid-sandbox',
                '--disable-webgl',
                '--disable-accelerated-2d-canvas',
                '--disable-gpu',
                '--disable-notifications',
                '--disable-popup-blocking',
                '--ignore-certificate-errors',
                '--no-default-browser-check',
                '--no-first-run',
                '--disable-background-networking',
                '--disable-background-timer-throttling',
                '--disable-backgrounding-occluded-windows',
                '--disable-breakpad',
                '--disable-component-extensions-with-background-pages',
                '--disable-extensions',
                '--disable-features=TranslateUI',
                '--disable-ipc-flooding-protection',
                '--disable-renderer-backgrounding',
                '--force-color-profile=srgb',
                '--metrics-recording-only',
                '--start-maximized',
            ];
            // Add autoplay policy if provided
            if (opts.autoplayPolicy) {
                baseArgs.push(`--autoplay-policy=${opts.autoplayPolicy}`);
            }
            const mergedArgs = Array.from(new Set([...baseArgs, ...(opts.args || [])]));
            const launchOptions = {
                headless,
                proxy: opts.proxy,
                useCurrentScreenSize: opts.useCurrentScreenSize ?? true,
                args: mergedArgs,
                ignoreDefaultArgs: [
                    '--enable-automation',
                    '--enable-blink-features=IdleDetection',
                    ...(opts.ignoreDefaultArgs || []),
                ],
                ignoreHTTPSErrors: opts.ignoreHTTPSErrors ?? true,
            };
            this.logger.info(`Launching browser`, { type, headless });
            const launcher = type === BrowserType.FIREFOX ? firefox : type === BrowserType.WEBKIT ? webkit : chromium;
            this.browser = await launcher.launch(launchOptions);
            // Get user agent and headers for context
            const userAgent = opts.userAgent;
            const extraHTTPHeaders = opts.extraHTTPHeaders;
            this.context = await this.browser.newContext({
                userAgent,
                extraHTTPHeaders,
                viewport: null, // Allow resizable viewport
            });
            this.page = await this.context.newPage();
            // Debug: confirm viewport behavior at runtime
            try {
                const size = await this.page.viewportSize();
                this.logger.debug('Viewport size after init (null means resizable):', { size });
            }
            catch {
                // ignore
            }
            // Set up debug listeners
            this.setupDebugListeners();
            // Add stealth scripts
            await this.injectStealthScripts();
            // Set full screen mode if enabled
            if (!headless && opts.fullScreen) {
                await this.setFullScreenMode();
            }
            // Set up network error handling
            await this.setupNetworkErrorHandling();
            this.logger.info('Browser initialized successfully with enhanced stealth');
        }
        catch (error) {
            this.logger.error('Failed to initialize browser', error);
            await this.close();
            throw error;
        }
    }
    setupDebugListeners() {
        if (!this.page)
            return;
        // Log console messages (mirror overlay/dev logs at info)
        this.page.on('console', msg => {
            const type = msg.type();
            const text = msg.text();
            if (text.startsWith('DEV_OVERLAY:') || text.startsWith('UI_EVENT:') || text.startsWith('[cursor-flow]')) {
                this.logger.info(`Page console [${type}]`, { text });
            }
            else {
                this.logger.debug(`Page console [${type}]`, { text });
            }
        });
        // Log page errors
        this.page.on('pageerror', error => {
            this.logger.error('Page error:', error);
        });
        // Log failed requests
        this.page.on('requestfailed', request => {
            this.logger.warn('Failed request:', {
                url: request.url(),
                failure: request.failure()?.errorText,
                headers: request.headers(),
            });
        });
        // Log responses with error status codes
        this.page.on('response', response => {
            const status = response.status();
            if (status >= 400) {
                this.logger.warn('Error response:', {
                    url: response.url(),
                    status,
                    statusText: response.statusText(),
                });
            }
        });
    }
    async injectStealthScripts() {
        if (!this.context)
            return;
        await this.context.addInitScript(`
      // Override webdriver property
      Object.defineProperty(navigator, 'webdriver', { get: () => undefined })

      // Add fake plugins
      Object.defineProperty(navigator, 'plugins', {
        get: () => [
          { name: 'Chrome PDF Plugin', filename: 'internal-pdf-viewer' },
          { name: 'Chrome PDF Viewer', filename: 'mhjfbmdgcfjbbpaeojofohoefgiehjai' },
          { name: 'Native Client', filename: 'internal-nacl-plugin' }
        ]
      })

      // Add fake languages
      Object.defineProperty(navigator, 'languages', {
        get: () => ['en-US', 'en', 'es']
      })

      // Add fake chrome runtime
      window.chrome = {
        runtime: {},
        loadTimes: function() {},
        csi: function() {},
        app: {}
      }

      // Override permissions query
      const originalQuery = window.navigator.permissions.query
      window.navigator.permissions.query = (parameters) => (
        parameters.name === 'notifications' ?
          Promise.resolve({ state: Notification.permission }) :
          originalQuery(parameters)
      )
    `);
    }
    async setupNetworkErrorHandling() {
        if (!this.page)
            return;
        // Handle network timeouts
        await this.page.route('**/*', async (route) => {
            try {
                const timeoutPromise = new Promise((_, reject) => {
                    setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('Request timeout')), 30000);
                });
                await Promise.race([route.continue(), timeoutPromise]);
            }
            catch (error) {
                this.logger.warn(`Request timeout for ${route.request().url()}, continuing with page load`, error);
                route.abort('timedout');
            }
        });
        // Handle worker crashes
        this.page.on('worker', worker => {
            worker.on('close', () => this.logger.warn('A worker in the page has crashed'));
        });
    }
    async navigateToUrl(url, waitUntil = 'networkidle') {
        if (!this.page) {
            throw new Error('Browser not initialized');
        }
        let retryCount = 0;
        while (retryCount < this.maxRetries) {
            try {
                // Add random delay before navigation
                const delay = Math.floor(Math.random() * 2000) + 1000;
                await this.page.waitForTimeout(delay);
                // Navigate with longer timeout
                await this.page.goto(url, {
                    waitUntil,
                    timeout: this.defaultTimeout * 2,
                });
                this.logger.info(`Navigated to ${url}`);
                return;
            }
            catch (error) {
                retryCount++;
                this.logger.error(`Failed to navigate to ${url} (attempt ${retryCount}/${this.maxRetries})`, error);
                if (retryCount === this.maxRetries) {
                    throw error;
                }
                // Wait before retrying
                await this.page.waitForTimeout(this.retryDelay);
            }
        }
    }
    async navigateWithRetry(url, options = {}) {
        if (!this.page) {
            this.logger.error('Cannot navigate: Browser page is not initialized');
            return false;
        }
        const maxRetries = options.maxRetries || this.maxRetries;
        const timeout = options.timeout || this.defaultTimeout;
        for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= maxRetries; attempt++) {
            try {
                this.logger.info(`Navigation attempt ${attempt}/${maxRetries} to ${url}`);
                await this.page.goto(url, {
                    waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded',
                    timeout: timeout,
                });
                // Verify page loaded properly
                const pageTitle = await this.page.title().catch(() => '');
                if (pageTitle !== '') {
                    this.logger.info(`Successfully loaded ${url} (title: ${pageTitle})`);
                    return true;
                }
                this.logger.warn(`Page loaded but no title found on attempt ${attempt}`);
                // Short pause before retry
                if (attempt < maxRetries) {
                    await this.page.waitForTimeout(1000 * attempt);
                }
            }
            catch (error) {
                this.logger.warn(`Navigation failed on attempt ${attempt}/${maxRetries}:`, error);
                if (attempt < maxRetries) {
                    await this.page.waitForTimeout(1000 * attempt);
                }
                else {
                    this.logger.error(`Failed to navigate to ${url} after ${maxRetries} attempts`);
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
    async waitForElement(selector, options) {
        if (!this.page) {
            throw new Error('Browser not initialized');
        }
        try {
            const element = this.page.locator(selector);
            await element.waitFor({
                state: options?.state || 'visible',
                timeout: options?.timeout || this.defaultTimeout,
            });
            return element;
        }
        catch (error) {
            this.logger.error(`Failed to wait for element ${selector}`, error);
            throw error;
        }
    }
    async getElementText(selector) {
        if (!this.page) {
            throw new Error('Browser not initialized');
        }
        try {
            const element = this.page.locator(selector);
            return (await element.textContent()) || '';
        }
        catch (error) {
            this.logger.error(`Failed to get text from ${selector}`, error);
            throw error;
        }
    }
    async getCurrentUrl() {
        if (!this.page) {
            throw new Error('Browser not initialized');
        }
        return this.page.url();
    }
    async setFullScreenMode() {
        if (!this.page) {
            this.logger.warn('Cannot set full screen: Browser page is not initialized');
            return;
        }
        try {
            await this.page.keyboard.press('F11');
            this.logger.info('Full screen mode activated');
            // Wait a moment for the transition
            await this.page.waitForTimeout(500);
        }
        catch (error) {
            this.logger.warn('Failed to set full screen mode:', error);
        }
    }
    isHeadless() {
        return this.headlessMode;
    }
    async setHeadlessMode(headless) {
        if (this.headlessMode === headless) {
            this.logger.debug('Headless mode already set to', { headless });
            return;
        }
        this.headlessMode = headless;
        this.logger.info('Setting headless mode to', { headless });
        // Close current browser instance
        await this.close();
        // Reinitialize with new headless setting
        await this.initialize(BrowserType.CHROMIUM, { headless });
    }
    getPage() {
        return this.page;
    }
    getRequiredPage() {
        if (!this.page) {
            throw new Error('Browser not initialized');
        }
        return this.page;
    }
    getContext() {
        return this.context;
    }
    getRequiredContext() {
        if (!this.context) {
            throw new Error('Browser not initialized');
        }
        return this.context;
    }
    async close() {
        try {
            if (this.browser) {
                await this.browser.close();
                this.browser = null;
                this.context = null;
                this.page = null;
                this.logger.info('Browser closed successfully');
            }
        }
        catch (error) {
            this.logger.error('Failed to close browser', error);
            throw error;
        }
    }
}

import { chromium, firefox, webkit } from 'playwright'
import { CloudLogger } from '@org/common/logger'
export { ensureCursorOverlay, getCursorOverlayScript } from './cursor-overlay.js'

export enum BrowserType {
  CHROMIUM = 'chromium',
  WEBKIT = 'webkit',
  FIREFOX = 'firefox',
}

export interface LaunchOptions {
  headless?: boolean
  proxy?: { server: string } | undefined
  args?: string[]
  userAgent?: string
  extraHTTPHeaders?: Record<string, string>
  ignoreDefaultArgs?: string[]
  ignoreHTTPSErrors?: boolean
  useCurrentScreenSize?: boolean
  autoplayPolicy?: string
  defaultTimeout?: number
  retryAttempts?: number
  retryDelay?: number
  fullScreen?: boolean
}

export class BrowserService {
  private browser: Browser | null = null
  private context: BrowserContext | null = null
  private page: Page | null = null
  protected readonly logger: CloudLogger
  private headlessMode: boolean
  private defaultTimeout: number
  private maxRetries: number
  private retryDelay: number

  constructor(logger: CloudLogger, defaultHeadless = false, config?: {
    defaultTimeout?: number
    retryAttempts?: number
    retryDelay?: number
  }) {
    this.logger = logger
    this.headlessMode = defaultHeadless
    this.defaultTimeout = config?.defaultTimeout ?? 30000
    this.maxRetries = config?.retryAttempts ?? 3
    this.retryDelay = config?.retryDelay ?? 1000
  }

  private async initializeStealthPlugin(): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const StealthPlugin = await import('puppeteer-extra-plugin-stealth').then(
        m => m.default
      )
      // Apply stealth plugin to playwright-extra if available
      this.logger.debug('Stealth plugin initialized')
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.warn('Failed to initialize stealth plugin, continuing without it', error as Error)
    }
  }

  async initialize(type: BrowserType = BrowserType.CHROMIUM, opts: LaunchOptions = {}): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const headless = opts.headless ?? this.headlessMode

      // Initialize stealth plugin
      await this.initializeStealthPlugin()

      // Enhanced launch arguments for better stealth
      const baseArgs = [
        '--disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled',
        '--disable-features=IsolateOrigins,site-per-process',
        '--disable-site-isolation-trials',
        '--disable-web-security',
        '--no-sandbox',
        '--disable-setuid-sandbox',
        '--disable-webgl',
        '--disable-accelerated-2d-canvas',
        '--disable-gpu',
        '--disable-notifications',
        '--disable-popup-blocking',
        '--ignore-certificate-errors',
        '--no-default-browser-check',
        '--no-first-run',
        '--disable-background-networking',
        '--disable-background-timer-throttling',
        '--disable-backgrounding-occluded-windows',
        '--disable-breakpad',
        '--disable-component-extensions-with-background-pages',
        '--disable-extensions',
        '--disable-features=TranslateUI',
        '--disable-ipc-flooding-protection',
        '--disable-renderer-backgrounding',
        '--force-color-profile=srgb',
        '--metrics-recording-only',
        '--start-maximized',
      ]

      // Add autoplay policy if provided
      if (opts.autoplayPolicy) {
        baseArgs.push(`--autoplay-policy=${opts.autoplayPolicy}`)
      }

      const mergedArgs = Array.from(new Set([...baseArgs, ...(opts.args || [])]))

      const launchOptions = {
        headless,
        proxy: opts.proxy,
        useCurrentScreenSize: opts.useCurrentScreenSize ?? true,
        args: mergedArgs,
        ignoreDefaultArgs: [
          '--enable-automation',
          '--enable-blink-features=IdleDetection',
          ...(opts.ignoreDefaultArgs || []),
        ],
        ignoreHTTPSErrors: opts.ignoreHTTPSErrors ?? true,
      }

      this.logger.info(`Launching browser`, { type, headless })

      const launcher = type === BrowserType.FIREFOX ? firefox : type === BrowserType.WEBKIT ? webkit : chromium
      this.browser = await launcher.launch(launchOptions as any)

      // Get user agent and headers for context
      const userAgent = opts.userAgent
      const extraHTTPHeaders = opts.extraHTTPHeaders

      this.context = await this.browser.newContext({
        userAgent,
        extraHTTPHeaders,
        viewport: null, // Allow resizable viewport
      })

      this.page = await this.context.newPage()

      // Debug: confirm viewport behavior at runtime
      try {
        const size = await this.page.viewportSize()
        this.logger.debug('Viewport size after init (null means resizable):', { size })
      } catch {
        // ignore
      }

      // Set up debug listeners
      this.setupDebugListeners()

      // Add stealth scripts
      await this.injectStealthScripts()

      // Set full screen mode if enabled
      if (!headless && opts.fullScreen) {
        await this.setFullScreenMode()
      }

      // Set up network error handling
      await this.setupNetworkErrorHandling()

      this.logger.info('Browser initialized successfully with enhanced stealth')

    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error('Failed to initialize browser', error as Error)
      await this.close()
      throw error
    }
  }

  private setupDebugListeners(): void {
    if (!this.page) return

    // Log console messages (mirror overlay/dev logs at info)
    this.page.on('console', msg => {
      const type = msg.type()
      const text = msg.text()
      if (text.startsWith('DEV_OVERLAY:') || text.startsWith('UI_EVENT:') || text.startsWith('[cursor-flow]')) {
        this.logger.info(`Page console [${type}]`, { text })
      } else {
        this.logger.debug(`Page console [${type}]`, { text })
      }
    })

    // Log page errors
      this.page.on('pageerror', error => {
      this.logger.error('Page error:', error)
    })

    // Log failed requests
    this.page.on('requestfailed', request => {
      this.logger.warn('Failed request:', {
        url: request.url(),
        failure: request.failure()?.errorText,
        headers: request.headers(),
      })
    })

    // Log responses with error status codes
    this.page.on('response', response => {
      const status = response.status()
      if (status >= 400) {
        this.logger.warn('Error response:', {
          url: response.url(),
          status,
          statusText: response.statusText(),
        })
      }
    })
  }

  private async injectStealthScripts(): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.context) return

    await this.context.addInitScript(`
      // Override webdriver property
      Object.defineProperty(navigator, 'webdriver', { get: () => undefined })

      // Add fake plugins
      Object.defineProperty(navigator, 'plugins', {
        get: () => [
          { name: 'Chrome PDF Plugin', filename: 'internal-pdf-viewer' },
          { name: 'Chrome PDF Viewer', filename: 'mhjfbmdgcfjbbpaeojofohoefgiehjai' },
          { name: 'Native Client', filename: 'internal-nacl-plugin' }
        ]
      })

      // Add fake languages
      Object.defineProperty(navigator, 'languages', {
        get: () => ['en-US', 'en', 'es']
      })

      // Add fake chrome runtime
      window.chrome = {
        runtime: {},
        loadTimes: function() {},
        csi: function() {},
        app: {}
      }

      // Override permissions query
      const originalQuery = window.navigator.permissions.query
      window.navigator.permissions.query = (parameters) => (
        parameters.name === 'notifications' ?
          Promise.resolve({ state: Notification.permission }) :
          originalQuery(parameters)
      )
    `)
  }

  private async setupNetworkErrorHandling(): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.page) return

    // Handle network timeouts
    await this.page.route('**/*', async route => {
      try {
        const timeoutPromise = new Promise((_, reject) => {
          setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('Request timeout')), 30000)
        })

        await Promise.race([route.continue(), timeoutPromise])
      } catch (error) {
        this.logger.warn(
          `Request timeout for ${route.request().url()}, continuing with page load`,
          error as Error
        )
        route.abort('timedout')
      }
    })

    // Handle worker crashes
    this.page.on('worker', worker => {
      worker.on('close', () =>
        this.logger.warn('A worker in the page has crashed')
      )
    })
  }

  async navigateToUrl(
    url: string,
    waitUntil: 'load' | 'domcontentloaded' | 'networkidle' = 'networkidle'
  ): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.page) {
      throw new Error('Browser not initialized')
    }

    // Check if page/browser is still open before attempting navigation
    if (this.page.isClosed()) {
      throw new Error('Browser page has been closed')
    }

    let retryCount = 0
    while (retryCount < this.maxRetries) {
      try {
        // Check again before each attempt
        if (this.page.isClosed() || !this.browser || !this.browser.isConnected()) {
          throw new Error('Browser or page has been closed')
        }

        // Add random delay before navigation
        const delay = Math.floor(Math.random() * 2000) + 1000
        await this.page.waitForTimeout(delay)

        // Navigate with longer timeout
        await this.page.goto(url, {
          waitUntil,
          timeout: this.defaultTimeout * 2,
        })
        this.logger.info(`Navigated to ${url}`)
        return
      } catch (error) {
        const errorMessage = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)
        
        // Check if browser/page was closed (common on SIGINT/Ctrl+C)
        if (
          errorMessage.includes('Target page, context or browser has been closed') ||
          errorMessage.includes('Browser page has been closed') ||
          errorMessage.includes('Browser or page has been closed') ||
          this.page?.isClosed() ||
          !this.browser?.isConnected()
        ) {
          this.logger.warn('Navigation cancelled: Browser or page was closed')
          throw new Error('Navigation cancelled: Browser or page was closed')
        }

        retryCount++
        this.logger.error(
          `Failed to navigate to ${url} (attempt ${retryCount}/${this.maxRetries})`,
          error as Error
        )

        if (retryCount === this.maxRetries) {
          throw error
        }

        // Wait before retrying (only if page is still open)
        if (!this.page.isClosed()) {
          await this.page.waitForTimeout(this.retryDelay)
        } else {
          throw new Error('Browser page was closed during retry')
        }
      }
    }
  }

  async navigateWithRetry(
    url: string,
    options: { maxRetries?: number; timeout?: number } = {}
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    if (!this.page) {
      this.logger.error('Cannot navigate: Browser page is not initialized')
      return false
    }

    // Check if page/browser is still open before attempting navigation
    if (this.page.isClosed()) {
      this.logger.warn('Browser page has been closed')
      return false
    }

    const maxRetries = options.maxRetries || this.maxRetries
    const timeout = options.timeout || this.defaultTimeout

    for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= maxRetries; attempt++) {
      try {
        // Check again before each attempt
        if (this.page.isClosed() || !this.browser || !this.browser.isConnected()) {
          this.logger.warn('Browser or page has been closed, aborting navigation')
          return false
        }

        this.logger.info(
          `Navigation attempt ${attempt}/${maxRetries} to ${url}`
        )

        await this.page.goto(url, {
          waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded',
          timeout: timeout,
        })

        // Verify page loaded properly
        const pageTitle = await this.page.title().catch(() => '')
        if (pageTitle !== '') {
          this.logger.info(`Successfully loaded ${url} (title: ${pageTitle})`)
          return true
        }

        this.logger.warn(
          `Page loaded but no title found on attempt ${attempt}`
        )

        // Short pause before retry (only if page is still open)
        if (attempt < maxRetries && !this.page.isClosed()) {
          await this.page.waitForTimeout(1000 * attempt)
        }
      } catch (error) {
        const errorMessage = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)
        
        // Check if browser/page was closed (common on SIGINT/Ctrl+C)
        if (
          errorMessage.includes('Target page, context or browser has been closed') ||
          errorMessage.includes('Browser page has been closed') ||
          errorMessage.includes('Browser or page has been closed') ||
          this.page?.isClosed() ||
          !this.browser?.isConnected()
        ) {
          this.logger.warn('Navigation cancelled: Browser or page was closed')
          return false
        }

        this.logger.warn(
          `Navigation failed on attempt ${attempt}/${maxRetries}:`,
          error as Error
        )

        if (attempt < maxRetries) {
          // Only wait if page is still open
          if (!this.page.isClosed()) {
            await this.page.waitForTimeout(1000 * attempt)
          } else {
            this.logger.warn('Browser page was closed during retry')
            return false
          }
        } else {
          this.logger.error(
            `Failed to navigate to ${url} after ${maxRetries} attempts`
          )
          return false
        }
      }
    }

    return false
  }

  async waitForElement(
    selector: string,
    options?: {
      timeout?: number
      state?: 'visible' | 'hidden' | 'attached' | 'detached'
    }
  ): Promise<Locator> {
    if (!this.page) {
      throw new Error('Browser not initialized')
    }

    try {
      const element = this.page.locator(selector)
      await element.waitFor({
        state: options?.state || 'visible',
        timeout: options?.timeout || this.defaultTimeout,
      })
      return element
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error(`Failed to wait for element ${selector}`, error as Error)
      throw error
    }
  }

  async getElementText(selector: string): Promise<string> {
    if (!this.page) {
      throw new Error('Browser not initialized')
    }

    try {
      const element = this.page.locator(selector)
      return (await element.textContent()) || ''
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error(`Failed to get text from ${selector}`, error as Error)
      throw error
    }
  }

  async getCurrentUrl(): Promise<string> {
    if (!this.page) {
      throw new Error('Browser not initialized')
    }
    return this.page.url()
  }

  async setFullScreenMode(): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.page) {
      this.logger.warn('Cannot set full screen: Browser page is not initialized')
      return
    }

    try {
      await this.page.keyboard.press('F11')
      this.logger.info('Full screen mode activated')

      // Wait a moment for the transition
      await this.page.waitForTimeout(500)
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.warn('Failed to set full screen mode:', error as Error)
    }
  }

  isHeadless(): boolean {
    return this.headlessMode
  }

  async setHeadlessMode(headless: boolean): Promise<void> {
    if (this.headlessMode === headless) {
      this.logger.debug('Headless mode already set to', { headless })
      return
    }

    this.headlessMode = headless
    this.logger.info('Setting headless mode to', { headless })

    // Close current browser instance
    await this.close()

    // Reinitialize with new headless setting
    await this.initialize(BrowserType.CHROMIUM, { headless })
  }

  getPage(): Page | null {
    return this.page
  }

  protected getRequiredPage(): Page {
    if (!this.page) {
      throw new Error('Browser not initialized')
    }
    return this.page
  }

  getContext(): BrowserContext | null {
    return this.context
  }

  protected getRequiredContext(): BrowserContext {
    if (!this.context) {
      throw new Error('Browser not initialized')
    }
    return this.context
  }

  async close(): Promise<void> {
    try {
      if (this.browser) {
        await this.browser.close()
        this.browser = null
        this.context = null
        this.page = null
        this.logger.info('Browser closed successfully')
      }
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error('Failed to close browser', error as Error)
      throw error
    }
  }
}

import * as dotenv from 'dotenv'
import * as path from 'path'
import * as fs from 'fs'

export interface AppConfig {
  logLevel: string
}

export function loadEnv(): void {
  const candidates = [
    path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env'),
    path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'apps/opencall/.env'),
    path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'apps/kareo/.env')
  ]
  for (const p of candidates) {
    if (fs.existsSync(p)) {
      dotenv.config({ path: p })
      break
    }
  }
}

export function getConfig(): AppConfig {
  return {
    logLevel: process.env.LOG_LEVEL || (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production' ? 'info' : 'debug'),
  }
}

==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/libs/common/logger/src/index.js ====
import * as winston from 'winston';
import * as fs from 'node:fs';
import * as path from 'node:path';
export function getRunId() {
    if (process.env.RUN_ID && process.env.RUN_ID.length > 0)
        return process.env.RUN_ID;
    const fromEnv = process.env.CI_RUN_ID || process.env.GITHUB_RUN_ID || '';
    const fallback = 'run-' + new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, '-');
    const id = fromEnv || fallback;
    process.env.RUN_ID = id;
    return id;
}
export class CloudLogger {
    constructor(options = {}) {
        this.serviceName = options.serviceName || process.env.SERVICE_NAME || process.env.APP_NAME || 'app';
        this.namespace = options.namespace || process.env.LOG_NAMESPACE || 'default';
        this.runId = options.runId || getRunId();
        const envLevel = process.env[`LOG_LEVEL__${this.namespace.toUpperCase()}`];
        const level = options.level || envLevel || process.env.LOG_LEVEL || 'info';
        const logDir = options.logDir || process.env.LOG_DIR || path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'logs');
        const logToFile = options.logToFile ?? (process.env.LOG_TO_FILE ? process.env.LOG_TO_FILE === 'true' : true);
        // Organize logs by service/app and run id: logs/<serviceName>/<runId>/...
        const filePath = path.join(logDir, this.serviceName, this.runId);
        if (logToFile) {
            try {
                fs.mkdirSync(filePath, { recursive: true });
            }
            catch { }
        }
        const baseFormat = winston.format.combine(winston.format.timestamp(), winston.format.json());
        const transports = [];
        transports.push(new winston.transports.Console({
            level,
            format: winston.format.combine(winston.format.colorize(), winston.format.printf(info => {
                const { level: lvl, message, timestamp, ...rest } = info;
                const meta = Object.keys(rest).length ? ` ${JSON.stringify(rest)}` : '';
                return `${lvl}: ${message} ${meta}`;
            }))
        }));
        if (logToFile) {
            transports.push(new winston.transports.File({
                filename: path.join(filePath, `${this.serviceName}.${this.namespace}.log`),
                level,
                format: baseFormat
            }));
            transports.push(new winston.transports.File({
                filename: path.join(filePath, `${this.serviceName}.error.log`),
                level: 'error',
                format: baseFormat
            }));
        }
        this.logger = winston.createLogger({
            level,
            defaultMeta: { service: this.serviceName, namespace: this.namespace, runId: this.runId, pid: process.pid },
            transports
        });
    }
    child(namespace, level) {
        return new CloudLogger({
            serviceName: this.serviceName,
            namespace,
            level: level || process.env[`LOG_LEVEL__${namespace.toUpperCase()}`] || process.env.LOG_LEVEL || 'info',
            runId: this.runId,
            logDir: process.env.LOG_DIR,
            logToFile: process.env.LOG_TO_FILE ? process.env.LOG_TO_FILE === 'true' : true
        });
    }
    coerceMeta(meta) {
        if (!meta)
            return undefined;
        if (meta instanceof Error)
            return { message: meta.message, stack: meta.stack };
        if (typeof meta === 'object')
            return meta;
        return { value: meta };
    }
    debug(message, meta) {
        this.logger.debug(message, this.coerceMeta(meta));
    }
    info(message, meta) {
        this.logger.info(message, this.coerceMeta(meta));
    }
    warn(message, meta) {
        this.logger.warn(message, this.coerceMeta(meta));
    }
    error(message, error, meta) {
        const coerced = this.coerceMeta(meta);
        const errorInfo = error
            ? { message: error.message, stack: error.stack, ...coerced }
            : coerced;
        this.logger.error(message, errorInfo);
    }
}

==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/libs/common/logger/src/index.ts ====
export * from './runLogger.js'
export * from './tailLatest.js'

import * as winston from 'winston'
import * as fs from 'node:fs'
import * as path from 'node:path'

export interface Logger {
  debug(message: string, meta?: unknown): void
  info(message: string, meta?: unknown): void
  warn(message: string, meta?: unknown): void
  error(message: string, error?: Error, meta?: unknown): void
}

export interface CloudLoggerOptions {
  serviceName?: string
  namespace?: string
  level?: string
  runId?: string
  logDir?: string
  logToFile?: boolean
}

export function getRunId(): string {
  if (process.env.RUN_ID && process.env.RUN_ID.length > 0) return process.env.RUN_ID
  const fromEnv = process.env.CI_RUN_ID || process.env.GITHUB_RUN_ID || ''
  const fallback = 'run-' + new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, '-')
  const id = fromEnv || fallback
  process.env.RUN_ID = id
  return id
}

export class CloudLogger implements Logger {
  private logger: winston.Logger
  private serviceName: string
  private namespace: string
  private runId: string

  constructor(options: CloudLoggerOptions = {}) {
    this.serviceName = options.serviceName || process.env.SERVICE_NAME || process.env.APP_NAME || 'app'
    this.namespace = options.namespace || process.env.LOG_NAMESPACE || 'default'
    this.runId = options.runId || getRunId()

    const envLevel = process.env[`LOG_LEVEL__${this.namespace.toUpperCase()}`]
    const level = options.level || envLevel || process.env.LOG_LEVEL || 'info'

    const logDir = options.logDir || process.env.LOG_DIR || path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'logs')
    const logToFile = options.logToFile ?? (process.env.LOG_TO_FILE ? process.env.LOG_TO_FILE === 'true' : true)

    // Organize logs by service/app and run id: logs/<serviceName>/<runId>/...
    const filePath = path.join(logDir, this.serviceName, this.runId)
    if (logToFile) {
      try { fs.mkdirSync(filePath, { recursive: true }) } catch {}
    }

    const baseFormat = winston.format.combine(
      winston.format.timestamp(),
      winston.format.json()
    )

    const transports: winston.transport[] = []

    transports.push(new winston.transports.Console({
      level,
      format: winston.format.combine(
        winston.format.colorize(),
        winston.format.printf(info => {
          const { level: lvl, message, timestamp, ...rest } = info as any
          const meta = Object.keys(rest).length ? ` ${JSON.stringify(rest)}` : ''
          return `${lvl}: ${message} ${meta}`
        })
      )
    }))

    if (logToFile) {
      transports.push(new winston.transports.File({
        filename: path.join(filePath, `${this.serviceName}.${this.namespace}.log`),
        level,
        format: baseFormat
      }))
      transports.push(new winston.transports.File({
        filename: path.join(filePath, `${this.serviceName}.error.log`),
        level: 'error',
        format: baseFormat
      }))
    }

    this.logger = winston.createLogger({
      level,
      defaultMeta: { service: this.serviceName, namespace: this.namespace, runId: this.runId, pid: process.pid },
      transports
    })
  }

  child(namespace: string, level?: string): CloudLogger {
    return new CloudLogger({
      serviceName: this.serviceName,
      namespace,
      level: level || process.env[`LOG_LEVEL__${namespace.toUpperCase()}`] || process.env.LOG_LEVEL || 'info',
      runId: this.runId,
      logDir: process.env.LOG_DIR,
      logToFile: process.env.LOG_TO_FILE ? process.env.LOG_TO_FILE === 'true' : true
    })
  }

  private coerceMeta(meta?: unknown): Record<string, unknown> | undefined {
    if (!meta) return undefined
    if (meta instanceof Error) return { message: meta.message, stack: meta.stack }
    if (typeof meta === 'object') return meta as Record<string, unknown>
    return { value: meta }
  }

  debug(message: string, meta?: unknown): void {
    this.logger.debug(message, this.coerceMeta(meta))
  }

  info(message: string, meta?: unknown): void {
    this.logger.info(message, this.coerceMeta(meta))
  }

  warn(message: string, meta?: unknown): void {
    this.logger.warn(message, this.coerceMeta(meta))
  }

  error(message: string, error?: Error, meta?: unknown): void {
    const coerced = this.coerceMeta(meta)
    const errorInfo = error
      ? { message: error.message, stack: error.stack, ...coerced }
      : coerced
    this.logger.error(message, errorInfo)
  }
}





==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/libs/common/logger/src/runLogger.ts ====
import fs from 'fs'
import path from 'path'
import winston from 'winston'

export interface RunLoggerOptions {
  flowName?: string
  runId?: string
  logLevel?: string
}

export function createRunLogger(appId: string, options: RunLoggerOptions = {}) {
  const logLevel = (options.logLevel || process.env.LOG_LEVEL || 'info').toLowerCase()
  const now = new Date()
  const yyyyMmDd = now.toISOString().slice(0, 10)
  const dir = path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'logs', appId, yyyyMmDd)
  fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true })

  const filename = options.flowName && options.runId
    ? options.flowName + '.' + options.runId + '.log'
    : 'run-' + now.getTime() + '.log'

  const filePath = path.join(dir, filename)
  const latestPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'logs', appId, 'latest.log')

  const transports: winston.transport[] = [
    new winston.transports.Console({
      level: logLevel,
      format: winston.format.combine(
        winston.format.colorize(),
        winston.format.timestamp(),
        winston.format.printf(info => info.timestamp + ' ' + info.level + ' ' + (info.message as string))
      ),
    }),
    new winston.transports.File({
      level: logLevel,
      filename: filePath,
      format: winston.format.combine(
        winston.format.timestamp(),
        winston.format.json()
      ),
    }),
  ]

  const logger = winston.createLogger({
    level: logLevel,
    transports,
  })

  try {
    // Update pointer to latest log (copy path string)
    fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(latestPath), { recursive: true })
    try { fs.unlinkSync(latestPath) } catch {}
    try { fs.symlinkSync(filePath, latestPath) } catch {
      // On systems without symlink permissions, write a small pointer file
      fs.writeFileSync(latestPath, filePath)
    }
  } catch {}

  return { logger, filePath }
}
