/**
 * Highlight System Feature - Highlights elements on the page
 */

import type { Page } from 'playwright';
import type { EventHandler } from '../core/EventHandler';

export class HighlightSystem {
  private page: Page;
  private eventHandler: EventHandler;
  private options: any;

  constructor(page: Page, eventHandler: EventHandler, options: any = {}) {
    this.page = page;
    this.eventHandler = eventHandler;
    this.options = options;
  }

  async initialize(): Promise<void> {
    // Initialize highlight system
  }

  async highlight(selector: string, duration = 3000): Promise<void> {
    const elements = await this.page.$$(selector);
    if (elements.length === 0) return;

    // Add highlight overlay
    await this.page.evaluate((args: any) => {
      const [selector, duration] = args as [string, number];
      const elements = document.querySelectorAll(selector);
      const highlights: HTMLElement[] = [];

      elements.forEach((element) => {
        const rect = (element as Element).getBoundingClientRect();
        const highlight = document.createElement('div');
        highlight.style.position = 'fixed';
        highlight.style.left = rect.left + 'px';
        highlight.style.top = rect.top + 'px';
        highlight.style.width = rect.width + 'px';
        highlight.style.height = rect.height + 'px';
        highlight.style.background = 'rgba(0,195,255,0.18)';
        highlight.style.border = '2px solid rgba(0,195,255,0.9)';
        highlight.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
        highlight.style.zIndex = '2147483646';

        document.body.appendChild(highlight);
        highlights.push(highlight);
      });

      // Remove highlights after duration
      setTimeout(() => {
        highlights.forEach(h => {
          if (h.parentNode) {
            h.parentNode.removeChild(h);
          }
        });
      }, duration);
    }, [selector, duration]);
  }

  async destroy(): Promise<void> {
    // Clean up any remaining highlights
    await this.page.evaluate(() => {
      const highlights = document.querySelectorAll('[style*="rgba(0,195,255,0.18)"]');
      highlights.forEach(h => {
        if (h.parentNode) {
          h.parentNode.removeChild(h);
        }
      });
    });
  }
}

            minimizable: true,
            resizable: false

    };

    return {
        id,
        title,
        buttons,
        collapsible: options.collapsible || false,
        collapsed: options.collapsed || false
    };
}

import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { UIManager, createDefaultUIConfig, createSection, createButton } from './index.js';

test('UI Library exports work correctly', async () => {
  // Test that main exports are available
  assert.ok(UIManager);
  assert.ok(createDefaultUIConfig);
  assert.ok(createSection);
  assert.ok(createButton);
});

test('createDefaultUIConfig creates valid config', () => {
  const sections = [
    createSection('test', 'Test Section', [
      createButton('test-btn', 'Test', 'test')
    ])
  ];

  const config = createDefaultUIConfig('Test UI', sections);

  assert.ok(config.options);
  assert.ok(config.sections);
  assert.ok(config.features);
  assert.ok(config.handlers);
  assert.equal(config.options.title, 'Test UI');
  assert.equal(config.sections.length, 1);
});

test('createButton creates valid button config', () => {
  const button = createButton('test-btn', 'Test Button', 'test-action');

  assert.equal(button.id, 'test-btn');
  assert.equal(button.label, 'Test Button');
  assert.equal(button.action, 'test-action');
  assert.ok(button.style);
  assert.equal(button.visible, true);
  assert.equal(button.disabled, false);
});

test('createSection creates valid section config', () => {
  const buttons = [
    createButton('btn1', 'Button 1', 'action1'),
    createButton('btn2', 'Button 2', 'action2')
  ];

  const section = createSection('test-section', 'Test Section', buttons);

  assert.equal(section.id, 'test-section');
  assert.equal(section.title, 'Test Section');
  assert.equal(section.buttons.length, 2);
  assert.equal(section.collapsible, false);
  assert.equal(section.collapsed, false);
});

/**
 * Base Theme - Default theme configuration
 */
export const BaseTheme = {
    name: 'base',
    colors: {
        primary: '#3498db',
        secondary: '#2c3e50',
        success: '#27ae60',
        error: '#e74c3c',
        warning: '#f39c12',
        info: '#6c757d',
        background: '#2c3e50',
        surface: '#34495e',

/**
 * UI Event Types for Automation Platform
 */
export {};



==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/libs/common/ui/src/types/events.types.ts ====
/**
 * UI Event Types for Automation Platform
 */

export type UIButtonEvent = 'click' | 'hover' | 'focus' | 'blur';

export type UIPanelEvent = 'move' | 'resize' | 'minimize' | 'maximize' | 'close' | 'focus';

export type UIToastEvent = 'show' | 'hide' | 'click';

export type UIHighlightEvent = 'start' | 'end' | 'update';

export interface UIEvent {
  type: string;
  timestamp: number;
  target: string;
  data?: any;
}

export interface ButtonClickEvent extends UIEvent {
  type: 'button:click';
  target: string;
  data: {
    action: string;
    buttonId: string;
    originalEvent: MouseEvent;
  };
}

export interface PanelMoveEvent extends UIEvent {
  type: 'panel:move';
  target: string;
  data: {
    position: { x: number; y: number };
    delta: { x: number; y: number };
  };
}

export interface PanelResizeEvent extends UIEvent {
  type: 'panel:resize';
  target: string;
  data: {
    size: { width: number; height: number };
    delta: { width: number; height: number };
  };
}

export interface PanelStateEvent extends UIEvent {
  type: 'panel:state';
  target: string;
  data: {
    state: 'minimized' | 'maximized' | 'normal';
    previousState: 'minimized' | 'maximized' | 'normal';
  };
}

export interface ToastEvent extends UIEvent {
  type: 'toast:show' | 'toast:hide' | 'toast:click';
  target: string;
  data: {
    message: string;
    type: 'info' | 'success' | 'error' | 'warning';
    duration?: number;
  };
}

export interface HighlightEvent extends UIEvent {
  type: 'highlight:start' | 'highlight:end' | 'highlight:update';
  target: string;
  data: {
    selector: string;
    bounds?: { x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number };
  };
}

export interface ElementPickerEvent extends UIEvent {
  type: 'picker:start' | 'picker:end' | 'picker:select';
  target: string;
  data: {
    selector?: string;
    element?: Element;
    bounds?: { x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number };
  };
}

export type UIAnyEvent =
  | ButtonClickEvent
  | PanelMoveEvent
  | PanelResizeEvent
  | PanelStateEvent
  | ToastEvent
  | HighlightEvent
  | ElementPickerEvent;

export interface EventListener<T extends UIEvent = UIEvent> {
  (event: T): void | Promise<void>;
}

export interface EventEmitter {
  on<T extends UIEvent>(eventType: T['type'], listener: EventListener<T>): void;
  off<T extends UIEvent>(eventType: T['type'], listener: EventListener<T>): void;
  emit<T extends UIEvent>(event: T): void;
  removeAllListeners(eventType?: string): void;
}

/**
 * DOM Utilities - Helper functions for DOM manipulation
 */
export class DOMUtils {
    /**
     * Create a DOM element with attributes and styles
     */
    static createElement(tagName, attributes = {}, styles = {}) {
        const element = document.createElement(tagName);
        // Set attributes
        Object.entries(attributes).forEach(([key, value]) => {
            element.setAttribute(key, value);
        });
        // Set styles
        Object.entries(styles).forEach(([key, value]) => {
            element.style[key] = value;
        });
        return element;
    }
    /**
     * Add event listener with automatic cleanup
     */
    static addEventListener(element, event, handler, options) {
        element.addEventListener(event, handler, options);
        return () => element.removeEventListener(event, handler, options);
    }
    /**
     * Wait for an element to exist in the DOM
     */
    static waitForElement(selector, timeout = 5000) {
        return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
            const element = document.querySelector(selector);
            if (element) {
                resolve(element);
                return;
            }
            const observer = new MutationObserver(() => {
                const element = document.querySelector(selector);
                if (element) {
                    observer.disconnect();
                    resolve(element);
                }
            });
            observer.observe(document.body, {
                childList: true,
                subtree: true
            });
            setTimeout(() => {
                observer.disconnect();
                reject(new Error(`Element ${selector} not found within ${timeout}ms`));
            }, timeout);
        });
    }
    /**
     * Get element bounds
     */
    static getBounds(element) {
        const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect();
        return {
            x: rect.left,
            y: rect.top,
            width: rect.width,
            height: rect.height
        };
    }
    /**
     * Check if element is visible
     */
    static isVisible(element) {
        const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect();
        return rect.width > 0 && rect.height > 0;
    }
    /**
     * Generate a unique ID
     */
    static generateId(prefix = 'ui') {
        return `${prefix}-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}`;
    }
}

/**
 * DOM Utilities - Helper functions for DOM manipulation
 */

export class DOMUtils {
  /**
   * Create a DOM element with attributes and styles
   */
  static createElement(
    tagName: string,
    attributes: Record<string, string> = {},
    styles: Record<string, string> = {}
  ): HTMLElement {
    const element = document.createElement(tagName);

    // Set attributes
    Object.entries(attributes).forEach(([key, value]) => {
      element.setAttribute(key, value);
    });

    // Set styles
    Object.entries(styles).forEach(([key, value]) => {
      (element.style as any)[key] = value;
    });

    return element;
  }

  /**
   * Add event listener with automatic cleanup
   */
  static addEventListener(
    element: Element,
    event: string,
    handler: EventListener,
    options?: AddEventListenerOptions
  ): () => void {
    element.addEventListener(event, handler, options);
    return () => element.removeEventListener(event, handler, options);
  }

  /**
   * Wait for an element to exist in the DOM
   */
  static waitForElement(selector: string, timeout = 5000): Promise<Element> {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const element = document.querySelector(selector);
      if (element) {
        resolve(element);
        return;
      }

      const observer = new MutationObserver(() => {
        const element = document.querySelector(selector);
        if (element) {
          observer.disconnect();
          resolve(element);
        }
      });

      observer.observe(document.body, {
        childList: true,
        subtree: true
      });

      setTimeout(() => {
        observer.disconnect();
        reject(new Error(`Element ${selector} not found within ${timeout}ms`));
      }, timeout);
    });
  }

  /**
   * Get element bounds
   */
  static getBounds(element: Element): { x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number } {
    const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect();
    return {
      x: rect.left,
      y: rect.top,
      width: rect.width,
      height: rect.height
    };
  }

  /**
   * Check if element is visible
   */
  static isVisible(element: Element): boolean {
    const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect();
    return rect.width > 0 && rect.height > 0;
  }

  /**
   * Generate a unique ID
   */
  static generateId(prefix = 'ui'): string {
    return `${prefix}-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}`;
  }
}

/**
 * Position Utilities - Helper functions for positioning elements
 */
export class PositionUtils {
    /**
     * Constrain position within viewport bounds
     */
    static constrainToViewport(position, size, margin = 10) {
        const viewportWidth = window.innerWidth;
        const viewportHeight = window.innerHeight;
        let x = Math.max(margin, Math.min(position.x, viewportWidth - size.width - margin));
        let y = Math.max(margin, Math.min(position.y, viewportHeight - size.height - margin));
        return { x, y };
    }
    /**
     * Center position within viewport
     */
    static centerInViewport(size) {
        const viewportWidth = window.innerWidth;
        const viewportHeight = window.innerHeight;
        return {
            x: (viewportWidth - size.width) / 2,
            y: (viewportHeight - size.height) / 2
        };
    }
    /**
     * Get element bounds
     */
    static getElementBounds(element) {
        const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect();
        return {
            x: rect.left,
            y: rect.top,
            width: rect.width,
            height: rect.height
        };
    }
    /**
     * Calculate distance between two positions
     */
    static distance(pos1, pos2) {
        const dx = pos2.x - pos1.x;
        const dy = pos2.y - pos1.y;
        return Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
    }
    /**
     * Check if position is within bounds
     */
    static isWithinBounds(position, bounds) {
        return (position.x >= bounds.x &&
            position.x <= bounds.x + bounds.width &&
            position.y >= bounds.y &&
            position.y <= bounds.y + bounds.height);
    }
    /**
     * Snap position to grid
     */
    static snapToGrid(position, gridSize = 10) {
        return {
            x: Math.round(position.x / gridSize) * gridSize,
            y: Math.round(position.y / gridSize) * gridSize
        };
    }
}

/**
 * Position Utilities - Helper functions for positioning elements
 */

export interface Position {
  x: number;
  y: number;
}

export interface Size {
  width: number;
  height: number;
}

export interface Bounds extends Position, Size {}

export class PositionUtils {
  /**
   * Constrain position within viewport bounds
   */
  static constrainToViewport(position: Position, size: Size, margin = 10): Position {
    const viewportWidth = window.innerWidth;
    const viewportHeight = window.innerHeight;

    let x = Math.max(margin, Math.min(position.x, viewportWidth - size.width - margin));
    let y = Math.max(margin, Math.min(position.y, viewportHeight - size.height - margin));

    return { x, y };
  }

  /**
   * Center position within viewport
   */
  static centerInViewport(size: Size): Position {
    const viewportWidth = window.innerWidth;
    const viewportHeight = window.innerHeight;

    return {
      x: (viewportWidth - size.width) / 2,
      y: (viewportHeight - size.height) / 2
    };
  }

  /**
   * Get element bounds
   */
  static getElementBounds(element: Element): Bounds {
    const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect();
    return {
      x: rect.left,
      y: rect.top,
      width: rect.width,
      height: rect.height
    };
  }

  /**
   * Calculate distance between two positions
   */
  static distance(pos1: Position, pos2: Position): number {
    const dx = pos2.x - pos1.x;
    const dy = pos2.y - pos1.y;
    return Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
  }

  /**
   * Check if position is within bounds
   */
  static isWithinBounds(position: Position, bounds: Bounds): boolean {
    return (
      position.x >= bounds.x &&
      position.x <= bounds.x + bounds.width &&
      position.y >= bounds.y &&
      position.y <= bounds.y + bounds.height
    );
  }

  /**
   * Snap position to grid
   */
  static snapToGrid(position: Position, gridSize = 10): Position {
    return {
      x: Math.round(position.x / gridSize) * gridSize,
      y: Math.round(position.y / gridSize) * gridSize
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Style Utilities - CSS and styling helpers
 */
export class StyleUtils {
    /**
     * Convert camelCase to kebab-case
     */
    static camelToKebab(str) {
        return str.replace(/([a-z0-9]|(?=[A-Z]))([A-Z])/g, '$1-$2').toLowerCase();
    }
    /**
     * Convert style object to CSS string
     */
    static styleObjectToString(styles) {
        return Object.entries(styles)
            .map(([key, value]) => `${this.camelToKebab(key)}: ${value}`)
            .join('; ');
    }
    /**
     * Add CSS styles to document head
     */
    static addStyles(css, id) {
        const style = document.createElement('style');
        if (id)
            style.id = id;
        style.textContent = css;
        document.head.appendChild(style);
    }
    /**
     * Remove CSS styles by ID
     */
    static removeStyles(id) {
        const style = document.getElementById(id);
        if (style) {
            style.remove();
        }
    }
    /**
     * Create CSS animation keyframes
     */
    static createAnimation(name, keyframes) {
        const keyframeRules = Object.entries(keyframes)
            .map(([key, styles]) => {
            const styleString = this.styleObjectToString(styles);
            return `${key} { ${styleString} }`;
        })
            .join('\n    ');
        return `@keyframes ${name} {\n    ${keyframeRules}\n  }`;
    }
    /**
     * Apply styles to element
     */
    static applyStyles(element, styles) {
        Object.entries(styles).forEach(([key, value]) => {
            element.style[key] = value;
        });
    }
}



==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/libs/common/ui/src/utils/StyleUtils.ts ====
/**
 * Style Utilities - CSS and styling helpers
 */

export class StyleUtils {
  /**
   * Convert camelCase to kebab-case
   */
  static camelToKebab(str: string): string {
    return str.replace(/([a-z0-9]|(?=[A-Z]))([A-Z])/g, '$1-$2').toLowerCase();
  }

  /**
   * Convert style object to CSS string
   */
  static styleObjectToString(styles: Record<string, string | number>): string {
    return Object.entries(styles)
      .map(([key, value]) => `${this.camelToKebab(key)}: ${value}`)
      .join('; ');
  }

  /**
   * Add CSS styles to document head
   */
  static addStyles(css: string, id?: string): void {
    const style = document.createElement('style');
    if (id) style.id = id;
    style.textContent = css;
    document.head.appendChild(style);
  }

  /**
   * Remove CSS styles by ID
   */
  static removeStyles(id: string): void {
    const style = document.getElementById(id);
    if (style) {
      style.remove();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Create CSS animation keyframes
   */
  static createAnimation(name: string, keyframes: Record<string, Record<string, string>>): string {
    const keyframeRules = Object.entries(keyframes)
      .map(([key, styles]) => {
        const styleString = this.styleObjectToString(styles);
        return `${key} { ${styleString} }`;
      })
      .join('\n    ');

    return `@keyframes ${name} {\n    ${keyframeRules}\n  }`;
  }

  /**
   * Apply styles to element
   */
  static applyStyles(element: HTMLElement, styles: Record<string, string | number>): void {
    Object.entries(styles).forEach(([key, value]) => {
      (element.style as any)[key] = value;
    });
  }
}

import { test } from 'node:test'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import { extractNumericCode, sanitizeInput, sleep } from './index.js'

test('sanitizeInput masks sensitive fields', () => {
  const input = { username: 'u', password: 'p', token: 't' }
  const out = sanitizeInput(input) as Record<string, unknown>
  assert.equal(out.password, '****')
  assert.equal(out.token, '****')
})

test('sleep resolves after delay', async () => {
  const before = Date.now()
  await sleep(10)
  const elapsed = Date.now() - before
  assert.ok(elapsed >= 8)
})

test('extractNumericCode returns first matching code', () => {
  assert.equal(extractNumericCode('Your code is 123456.'), '123456')
  assert.equal(extractNumericCode('Use 654321 then 123456', 6), '654321')
  assert.equal(extractNumericCode('No code here'), null)
})

export function sanitizeInput(
  input: unknown,
  sensitiveFieldsParam?: string[]
): unknown {
  if (typeof input === 'object' && input !== null) {
    const sanitizedInput = { ...(input as Record<string, unknown>) }

    const sensitiveFields =
      Array.isArray(sensitiveFieldsParam) && sensitiveFieldsParam.length > 0
        ? sensitiveFieldsParam
        : ['password', 'token', 'credentials', 'secretKey', 'accessToken']

    for (const field of sensitiveFields) {
      if (field in sanitizedInput) {
        sanitizedInput[field] = '****'
      }
    }

    return Object.keys(sanitizedInput).length > 10
      ? { ...sanitizedInput, __truncated: true }
      : sanitizedInput
  }

  return input
}

export function sleep(ms: number): Promise<void> {
  const durationMs = Number.isFinite(ms) ? Math.max(0, Math.floor(ms)) : 0
  return new Promise(resolve => {
    setTimeout(resolve, durationMs)
  })
}

export function extractNumericCode(
  input: string | null | undefined,
  digits = 6
): string | null {
  if (!input || !Number.isInteger(digits) || digits <= 0) {
    return null
  }

  const pattern = new RegExp(`\\b\\d{${digits}}\\b`)
  const match = input.match(pattern)
  return match ? match[0] : null
}

# Cursor Flow Creation Prompt (Shared)

## Parameters
- APP_ID: {APP_ID}
- FLOW_ROOT: {FLOW_ROOT}

## Context
You are being asked to create a Playwright automation flow based on user-recorded steps. The user has recorded a sequence of interactions on a web page and wants you to generate a proper Playwright test or automation script.

## Input Data Structure
```json
{
  "flowName": "string",
  "url": "string",
  "steps": [
    {
      "type": "goto|click|fill|type|waitFor|assertVisible",
      "locator": {
        "by": "css|text|role",
        "selector": "string"
      },
      "description": "string",
      "value": "string (for fill/type actions)"
    }
  ]
}
```

## Output Requirements

### 1. File Location
- Staging: `{FLOW_ROOT}/staging/{flowName}.json`
- Promoted: `{FLOW_ROOT}/promoted/{flowName}.json`

### 2. Code Generation
Generate a TypeScript file at: `apps/{APP_ID}/src/flows/generated/{flowName}.ts`

### 3. Implementation Guidelines

#### Page Object Pattern
```typescript
export class GeneratedFlowNamePage {
  constructor(private page: Page) {}

  async executeFlow(): Promise<void> {
    // Implementation here
  }
}
```

#### Error Handling
- Use try/catch blocks
- Log meaningful error messages
- Handle timeouts gracefully

#### Selectors
- Prefer data-testid attributes
- Fall back to CSS selectors
- Use descriptive variable names

#### Timeouts
- Default: 30000ms for page loads
- 10000ms for element interactions
- 5000ms for assertions

### 4. Code Structure Template

```typescript
import { Page } from 'playwright'

export interface FlowStep {
  type: 'goto' | 'click' | 'fill' | 'type' | 'waitFor' | 'assertVisible'
  locator?: {
    by: 'css' | 'text' | 'role'
    selector: string
  }
  description?: string
  value?: string
}

export class {FlowName}Flow {
  constructor(private page: Page) {}

  async executeFlow(steps: FlowStep[]): Promise<void> {
    try {
      for (const step of steps) {
        await this.executeStep(step)
      }
      console.log('✅ {FlowName} flow completed successfully')
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('❌ {FlowName} flow failed:', error)
      throw error
    }
  }

  private async executeStep(step: FlowStep): Promise<void> {
    switch (step.type) {
      case 'goto':
        await this.page.goto(step.value!, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' })
        break
      case 'click':
        await this.page.click(step.locator!.selector)
        break
      case 'fill':
        await this.page.fill(step.locator!.selector, step.value || '')
        break
      case 'type':
        await this.page.type(step.locator!.selector, step.value || '')
        break
      case 'waitFor':
        if (step.value === 'load') {
          await this.page.waitForLoadState('load')
        }
        break
      case 'assertVisible':
        await this.page.waitForSelector(step.locator!.selector, {
          state: 'visible',
          timeout: 10000,
        })
        break
      default:
        console.warn('Unknown step type: ' + step.type)
    }
  }
}
```

### 5. Completion Signal

When the flow generation is complete, update the session file to indicate completion:

```json
{
  "sessionId": "string",
  "status": "completed",
  "lastActivity": "ISO timestamp",
  "currentFlow": "flowName",
  "generatedFiles": [
    "apps/{APP_ID}/src/flows/generated/{flowName}.ts",
    "{FLOW_ROOT}/promoted/{flowName}.json"
  ]
}
```

### 6. Best Practices

- Use meaningful variable names
- Add JSDoc comments
- Handle edge cases
- Log progress at each step
- Provide clear error messages
- Follow TypeScript strict mode guidelines

# Cursor Flow Refinement Prompt (Shared)

## Parameters
- APP_ID: {APP_ID}
- FLOW_ROOT: {FLOW_ROOT}

## Context
You are refining an existing Playwright automation flow. The user has provided feedback or the flow needs optimization for reliability, performance, or maintainability.

## Input Data Structure
```json
{
  "flowName": "string",
  "currentImplementation": "apps/{APP_ID}/src/flows/generated/{flowName}.ts",
  "issues": ["array of specific issues or improvement requests"],
  "performanceMetrics": {
    "executionTime": "number (ms)",
    "successRate": "number (percentage)",
    "failurePoints": ["array of step indices that commonly fail"]
  }
}
```

## Refinement Tasks

### 1. Reliability Improvements
- Add retry mechanisms for flaky selectors
- Implement better waiting strategies
- Add assertion recovery mechanisms
- Handle network timeouts gracefully

### 2. Performance Optimizations
- Reduce unnecessary waits
- Optimize selector strategies
- Parallelize independent operations
- Cache frequently accessed elements

### 3. Maintainability Enhancements
- Extract reusable page methods
- Add comprehensive error messages
- Implement logging improvements
- Add configuration options

### 4. Code Quality
- Add TypeScript strict type checking
- Implement proper error boundaries
- Add input validation
- Follow DRY principles

## Refinement Template

```typescript
export class RefinedFlowNameFlow {
  private readonly maxRetries = 3
  private readonly defaultTimeout = 30000

  constructor(private page: Page) {}

  async executeFlow(steps: FlowStep[]): Promise<void> {
    const startTime = Date.now()

    try {
      for (let i = 0; i < steps.length; i++) {
        await this.executeStepWithRetry(steps[i], i)
      }

      const executionTime = Date.now() - startTime
      console.log('✅ Flow completed in ' + executionTime + 'ms')

    } catch (error) {
      console.error('❌ Flow failed at step: ', error)
      throw error
    }
  }

  private async executeStepWithRetry(step: FlowStep, stepIndex: number): Promise<void> {
    for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= this.maxRetries; attempt++) {
      try {
        await this.executeStep(step)
        return
      } catch (error) {
        if (attempt === this.maxRetries) {
          throw { stepIndex: stepIndex, cause: error }
        }
        console.warn('Step ' + stepIndex + ' failed (attempt ' + attempt + '), retrying...')
        await this.page.waitForTimeout(1000 * attempt)
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Output Requirements

### 1. Enhanced Implementation
- Location: `apps/{APP_ID}/src/flows/refined/{flowName}.ts`
- Backup Original: `apps/{APP_ID}/src/flows/generated/{flowName}.v1.ts`

# Cursor Flow - Web Automation Made Easy

A comprehensive web automation system for creating, editing, and managing automated workflows with AI assistance.

## 🚀 Features

- **🎯 Visual Flow Editor**: Create and edit automation flows with a user-friendly interface
- **🤖 AI-Powered**: Generate flows automatically using AI models
- **📦 Staging & Promotion**: Test flows in staging before promoting to production
- **🔧 Step Management**: Add, edit, move, and delete individual steps
- **🎨 Element Picker**: Visually select elements on web pages
- **📊 Observability**: Comprehensive logging and action tracking
- **🔄 Bridge Communication**: Seamless integration with backend platforms

## 📋 Architecture

The cursor-flow system consists of several key components:

### Core Components

1. **FlowEditorUI** (`src/ui/FlowEditorUI.ts`)
   - Main UI component for flow editing
   - Handles modal display and user interactions
   - Manages flow state and step editing

2. **FlowEditor** (`src/ui/flow/FlowEditor.ts`)
   - Core business logic for flow management
   - Implements the `FlowEditorApi` interface
   - Handles flow validation and step operations

3. **CursorCLIIntegration** (`src/cursorCLI.ts`)
   - Interface for AI model integration
   - Handles flow generation and optimization

4. **StagingWorkflowManager** (`src/stagingWorkflow.ts`)
   - Manages flow deployment lifecycle
   - Handles staging, testing, and promotion

### Interface Definition

The `FlowEditorApi` interface defines the contract for flow editing operations:

```typescript
interface FlowEditorApi {
  getSteps(): FlowStepDef[]
  setSteps(steps: FlowStepDef[]): void
  append(step: FlowStepDef): void
  loadFlow(flow: Flow): void
  getFlow(): Flow
  addStep(step: FlowStep): void
  moveStep(fromIndex: number, toIndex: number): void
  validateFlow(): void
  updateStepLocator(stepIndex: number, locator: any): void
  saveFlow(): void
  canRunFlow(): boolean
  updateContent(content: string): void
}
```

## 🎯 Usage

### Basic Flow Creation

1. **Open Editor**: Click the "Open Editor" button in the main menu
2. **Create Flow**: Click "Create New Flow" to start a new automation
3. **Add Steps**: Use the step editor to add individual actions
4. **Configure Elements**: Use the element picker to select page elements
5. **Save & Test**: Save your flow and test it in the staging environment
6. **Promote**: Move successful flows to production

### Step Types

The system supports various step types:

- **click**: Click on an element
- **type**: Type text into an input field
- **select**: Select an option from a dropdown
- **goto**: Navigate to a URL
- **waitFor**: Wait for an element or condition
- **assertVisible**: Assert that an element is visible
- **assertText**: Assert that text is present
- **iterate**: Repeat steps for multiple elements

### Element Locators

Elements can be located using various strategies:

- **CSS Selectors**: `.button`, `#element-id`
- **Text Content**: Elements containing specific text
- **ARIA Roles**: `button`, `textbox`, etc.
- **Labels**: Form elements with specific labels
- **Placeholders**: Input fields with placeholder text
- **Test IDs**: Elements with `data-testid` attributes

## 🔧 Bridge Events

The system uses bridge events for communication between the overlay and platform:

### Outgoing Events (from overlay to platform)

- `openEditor`: Open the flow editor modal
- `saveSteps`: Save flow steps to storage
- `runDraft`: Execute the current draft flow
- `promoteDraft`: Promote draft to production
- `testFlow`: Test flow in staging environment
- `generateFlow`: Generate flow using AI

### Incoming Events (from platform to overlay)

- `cursorflow:testResults`: Test execution results
- `cursorflow:aiSuggestions`: AI-generated step suggestions

      localStorage: {
        getItem: vi.fn(),
        setItem: vi.fn(),
        removeItem: vi.fn(),
        clear: vi.fn(),
      },
      addEventListener: vi.fn(),

      dispatchEvent: vi.fn(),
      getComputedStyle: vi.fn().mockReturnValue({}),
      requestAnimationFrame: vi.fn(),
      cancelAnimationFrame: vi.fn(),
    } as any;
  }
}

// Test data generators
export class TestDataGenerator {
  static randomString(length = 10): string {
    return Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, length + 2);
  }

  static randomUrl(): string {
    return `https://${this.randomString()}.com`;
  }

  static randomEmail(): string {
    return `${this.randomString()}@${this.randomString()}.com`;
  }

  static randomId(): string {
    return `id_${this.randomString()}`;
  }

  static randomSelector(): string {
    return `.${this.randomString()}`;
  }
}

// Async test utilities
export class AsyncTestUtils {
  static async waitForCondition(
    condition: () => boolean | Promise<boolean>,
    timeout = 1000,
    interval = 50
  ): Promise<void> {
    const startTime = Date.now();

    while (Date.now() - startTime < timeout) {
      if (await condition()) {
        return;
      }
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, interval));
    }

    throw new Error('Condition not met within timeout');
  }

  static async expectAsync(
    operation: () => Promise<any>,
    expected: any,
    timeout = 1000
  ): Promise<void> {
    await this.waitForCondition(async () => {
      try {
        const result = await operation();
        return result === expected;
      } catch {
        return false;
      }
    }, timeout);
  }
}

// Network mocking utilities
export class NetworkMocks {
  static mockFetch(response: any, status = 200) {
    const mockResponse = {
      ok: status >= 200 && status < 300,
      status,
      json: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(response),
      text: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(JSON.stringify(response)),
    };

    return vi.spyOn(global, 'fetch').mockResolvedValue(mockResponse as any);
  }

  static mockFetchError(error: Error) {
    return vi.spyOn(global, 'fetch').mockRejectedValue(error);
  }
}

==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/libs/cursor-flow/src/cursorBridge.ts ====
import { spawn } from 'child_process'
import fs from 'fs'

export function applyFlow({ flowPath, filesGlob, model = 'gpt-5' }: { flowPath: string; filesGlob: string; model?: string }) {
  const flow = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(flowPath, 'utf8'))
  const plan = [
    '# Cursor Implementation Plan',
    `Flow: ${flow.name}`,
    'Desired diffs:',
    '- Add missing testIds where needed.',
    '- Ensure buttons/inputs are accessible by role/label.',
    '- Align UI with shared-ui primitives.',
  ].join('\n')

  const child = spawn('cursor-agent', ['--model', model, '--files', filesGlob], {
    stdio: ['pipe', 'inherit', 'inherit'],
    shell: true,
  })
  child.stdin.write(plan)
  child.stdin.end()
}

/**
 * Cursor CLI Integration Service
 * Handles communication with Cursor CLI for model selection and flow generation
 */

export interface CursorModel {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  maxTokens: number;
  isAvailable: boolean;
}

export interface CursorCLIOptions {
  baseUrl?: string;
  apiKey?: string;
  timeout?: number;
  maxRetries?: number;
}

export interface FlowGenerationRequest {
  flow: {
    name: string;
    description?: string;
    steps: any[];
  };
  modelId: string;
  options?: {
    generateDescription?: boolean;
    generateSelectors?: boolean;
    optimizeSteps?: boolean;
  };
}

export interface FlowGenerationResponse {
  success: boolean;
  generatedFlow?: any;
  error?: string;
  metadata?: {
    modelUsed: string;
    generationTime: number;
    tokensUsed: number;
  };
}

export class CursorCLIIntegration {
  private options: Required<CursorCLIOptions>;

  constructor(options: CursorCLIOptions = {}) {
    this.options = {
      baseUrl: options.baseUrl || 'http://localhost:4488',
      apiKey: options.apiKey || process.env.CURSOR_API_KEY || '',
      timeout: options.timeout || 30000,
      maxRetries: options.maxRetries || 3,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Get available models from Cursor CLI
   */
  async getAvailableModels(): Promise<CursorModel[]> {
    try {
      const response = await this.makeRequest('/models');

      if (response.success && response.models) {
        return response.models.map((model: any) => ({
          id: model.id,
          name: model.name,
          description: model.description,
          maxTokens: model.maxTokens || 4096,
          isAvailable: model.isAvailable !== false,
        }));
      }

      throw new Error('Failed to fetch models from Cursor CLI');
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error fetching Cursor models:', error);
      return this.getDefaultModels();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Submit flow for generation with specified model
   */
  async generateFlow(request: FlowGenerationRequest): Promise<FlowGenerationResponse> {
    try {
      const response = await this.makeRequest('/generate', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify(request),
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
      });

      if (response.success) {
        return {
          success: true,
          generatedFlow: response.flow,
          metadata: {
            modelUsed: response.model || request.modelId,
            generationTime: response.generationTime || 0,
            tokensUsed: response.tokensUsed || 0,
          },
        };
      } else {
        return {
          success: false,
          error: response.error || 'Unknown error occurred',
        };
      }
    } catch (error) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Network error',
      };
    }
  }

  /**
   * Submit flow to staging area
   */
  async submitToStaging(flowName: string, flowData: any): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> {
    try {
      const response = await this.makeRequest('/staging', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify({ flowName, flowData }),
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
      });

      return {
        success: response.success || false,
        error: response.error,
      };
    } catch (error) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to submit to staging',
      };
    }
  }

  /**
   * Promote flow from staging to production
   */
  async promoteFlow(flowName: string): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> {
    try {
      const response = await this.makeRequest('/promote', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify({ flowName }),
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
      });

      return {
        success: response.success || false,
        error: response.error,
      };
    } catch (error) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to promote flow',
      };
    }
  }

  /**
   * Test flow in staging environment
   */
  async testFlow(flowName: string): Promise<{ success: boolean; results?: any; error?: string }> {
    try {
      const response = await this.makeRequest('/test', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify({ flowName }),
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
      });

      return {
        success: response.success || false,
        results: response.results,
        error: response.error,
      };
    } catch (error) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to test flow',
      };
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get staging status
   */
  async getStagingStatus(): Promise<{ flows: string[]; isReady: boolean; error?: string }> {
    try {
      const response = await this.makeRequest('/staging/status');

      return {
        flows: response.flows || [],
        isReady: response.isReady !== false,
        error: response.error,
      };
    } catch (error) {
      return {
        flows: [],
        isReady: false,
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to get staging status',
      };
    }
  }

  private async makeRequest(endpoint: string, options: RequestInit = {}): Promise<any> {
    const url = `${this.options.baseUrl}${endpoint}`;

    const requestOptions: RequestInit = {
      ...options,
      headers: {
        ...options.headers,
        ...(this.options.apiKey && { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${this.options.apiKey}` }),
      },
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(this.options.timeout),
    };

    let lastError: Error;

    for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= this.options.maxRetries; attempt++) {
      try {
        const response = await fetch(url, requestOptions);

        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`);
        }

        const data = await response.json();
        return data;
      } catch (error) {
        lastError = error as Error;

        if (attempt === this.options.maxRetries) {
          break;
        }

        // Exponential backoff
        const delay = Math.min(1000 * Math.pow(2, attempt - 1), 10000);
        await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, delay));
      }
    }

    throw lastError;
  }

  private getDefaultModels(): CursorModel[] {
    return [
      {
        id: 'gpt-4',
        name: 'GPT-4',
        description: 'Most capable model, optimized for complex tasks',
        maxTokens: 8192,
        isAvailable: true,
      },
      {
        id: 'gpt-3.5-turbo',
        name: 'GPT-3.5 Turbo',
        description: 'Fast and efficient for most tasks',
        maxTokens: 4096,
        isAvailable: true,
      },
      {
        id: 'claude-3-opus',
        name: 'Claude 3 Opus',
        description: 'Advanced reasoning and analysis',
        maxTokens: 8192,
        isAvailable: true,
      },
      {
        id: 'claude-3-sonnet',
        name: 'Claude 3 Sonnet',
        description: 'Balanced performance and speed',
        maxTokens: 4096,
        isAvailable: true,
      },
    ];
  }

  /**
   * Check if Cursor CLI is available
   */
  async isAvailable(): Promise<boolean> {
    try {
      await this.getAvailableModels();
      return true;
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get CLI version
   */
  async getVersion(): Promise<string> {
    try {
      const response = await this.makeRequest('/version');
      return response.version || 'unknown';
    } catch {
      return 'unknown';
    }
  }
}

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import { toLocator } from './locators';
import type { LocatorDef } from './types';

// Mock playwright
const mockPage = {
  getByRole: vi.fn(),
  getByLabel: vi.fn(),
  getByPlaceholder: vi.fn(),
  getByTestId: vi.fn(),
  locator: vi.fn(),
};

describe('toLocator', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks();
  });

  it('should create role-based locator', () => {
    const def: LocatorDef = { by: 'role', role: 'button', name: 'Submit' };
    const mockLocator = { click: vi.fn() };
    mockPage.getByRole.mockReturnValue(mockLocator);

    const result = toLocator(mockPage as any, def);

    expect(mockPage.getByRole).toHaveBeenCalledWith('button', { name: 'Submit' });
    expect(result).toBe(mockLocator);
  });

  it('should create role-based locator without name', () => {
    const def: LocatorDef = { by: 'role', role: 'textbox' };
    const mockLocator = { fill: vi.fn() };
    mockPage.getByRole.mockReturnValue(mockLocator);

    const result = toLocator(mockPage as any, def);

    expect(mockPage.getByRole).toHaveBeenCalledWith('textbox', {});
    expect(result).toBe(mockLocator);
  });

  it('should create label-based locator', () => {
    const def: LocatorDef = { by: 'label', text: 'Email Address' };
    const mockLocator = { fill: vi.fn() };
    mockPage.getByLabel.mockReturnValue(mockLocator);

    const result = toLocator(mockPage as any, def);

    expect(mockPage.getByLabel).toHaveBeenCalledWith('Email Address');
    expect(result).toBe(mockLocator);
  });

  it('should create placeholder-based locator', () => {
    const def: LocatorDef = { by: 'placeholder', text: 'Enter your email' };
    const mockLocator = { fill: vi.fn() };
    mockPage.getByPlaceholder.mockReturnValue(mockLocator);

    const result = toLocator(mockPage as any, def);

    expect(mockPage.getByPlaceholder).toHaveBeenCalledWith('Enter your email');
    expect(result).toBe(mockLocator);
  });

  it('should create testId-based locator', () => {
    const def: LocatorDef = { by: 'testId', id: 'submit-button' };
    const mockLocator = { click: vi.fn() };
    mockPage.getByTestId.mockReturnValue(mockLocator);

    const result = toLocator(mockPage as any, def);

    expect(mockPage.getByTestId).toHaveBeenCalledWith('submit-button');
    expect(result).toBe(mockLocator);
  });

  it('should create CSS-based locator', () => {
    const def: LocatorDef = { by: 'css', selector: '.btn-primary' };
    const mockLocator = { click: vi.fn() };
    mockPage.locator.mockReturnValue(mockLocator);

    const result = toLocator(mockPage as any, def);

    expect(mockPage.locator).toHaveBeenCalledWith('.btn-primary');
    expect(result).toBe(mockLocator);
  });

  it('should throw error for unsupported locator type', () => {
    const def = { by: 'xpath', path: '//button' } as any;

    expect(() => toLocator(mockPage as any, def)).toThrow(
      'Unsupported locator: {"by":"xpath","path":"//button"}'
    );
  });

  it('should support all locator types', () => {
    const testCases: LocatorDef[] = [
      { by: 'role', role: 'button', name: 'Click me' },
      { by: 'role', role: 'textbox' },
      { by: 'label', text: 'Username' },
      { by: 'placeholder', text: 'Enter password' },
      { by: 'testId', id: 'login-form' },
      { by: 'css', selector: '#submit-btn' },
    ];

    testCases.forEach((def, index) => {
      const mockLocator = { [`method${index}`]: vi.fn() };
      mockPage.getByRole.mockReturnValue(mockLocator);
      mockPage.getByLabel.mockReturnValue(mockLocator);
      mockPage.getByPlaceholder.mockReturnValue(mockLocator);
      mockPage.getByTestId.mockReturnValue(mockLocator);
      mockPage.locator.mockReturnValue(mockLocator);

      const result = toLocator(mockPage as any, def);
      expect(result).toBe(mockLocator);
    });
  });
});



==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/libs/cursor-flow/src/locators.ts ====
import type { Page, Locator } from 'playwright'
import type { LocatorDef } from './types.js'

export function toLocator(page: Page, def: LocatorDef): Locator {
  switch (def.by) {
    case 'role':
      return page.getByRole(def.role as any, def.name ? { name: def.name } : {})
    case 'label':
      return page.getByLabel(def.text)
    case 'placeholder':
      return page.getByPlaceholder(def.text)
    case 'testId':
      return page.getByTestId(def.id)
    case 'css':
      return page.locator(def.selector)
    default:
      throw new Error(`Unsupported locator: ${JSON.stringify(def)}`)
  }
}

      } else {

      logArea.appendChild(entry);
      logArea.scrollTop = logArea.scrollHeight;

      console.log("[cursor-flow]", message, payload);

  function persistState() {
    try {
      var rect = host.getBoundingClientRect();
      var payload = {
        left: rect.left,
        top: rect.top,
        minimized: root.classList.contains(MINIMIZED_CLASS)
      };
      window.sessionStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(payload));
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn("[cursor-flow] failed to persist overlay state", error);
    }
  }

  function restoreState() {
    try {
      var stored = window.sessionStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      if (!stored) return;
      var payload = JSON.parse(stored);
      if (payload && typeof payload === "object") {
        if (typeof payload.left === "number" && typeof payload.top === "number") {
          host.style.left = payload.left + "px";
          host.style.top = payload.top + "px";
          host.style.right = "auto";
          host.style.bottom = "auto";
        }
        if (payload.minimized) {
          root.classList.add(MINIMIZED_CLASS);
        }
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn("[cursor-flow] failed to restore overlay state", error);
    }
  }

  function ensureBridge() {
    window.__cursorFlowLog = log;
    if (typeof window.__cursorBridgePost !== "function") {
      window.__cursorBridgePost = function (event, payload) {
        try {
          var base = window.__cursorBridgeUrl || "http://localhost:4488";
          fetch(base + "/post", {
            method: "POST",
            headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
            body: JSON.stringify({ event: event, payload: payload }),
            keepalive: true
          });
        } catch (error) {
          console.warn("[cursor-flow] no bridge handler; event dropped:", event, error);
        }
      };
    }
  }

  function cssPath(element) {
    if (!(element instanceof Element)) return "";
    var parts = [];
    var node = element;
    for (var depth = 0; node && depth < 5; depth++) {
      var selector = node.nodeName.toLowerCase();
      if (node.id) {
        selector += "#" + node.id;
        parts.unshift(selector);
        break;
      }
      var parent = node.parentElement;
      if (!parent) {
        parts.unshift(selector);
        break;
      }
      var siblings = Array.prototype.filter.call(parent.children, function (child) {
        return child.nodeName === node.nodeName;
      });
      var index = siblings.indexOf(node);
      if (siblings.length > 1 && index >= 0) {
        selector += ":nth-of-type(" + (index + 1) + ")";
      }
      parts.unshift(selector);
      node = parent;
    }
    return parts.join(" > ");
  }

  function locatorFor(element) {
    if (!(element instanceof Element)) {
      return { by: "css", selector: "body" };
    }
    var aria = element.getAttribute("aria-label");
    var role = element.getAttribute("role");
    var textContent = (element.textContent || "").trim();
    if (role && textContent) {
      return { by: "role", role: role, name: textContent };
    }
    var labelledBy = element.getAttribute("aria-labelledby");
    if (labelledBy) {
      return { by: "label", text: labelledBy };
    }
    var placeholder = element.getAttribute("placeholder");
    if (placeholder) {
      return { by: "placeholder", text: placeholder };
    }
    var testId = element.getAttribute("data-testid") || element.getAttribute("data-automation-id");
    if (testId) {
      return { by: "testId", id: testId };
    }
    return { by: "css", selector: cssPath(element) };
  }

  function installPicker() {
    var highlight = document.createElement("div");
    highlight.style.cssText = "position:fixed;pointer-events:none;border:2px solid #00e0ff;background:rgba(0,224,255,0.18);z-index:2147483645;border-radius:6px;transition:all 0.12s ease;";
    document.body.appendChild(highlight);

    function draw(element) {
      if (!element) return;
      var rect = element.getBoundingClientRect();
      highlight.style.left = rect.left + "px";
      highlight.style.top = rect.top + "px";
      highlight.style.width = rect.width + "px";
      highlight.style.height = rect.height + "px";
    }

    function onMove(event) {
      var element = document.elementFromPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY);
      if (!element || host.contains(element)) return;
      lastPickedElement = element;
      draw(element);
    }

    function cleanup() {
      window.removeEventListener("mousemove", onMove, true);
      window.removeEventListener("click", onClick, true);
      window.removeEventListener("keydown", onCancel, true);
      try { highlight.remove(); } catch (_) {}
    }

    function onClick(event) {
      event.preventDefault();
      event.stopPropagation();
      cleanup();
      if (lastPickedElement) {
        log("Element picked: " + lastPickedElement.tagName);
      }
    }

    function onCancel(event) {
      if (event.key === "Escape") {
        cleanup();
        log("Element picker cancelled");
      }
    }

    window.addEventListener("mousemove", onMove, true);
    window.addEventListener("click", onClick, true);
    window.addEventListener("keydown", onCancel, true);
    log("🎯 Element picker activated - press ESC to cancel");
  }

  function handleAction(action) {
    switch (action) {
      case "minimize":
        root.classList.toggle(MINIMIZED_CLASS);
        persistState();
        log("Overlay " + (root.classList.contains(MINIMIZED_CLASS) ? "minimized" : "restored"));
        break;
      case "close":
        try { window.sessionStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY); } catch (_) {}
        host.remove();
        if (window.__cursorFlowOverlay) delete window.__cursorFlowOverlay;
        break;
      case "pick":
        installPicker();
        break;
      case "append":
        if (!lastPickedElement) {
          log("⚠️ No element picked. Use Pick Element first.");
          return;
        }
        var locator = locatorFor(lastPickedElement);
        window.__cursorBridgePost("saveSteps", {
          app: APP_ID,
          steps: [{ type: "click", locator: locator }]
        });
        log("Step appended for: " + lastPickedElement.tagName);
        break;
      case "run":
        window.__cursorBridgePost("runDraft", { app: APP_ID });
        log("Running draft flow...");
        break;
      case "promote":
        window.__cursorBridgePost("promoteDraft", { app: APP_ID });
        log("Promoting draft flow...");
        break;
      case "open-editor":
        window.__cursorBridgePost("openEditor", { app: APP_ID, source: "overlay" });
        log("Opening Cursor Flow Editor...");
        break;
      default:
        log("Unknown action: " + action);
    }
  }

  function setupButtons() {
    root.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
      var target = event.target instanceof HTMLElement ? event.target.closest("[data-action]") : null;
      if (!target) return;
      var action = target.getAttribute("data-action");
      if (!action) return;
      handleAction(action);
    });
  }

  function setupDrag() {
    if (!header) return;
    var dragging = false;
    var offsetX = 0;
    var offsetY = 0;

    function onDrag(event) {
      if (!dragging) return;
      var left = Math.max(8, event.clientX - offsetX);
      var top = Math.max(8, event.clientY - offsetY);
      host.style.left = left + "px";
      host.style.top = top + "px";
      host.style.right = "auto";
      host.style.bottom = "auto";
    }

    function stopDrag() {
      if (!dragging) return;
      dragging = false;
      root.classList.remove(DRAGGING_CLASS);
      document.removeEventListener("mousemove", onDrag, true);
      document.removeEventListener("mouseup", stopDrag, true);
      persistState();
    }

    header.addEventListener("mousedown", function (event) {
      if (event.button !== 0) return;
      if (event.target instanceof HTMLElement && event.target.closest("button")) return;
      dragging = true;
      root.classList.add(DRAGGING_CLASS);
      var rect = host.getBoundingClientRect();
      offsetX = event.clientX - rect.left;
      offsetY = event.clientY - rect.top;
      document.addEventListener("mousemove", onDrag, true);
      document.addEventListener("mouseup", stopDrag, true);
    });
  }

  function ensureMounted() {
    if (!document.body.contains(host)) {
      document.body.appendChild(host);
    }
  }

  ensureBridge();
  setupButtons();
  setupDrag();
  restoreState();

  window.__cursorFlowOverlay = {
    host: host,
    root: root,
    log: log,
    persist: persistState
  };

  var observer = new MutationObserver(ensureMounted);
  observer.observe(document.documentElement, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  window.addEventListener("pageshow", ensureMounted, true);
  window.addEventListener("load", ensureMounted, true);

  log("✅ Cursor Flow overlay initialized");
})();`;
};

import fs from 'fs'
import path from 'path'
import { chromium } from 'playwright'
import type { Flow, FlowStep } from './types.js'
import { toLocator } from './locators.js'

type RunOptions = {
  flowPath: string
  project?: string
  headless?: boolean
  artifactsDir?: string
}

export async function runFlow({ flowPath, project = 'default', headless = true, artifactsDir = 'artifacts' }: RunOptions) {
  const raw = fs.readFileSync(flowPath, 'utf8')
  const flow: Flow = JSON.parse(raw)

  const browser = await chromium.launch({ headless })
  const context = await browser.newContext({ storageState: storageStateIfExists(project) })
  const page = await context.newPage()

  const slug = slugify(flow.name || path.basename(flowPath))
  const outDir = path.join(artifactsDir, project, slug, String(Date.now()))
  fs.mkdirSync(outDir, { recursive: true })

  try {
    if (flow.url) await page.goto(flow.url)
    for (const step of flow.steps) {
      await execStep(step)
    }
  } catch (e) {
    try { await page.screenshot({ path: path.join(outDir, 'error.png'), fullPage: true }) } catch {}
    throw e
  } finally {
    try { await context.tracing.stop({ path: path.join(outDir, 'trace.zip') } as any) } catch {}
    await browser.close()
  }

  async function execStep(step: FlowStep): Promise<void> {
    switch (step.type) {
      case 'goto':
        await page.goto(step.url)
        return
      case 'click':
        await toLocator(page, step.locator).click()
        return
      case 'fill':
        await toLocator(page, step.locator).fill(step.value)
        return
      case 'select':
        await toLocator(page, step.locator).selectOption(step.value)
        return
      case 'waitFor':
        if (step.state === 'selector' && step.selector) {
          await toLocator(page, step.selector).waitFor()
        } else {
          await page.waitForLoadState(step.state)
        }
        return
      case 'assertVisible':
        await toLocator(page, step.locator).waitFor({ state: 'visible', timeout: 15000 })
        return
      case 'assertText': {
        const loc = toLocator(page, step.locator)
        await loc.waitFor({ state: 'visible', timeout: 15000 })
        const content = await loc.innerText()
        if (!content.includes(step.text)) throw new Error(`assertText failed: expected includes "${step.text}", got "${content}"`)
        return
      }
      case 'iterate': {
        const rows = toLocator(page, step.locator)
        const count = await rows.count()
        for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
          const row = rows.nth(i)
          for (const inner of step.each) {
            await execStep(inner)
          }
        }
        return
      }
      default:
        throw new Error(`Unknown step type: ${(step as any).type}`)
    }
  }

  function storageStateIfExists(app: string) {
    const p = path.resolve(`apps/${app}/auth/storageState.json`)
    return fs.existsSync(p) ? p : undefined
  }
}

function slugify(s: string) {
  return s.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/(^-|-$)/g, '')
}

/**
 * Staging Workflow Manager
 * Handles the complete flow lifecycle from draft to staging to production
 */

export interface StagingEnvironment {
  name: string;
  url: string;
  isAvailable: boolean;
  lastDeployment?: Date;
  status: 'online' | 'offline' | 'maintenance';
}

export interface FlowDeployment {
  flowName: string;
  version: number;
  environment: string;
  status: 'pending' | 'deploying' | 'deployed' | 'failed' | 'rolled_back';
  deployedAt: Date;
  deployedBy: string;
  rollbackVersion?: number;
}

export interface DeploymentResult {
  success: boolean;
  deployment?: FlowDeployment;
  error?: string;
  logs?: string[];
}

export interface StagingConfig {
  environments: StagingEnvironment[];
  autoDeploy: boolean;
  requireApproval: boolean;
  maxConcurrentDeployments: number;
  rollbackOnFailure: boolean;
}

export class StagingWorkflowManager {
  private config: StagingConfig;
  private activeDeployments: Map<string, FlowDeployment> = new Map();
  private deploymentHistory: FlowDeployment[] = [];

  constructor(config: Partial<StagingConfig> = {}) {
    this.config = {
      environments: [
        {
          name: 'staging',
          url: 'https://staging.example.com',
          isAvailable: true,
          status: 'online',
        },
        {
          name: 'production',
          url: 'https://app.example.com',
          isAvailable: true,
          status: 'online',
        },
      ],
      autoDeploy: false,
      requireApproval: true,
      maxConcurrentDeployments: 3,
      rollbackOnFailure: true,
      ...config,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Submit flow to staging environment
   */
  async submitToStaging(
    flowName: string,
    flowData: any,
    options: {
      version?: number;
      description?: string;
      skipTests?: boolean;
    } = {}
  ): Promise<DeploymentResult> {
    try {
      // Validate environment availability
      const stagingEnv = this.config.environments.find(env => env.name === 'staging');
      if (!stagingEnv || !stagingEnv.isAvailable) {
        return {
          success: false,
          error: 'Staging environment is not available',
        };
      }

      // Check deployment limits
      const activeCount = Array.from(this.activeDeployments.values())
        .filter(d => d.status === 'deploying').length;

      if (activeCount >= this.config.maxConcurrentDeployments) {
        return {
          success: false,
          error: 'Maximum concurrent deployments reached',
        };
      }

      // Create deployment record
      const deployment: FlowDeployment = {
        flowName,
        version: options.version || this.getNextVersion(flowName),
        environment: 'staging',
        status: 'pending',
        deployedAt: new Date(),
        deployedBy: this.getCurrentUser(),
      };

      this.activeDeployments.set(`${flowName}-staging`, deployment);

      // Run pre-deployment tests if not skipped
      if (!options.skipTests) {
        const testResult = await this.runPreDeploymentTests(flowName, flowData);
        if (!testResult.success) {
          deployment.status = 'failed';
          return {
            success: false,
            error: `Pre-deployment tests failed: ${testResult.error}`,
            logs: testResult.logs,
          };
        }
      }

      // Deploy to staging
      deployment.status = 'deploying';
      const deployResult = await this.deployToEnvironment(deployment, flowData, options.description);

      if (deployResult.success) {
        deployment.status = 'deployed';
        this.deploymentHistory.push(deployment);

        return {
          success: true,
          deployment,
          logs: deployResult.logs,
        };
      } else {
        deployment.status = 'failed';
        return {
          success: false,
          error: deployResult.error,
          logs: deployResult.logs,
        };
      }
    } catch (error) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown deployment error',
      };
    }
  }

  /**
   * Promote flow from staging to production
   */
  async promoteToProduction(
    flowName: string,
    options: {
      version?: number;
      description?: string;
      skipTests?: boolean;
      requireApproval?: boolean;
    } = {}
  ): Promise<DeploymentResult> {
    try {
      // Check if staging deployment exists
      const stagingDeployment = this.activeDeployments.get(`${flowName}-staging`);
      if (!stagingDeployment || stagingDeployment.status !== 'deployed') {
        return {
          success: false,
          error: 'No successful staging deployment found',
        };
      }

      // Check approval if required
      if (this.config.requireApproval || options.requireApproval !== false) {
        const approved = await this.requestApproval(flowName, 'production');
        if (!approved) {
          return {
            success: false,
            error: 'Deployment requires approval',
          };
        }
      }

      // Check production environment
      const prodEnv = this.config.environments.find(env => env.name === 'production');
      if (!prodEnv || !prodEnv.isAvailable) {
        return {
          success: false,
          error: 'Production environment is not available',
        };
      }

      // Get staging flow data (in real implementation, this would fetch from staging)
      const flowData = await this.getFlowFromStaging(flowName);

      // Create production deployment
      const deployment: FlowDeployment = {
        flowName,
        version: options.version || stagingDeployment.version,
        environment: 'production',
        status: 'pending',
        deployedAt: new Date(),
        deployedBy: this.getCurrentUser(),
      };

      this.activeDeployments.set(`${flowName}-production`, deployment);

      // Run pre-deployment tests
      if (!options.skipTests) {
        const testResult = await this.runPreDeploymentTests(flowName, flowData, 'production');
        if (!testResult.success) {
          deployment.status = 'failed';
          return {
            success: false,
            error: `Pre-deployment tests failed: ${testResult.error}`,
            logs: testResult.logs,
          };
        }
      }

      // Deploy to production
      deployment.status = 'deploying';
      const deployResult = await this.deployToEnvironment(deployment, flowData, options.description);

      if (deployResult.success) {
        deployment.status = 'deployed';
        this.deploymentHistory.push(deployment);

        return {
          success: true,
          deployment,
          logs: deployResult.logs,
        };
      } else {
        deployment.status = 'failed';

        // Auto-rollback if configured
        if (this.config.rollbackOnFailure) {
          await this.rollbackDeployment(deployment);
        }

        return {
          success: false,
          error: deployResult.error,
          logs: deployResult.logs,
        };
      }
    } catch (error) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown promotion error',
      };
    }
  }

  /**
   * Rollback a failed deployment
   */
  async rollbackDeployment(deployment: FlowDeployment): Promise<DeploymentResult> {
    try {
      // Find previous successful deployment
      const previousDeployments = this.deploymentHistory
        .filter(d => d.flowName === deployment.flowName &&
                    d.environment === deployment.environment &&
                    d.status === 'deployed' &&
                    d.deployedAt < deployment.deployedAt)
        .sort((a, b) => b.deployedAt.getTime() - a.deployedAt.getTime());

      if (previousDeployments.length === 0) {
        return {
          success: false,
          error: 'No previous deployment found for rollback',
        };
      }

      const previousDeployment = previousDeployments[0];
      previousDeployment.status = 'rolled_back';
      previousDeployment.rollbackVersion = deployment.version;

      // In a real implementation, this would revert the environment
      console.log(`Rolling back ${deployment.flowName} from version ${deployment.version} to ${previousDeployment.version}`);

      return {
        success: true,
        deployment: previousDeployment,
      };
    } catch (error) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Rollback failed',
      };
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get deployment status for a flow
   */
  getDeploymentStatus(flowName: string): {
    staging?: FlowDeployment;
    production?: FlowDeployment;
    history: FlowDeployment[];
  } {
    return {
      staging: this.activeDeployments.get(`${flowName}-staging`),
      production: this.activeDeployments.get(`${flowName}-production`),
      history: this.deploymentHistory.filter(d => d.flowName === flowName),
    };
  }

  /**
   * Get all active deployments
   */
  getActiveDeployments(): FlowDeployment[] {
    return Array.from(this.activeDeployments.values());
  }

  /**
   * Get deployment history
   */
  getDeploymentHistory(limit: number = 50): FlowDeployment[] {
    return this.deploymentHistory
      .sort((a, b) => b.deployedAt.getTime() - a.deployedAt.getTime())
      .slice(0, limit);
  }

  /**
   * Update environment status
   */
  updateEnvironmentStatus(environmentName: string, status: StagingEnvironment['status']): boolean {
    const environment = this.config.environments.find(env => env.name === environmentName);
    if (environment) {
      environment.status = status;
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  private getNextVersion(flowName: string): number {
    const deployments = this.deploymentHistory
      .filter(d => d.flowName === flowName)
      .sort((a, b) => b.version - a.version);

    return deployments.length > 0 ? deployments[0].version + 1 : 1;
  }

  private getCurrentUser(): string {
    // In a real implementation, this would get the actual user
    return 'current-user';
  }

  private async runPreDeploymentTests(
    flowName: string,
    flowData: any,
    environment: string = 'staging'
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string; logs?: string[] }> {
    // In a real implementation, this would run actual tests
    console.log(`Running pre-deployment tests for ${flowName} in ${environment}`);

    // Simulate test execution
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 1000));

    return {
      success: true,
      logs: [`Tests passed for ${flowName}`],
    };
  }

  private async deployToEnvironment(
    deployment: FlowDeployment,
    flowData: any,
    description?: string
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string; logs?: string[] }> {
    // In a real implementation, this would deploy to the actual environment
    console.log(`Deploying ${deployment.flowName} v${deployment.version} to ${deployment.environment}`);

    // Simulate deployment
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 2000));

    return {
      success: true,
      logs: [
        `Started deployment of ${deployment.flowName} v${deployment.version}`,
        'Validating flow structure...',
        'Deploying to environment...',
        'Deployment completed successfully',
      ],
    };
  }

  private async getFlowFromStaging(flowName: string): Promise<any> {
    // In a real implementation, this would fetch the flow from staging
    // For now, return a mock object
    return { name: flowName, version: 1, steps: [] };
  }

  private async requestApproval(flowName: string, environment: string): Promise<boolean> {
    // In a real implementation, this would send an approval request
    console.log(`Requesting approval for ${flowName} deployment to ${environment}`);
    return true; // Auto-approve for demo
  }
}

==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/libs/cursor-flow/src/types.ts ====
export type Flow = {
  name: string
  url?: string
  tags?: string[]
  steps: FlowStep[]
}

export type FlowStep =
  | { type: 'goto'; url: string }
  | { type: 'click'; locator: LocatorDef }
  | { type: 'fill'; locator: LocatorDef; value: string }
  | { type: 'select'; locator: LocatorDef; value: string }
  | { type: 'waitFor'; state: 'load' | 'networkidle' | 'selector'; selector?: LocatorDef }
  | { type: 'iterate'; locator: LocatorDef; each: FlowStep[] }
  | { type: 'assertVisible'; locator: LocatorDef }
  | { type: 'assertText'; locator: LocatorDef; text: string }

export type LocatorDef =
  | { by: 'role'; role: 'button' | 'link' | 'textbox' | 'cell' | 'row' | 'heading'; name?: string }
  | { by: 'label'; text: string }
  | { by: 'placeholder'; text: string }
  | { by: 'testId'; id: string }
  | { by: 'css'; selector: string }

        FlowFactory.createClickStep(),
        FlowFactory.createFillStep(),

    });

    editor.loadFlow(flow);

    // Reorder steps (move first step to end)
    editor.moveStep(0, 2);

    // Mock localStorage
    const mockStorage: Record<string, string> = {};
    Object.defineProperty(window, 'localStorage', {
      value: {
        getItem: vi.fn((key: string) => mockStorage[key] || null),
        setItem: vi.fn((key: string, value: string) => {
          mockStorage[key] = value;
        }),
        removeItem: vi.fn((key: string) => {
          delete mockStorage[key];

        clear: vi.fn(() => {

import { EventEmitter } from 'events'

export type UiBusEventMap = {
  'window:minimize': { windowId: string }
  'window:restore': { windowId: string }
  'window:focus': { windowId: string }
  'window:moved': { windowId: string; x: number; y: number }
  'window:resized': { windowId: string; width: number; height: number }
  'log:update-latest': { appId: string; runId: string; flowName?: string }
  'feature:flag-changed': { key: string; enabled: boolean }
}

export type UiBusEvent = keyof UiBusEventMap

export interface UiBus {
  on<E extends UiBusEvent>(event: E, listener: (payload: UiBusEventMap[E]) => void): this
  off<E extends UiBusEvent>(event: E, listener: (payload: UiBusEventMap[E]) => void): this
  emit<E extends UiBusEvent>(event: E, payload: UiBusEventMap[E]): boolean
}

export class SimpleUiBus extends EventEmitter implements UiBus {
  // EventEmitter already provides the runtime, we just add typing surface
}

export const uiBus = new SimpleUiBus()

      if (window.__cursorBridgePost) {
        console.log('[CursorFlow] ✅ Bridge function is available');
      } else {
        console.log('[CursorFlow] ❌ Bridge function not found yet');
      }

      // Create container
      this.container = document.createElement('div');
      this.container.id = '__cursorflow_editor__';
      this.container.style.cssText = 'all:initial;position:fixed;z-index:2147483647;';
      document.body.appendChild(this.container);

      this.shadowRoot = this.container.attachShadow({ mode: 'open' });

      this.render();
