# Batch Runner Integration Guide

## Overview

The Batch Runner provides a reusable, MV3-safe utility for executing batch operations across multiple URLs with concurrency control, pause/resume, retry logic, and deterministic persistence.

## Architecture

```
┌─────────────┐
│  Sidepanel  │ ←─ UI subscribes to BATCH_ROW_UPDATE events
└──────┬──────┘
       │ chrome.runtime.sendMessage
       ▼
┌──────────────────┐
│ Service Worker   │ ←─ Handles START/PAUSE/RESUME/ABORT messages
└──────┬───────────┘
       │
       ▼
┌──────────────────┐
│  BatchRunner     │ ←─ Core scheduler
└──────┬───────────┘
       │
       ├──► TabSessionManager ──► chrome.tabs / chrome.scripting
       ├──► BatchStateStore ────► chrome.storage.local + SecureStorage
       ├──► TaskExecutor ────────► Recipe execution or custom logic
       └──► RowSink ─────────────► StorageTableSink (DataTable updates)
```

## Integration Checklist

### 1. Define Tasks

Tasks represent individual work items in a batch operation. Each task must have:
- `id`: Unique identifier (deterministic for resume)
- `urlRef`: URL string (non-PHI) or secure storage reference (PHI mode)
- `input`: Task-specific input data
- `meta`: Task metadata

```typescript
import type { BatchTask } from '@chrome-ext/automation-batch';

const tasks: BatchTask[] = urls.map((url, index) => ({
  id: `task-${index}`,
  urlRef: url, // or secure storage key in PHI mode
  input: { /* task input */ },
  meta: { /* task metadata */ },
}));
```

### 2. Implement Task Executor

Create an executor that implements `TaskExecutor` interface:

```typescript
import { RecipeTaskExecutor } from '@chrome-ext/automation-batch';
import { createContentRuntime } from './recipe-runtime';
import { executeRecipe } from './recipes/executor';
import { getRecipe } from './recipes/registry';

const executor = new RecipeTaskExecutor({
  appId: 'my-app',
  recipeId: 'my-recipe',
  dependencies: {
    createContentRuntime,
    executeRecipe,
    getRecipe,
  },
});
```

Or implement a custom executor:

```typescript
import type { TaskExecutor } from '@chrome-ext/automation-batch';

class MyCustomExecutor implements TaskExecutor {
  async execute({ tabId, task, runContext, signal, emitProgress }) {
    // Custom execution logic
    return result;
  }
}
```

### 3. Implement Row Sink

Use `StorageTableSink` for DataTable-friendly updates:

```typescript
import { StorageTableSink } from '@chrome-ext/automation-batch';

const sink = new StorageTableSink({
  appId: 'my-app',
  operationId: 'my-operation',
  broadcastEvents: true, // Enable UI event broadcasting
});
```

### 4. Wire Service Worker Handlers

Add message handlers in your service worker:

```typescript
import { BatchRunner } from '@chrome-ext/automation-batch';

const batchRunner = new BatchRunner();

chrome.runtime.onMessage.addListener((msg, sender, sendResponse) => {
  if (msg.type === 'START_BATCH') {
    batchRunner.start({
      runId: msg.runId,
      appId: 'my-app',
      operationId: 'my-operation',
      tasks: msg.tasks,
      executor,
      sink,
      options: {
        maxConcurrency: msg.maxConcurrency ?? 3,
        closeTabsOnComplete: true,
        focusTabs: false,
      },
    }).then(() => {
      sendResponse({ ok: true });
    }).catch(error => {
      sendResponse({ ok: false, error: error.message });
    });
    return true;
  }

  if (msg.type === 'PAUSE_BATCH') {
    batchRunner.pause(msg.runId).then(() => {
      sendResponse({ ok: true });
    });
    return true;
  }

  // ... RESUME_BATCH, ABORT_BATCH, RESUME_DEFERRED_BATCH
});
```

### 5. Wire Sidepanel UI

Subscribe to batch events and read table state:

```typescript
import { StorageTableSink } from '@chrome-ext/automation-batch';
import { DataTable } from '@chrome-ext/ui-shared-components';

function MyBatchComponent() {
  const [tableState, setTableState] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    // Load initial state
    StorageTableSink.getTableState('my-app', 'my-operation', runId)
      .then(setTableState);

    // Subscribe to updates
    const listener = (msg) => {
      if (msg.type === 'BATCH_ROW_UPDATE' && msg.runId === runId) {
        StorageTableSink.getTableState('my-app', 'my-operation', runId)
          .then(setTableState);
      }
    };

    chrome.runtime.onMessage.addListener(listener);
    return () => chrome.runtime.onMessage.removeListener(listener);
  }, [runId]);

  return (
    <DataTable
      data={Object.values(tableState?.rowsById ?? {})}
      columns={[
        { id: 'id', label: 'Task ID' },
        { id: 'status', label: 'Status' },
        // ...
      ]}
      // ...
    />
  );
}
```

## MV3 Lifecycle Notes

### Persistence-First Design

Batch runs persist state frequently to survive service worker suspension:
- Run snapshots saved after status changes
- Task states saved in chunks (throttled)
- Deferred tasks saved immediately

### Resume After Suspension

To resume a run after browser restart:

```typescript
const snapshot = await batchRunner.getRunSnapshot(appId, operationId, runId);
if (snapshot && snapshot.status === 'paused') {
  await batchRunner.resume(runId);
}
```

### Event Listeners

Event listeners are in-memory only. To persist across suspension:
- Store events in chrome.storage.local
- Replay events on resume
- Or use `chrome.storage.onChanged` to detect state updates

## PHI-Safe Guidelines

### Never Log/Store URLs in Plaintext

In PHI mode (`phiMode: true`):
- URLs stored only in encrypted secure storage
- Local storage contains only task IDs and status summaries
- Logs must redact URLs (use `maskUrl()` helper)

### Secure Storage Initialization

```typescript
const stateStore = new BatchStateStore({
  useSecureStorage: true,
  secureStoragePrefix: 'batch',
});

await stateStore.initSecureStorage(passphrase); // Optional passphrase
```

### Redaction Checklist

- [ ] No URLs in `chrome.storage.local` keys or values
- [ ] No URLs in log messages (use masking)
- [ ] No URLs in error messages sent to UI
- [ ] Task summaries exclude PHI fields
- [ ] Result references point to secure storage

## Example: Complete Integration

See `apps/chrome-extensions/job-hunt-extension` for a complete reference implementation:
- Service worker handlers
- Recipe executor adapter
- Storage table sink
- Sidepanel UI with DataTable

## Troubleshooting

### Tab Creation Fails

- Check `chrome.tabs` permission in manifest
- Verify serialized tab queue (TabSessionManager handles this)
- Check for concurrent tab limits

### Content Script Not Ready

- Verify content script path matches manifest
- Check PING protocol handler is registered
- Increase `contentReadyMs` timeout if needed

### Storage Quota Errors

- Reduce `chunkSize` in BatchStateStore config
- Enable secure storage for large payloads
- Implement cleanup policies (TTL)

### Resume Not Working

- Verify run snapshot exists in storage
- Check task states are persisted
- Ensure secure storage is initialized (if PHI mode)

## API Reference

See TypeScript definitions in `src/types.ts` for complete API documentation.

# Batch Runner Library

## Overview

The Batch Runner provides a reusable, MV3-safe utility for executing batch operations across multiple URLs with concurrency control, pause/resume, retry logic, and deterministic persistence.

## Quick Start

See [BATCH_OPERATION_TEMPLATE.md](./BATCH_OPERATION_TEMPLATE.md) for a complete integration guide.

## Key Features

- **Concurrency Control**: Configurable max concurrency with worker pool pattern
- **Pause/Resume**: Pause running batches and resume later
- **Abort**: Cleanly abort batch runs with tab cleanup
- **Deferred Tasks**: Automatically defer tasks on captcha/timeout
- **Resume Deferred**: Resume deferred tasks separately
- **PHI-Safe**: Built-in support for PHI-safe logging and storage
- **MV3 Compatible**: Designed for service worker lifecycle
- **Deterministic Persistence**: Resume after browser restart

## Architecture

```
┌─────────────┐
│  Sidepanel  │ ←─ UI subscribes to batch events
└──────┬──────┘
       │ chrome.runtime.sendMessage
       ▼
┌──────────────────┐
│ Service Worker   │ ←─ Handles START/PAUSE/RESUME/ABORT messages
└──────┬───────────┘
       │
       ▼
┌──────────────────┐
│  BatchRunner     │ ←─ Core scheduler
└──────┬───────────┘
       │
       ├──► TabSessionManager ──► chrome.tabs / chrome.scripting
       ├──► BatchStateStore ────► chrome.storage.local + SecureStorage
       ├──► TaskExecutor ────────► Recipe execution or custom logic
       └──► RowSink ─────────────► StorageTableSink (DataTable updates)
```

## Core Components

### BatchRunner

Main scheduler that manages batch execution:

```typescript
import { BatchRunner } from '@chrome-ext/automation-batch';

const batchRunner = new BatchRunner();
await batchRunner.start({
  runId: 'my-batch-run',
  appId: 'my-app',
  operationId: 'my-operation',
  tasks: [...],
  executor: myExecutor,
  sink: mySink,
  options: { maxConcurrency: 2 },
});
```

### TabSessionManager

Handles tab lifecycle with serialized opening and content script injection:

```typescript
import { TabSessionManager } from '@chrome-ext/automation-batch';

const tabManager = new TabSessionManager();
const session = await tabManager.open('https://example.com', { active: false });
await tabManager.waitForLoad(session.tabId);
await tabManager.ensureContentReady(session.tabId);
```

### BatchStateStore

Persists batch run state with chunked storage and secure storage support:

```typescript
import { BatchStateStore } from '@chrome-ext/automation-batch';

const stateStore = new BatchStateStore();
await stateStore.saveRunSnapshot(snapshot);
const snapshot = await stateStore.getRunSnapshot(appId, operationId, runId);
```

## Integration Helpers

### createBatchMessageHandlers

Helper function to create batch message handlers:

```typescript
import { createBatchMessageHandlers } from '@chrome-ext/automation-batch';

const handlers = createBatchMessageHandlers({
  operationId: 'my-operation',
  appId: 'my-app',
  executorFactory: (context, recipeKey, correlationId, recipeId) => {
    return new MyTaskExecutor(context, recipeKey, correlationId, recipeId);
  },
  sinkFactory: (correlationId) => {
    return new MyRowSink(correlationId);
  },
  getBatchRunner: (runId) => batchRunners.get(runId) ?? new BatchRunner(),
});
```

## UI Components

### BatchRunSummaryBanner

Displays batch run summary statistics:

```typescript
import { BatchRunSummaryBanner } from '@chrome-ext/ui-shared-components';

<BatchRunSummaryBanner
  snapshot={snapshot}
  title="Batch Operation Status"
  onViewLogs={(runId, correlationId) => {/* view logs */}}
/>
```

### BatchControls

Provides batch operation controls:

```typescript
import { BatchControls } from '@chrome-ext/ui-shared-components';

<BatchControls
  runId={runId}
  isRunning={isRunning}
  isPaused={isPaused}
  hasDeferred={hasDeferred}
  onStart={handleStart}
  onPause={handlePause}

Status badge for batch tasks:

```typescript

  status="running"

==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/libs/Google-Chrome-Extension-Library/automation/batch/src/batch-runner.ts ====
/**
 * Batch Runner
 *
 * Core scheduler for batch operations with concurrency control, pause/resume, and retry logic.
 */

import { logger } from '@chrome-ext/core-telemetry';
import { TabSessionManager } from './tab-session-manager.js';
import { BatchStateStore } from './batch-state-store.js';
import {
  BatchTransientError,
  BatchPermanentError,
  BatchRunnerNotFoundError,
  BatchRunExistsError,
} from './errors.js';
import type {
  BatchRunOptions,
  BatchTask,
  BatchTaskState,
  BatchEvent,
  BatchRunSnapshot,
  BatchRunStatus,
  BatchTaskStatus,
  TaskExecutor,
  RowSink,
  CaptchaPolicy,
  RetryPolicy,
  BatchTimeouts,
  BatchResultRef,
} from './types.js';

/**
 * Default retry policy
 */
const DEFAULT_RETRY_POLICY: Required<RetryPolicy> = {
  maxAttempts: 3,
  initialDelayMs: 1000,
  maxDelayMs: 30000,
  backoffMultiplier: 2,
  jitter: true,
};

/**
 * Default timeouts
 */
const DEFAULT_TIMEOUTS: Required<BatchTimeouts> = {
  tabLoadMs: 30000,
  contentReadyMs: 5000,
  taskExecutionMs: 300000, // 5 minutes per task
  pingRetryMs: 2000,
};

/**
 * Batch run specification
 */
export interface BatchRunSpec<TInput = unknown, TMeta = unknown> {
  runId: string;
  appId: string;
  operationId: string;
  tasks: BatchTask<TInput, TMeta>[];
  executor: TaskExecutor<TInput, TMeta>;
  sink: RowSink;
  options: BatchRunOptions;
  captchaPolicy?: CaptchaPolicy;
  correlationId?: string;
}

/**
 * Batch runner implementation
 */
export class BatchRunner {
  private runs = new Map<string, BatchRunContext>();
  private tabManager: TabSessionManager;
  private stateStore: BatchStateStore;

  constructor(stateStore?: BatchStateStore) {
    this.tabManager = new TabSessionManager();
    this.stateStore = stateStore ?? new BatchStateStore();
  }

  /**
   * Start a new batch run
   */
  async start<TInput = unknown, TMeta = unknown>(
    spec: BatchRunSpec<TInput, TMeta>
  ): Promise<void> {
    const { runId, appId, operationId, tasks, executor, sink, options, captchaPolicy, correlationId } = spec;

    // Check if run already exists
    const existing = await this.stateStore.getRunSnapshot(appId, operationId, runId);
    if (existing && existing.status !== 'completed' && existing.status !== 'aborted') {
      throw new BatchRunExistsError(runId);
    }

    // Initialize secure storage if needed
    if (options.phiMode || options.storage?.useSecureStorage) {
      await this.stateStore.initSecureStorage();
    }

    // Save task secure data
    for (const task of tasks) {
      await this.stateStore.saveTaskSecureData(runId, task.id, task);
    }

    // Create initial snapshot
    const snapshot: BatchRunSnapshot = {
      runId,
      appId,
      operationId,
      status: 'pending',
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      options: {
        ...options,
        timeouts: { ...DEFAULT_TIMEOUTS, ...options.timeouts },
        retryPolicy: { ...DEFAULT_RETRY_POLICY, ...options.retryPolicy },
      },
      metrics: {
        totalTasks: tasks.length,
        completedTasks: 0,
        failedTasks: 0,
        deferredTasks: 0,
        currentConcurrency: 0,
      },
    };

    await this.stateStore.saveRunSnapshot(snapshot);

    // Create run context
    const context: BatchRunContext = {
      spec,
      snapshot,
      taskStates: new Map(),
      abortController: new AbortController(),
      paused: false,
      pauseResolve: null,
      eventListeners: new Set(),
      activeWorkers: 0,
      openTabs: [],
    };

    // Initialize task states
    for (const task of tasks) {
      context.taskStates.set(task.id, {
        taskId: task.id,
        status: 'queued',
        attempts: 0,
      });
    }

    this.runs.set(runId, context);

    // Emit RUN_STARTED event
    await this.emitEvent(context, {
      type: 'RUN_STARTED',
      runId,
      appId,
      operationId,
      taskCount: tasks.length,
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    });

    // Start execution
    this.executeRun(context).catch(error => {
      logger.error('Batch run execution failed', error as Error, {
        runId,
        appId,
        operationId,
        correlationId,
      });
    });
  }

  /**
   * Pause a running batch
   */
  async pause(runId: string): Promise<void> {
    const context = this.getRunContext(runId);
    if (context.snapshot.status !== 'running') {
      throw new BatchPermanentError(`Cannot pause run in status: ${context.snapshot.status}`);
    }

    context.paused = true;
    context.snapshot.status = 'paused';
    context.snapshot.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    await this.stateStore.saveRunSnapshot(context.snapshot);

    await this.emitEvent(context, {
      type: 'RUN_PAUSED',
      runId,
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    });
  }

  /**
   * Resume a paused batch
   */
  async resume(runId: string): Promise<void> {
    const context = this.getRunContext(runId);
    if (context.snapshot.status !== 'paused') {
      throw new BatchPermanentError(`Cannot resume run in status: ${context.snapshot.status}`);
    }

    context.paused = false;
    context.snapshot.status = 'running';
    context.snapshot.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    await this.stateStore.saveRunSnapshot(context.snapshot);

    // Resume paused workers
    if (context.pauseResolve) {
      context.pauseResolve();
      context.pauseResolve = null;
    }

    await this.emitEvent(context, {
      type: 'RUN_RESUMED',
      runId,
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    });

    // Continue execution
    this.executeRun(context).catch(error => {
      logger.error('Batch run resume failed', error as Error, { runId });
    });
  }

  /**
   * Abort a running batch
   */
  async abort(runId: string, reason?: string): Promise<void> {
    const context = this.getRunContext(runId);
    if (context.snapshot.status === 'completed' || context.snapshot.status === 'aborted') {
      return;
    }

    context.abortController.abort();
    context.snapshot.status = 'aborted';
    context.snapshot.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    await this.stateStore.saveRunSnapshot(context.snapshot);

    // Close all tabs
    await this.tabManager.closeAll(context.openTabs);
    context.openTabs = [];

    await this.emitEvent(context, {
      type: 'RUN_ABORTED',
      runId,
      reason,
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    });
  }

  /**
   * Resume deferred tasks
   */
  async resumeDeferred(
    runId: string,
    deferredKey?: string
  ): Promise<void> {
    const context = this.getRunContext(runId);
    const { appId, operationId } = context.snapshot;

    const key = deferredKey ?? `default:${runId}`;
    const deferredTaskIds = await this.stateStore.getDeferredTasks(
      appId,
      operationId,
      key
    );

    if (deferredTaskIds.length === 0) {
      return;
    }

    // Reset deferred tasks to queued
    for (const taskId of deferredTaskIds) {
      const state = context.taskStates.get(taskId);
      if (state && state.status === 'deferred') {
        state.status = 'queued';
        state.attempts = 0;
      }
    }

    // Continue execution
    if (context.snapshot.status === 'paused') {
      await this.resume(runId);
    } else {
      this.executeRun(context).catch(error => {
        logger.error('Resume deferred failed', error as Error, { runId });
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get run snapshot
   */
  async getRunSnapshot(
    appId: string,
    operationId: string,
    runId: string
  ): Promise<BatchRunSnapshot | null> {
    return this.stateStore.getRunSnapshot(appId, operationId, runId);
  }

  /**
   * Add event listener
   */
  onEvent(runId: string, listener: (event: BatchEvent) => void): () => void {
    const context = this.getRunContext(runId);
    context.eventListeners.add(listener);
    return () => {
      context.eventListeners.delete(listener);
    };
  }

  /**
   * Get run context (internal)
   */
  private getRunContext(runId: string): BatchRunContext {
    const context = this.runs.get(runId);
    if (!context) {
      throw new BatchRunnerNotFoundError(runId);
    }
    return context;
  }

  /**
   * Execute batch run (internal)
   */
  private async executeRun(context: BatchRunContext): Promise<void> {
    const { spec, snapshot } = context;
    const { tasks, executor, sink, options } = spec;

    context.snapshot.status = 'running';
    context.snapshot.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    await this.stateStore.saveRunSnapshot(context.snapshot);

    const maxConcurrency = options.maxConcurrency;
    const retryPolicy = snapshot.options.retryPolicy as Required<RetryPolicy>;
    const timeouts = snapshot.options.timeouts as Required<BatchTimeouts>;

    // Worker pool
    const workers: Promise<void>[] = [];
    let taskIndex = 0;
    const taskQueue = tasks.filter(
      t => context.taskStates.get(t.id)?.status !== 'succeeded' && 
           context.taskStates.get(t.id)?.status !== 'failed'
    );

    const worker = async (): Promise<void> => {
      while (taskIndex < taskQueue.length && !context.abortController.signal.aborted) {
        // Wait for pause
        if (context.paused) {
          await new Promise<void>(resolve => {
            context.pauseResolve = resolve;
          });
        }

        if (context.abortController.signal.aborted) {
          break;
        }

        const currentIndex = taskIndex++;
        const task = taskQueue[currentIndex];
        const taskState = context.taskStates.get(task.id);

        if (!taskState || taskState.status === 'succeeded' || taskState.status === 'failed') {
          continue;
        }

        await this.executeTask(
          context,
          task,
          executor,
          sink,
          retryPolicy,
          timeouts,
          options
        );
      }
    };

    // Start workers
    const workerCount = Math.min(maxConcurrency, tasks.length);
    for (let i = 0; i < workerCount; i++) {
      workers.push(worker());
    }

    await Promise.all(workers);

    // Check if all tasks are done
    const allDone = Array.from(context.taskStates.values()).every(
      state => state.status === 'succeeded' || state.status === 'failed'
    );

    if (allDone && !context.abortController.signal.aborted) {
      context.snapshot.status = 'completed';
      context.snapshot.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
      await this.stateStore.saveRunSnapshot(context.snapshot);

      await this.emitEvent(context, {
        type: 'RUN_COMPLETED',
        runId: snapshot.runId,
        metrics: context.snapshot.metrics,
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      });

      // Close tabs if configured
      if (options.closeTabsOnComplete) {
        await this.tabManager.closeAll(context.openTabs);
        context.openTabs = [];
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Execute a single task (internal)
   */
  private async executeTask<TInput, TMeta>(
    context: BatchRunContext,
    task: BatchTask<TInput, TMeta>,
    executor: TaskExecutor<TInput, TMeta>,
    sink: RowSink,
    retryPolicy: Required<RetryPolicy>,
    timeouts: Required<BatchTimeouts>,
    options: BatchRunOptions
  ): Promise<void> {
    const { snapshot } = context;
    const taskState = context.taskStates.get(task.id)!;

    taskState.status = 'running';
    taskState.startedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    taskState.attempts += 1;
    context.snapshot.metrics.currentConcurrency += 1;

    await this.stateStore.saveTaskStates(snapshot.runId, Array.from(context.taskStates.values()));
    await this.stateStore.saveRunSnapshot(context.snapshot);

    await this.emitEvent(context, {
      type: 'TASK_STARTED',
      runId: snapshot.runId,
      taskId: task.id,
      attempt: taskState.attempts,
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    });

    await sink.onTaskUpdate({
      runId: snapshot.runId,
      taskId: task.id,
      state: { ...taskState },
    });

    let tabId: number | undefined;
    let lastError: Error | null = null;

    try {
      // Get URL from secure storage
      const taskData = await this.stateStore.getTaskSecureData<TInput, TMeta>(
        snapshot.runId,
        task.id
      );
      if (!taskData) {
        throw new BatchPermanentError(`Task data not found: ${task.id}`);
      }

      // Open tab
      const session = await this.tabManager.open(taskData.urlRef, {
        active: options.focusTabs ?? false,
        focused: options.focusTabs ?? false,
      });
      tabId = session.tabId;
      context.openTabs.push(tabId);

      // Wait for load
      await this.tabManager.waitForLoad(tabId, timeouts.tabLoadMs);

      // Ensure content ready
      await this.tabManager.ensureContentReady(tabId, {
        contentScriptPath: 'content.iife.js', // Default, can be overridden
        pingTimeoutMs: timeouts.contentReadyMs,
        maxRetries: 6,
        initialDelayMs: 200,
      });

      // Check for captcha
      if (context.spec.captchaPolicy) {
        const detection = await context.spec.captchaPolicy.detect(tabId);
        if (detection.detected) {
          if (context.spec.captchaPolicy.onDetected) {
            await context.spec.captchaPolicy.onDetected({
              runId: snapshot.runId,
              taskId: task.id,
              tabId,
              detection,
            });
          }

          // Defer if timeout configured
          if (
            context.spec.captchaPolicy.deferOnTimeout &&
            context.spec.captchaPolicy.timeoutMs
          ) {
            const deferredKey = `captcha:${snapshot.runId}`;
            await this.deferTask(context, task.id, 'captcha-detected', deferredKey);
            return;
          }
        }
      }

      // Execute task
      const progressCallback = (progress: unknown) => {
        this.emitEvent(context, {
          type: 'TASK_PROGRESS',
          runId: snapshot.runId,
          taskId: task.id,
          progress,
          timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        }).catch(() => {
          // Ignore emit errors
        });

        sink.onTaskUpdate({
          runId: snapshot.runId,
          taskId: task.id,
          state: { ...taskState },
          progress,
        }).catch(() => {
          // Ignore sink errors
        });
      };

      const result = await Promise.race([
        executor.execute({
          tabId,
          task: taskData,
          runContext: {
            runId: snapshot.runId,
            appId: snapshot.appId,
            operationId: snapshot.operationId,
            correlationId: context.spec.correlationId,
          },
          signal: context.abortController.signal,
          emitProgress: progressCallback,
        }),
        new Promise<never>((_, reject) => {
          setTimeout(
            () => reject(new Error('Task execution timeout')),
            timeouts.taskExecutionMs
          );
        }),
      ]);

      // Save result
      const resultRef = await this.stateStore.saveResultSecure(
        snapshot.runId,
        task.id,
        result
      );

      taskState.status = 'succeeded';
      taskState.completedAt = new Date().toISOString();
      context.snapshot.metrics.completedTasks += 1;

      await this.emitEvent(context, {
        type: 'TASK_SUCCEEDED',
        runId: snapshot.runId,
        taskId: task.id,
        resultRef,
        durationMs:
          Date.now() - new Date(taskState.startedAt!).getTime(),
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      });

      await sink.onTaskUpdate({
        runId: snapshot.runId,
        taskId: task.id,
        state: { ...taskState },
        resultRef,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      lastError = error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error));
      const isTransient = error instanceof BatchTransientError;
      const shouldRetry =
        isTransient &&
        taskState.attempts < retryPolicy.maxAttempts &&
        !context.abortController.signal.aborted;

      if (shouldRetry) {
        // Retry with backoff
        const delay = this.calculateBackoff(
          taskState.attempts,
          retryPolicy
        );
        await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, delay));

        // Reset state for retry
        taskState.status = 'queued';
        taskState.startedAt = undefined;
        taskState.completedAt = undefined;
        taskState.lastErrorCode = undefined;
        taskState.lastErrorSummary = undefined;
        
        // Retry by calling executeTask again
        await this.executeTask(
          context,
          task,
          executor,
          sink,
          retryPolicy,
          timeouts,
          options
        );
        return;
      }

      // Permanent failure or max retries
      taskState.status = 'failed';
      taskState.completedAt = new Date().toISOString();
      taskState.lastErrorCode = lastError.name;
      taskState.lastErrorSummary = lastError.message.substring(0, 200);
      context.snapshot.metrics.failedTasks += 1;

      await this.emitEvent(context, {
        type: 'TASK_FAILED',
        runId: snapshot.runId,
        taskId: task.id,
        errorCode: taskState.lastErrorCode,
        errorSummary: taskState.lastErrorSummary,
        willRetry: false,
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      });

      await sink.onTaskUpdate({
        runId: snapshot.runId,
        taskId: task.id,
        state: { ...taskState },
      });
    } finally {
      context.snapshot.metrics.currentConcurrency -= 1;
      await this.stateStore.saveTaskStates(
        snapshot.runId,
        Array.from(context.taskStates.values())
      );
      await this.stateStore.saveRunSnapshot(context.snapshot);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Defer a task (internal)
   */
  private async deferTask(
    context: BatchRunContext,
    taskId: string,
    reason: string,
    deferredKey?: string
  ): Promise<void> {
    const taskState = context.taskStates.get(taskId);
    if (!taskState) {
      return;
    }

    taskState.status = 'deferred';
    taskState.completedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    context.snapshot.metrics.deferredTasks += 1;

    const key = deferredKey ?? `default:${context.snapshot.runId}`;
    const existing = await this.stateStore.getDeferredTasks(
      context.snapshot.appId,
      context.snapshot.operationId,
      key
    );
    await this.stateStore.saveDeferredTasks(
      context.snapshot.appId,
      context.snapshot.operationId,
      key,
      [...existing, taskId]
    );

    await this.emitEvent(context, {
      type: 'TASK_DEFERRED',
      runId: context.snapshot.runId,
      taskId,
      reason,
      deferredKey: key,
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    });
  }

  /**
   * Calculate backoff delay (internal)
   */
  private calculateBackoff(attempt: number, policy: Required<RetryPolicy>): number {
    let delay = policy.initialDelayMs * Math.pow(policy.backoffMultiplier, attempt - 1);
    delay = Math.min(delay, policy.maxDelayMs);

    if (policy.jitter) {
      const jitterAmount = delay * 0.1; // 10% jitter
      delay += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * jitterAmount;
    }

    return Math.max(0, Math.floor(delay));
  }

  /**
   * Emit event to listeners (internal)
   */
  private async emitEvent(context: BatchRunContext, event: BatchEvent): Promise<void> {
    for (const listener of context.eventListeners) {
      try {
        listener(event);
      } catch (error) {
        logger.error('Event listener error', error as Error, {
          runId: context.snapshot.runId,
          eventType: event.type,
        });
      }
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Internal run context
 */
interface BatchRunContext {
  spec: BatchRunSpec;
  snapshot: BatchRunSnapshot;
  taskStates: Map<string, BatchTaskState>;
  abortController: AbortController;
  paused: boolean;
  pauseResolve: (() => void) | null;
  eventListeners: Set<(event: BatchEvent) => void>;
  activeWorkers: number;
  openTabs: number[];
}

/**

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import { BatchStateStore } from './batch-state-store.js';

// Mock chrome.storage
const mockStorage = {

  },

// Mock secure storage
const mockSecureStorage = {

// @ts-expect-error - Mocking chrome global
global.chrome = {
  storage: mockStorage as any,
};

describe('BatchStateStore', () => {
  let store: BatchStateStore;

  beforeEach(() => {
    store = new BatchStateStore();
    vi.clearAllMocks();
    mockStorage.local.get.mockResolvedValue({});
    mockStorage.local.set.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
    mockStorage.local.remove.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
  });

  describe('saveRunSnapshot', () => {
    it('should save run snapshot', async () => {
      const snapshot = {
        runId: 'run-1',
        appId: 'app-1',
        operationId: 'op-1',
        status: 'running' as const,
        createdAt: '2024-01-01T00:00:00Z',
        updatedAt: '2024-01-01T00:00:00Z',
        options: {
          maxConcurrency: 3,
          timeouts: {
            tabLoadMs: 30000,
            contentReadyMs: 5000,
            taskExecutionMs: 300000,
            pingRetryMs: 2000,
          },
          retryPolicy: {
            maxAttempts: 3,
            initialDelayMs: 1000,
            maxDelayMs: 30000,
            backoffMultiplier: 2,
            jitter: true,
          },
        },
        metrics: {
          totalTasks: 10,
          completedTasks: 5,
          failedTasks: 0,
          deferredTasks: 0,
          currentConcurrency: 2,
        },
      };

      await store.saveRunSnapshot(snapshot);

      expect(mockStorage.local.set).toHaveBeenCalled();
      const call = mockStorage.local.set.mock.calls[0][0];
      const key = Object.keys(call)[0];
      expect(key).toContain('batch_run:app-1:op-1:run-1');
      expect(call[key]).toMatchObject(snapshot);
    });
  });

  describe('getRunSnapshot', () => {
    it('should retrieve run snapshot', async () => {
      const snapshot = {
        runId: 'run-1',
        appId: 'app-1',
        operationId: 'op-1',
        status: 'running' as const,
        createdAt: '2024-01-01T00:00:00Z',
        updatedAt: '2024-01-01T00:00:00Z',
        options: {} as any,
        metrics: {} as any,
      };

      mockStorage.local.get.mockResolvedValue({
        'batch_run:app-1:op-1:run-1': snapshot,
      });

      const result = await store.getRunSnapshot('app-1', 'op-1', 'run-1');

      expect(result).toEqual(snapshot);
    });

    it('should return null if snapshot not found', async () => {
      mockStorage.local.get.mockResolvedValue({});

      const result = await store.getRunSnapshot('app-1', 'op-1', 'run-1');

      expect(result).toBeNull();
    });
  });

  describe('saveTaskStates', () => {
    it('should chunk task states', async () => {
      const runId = 'run-1';
      const tasks: any[] = Array.from({ length: 75 }, (_, i) => ({
        taskId: `task-${i}`,
        status: 'queued' as const,
        attempts: 0,
      }));

      await store.saveTaskStates(runId, tasks);

      // Should create 2 chunks (50 + 25)
      expect(mockStorage.local.set).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
    });
  });

  describe('saveTaskSecureData', () => {
    it('should use local storage when secure storage disabled', async () => {
      const task = {
        id: 'task-1',
        urlRef: 'https://example.com',
        input: { foo: 'bar' },
        meta: { baz: 'qux' },
      };

      await store.saveTaskSecureData('run-1', 'task-1', task);

      expect(mockStorage.local.set).toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(mockSecureStorage.set).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it('should use secure storage when enabled', async () => {
      const secureStore = new BatchStateStore({
        useSecureStorage: true,
      });

      await secureStore.initSecureStorage();
      mockSecureStorage.set.mockResolvedValue(undefined);

      const task = {
        id: 'task-1',
        urlRef: 'https://example.com',
        input: { foo: 'bar' },
        meta: { baz: 'qux' },
      };

      await secureStore.saveTaskSecureData('run-1', 'task-1', task);

      expect(mockSecureStorage.set).toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
  });

  describe('saveDeferredTasks', () => {
    it('should save deferred task IDs', async () => {
      await store.saveDeferredTasks('app-1', 'op-1', 'deferred-1', [
        'task-1',
        'task-2',
      ]);

      expect(mockStorage.local.set).toHaveBeenCalled();
      const call = mockStorage.local.set.mock.calls[0][0];
      const key = Object.keys(call)[0];
      expect(key).toContain('batch_deferred:app-1:op-1:deferred-1');
      expect(call[key].taskIds).toEqual(['task-1', 'task-2']);
    });
  });
});




==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/libs/Google-Chrome-Extension-Library/automation/batch/src/batch-state-store.ts ====
/**
 * Batch State Store
 *
 * Deterministic, chunked persistence with PHI-safe secure storage for sensitive data.
 */

import { logger } from '@chrome-ext/core-telemetry';
import { getSecureStorage } from '@chrome-ext/core-secure-storage';
import type { SecureStorage } from '@chrome-ext/core-secure-storage';
import { BatchPersistenceError } from './errors.js';
import type {
  BatchRunSnapshot,
  BatchTaskState,
  BatchTask,
  BatchResultRef,
  BatchStorageConfig,
} from './types.js';

/**
 * Schema version for stored runs (for migration support)
 */
const CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION = 1;

/**
 * Default storage configuration
 */
const DEFAULT_STORAGE_CONFIG: Required<BatchStorageConfig> = {
  useSecureStorage: false,
  secureStoragePrefix: 'batch',
  chunkSize: 50,
  writeThrottleMs: 300,
};

/**
 * Batch state store implementation
 */
export class BatchStateStore {
  private secureStorage: SecureStorage | null = null;
  private writeQueue: Promise<void> = Promise.resolve();
  private pendingWrites = new Map<string, () => Promise<void>>();
  private throttleTimers = new Map<string, NodeJS.Timeout>();
  private config: Required<BatchStorageConfig>;

  constructor(config?: Partial<BatchStorageConfig>) {
    this.config = { ...DEFAULT_STORAGE_CONFIG, ...config };
  }

  /**
   * Initialize secure storage if needed
   */
  async initSecureStorage(passphrase?: string): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.config.useSecureStorage) {
      return;
    }

    try {
      this.secureStorage = getSecureStorage();
      await this.secureStorage.init({ passphrase });
      logger.debug('Batch secure storage initialized');
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('Failed to initialize secure storage', error as Error);
      throw new BatchPersistenceError(
        `Secure storage init failed: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}`,
        error
      );
    }
  }

  /**
   * Save run snapshot
   */
  async saveRunSnapshot(snapshot: BatchRunSnapshot): Promise<void> {
    const key = `batch_run:${snapshot.appId}:${snapshot.operationId}:${snapshot.runId}`;
    const data = {
      ...snapshot,
      schemaVersion: CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
    };

    await this.throttledWrite(key, async () => {
      await chrome.storage.local.set({ [key]: data });
    });
  }

  /**
   * Get run snapshot
   */
  async getRunSnapshot(
    appId: string,
    operationId: string,
    runId: string
  ): Promise<BatchRunSnapshot | null> {
    const key = `batch_run:${appId}:${operationId}:${runId}`;
    const result = await chrome.storage.local.get(key);
    const snapshot = result[key] as BatchRunSnapshot | undefined;

    if (!snapshot) {
      return null;
    }

    // Migration support (future)
    if (snapshot.schemaVersion !== CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION) {
      logger.warn('Schema version mismatch, may need migration', {
        stored: snapshot.schemaVersion,
        current: CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
        runId,
      });
    }

    return snapshot;
  }

  /**
   * Save task states in chunks
   */
  async saveTaskStates(
    runId: string,
    taskStates: BatchTaskState[]
  ): Promise<void> {
    const chunks: BatchTaskState[][] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < taskStates.length; i += this.config.chunkSize) {
      chunks.push(taskStates.slice(i, i + this.config.chunkSize));
    }

    await Promise.all(
      chunks.map((chunk, chunkIndex) => {
        const key = `batch_tasks:${runId}:${chunkIndex}`;
        return this.throttledWrite(key, async () => {
          await chrome.storage.local.set({
            [key]: {
              runId,
              chunkIndex,
              tasks: chunk,
              schemaVersion: CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
              updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
            },
          });
        });
      })
    );
  }

  /**
   * Get all task states for a run
   */
  async getTaskStates(runId: string): Promise<BatchTaskState[]> {
    const allStorage = await chrome.storage.local.get(null);
    const taskStates: BatchTaskState[] = [];

    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(allStorage)) {
      if (key.startsWith(`batch_tasks:${runId}:`)) {
        const chunk = value as {
          tasks: BatchTaskState[];
          schemaVersion?: number;
        };
        if (Array.isArray(chunk.tasks)) {
          taskStates.push(...chunk.tasks);
        }
      }
    }

    // Sort by taskId for consistency
    return taskStates.sort((a, b) => a.taskId.localeCompare(b.taskId));
  }

  /**
   * Save task URL/input to secure storage (PHI-safe)
   */
  async saveTaskSecureData(
    runId: string,
    taskId: string,
    task: BatchTask
  ): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.config.useSecureStorage || !this.secureStorage) {
      // In non-PHI mode, URLs can be stored in local storage
      // But we still use a ref pattern for consistency
      const key = `batch_task_data:${runId}:${taskId}`;
      await chrome.storage.local.set({
        [key]: {
          urlRef: task.urlRef,
          input: task.input,
          meta: task.meta,
        },
      });
      return;
    }

    const secureKey = `${this.config.secureStoragePrefix}:${runId}:task:${taskId}`;
    try {
      await this.secureStorage.set(secureKey, {
        urlRef: task.urlRef,
        input: task.input,
        meta: task.meta,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      throw new BatchPersistenceError(
        `Failed to save task secure data: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}`,
        error
      );
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get task URL/input from secure storage
   */
  async getTaskSecureData<TInput = unknown, TMeta = unknown>(
    runId: string,
    taskId: string
  ): Promise<BatchTask<TInput, TMeta> | null> {
    if (!this.config.useSecureStorage || !this.secureStorage) {
      const key = `batch_task_data:${runId}:${taskId}`;
      const result = await chrome.storage.local.get(key);
      const data = result[key] as
        | { urlRef: string; input: TInput; meta: TMeta }
        | undefined;

      if (!data) {
        return null;
      }

      return {
        id: taskId,
        urlRef: data.urlRef,
        input: data.input,
        meta: data.meta,
      };
    }

    const secureKey = `${this.config.secureStoragePrefix}:${runId}:task:${taskId}`;
    try {
      const data = await this.secureStorage.get<{
        urlRef: string;
        input: TInput;
        meta: TMeta;
      }>(secureKey);

      if (!data) {
        return null;
      }

      return {
        id: taskId,
        urlRef: data.urlRef,
        input: data.input,
        meta: data.meta,
      };
    } catch (error) {
      throw new BatchPersistenceError(
        `Failed to get task secure data: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}`,
        error
      );
    }
  }

  /**
   * Save result to secure storage (for large payloads)
   */
  async saveResultSecure(
    runId: string,
    taskId: string,
    result: unknown
  ): Promise<BatchResultRef> {
    if (!this.config.useSecureStorage || !this.secureStorage) {
      // In non-PHI mode, store summary in local storage
      const key = `batch_result:${runId}:${taskId}`;
      const summary = this.extractSummary(result);
      await chrome.storage.local.set({
        [key]: {
          summary,
          storedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        },
      });
      return {
        refType: 'local',
        key,
        summary,
      };
    }

    const secureKey = `${this.config.secureStoragePrefix}:${runId}:result:${taskId}`;
    try {
      await this.secureStorage.set(secureKey, result);
      const summary = this.extractSummary(result);
      return {
        refType: 'secure',
        key: secureKey,
        summary,
      };
    } catch (error) {
      throw new BatchPersistenceError(
        `Failed to save result secure: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}`,
        error
      );
    }
  }

  /**
   * Save deferred tasks
   */
  async saveDeferredTasks(
    appId: string,
    operationId: string,
    deferredKey: string,
    taskIds: string[]
  ): Promise<void> {
    const key = `batch_deferred:${appId}:${operationId}:${deferredKey}`;
    await this.throttledWrite(key, async () => {
      await chrome.storage.local.set({
        [key]: {
          appId,
          operationId,
          deferredKey,
          taskIds,
          createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          schemaVersion: CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
        },
      });
    });
  }

  /**
   * Get deferred tasks
   */
  async getDeferredTasks(
    appId: string,
    operationId: string,
    deferredKey: string
  ): Promise<string[]> {
    const key = `batch_deferred:${appId}:${operationId}:${deferredKey}`;
    const result = await chrome.storage.local.get(key);
    const deferred = result[key] as { taskIds: string[] } | undefined;
    return deferred?.taskIds ?? [];
  }

  /**
   * Cleanup run data (optional TTL-based)
   */
  async cleanupRun(runId: string, appId: string, operationId: string): Promise<void> {
    // Remove run snapshot
    const snapshotKey = `batch_run:${appId}:${operationId}:${runId}`;
    await chrome.storage.local.remove(snapshotKey);

    // Remove task chunks
    const allStorage = await chrome.storage.local.get(null);
    const keysToRemove: string[] = [];
    for (const key of Object.keys(allStorage)) {
      if (key.startsWith(`batch_tasks:${runId}:`)) {
        keysToRemove.push(key);
      }
      if (key.startsWith(`batch_task_data:${runId}:`)) {
        keysToRemove.push(key);
      }
      if (key.startsWith(`batch_result:${runId}:`)) {
        keysToRemove.push(key);
      }
    }

    if (keysToRemove.length > 0) {
      await chrome.storage.local.remove(keysToRemove);
    }

    // Cleanup secure storage if used
    if (this.config.useSecureStorage && this.secureStorage) {
      // Note: Secure storage cleanup would require listing keys, which may not be efficient
      // For now, we rely on TTL/cleanup policies at the app level
      logger.debug('Secure storage cleanup skipped (requires app-level policy)', {
        runId,
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Throttled write with coalescing
   */
  private async throttledWrite(
    key: string,
    writeFn: () => Promise<void>
  ): Promise<void> {
    // Cancel existing throttle timer
    const existingTimer = this.throttleTimers.get(key);
    if (existingTimer) {
      clearTimeout(existingTimer);
    }

    // Store write function
    this.pendingWrites.set(key, writeFn);

    // Set new throttle timer
    const timer = setTimeout(async () => {
      const fn = this.pendingWrites.get(key);
      if (fn) {
        this.pendingWrites.delete(key);
        this.throttleTimers.delete(key);
        await fn();
      }
    }, this.config.writeThrottleMs);

    this.throttleTimers.set(key, timer);
  }

  /**
   * Extract summary from result (for non-PHI storage)
   */
  private extractSummary(result: unknown): unknown {
    if (result === null || result === undefined) {
      return null;
    }

    if (typeof result === 'object') {
      const obj = result as Record<string, unknown>;
      // Extract only non-sensitive fields
      const summary: Record<string, unknown> = {};
      for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(obj)) {
        if (
          !key.toLowerCase().includes('url') &&
          !key.toLowerCase().includes('phi') &&
          !key.toLowerCase().includes('patient') &&
          !key.toLowerCase().includes('encounter')
        ) {
          if (typeof value === 'string' && value.length < 200) {
            summary[key] = value;
          } else if (typeof value === 'number' || typeof value === 'boolean') {
            summary[key] = value;
          }
        }
      }
      return summary;
    }

    return String(result).substring(0, 200);
  }
}

/**
 * Batch Runner Errors
 *
 * Domain-specific error classes following workspace error taxonomy.
 */

/**
 * Base batch error class
 */
export class BatchError extends Error {
  constructor(
    message: string,
    public readonly code: string,
    public readonly cause?: unknown
  ) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'BatchError';
    if (cause) {
      (this as any).cause = cause;
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Transient batch error (retryable)
 */
export class BatchTransientError extends BatchError {
  constructor(message: string, cause?: unknown) {
    super(message, 'BATCH_TRANSIENT_ERROR', cause);
    this.name = 'BatchTransientError';
  }
}

/**
 * Permanent batch error (not retryable)
 */
export class BatchPermanentError extends BatchError {
  constructor(message: string, cause?: unknown) {
    super(message, 'BATCH_PERMANENT_ERROR', cause);
    this.name = 'BatchPermanentError';
  }
}

/**
 * Tab session error
 */
export class TabSessionError extends BatchError {
  constructor(message: string, cause?: unknown) {
    super(message, 'TAB_SESSION_ERROR', cause);
    this.name = 'TabSessionError';
  }
}

/**
 * Batch persistence error
 */
export class BatchPersistenceError extends BatchError {
  constructor(message: string, cause?: unknown) {
    super(message, 'BATCH_PERSISTENCE_ERROR', cause);
    this.name = 'BatchPersistenceError';
  }
}

/**
 * Batch runner not found error
 */
export class BatchRunnerNotFoundError extends BatchPermanentError {
  constructor(runId: string) {
    super(`Batch run not found: ${runId}`);
    this.name = 'BatchRunnerNotFoundError';
  }
}

/**
 * Batch run already exists error
 */
export class BatchRunExistsError extends BatchPermanentError {
  constructor(runId: string) {
    super(`Batch run already exists: ${runId}`);
    this.name = 'BatchRunExistsError';
  }
}

/**
 * Recipe Task Executor
 *
 * Reference adapter for executing recipes in batch operations.
 */

import { logger } from '@chrome-ext/core-telemetry';
import type { FlowRuntime, ExecutionContext, ExecutionResult, StepProgressCallback } from '@chrome-ext/automation-recipes';
import type { Recipe } from '@chrome-ext/automation-recipes';
import { BatchTransientError, BatchPermanentError } from '../errors.js';
import type { TaskExecutor } from '../types.js';

/**
 * Recipe executor dependencies (provided by app)
 */
export interface RecipeExecutorDependencies {
  createContentRuntime: (tabId: number, context?: unknown) => FlowRuntime;
  executeRecipe: (
    recipe: Recipe,
    runtime: FlowRuntime,
    context: ExecutionContext,
    onStepProgress?: StepProgressCallback
  ) => Promise<ExecutionResult>;
  getRecipe: (app: string, id: string) => Recipe | null;
}

/**
 * Recipe task executor configuration
 */
export interface RecipeTaskExecutorConfig {
  appId: string;
  recipeId: string;
  dependencies: RecipeExecutorDependencies;
  baseDownloadFolder?: string;
  variables?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

/**
 * Recipe task executor implementation
 */
export class RecipeTaskExecutor<TInput = unknown, TMeta = unknown>
  implements TaskExecutor<TInput, TMeta, ExecutionResult>
{
  private config: RecipeTaskExecutorConfig;

  constructor(config: RecipeTaskExecutorConfig) {
    this.config = config;
  }

  async execute(params: {
    tabId: number;
    task: import('../types.js').BatchTask<TInput, TMeta>;
    runContext: import('../types.js').TaskExecutorContext;
    signal: AbortSignal;
    emitProgress: (progress: unknown) => void;
  }): Promise<ExecutionResult> {
    const { tabId, task, runContext, signal, emitProgress } = params;
    const { dependencies, appId, recipeId, baseDownloadFolder, variables } = this.config;

    // Get recipe
    const recipe = dependencies.getRecipe(appId, recipeId);
    if (!recipe) {
      throw new BatchPermanentError(`Recipe not found: ${appId}:${recipeId}`);
    }

    // Create content runtime
    const runtime = dependencies.createContentRuntime(tabId, {
      baseDownloadFolder,
      variables: {
        ...variables,
        ...(task.meta as Record<string, unknown>),
        ...(task.input as Record<string, unknown>),
      },
      recipeKey: `${appId}:${recipeId}`,
    });

    // Create execution context
    const executionContext: ExecutionContext = {
      tabId,
      abortSignal: signal,
      baseDownloadFolder,
      variables: {
        ...variables,
        ...(task.meta as Record<string, unknown>),
        ...(task.input as Record<string, unknown>),
      },
      recipeKey: `${appId}:${recipeId}`,
      correlationId: runContext.correlationId,
    };

    // Step progress callback
    const onStepProgress: StepProgressCallback = (progress) => {
      emitProgress(progress);
    };

    try {
      // Execute recipe
      const result = await dependencies.executeRecipe(
        recipe,
        runtime,
        executionContext,
        onStepProgress
      );

      if (!result.success) {
        const errorMessage = result.error ?? 'Recipe execution failed';
        // Determine if error is transient
        const isTransient = this.isTransientError(errorMessage);
        if (isTransient) {
          throw new BatchTransientError(errorMessage);
        } else {
          throw new BatchPermanentError(errorMessage);
        }
      }

      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof BatchTransientError || error instanceof BatchPermanentError) {
        throw error;
      }

      // Wrap unknown errors
      const errorMessage = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
      logger.error('Recipe execution error', error as Error, {
        tabId,
        taskId: task.id,
        runId: runContext.runId,
      });
      throw new BatchPermanentError(`Recipe execution failed: ${errorMessage}`, error);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Determine if error is transient (retryable)
   */
  private isTransientError(errorMessage: string): boolean {
    const transientPatterns = [
      'timeout',
      'network',
      'connection',
      'temporarily',
      'retry',
      'rate limit',
      'quota',
    ];

    const lowerMessage = errorMessage.toLowerCase();
    return transientPatterns.some(pattern => lowerMessage.includes(pattern));
  }
}

/**
 * Batch Operation Helpers
 *
 * Utility functions for creating batch message handlers and common patterns.
 */

import { logger } from '@chrome-ext/core-telemetry';
import { BatchRunner } from './batch-runner.js';
import type {
  BatchTask,
  TaskExecutor,
  RowSink,
  BatchRunSnapshot,
} from './types.js';
import type { ExecutionContext, StepProgressCallback } from '@chrome-ext/automation-recipes';

/**
 * Generate correlation ID (simple implementation)
 * Projects should provide their own implementation if they have one
 */
function generateCorrelationId(): string {
  return `${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 9)}`;
}

/**
 * Factory function for creating task executors
 */
export type ExecutorFactory<TInput = unknown, TMeta = unknown> = (
  context: ExecutionContext,
  recipeKey: string,
  correlationId: string,
  recipeId: string,
  onStepProgress?: StepProgressCallback
) => TaskExecutor<TInput, TMeta>;

/**
 * Factory function for creating row sinks
 */
export type SinkFactory = (correlationId: string) => RowSink;

/**
 * Options for creating batch message handlers
 */
export interface BatchMessageHandlerOptions<TInput = unknown, TMeta = unknown> {
  operationId: string;
  appId: string;
  executorFactory: ExecutorFactory<TInput, TMeta>;
  sinkFactory: SinkFactory;
  getBatchRunner: (runId: string) => BatchRunner;
  defaultOptions?: {
    maxConcurrency?: number;
    closeTabsOnComplete?: boolean;
    focusTabs?: boolean;
    phiMode?: boolean;
    captchaPolicy?: unknown; // CaptchaPolicy type
  };
  getExecutionContext?: (correlationId: string) => Promise<ExecutionContext>;
  getRecipeId?: (msg: any) => string;
  generateCorrelationId?: () => string; // Optional: provide your own correlation ID generator
}

/**
 * Batch message handler result
 */
export interface BatchHandlerResult {
  handled: boolean;
  async?: boolean;
}

/**
 * Create batch message handlers for a specific operation
 */
export function createBatchMessageHandlers<TInput = unknown, TMeta = unknown>(
  options: BatchMessageHandlerOptions<TInput, TMeta>
): {
  canHandle: (msg: any) => boolean;
  handle: (
    msg: any,
    sender: any,
    sendResponse: (response?: any) => void
  ) => boolean | void;
} {
  const {
    operationId,
    appId,
    executorFactory,
    sinkFactory,
    getBatchRunner,
    defaultOptions = {},
    getExecutionContext,
    getRecipeId,
    generateCorrelationId: customGenerateCorrelationId,
  } = options;

  const generateCorrelationIdFn = customGenerateCorrelationId ?? generateCorrelationId;

  const messagePrefix = operationId.toUpperCase().replace(/-/g, '_');
  const startType = `START_${messagePrefix}_BATCH`;
  const pauseType = `PAUSE_${messagePrefix}_BATCH`;
  const resumeType = `RESUME_${messagePrefix}_BATCH`;
  const abortType = `ABORT_${messagePrefix}_BATCH`;
  const resumeDeferredType = `RESUME_DEFERRED_${messagePrefix}_BATCH`;
  const getStatusType = `GET_${messagePrefix}_BATCH_STATUS`;

  function canHandle(msg: any): boolean {
    return (
      msg?.type === startType ||
      msg?.type === pauseType ||
      msg?.type === resumeType ||
      msg?.type === abortType ||
      msg?.type === resumeDeferredType ||
      msg?.type === getStatusType
    );
  }

  async function handleStart(
    msg: any,
    sendResponse: (response?: any) => void
  ): Promise<void> {
    const correlationId = msg.correlationId ?? generateCorrelationIdFn();
    const {
      tasks,
      urls,
      recipeId,
      maxConcurrency,
      source,
    } = msg as {
      tasks?: BatchTask<TInput, TMeta>[];
      urls?: Array<{ url: string; [key: string]: unknown }>;
      recipeId?: string;
      maxConcurrency?: number;
      source?: string;
    };

    // Convert URLs to tasks if provided
    let batchTasks: BatchTask<TInput, TMeta>[];
    if (tasks) {
      batchTasks = tasks;
    } else if (urls && urls.length > 0) {
      batchTasks = urls.map((urlData, index) => ({
        id: `task-${index}-${Date.now()}`,
        urlRef: urlData.url,
        input: urlData as TInput,
        meta: {} as TMeta,
      }));
    } else {
      sendResponse({
        ok: false,
        error: 'No tasks or URLs provided',
      });
      return;
    }

    sendResponse({
      ok: true,
      started: true,
      correlationId,
    });

    try {
      const runId = `${operationId}-batch-${correlationId}`;
      const batchRunner = getBatchRunner(runId);

      // Get execution context
      const executionContext = getExecutionContext
        ? await getExecutionContext(correlationId)
        : createDefaultExecutionContext(correlationId);

      // Get recipe ID
      const finalRecipeId = getRecipeId ? getRecipeId(msg) : recipeId ?? `${operationId}-scrape`;

      // Create adapters
      const executor = executorFactory(
        executionContext,
        `${appId}:${finalRecipeId}`,
        correlationId,
        finalRecipeId
      );
      const sink = sinkFactory(correlationId);

      // Start batch run
      await batchRunner.start({
        runId,
        appId,
        operationId,
        tasks: batchTasks,
        executor,
        sink,
        options: {
          maxConcurrency: maxConcurrency ?? defaultOptions.maxConcurrency ?? 2,
          closeTabsOnComplete: defaultOptions.closeTabsOnComplete ?? true,
          focusTabs: defaultOptions.focusTabs ?? false,
          phiMode: defaultOptions.phiMode ?? false,
          storage: defaultOptions.phiMode
            ? { useSecureStorage: true }
            : undefined,
        },
        captchaPolicy: defaultOptions.captchaPolicy,
        correlationId,
      });

      // Notify UI
      chrome.runtime.sendMessage({
        type: 'BATCH_RUN_STARTED',
        runId,
        correlationId,
        taskCount: batchTasks.length,
        operationId,
      }).catch(() => {});

      logger.info('Batch run started', {
        correlationId,
        runId,
        operationId,
        taskCount: batchTasks.length,
        source: source ?? 'unknown',
      });
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('Failed to start batch run', error as Error, {
        correlationId,
        operationId,
      });
      chrome.runtime.sendMessage({
        type: 'BATCH_RUN_ERROR',
        correlationId,
        operationId,
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
      }).catch(() => {});
    }
  }

  function handle(
    msg: any,
    sender: any,
    sendResponse: (response?: any) => void
  ): boolean | void {
    if (!canHandle(msg)) {
      return false;
    }

    if (msg?.type === startType) {
      handleStart(msg, sendResponse);
      return true; // Async response
    }

    if (msg?.type === pauseType) {
      (async () => {
        try {
          const { runId } = msg as { runId: string };
          const batchRunner = getBatchRunner(runId);
          await batchRunner.pause(runId);
          sendResponse({ ok: true });
        } catch (error) {
          sendResponse({
            ok: false,
            error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
          });
        }
      })();
      return true;
    }

    if (msg?.type === resumeType) {
      (async () => {
        try {
          const { runId } = msg as { runId: string };
          const batchRunner = getBatchRunner(runId);
          await batchRunner.resume(runId);
          sendResponse({ ok: true });
        } catch (error) {
          sendResponse({
            ok: false,
            error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
          });
        }
      })();
      return true;
    }

    if (msg?.type === abortType) {
      (async () => {
        try {
          const { runId } = msg as { runId: string };
          const batchRunner = getBatchRunner(runId);
          await batchRunner.abort(runId);
          sendResponse({ ok: true });
        } catch (error) {
          sendResponse({
            ok: false,
            error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
          });
        }
      })();
      return true;
    }

    if (msg?.type === resumeDeferredType) {
      (async () => {
        try {
          const { runId, deferredKey } = msg as { runId: string; deferredKey?: string };
          const batchRunner = getBatchRunner(runId);
          await batchRunner.resumeDeferred(runId, deferredKey);
          sendResponse({ ok: true });
        } catch (error) {
          sendResponse({
            ok: false,
            error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
          });
        }
      })();
      return true;
    }

    if (msg?.type === getStatusType) {
      (async () => {
        try {
          const { runId } = msg as { runId: string };
          const batchRunner = getBatchRunner(runId);
          const snapshot = await batchRunner.getRunSnapshot(appId, operationId, runId);
          sendResponse({ ok: true, snapshot });
        } catch (error) {
          sendResponse({
            ok: false,
            error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
          });
        }
      })();
      return true;
    }

    return false;
  }

  return { canHandle, handle };
}

/**
 * Create default execution context
 */
function createDefaultExecutionContext(correlationId: string): ExecutionContext {
  return {
    tabId: undefined,
    correlationId,
    variables: {},
    baseDownloadFolder: '', // Will be set by runtime
    recipeKey: '',
    abortSignal: new AbortController().signal,
  };
}

/**
 * Storage Table Sink
 *
 * Reference adapter for writing batch task updates to a DataTable-friendly storage format.
 */

import { logger } from '@chrome-ext/core-telemetry';
import type { RowSink, BatchTaskState, BatchResultRef } from '../types.js';

/**
 * Table row data structure
 */
export interface TableRow {
  id: string;
  status: BatchTaskState['status'];
  attempts: number;
  startedAt?: string;
  completedAt?: string;
  lastErrorCode?: string;
  lastErrorSummary?: string;
  progress?: unknown;
  summary?: unknown;
  resultRef?: BatchResultRef;
  tabId?: number;
  updatedAt: string;
}

/**
 * Table state structure
 */
export interface TableState {
  runId: string;
  appId: string;
  operationId: string;
  rowOrder: string[];
  rowsById: Record<string, TableRow>;
  updatedAt: string;
  metrics: {
    total: number;
    completed: number;
    failed: number;
    deferred: number;
    running: number;
    queued: number;
  };
}

/**
 * Storage table sink configuration
 */
export interface StorageTableSinkConfig {
  appId: string;
  operationId: string;
  broadcastEvents?: boolean;
}

/**
 * Storage table sink implementation
 */
export class StorageTableSink implements RowSink {
  private config: StorageTableSinkConfig;
  private currentRunId: string | null = null;
  private writeThrottle: NodeJS.Timeout | null = null;
  private pendingUpdates = new Map<string, TableRow>();

  constructor(config: StorageTableSinkConfig) {
    this.config = config;
  }

  async onTaskUpdate(params: {
    runId: string;
    taskId: string;
    state: BatchTaskState;
    progress?: unknown;
    summary?: unknown;
    resultRef?: BatchResultRef;
  }): Promise<void> {
    const { runId, taskId, state, progress, summary, resultRef } = params;

    // Track current run
    if (this.currentRunId !== runId) {
      this.currentRunId = runId;
    }

    // Build row data
    const row: TableRow = {
      id: taskId,
      status: state.status,
      attempts: state.attempts,
      startedAt: state.startedAt,
      completedAt: state.completedAt,
      lastErrorCode: state.lastErrorCode,
      lastErrorSummary: state.lastErrorSummary,
      progress,
      summary,
      resultRef,
      tabId: state.tabId,
      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };

    // Store pending update
    this.pendingUpdates.set(taskId, row);

    // Throttle writes
    if (this.writeThrottle) {
      clearTimeout(this.writeThrottle);
    }

    this.writeThrottle = setTimeout(() => {
      this.flushUpdates(runId).catch(error => {
        logger.error('Failed to flush table updates', error as Error, {
          runId,
          appId: this.config.appId,
          operationId: this.config.operationId,
        });
      });
    }, 250);

    // Broadcast event if configured
    if (this.config.broadcastEvents) {
      this.broadcastRowUpdate(runId, taskId, row).catch(() => {
        // Ignore broadcast errors
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Flush pending updates to storage
   */
  private async flushUpdates(runId: string): Promise<void> {
    if (this.pendingUpdates.size === 0) {
      return;
    }

    const updates = Array.from(this.pendingUpdates.entries());
    this.pendingUpdates.clear();

    // Load current state
    const key = `batch_table:${this.config.appId}:${this.config.operationId}:${runId}`;
    const result = await chrome.storage.local.get(key);
    const current = (result[key] as TableState | undefined) ?? {
      runId,
      appId: this.config.appId,
      operationId: this.config.operationId,
      rowOrder: [],
      rowsById: {},
      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      metrics: {
        total: 0,
        completed: 0,
        failed: 0,
        deferred: 0,
        running: 0,
        queued: 0,
      },
    };

    // Apply updates
    for (const [taskId, row] of updates) {
      current.rowsById[taskId] = row;

      // Update row order if new
      if (!current.rowOrder.includes(taskId)) {
        current.rowOrder.push(taskId);
      }
    }

    // Recalculate metrics
    current.metrics = {
      total: current.rowOrder.length,
      completed: Object.values(current.rowsById).filter(r => r.status === 'succeeded').length,
      failed: Object.values(current.rowsById).filter(r => r.status === 'failed').length,
      deferred: Object.values(current.rowsById).filter(r => r.status === 'deferred').length,
      running: Object.values(current.rowsById).filter(r => r.status === 'running').length,
      queued: Object.values(current.rowsById).filter(r => r.status === 'queued').length,
    };

    current.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();

    // Save to storage
    await chrome.storage.local.set({ [key]: current });
  }

  /**
   * Broadcast row update to UI
   */
  private async broadcastRowUpdate(
    runId: string,
    taskId: string,
    row: TableRow
  ): Promise<void> {
    try {
      chrome.runtime.sendMessage(
        {
          type: 'BATCH_ROW_UPDATE',
          runId,
          appId: this.config.appId,
          operationId: this.config.operationId,
          taskId,
          row,
        },
        () => {
          // Ignore errors (sidepanel may not be open)
          if (chrome.runtime.lastError) {
            // Expected if no listeners
          }
        }
      );
    } catch (error) {
      // Ignore broadcast errors
      logger.debug('Failed to broadcast row update', {
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
        runId,
        taskId,
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get table state for a run
   */
  static async getTableState(
    appId: string,
    operationId: string,
    runId: string
  ): Promise<TableState | null> {
    const key = `batch_table:${appId}:${operationId}:${runId}`;
    const result = await chrome.storage.local.get(key);
    return (result[key] as TableState | undefined) ?? null;
  }

  /**
   * Get all table states for an operation
   */
  static async getAllTableStates(
    appId: string,
    operationId: string
  ): Promise<TableState[]> {
    const allStorage = await chrome.storage.local.get(null);
    const prefix = `batch_table:${appId}:${operationId}:`;
    const states: TableState[] = [];

    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(allStorage)) {
      if (key.startsWith(prefix)) {
        const state = value as TableState;
        if (state) {
          states.push(state);
        }
      }
    }

    return states.sort((a, b) => {
      const aTime = new Date(a.updatedAt).getTime();
      const bTime = new Date(b.updatedAt).getTime();
      return bTime - aTime; // Most recent first
    });
  }
}

/**
 * Tab Session Manager Tests
 */

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import { TabSessionManager } from './tab-session-manager.js';
import { TabSessionError } from './errors.js';

// Mock chrome APIs
const mockTabs = {
  create: vi.fn(),
  get: vi.fn(),
  update: vi.fn(),
  remove: vi.fn(),
  onUpdated: {
    addListener: vi.fn(),
    removeListener: vi.fn(),
  },
};

const mockWindows = {
  update: vi.fn(),
};

const mockScripting = {
  executeScript: vi.fn(),
};

const mockRuntime = {
  sendMessage: vi.fn(),
  lastError: null,
};

// @ts-expect-error - Mocking chrome global
global.chrome = {
  tabs: mockTabs as any,
  windows: mockWindows as any,
  scripting: mockScripting as any,
  runtime: mockRuntime as any,
};

describe('TabSessionManager', () => {
  let manager: TabSessionManager;

  beforeEach(() => {
    manager = new TabSessionManager();
    vi.clearAllMocks();
    mockRuntime.lastError = null;
  });

  describe('open', () => {
    it('should create a tab with correct properties', async () => {
      const mockTab = { id: 123, windowId: 456 };
      mockTabs.create.mockResolvedValue(mockTab);

      const result = await manager.open('https://example.com', {
        active: true,
        focused: true,
      });

      expect(mockTabs.create).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
        url: 'https://example.com',
        active: true,
      });
      expect(result.tabId).toBe(123);
      expect(result.windowId).toBe(456);
    });

    it('should handle tab creation errors', async () => {
      mockTabs.create.mockRejectedValue(new Error('Tab creation failed'));

      await expect(
        manager.open('https://example.com')
      ).rejects.toThrow(TabSessionError);
    });

    it('should serialize tab opens', async () => {
      const mockTab1 = { id: 1 };
      const mockTab2 = { id: 2 };
      mockTabs.create
        .mockResolvedValueOnce(mockTab1)
        .mockResolvedValueOnce(mockTab2);

      const promise1 = manager.open('https://example.com/1');
      const promise2 = manager.open('https://example.com/2');

      const [result1, result2] = await Promise.all([promise1, promise2]);

      // Verify calls were serialized (second call happened after first resolved)
      expect(mockTabs.create).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
      expect(result1.tabId).toBe(1);
      expect(result2.tabId).toBe(2);
    });
  });

  describe('waitForLoad', () => {
    it('should resolve if tab is already complete', async () => {
      const tabId = 123;
      mockTabs.get.mockResolvedValue({ id: tabId, status: 'complete' });

      await manager.waitForLoad(tabId);

      expect(mockTabs.onUpdated.addListener).toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(mockTabs.onUpdated.removeListener).toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it('should timeout if tab does not load', async () => {
      const tabId = 123;
      mockTabs.get.mockResolvedValue({ id: tabId, status: 'loading' });

      // Mock listener to never fire
      mockTabs.onUpdated.addListener.mockImplementation(() => {});

      await expect(manager.waitForLoad(tabId, 100)).rejects.toThrow(
        TabSessionError
      );
    });
  });

  describe('ensureContentReady', () => {
    it('should inject script and ping successfully', async () => {
      const tabId = 123;
      mockScripting.executeScript.mockResolvedValue([]);
      mockRuntime.sendMessage.mockImplementation((id, msg, callback) => {
        if (msg.type === 'PING') {
          callback({ ok: true });
        }
      });

      await manager.ensureContentReady(tabId, {
        contentScriptPath: 'content.js',
      });

      expect(mockScripting.executeScript).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
        target: { tabId },
        files: ['content.js'],
      });
      expect(mockRuntime.sendMessage).toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it('should retry ping on failure', async () => {
      const tabId = 123;
      let attempt = 0;
      mockScripting.executeScript.mockResolvedValue([]);
      mockRuntime.sendMessage.mockImplementation((id, msg, callback) => {
        if (msg.type === 'PING') {
          attempt++;
          if (attempt < 2) {
            callback({ ok: false });
          } else {
            callback({ ok: true });
          }
        }
      });

      await manager.ensureContentReady(tabId, {
        contentScriptPath: 'content.js',
        maxRetries: 3,
      });

      expect(mockRuntime.sendMessage).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
    });
  });

  describe('close', () => {
    it('should close tab successfully', async () => {
      const tabId = 123;
      mockTabs.remove.mockResolvedValue(undefined);

      await manager.close(tabId);

      expect(mockTabs.remove).toHaveBeenCalledWith(tabId);
    });

    it('should handle close errors gracefully', async () => {
      const tabId = 123;
      mockTabs.remove.mockRejectedValue(new Error('Tab not found'));

      // Should not throw
      await manager.close(tabId);
    });
  });
});
