/**
 * Tab Session Manager
 *
 * MV3-safe tab lifecycle management with serialized opens and content script readiness checks.
 */

import { logger } from '@chrome-ext/core-telemetry';
import { TabSessionError } from './errors.js';

/**
 * Tab open options
 */
export interface TabOpenOptions {
  active?: boolean;
  focused?: boolean;
  windowId?: number;
}

/**
 * Tab session result
 */
export interface TabSessionResult {
  tabId: number;
  windowId?: number;
}

/**
 * Content ready options
 */
export interface ContentReadyOptions {
  contentScriptPath: string;
  pingTimeoutMs?: number;
  maxRetries?: number;
  initialDelayMs?: number;
}

/**
 * Tab session manager for batch operations
 */
export class TabSessionManager {
  private tabOpenQueue: Promise<void> = Promise.resolve();
  private activeTabs = new Set<number>();

  /**
   * Open a new tab with serialized queue to avoid concurrent creation issues
   */
  async open(url: string, options: TabOpenOptions = {}): Promise<TabSessionResult> {
    const previous = this.tabOpenQueue;
    let release: () => void;
    this.tabOpenQueue = new Promise<void>(resolve => {
      release = resolve;
    });

    await previous;

    try {
      const createProperties: chrome.tabs.CreateProperties = {
        url,
        active: options.active ?? false,
      };

      if (options.windowId !== undefined) {
        createProperties.windowId = options.windowId;
      }

      const tab = await chrome.tabs.create(createProperties);

      if (!tab.id) {
        throw new TabSessionError('Failed to create tab: no tab ID returned');
      }

      if (options.focused && tab.windowId !== undefined) {
        await chrome.tabs.update(tab.id, { active: true }).catch(() => {
          // Ignore focus errors
        });
        await chrome.windows.update(tab.windowId, { focused: true }).catch(() => {
          // Ignore focus errors
        });
      }

      this.activeTabs.add(tab.id);

      logger.debug('Tab opened', {
        tabId: tab.id,
        url: this.maskUrl(url),
        windowId: tab.windowId,
      });

      return {
        tabId: tab.id,
        windowId: tab.windowId,
      };
    } catch (error) {
      throw new TabSessionError(
        `Failed to open tab: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}`,
        error
      );
    } finally {
      release();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Wait for tab to finish loading
   */
  async waitForLoad(tabId: number, timeoutMs: number = 30000): Promise<void> {
    return new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
      const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
        chrome.tabs.onUpdated.removeListener(listener);
        reject(
          new TabSessionError(`Tab load timeout after ${timeoutMs}ms for tab ${tabId}`)
        );
      }, timeoutMs);

      const listener = (
        updatedTabId: number,
        changeInfo: chrome.tabs.TabChangeInfo
      ) => {
        if (updatedTabId === tabId && changeInfo.status === 'complete') {
          clearTimeout(timeoutId);
          chrome.tabs.onUpdated.removeListener(listener);
          resolve();
        }
      };

      chrome.tabs.onUpdated.addListener(listener);

      // Check if already loaded
      chrome.tabs
        .get(tabId)
        .then(tab => {
          if (tab.status === 'complete') {
            clearTimeout(timeoutId);
            chrome.tabs.onUpdated.removeListener(listener);
            resolve();
          }
        })
        .catch(() => {
          // Wait for listener
        });
    });
  }

  /**
   * Ensure content script is injected and ready (PING protocol)
   */
  async ensureContentReady(
    tabId: number,
    options: ContentReadyOptions
  ): Promise<void> {
    const {
      contentScriptPath,
      pingTimeoutMs = 5000,
      maxRetries = 6,
      initialDelayMs = 200,
    } = options;

    // Initial delay to allow script initialization
    if (initialDelayMs > 0) {
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, initialDelayMs));
    }

    // Try to inject script if needed
    try {
      await chrome.scripting.executeScript({
        target: { tabId },
        files: [contentScriptPath],
      });
      // Wait for script to initialize
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 200));
      logger.debug('Content script injection attempted', {
        tabId,
        contentScriptPath,
      });
    } catch (injectError) {
      // Injection might fail if script is already injected - proceed with ping
      logger.debug('Content script injection attempt failed (may already be injected)', {
        tabId,
        contentScriptPath,
        error:
          injectError instanceof Error ? injectError.message : String(injectError),
      });
    }

    // Ping with retry and exponential backoff
    let lastError: Error | null = null;

    for (let attempt = 0; attempt <= maxRetries; attempt++) {
      try {
        await this.pingContentScript(tabId, pingTimeoutMs);
        logger.debug('Content script ready after ping', {
          tabId,
          attempt: attempt + 1,
        });
        return; // Success
      } catch (error) {
        lastError = error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error));
        if (attempt < maxRetries) {
          // Exponential backoff: 200ms, 400ms, 800ms, 1600ms, 3200ms, 5000ms (capped)
          const delayMs = Math.min(200 * Math.pow(2, attempt), 5000);
          logger.debug('Content script ping failed, retrying', {
            tabId,
            attempt: attempt + 1,
            maxRetries: maxRetries + 1,
            delayMs,
            error: lastError.message,
          });
          await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, delayMs));
        }
      }
    }

    // All retries exhausted
    throw new TabSessionError(
      `Content script not ready after ${maxRetries + 1} attempts: ${lastError?.message ?? 'Unknown error'}`
    );
  }

  /**
   * Ping content script to verify readiness
   */
  private pingContentScript(tabId: number, timeoutMs: number): Promise<void> {
    return new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
      const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
        reject(new Error(`Ping timeout after ${timeoutMs}ms`));
      }, timeoutMs);

      try {
        chrome.tabs.sendMessage(
          tabId,
          { type: 'PING' },
          (response: { ok?: boolean; error?: string } | undefined) => {
            clearTimeout(timeoutId);

            const lastError = chrome.runtime.lastError as
              | chrome.runtime.LastError
              | undefined;
            if (lastError != null) {
              reject(
                new Error(`Content script not available: ${lastError.message}`)
              );
              return;
            }

            if (response?.ok === true) {
              resolve();
              return;
            } else {
              reject(
                new Error(
                  `Ping response not ok: ${response?.error ?? 'Unknown error'}`
                )
              );
            }
          }
        );
      } catch (error) {
        clearTimeout(timeoutId);
        reject(
          new Error(
            `Failed to ping content script: ${
              error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)
            }`
          )
        );
      }
    });
  }

  /**
   * Close a tab safely (best-effort)
   */
  async close(tabId: number): Promise<void> {
    try {
      await chrome.tabs.remove(tabId);
      this.activeTabs.delete(tabId);
      logger.debug('Tab closed', { tabId });
    } catch (error) {
      // Log but don't throw - tab may already be closed
      logger.debug('Tab close failed (may already be closed)', {
        tabId,
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
      });
      this.activeTabs.delete(tabId);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Close multiple tabs
   */
  async closeAll(tabIds: number[]): Promise<void> {
    await Promise.allSettled(tabIds.map(tabId => this.close(tabId)));
  }

  /**
   * Get active tabs tracked by this manager
   */
  getActiveTabs(): number[] {
    return Array.from(this.activeTabs);
  }

  /**
   * Mask URL for logging (remove query params and hash for privacy)
   */
  private maskUrl(url: string): string {
    try {
      const urlObj = new URL(url);
      return `${urlObj.protocol}//${urlObj.hostname}${urlObj.pathname}`;
    } catch {
      return url.substring(0, 50) + '...';
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Batch Runner Types
 *
 * Core type definitions for the batch execution system.
 */

/**
 * Tab opening mode for batch operations
 */
export type TabOpenMode = 'multiTab' | 'singleTabReuse';

/**
 * Task status in batch execution
 */
export type BatchTaskStatus =
  | 'queued'
  | 'running'
  | 'succeeded'
  | 'failed'
  | 'deferred';

/**
 * Run status for batch operations
 */
export type BatchRunStatus =
  | 'pending'
  | 'running'
  | 'paused'
  | 'completed'
  | 'failed'
  | 'aborted';

/**
 * Retry policy configuration
 */
export interface RetryPolicy {
  maxAttempts: number;
  initialDelayMs: number;
  maxDelayMs: number;
  backoffMultiplier: number;
  jitter: boolean;
}

/**
 * Timeout configuration for batch operations
 */
export interface BatchTimeouts {
  tabLoadMs: number;
  contentReadyMs: number;
  taskExecutionMs: number;

}

 * Storage configuration for batch state

  secureStoragePrefix?: string;

}

 * Batch run options
 */
export interface BatchRunOptions {
  maxConcurrency: number;
  tabOpenMode?: TabOpenMode;
  timeouts?: Partial<BatchTimeouts>;

  focusTabs?: boolean;

}

/**
 * Automation error classes
 */

export class AutomationError extends Error {
  constructor(
    message: string,
    public readonly code: string,
    public readonly details?: unknown
  ) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'AutomationError';
  }
}

export class StepTimeoutError extends AutomationError {
  constructor(stepIndex: number, timeout: number) {
    super(`Step ${stepIndex} timed out after ${timeout}ms`, 'STEP_TIMEOUT', {
      stepIndex,
      timeout,
    });
  }
}

export class ElementNotFoundError extends AutomationError {
  constructor(selector: string, stepIndex: number) {
    super(`Element not found: ${selector}`, 'ELEMENT_NOT_FOUND', {
      selector,
      stepIndex,
    });
  }
}

export class NavigationError extends AutomationError {
  constructor(url: string, stepIndex: number) {
    super(`Navigation failed to: ${url}`, 'NAVIGATION_ERROR', {
      url,
      stepIndex,
    });
  }
}

/**
 * Automation Orchestrator
 *
 * Manages flow registration and execution across tabs.
 */

import type { FlowRegistration, ExecutionResult } from './types.js';
import { logger } from '@chrome-ext/core-telemetry';

export class AutomationOrchestrator {
  private flows = new Map<string, FlowRegistration>();
  private activeExecutions = new Set<string>();

  /**
   * Register a flow for execution
   */
  registerFlow(tabId: number, site: string, flowName: string): string {
    const flowId = crypto.randomUUID();
    const registration: FlowRegistration = {
      id: flowId,
      tabId,
      site,
      flowName,
      registeredAt: Date.now(),
    };

    this.flows.set(flowId, registration);
    logger.info('Flow registered', { flowId, tabId, site, flowName });

    return flowId;
  }

  /**
   * Execute a registered flow
   */
  async executeFlow(
    flowId: string,
    params: Record<string, unknown> = {}
  ): Promise<ExecutionResult> {
    const flow = this.flows.get(flowId);
    if (!flow) {
      logger.error('Flow not found', undefined, { flowId });
      return { success: false, error: 'Flow not found' };
    }

    // Prevent concurrent execution
    if (this.activeExecutions.has(flowId)) {
      logger.warn('Flow already executing', { flowId });
      return { success: false, error: 'Flow already executing' };
    }

    this.activeExecutions.add(flowId);
    flow.executing = true;

    try {
      const result = await chrome.tabs.sendMessage(flow.tabId, {
        type: 'EXECUTE_AUTOMATION',
        flowId,
        site: flow.site,
        flowName: flow.flowName,
        params,
      });

      logger.info('Flow execution completed', {
        flowId,
        success: (result as ExecutionResult)?.success ?? true,
      });

      return (result as ExecutionResult) || { success: true };
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('Flow execution failed', error as Error, { flowId });
      return {
        success: false,
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Execution failed',
      };
    } finally {
      this.activeExecutions.delete(flowId);
      flow.executing = false;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Unregister a flow
   */
  unregisterFlow(flowId: string): boolean {
    const flow = this.flows.get(flowId);
    if (flow?.executing) {
      logger.warn('Cannot unregister executing flow', { flowId });
      return false;
    }

    const deleted = this.flows.delete(flowId);
    if (deleted) {
      logger.info('Flow unregistered', { flowId });
    }
    return deleted;
  }

  /**
   * Get active flows
   */
  getActiveFlows(): FlowRegistration[] {
    return Array.from(this.flows.values()).filter(f => f.executing);
  }

  /**
   * Get all registered flows
   */
  getRegisteredFlows(): FlowRegistration[] {
    return Array.from(this.flows.values());
  }

  /**
   * Get flow by ID
   */
  getFlow(flowId: string): FlowRegistration | undefined {
    return this.flows.get(flowId);
  }
}

/**
 * Flow Executor
 *
 * Executes automation flows step by step with error handling and recovery.
 */

import type { StepSpec, Task } from '@chrome-ext/automation-core';
import { logger } from '@chrome-ext/core-telemetry';
import { pingContentScript, waitForTabLoad } from '@chrome-ext/core-runtime';

export class FlowExecutor {
  /**
   * Execute task steps
   */
  async executeTaskSteps(task: Task, fromStep: number = 0): Promise<void> {
    logger.info('Executing task steps', {
      taskId: task.taskId,
      fromStep,
      totalSteps: task.steps.length,
    });

    for (let i = fromStep; i < task.steps.length; i++) {
      const step = task.steps[i];
      logger.debug('Executing step', {
        taskId: task.taskId,
        stepIndex: i,
        stepType: step.type,
        description: step.description,
      });

      try {
        // Handle navigation-capable steps
        const stepData = step.data as { action?: string } | undefined;
        const stepAction = stepData?.action;
        const isNavigationCapable =
          step.type === 'goto' ||
          (step.type === 'custom' &&
            stepAction !== null &&
            stepAction !== undefined &&
            stepAction === 'navigateToFirstResult');

        if (isNavigationCapable === true) {
          task.nextStepIndex = i + 1;
          task.updatedAt = Date.now();
          logger.info('Navigation step executed, breaking for navigation', {
            taskId: task.taskId,
            stepIndex: i,
          });
          return; // Stop here, resume on CONTENT_READY
        }

        // Execute step via content script
        await this.executeStep(task.tabId, step, i);

        logger.debug('Step completed', {
          taskId: task.taskId,
          stepIndex: i,
        });
      } catch (error) {
        logger.error('Step execution failed', error as Error, {
          taskId: task.taskId,
          stepIndex: i,
          stepType: step.type,
        });

        task.state = 'done';
        task.log.push({
          ts: Date.now(),
          level: 'error',
          context: 'background',
          message: `Step ${i} failed: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}`,
          stack: error instanceof Error ? error.stack : undefined,
        });

        throw error;
      }
    }

    // Task completed
    task.state = 'done';
    task.updatedAt = Date.now();
    task.log.push({
      ts: Date.now(),
      level: 'info',
      context: 'background',
      message: `Task completed successfully with ${task.steps.length} steps`,
    });

    logger.info('Task completed', {
      taskId: task.taskId,
      totalSteps: task.steps.length,
    });
  }

  /**
   * Execute a single step
   */
  private async executeStep(
    tabId: number,
    step: StepSpec,
    stepIndex: number
  ): Promise<void> {
    // Ensure content script is ready
    await pingContentScript(tabId);

    // Send step to content script
    const response = await chrome.tabs.sendMessage(tabId, {
      type: 'EXEC_STEPS',
      taskId: `step_${stepIndex}`,
      fromStep: stepIndex,
      steps: [step],
    });

    if (
      response === null ||
      response === undefined ||
      typeof response !== 'object' ||
      !('ok' in response) ||
      response.ok !== true
    ) {
      const errorMessage = (response as { error?: string })?.error;
      throw new Error(
        `Step execution failed: ${errorMessage !== null && errorMessage !== undefined ? errorMessage : 'Unknown error'}`
      );
    }
  }

  /**
   * Resume task after navigation
   */
  async resumeTask(task: Task): Promise<void> {
    if (task.state !== 'running') {
      return;
    }

    logger.info('Resuming task after navigation', {
      taskId: task.taskId,
      nextStepIndex: task.nextStepIndex,
    });

    await this.executeTaskSteps(task, task.nextStepIndex);
  }
}

/**
 * Flow Loader
 *
 * Loads flows from storage or JSON files.
 */

import type { Flow, FlowMetadata } from './types.js';
import { ChromeStorage } from '@chrome-ext/core-storage';
import { logger } from '@chrome-ext/core-telemetry';

export class FlowLoader {
  private storage: ChromeStorage<{
    flows: Record<string, Flow>;
    sites: Record<
      string,
      { flows: Record<string, Flow>; latestFlowId?: string }
    >;
  }>;

  constructor(namespace: string = 'automation') {
    this.storage = new ChromeStorage('local', namespace);
  }

  /**
   * Load a flow by ID
   */
  async loadFlow(flowId: string): Promise<Flow | null> {
    try {
      const data = await this.storage.getAll();
      const flows = data.flows || {};
      return flows[flowId] || null;
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('Failed to load flow', error as Error, { flowId });
      return null;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Load flows for a site
   */
  async loadFlowsForSite(site: string): Promise<Flow[]> {
    try {
      const data = await this.storage.getAll();
      const sites = data.sites || {};
      const siteData = sites[site];
      if (!siteData || !siteData.flows) {
        return [];
      }
      return Object.values(siteData.flows);
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('Failed to load flows for site', error as Error, { site });
      return [];
    }
  }

  /**
   * Save a flow
   */
  async saveFlow(flow: Flow, site?: string): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const data = await this.storage.getAll();

      if (!data.flows) {
        data.flows = {};
      }
      data.flows[flow.id] = flow;

      if (site) {
        if (!data.sites) {
          data.sites = {};
        }
        if (!data.sites[site]) {
          data.sites[site] = { flows: {} };
        }
        data.sites[site].flows[flow.id] = flow;
        data.sites[site].latestFlowId = flow.id;
      }

      await this.storage.set('flows' as never, data.flows as never);
      if (data.sites) {
        await this.storage.set('sites' as never, data.sites as never);
      }

      logger.info('Flow saved', { flowId: flow.id, site });
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('Failed to save flow', error as Error, { flowId: flow.id });
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * List all flows
   */
  async listFlows(): Promise<FlowMetadata[]> {
    try {
      const data = await this.storage.getAll();
      const flows = data.flows || {};
      return Object.values(flows).map(flow => ({
        id: flow.id,
        name: flow.name,
        url: flow.url,
        tags: flow.tags,
      }));
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('Failed to list flows', error as Error);
      return [];
    }
  }
}



==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/libs/Google-Chrome-Extension-Library/automation/flows/src/flow-registry.ts ====
/**
 * Flow Registry
 *
 * Manages flow registration and metadata.
 */

import type { Flow, FlowMetadata } from './types.js';
import { FlowLoader } from './flow-loader.js';

export class FlowRegistry {
  private loader: FlowLoader;
  private flows = new Map<string, Flow>();

  constructor(namespace: string = 'automation') {
    this.loader = new FlowLoader(namespace);
  }

  /**
   * Register a flow
   */
  register(flow: Flow): void {
    this.flows.set(flow.id, flow);
  }

  /**
   * Get a flow by ID
   */
  get(flowId: string): Flow | undefined {
    return this.flows.get(flowId);
  }

  /**
   * Get all registered flows
   */
  getAll(): Flow[] {
    return Array.from(this.flows.values());
  }

  /**
   * Load flows from storage
   */
  async loadFromStorage(): Promise<void> {
    const flows = await this.loader.listFlows();
    for (const metadata of flows) {
      const flow = await this.loader.loadFlow(metadata.id);
      if (flow !== null && flow !== undefined) {
        this.register(flow);
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Save flow to storage
   */
  async save(flow: Flow, site?: string): Promise<void> {
    this.register(flow);
    await this.loader.saveFlow(flow, site);
  }
}

export interface NotificationSoundOptions {
  volume?: number;
  repeat?: number;
  intervalMs?: number;
}

export interface VisualNotificationOptions {
  message?: string;
  backgroundColor?: string;
  accentColor?: string;
}

function getAudioContext(doc: Document): AudioContext | null {
  const win = doc.defaultView || window;
  const AudioContextClass =
    (win as any).AudioContext || (win as any).webkitAudioContext;
  if (!AudioContextClass) return null;
  return (win as any).__notaryAudioContext ||
    ((win as any).__notaryAudioContext = new AudioContextClass());
}

export async function playNotificationChime(
  options: NotificationSoundOptions = {},
  doc: Document = document
): Promise<void> {
  const repeat = options.repeat ?? 1;
  const intervalMs = options.intervalMs ?? 400;

  for (let i = 0; i < repeat; i += 1) {
    setTimeout(() => {
      const ctx = getAudioContext(doc);
      if (!ctx) {
        return;
      }

      const oscillator = ctx.createOscillator();
      const gain = ctx.createGain();
      const filter = ctx.createBiquadFilter();

      filter.type = 'lowpass';
      filter.frequency.setValueAtTime(2000, ctx.currentTime);
      filter.Q.setValueAtTime(1, ctx.currentTime);

      oscillator.type = 'sine';
      oscillator.frequency.setValueAtTime(261.63, ctx.currentTime);
      oscillator.frequency.setValueAtTime(329.63, ctx.currentTime + 0.15);
      oscillator.frequency.setValueAtTime(392.0, ctx.currentTime + 0.3);

      const volume = options.volume ?? 0.7;
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0, ctx.currentTime);
      gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(volume, ctx.currentTime + 0.02);
      gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(volume * 0.7, ctx.currentTime + 0.15);
      gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(volume * 0.5, ctx.currentTime + 0.3);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, ctx.currentTime + 0.8);

      oscillator.connect(filter);
      filter.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(ctx.destination);

      oscillator.start(ctx.currentTime);
      oscillator.stop(ctx.currentTime + 0.8);
    }, i * intervalMs);
  }
}

export async function showVisualNotification(
  options: VisualNotificationOptions = {},
  doc: Document = document
): Promise<void> {
  const message =
    options.message || 'Open Call detected. Attempted to join immediately.';
  const background = options.backgroundColor || 'rgba(255, 255, 0, 0.3)';
  const accent = options.accentColor || 'rgba(0, 255, 0, 0.9)';

  const flash = doc.createElement('div');
  flash.id = 'notary-button-press-flash';
  flash.style.cssText = `
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    background: ${background};
    z-index: 10002;
    pointer-events: none;
    animation: notaryFlash 0.5s ease-out;
  `;

  const style = doc.createElement('style');
  style.textContent = `
    @keyframes notaryFlash {
      0% { opacity: 0; }
      50% { opacity: 0.8; }
      100% { opacity: 0; }
    }
    @keyframes notaryMessageFade {
      0% { opacity: 0; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(0.8); }
      20% { opacity: 1; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1.1); }
      80% { opacity: 1; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1); }
      100% { opacity: 0; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(0.9); }
    }
  `;

  const messageEl = doc.createElement('div');
  messageEl.style.cssText = `
    position: fixed;
    top: 50%;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    background: ${accent};
    color: white;
    padding: 20px 30px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: bold;
    z-index: 10003;
    pointer-events: none;
    animation: notaryMessageFade 2s ease-out;
    text-align: center;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
  `;
  messageEl.textContent = message;

  doc.head.appendChild(style);
  doc.body.appendChild(flash);
  doc.body.appendChild(messageEl);

  setTimeout(() => {
    flash.remove();
    messageEl.remove();
    style.remove();
  }, 2000);
}

export function showToast(
  message: string,
  type: 'info' | 'success' | 'error' = 'info',
  durationMs: number = 3000,
  doc: Document = document
): void {
  const toast = doc.createElement('div');
  const background =
    type === 'success'
      ? '#28a745'
      : type === 'error'
      ? '#dc3545'
      : '#6c757d';

  toast.textContent = message;
  toast.style.position = 'fixed';
  toast.style.top = '20px';
  toast.style.right = '20px';
  toast.style.zIndex = '10001';
  toast.style.background = background;
  toast.style.color = 'white';
  toast.style.padding = '10px 14px';
  toast.style.borderRadius = '6px';
  toast.style.boxShadow = '0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.25)';
  toast.style.fontSize = '12px';
  toast.style.maxWidth = '280px';
  toast.style.wordBreak = 'break-word';

  doc.body.appendChild(toast);
  setTimeout(() => toast.remove(), durationMs);
}

import { computeCssSelector, describeElement, generateCandidateSelectors } from './selector-utils.js';

export interface ElementPickerResult {
  selector: string;
  candidates: string[];
  description: string;
}

export interface ElementPickerOptions {
  document?: Document;
  excludeSelector?: string;
  highlightColor?: string;
  hintText?: string;
}

const ACTIVE_FLAG = '__notaryElementPickerActive';

function isExcluded(element: Element, excludeSelector?: string): boolean {
  if (!excludeSelector) return false;
  return Boolean(element.closest(excludeSelector));
}

export function pickElementSelector(
  options: ElementPickerOptions = {}
): Promise<ElementPickerResult | null> {
  const doc = options.document ?? document;

  return new Promise(resolve => {
    if ((window as any)[ACTIVE_FLAG]) {
      resolve(null);
      return;
    }
    (window as any)[ACTIVE_FLAG] = true;

    const highlightStyle = `outline: 3px solid ${options.highlightColor || '#00c3ff'}; outline-offset: 2px;`;
    let lastElement: HTMLElement | null = null;

    const overlay = doc.createElement('div');
    overlay.id = 'notary-element-picker-overlay';
    overlay.style.position = 'fixed';
    overlay.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
    overlay.style.top = '0';
    overlay.style.left = '0';
    overlay.style.width = '100%';
    overlay.style.height = '100%';
    overlay.style.zIndex = '2147483646';

    const hint = doc.createElement('div');
    hint.id = 'notary-element-picker-hint';
    hint.textContent =
      options.hintText ||
      'Element Picker: hover to highlight, click to save selector (Esc to cancel)';
    hint.style.position = 'fixed';
    hint.style.top = '12px';
    hint.style.left = '50%';
    hint.style.transform = 'translateX(-50%)';
    hint.style.background = '#2c3e50';
    hint.style.color = '#fff';
    hint.style.padding = '6px 10px';
    hint.style.fontSize = '12px';
    hint.style.borderRadius = '6px';
    hint.style.zIndex = '2147483647';
    hint.style.boxShadow = '0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.25)';

    doc.body.appendChild(overlay);
    doc.body.appendChild(hint);

    const clearHighlight = () => {
      if (lastElement) {
        lastElement.style.outline = '';
        lastElement.style.outlineOffset = '';
        lastElement = null;
      }
    };

    const teardown = (result: ElementPickerResult | null) => {
      clearHighlight();
      doc.removeEventListener('mouseover', onMouseOver, true);
      doc.removeEventListener('click', onClick, true);
      doc.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown, true);
      overlay.remove();
      hint.remove();
      (window as any)[ACTIVE_FLAG] = false;
      resolve(result);
    };

    const onMouseOver = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      const target = event.target as Element | null;
      if (!target) return;
      if (target.id === overlay.id || target.id === hint.id) return;
      if (isExcluded(target, options.excludeSelector)) return;

      clearHighlight();
      lastElement = target as HTMLElement;
      lastElement.style.outline = highlightStyle;
      lastElement.style.outlineOffset = '2px';
    };

    const onClick = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      const target = event.target as Element | null;
      if (!target) return;
      if (target.id === overlay.id || target.id === hint.id) return;
      if (isExcluded(target, options.excludeSelector)) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      event.stopPropagation();

      const candidates = generateCandidateSelectors(target).map(c => c.selector);
      const selector = candidates[0] || computeCssSelector(target);

      teardown({
        selector,
        candidates: candidates.length > 0 ? candidates : [selector],
        description: describeElement(target),
      });
    };

    const onKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (event.key === 'Escape') {
        event.preventDefault();
        teardown(null);
      }
    };

    doc.addEventListener('mouseover', onMouseOver, true);
    doc.addEventListener('click', onClick, true);
    doc.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown, true);
  });
}



==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/libs/Google-Chrome-Extension-Library/automation/notary/src/selector-utils.ts ====
export interface SelectorCandidate {
  selector: string;
  label?: string;
}

const DATA_ATTRIBUTES = [
  'data-automation-id',
  'data-testid',
  'data-test',
  'data-qa',
  'data-cy',
];

function cssEscape(value: string): string {
  if (typeof (globalThis as any).CSS !== 'undefined' && (CSS as any).escape) {
    return (CSS as any).escape(value);
  }
  return value.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '\\$&');
}

function getFirstClassName(className: string): string | null {
  const parts = className
    .split(' ')
    .map(part => part.trim())
    .filter(Boolean);
  return parts.length > 0 ? parts[0] : null;
}

function hasUniqueAttribute(element: Element, attr: string): boolean {
  const value = element.getAttribute(attr);
  if (!value) return false;
  const matches = document.querySelectorAll(`[${attr}="${cssEscape(value)}"]`);
  return matches.length === 1;
}

export function generateCandidateSelectors(element: Element): SelectorCandidate[] {
  const candidates: SelectorCandidate[] = [];

  for (const attr of DATA_ATTRIBUTES) {
    if (element.hasAttribute(attr)) {
      const value = element.getAttribute(attr) || '';
      candidates.push({
        selector: `[${attr}="${cssEscape(value)}"]`,
        label: `${attr} selector`,
      });
      if (hasUniqueAttribute(element, attr)) {
        return candidates;
      }
    }
  }

  if (element.id) {
    candidates.push({
      selector: `#${cssEscape(element.id)}`,
      label: 'id selector',
    });
    return candidates;
  }

  const tag = element.tagName.toLowerCase();
  const firstClass = element.className
    ? getFirstClassName(element.className)
    : null;

  if (firstClass) {
    candidates.push({
      selector: `${tag}.${cssEscape(firstClass)}`,
      label: 'tag + class',
    });
  }

  candidates.push({
    selector: tag,
    label: 'tag selector',
  });

  return candidates;
}

export function computeCssSelector(element: Element): string {
  const directCandidates = generateCandidateSelectors(element);
  if (directCandidates.length > 0) {
    return directCandidates[0].selector;
  }

  const parts: string[] = [];
  let current: Element | null = element;

  while (current && current.tagName.toLowerCase() !== 'body') {
    const tag = current.tagName.toLowerCase();
    let part = tag;

    if (current.id) {
      part = `#${cssEscape(current.id)}`;
      parts.unshift(part);
      break;
    }

    const className = current.className
      ? getFirstClassName(current.className)
      : null;
    if (className) {
      part += `.${cssEscape(className)}`;
    }

    const parent = current.parentElement;
    if (parent) {
      const siblings = Array.from(parent.children).filter(
        child => child.tagName === current?.tagName
      );
      if (siblings.length > 1) {
        const index = Array.from(parent.children).indexOf(current) + 1;
        part += `:nth-child(${index})`;
      }
    }

    parts.unshift(part);
    current = current.parentElement;
  }

  return parts.join(' > ');
}

export function describeElement(element: Element): string {
  const tag = element.tagName.toLowerCase();
  const id = element.id ? `#${element.id}` : '';
  const className = element.className
    ? `.${String(element.className).split(' ')[0]}`
    : '';
  return `${tag}${id}${className}`;
}

export interface WatchOverlayOptions {
  document?: Document;
  containerSelector?: string;
  targetSelector?: string;
  label?: string;
  statusText?: string;
  color?: string;
}

export interface WatchOverlayController {
  stop: () => void;
  update: (options?: Partial<WatchOverlayOptions>) => void;
}

function computeUnionRect(
  doc: Document,
  targetSelector?: string,
  containerSelector?: string
): { top: number; left: number; width: number; height: number } {
  let elements: Element[] = [];
  if (targetSelector) {
    elements = Array.from(doc.querySelectorAll(targetSelector));
  }

  if (elements.length === 0 && containerSelector) {
    const container = doc.querySelector(containerSelector);
    if (container) {
      elements = [container];
    }
  }

  if (elements.length === 0) {
    return {
      top: 0,
      left: 0,
      width: doc.documentElement.clientWidth,
      height: doc.documentElement.clientHeight,
    };
  }

  let rect = elements[0].getBoundingClientRect();
  let top = rect.top;
  let left = rect.left;
  let right = rect.right;
  let bottom = rect.bottom;

  elements.slice(1).forEach(el => {
    rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    top = Math.min(top, rect.top);
    left = Math.min(left, rect.left);
    right = Math.max(right, rect.right);
    bottom = Math.max(bottom, rect.bottom);
  });

  return { top, left, width: right - left, height: bottom - top };
}

    },

export function highlightTargets(
  containerSelector: string | undefined,
  targetSelector: string | undefined,
  doc: Document = document
): () => void {
  const layerId = 'notary-highlight-layer';
  let layer = doc.getElementById(layerId);
  if (!layer) {
    layer = doc.createElement('div');
    layer.id = layerId;
    layer.style.position = 'fixed';
    layer.style.left = '0';
    layer.style.top = '0';
    layer.style.width = '100%';
    layer.style.height = '100%';
    layer.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
    layer.style.zIndex = '2147483647';
    doc.body.appendChild(layer);
  }

  const render = () => {
    if (!layer) return;
    layer.innerHTML = '';
    let elements: Element[] = [];
    if (targetSelector) {
      elements = Array.from(doc.querySelectorAll(targetSelector));
    }
    if (elements.length === 0 && containerSelector) {
      const container = doc.querySelector(containerSelector);
      if (container) {
        elements = Array.from(container.querySelectorAll(targetSelector || '*'));
      }
    }

    elements.forEach(el => {
      const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (rect.width === 0 || rect.height === 0) return;
      const highlight = doc.createElement('div');
      highlight.style.position = 'fixed';
      highlight.style.left = `${rect.left}px`;
      highlight.style.top = `${rect.top}px`;
      highlight.style.width = `${rect.width}px`;
      highlight.style.height = `${rect.height}px`;
      highlight.style.background = 'rgba(0,195,255,0.18)';
      highlight.style.border = '2px solid rgba(0,195,255,0.9)';
      highlight.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
      layer?.appendChild(highlight);
    });
  };

  render();
  const onScroll = () => render();
  const onResize = () => render();

  doc.defaultView?.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, true);
  doc.defaultView?.addEventListener('resize', onResize);

  return () => {
    doc.defaultView?.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll, true);
    doc.defaultView?.removeEventListener('resize', onResize);
    layer?.remove();
  };
}

# Recipe Execution Observability Audit

## Overview
This document provides a comprehensive audit of all logging points in the recipe execution system to ensure full observability for debugging and monitoring.

## Logging Architecture

### Log Channels
1. **Navigation Logs** (`logNavigation`) - Sent to test harness via `RECIPE_NAVIGATION_LOG` messages
2. **Standard Logger** (`logger`) - Console logs (service worker console)
3. **Step Progress** (`onStepProgress`) - Sent to test harness via `RECIPE_STEP_PROGRESS` messages

/**
 * Recipe Composition Utilities
 *
 * Provides utilities for programmatically composing recipes and validating compositions.
 */

import type { Recipe, RecipeStep } from './types.js';
import { getRecipe, getRecipeDependencies } from './registry.js';
import { logger } from '@chrome-ext/core-telemetry';

export interface RecipeReference {
  app: string;
  recipeId: string;
  variables?: Record<string, string>; // Map parent context variables to recipe variables
  mergeResults?: boolean;
}

export interface ValidationResult {
  valid: boolean;
  errors: string[];
  warnings: string[];
}

/**
 * Compose multiple recipes into a single recipe
 */
export function composeRecipes(
  recipeRefs: RecipeReference[],
  name: string,
  url: string,
  tags?: string[]
): Recipe {
  const steps: RecipeStep[] = [];

  for (const ref of recipeRefs) {
    const recipe = getRecipe(ref.app, ref.recipeId);
    if (!recipe) {
      throw new Error(`Recipe not found: ${ref.app}:${ref.recipeId}`);
    }

    // Create a recipeReference step for each referenced recipe
    steps.push({
      type: 'recipeReference',
      description: `Execute ${ref.app}:${ref.recipeId}`,
      recipeReference: {
        app: ref.app,
        recipeId: ref.recipeId,
        variables: ref.variables,
        mergeResults: ref.mergeResults ?? true,
      },
    });
  }

  return {
    name,
    url,
    tags,
    steps,
  };
}

/**
 * Validate a recipe composition
 */
export function validateComposition(recipe: Recipe): ValidationResult {
  const errors: string[] = [];
  const warnings: string[] = [];

  // Check for circular dependencies
  const visitedRecipes = new Set<string>();
  const checkCircularDeps = (recipeKey: string, path: string[]): void => {
    if (path.includes(recipeKey)) {
      errors.push(`Circular dependency detected: ${path.join(' -> ')} -> ${recipeKey}`);
      return;
    }
    if (visitedRecipes.has(recipeKey)) {
      return;
    }
    visitedRecipes.add(recipeKey);

    // Extract recipe references from steps
    const refs = extractRecipeReferences(recipe);
    for (const ref of refs) {
      const refKey = `${ref.app}:${ref.recipeId}`;
      const refRecipe = getRecipe(ref.app, ref.recipeId);
      if (!refRecipe) {
        errors.push(`Referenced recipe not found: ${refKey}`);
        continue;
      }
      checkCircularDeps(refKey, [...path, recipeKey]);
    }
  };

  // Check for missing dependencies
  const refs = extractRecipeReferences(recipe);
  for (const ref of refs) {
    const refRecipe = getRecipe(ref.app, ref.recipeId);
    if (!refRecipe) {
      errors.push(`Referenced recipe not found: ${ref.app}:${ref.recipeId}`);
    } else {
      // Check if referenced recipe has dependencies that aren't satisfied
      const deps = getRecipeDependencies(`${ref.app}:${ref.recipeId}`);
      for (const dep of deps) {
        const [depApp, depId] = dep.split(':');
        if (!getRecipe(depApp, depId)) {
          warnings.push(
            `Referenced recipe ${ref.app}:${ref.recipeId} depends on missing recipe: ${dep}`
          );
        }
      }
    }
  }

  return {
    valid: errors.length === 0,
    errors,
    warnings,
  };
}

/**
 * Flatten a recipe by expanding all recipe references into a flat step list
 */
export function flattenRecipe(recipe: Recipe): RecipeStep[] {
  const flattened: RecipeStep[] = [];

  const flattenSteps = (steps: RecipeStep[]): void => {
    for (const step of steps) {
      if (step.type === 'recipeReference' && step.recipeReference) {
        const { app, recipeId } = step.recipeReference;
        const refRecipe = getRecipe(app, recipeId);
        if (!refRecipe) {
          logger.warn('Referenced recipe not found during flattening', { app, recipeId });
          continue;
        }
        // Recursively flatten the referenced recipe
        flattenSteps(refRecipe.steps);
      } else if (step.type === 'loop' && step.steps) {
        // Handle loop steps - keep the loop structure but flatten nested recipe references
        const loopStep: RecipeStep = {
          ...step,
          steps: [],
        };
        flattenSteps(step.steps);
        // Note: This doesn't fully handle loops with recipe references - would need more complex logic
        flattened.push(step);
      } else {
        flattened.push(step);
      }
    }
  };

  flattenSteps(recipe.steps);
  return flattened;
}

/**
 * Extract all recipe references from a recipe
 */
function extractRecipeReferences(recipe: Recipe): RecipeReference[] {
  const refs: RecipeReference[] = [];

  const extractFromSteps = (steps: RecipeStep[]): void => {
    for (const step of steps) {
      if (step.type === 'recipeReference' && step.recipeReference) {
        refs.push(step.recipeReference);
      } else if (step.steps) {
        extractFromSteps(step.steps);
      }
    }
  };

  extractFromSteps(recipe.steps);
  return refs;
}
