// Content script runtime - communicates with content script to execute recipe steps

import type { FlowRuntime } from './executor.js';
import type { Locator, RecipeStep } from './types.js';
import { logger } from '@chrome-ext/core-telemetry';
import {
  RecipeStateManager,
  type RecipeStateContext,
} from './recipe-state-manager.js';

export interface ContentRuntimeDependencies {
  captureHtml: (
    baseFolder: string,
    filePath: string,
    htmlContent: string,
    diffCheck?: boolean,
    recipeKey?: string
  ) => Promise<string>;
  saveUrl: (
    baseFolder: string,
    filePath: string,
    url: string,
    metadata?: Record<string, unknown>
  ) => Promise<void>;
  ensureFolder: (baseFolder: string, path: string) => Promise<void>;
  validateFolderExists: (
    baseFolder: string,
    path: string,
    timeoutMs?: number
  ) => Promise<boolean>;
  validateFileExists: (
    baseFolder: string,
    filePath: string,
    timeoutMs?: number
  ) => Promise<boolean>;
  getBaseDownloadFolder: (timestamp?: string) => string;
  contentScriptPath?: string;
}

export interface ContentRuntimeHooks {
  onCheckpointSaved?: (
    checkpointId: string,
    checkpoint: Record<string, unknown>
  ) => Promise<void> | void;
  onNavigationLog?: (
    level: 'info' | 'debug' | 'warn' | 'error',
    message: string,
    metadata?: Record<string, unknown>
  ) => Promise<void> | void;
  onArtifactCaptured?: (
    payload: {
      baseFolder: string;
      filePath: string;
      html: string;
      diffCheck: boolean;
      variables: Record<string, unknown>;
    }
  ) => Promise<void> | void;
}

export interface ContentRuntimeContext {
  baseDownloadFolder?: string;
  variables?: Record<string, unknown>;
  recipeKey?: string;
  correlationId?: string;
}

export interface ContentRuntimeConfig extends ContentRuntimeContext {
  dependencies: ContentRuntimeDependencies;
  hooks?: ContentRuntimeHooks;
}

/**
 * Ping content script to verify it's ready and listening
 * @param tabId - Tab ID to ping
 * @param timeoutMs - Timeout in milliseconds (default: 3000)
 * @returns Promise that resolves if content script responds, rejects on timeout or error
 */
async function pingContentScript(
  tabId: number,
  timeoutMs: number = 5000
): Promise<void> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
      reject(
        new Error(
          `Content script ping timeout after ${timeoutMs}ms. Content script may not be injected or ready.`
        )
      );
    }, timeoutMs);

    try {
      chrome.tabs.sendMessage(
        tabId,
        { type: 'PING' },
        (response: { ok?: boolean; error?: string } | undefined) => {
          clearTimeout(timeoutId);

          const lastError = chrome.runtime.lastError as
            | chrome.runtime.LastError
            | undefined;
          if (lastError != null) {
            reject(
              new Error(`Content script not available: ${lastError.message}`)
            );
            return;
          }

          if (response?.ok === true) {
            logger.debug('Content script ping successful', { tabId });
            resolve();
            return;
          } else {
            reject(
              new Error(
                `Content script ping failed: ${response?.error ?? 'Unknown error'}`
              )
            );
          }
        }
      );
    } catch (error) {
      clearTimeout(timeoutId);
      reject(
        new Error(
          `Failed to ping content script: ${
            error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)
          }`
        )
      );
    }
  });
}

/**
 * Ping content script with retries and exponential backoff
 * @param tabId - Tab ID to ping
 * @param maxRetries - Maximum number of retries (default: 4, increased for stability)
 * @param initialDelayMs - Initial delay before first ping (default: 0)
 * @returns Promise that resolves if content script responds
 */
async function pingContentScriptWithRetry(
  tabId: number,
  maxRetries: number = 4,
  initialDelayMs: number = 0
): Promise<void> {
  let lastError: Error | null = null;

  // Initial delay to give content script time to initialize
  if (initialDelayMs > 0) {
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, initialDelayMs));
  }

  for (let attempt = 0; attempt <= maxRetries; attempt++) {
    try {
      await pingContentScript(tabId, 5000); // Use 5 second timeout per attempt
      logger.debug('Content script ping successful', {
        tabId,
        attempt: attempt + 1,
      });
      return; // Success
    } catch (error) {
      lastError = error as Error;
      if (attempt < maxRetries) {
        // Exponential backoff: 200ms, 400ms, 800ms, 1600ms, 3200ms
        const delayMs = Math.min(200 * Math.pow(2, attempt), 5000);
        logger.debug('Content script ping failed, retrying', {
          tabId,
          attempt: attempt + 1,
          maxRetries: maxRetries + 1,
          delayMs,
          error: lastError.message,
        });
        await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, delayMs));
      }
    }
  }

  // All retries exhausted
  throw new Error(
    `Content script not ready after ${maxRetries + 1} attempts: ${lastError?.message ?? 'Unknown error'}`
  );
}

// Cache ping results per tab to avoid repeated pings
const pingCache = new Map<number, { timestamp: number; ready: boolean }>();
const PING_CACHE_TTL_MS = 5000; // Cache ping result for 5 seconds

/**
 * Normalize URL for comparison purposes
 * Handles protocol differences, trailing slashes, query parameters, and hash routing
 * @param url - URL to normalize
 * @param options - Normalization options
 * @returns Normalized URL string
 */
function normalizeUrlForComparison(
  url: string,
  options: { removeQueryParams?: boolean; removeHash?: boolean } = {}
): string {
  if (!url || url.length === 0) {
    return '';
  }

  try {
    // Handle relative URLs or URLs without protocol
    let fullUrl = url.trim();
    if (!fullUrl.startsWith('http://') && !fullUrl.startsWith('https://')) {
      fullUrl = `https://${fullUrl}`;
    }

    const urlObj = new URL(fullUrl);

    // Normalize protocol (treat http/https as same for comparison)
    const protocol = 'https'; // Always use https for comparison

    // Normalize hostname (lowercase)
    const hostname = urlObj.hostname.toLowerCase();

    // Normalize pathname (remove trailing slash except root)
    // Note: For hash-based routing (SPA), the pathname might be just "/" 
    // and the route is in the hash, so we preserve the root slash
    let pathname = urlObj.pathname;
    if (pathname.length > 1 && pathname.endsWith('/') && !urlObj.hash) {
      // Only remove trailing slash if there's no hash fragment
      // If there's a hash, the trailing slash might be intentional for routing
      pathname = pathname.slice(0, -1);
    } else if (pathname.length > 1 && pathname.endsWith('/') && urlObj.hash) {
      // For hash-based routing, check if the pathname is just "/" 
      // If it's longer, remove trailing slash before hash
      if (pathname !== '/') {
        pathname = pathname.slice(0, -1);
      }
    }

    // Preserve hash (critical for SPA routing like #!/app/...) unless explicitly removed
    const hash = options.removeHash ? '' : urlObj.hash;

    // Normalize query params (sort for consistent comparison) unless explicitly removed
    let queryString = '';
    if (!options.removeQueryParams) {
      const searchParams = new URLSearchParams(urlObj.search);
      const sortedParams = Array.from(searchParams.entries())
        .sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b))
        .map(([k, v]) => `${k}=${v}`)
        .join('&');
      queryString = sortedParams ? `?${sortedParams}` : '';
    }

    // Reconstruct normalized URL
    const normalized = `${protocol}://${hostname}${pathname}${hash}${queryString}`;

    return normalized;
  } catch (error) {
    // Fallback to original URL if parsing fails (with basic normalization)
    logger.warn('URL normalization failed, using fallback', {
      url,
      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
    });
    return url.toLowerCase().trim();
  }
}

/**
 * Check if URLs match using various strategies including partial matching
 * @param currentUrl - Current page URL
 * @param targetUrl - Target URL to match against
 * @returns Object with match results and details
 */
function checkUrlMatch(
  currentUrl: string,
  targetUrl: string
): {
  exactMatch: boolean;
  normalizedMatch: boolean;
  partialMatch: boolean;
  hashMatch: boolean;
  pathnameHashMatch: boolean;
  isMatch: boolean;
  matchType?: string;
} {
  if (!currentUrl || currentUrl.length === 0) {
    return {
      exactMatch: false,
      normalizedMatch: false,
      partialMatch: false,
      hashMatch: false,
      pathnameHashMatch: false,
      isMatch: false,
    };
  }

  // Exact match
  const exactMatch = currentUrl === targetUrl;

  // Normalized exact match (with query params)
  const normalizedCurrent = normalizeUrlForComparison(currentUrl);
  const normalizedTarget = normalizeUrlForComparison(targetUrl);
  const normalizedMatch = normalizedCurrent === normalizedTarget;

  // Normalized match without query params (for partial matching)
  const normalizedCurrentNoQuery = normalizeUrlForComparison(currentUrl, {
    removeQueryParams: true,
  });
  const normalizedTargetNoQuery = normalizeUrlForComparison(targetUrl, {
    removeQueryParams: true,
  });
  const normalizedMatchNoQuery =
    normalizedCurrentNoQuery === normalizedTargetNoQuery;

  // Partial match: check if target URL is contained in current URL or vice versa
  // This helps with URLs that have additional query parameters or fragments
  const partialMatch =
    normalizedCurrent.includes(normalizedTarget) ||
    normalizedTarget.includes(normalizedCurrent) ||
    normalizedCurrentNoQuery.includes(normalizedTargetNoQuery) ||
    normalizedTargetNoQuery.includes(normalizedCurrentNoQuery);

  // Hash-based route matching (for SPAs)
  // Extract hash portions and compare them
  let hashMatch = false;
  let pathnameHashMatch = false;
  try {
    const currentUrlObj = new URL(
      currentUrl.startsWith('http') ? currentUrl : `https://${currentUrl}`
    );
    const targetUrlObj = new URL(
      targetUrl.startsWith('http') ? targetUrl : `https://${targetUrl}`
    );

    const currentHash = currentUrlObj.hash.toLowerCase();
    const targetHash = targetUrlObj.hash.toLowerCase();

    // If both have hashes, check if they match
    if (currentHash && targetHash) {
      hashMatch = currentHash === targetHash;
      // Also check if target hash is contained in current hash (for partial hash matching)
      if (!hashMatch) {
        hashMatch =
          currentHash.includes(targetHash) || targetHash.includes(currentHash);
      }
    }

    // Match based on pathname + hash (ignoring query params)
    // This is useful for SPA routes where query params might vary
    const currentPathnameHash = `${currentUrlObj.pathname}${currentHash}`;
    const targetPathnameHash = `${targetUrlObj.pathname}${targetHash}`;
    pathnameHashMatch = currentPathnameHash === targetPathnameHash;
  } catch {
    // If URL parsing fails, hash matching won't work
  }

  // Determine overall match
  const isMatch =
    exactMatch ||
    normalizedMatch ||
    normalizedMatchNoQuery ||
    partialMatch ||
    hashMatch ||
    pathnameHashMatch;

  // Determine match type for logging
  let matchType: string | undefined;
  if (exactMatch) {
    matchType = 'exact';
  } else if (normalizedMatch) {
    matchType = 'normalized';
  } else if (normalizedMatchNoQuery) {
    matchType = 'normalized_no_query';
  } else if (hashMatch) {
    matchType = 'hash';
  } else if (pathnameHashMatch) {
    matchType = 'pathname_hash';
  } else if (partialMatch) {
    matchType = 'partial';
  }

  return {
    exactMatch,
    normalizedMatch,
    partialMatch,
    hashMatch,
    pathnameHashMatch,
    isMatch,
    matchType,
  };
}

async function waitForUrlMatch(
  tabId: number,
  targetUrl: string,
  timeoutMs: number = 3000,
  pollIntervalMs: number = 250,
  logNavigation?: (
    level: 'info' | 'debug' | 'warn' | 'error',
    message: string,
    metadata?: Record<string, unknown>
  ) => void
): Promise<boolean> {
  const startTime = Date.now();
  const logNav = (level: 'info' | 'debug' | 'warn' | 'error', message: string, metadata?: Record<string, unknown>) => {
    logger[level](message, metadata);
    if (logNavigation) {
      logNavigation(level, message, metadata);
    }
  };

  logNav('debug', 'Waiting for URL match', {
    tabId,
    targetUrl,
    timeoutMs,
    pollIntervalMs,
  });

  while (Date.now() - startTime < timeoutMs) {
    const tab = await chrome.tabs.get(tabId);
    const lastError = chrome.runtime.lastError as
      | chrome.runtime.LastError
      | undefined;
    if (lastError != null) {
      throw new Error(`Failed to get tab while waiting for URL match: ${lastError.message}`);
    }

    const currentUrl = typeof tab.url === 'string' ? tab.url : '';
    const matchResults = checkUrlMatch(currentUrl, targetUrl);
    if (matchResults.isMatch) {
      logNav('info', 'Target URL match detected', {
        tabId,
        currentUrl,
        targetUrl,
        matchType: matchResults.matchType,
        elapsedMs: Date.now() - startTime,
      });
      return true;
    }

    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, pollIntervalMs));
  }

  logNav('warn', 'Target URL match not detected within timeout', {
    tabId,
    targetUrl,
    timeoutMs,
  });
  return false;
}

/**
 * Wait for navigation to complete on a tab
 * @param tabId - Tab ID to monitor
 * @param targetUrl - Expected URL after navigation (optional, for validation)
 * @param timeoutMs - Timeout in milliseconds (default: 10000)
 * @returns Promise that resolves when navigation completes
 */
async function waitForNavigationComplete(
  tabId: number,
  targetUrl?: string,
  timeoutMs: number = 10000,
  logNavigation?: (
    level: 'info' | 'debug' | 'warn' | 'error',
    message: string,
    metadata?: Record<string, unknown>
  ) => void
): Promise<void> {
  const startTime = Date.now();
  const logNav = (level: 'info' | 'debug' | 'warn' | 'error', message: string, metadata?: Record<string, unknown>) => {
    logger[level](message, metadata);
    if (logNavigation) {
      logNavigation(level, message, metadata);
    }
  };
  
  logNav('info', 'Starting navigation completion wait', {
    tabId,
    targetUrl,
    timeoutMs,
    startTime,
  });

  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
      const elapsedMs = Date.now() - startTime;
      logger.warn('Navigation completion timeout reached', {
        tabId,
        targetUrl,
        timeoutMs,
        elapsedMs,
      });
      chrome.tabs.onUpdated.removeListener(listener);
      chrome.tabs.onRemoved.removeListener(removedListener);
      // Check if tab still exists before reporting timeout
      chrome.tabs.get(tabId, tab => {
        const lastError = chrome.runtime.lastError as
          | chrome.runtime.LastError
          | undefined;
        if (lastError != null) {
          logNav('error', 'Tab not found during timeout check', {
            tabId,
            targetUrl,
            timeoutMs,
            elapsedMs,
            error: lastError.message,
          });
          reject(
            new Error(
              `Navigation timeout: Tab ${tabId} was closed or removed during navigation.`
            )
          );
        } else {
          const currentUrl = tab.url ?? 'unknown';
          const tabStatus = tab.status;
          const tabLoading = tab.loading;
          logNav('error', 'Navigation timeout - tab still exists', {
            tabId,
            targetUrl,
            currentUrl,
            tabStatus,
            tabLoading,
            timeoutMs,
            elapsedMs,
            urlComparison: targetUrl
              ? {
                  expected: targetUrl,
                  actual: currentUrl,
                  normalizedExpected: normalizeUrlForComparison(targetUrl),
                  normalizedActual: normalizeUrlForComparison(currentUrl),
                }
              : undefined,
          });
          reject(
            new Error(
              `Navigation timeout after ${timeoutMs}ms. Tab may not have navigated or is still loading. Current URL: ${currentUrl}, Status: ${tabStatus}, Loading: ${tabLoading}`
            )
          );
        }
      });
    }, timeoutMs);

    // Handle tab removal (tab closed during navigation)
    const removedListener = (removedTabId: number) => {
      if (removedTabId === tabId) {
        clearTimeout(timeoutId);
        chrome.tabs.onUpdated.removeListener(listener);
        chrome.tabs.onRemoved.removeListener(removedListener);
        reject(
          new Error(
            `Navigation failed: Tab ${tabId} was closed during navigation.`
          )
        );
      }
    };

    // Set up one-time listener for tab updates
    const listener = (updatedTabId: number, changeInfo: any, tab: any) => {
      // Only process updates for the target tab
      if (updatedTabId !== tabId) {
        return;
      }

      const elapsedMs = Date.now() - startTime;
      logNav('debug', 'Tab update event received', {
        tabId,
        changeInfo,
        tabUrl: tab.url,
        tabStatus: tab.status,
        tabLoading: tab.loading,
        elapsedMs,
        targetUrl,
      });

      // Check if navigation is complete
      if (changeInfo.status === 'complete') {
        logNav('info', 'Tab status changed to complete', {
          tabId,
          tabUrl: tab.url,
          tabStatus: tab.status,
          elapsedMs,
          targetUrl,
        });
        // If target URL provided, validate it matches using normalized comparison
        if (targetUrl !== null && targetUrl !== undefined && targetUrl !== '') {
          const currentUrl = tab.url;
          if (currentUrl !== null && currentUrl !== undefined) {
            // Use normalized URL comparison for robust matching
            const normalizedCurrent = normalizeUrlForComparison(currentUrl);
            const normalizedTarget = normalizeUrlForComparison(targetUrl);
            const normalizedMatch = normalizedCurrent === normalizedTarget;
            const normalizedMatchWithoutQuery =
              normalizedCurrent.split('?')[0] ===
              normalizedTarget.split('?')[0];

            if (!normalizedMatch && !normalizedMatchWithoutQuery) {
              // URL doesn't match, but navigation completed - log warning but continue
              logNav('warn', 'Navigation completed but URL mismatch detected', {
                tabId,
                expected: targetUrl,
                actual: currentUrl,
                normalizedExpected: normalizedTarget,
                normalizedActual: normalizedCurrent,
                normalizedMatch,
                normalizedMatchWithoutQuery,
                elapsedMs,
                urlComponents: {
                  expected: {
                    protocol: targetUrl.split('://')[0],
                    hostname: targetUrl.split('://')[1]?.split('/')[0],
                    pathname: targetUrl.split('?')[0]?.split('#')[0],
                    hash: targetUrl.includes('#')
                      ? targetUrl.split('#')[1]
                      : undefined,
                  },
                  actual: {
                    protocol: currentUrl.split('://')[0],
                    hostname: currentUrl.split('://')[1]?.split('/')[0],
                    pathname: currentUrl.split('?')[0]?.split('#')[0],
                    hash: currentUrl.includes('#')
                      ? currentUrl.split('#')[1]
                      : undefined,
                  },
                },
              });
            } else {
              logNav('info', 'Navigation completed with URL match', {
                tabId,
                expected: targetUrl,
                actual: currentUrl,
                normalizedExpected: normalizedTarget,
                normalizedActual: normalizedCurrent,
                normalizedMatch,
                normalizedMatchWithoutQuery,
                elapsedMs,
                matchType: normalizedMatch
                  ? 'normalized'
                  : normalizedMatchWithoutQuery
                    ? 'normalizedWithoutQuery'
                    : 'unknown',
              });
            }
          } else {
            logNav('info', 'Navigation completed (no target URL validation)', {
              tabId,
              actualUrl: tab.url,
              elapsedMs,
            });
          }
        }

        // Navigation complete
        const totalElapsedMs = Date.now() - startTime;
        clearTimeout(timeoutId);
        chrome.tabs.onUpdated.removeListener(listener);
        chrome.tabs.onRemoved.removeListener(removedListener);
        logNav('info', 'Navigation completion resolved successfully', {
          tabId,
          finalUrl: tab.url,
          elapsedMs: totalElapsedMs,
          targetUrl,
        });
        resolve();
      }
    };

    chrome.tabs.onUpdated.addListener(listener);
    chrome.tabs.onRemoved.addListener(removedListener);

    // Also check current tab state immediately (in case navigation already completed)
    logNav('debug', 'Checking initial tab state', { tabId, targetUrl });
    chrome.tabs.get(tabId, tab => {
      const lastError = chrome.runtime.lastError as
        | chrome.runtime.LastError
        | undefined;
      if (lastError != null) {
        logNav('error', 'Failed to get tab for initial state check', {
          tabId,
          targetUrl,
          error: lastError.message,
        });
        clearTimeout(timeoutId);
        chrome.tabs.onUpdated.removeListener(listener);
        chrome.tabs.onRemoved.removeListener(removedListener);
        reject(
          new Error(
            `Failed to get tab: ${lastError.message}. Tab may have been closed.`
          )
        );
        return;
      }

      logNav('debug', 'Initial tab state retrieved', {
        tabId,
        tabUrl: tab.url,
        tabStatus: tab.status,
        tabLoading: tab.loading,
        targetUrl,
      });

      if (tab.status === 'complete') {
        // Already complete, resolve immediately
        const elapsedMs = Date.now() - startTime;
        logNav('info', 'Tab already in complete state - resolving immediately', {
          tabId,
          tabUrl: tab.url,
          elapsedMs,
          targetUrl,
          urlMatch: targetUrl
            ? {
                expected: targetUrl,
                actual: tab.url,
                normalizedExpected: normalizeUrlForComparison(targetUrl),
                normalizedActual: tab.url
                  ? normalizeUrlForComparison(tab.url)
                  : undefined,
              }
            : undefined,
        });
        clearTimeout(timeoutId);
        chrome.tabs.onUpdated.removeListener(listener);
        chrome.tabs.onRemoved.removeListener(removedListener);
        resolve();
      } else {
        logNav('debug', 'Tab not yet complete, waiting for status change', {
          tabId,
          tabStatus: tab.status,
          tabLoading: tab.loading,
          targetUrl,
        });
      }
    });
  });
}

/**
 * Ensure content script is injected if it's not available
 * @param tabId - Tab ID to check/inject
 * @param contentScriptPath - Path to content script file (defaults to 'content.js')
 * @returns Promise that resolves when content script is ready
 */
async function ensureContentScriptInjected(
  tabId: number,
  contentScriptPath: string = 'content.js'
): Promise<void> {
  // First try a quick ping to see if content script is already there
  try {
    await pingContentScript(tabId, 1000);
    return; // Content script is ready
  } catch (error) {
    const errorMessage = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
    
    // Check if the error indicates content script is not injected
    // "Receiving end does not exist" means no listener is registered
    if (
      errorMessage.includes('Receiving end does not exist') ||
      errorMessage.includes('Could not establish connection')
    ) {
      // Try to inject content script if chrome.scripting is available
      if (chrome.scripting?.executeScript) {
        try {
          logger.debug('Content script not found, attempting to inject', {
            tabId,
            contentScriptPath,
          });
          // Note: This assumes content script is registered in manifest
          // If not, the injection will fail and we'll fall back to waiting
          // The content script should be auto-injected via manifest, but sometimes
          // for already-loaded pages it might not be there yet
          await chrome.scripting.executeScript({
            target: { tabId },
            files: [contentScriptPath],
          });
          // Wait for script to initialize - longer delay for content.iife.js which may be larger
          const initDelay = contentScriptPath.includes('iife') ? 500 : 200;
          await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, initDelay));
          logger.debug('Content script injection attempted', { tabId, contentScriptPath, initDelay });
          
          // Try to verify injection worked by pinging once
          try {
            await pingContentScript(tabId, 1000);
            logger.debug('Content script verified ready after injection', { tabId, contentScriptPath });
          } catch (verifyError) {
            logger.debug('Content script not immediately ready after injection, will retry', {
              tabId,
              contentScriptPath,
              error: verifyError instanceof Error ? verifyError.message : String(verifyError),
            });
          }
        } catch (injectError) {
          // Injection might fail if script is already injected or path is wrong
          // This is okay - we'll proceed with retry logic
          logger.debug('Content script injection attempt failed (may already be injected)', {
            tabId,
            contentScriptPath,
            error: injectError instanceof Error ? injectError.message : String(injectError),
          });
        }
      }
    }
    
    // Re-throw to trigger retry logic
    throw error;
  }
}

/**
 * Check if content script is ready (with caching)
 * @param tabId - Tab ID to check
 * @param allowCache - Whether to use cached results (default: true)
 * @param initialDelayMs - Initial delay before first ping (default: 0)
 * @param injectIfMissing - Whether to try injecting content script if not found (default: false)
 * @param contentScriptPath - Path to content script file (defaults to 'content.js')
 */
async function ensureContentScriptReady(
  tabId: number,
  allowCache: boolean = true,
  initialDelayMs: number = 0,
  injectIfMissing: boolean = false,
  contentScriptPath: string = 'content.js'
): Promise<void> {
  const cached = pingCache.get(tabId);
  const now = Date.now();

  // Use cached result if still valid and caching is allowed
  if (
    allowCache &&
    cached !== undefined &&
    cached.ready === true &&
    now - cached.timestamp < PING_CACHE_TTL_MS
  ) {
    logger.debug('Using cached content script ready status', { tabId });
    return;
  }

  // If injection is requested and first ping fails, try to inject
  if (injectIfMissing) {
    try {
      await ensureContentScriptInjected(tabId, contentScriptPath);
    } catch {
      // If injection attempt fails, proceed with retry logic
    }
  }

  // Ping with retry (increased retries for stability)
  // Use longer timeout and more retries for post-navigation scenarios
  await pingContentScriptWithRetry(tabId, 6, initialDelayMs);

  // Cache successful ping
  pingCache.set(tabId, { timestamp: now, ready: true });
}

/**
 * Checkpoint storage key prefix
 */
const CHECKPOINT_PREFIX = 'checkpoint:';

function isStorageQuotaError(error: unknown): boolean {
  if (!error) {
    return false;
  }
  const message =
    error instanceof Error
      ? error.message
      : typeof error === 'string'
        ? error
        : JSON.stringify(error);
  return /quota/i.test(message) || message.includes('kQuotaBytes');
}

// Simple write queue to serialize concurrent checkpoint saves (and their hooks).
let writeQueue: Promise<void> = Promise.resolve();

/**
 * Save checkpoint to chrome.storage.local
 * IMPORTANT: Hooks are ALWAYS called regardless of storage success
 * This ensures postings are captured even if storage has contention issues
 */
async function saveCheckpointToStorage(
  checkpointId: string,
  metadata: Record<string, unknown>,
  hooks?: ContentRuntimeHooks,
  stateContext?: RecipeStateContext
): Promise<void> {
  const key = `${CHECKPOINT_PREFIX}${checkpointId}`;
  const checkpointPayload = {
    id: checkpointId,
    savedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    recipeKey: stateContext?.recipeKey,
    correlationId: stateContext?.correlationId,
    ...metadata,
  };
  
  let stored = false;
  let storageError: Error | null = null;
  
  // Serialize storage writes and hooks to avoid contention + overlapping hook calls.
  writeQueue = writeQueue
    .then(async () => {
      try {
        await chrome.storage.local.set({
          [key]: checkpointPayload,
        });
        stored = true;
        logger.info('Checkpoint saved to storage', {
          checkpointId,
          metadataKeys: Object.keys(metadata),
        });
      } catch (error) {
        const isQuota = isStorageQuotaError(error);
        if (checkpointId.startsWith('job-') && isQuota) {
          logger.warn('Checkpoint storage quota exceeded - skipping persistence', {
            checkpointId,
            error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
          });
        } else {
          storageError = error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error));
          logger.warn('Checkpoint storage failed - will still call hook', {
            checkpointId,
            error: storageError.message,
          });
        }
      }

      // Save single-state file and cleanup old checkpoints for this execution.
      try {
        await RecipeStateManager.saveState(
          stateContext ?? {},
          checkpointId,
          checkpointPayload
        );
      } catch (error) {
        logger.warn('Checkpoint state save failed', error as Error, {
          checkpointId,
        });
      }

      // ALWAYS call hooks regardless of storage success.
      // This ensures postings are captured even with storage contention.
      if (hooks?.onCheckpointSaved) {
        try {
          await hooks.onCheckpointSaved(checkpointId, checkpointPayload);
        } catch (error) {
          logger.warn('Checkpoint hook failed', error as Error, { checkpointId, stored });
        }
      }
    })
    .catch((error) => {
      logger.warn('Write queue error', { checkpointId, error });
    });
  
  // Wait for storage + hook operation
  await writeQueue;
  
  // Throw storage error after hook is called, but only for non-quota errors
  if (storageError && !isStorageQuotaError(storageError)) {
    throw storageError;
  }
}

/**
 * Restore checkpoint from chrome.storage.local
 */
async function restoreCheckpointFromStorage(
  checkpointId: string,
  stateContext?: RecipeStateContext
): Promise<Record<string, unknown> | null> {
  try {
    const state = await RecipeStateManager.loadState(stateContext ?? {});
    if (state && state.checkpointId === checkpointId) {
      logger.info('Checkpoint restored from state file', { checkpointId });
      return state.checkpoint as Record<string, unknown>;
    }

    const key = `${CHECKPOINT_PREFIX}${checkpointId}`;
    const result = await chrome.storage.local.get(key);
    const checkpoint = result[key];
    if (checkpoint !== undefined && checkpoint !== null) {
      logger.info('Checkpoint restored', { checkpointId });
      return checkpoint as Record<string, unknown>;
    }
    logger.debug('Checkpoint not found', { checkpointId });
    return null;
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Failed to restore checkpoint', error as Error, {
      checkpointId,
    });
    throw error;
  }
}

export function createContentRuntime(
  tabId: number,
  config: ContentRuntimeConfig
): FlowRuntime {
  const { dependencies, hooks, ...context } = config;
  const onNavigationLog = hooks?.onNavigationLog;
  const onArtifactCaptured = hooks?.onArtifactCaptured;
  const {
    captureHtml: downloadCaptureHtml,
    saveUrl: downloadSaveUrl,
    ensureFolder: downloadEnsureFolder,
    validateFolderExists: downloadValidateFolderExists,
    validateFileExists: downloadValidateFileExists,
    getBaseDownloadFolder,
    contentScriptPath = 'content.js',
  } = dependencies;

  // Runtime variables storage
  const variables: Record<string, unknown> = context?.variables ?? {};

  // Base download folder - use baseFolder variable if set, otherwise use context or default
  // This allows recipes to override the base folder with their own variable
  const baseFolder =
    typeof variables.baseFolder === 'string' && variables.baseFolder
      ? variables.baseFolder
      : (context?.baseDownloadFolder ?? getBaseDownloadFolder());
  const recipeKey = context?.recipeKey;
  const correlationId = context?.correlationId;

  // Make tabId mutable so we can switch to a new tab if content script injection fails
  let currentTabId = tabId;

  // Helper to log navigation events both to console and to sidepanel
  const logNavigation = (
    level: 'info' | 'debug' | 'warn' | 'error',
    message: string,
    metadata?: Record<string, unknown>
  ): void => {
    // Log to console using the logger
    logger[level](message, metadata);
    // Also send to sidepanel if hook is provided
    if (onNavigationLog) {
      const result = onNavigationLog(level, message, metadata);
      if (result instanceof Promise) {
        result.catch((error: unknown) => {
          // Don't fail navigation if log sending fails
          logger.debug('Failed to send navigation log to sidepanel', {
            error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
          });
        });
      }
    }
  };

  const summarizeExecArgs = (
    fn: string,
    args: Record<string, unknown>
  ): Record<string, unknown> => {
    const summary: Record<string, unknown> = {
      fn,
      argKeys: Object.keys(args),
    };

    if (args.locator && typeof args.locator === 'object') {
      const locator = args.locator as {
        by?: unknown;
        selector?: unknown;
        role?: unknown;
        name?: unknown;
      };
      summary.locator = {
        by: locator.by,
        selector:
          typeof locator.selector === 'string'
            ? locator.selector.slice(0, 220)
            : locator.selector,
        role: locator.role,
        name: locator.name,
      };
    }

    if (fn === 'waitFor' && args.state !== undefined) {
      summary.state = args.state;
    }

    if (args.loopIndex !== undefined) {
      summary.loopIndex = args.loopIndex;
    }

    return summary;
  };

  const getTabSnapshot = async (
    targetTabId: number
  ): Promise<Record<string, unknown>> => {
    try {
      const tab = await chrome.tabs.get(targetTabId);
      return {
        id: tab.id,
        active: tab.active,
        status: tab.status,
        discarded: tab.discarded,
        audible: tab.audible,
        muted: tab.mutedInfo?.muted,
        title: tab.title,
        url:
          typeof tab.url === 'string' && tab.url.length > 0
            ? tab.url
            : '(empty)',
      };
    } catch (snapshotError) {
      return {
        id: targetTabId,
        snapshotError:
          snapshotError instanceof Error
            ? snapshotError.message
            : String(snapshotError),
      };
    }
  };

  const isRecoverableExecError = (errorMessage: string): boolean => {
    const normalized = errorMessage.toLowerCase();
    return (
      normalized.includes('message channel may have closed') ||
      normalized.includes('message channel closed') ||
      normalized.includes('back/forward cache') ||
      normalized.includes('asynchronous response by returning true') ||
      normalized.includes('could not establish connection')
    );
  };

  const exec = <T = unknown>(
    fn: string,
    args: Record<string, unknown> = {}
  ): Promise<T> => {
    const retryAttempt =
      typeof args.__runtimeExecAttempt === 'number'
        ? (args.__runtimeExecAttempt as number)
        : 0;
    const requestArgs: Record<string, unknown> = { ...args };
    delete requestArgs.__runtimeExecAttempt;

    const withTimeout = async <U>(
      promise: Promise<U>,
      timeoutMs: number,
      phase: string
    ): Promise<U> => {
      return await Promise.race([
        promise,
        new Promise<never>((_, reject) => {
          setTimeout(() => {
            reject(
              new Error(`${phase} timed out after ${timeoutMs}ms`)
            );
          }, timeoutMs);
        }),
      ]);
    };

    // Ensure content script is ready before sending messages
    // Prefer a fast cached readiness check first, then bounded recovery preflight.
    return withTimeout(
      ensureContentScriptReady(currentTabId, true, 0, false, contentScriptPath),
      4000,
      'Content-script preflight'
    )
      .catch(async error => {
        logger.warn(
          'Content script not ready in fast preflight, attempting recovery preflight',
          {
            tabId: currentTabId,
            fn,
            error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
          }
        );
        return await withTimeout(
          ensureContentScriptReady(
            currentTabId,
            false,
            250,
            true,
            contentScriptPath
          ),
          7000,
          'Content-script recovery preflight'
        );
      })
      .then(() => {
        // Verify tab is still valid before sending message
        return new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
          chrome.tabs.get(currentTabId, tab => {
            const lastError = chrome.runtime.lastError as
              | chrome.runtime.LastError
              | undefined;
            if (lastError != null) {
              reject(
                new Error(
                  `Tab ${currentTabId} is no longer valid: ${lastError.message}`
                )
              );
              return;
            }
            if (
              tab === undefined ||
              tab === null ||
              typeof tab.url !== 'string' ||
              tab.url.length === 0
            ) {
              reject(new Error(`Tab ${currentTabId} is invalid or has no URL`));
              return;
            }
            resolve();
          });
        });
      })
      .then(() => {
        // Use callback-based API for better error handling
        return new Promise<T>((resolve, reject) => {
          const messageTimeoutMs = (() => {
            if (fn === 'waitFor') {
              const state = requestArgs.state as
                | { timeoutMs?: unknown }
                | undefined;
              const requestedTimeout =
                state !== undefined &&
                typeof state.timeoutMs === 'number' &&
                Number.isFinite(state.timeoutMs)
                  ? Math.max(0, state.timeoutMs)
                  : 0;
              if (requestedTimeout > 0) {
                return Math.max(30000, requestedTimeout + 5000);
              }
            }

            if (fn === 'waitForPagination') {
              const requestedTimeout =
                typeof requestArgs.timeout === 'number' &&
                Number.isFinite(requestArgs.timeout)
                  ? Math.max(0, requestArgs.timeout)
                  : 0;
              if (requestedTimeout > 0) {
                return Math.max(30000, requestedTimeout + 5000);
              }
            }

            return 30000;
          })();

          const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
            reject(
              new Error(
                `Recipe execution timeout for ${fn} after ${Math.round(
                  messageTimeoutMs / 1000
                )} seconds. The message channel may have closed.`
              )
            );
          }, messageTimeoutMs);

          try {
            chrome.tabs.sendMessage(
              currentTabId,
              {
                type: 'RECIPE_EXEC',
                fn,
                args: requestArgs,
              },
              (response: T | undefined) => {
                clearTimeout(timeoutId);

                // Check for runtime errors (channel closed, tab closed, etc.)
                const lastError = chrome.runtime.lastError as
                  | chrome.runtime.LastError
                  | undefined;
                if (lastError != null) {
                  const errorMsg = lastError.message;
                  // Clear cache on error
                  pingCache.delete(currentTabId);
                  reject(
                    new Error(
                      `Content script communication failed: ${errorMsg}. This may occur if the page navigated or the tab was closed.`
                    )
                  );
                  return;
                }

                // Check if response indicates an error
                const responseObject =
                  response !== null &&
                  response !== undefined &&
                  typeof response === 'object'
                    ? (response as { ok?: boolean; error?: string })
                    : null;
                if (responseObject !== null && responseObject.ok === false) {
                  const errorMsg = responseObject.error ?? 'Unknown error';
                  reject(new Error(`Recipe step failed: ${errorMsg}`));
                  return;
                }

                // Success
                resolve(response as T);
              }
            );
          } catch (error) {
            clearTimeout(timeoutId);
            pingCache.delete(currentTabId);
            reject(
              new Error(
                `Failed to send message to content script: ${
                  error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)
                }`
              )
            );
          }
        });
      })
      .catch(async error => {
        // Clear cache on error
        pingCache.delete(currentTabId);
        const errorMessage = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);

        if (retryAttempt < 1 && isRecoverableExecError(errorMessage)) {
          logger.warn('Recoverable content script communication error, retrying once', {
            tabId: currentTabId,
            fn,
            retryAttempt,
            error: errorMessage,
          });
          try {
            await ensureContentScriptReady(
              currentTabId,
              false,
              500,
              true,
              contentScriptPath
            );
          } catch (retryPrepError) {
            logger.debug('Retry preflight failed; retrying exec anyway', {
              tabId: currentTabId,
              fn,
              error:
                retryPrepError instanceof Error
                  ? retryPrepError.message
                  : String(retryPrepError),
            });
          }

          return exec<T>(fn, {
            ...requestArgs,
            __runtimeExecAttempt: retryAttempt + 1,
          });
        }

        const tabSnapshot = await getTabSnapshot(currentTabId);
        logger.error('Content script communication failed', error as Error, {
          tabId: currentTabId,
          fn,
          execArgs: summarizeExecArgs(fn, requestArgs),
          tabSnapshot,
        });
        throw error;
      });
  };

  return {
    goto: async (url: string): Promise<void> => {
      const startTime = Date.now();
      logNavigation('info', 'Navigation step starting', {
        tabId: currentTabId,
        targetUrl: url,
        step: 'goto',
        timestamp: startTime,
      });

      // Check current tab URL to see if we're already on the target page
      const checkStartTime = Date.now();
      logNavigation('debug', 'Checking current tab URL', { tabId: currentTabId });
      const currentTab = await chrome.tabs.get(currentTabId);
      const checkDuration = Date.now() - checkStartTime;

      const lastError = chrome.runtime.lastError as
        | chrome.runtime.LastError
        | undefined;
      if (lastError != null) {
        logNavigation('error', 'Failed to get current tab', {
          tabId: currentTabId,
          targetUrl: url,
          error: lastError.message,
        });
        throw new Error(`Failed to get tab: ${lastError.message}`);
      }

      const currentUrl =
        typeof currentTab.url === 'string' ? currentTab.url : '';
      const tabStatus = currentTab.status;
      const tabLoading = currentTab.loading;

      logNavigation('info', 'Current tab state retrieved', {
        tabId: currentTabId,
        currentUrl,
        tabStatus,
        tabLoading,
        checkDurationMs: checkDuration,
      });

      // Normalize URLs for robust comparison
      logNavigation('debug', 'Normalizing URLs for comparison', {
        tabId: currentTabId,
        currentUrl,
        targetUrl: url,
      });
      const normalizedCurrent = normalizeUrlForComparison(currentUrl);
      const normalizedTarget = normalizeUrlForComparison(url);

      // Check if already on target URL using multiple comparison strategies
      // This includes exact match, normalized match, partial match, and hash-based matching
      const matchResults = checkUrlMatch(currentUrl, url);
      const isAlreadyOnTargetUrl = matchResults.isMatch;

      logNavigation('info', 'URL comparison results', {
        tabId: currentTabId,
        currentUrl,
        targetUrl: url,
        normalizedCurrent,
        normalizedTarget,
        comparisonResults: {
          exactMatch: matchResults.exactMatch,
          normalizedMatch: matchResults.normalizedMatch,
          partialMatch: matchResults.partialMatch,
          hashMatch: matchResults.hashMatch,
          pathnameHashMatch: matchResults.pathnameHashMatch,
          isAlreadyOnTargetUrl,
          matchType: matchResults.matchType,
        },
        urlComponents: {
          current: {
            protocol: currentUrl.split('://')[0],
            hostname: currentUrl.split('://')[1]?.split('/')[0],
            pathname: currentUrl.split('?')[0]?.split('#')[0],
            hash: currentUrl.includes('#')
              ? currentUrl.split('#')[1]
              : undefined,
            search: currentUrl.includes('?')
              ? currentUrl.split('?')[1]?.split('#')[0]
              : undefined,
          },
          target: {
            protocol: url.split('://')[0],
            hostname: url.split('://')[1]?.split('/')[0],
            pathname: url.split('?')[0]?.split('#')[0],
            hash: url.includes('#') ? url.split('#')[1] : undefined,
            search: url.includes('?') ? url.split('?')[1]?.split('#')[0] : undefined,
          },
        },
      });

      if (isAlreadyOnTargetUrl) {
        const totalDuration = Date.now() - startTime;
        logNavigation('info', 'Already on target URL, skipping navigation', {
          tabId: currentTabId,
          url,
          currentUrl,
          normalizedCurrent,
          normalizedTarget,
          matchType: matchResults.matchType,
          matchDetails: {
            exactMatch: matchResults.exactMatch,
            normalizedMatch: matchResults.normalizedMatch,
            partialMatch: matchResults.partialMatch,
            hashMatch: matchResults.hashMatch,
            pathnameHashMatch: matchResults.pathnameHashMatch,
          },
          checkDuration,
          totalDuration,
        });

        // When already on the page, ensure content script is ready.
        // This is critical for flows that start on the target URL.
        // Use longer timeouts and retries since the page is already loaded.
        try {
          logNavigation('debug', 'Checking content script readiness', {
            tabId: currentTabId,
            url,
          });
          // Clear cache to force fresh check when already on page
          pingCache.delete(currentTabId);
          // Use injectIfMissing=true to try injecting if not found
          // Use longer initial delay (500ms) to give page time to stabilize
          // Use more retries (8 instead of 6) for already-loaded pages
          await ensureContentScriptReady(currentTabId, false, 500, true, contentScriptPath);
          logNavigation('debug', 'Content script ready', { tabId: currentTabId, url });
        } catch (error) {
          pingCache.delete(currentTabId);
          logNavigation('warn', 'Content script not ready on already loaded page, retrying with injection', {
            tabId: currentTabId,
            url,
            error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
          });
          try {
            // Retry with injection attempt and longer delays
            await ensureContentScriptReady(currentTabId, false, 1000, true, contentScriptPath);
            logNavigation('debug', 'Content script ready after retry', {
              tabId: currentTabId,
              url,
            });
          } catch (retryError) {
            // Final attempt: try one more time with even longer delay
            // This handles cases where content script needs more time to initialize
            logNavigation('debug', 'Content script still not ready, final attempt with extended delay', {
              tabId: currentTabId,
              url,
              error:
                retryError instanceof Error
                  ? retryError.message
                  : String(retryError),
            });
            try {
              await ensureContentScriptReady(currentTabId, false, 2000, true, contentScriptPath);
              logNavigation('debug', 'Content script ready after final retry', {
                tabId: currentTabId,
                url,
              });
            } catch (finalError) {
              // If still not ready after all attempts, create a new tab and navigate there
              // This ensures content script will be properly injected on a fresh page load
              logNavigation('warn', 'Content script still not ready after all retries, creating new tab', {
                tabId: currentTabId,
                url,
                error:
                  finalError instanceof Error
                    ? finalError.message
                    : String(finalError),
              });
              
              try {
                // Create a new tab with the target URL
                const newTab = await new Promise<chrome.tabs.Tab>((resolve, reject) => {
                  chrome.tabs.create({ url, active: true }, (createdTab) => {
                    const lastError = chrome.runtime.lastError as
                      | chrome.runtime.LastError
                      | undefined;
                    if (lastError != null) {
                      reject(new Error(`Failed to create new tab: ${lastError.message}`));
                      return;
                    }
                    if (createdTab.id === null || createdTab.id === undefined) {
                      reject(new Error('Created tab has no ID'));
                      return;
                    }
                    resolve(createdTab);
                  });
                });

                logNavigation('info', 'New tab created for navigation', {
                  oldTabId: currentTabId,
                  newTabId: newTab.id,
                  url,
                });

                // Update current tab ID to the new tab
                currentTabId = newTab.id!;
                
                // Clear cache for the new tab
                pingCache.delete(newTab.id!);

                // Wait for navigation to complete in the new tab
                await waitForNavigationComplete(
                  currentTabId,
                  url,
                  15000, // 15 second timeout for new tab
                  logNavigation
                );

                // Wait for content script to be ready in the new tab
                logNavigation('info', 'Waiting for content script in new tab', {
                  tabId: currentTabId,
                  url,
                });
                await ensureContentScriptReady(currentTabId, false, 500, true, contentScriptPath);
                
                logNavigation('info', 'Content script ready in new tab', {
                  tabId: currentTabId,
                  url,
                });
              } catch (newTabError) {
                // If creating new tab fails, throw error
                const errorMessage =
                  newTabError instanceof Error
                    ? newTabError.message
                    : String(newTabError);
                logNavigation('error', 'Failed to create new tab for navigation', {
                  tabId: currentTabId,
                  url,
                  error: errorMessage,
                });
                throw new Error(
                  `Content script injection failed and new tab creation failed: ${errorMessage}`
                );
              }
            }
          }
        }

        // Navigation step complete - we're already on the page
        logNavigation('info', 'Navigation step complete (already on target URL)', {
          tabId,
          url,
          totalDuration,
        });
        return;
      }

      // Not on target URL - proceed with navigation
      logNavigation('info', 'URLs do not match, initiating navigation', {
        tabId,
        targetUrl: url,
        currentUrl,
        normalizedTarget,
        normalizedCurrent,
        comparisonResults: {
          exactMatch: matchResults.exactMatch,
          normalizedMatch: matchResults.normalizedMatch,
        },
        reason: 'Navigation required - URLs differ',
      });

      // Clear ping cache since content script will be re-injected after navigation
      pingCache.delete(currentTabId);
      logNavigation('debug', 'Cleared ping cache for tab', { tabId: currentTabId });

      try {
        // Navigate to the URL
        logNavigation('info', 'Calling chrome.tabs.update to navigate', {
          tabId: currentTabId,
          targetUrl: url,
          timestamp: Date.now(),
        });
        await chrome.tabs.update(currentTabId, { url });
        logNavigation('info', 'chrome.tabs.update completed successfully', {
          tabId: currentTabId,
          targetUrl: url,
          timestamp: Date.now(),
        });
      } catch (error) {
        const errorMessage =
          error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
        logNavigation('error', 'Failed to initiate navigation', {
          tabId: currentTabId,
          targetUrl: url,
          errorMessage,
        });
        throw new Error(
          `Failed to initiate navigation to ${url}: ${errorMessage}. Tab may have been closed or removed.`
        );
      }

      try {
        // Wait for navigation to complete
        logNavigation('info', 'Waiting for navigation to complete', {
          tabId: currentTabId,
          targetUrl: url,
          timeoutMs: 10000,
          timestamp: Date.now(),
        });
        await waitForNavigationComplete(currentTabId, url, 10000, logNavigation);
        logNavigation('info', 'Navigation completed successfully', {
          tabId: currentTabId,
          targetUrl: url,
          timestamp: Date.now(),
        });
      } catch (error) {
        const errorMessage =
          error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
        logNavigation('error', 'Navigation timeout or failure', {
          tabId: currentTabId,
          targetUrl: url,
          errorMessage,
        });
        // Check if tab still exists
        try {
          const tab = await chrome.tabs.get(currentTabId);
          const finalUrl = tab.url ?? 'unknown';
          const finalStatus = tab.status;
          logNavigation('error', 'Navigation timeout - tab still exists', {
            tabId: currentTabId,
            targetUrl: url,
            finalUrl,
            finalStatus,
            tabLoading: tab.loading,
            errorMessage,
          });
          throw new Error(
            `Navigation timeout: Tab navigated but did not reach target URL ${url} within 10 seconds. Current URL: ${finalUrl}, Status: ${finalStatus}. ${errorMessage}`
          );
        } catch (tabError) {
          const tabErrorMessage =
            tabError instanceof Error ? tabError.message : String(tabError);
          logNavigation('error', 'Navigation failed - tab may be closed', {
            tabId: currentTabId,
            targetUrl: url,
            tabError: tabErrorMessage,
            errorMessage,
          });
          throw new Error(
            `Navigation failed: Tab ${currentTabId} may have been closed or removed. ${errorMessage}. Tab error: ${tabErrorMessage}`
          );
        }
      }

      // Wait for content script to re-inject and be ready
      // Use fresh ping (cache was cleared) with retry logic
      logNavigation('info', 'Waiting for content script re-injection after navigation', {
        tabId: currentTabId,
        url,
      });
      try {
        // Give content script a moment to inject after navigation completes
        // Use a small delay and then check with retries
        await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 100));
        logNavigation('debug', 'Starting content script readiness check', {
          tabId: currentTabId,
          url,
        });
        await ensureContentScriptReady(currentTabId, false, 100, false, contentScriptPath);
        logNavigation('info', 'Content script ready after navigation', {
          tabId: currentTabId,
          url,
        });
      } catch (error) {
        const errorMessage =
          error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
        logNavigation('error', 'Content script injection failed after navigation', {
          tabId: currentTabId,
          url,
          errorMessage,
        });
        throw new Error(
          `Navigation succeeded but content script injection failed for ${url}: ${errorMessage}. The page may have blocked script injection or the extension may need to be reloaded.`
        );
      }

      logNavigation('info', 'Navigation and content script ready', { tabId: currentTabId, url });
    },
    waitFor: async (
      state:
        | 'load'
        | 'domcontentloaded'
        | 'networkidle'
        | { state: 'selector'; selector: Locator | Locator[]; timeoutMs?: number }
        | { state: 'notVisible'; selector: Locator | Locator[]; timeoutMs?: number }
    ): Promise<void> => {
      const waitForStartTime = Date.now();
      const stateDescription =
        typeof state === 'string'
          ? state
          : `${state.state}: ${JSON.stringify(state.selector)}`;
      
      logNavigation('info', 'WaitFor step starting', {
        tabId: currentTabId,
        state: stateDescription,
        timestamp: waitForStartTime,
      });

      // For 'load' and 'domcontentloaded' states, we can check readyState directly
      // without needing content script ping - this is faster and more reliable
      // when already on the page
      if (state === 'load' || state === 'domcontentloaded') {
        try {
          logNavigation('debug', 'Checking page readyState before waitFor', {
            tabId: currentTabId,
            state,
          });
          // Quick check: try to get readyState from content script without ping
          // This is fast and doesn't require content script to respond to ping
          const readyStateResponse = await exec<{
            ok: boolean;
            readyState?: string;
          }>('getReadyState', {}).catch(() => null); // Don't fail if content script isn't ready yet
          const readyState =
            readyStateResponse !== null &&
            readyStateResponse.ok === true &&
            typeof readyStateResponse.readyState === 'string' &&
            readyStateResponse.readyState.length > 0
              ? readyStateResponse.readyState
              : null;

          if (readyState !== null) {
            const isAlreadyLoaded =
              (state === 'load' && readyState === 'complete') ||
              (state === 'domcontentloaded' &&
                (readyState === 'complete' || readyState === 'interactive'));

            if (isAlreadyLoaded) {
              const duration = Date.now() - waitForStartTime;
              logNavigation('info', 'Page already loaded, skipping waitFor', {
                tabId: currentTabId,
                state,
                readyState,
                durationMs: duration,
              });
              return; // Page is already in the desired state, no need to wait
            } else {
              logNavigation('debug', 'Page not yet loaded, proceeding with waitFor', {
                tabId: currentTabId,
                state,
                currentReadyState: readyState,
                targetState: state,
              });
            }
          } else {
            logNavigation('debug', 'Could not get readyState, proceeding with waitFor', {
              tabId: currentTabId,
              state,
            });
          }
        } catch (error) {
          // If we can't check readyState, fall through to normal waitFor
          // This handles cases where content script isn't ready yet
          logNavigation('debug', 'Could not check readyState, proceeding with waitFor', {
            tabId: currentTabId,
            state,
            error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
          });
        }
      }

      // For selector-based waits or if readyState check didn't work, ensure content script is ready
      // When already on page, try to inject if missing and use longer delays
      logNavigation('debug', 'Ensuring content script ready for waitFor', {
        tabId: currentTabId,
        state: stateDescription,
      });
      try {
        // Try cached check first for speed
        await ensureContentScriptReady(currentTabId, true, 0, false, contentScriptPath);
        logNavigation('debug', 'Content script ready (cached) for waitFor', {
          tabId: currentTabId,
          state: stateDescription,
        });
      } catch {
        // If cached check fails, try without cache and attempt injection if needed
        logNavigation('debug', 'Cached content script check failed, retrying with injection attempt', {
          tabId: currentTabId,
          state: stateDescription,
        });
        try {
          // Use longer delay (500ms) and try to inject if missing when already on page
          await ensureContentScriptReady(currentTabId, false, 500, true, contentScriptPath);
          logNavigation('debug', 'Content script ready (fresh check) for waitFor', {
            tabId: currentTabId,
            state: stateDescription,
          });
        } catch (retryError) {
          // For 'load' and 'domcontentloaded', we can still try to execute waitFor
          // The content script will check readyState internally
          if (state === 'load' || state === 'domcontentloaded') {
            logNavigation('warn',
              'Content script ping failed, but proceeding with waitFor (will check readyState in content script)',
              {
                tabId: currentTabId,
                state,
                error:
                  retryError instanceof Error
                    ? retryError.message
                    : String(retryError),
              }
            );
            // Don't throw - allow recipe to continue
            // The exec call below will handle the error if content script is truly unavailable
          } else {
            // For selector-based waits (including notVisible), try harder with more retries
            // notVisible checks are critical for login detection, so we need robust retry logic
            const isNotVisible = typeof state === 'object' && state !== null && 'state' in state && state.state === 'notVisible';
            const maxRetries = isNotVisible ? 3 : 1;
            const delays = isNotVisible ? [1000, 2000, 3000] : [1000];
            
            let lastError: Error | null = null;
            for (let retryIndex = 0; retryIndex < maxRetries; retryIndex++) {
              logNavigation('debug',
                `Content script not ready before waitFor (selector-based), retry ${retryIndex + 1}/${maxRetries}`,
                {
                  tabId: currentTabId,
                  state: stateDescription,
                  delayMs: delays[retryIndex],
                  error:
                    lastError instanceof Error
                      ? lastError.message
                      : String(lastError || retryError),
                }
              );
              try {
                await ensureContentScriptReady(currentTabId, false, delays[retryIndex], true, contentScriptPath);
                logNavigation('debug', 'Content script ready after extended retry for waitFor', {
                  tabId: currentTabId,
                  state: stateDescription,
                  retryIndex: retryIndex + 1,
                });
                lastError = null;
                break; // Success, exit retry loop
              } catch (finalError) {
                lastError = finalError instanceof Error ? finalError : new Error(String(finalError));
                if (retryIndex === maxRetries - 1) {
                  // Last retry failed
                  logNavigation('warn',
                    'Content script not ready before waitFor (selector-based), proceeding anyway',
                    {
                      tabId: currentTabId,
                      state: stateDescription,
                      error: lastError.message,
                      totalRetries: maxRetries,
                    }
                  );
                  // Don't throw - allow recipe to continue
                  // The exec call below will handle the error if content script is truly unavailable
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }

      // Call waitFor - the content script will check readyState internally
      // and skip waiting if page is already loaded
      logNavigation('info', 'Executing waitFor in content script', {
        tabId: currentTabId,
        state: stateDescription,
      });
      // Wrap in try-catch to handle cases where content script isn't ready
      // For 'load' and 'domcontentloaded', we can still succeed if page is already loaded
      try {
        const waitForExecStartTime = Date.now();
        await exec('waitFor', { state });
        const waitForDuration = Date.now() - waitForExecStartTime;
        const totalDuration = Date.now() - waitForStartTime;
        logNavigation('info', 'WaitFor step completed successfully', {
          tabId: currentTabId,
          state: stateDescription,
          waitForDurationMs: waitForDuration,
          totalDurationMs: totalDuration,
        });
        return;
      } catch (error) {
        const errorMessage = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
        logNavigation('warn', 'WaitFor exec failed, attempting fallback check', {
          tabId: currentTabId,
          state: stateDescription,
          error: errorMessage,
        });
        // If exec fails and we're checking for load/domcontentloaded,
        // check if we can verify page state another way
        if (state === 'load' || state === 'domcontentloaded') {
          // Try one more time to get readyState
          try {
            logNavigation('debug', 'Attempting fallback readyState check', {
              tabId: currentTabId,
              state,
            });
            const readyStateResponse = await exec<{
              ok: boolean;
              readyState?: string;
            }>('getReadyState', {});
            const readyState =
              readyStateResponse.ok === true &&
              typeof readyStateResponse.readyState === 'string' &&
              readyStateResponse.readyState.length > 0
                ? readyStateResponse.readyState
                : null;

            if (readyState !== null) {
              const isAlreadyLoaded =
                (state === 'load' && readyState === 'complete') ||
                (state === 'domcontentloaded' &&
                  (readyState === 'complete' || readyState === 'interactive'));

              if (isAlreadyLoaded) {
                const totalDuration = Date.now() - waitForStartTime;
                logNavigation('info',
                  'Page already loaded (verified after exec failure), waitFor complete',
                  {
                    tabId: currentTabId,
                    state,
                    readyState,
                    totalDurationMs: totalDuration,
                  }
                );
                return; // Page is already loaded, success
              } else {
                logNavigation('warn', 'Page not yet loaded, waitFor may have failed', {
                  tabId: currentTabId,
                  state,
                  currentReadyState: readyState,
                  targetState: state,
                });
              }
            } else {
              logNavigation('warn', 'Could not get readyState in fallback check', {
                tabId: currentTabId,
                state,
              });
            }
          } catch (retryError) {
            // If we still can't verify, log warning but don't fail
            // The page might be loaded but content script communication is flaky
            const totalDuration = Date.now() - waitForStartTime;
            logNavigation('warn',
              'Could not verify page state, but assuming page is loaded (already on URL)',
              {
                tabId,
                state,
                totalDurationMs: totalDuration,
                error:
                  retryError instanceof Error
                    ? retryError.message
                    : String(retryError),
              }
            );
            // Don't throw - if we're already on the URL, page is likely loaded
            return;
          }
        } else {
          // For selector-based waits, we can't recover - must fail
          const totalDuration = Date.now() - waitForStartTime;
          logNavigation('error', 'WaitFor failed (selector-based, no recovery possible)', {
            tabId,
            state: stateDescription,
            totalDurationMs: totalDuration,
            error: errorMessage,
          });
        }

        // For selector-based waits or if we can't verify page state, throw the error
        throw error;
      }
    },
    assertVisible: async (locator: Locator): Promise<void> => {
      await exec('assertVisible', { locator });
    },
    click: async (
      locator: Locator,
      index?: number,
      loopLocator?: Locator
    ): Promise<void> => {
      // Get loop index from variables if not provided
      const loopIndex =
        index ?? (variables.patientRowIndex as number | undefined);
      await exec('click', { locator, loopIndex, loopLocator });
    },
    fill: async (locator: Locator, value: string): Promise<void> => {
      await exec('fill', { locator, value });
    },
    type: async (locator: Locator, value: string): Promise<void> => {
      await exec('type', { locator, value });
    },
    extract: async (
      locator: Locator,
      options: {
        key: string;
        multiple?: boolean;
        attribute?: string;
        index?: number;
        loopLocator?: Locator;
        optional?: boolean;
      }
    ): Promise<unknown> => {
      // Get loop index from options.index first, then fall back to variables
      // options.index is explicitly passed from executor and should be used
      const loopIndex =
        options.index !== undefined && options.index !== null
          ? options.index
          : (variables.patientRowIndex as number | undefined);

      logger.debug('Extract runtime: Index resolution', {
        providedIndex: options.index,
        patientRowIndex: variables.patientRowIndex,
        resolvedLoopIndex: loopIndex,
        key: options.key,
        hasLoopLocator: !!options.loopLocator,
      });

      const response = await exec<{ ok: boolean; data?: unknown }>('extract', {
        locator,
        ...options,
        loopIndex, // Explicitly pass loopIndex - content script will use this
        index: loopIndex, // Also set index to ensure consistency
        loopLocator: options.loopLocator, // Pass container locator for scoping
      });
      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error('Extraction failed');
      }
      return response.data;
    },
    // New methods for extended functionality
    captureHtml: async (
      filename: string,
      locator?: Locator,
      diffCheck: boolean = false
    ): Promise<string> => {
      // Read baseFolder dynamically from variables (may have been updated during execution)
      // This ensures we use the same baseFolder that was set via setVariable
      const currentBaseFolder =
        typeof variables.baseFolder === 'string' && variables.baseFolder
          ? variables.baseFolder
          : (context?.baseDownloadFolder ?? baseFolder);

      // Calculate expected full path BEFORE calling download manager
      const expectedFullPath = `${currentBaseFolder}/${filename}`;

      // Log expected path before calling download manager
      logger.info('captureHtml called - Pre-download validation', {
        filename,
        currentBaseFolder,
        variablesBaseFolder: variables.baseFolder,
        contextBaseDownloadFolder: context?.baseDownloadFolder,
        runtimeBaseFolder: baseFolder,
        expectedFullPath,
        variableState: {
          patientName: variables.patientName,
          patientId: variables.patientId,
          patientSlug: variables.patientSlug,
          patientFolder: variables.patientFolder,
          pageFolder: variables.pageFolder,
          patientRowIndex: variables.patientRowIndex,
          baseFolder: variables.baseFolder,
        },
        pathValidation: {
          expectedPath: expectedFullPath,
          willValidateAfterDownload: true,
        },
      });

      // Get HTML from content script
      const htmlResponse = await exec<{ ok: boolean; html?: string }>(
        'captureHtml',
        { locator, diffCheck }
      );
      if (
        htmlResponse.ok !== true ||
        typeof htmlResponse.html !== 'string' ||
        htmlResponse.html.length === 0
      ) {
        throw new Error('Failed to capture HTML from content script');
      }

      const parseBoolean = (value: unknown): boolean | undefined => {
        if (typeof value === 'boolean') {
          return value;
        }
        if (typeof value === 'string') {
          const normalized = value.trim().toLowerCase();
          if (normalized === 'true') {
            return true;
          }
          if (normalized === 'false') {
            return false;
          }
        }
        return undefined;
      };

      const minifyEnabled = parseBoolean(variables.minifyHtml) ?? false;
      const minifyOnly = parseBoolean(variables.minifyHtmlOnly);
      const captureRaw = !minifyEnabled || minifyOnly === false;
      const captureMinified = minifyEnabled;

      const rawHtml = htmlResponse.html;
      const minifiedHtml = captureMinified
        ? rawHtml.replace(/<!--[\s\S]*?-->/g, '').replace(/>\s+</g, '><').trim()
        : '';

      const toMinifiedFilename = (path: string): string => {
        const lower = path.toLowerCase();
        const htmlIndex = lower.lastIndexOf('.html');
        if (htmlIndex !== -1) {
          return `${path.slice(0, htmlIndex)}.min${path.slice(htmlIndex)}`;
        }
        return `${path}.min`;
      };

      const minifiedFilename =
        captureRaw && captureMinified ? toMinifiedFilename(filename) : filename;

      const reportArtifact = async (filePath: string, html: string) => {
        if (!onArtifactCaptured) {
          return;
        }
        try {
          const result = onArtifactCaptured({
            baseFolder: currentBaseFolder,
            filePath,
            html,
            diffCheck,
            variables: { ...variables },
          });
          if (result instanceof Promise) {
            await result;
          }
        } catch (error) {
          logger.warn('Artifact capture hook failed', {
            error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
            filename: filePath,
            baseFolder: currentBaseFolder,
          });
        }
      };

      if (captureRaw) {
        await reportArtifact(filename, rawHtml);
      }
      if (captureMinified) {
        await reportArtifact(minifiedFilename, minifiedHtml);
      }

      let actualPath = '';
      if (captureRaw) {
        actualPath = await downloadCaptureHtml(
          currentBaseFolder,
          filename,
          rawHtml,
          diffCheck,
          recipeKey
        );
      }
      if (captureMinified) {
        const minifiedPath = await downloadCaptureHtml(
          currentBaseFolder,
          minifiedFilename,
          minifiedHtml,
          diffCheck,
          recipeKey
        );
        if (!captureRaw) {
          actualPath = minifiedPath;
        }
      }

      // Validate actual path matches expected path
      const pathMatches =
        actualPath === expectedFullPath || actualPath.endsWith(filename);
      if (!pathMatches) {
        logger.warn('Path validation mismatch in runtime', {
          expectedPath: expectedFullPath,
          actualPath,
          filename,
          mismatch: true,
          variableState: {
            patientName: variables.patientName,
            patientId: variables.patientId,
            patientSlug: variables.patientSlug,
            patientFolder: variables.patientFolder,
            pageFolder: variables.pageFolder,
            patientRowIndex: variables.patientRowIndex,
            baseFolder: variables.baseFolder,
          },
        });
      } else {
        logger.info('Path validation passed in runtime', {
          expectedPath: expectedFullPath,
          actualPath,
          pathMatches: true,
        });
      }

      return actualPath;
    },
    saveUrl: async (
      filename: string,
      metadata?: Record<string, unknown>
    ): Promise<void> => {
      // Get current URL from tab
      const tab = await chrome.tabs.get(tabId);
      const tabUrl = typeof tab.url === 'string' ? tab.url : '';
      if (tabUrl.length === 0) {
        throw new Error('Tab does not have a URL');
      }

      // Read baseFolder dynamically from variables (may have been updated during execution)
      const currentBaseFolder =
        typeof variables.baseFolder === 'string' && variables.baseFolder
          ? variables.baseFolder
          : (context?.baseDownloadFolder ?? baseFolder);

      await downloadSaveUrl(currentBaseFolder, filename, tabUrl, metadata);
    },
    setVariable: (name: string, value: unknown): void => {

      } else {
        variables[name] = value;

    deleteVariable: (name: string): void => {

      logger.debug('Variable deleted', { name });
    },

      return variables[name];
    },

            }
          }

        if (
