          checkpoint.baseFolder.length > 0
        ) {

          logger.debug('Checkpoint restored with base folder', {

            baseFolder: checkpoint.baseFolder,
          });
        }
      }

    executeLoop: async (
      locator: Locator,
      variable: string,
      steps: RecipeStep[],
      maxIterations?: number
    ): Promise<void> => {
      // Extract all matching elements
      const elementsResponse = await exec<{
        ok: boolean;
        count?: number;
        elements?: unknown[];
      }>('extract', {
        locator,
        key: 'loopElements',
        multiple: true,
      });
      if (!elementsResponse.ok) {
        throw new Error('Failed to extract elements for loop');
      }

      // Get element count (we'll iterate by index)
      const countResponse = await exec<{ ok: boolean; count?: number }>(
        'getElementCount',
        { locator }
      );
      const elementCount = countResponse.count ?? 0;

      if (elementCount === 0) {
        logger.debug('No elements found for loop', { locator });
        return;
      }

      const hasMaxIterations =
        typeof maxIterations === 'number' && Number.isFinite(maxIterations);
      const iterations = hasMaxIterations
        ? Math.min(elementCount, Math.max(0, maxIterations))
        : elementCount;

      logger.info('Starting loop execution', {
        locator,
        variable,
        elementCount,
        iterations,
        stepCount: steps.length,
      });

      // Execute steps for each element
      for (let i = 0; i < iterations; i++) {
        logger.debug('Loop iteration', {
          variable,
          index: i,
          total: iterations,
        });

        // Set current index variable
        variables[`${variable}Index`] = i;
        variables[variable] = i; // Current element index

        // Execute nested steps (they will be executed by the main executor)
        // Note: This is a simplified implementation - full loop execution
        // would require recursive step execution which is handled in executor.ts
        await exec('loopIteration', {
          variable,
          index: i,
          steps,
        });
      }

      logger.info('Loop execution complete', {
        locator,
        variable,
        iterations,
      });
    },
    validateFolderExists: async (
      path: string,
      timeoutMs?: number
    ): Promise<boolean> => {
      const currentBaseFolder =
        typeof variables.baseFolder === 'string' && variables.baseFolder
          ? variables.baseFolder
          : (context?.baseDownloadFolder ?? baseFolder);
      return await downloadValidateFolderExists(
        currentBaseFolder,
        path,
        timeoutMs
      );
    },
    validateFileExists: async (
      filePath: string,
      timeoutMs?: number
    ): Promise<boolean> => {
      const currentBaseFolder =
        typeof variables.baseFolder === 'string' && variables.baseFolder
          ? variables.baseFolder
          : (context?.baseDownloadFolder ?? baseFolder);

      // Log for debugging - ensure we're using the same baseFolder that was used for download
      logger.debug('validateFileExists called', {
        filePath,
        currentBaseFolder,
        variablesBaseFolder: variables.baseFolder,
        contextBaseDownloadFolder: context?.baseDownloadFolder,
        runtimeBaseFolder: baseFolder,
        timeoutMs,
      });

      return await downloadValidateFileExists(
        currentBaseFolder,
        filePath,
        timeoutMs
      );
    },
  };
}

// DOM Action Utilities (shared)
// Reliable element interactions with error handling and retries

export type ActionResult = {
  success: boolean;
  error?: string;
  element?: Element;
};

export type ClickOptions = {
  force?: boolean;
  waitForVisible?: boolean;
  timeout?: number;
};

export type TypeOptions = {
  clear?: boolean;
  delay?: number;
  waitForVisible?: boolean;
  timeout?: number;
};

/**
 * Find the associated label for a radio button or checkbox input
 */
function findAssociatedLabel(input: HTMLInputElement): HTMLElement | null {
  // Check if input has an id and label with matching 'for' attribute
  if (input.id) {
    const label = document.querySelector(
      `label[for="${input.id}"]`
    ) as HTMLElement;
    if (label) return label;
  }

  // Check if input is wrapped in a label
  const parentLabel = input.closest('label') as HTMLElement;
  if (parentLabel) return parentLabel;

  // Check for adjacent label (common pattern: <input><label>)
  const nextSibling = input.nextElementSibling;
  if (nextSibling && nextSibling.tagName === 'LABEL') {
    return nextSibling as HTMLElement;
  }

  // Check for preceding label (common pattern: <label><input>)
  const prevSibling = input.previousElementSibling;
  if (prevSibling && prevSibling.tagName === 'LABEL') {
    return prevSibling as HTMLElement;
  }

  return null;
}

/**
 * Check if a radio button is already selected
 */
function isRadioSelected(input: HTMLInputElement): boolean {
  return input.checked === true;
}

// Click action with retry and error handling
export async function click(
  selector: any,
  options: ClickOptions = {}
): Promise<ActionResult> {
  const { force = false, waitForVisible = true, timeout = 10000 } = options;

  try {
    // Import query functions (avoid circular dependency)
    const { queryElement, isInteractable, isVisible } = await import(
      './query.js'
    );

    const element = queryElement(selector) as HTMLElement | null;

    if (element === null || element === undefined) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Element not found' };
    }

    // Special handling for radio buttons and checkboxes
    let targetElement: HTMLElement = element;
    let isRadioOrCheckbox = false;

    if (element instanceof HTMLInputElement) {
      const inputType = element.type.toLowerCase();
      if (inputType === 'radio' || inputType === 'checkbox') {
        isRadioOrCheckbox = true;

        // For radio buttons, check if already selected (no need to click if already selected)
        if (inputType === 'radio' && isRadioSelected(element)) {
          return {
            success: true,
            element,
            error: 'Radio button already selected',
          };
        }

        // Try to find associated label - labels are often more reliable to click
        const label = findAssociatedLabel(element);
        if (label && isVisible(label)) {
          targetElement = label;
        } else {
          // If no visible label, try clicking the input directly
          // Radio buttons may be hidden but still clickable via programmatic click
          targetElement = element;
        }
      }
    }

    // Wait for element to be interactable if requested
    if (waitForVisible && !isRadioOrCheckbox) {
      // For non-radio/checkbox elements, check interactability
      const startTime = Date.now();
      while (
        !isInteractable(targetElement) &&
        Date.now() - startTime < timeout
      ) {
        await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 100));
      }

      if (!isInteractable(targetElement)) {
        return {
          success: false,
          error: 'Element not interactable',
          element: targetElement,
        };
      }
    } else if (waitForVisible && isRadioOrCheckbox) {
      // For radio buttons, wait for element to exist and be in DOM
      const startTime = Date.now();
      while (!document.contains(element) && Date.now() - startTime < timeout) {
        await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 100));
      }

      if (!document.contains(element)) {
        return {
          success: false,
          error: 'Radio button not found in DOM',
          element,
        };
      }

      // Wait a bit more for any animations or transitions
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 200));
    }

    // Scroll into view (only if element is visible)
    if (isVisible(targetElement)) {
      targetElement.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 300));
    } else if (isRadioOrCheckbox) {
      // For hidden radio buttons, scroll the input element into view
      element.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 300));
    }

    // Click the element
    if (force) {
      targetElement.click();
    } else {
      // Try native click first, fallback to dispatch
      try {
        targetElement.click();
      } catch (clickError) {
        // If clicking label fails, try clicking the input directly
        if (
          isRadioOrCheckbox &&
          targetElement !== element &&
          element instanceof HTMLInputElement
        ) {
          try {
            element.click();
          } catch {
            // Dispatch events as last resort
            const event = new MouseEvent('click', {
              bubbles: true,
              cancelable: true,
              view: window,
            });
            element.dispatchEvent(event);
            // Also trigger change event for radio buttons
            if (element.type === 'radio') {
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
            }
          }
        } else {
          const event = new MouseEvent('click', {
            bubbles: true,
            cancelable: true,
            view: window,
          });
          targetElement.dispatchEvent(event);
        }
      }
    }

    // For radio buttons, verify the click worked
    if (isRadioOrCheckbox && element instanceof HTMLInputElement) {
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 100));
      if (element.type === 'radio' && !element.checked) {
        // Radio button didn't get checked, try direct input click
        element.checked = true;
        element.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
        element.dispatchEvent(new Event('click', { bubbles: true }));
      }
    }

    return { success: true, element: targetElement };
  } catch (error) {
    const errorMessage = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
    return { success: false, error: `Click failed: ${errorMessage}` };
  }
}

// Type text into input/textarea
export async function type(
  selector: any,
  text: string,
  options: TypeOptions = {}
): Promise<ActionResult> {
  const {
    clear = true,
    delay = 10,
    waitForVisible = true,
    timeout = 5000,
  } = options;

  try {
    const { queryElement, isInteractable } = await import('./query.js');

    const element = queryElement(selector) as
      | HTMLInputElement
      | HTMLTextAreaElement
      | null;

    if (element === null || element === undefined) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Element not found' };
    }

    if (
      !(element instanceof HTMLInputElement) &&
      !(element instanceof HTMLTextAreaElement)
    ) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: 'Element is not an input or textarea',
        element,
      };
    }

    // Wait for element to be interactable
    if (waitForVisible) {
      const startTime = Date.now();
      while (!isInteractable(element) && Date.now() - startTime < timeout) {
        await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 100));
      }

      if (!isInteractable(element)) {
        return { success: false, error: 'Element not interactable', element };
      }
    }

    // Focus the element
    element.focus();
    element.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 100));

    // Clear existing text if requested
    if (clear) {
      element.value = '';
      element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
      element.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
    }

    // Type text with delay between characters
    for (const char of text) {
      element.value += char;
      element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));

      if (delay > 0) {
        await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, delay));
      }
    }

    // Trigger change event
    element.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
    element.dispatchEvent(new Event('blur', { bubbles: true }));

    return { success: true, element };
  } catch (error) {
    const errorMessage = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
    return { success: false, error: `Type failed: ${errorMessage}` };
  }
}

// DOM Query Utilities (shared)
// Functional helpers for selectors and element selection

export type SelectorType = 'css' | 'xpath' | 'text' | 'testid';

// Query execution functions
export function queryElement(
  selector: string | { type: string; selector: string; contains?: boolean }
): Element | null {
  if (typeof selector === 'string') {
    return document.querySelector(selector);
  }

  switch (selector.type) {
    case 'css':
      return document.querySelector(selector.selector);

    case 'xpath':
      return queryElementByXPath(selector.selector);

    case 'text':
      return queryElementByText(selector.selector, selector.contains);

    default:
      console.warn('Unknown selector type:', selector.type);
      return null;
  }
}

export function queryElements(
  selector: string | { type: string; selector: string; contains?: boolean }
): Element[] {
  if (typeof selector === 'string') {
    return Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(selector));
  }

  switch (selector.type) {
    case 'css':
      return Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(selector.selector));

    case 'xpath':
      return queryElementsByXPath(selector.selector);

    case 'text':
      const element = queryElementByText(selector.selector, selector.contains);
      return element ? [element] : [];

    default:
      console.warn('Unknown selector type:', selector.type);
      return [];
  }
}

function queryElementByXPath(xpath: string): Element | null {
  try {
    const result = document.evaluate(
      xpath,
      document,
      null,
      XPathResult.FIRST_ORDERED_NODE_TYPE,
      null
    );
    return result.singleNodeValue as Element;
  } catch (error) {
    console.warn('Invalid XPath:', xpath, error);
    return null;
  }
}

function queryElementsByXPath(xpath: string): Element[] {
  try {
    const result = document.evaluate(
      xpath,
      document,
      null,
      XPathResult.ORDERED_NODE_SNAPSHOT_TYPE,
      null
    );

    const elements: Element[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < result.snapshotLength; i++) {
      elements.push(result.snapshotItem(i) as Element);
    }
    return elements;
  } catch (error) {
    console.warn('Invalid XPath:', xpath, error);
    return [];
  }
}

function queryElementByText(text: string, contains = false): Element | null {
  const elements = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('*'));

  for (const element of elements) {
    const elementText = element.textContent?.trim() ?? '';

    if (contains) {
      if (elementText.toLowerCase().includes(text.toLowerCase())) {
        return element;
      }
    } else {
      if (elementText.toLowerCase() === text.toLowerCase()) {
        return element;
      }
    }
  }

  return null;
}

// Visibility and interaction helpers
export function isVisible(element: Element): boolean {
  const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect();
  const style = window.getComputedStyle(element);

  return (
    element.isConnected &&
    rect.width > 0 &&
    rect.height > 0 &&
    style.display !== 'none' &&
    style.visibility !== 'hidden' &&
    style.opacity !== '0'
  );
}

export function isInteractable(element: Element): boolean {
  // Special handling for radio buttons and checkboxes - they may be hidden but still functional
  if (element instanceof HTMLInputElement) {
    const inputType = element.type.toLowerCase();
    if (inputType === 'radio' || inputType === 'checkbox') {
      // Radio buttons and checkboxes can be hidden but still clickable
      // Check if element exists in DOM and is not disabled
      return (
        document.contains(element) &&
        !element.hasAttribute('disabled') &&
        !element.disabled
      );
    }
  }

  // For other elements, check visibility and disabled state
  return (
    isVisible(element) &&
    !element.hasAttribute('disabled') &&
    !(element instanceof HTMLInputElement && element.disabled) &&
    !(element instanceof HTMLButtonElement && element.disabled) &&
    !(element instanceof HTMLSelectElement && element.disabled)
  );
}

/**
 * Element Validation Utilities (shared)
 *
 * Ported from scraper library patterns for element validation
 */

export interface ElementState {
  isElement: boolean;
  isVisible: boolean;
  isClickable: boolean;
  boundingBox: { x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number } | null;
  isInViewport: boolean;
  tagName: string | null;
  className: string | null;
  textContent: string | null;
}

/**
 * Validate element for interaction
 */
export function validateElementForClick(
  element: Element | null,
  selector: string
): ElementState {
  if (!element) {
    return {
      isElement: false,
      isVisible: false,
      isClickable: false,
      boundingBox: null,
      isInViewport: false,
      tagName: null,
      className: null,
      textContent: null,
    };
  }

  const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect();
  const style = window.getComputedStyle(element);
  const isVisible =
    style.display !== 'none' &&
    style.visibility !== 'hidden' &&
    style.opacity !== '0' &&
    rect.width > 0 &&
    rect.height > 0;

  const isInViewport =
    rect.top >= 0 &&
    rect.left >= 0 &&
    rect.bottom <= window.innerHeight &&
    rect.right <= window.innerWidth;

  const isClickable = isVisible && isInViewport;

  return {
    isElement: element instanceof Element,
    isVisible,
    isClickable,
    boundingBox: {
      x: rect.x,
      y: rect.y,
      width: rect.width,
      height: rect.height,
    },
    isInViewport,
    tagName: element.tagName,
    className: element.className || null,
    textContent: element.textContent?.trim().substring(0, 100) || null,
  };
}

/**
 * Scroll element into view
 */
export function scrollElementIntoView(element: Element): void {
  element.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
}

/**
 * Try multiple selectors with fallback pattern
 */
export function queryWithFallback(
  selectors: string[],
  queryFn: (selector: string) => Element | null
): { element: Element | null; usedSelector: string | null } {
  for (const selector of selectors) {
    const element = queryFn(selector);
    if (element) {
      return { element, usedSelector: selector };
    }
  }
  return { element: null, usedSelector: null };
}

/**
 * Try multiple selectors and return all matching elements
 */
export function queryAllWithFallback(
  selectors: string[],
  queryFn: (selector: string) => Element[]
): { elements: Element[]; usedSelector: string | null } {
  for (const selector of selectors) {
    const elements = queryFn(selector);
    if (elements.length > 0) {
      return { elements, usedSelector: selector };
    }
  }
  return { elements: [], usedSelector: null };
}

// Robust DOM Wait Utilities (shared)
// Auto-retry, visibility guards, and phased waits for reliable automation

export type WaitOptions = {
  timeout?: number;
  interval?: number;
  visible?: boolean;
  attached?: boolean;
};

export type WaitResult<T> = {
  success: boolean;
  value?: T;
  error?: string;
};

// Wait for element to exist in DOM
export async function waitForElement(
  selector: string,
  options: WaitOptions = {}
): Promise<WaitResult<Element>> {
  const {
    timeout = 10000,
    interval = 100,
    visible = true,
    attached = true,
  } = options;

  return new Promise(resolve => {
    const startTime = Date.now();

    const check = () => {
      try {
        const element = document.querySelector(selector);

        if (!element) {
          if (Date.now() - startTime > timeout) {
            resolve({
              success: false,
              error: `Element ${selector} not found within ${timeout}ms`,
            });
            return;
          }
          setTimeout(check, interval);
          return;
        }

        // Check visibility if required
        if (visible && !isVisible(element)) {
          if (Date.now() - startTime > timeout) {
            resolve({
              success: false,
              error: `Element ${selector} not visible within ${timeout}ms`,
            });
            return;
          }
          setTimeout(check, interval);
          return;
        }

        // Check if attached to DOM if required
        if (attached && !document.contains(element)) {
          if (Date.now() - startTime > timeout) {
            resolve({
              success: false,
              error: `Element ${selector} not attached within ${timeout}ms`,
            });
            return;
          }
          setTimeout(check, interval);
          return;
        }

        resolve({ success: true, value: element });
      } catch (error) {
        resolve({
          success: false,
          error: `Error checking element ${selector}: ${
            error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)
          }`,
        });
      }
    };

    check();
  });
}

// Utility function to check if element is visible
function isVisible(element: Element): boolean {
  const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect();
  return rect.width > 0 && rect.height > 0 && rect.top >= 0 && rect.left >= 0;
}
