// Content script recipe handler - executes recipe steps in the page context

import type { Locator } from '../types.js';
import { queryElement } from './dom/query.js';
import { click as domClick, type as domType } from './dom/actions.js';
import { waitForElement } from './dom/wait.js';
import { createGuideOverlay } from '@chrome-ext/core-guide-overlay';

const sleep = (ms: number) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms));

// Create a global guide overlay for highlighting elements during extraction
let guideOverlay: ReturnType<typeof createGuideOverlay> | null = null;
function getGuideOverlay(): ReturnType<typeof createGuideOverlay> {
  if (!guideOverlay) {
    guideOverlay = createGuideOverlay(document);
  }
  return guideOverlay;
}

/**
 * Find element by role and optional name (text content)
 * This handles role-based selectors that need text matching
 * Handles nested text content (text may be in child elements)
 */
function queryElementByRoleAndName(
  role: string,
  name?: string
): Element | null {
  const roleElements = Array.from(
    document.querySelectorAll(`[role="${role}"]`)
  );

  if (!name || name === '') {
    return roleElements[0] || null;
  }

  // Find element with matching text content
  const normalizedName = name.toLowerCase().trim();
  for (const element of roleElements) {
    // Get all text content including nested elements
    const elementText = element.textContent?.trim().toLowerCase() || '';

    // Check exact match or contains match
    if (
      elementText === normalizedName ||
      elementText.includes(normalizedName)
    ) {
      return element;
    }

    // Also check if any direct child contains the text (for links with nested spans)
    const children = Array.from(element.children);
    for (const child of children) {
      const childText = child.textContent?.trim().toLowerCase() || '';
      if (childText === normalizedName || childText.includes(normalizedName)) {
        return element; // Return parent element with role
      }
    }

    // Check aria-label
    const ariaLabel = element.getAttribute('aria-label')?.toLowerCase().trim();
    if (ariaLabel === normalizedName || ariaLabel?.includes(normalizedName)) {
      return element;
    }

    // Check if element is a link and has text content
    if (element.tagName === 'A' || element.tagName === 'BUTTON') {
      const linkText = element.textContent?.trim().toLowerCase() || '';
      if (linkText === normalizedName || linkText.includes(normalizedName)) {
        return element;
      }
    }
  }

  // Special handling for menuitem role - search within submenu containers
  if (role === 'menuitem') {
    // First, try to find within submenu containers
    const submenuContainers = Array.from(
      document.querySelectorAll(
        '.submenu-container, .ellipsis-submenu-container, [role="menu"], [role="menubar"]'
      )
    );

    for (const container of submenuContainers) {
      // Check if container is visible
      const style = window.getComputedStyle(container);
      if (style.display === 'none' || style.visibility === 'hidden') {
        continue;
      }

      // Search for menuitems within this container
      const menuItems = Array.from(
        container.querySelectorAll(
          '[role="menuitem"], .submenu-item, a, button, div[class*="menu-item"]'
        )
      );

      for (const item of menuItems) {
        const itemText = item.textContent?.trim().toLowerCase() || '';
        const ariaLabel =
          item.getAttribute('aria-label')?.toLowerCase().trim() || '';

        if (
          itemText === normalizedName ||
          itemText.includes(normalizedName) ||
          ariaLabel === normalizedName ||
          ariaLabel.includes(normalizedName)
        ) {
          return item;
        }

        // Check nested text content (e.g., .body-2 span inside .submenu-item)
        const nestedText = Array.from(item.querySelectorAll('*')).find(el => {
          const text = el.textContent?.trim().toLowerCase() || '';
          return text === normalizedName || text.includes(normalizedName);
        });
        if (nestedText) {
          return item; // Return the parent menu item
        }
      }
    }

    // Fallback: search all elements that might be menu items
    const allMenuItems = Array.from(
      document.querySelectorAll(
        '[role="menuitem"], .submenu-item, .menu-item, a[class*="menu"], button[class*="menu"]'
      )
    );
    for (const item of allMenuItems) {
      const itemText = item.textContent?.trim().toLowerCase() || '';
      const ariaLabel =
        item.getAttribute('aria-label')?.toLowerCase().trim() || '';
      if (
        itemText === normalizedName ||
        itemText.includes(normalizedName) ||
        ariaLabel === normalizedName ||
        ariaLabel.includes(normalizedName)
      ) {
        // Verify it's in a menu-like structure
        const parent = item.closest('.submenu-container, .menu, [role="menu"]');
        if (parent) {
          return item;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // If not found by role, try finding by text content in common structures
  // This is a fallback for cases where role might not be set correctly
  const allElements = Array.from(
    document.querySelectorAll('a, button, [role="tab"], [role="button"]')
  );
  for (const element of allElements) {
    const elementText = element.textContent?.trim().toLowerCase() || '';
    if (
      elementText === normalizedName ||
      elementText.includes(normalizedName)
    ) {
      // For tabs, verify it's in a tab-like structure
      if (role === 'tab') {
        const parent = element.closest('nav, .ep-subnav, [role="tablist"]');
        if (parent) {
          return element;
        }
      } else {
        // For buttons (like Cancel/Close), check if it's in a modal or dialog
        const parent = element.closest(
          '.modal, .modal-dialog, [role="dialog"]'
        );
        if (parent || role === 'button') {
          return element;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // Special handling for Cancel/Close buttons - search all buttons if role="button" and name="Cancel"/"Close"
  if (
    role === 'button' &&
    (normalizedName === 'cancel' || normalizedName === 'close')
  ) {
    const allButtons = Array.from(
      document.querySelectorAll('button, [role="button"], .close, .modal-close')
    );
    for (const button of allButtons) {
      const buttonText = button.textContent?.trim().toLowerCase() || '';
      const ariaLabel =
        button.getAttribute('aria-label')?.toLowerCase().trim() || '';
      const className = button.className?.toLowerCase() || '';

      // Check if it's a close/cancel button
      if (
        buttonText === normalizedName ||
        buttonText.includes(normalizedName) ||
        ariaLabel === normalizedName ||
        ariaLabel.includes(normalizedName) ||
        className.includes('close') ||
        button.classList.contains('close') ||
        button.classList.contains('modal-close')
      ) {
        // Prefer buttons in modals/dialogs
        const inModal = button.closest(
          '.modal, .modal-dialog, [role="dialog"]'
        );
        if (inModal) {
          return button;
        }
      }
    }
    // If not found in modal, return first matching button
    for (const button of allButtons) {
      const buttonText = button.textContent?.trim().toLowerCase() || '';
      const ariaLabel =
        button.getAttribute('aria-label')?.toLowerCase().trim() || '';
      if (
        buttonText === normalizedName ||
        buttonText.includes(normalizedName) ||
        ariaLabel === normalizedName ||
        ariaLabel.includes(normalizedName)
      ) {
        return button;
      }
    }
  }

  return null;
}

function locatorToSelector(locator: Locator): string {
  if (
    locator.by === 'css' &&
    locator.selector !== null &&
    locator.selector !== undefined &&
    locator.selector !== ''
  ) {
    return locator.selector;
  }
  if (
    locator.by === 'role' &&
    locator.role !== null &&
    locator.role !== undefined &&
    locator.role !== ''
  ) {
    // For role-based selectors, return a special marker that will be handled by queryElement
    // We can't use :has-text() as it's not valid CSS
    return `[role="${locator.role}"]`;
  }
  throw new Error(`Invalid locator: ${JSON.stringify(locator)}`);
}

function buildFallbackSelectors(selectors: Locator | Locator[]): string[] {
  const locatorsToTry: Locator[] = Array.isArray(selectors)
    ? selectors
    : [selectors];

  const fallbackSelectors: string[] = [];

  for (const locator of locatorsToTry) {
    if (locator.by === 'css' && locator.selector) {
      fallbackSelectors.push(locator.selector);
    } else {
      fallbackSelectors.push(locatorToSelector(locator));
    }
  }

  if (locatorsToTry.length > 0) {
    const firstLocator = locatorsToTry[0];
    if (firstLocator.by === 'css' && firstLocator.selector) {
      const primarySelector = firstLocator.selector;

      if (primarySelector.includes('.ui-select-container')) {
        if (!fallbackSelectors.includes('.ui-select-container')) {
          fallbackSelectors.push('.ui-select-container');
        }
        if (
          !fallbackSelectors.includes(
            '.grid-footer-left-section .ui-select-container'
          )
        ) {
          fallbackSelectors.push(
            '.grid-footer-left-section .ui-select-container'
          );
        }
        if (
          !fallbackSelectors.includes(
            '.grid-footer-left-section .av-select.pageSize'
          )
        ) {
          fallbackSelectors.push(
            '.grid-footer-left-section .av-select.pageSize'
          );
        }
        if (!fallbackSelectors.includes('.pageSize.ui-select-container')) {
          fallbackSelectors.push('.pageSize.ui-select-container');
        }
        if (
          !fallbackSelectors.includes('.av-select.pageSize.ui-select-container')
        ) {
          fallbackSelectors.push('.av-select.pageSize.ui-select-container');
        }
        if (!fallbackSelectors.includes('.ui-grid .ui-select-container')) {
          fallbackSelectors.push('.ui-grid .ui-select-container');
        }
        if (!fallbackSelectors.includes('.ayva-data-table .ui-select-container')) {
          fallbackSelectors.push('.ayva-data-table .ui-select-container');
        }
        if (
          !fallbackSelectors.includes(
            '[class*="grid"] .ui-select-container'
          )
        ) {
          fallbackSelectors.push('[class*="grid"] .ui-select-container');
        }
      }

      if (
        primarySelector.includes('perPage') ||
        primarySelector.includes('pageSize')
      ) {
        if (!fallbackSelectors.includes('select[name*="perPage"]')) {
          fallbackSelectors.push('select[name*="perPage"]');
        }
        if (!fallbackSelectors.includes('select[name*="pageSize"]')) {
          fallbackSelectors.push('select[name*="pageSize"]');
        }
        if (!fallbackSelectors.includes('select[ng-model*="pageSize"]')) {
          fallbackSelectors.push('select[ng-model*="pageSize"]');
        }
      }
    }
  }

  return fallbackSelectors;
}

function isElementVisible(element: Element): boolean {
  const rect = (element as HTMLElement).getBoundingClientRect();
  if (rect.width === 0 || rect.height === 0) {
    return false;
  }

  const style = window.getComputedStyle(element as HTMLElement);
  if (
    style.display === 'none' ||
    style.visibility === 'hidden' ||
    style.opacity === '0'
  ) {
    return false;
  }

  return true;
}

async function waitForState(state: unknown): Promise<void> {
  if (
    state === 'load' ||
    state === 'domcontentloaded' ||
    state === 'networkidle'
  ) {
    // Check if page is already in the desired state before waiting
    const readyState = document.readyState;

    // 'complete' means load event has fired (page fully loaded)
    // 'interactive' means DOMContentLoaded has fired (DOM ready, but resources may still be loading)
    const isAlreadyLoaded =
      (state === 'load' && readyState === 'complete') ||
      (state === 'domcontentloaded' &&
        (readyState === 'complete' || readyState === 'interactive'));

    if (isAlreadyLoaded) {
      // Page is already in the desired state, no need to wait
      console.log(
        `Page already ${state}, skipping wait (readyState: ${readyState})`
      );
      return;
    }

    // Page is not yet in desired state, wait for it
    // Simple delay-based wait - can be enhanced with actual state detection
    const ms =
      state === 'load' ? 500 : state === 'domcontentloaded' ? 300 : 1000;
    await sleep(ms);
    return;
  }

  // Selector-based wait with fallback selectors
  if (typeof state === 'object' && state !== null && 'state' in state) {
    const s = state as {
      state: string;
      selector?: Locator | Locator[];
      timeoutMs?: number;
    };
    if (s.state === 'delay') {
      // Explicit fixed delay step for sequencing-sensitive flows
      const delayMs =
        typeof s.timeoutMs === 'number' && Number.isFinite(s.timeoutMs)
          ? Math.max(0, s.timeoutMs)
          : 500;
      await sleep(delayMs);
      return;
    }
    if ((s.state === 'selector' || s.state === 'notVisible') && s.selector) {
      const fallbackSelectors = buildFallbackSelectors(s.selector);
      const timeoutMs = s.timeoutMs ?? 10000;

      if (s.state === 'notVisible') {
        const start = Date.now();
        while (Date.now() - start < timeoutMs) {
          let anyVisible = false;
          for (const selector of fallbackSelectors) {
            const el = queryElement(selector);
            if (el && isElementVisible(el)) {
              anyVisible = true;
              break;
            }
          }
          if (!anyVisible) {
            return;
          }
          await sleep(100);
        }
        throw new Error(
          `Timeout waiting for selector to be not visible. Tried: ${fallbackSelectors.join(
            ', '
          )}`
        );
      }

      const start = Date.now();
      let triedSelectors: string[] = [];

      for (const selector of fallbackSelectors) {
        triedSelectors.push(selector);
        const selectorStart = Date.now();

        while (
          Date.now() - selectorStart <
          timeoutMs / fallbackSelectors.length
        ) {
          const el = queryElement(selector);
          if (el && isElementVisible(el)) {
            return;
          }

          if (Date.now() - start > timeoutMs) {
            break;
          }

          await sleep(100);
        }

        const el = queryElement(selector);
        if (el) {
          return;
        }
      }

      throw new Error(
        `Timeout waiting for selector. Tried: ${triedSelectors.join(', ')}`
      );
    }
  }
}

async function assertVisible(locator: Locator): Promise<void> {
  const selector = locatorToSelector(locator);
  // Wait for element to appear and be visible (with retry logic)
  const result = await waitForElement(selector, {
    timeout: 10000, // 10 second timeout
    interval: 100, // Check every 100ms
    visible: true, // Element must be visible
    attached: true, // Element must be attached to DOM
  });

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      result.error || `Element not found or not visible: ${selector}`
    );
  }

  // Additional visibility check to ensure element has dimensions
  const el = result.value;
  if (!el) {
    throw new Error(`Element not found: ${selector}`);
  }
  const rect = (el as HTMLElement).getBoundingClientRect();
  if (rect.width === 0 || rect.height === 0) {
    throw new Error(`Element not visible (zero dimensions): ${selector}`);
  }
}

// Global variable to store current loop index (set by executor)
let currentLoopIndex: number | null = null;

function setLoopIndex(index: number | null): void {
  currentLoopIndex = index;
}

function isElementCandidateInteractable(element: Element): boolean {
  if (!(element instanceof HTMLElement)) return false;
  const style = window.getComputedStyle(element);
  const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect();
  const ariaDisabled = element.getAttribute('aria-disabled');
  const isDisabled =
    element.hasAttribute('disabled') ||
    (element instanceof HTMLButtonElement && element.disabled) ||
    (element instanceof HTMLInputElement && element.disabled) ||
    ariaDisabled === 'true';

  return (
    element.isConnected &&
    rect.width > 0 &&
    rect.height > 0 &&
    style.display !== 'none' &&
    style.visibility !== 'hidden' &&
    style.opacity !== '0' &&
    style.pointerEvents !== 'none' &&
    !isDisabled
  );
}

function pickFirstInteractableElement(elements: Element[]): HTMLElement | null {
  for (const element of elements) {
    if (isElementCandidateInteractable(element)) {
      return element as HTMLElement;
    }
  }
  return null;
}

async function click(
  locator: Locator,
  index?: number,
  loopLocator?: Locator
): Promise<void> {
  // Handle role+name locators specially (can't use :has-text() in CSS)
  let selector: string;
  let element: HTMLElement | null = null;

  // Default to index 0 when no explicit index is provided.
  const elementIndex = index ?? 0;


  if (locator.by === 'role' && locator.role && locator.name) {
    const normalizedName = locator.name.toLowerCase().trim();
    // Detect modal buttons - these should NEVER be scoped to loop containers
    const isModalButton =
      normalizedName === 'cancel' ||
      normalizedName === 'close' ||
      normalizedName === 'save' ||
      normalizedName === 'ok' ||
      normalizedName === 'done';
    // Also check if there's a visible modal/dialog on the page
    const hasVisibleModal =
      document.querySelector(
        '.modal:not([style*="display: none"]), .modal-dialog:not([style*="display: none"]), [role="dialog"]:not([style*="display: none"])'
      ) !== null;


    // If loopLocator provided, try scoped search first, but ALWAYS skip scoped search for modal buttons
    // Also skip if there's a visible modal (button might be in modal even if name doesn't match)
    if (loopLocator && !isModalButton && !hasVisibleModal) {
      const containerSelector = locatorToSelector(loopLocator);
      const containerElements = Array.from(
        document.querySelectorAll(containerSelector)
      );


      if (containerElements.length === 0) {
        throw new Error(
          `No loop container elements found: ${containerSelector}`
        );
      }

      if (elementIndex < 0 || elementIndex >= containerElements.length) {
        throw new Error(
          `Loop container index out of bounds: ${elementIndex} (containers: ${containerElements.length})`
        );
      }
      const safeContainerIndex = elementIndex;
      const containerElement = containerElements[safeContainerIndex];

      // Search for role+name element within this container
      const roleElements = Array.from(
        containerElement.querySelectorAll(`[role="${locator.role}"]`)
      );


      for (const roleEl of roleElements) {
        const elementText = roleEl.textContent?.trim().toLowerCase() || '';
        const ariaLabel = roleEl
          .getAttribute('aria-label')
          ?.toLowerCase()
          .trim();

        if (
          elementText === normalizedName ||
          elementText.includes(normalizedName) ||
          ariaLabel === normalizedName ||
          ariaLabel?.includes(normalizedName)
        ) {
          element = roleEl as HTMLElement;
          break;
        }
      }

    }

    if (loopLocator && !isModalButton && !hasVisibleModal && !element) {
      throw new Error(
        `Element not found in scoped loop container: role="${locator.role}", name="${locator.name}", index=${elementIndex}`
      );
    }

    // If not found in scoped search (or is modal button/has visible modal), try unscoped search
    // For modal buttons or when modal is visible, ALWAYS use unscoped search
    if (!element || isModalButton || hasVisibleModal) {

      // Use role+name query function to find element by text content (original behavior)
      // This function has special handling for Cancel/Close buttons in modals
      element = queryElementByRoleAndName(
        locator.role,
        locator.name
      ) as HTMLElement | null;

    }

    if (element && !isElementCandidateInteractable(element)) {
      const roleNameCandidates = Array.from(
        document.querySelectorAll(
          `button, [role="${locator.role}"], [role="button"], a, [role="tab"]`
        )
      ).filter(candidate => {
        const text = candidate.textContent?.trim().toLowerCase() || '';
        const ariaLabel =
          candidate.getAttribute('aria-label')?.toLowerCase().trim() || '';
        return (
          text === normalizedName ||
          text.includes(normalizedName) ||
          ariaLabel === normalizedName ||
          ariaLabel.includes(normalizedName)
        );
      });

      const interactableCandidate =
        pickFirstInteractableElement(roleNameCandidates);
      if (interactableCandidate) {
        element = interactableCandidate;
      }
    }

    // If not found and it's a menuitem, try fallback selectors
    if (!element && locator.role === 'menuitem') {
      const normalizedName = locator.name.toLowerCase().trim();
      const fallbackSelectors = [
        '.submenu-item',
        '.ellipsis-submenu-container .submenu-item',
        '.submenu-container .submenu-item',
        '[role="menuitem"]',
        '.submenu-item a',
        '.submenu-item button',
      ];

      // Try fallback selectors - search within visible submenu containers first
      const submenuContainers = Array.from(
        document.querySelectorAll(
          '.submenu-container, .ellipsis-submenu-container, [role="menu"]'
        )
      ).filter(container => {
        const style = window.getComputedStyle(container);
        return style.display !== 'none' && style.visibility !== 'hidden';
      });

      for (const container of submenuContainers) {
        for (const fallbackSelector of fallbackSelectors) {
          const elements = Array.from(
            container.querySelectorAll(fallbackSelector)
          );
          for (const el of elements) {
            const elText = el.textContent?.trim().toLowerCase() || '';
            const ariaLabel =
              el.getAttribute('aria-label')?.toLowerCase().trim() || '';
            if (
              elText === normalizedName ||
              elText.includes(normalizedName) ||
              ariaLabel === normalizedName ||
              ariaLabel.includes(normalizedName)
            ) {
              element = el as HTMLElement;
              break;
            }
          }
          if (element) break;
        }
        if (element) break;
      }

      // If still not found, try searching entire document
      if (!element) {
        for (const fallbackSelector of fallbackSelectors) {
          const elements = Array.from(
            document.querySelectorAll(fallbackSelector)
          );
          for (const el of elements) {
            const elText = el.textContent?.trim().toLowerCase() || '';
            const ariaLabel =
              el.getAttribute('aria-label')?.toLowerCase().trim() || '';
            if (
              elText === normalizedName ||
              elText.includes(normalizedName) ||
              ariaLabel === normalizedName ||
              ariaLabel.includes(normalizedName)
            ) {
              element = el as HTMLElement;
              break;
            }
          }
          if (element) break;
        }
      }
    }

    if (!element) {
      throw new Error(
        `Element not found: role="${locator.role}", name="${locator.name}"`
      );
    }
    // Convert element to a selector for the domClick function
    // Use a unique identifier if available, otherwise use a temporary ID
    if (!element.id) {
      const tempId = `temp-click-${Date.now()}`;
      element.id = tempId;
      selector = `#${tempId}`;
    } else {
      selector = `#${element.id}`;
    }
  } else {
    // Regular CSS selector
    if (loopLocator) {
      // Check if selector targets modal/dialog elements (common patterns)
      const selectorStr = locatorToSelector(locator);
      const isModalSelector =
        selectorStr.includes('.modal') ||
        selectorStr.includes('[role="dialog"]') ||
        selectorStr.includes('.dialog') ||
        (selectorStr.includes('button') &&
          (selectorStr.includes('cancel') || selectorStr.includes('close')));


      // Try scoped search first (unless it's a modal selector)
      if (!isModalSelector) {
        const containerSelector = locatorToSelector(loopLocator);
        const containerElements = Array.from(
          document.querySelectorAll(containerSelector)
        );

        if (containerElements.length === 0) {
          throw new Error(
            `No loop container elements found: ${containerSelector}`
          );
        }

        if (elementIndex < 0 || elementIndex >= containerElements.length) {
          throw new Error(
            `Loop container index out of bounds: ${elementIndex} (containers: ${containerElements.length})`
          );
        }
        const safeContainerIndex = elementIndex;
        const containerElement = containerElements[safeContainerIndex];

        // Then scope click selector within container
        const scopedSelector = locatorToSelector(locator);
        const scopedElements = Array.from(
          containerElement.querySelectorAll(scopedSelector)
        );


        if (scopedElements.length > 0) {
          // Prefer an interactable element inside the scoped container.
          element =
            pickFirstInteractableElement(scopedElements) ??
            (scopedElements[0] as HTMLElement);

          console.log('Click scoped to loop container', {
            containerIndex: safeContainerIndex,
            containerSelector,
            scopedSelector,
            foundElements: scopedElements.length,
          });
        }
      }

      // If not found in scoped search (or is modal selector), fallback to unscoped
      if (!element) {
        if (!isModalSelector) {
          throw new Error(
            `Element not found in scoped loop container: ${locatorToSelector(locator)} (index=${elementIndex})`
          );
        }

        selector = locatorToSelector(locator);
        const allElements = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(selector));

        if (allElements.length === 0) {
          throw new Error(`Element not found: ${selector}`);
        }

        // Use index-based selection if index is provided and valid
        if (index !== undefined && index !== null && allElements.length > elementIndex) {
          element = allElements[elementIndex] as HTMLElement;
        } else if (allElements.length > 0) {
          element =
            pickFirstInteractableElement(allElements) ??
            (allElements[0] as HTMLElement);
        } else {
          throw new Error(
            `Element index out of bounds for selector "${selector}": ${elementIndex} (elements: ${allElements.length})`
          );
        }

      }
    } else {
      // Original behavior: query entire document
      selector = locatorToSelector(locator);
      const allElements = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(selector));

      if (allElements.length === 0) {
        throw new Error(`Element not found: ${selector}`);
      }

      // Use index-based selection if index is provided and valid
      if (index !== undefined && index !== null && allElements.length > elementIndex) {
        element = allElements[elementIndex] as HTMLElement;
      } else if (allElements.length > 0) {
        element =
          pickFirstInteractableElement(allElements) ??
          (allElements[0] as HTMLElement);
      }
    }

    // Create a temporary ID for this specific element if needed
    if (element) {
      if (!element.id) {
        const tempId = `temp-click-${Date.now()}-${elementIndex ?? 0}`;
        element.id = tempId;
        selector = `#${tempId}`;
      } else {
        selector = `#${element.id}`;
      }
    }
  }

  if (!element) {
    throw new Error(`Element not found at index ${elementIndex}: ${selector}`);
  }

  // Try clicking with retries for better reliability
  let lastError: string | undefined;
  const maxRetries = 3;

  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < maxRetries; attempt++) {
    const result = await domClick(selector, {
      // Keep per-attempt timeout modest so click failures surface before step-level timeout.
      timeout: 4000,
      waitForVisible: true,
    });

    if (result.success === true) {
      // Clean up temporary ID if we added one
      if (element && element.id.startsWith('temp-click-')) {
        element.removeAttribute('id');
      }
      return; // Success
    }

    lastError = result.error;

    // If not the last attempt, wait before retrying
    if (attempt < maxRetries - 1) {
      await sleep(500 * (attempt + 1)); // Exponential backoff
    }
  }

  // Clean up temporary ID if we added one
  if (element && element.id.startsWith('temp-click-')) {
    element.removeAttribute('id');
  }

  // All retries failed
  throw new Error(
    `Failed to click after ${maxRetries} attempts: ${lastError ?? `Failed to click: ${selector}`}`
  );
}

async function fill(locator: Locator, value: string): Promise<void> {
  const selector = locatorToSelector(locator);
  // Use type with clear option to fill input fields
  const result = await domType(selector, value, { clear: true });
  if (result.success !== true) {
    throw new Error(result.error ?? `Failed to fill: ${selector}`);
  }
}

async function type(locator: Locator, value: string): Promise<void> {
  const selector = locatorToSelector(locator);
  const result = await domType(selector, value);
  if (result.success !== true) {
    throw new Error(result.error ?? `Failed to type: ${selector}`);
  }
}

async function extract(
  locator: Locator,
  options: {
    key: string;
    multiple?: boolean;
    attribute?: string;
    index?: number;
    loopLocator?: Locator;
    optional?: boolean;
  }
): Promise<unknown> {
  let allElements: Element[];

  // If loopLocator provided, scope query to loop container
  if (options.loopLocator) {
    const containerSelector = locatorToSelector(options.loopLocator);
    const containerElements = Array.from(
      document.querySelectorAll(containerSelector)
    );

    if (containerElements.length === 0) {
      throw new Error(`No loop container elements found: ${containerSelector}`);
    }

    // Get container at specified index
    const elementIndex =
      options.index !== undefined && options.index !== null
        ? options.index
        : 0;

    const safeContainerIndex =
      elementIndex < containerElements.length ? elementIndex : 0;
    const containerElement = containerElements[safeContainerIndex];

    // Scope selector query to this container
    const scopedSelector = locatorToSelector(locator);
    allElements = Array.from(containerElement.querySelectorAll(scopedSelector));

    console.log('Extract scoped to loop container', {
      containerIndex: safeContainerIndex,
      containerSelector,
      scopedSelector,
      foundElements: allElements.length,
      key: options.key,
    });
  } else {
    // Original behavior: query entire document
    const selector = locatorToSelector(locator);
    allElements = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(selector));
  }

  if (allElements.length === 0) {
    const selector = locatorToSelector(locator);
    const isOptional = options.optional === true;

    // For optional extractions, log a warning and return undefined instead of throwing
    if (isOptional) {
      console.warn(`⚠️ Optional extraction failed: No elements found for selector "${selector}" (key: ${options.key})`);
      return options.multiple ? [] : undefined;
    }

    // For meta tags in head, they should be available immediately after page load
    // Provide a more helpful error message
    // Check for actual meta tag selectors, not just substring matches
    // Match patterns like: meta[name="..."], head meta, meta[property], etc.
    const isMetaTagSelector =
      /^meta\s*\[|^head\s+meta|meta\s*\[name=|meta\s*\[property=|meta\s*\[http-equiv=/i.test(
        selector
      );
    if (isMetaTagSelector) {
      throw new Error(
        `Meta tag not found: ${selector}. ` +
          `Meta tags should be available immediately after page load. ` +
          `Check if the page has fully loaded or if the selector is correct.`
      );
    }
    throw new Error(`No elements found for extraction: ${selector}`);
  }

  // Use only the explicit index for non-scoped extraction.
  // For scoped queries, always use index 0 because the container is already selected.
  const elementIndex = options.loopLocator
    ? 0
    : options.index !== undefined && options.index !== null
      ? options.index
      : 0;

  console.log('Extract function: Index resolution', {
    providedIndex: options.index,
    currentLoopIndex,
    resolvedIndex: elementIndex,
    totalElements: allElements.length,
    selector: options.loopLocator
      ? `scoped within container`
      : locatorToSelector(locator),
    key: options.key,
    willUseIndex: elementIndex,
    isScoped: !!options.loopLocator,
  });

  // Validate index is within bounds
  if (elementIndex >= allElements.length) {
    console.warn(
      `Extract index ${elementIndex} is out of bounds. ` +
        `Found ${allElements.length} elements. Using index 0 instead.`
    );
  }

  // Ensure we use the correct index, clamping to valid range
  const safeIndex = elementIndex < allElements.length ? elementIndex : 0;
  const elements = options.multiple
    ? allElements
    : [allElements[safeIndex]].filter((el): el is Element => el !== null);

  console.log('Extract function: Element selection', {
    safeIndex,
    selectedElementIndex: safeIndex,
    selectedElementTag: elements[0]?.tagName,
    selectedElementId: elements[0]?.id,
    selectedElementText: elements[0]
      ? (elements[0] as HTMLElement).textContent?.substring(0, 50)
      : 'N/A',
  });

  const attribute = options.attribute ?? 'textContent';
  const targetElement = elements[0];

  // Highlight the element being extracted (visual feedback)
  if (targetElement) {
    try {
      const overlay = getGuideOverlay();
      overlay.highlight(targetElement, {
        color: '#3b82f6',
        borderRadius: 8,
        padding: 6,
      });
      // Show tooltip with extraction info
      overlay.showTooltip(
        targetElement,
        `Extracting: ${options.key}${attribute !== 'textContent' ? ` (${attribute})` : ''}`,
        { placement: 'bottom' }
      );
      // Clear highlight after a short delay
      setTimeout(() => {
        overlay.clear();
      }, 1000);
    } catch (error) {
      // Ignore highlighting errors - don't fail extraction if highlighting fails
      console.warn('Failed to highlight element during extraction', error);
    }
  }

  // Log extraction details for debugging
  if (targetElement) {
    const elementHtml = (targetElement as HTMLElement).outerHTML.substring(
      0,
      200
    );
    const allDataAttributes: Record<string, string> = {};
    Array.from(targetElement.attributes).forEach(attr => {
      if (attr.name.startsWith('data-')) {
        allDataAttributes[attr.name] = attr.value;
      }
    });

    console.log('Extract operation details', {
      key: options.key,
      attribute,
      elementIndex,
      totalElements: allElements.length,
      elementHtml,
      allDataAttributes,
      elementId: targetElement.id,
      elementClasses: targetElement.className,
    });
  }

  const extractValue = (el: Element): unknown => {
    if (attribute === 'textContent') {
      return (el as HTMLElement).textContent?.trim() ?? '';
    }
    if (attribute === 'innerHTML') {
      return (el as HTMLElement).innerHTML;
    }
    if (attribute === 'value') {
      return (
        (el as HTMLInputElement | HTMLTextAreaElement | HTMLSelectElement)
          .value ?? ''
      );
    }
    // Special handling for href extraction when extracting jobId
    if (attribute === 'href' && options.key === 'jobId') {
      const hrefProp = (el as HTMLAnchorElement).href;
      const hrefAttr = el.getAttribute('href');
      const href = hrefProp || hrefAttr || '';
      if (href) {
        try {
          const parsed = new URL(href, window.location.href);
          const jk = parsed.searchParams.get('jk')?.trim();
          const vjk = parsed.searchParams.get('vjk')?.trim();
          if (jk || vjk) {
            console.log('Job ID extracted from href URL', {
              href,
              extractedId: jk || vjk,
              source: 'href-url',
            });
            return jk || vjk;
          }
        } catch {
          // Fallback to regex if URL constructor fails
          const match = href.match(/[?&](?:jk|vjk)=([^&]+)/i);
          if (match?.[1]) {
            const extracted = decodeURIComponent(match[1]).trim();
            console.log('Job ID extracted from href URL (regex fallback)', {
              href,
              extractedId: extracted,
              source: 'href-url-regex',
            });
            return extracted;
          }
        }
      }
      // If no jobId found in href, return empty string (will trigger fallback logic)
      return '';
    }
    // Special handling for id extraction when extracting jobId
    if (attribute === 'id' && options.key === 'jobId') {
      const id = el.id || el.getAttribute('id') || '';
      if (id) {
        // Common patterns: sj_<jobKey>, job_<jobKey>, jobTitle-<jobKey>
        const match =
          id.match(/^(?:sj|job)[-_]([a-z0-9]+)$/i) ??
          id.match(/^jobTitle[-_]([a-z0-9]+)$/i);
        if (match?.[1]) {
          const extracted = match[1].trim();
          console.log('Job ID extracted from element ID pattern', {
            id,
            extractedId: extracted,
            source: 'element-id',
          });
          return extracted;
        }
      }
      // If no jobId found in id, return empty string (will trigger fallback logic)
      return '';
    }
    if (attribute.startsWith('data-')) {
      // Try exact attribute first
      let value = el.getAttribute(attribute) ?? '';
      const triedAttribute = attribute; // Remember what we tried first

      // Special handling for jobId extraction (data-jk attribute)
      if (value === '' && options.key === 'jobId' && attribute === 'data-jk') {
        console.log(
          'Job ID extraction: data-jk not found, trying fallback strategies',
          {
            triedAttribute,
            elementTag: el.tagName,
            elementId: el.id,
            elementClasses: el.className,
            elementHtml: (el as HTMLElement).outerHTML.substring(0, 200),
            allAttributes: Array.from(el.attributes).map(
              attr => `${attr.name}="${attr.value}"`
            ),
          }
        );

        const normalizeCandidate = (
          candidate: string | null | undefined
        ): string => (candidate ?? '').trim();

        const extractJobIdFromElementId = (
          id: string | null | undefined
        ): string => {
          const normalized = normalizeCandidate(id);
          if (!normalized) return '';
          // Common patterns seen on Indeed:
          // - job_<jobKey>
          // - sj_<jobKey> (sponsored)
          // - jobTitle-<jobKey>
          const match =
            normalized.match(/^(?:job|sj)[-_]([a-z0-9]+)$/i) ??
            normalized.match(/^jobTitle[-_]([a-z0-9]+)$/i);
          return match?.[1] ? match[1] : '';
        };

        const extractJobIdFromUrl = (
          url: string | null | undefined
        ): string => {
          const raw = normalizeCandidate(url);
          if (!raw) return '';
          try {
            const parsed = new URL(raw, window.location.href);
            const jk = normalizeCandidate(parsed.searchParams.get('jk'));
            const vjk = normalizeCandidate(parsed.searchParams.get('vjk'));
            return jk || vjk;
          } catch {
            // Fallback to regex if URL constructor fails
            const match = raw.match(/[?&](?:jk|vjk)=([^&]+)/i);
            return match?.[1] ? decodeURIComponent(match[1]) : '';
          }
        };

        // 1) Try alternative attribute names on the same element
        const fallbackAttributes = [
          'data-jk',
          'jk',
          'data-job-id',
          'data-jobId',
          'data-jobkey',
          'data-job-key',
        ];
        for (const fallbackAttr of fallbackAttributes) {
          if (fallbackAttr === attribute) continue; // Skip already tried
          value = el.getAttribute(fallbackAttr) ?? '';
          if (value !== '' && value.trim() !== '') {
            console.log(
              `Job ID found using fallback attribute: ${fallbackAttr}`,
              {
                value,
                elementIndex,
                source: 'fallback-attribute',
              }
            );
            break;
          }
        }

        // 2) Try extracting from element id patterns (job_<id>, sj_<id>, jobTitle-<id>)
        if (value === '' && el.id) {
          const fromId = extractJobIdFromElementId(el.id);
          if (fromId) {
            value = fromId;
            console.log('Job ID extracted from element id pattern', {
              elementId: el.id,
              extractedId: value,
              source: 'element-id',
            });
          }
        }

        // 3) Try extracting from href URL (e.g., "viewjob?jk=abc123" or "rc/clk?jk=abc123")
        if (value === '') {
          const hrefProp = (el as HTMLAnchorElement).href;
          const hrefAttr = el.getAttribute('href');
          const fromUrl = extractJobIdFromUrl(hrefProp || hrefAttr);
          if (fromUrl) {
            value = fromUrl;
            console.log('Job ID extracted from link URL', {
              href: hrefProp || hrefAttr,
              extractedId: value,
              source: 'link-url',
            });
          }
        }

        // 4) If still empty, try a nearby ancestor (some layouts keep job key on parent container)
        if (value === '') {
          let parent = el.parentElement;
          let level = 0;
          const maxLevels = 6;
          while (parent && level < maxLevels && value === '') {
            const parentAttr =
              normalizeCandidate(parent.getAttribute('data-jk')) ||
              normalizeCandidate(parent.getAttribute('data-jobkey')) ||
              normalizeCandidate(parent.getAttribute('data-job-key'));
            if (parentAttr) {
              value = parentAttr;
              console.log('Job ID extracted from parent data attribute', {
                parentLevel: level,
                parentTag: parent.tagName,
                parentId: parent.id,
                extractedId: value,
                source: 'parent-data-attr',
              });
              break;
            }

            const fromParentId = extractJobIdFromElementId(parent.id);
            if (fromParentId) {
              value = fromParentId;
              console.log('Job ID extracted from parent id pattern', {
                parentLevel: level,
                parentTag: parent.tagName,
                parentId: parent.id,
                extractedId: value,
                source: 'parent-id',
              });
              break;
            }

            parent = parent.parentElement;
            level++;
          }
        }

        // 5) If still empty, try a descendant element (some layouts put job key on nested span)
        if (value === '' && (el as HTMLElement).querySelector) {
          const descendant = (el as HTMLElement).querySelector(
            '[data-jk], [data-jobkey], [data-job-key], [id^="job_"], [id^="sj_"], [id^="jobTitle-"]'
          ) as HTMLElement | null;

          if (descendant) {
            const descendantAttr =
              normalizeCandidate(descendant.getAttribute('data-jk')) ||
              normalizeCandidate(descendant.getAttribute('data-jobkey')) ||
              normalizeCandidate(descendant.getAttribute('data-job-key'));
            const descendantId = extractJobIdFromElementId(descendant.id);
            const fromDescendant = descendantAttr || descendantId;
            if (fromDescendant) {
              value = fromDescendant;
              console.log('Job ID extracted from descendant element', {
                descendantTag: descendant.tagName,
                descendantId: descendant.id,
                extractedId: value,
                source: 'descendant',
              });
            }
          }
        }
      }

      // If empty and this is a patient ID extraction, try comprehensive fallback strategy
      if (value === '' && options.key === 'patientId') {
        console.log(
          'Patient ID extraction: Starting comprehensive fallback search',
          {
            triedAttribute,
            elementTag: el.tagName,
            elementId: el.id,
            elementClasses: el.className,
          }
        );
        // Fallback attributes to try (skip the one we already tried)
        const fallbackAttributes = [
          'data-patient-id',
          'data-patientId',
          'data-id',
          'data-row-id',
          'data-record-id',
          'id',
        ].filter(attr => attr !== triedAttribute); // Skip already-tried attribute

        // Also try camelCase and kebab-case variations
        const additionalAttributes = [
          'dataPatientId',
          'dataPatientID',
          'dataRowId',
          'dataRecordId',
        ];

        // Try fallbacks on same element
        for (const fallbackAttr of fallbackAttributes) {
          if (fallbackAttr === 'id') {
            value = el.id ?? '';
          } else {
            value = el.getAttribute(fallbackAttr) ?? '';
          }

          if (value !== '' && value.trim() !== '') {
            console.log(
              `Patient ID found on element using fallback attribute: ${fallbackAttr}`,
              {
                value,
                elementIndex,
                source: 'element',
              }
            );
            break;
          }
        }

        // Try additional camelCase attributes via property access
        if (value === '') {
          for (const attr of additionalAttributes) {
            const elAny = el as any;
            if (elAny[attr] && String(elAny[attr]).trim() !== '') {
              value = String(elAny[attr]);
              console.log(
                `Patient ID found on element using camelCase property: ${attr}`,
                {
                  value,
                  elementIndex,
                  source: 'element-property',
                }
              );
              break;
            }
          }
        }

        // If still empty, try extracting from element ID pattern (e.g., "patient-123")
        if (value === '' && el.id) {
          const idMatch = el.id.match(/patient[-_]?(\d+)/i);
          if (idMatch && idMatch[1]) {
            value = idMatch[1];
            console.log('Patient ID extracted from element ID pattern', {
              elementId: el.id,
              extractedId: value,
              source: 'element-id-pattern',
            });
          }
        }

        // If still empty, check parent element (likely <tr> or row container)
        if (value === '') {
          let parent = el.parentElement;
          let parentLevel = 0;
          const maxParentLevels = 5; // Increased to check more levels

          while (parent && parentLevel < maxParentLevels) {
            // Log parent details for debugging
            const parentDataAttrs: Record<string, string> = {};
            Array.from(parent.attributes).forEach(attr => {
              if (attr.name.startsWith('data-')) {
                parentDataAttrs[attr.name] = attr.value;
              }
            });

            console.log(`Checking parent level ${parentLevel}`, {
              parentTag: parent.tagName,
              parentId: parent.id,
              parentClasses: parent.className,
              parentDataAttributes: parentDataAttrs,
            });

            // Try all fallback attributes on parent (including the original tried attribute)
            const parentAttributesToTry = [
              'data-patient-id',
              'data-patientId',
              'data-id',
              'data-row-id',
              'data-record-id',
              'id',
            ];

            for (const fallbackAttr of parentAttributesToTry) {
              let parentValue = '';
              if (fallbackAttr === 'id') {
                parentValue = parent.id ?? '';
              } else {
                parentValue = parent.getAttribute(fallbackAttr) ?? '';
              }

              if (parentValue !== '' && parentValue.trim() !== '') {
                value = parentValue;
                console.log(
                  `Patient ID found on parent element (level ${parentLevel}) using attribute: ${fallbackAttr}`,
                  {
                    value,
                    elementIndex,
                    source: `parent-level-${parentLevel}`,
                    parentTag: parent.tagName,
                    parentId: parent.id,
                    parentClasses: parent.className,
                  }
                );
                break;
              }
            }

            // If found, stop searching
            if (value !== '') {
              break;
            }

            // Try extracting from parent ID pattern (more patterns)
            if (value === '' && parent.id) {
              const patterns = [
                /patient[-_]?(\d+)/i,
                /row[-_]?(\d+)/i,
                /record[-_]?(\d+)/i,
                /id[-_]?(\d+)/i,
                /(\d+)/, // Just numbers
              ];

              for (const pattern of patterns) {
                const idMatch = parent.id.match(pattern);
                if (idMatch && idMatch[1]) {
                  value = idMatch[1];
                  console.log(
                    `Patient ID extracted from parent element (level ${parentLevel}) ID pattern`,
                    {
                      parentId: parent.id,
                      extractedId: value,
                      pattern: pattern.toString(),
                      source: `parent-level-${parentLevel}-id-pattern`,
                    }
                  );
                  break;
                }
              }

              if (value !== '') {
                break;
              }
            }

            // Try camelCase properties on parent
            if (value === '') {
              const parentAny = parent as any;
              for (const attr of additionalAttributes) {
                if (parentAny[attr] && String(parentAny[attr]).trim() !== '') {
                  value = String(parentAny[attr]);
                  console.log(
                    `Patient ID found on parent (level ${parentLevel}) using camelCase property: ${attr}`,
                    {
                      value,
                      elementIndex,
                      source: `parent-level-${parentLevel}-property`,
                    }
                  );
                  break;
                }
              }
            }

            if (value !== '') {
              break;
            }

            // Move up to next parent
            parent = parent.parentElement;
            parentLevel++;
          }
        }

        // If still empty, check closest ancestor with data-* attributes
        if (value === '') {
          let ancestor = el.parentElement;
          let ancestorLevel = 0;
          const maxAncestorLevels = 5;

          while (ancestor && ancestorLevel < maxAncestorLevels) {
            // Check if ancestor has any data-* attributes
            const hasDataAttrs = Array.from(ancestor.attributes).some(attr =>
              attr.name.startsWith('data-')
            );

            if (hasDataAttrs) {
              // Try all data-* attributes on this ancestor
              const ancestorDataAttrs: Record<string, string> = {};
              const attributes = Array.from(ancestor.attributes);

              for (const attr of attributes) {
                if (attr.name.startsWith('data-')) {
                  ancestorDataAttrs[attr.name] = attr.value;
                  // Check if this looks like a patient ID
                  if (
                    attr.name.includes('patient') ||
                    attr.name.includes('id')
                  ) {
                    const attrValue = attr.value;
                    if (attrValue && attrValue.trim() !== '') {
                      value = attrValue;
                      console.log(
                        `Patient ID found on ancestor (level ${ancestorLevel}) using data attribute: ${attr.name}`,
                        {
                          value,
                          elementIndex,
                          source: `ancestor-level-${ancestorLevel}`,
                          ancestorTag: ancestor.tagName,
                          ancestorId: ancestor.id,
                        }
                      );
                      break;
                    }
                  }
                }
              }

              if (value !== '') {
                break;
              }
            }

            ancestor = ancestor.parentElement;
            ancestorLevel++;
          }
        }

        // If still empty, use row index as final fallback patient ID
        if (value === '') {
          // Use zero-padded index as patient ID (e.g., "001", "002", etc.)
          const paddedIndex = String(elementIndex + 1).padStart(3, '0');
          value = paddedIndex;
          console.warn(
            'Patient ID extraction failed - using row index as fallback',
            {
              attribute: triedAttribute,
              fallbackPatientId: value,
              elementIndex,
              note: 'Using zero-padded row index as patient ID (e.g., 001, 002)',
            }
          );

          // Also log available attributes for debugging
          const availableDataAttrs: Record<string, string> = {};
          Array.from(el.attributes).forEach(attr => {
            if (attr.name.startsWith('data-')) {
              availableDataAttrs[attr.name] = attr.value;
            }
          });

          const parentDataAttrs: Record<string, string> = {};
          if (el.parentElement) {
            Array.from(el.parentElement.attributes).forEach(attr => {
              if (attr.name.startsWith('data-')) {
                parentDataAttrs[attr.name] = attr.value;
              }
            });
          }

          console.warn('Patient ID extraction details (using fallback)', {
            attribute: triedAttribute,
            fallbackAttributes,
            elementId: el.id,
            elementClasses: el.className,
            elementDataAttributes: availableDataAttrs,
            parentTag: el.parentElement?.tagName,
            parentId: el.parentElement?.id,
            parentDataAttributes: parentDataAttrs,
            fallbackValue: value,
          });
        }
      }

      return value;
    }
    // Generic attribute
    return (
      el.getAttribute(attribute) ??
      ((el as HTMLElement)[attribute as keyof HTMLElement] as
        | string
        | null
        | undefined) ??
      ''
    );
  };

  if (options.multiple === true) {
    return elements.map(extractValue);
  }
  const firstElement = elements[0];
  if (firstElement === undefined) {
    throw new Error('No element found for extraction');
  }

  const extractedValue = extractValue(firstElement);

  // Log extraction result
  console.log('Extract result', {
    key: options.key,
    attribute,
    elementIndex,
    extractedValue:
      typeof extractedValue === 'string'
        ? extractedValue.substring(0, 100)
        : extractedValue,
    isEmpty: !extractedValue || String(extractedValue).trim() === '',
  });

  return extractedValue;
}

async function captureHtml(locator?: Locator): Promise<string> {
  if (locator) {
    const selector = locatorToSelector(locator);
    const element = queryElement(selector);
    if (!element) {
      throw new Error(`Element not found for HTML capture: ${selector}`);
    }
    return (element as HTMLElement).outerHTML;
  }
  // Default to entire document
  return document.documentElement.outerHTML;
}

async function selectDropdown(locator: Locator, value: string): Promise<void> {
  // Try fallback selectors if the primary one fails
  const fallbackSelectors: string[] = [];

  // If the locator is a CSS selector, try fallback patterns
  if (locator.by === 'css' && locator.selector) {
    const primarySelector = locator.selector;
    fallbackSelectors.push(primarySelector);

    // If primary selector targets .ui-select-container, try variations
    if (primarySelector.includes('.ui-select-container')) {
      // Try with actual footer structure (based on real HTML)
      fallbackSelectors.push('.grid-footer-left-section .ui-select-container');
      fallbackSelectors.push('.grid-footer-left-section .av-select.pageSize');
      fallbackSelectors.push('.pageSize.ui-select-container');
      fallbackSelectors.push('.av-select.pageSize.ui-select-container');
      // Try without the parent context
      fallbackSelectors.push('.ui-select-container');
      // Try with alternative parent contexts
      fallbackSelectors.push('.ui-grid .ui-select-container');
      fallbackSelectors.push('.ayva-data-table .ui-select-container');
      fallbackSelectors.push('[class*="grid"] .ui-select-container');
    }

    // Try native select fallbacks
    if (
      primarySelector.includes('perPage') ||
      primarySelector.includes('pageSize')
    ) {
      fallbackSelectors.push('select[name*="perPage"]');
      fallbackSelectors.push('select[name*="pageSize"]');
      fallbackSelectors.push('select[ng-model*="pageSize"]');
    }
  } else {
    fallbackSelectors.push(locatorToSelector(locator));
  }

  let element: Element | null = null;
  let triedSelectors: string[] = [];

  // Try each selector until one works
  for (const selector of fallbackSelectors) {
    triedSelectors.push(selector);
    element = queryElement(selector);
    if (element) {
      break;
    }
    // Wait a bit before trying next selector
    await sleep(100);
  }

  if (!element) {
    throw new Error(
      `Dropdown not found. Tried selectors: ${triedSelectors.join(', ')}`
    );
  }

  // Handle UI-select (Angular UI Bootstrap select)
  // Check if element itself is a ui-select-container
  let uiSelect: Element | null = null;
  if (element.classList.contains('ui-select-container')) {
    uiSelect = element;
  } else {
    // Try to find parent ui-select-container
    uiSelect = element.closest('.ui-select-container');
  }

  if (uiSelect) {
    // Scroll into view
    uiSelect.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
    await sleep(200);

    // Click to open dropdown - try multiple toggle selectors
    const toggleSelectors = [
      '.ui-select-toggle',
      '.ui-select-match',
      'button',
      'a',
      '[role="button"]',
    ];

    let toggleClicked = false;
    for (const toggleSelector of toggleSelectors) {
      const toggle = uiSelect.querySelector(toggleSelector);
      if (toggle && (toggle as HTMLElement).offsetParent !== null) {
        (toggle as HTMLElement).click();
        toggleClicked = true;
        await sleep(500); // Wait for dropdown to open
        break;
      }
    }

    if (!toggleClicked) {
      // Fallback: click the container itself
      (uiSelect as HTMLElement).click();
      await sleep(500);
    }

    // Wait for dropdown options to appear
    let options: Element[] = [];
    const maxWait = 3000;
    const startTime = Date.now();

    while (options.length === 0 && Date.now() - startTime < maxWait) {
      // Try multiple option selectors
      const optionSelectors = [
        '.ui-select-choices-row',
        '.ui-select-choices .ui-select-choices-row',
        '.dropdown-menu li',
        '[role="option"]',
        '.ui-select-choices-row-inner',
      ];

      for (const optionSelector of optionSelectors) {
        options = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(optionSelector));
        if (options.length > 0) {
          break;
        }
      }

      if (options.length === 0) {
        await sleep(100);
      }
    }

    if (options.length === 0) {
      throw new Error(
        `Dropdown options not found after opening. Selector: ${triedSelectors.join(', ')}`
      );
    }

    // Find and click the option with matching value
    let optionFound = false;
    for (const option of options) {
      const optionText = (option as HTMLElement).textContent?.trim();
      const optionValue =
        (option as HTMLElement).getAttribute('data-value') ||
        (option as HTMLElement).getAttribute('value') ||
        optionText;

      if (
        optionText === value ||
        optionValue === value ||
        optionText?.includes(value) ||
        optionValue?.includes(value)
      ) {
        // Scroll option into view
        option.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
        await sleep(200);

        (option as HTMLElement).click();
        await sleep(500); // Wait for selection to apply

        optionFound = true;
        break;
      }
    }

    if (!optionFound) {
      const availableOptions = options
        .slice(0, 5)
        .map(opt => (opt as HTMLElement).textContent?.trim() || '')
        .join(', ');
      throw new Error(
        `Option "${value}" not found in dropdown. Available options (first 5): ${availableOptions}`
      );
    }

    return;
  }

  // Handle native select element
  const selectElement = element as HTMLSelectElement;
  if (selectElement.tagName === 'SELECT') {
    selectElement.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
    await sleep(200);

    // Try to find option by value or text
    const option = Array.from(selectElement.options).find(
      opt =>
        opt.value === value ||
        opt.textContent?.trim() === value ||
        opt.textContent?.trim().includes(value)
    );

    if (!option) {
      const availableOptions = Array.from(selectElement.options)
        .slice(0, 5)
        .map(opt => opt.textContent?.trim() || opt.value)
        .join(', ');
      throw new Error(
        `Option "${value}" not found in select. Available options (first 5): ${availableOptions}`
      );
    }

    selectElement.value = option.value;
    selectElement.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
    selectElement.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
    await sleep(300);
    return;
  }

  throw new Error(
    `Unsupported dropdown type. Element: ${element.tagName}, Selectors tried: ${triedSelectors.join(', ')}`
  );
}

async function waitForPagination(
  locator: Locator,
  expectedCount?: number,
  timeout: number = 10000
): Promise<void> {
  const selector = locatorToSelector(locator);
  const start = Date.now();

  while (Date.now() - start < timeout) {
    const elements = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(selector));
    const count = elements.length;

    // If expected count provided, wait until we have that many
    if (expectedCount !== undefined && expectedCount !== null) {
      if (count >= expectedCount) {
        // Wait a bit more to ensure pagination is complete
        await sleep(500);
        return;
      }
    } else {
      // Wait for count to stabilize (no change for 500ms)
      await sleep(500);
      const newCount = document.querySelectorAll(selector).length;
      if (newCount === count) {
        return; // Count stabilized
      }
    }

    await sleep(200);
  }

  const finalCount = document.querySelectorAll(selector).length;
  if (expectedCount !== undefined && finalCount < expectedCount) {
    throw new Error(
      `Pagination timeout: expected ${expectedCount} items, got ${finalCount}`
    );
  }
}

async function navigateBack(): Promise<void> {
  // Use browser history API
  window.history.back();
  await sleep(1000); // Wait for navigation
}

async function getElementCount(locator: Locator): Promise<number> {
  const selector = locatorToSelector(locator);
  return document.querySelectorAll(selector).length;
}

let isRecipeHandlerRegistered = false;

// Message handler for recipe execution (register once per content script load)
export function registerContentRecipeHandler(): void {
  if (isRecipeHandlerRegistered) {
    return;
  }
  isRecipeHandlerRegistered = true;

  chrome.runtime.onMessage.addListener(
    (msg: any, _sender: any, sendResponse: (response?: any) => void) => {
      // Track if we've already sent a response to prevent double-sending
      let responseSent = false;

      // Safe wrapper for sendResponse that checks if channel is still open
      const safeSendResponse = (response: any): boolean => {
        if (responseSent) {
          return false; // Already responded
        }

        try {
          // Check if runtime is still available (indicates channel might be open)
          if (chrome.runtime?.id === undefined) {
            return false; // Extension context invalidated
          }

          sendResponse(response);
          responseSent = true;
          return true;
        } catch (error) {
          // Channel may have closed - this is expected in some cases
          // Log for debugging but don't throw
          console.debug(
            'Failed to send response (channel may be closed):',
            error
          );
          return false;
        }
      };

      (async () => {
        // Ping handler for readiness check - respond immediately
        if (msg?.type === 'PING') {
          safeSendResponse({ ok: true, ready: true });
          return;
        }

        if (msg?.type === 'RECIPE_EXEC') {
          const { fn, args } = msg as {
            fn: string;
            args: Record<string, unknown>;
          };

          try {
            switch (fn) {
              case 'waitFor':
                await waitForState(args.state);
                break;
              case 'assertVisible':
                await assertVisible(args.locator as Locator);
                break;
              case 'click':
                // Clear first to prevent stale loop index from previous loop-scoped clicks.
                setLoopIndex(null);
                // Set loop index if provided
                if (args.loopIndex !== undefined) {
                  setLoopIndex(args.loopIndex as number);
                }
                await click(
                  args.locator as Locator,
                  args.loopIndex as number | undefined,
                  args.loopLocator as Locator | undefined
                );
                // Always clear after click to avoid leaking loop state into top-level clicks.
                setLoopIndex(null);
                break;
              case 'fill':
                await fill(args.locator as Locator, String(args.value ?? ''));
                break;
              case 'type':
                await type(args.locator as Locator, String(args.value ?? ''));
                break;
              case 'extract':
                // Clear currentLoopIndex first to avoid stale values
                setLoopIndex(null);
                // Set loop index if provided
                if (args.loopIndex !== undefined) {
                  setLoopIndex(args.loopIndex as number);
                }
                // Use the provided loopIndex directly, not currentLoopIndex
                const extractLoopIndex =
                  args.loopIndex !== undefined
                    ? (args.loopIndex as number)
                    : undefined;
                console.log('Extract called with loopIndex', {
                  providedLoopIndex: args.loopIndex,
                  extractLoopIndex,
                  currentLoopIndexAfterSet: currentLoopIndex,
                  key: args.key,
                  locator: args.locator,
                });
                const extracted = await extract(args.locator as Locator, {
                  key: String(args.key ?? ''),
                  multiple: Boolean(args.multiple),
                  attribute: String(args.attribute ?? 'textContent'),
                  index: extractLoopIndex,
                  loopLocator: args.loopLocator as Locator | undefined,
                  optional: Boolean(args.optional),
                });
                // Clear loop index after extraction to prevent stale values
                setLoopIndex(null);
                safeSendResponse({ ok: true, data: extracted });
                return;
              case 'captureHtml':
                const html = await captureHtml(
                  args.locator as Locator | undefined
                );
                safeSendResponse({ ok: true, html });
                return;
              case 'selectDropdown':
                await selectDropdown(
                  args.locator as Locator,
                  String(args.value ?? '')
                );
                break;
              case 'waitForPagination':
                await waitForPagination(
                  args.locator as Locator,
                  args.expectedCount as number | undefined,
                  (args.timeout as number | undefined) ?? 10000
                );
                break;
              case 'navigateBack':
                await navigateBack();
                break;
              case 'getElementCount':
                const count = await getElementCount(args.locator as Locator);
                safeSendResponse({ ok: true, count });
                return;
              case 'getReadyState':
                // Return document readyState without any delay
                // This is used to quickly check if page is already loaded
                safeSendResponse({ ok: true, readyState: document.readyState });
                return;
              case 'loopIteration':
                // Loop iteration is handled by the executor, but we acknowledge it
                // Set the current loop index for use in subsequent click/extract operations
                if (args.index !== undefined) {
                  setLoopIndex(args.index as number);
                }
                break;
              default:
                throw new Error(`Unknown function: ${fn}`);
            }
            safeSendResponse({ ok: true });
          } catch (error) {
            safeSendResponse({
              ok: false,
              error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
            });
          }
          return;
        }
      })().catch(err => {
        // Only send error response if we haven't already responded
        if (!responseSent) {
          safeSendResponse({
            ok: false,
            error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err),
          });
        }
      });

      // Return true to indicate we'll respond asynchronously
      // This keeps the message channel open
      return true;
    }
  );
}

/**
 * Error Recovery Framework
 *
 * Provides context-aware error recovery for recipe execution.
 */

import type { RecipeStep, ExecutionContext } from './types.js';
import { logger } from '@chrome-ext/core-telemetry';

export type ErrorType =
  | 'NAVIGATION_ERROR'
  | 'SELECTOR_ERROR'
  | 'TIMEOUT_ERROR'
  | 'VALIDATION_ERROR'
  | 'UNKNOWN_ERROR';

export type RecoveryAction = 'pause' | 'prompt' | 'retry' | 'skip' | 'abort';

export interface ErrorRecoveryContext {
  errorType: ErrorType;
  step: RecipeStep;
  stepIndex: number;
  stepName: string;
  error: Error;
  context: ExecutionContext;
  recoveryAction: RecoveryAction;
  metadata?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

export interface RecoveryHandler {
  canHandle(errorType: ErrorType): boolean;
  handle(context: ErrorRecoveryContext): Promise<RecoveryResult>;
}

export interface RecoveryResult {
  success: boolean;
  action: 'resume' | 'retry' | 'skip' | 'abort';
  updatedStep?: RecipeStep;
  error?: string;
}

/**
 * Error Recovery Context Builder
 */
export class ErrorRecoveryContextBuilder {
  private context: Partial<ErrorRecoveryContext> = {};

  setErrorType(errorType: ErrorType): this {
    this.context.errorType = errorType;
    return this;
  }

  setStep(step: RecipeStep, stepIndex: number, stepName: string): this {
    this.context.step = step;
    this.context.stepIndex = stepIndex;
    this.context.stepName = stepName;
    return this;
  }

  setError(error: Error): this {
    this.context.error = error;
    return this;
  }

  setExecutionContext(context: ExecutionContext): this {
    this.context.context = context;
    return this;
  }

  setRecoveryAction(action: RecoveryAction): this {
    this.context.recoveryAction = action;
    return this;
  }

  setMetadata(metadata: Record<string, unknown>): this {
    this.context.metadata = metadata;
    return this;
  }

  build(): ErrorRecoveryContext {
    if (
      !this.context.errorType ||
      !this.context.step ||
      this.context.stepIndex === undefined ||
      !this.context.stepName ||
      !this.context.error ||
      !this.context.context
    ) {
      throw new Error('ErrorRecoveryContext is incomplete');
    }
    return this.context as ErrorRecoveryContext;
  }
}

/**
 * Base Recovery Handler
 */
export abstract class BaseRecoveryHandler implements RecoveryHandler {
  abstract canHandle(errorType: ErrorType): boolean;
  abstract handle(context: ErrorRecoveryContext): Promise<RecoveryResult>;

  protected logRecovery(context: ErrorRecoveryContext, action: string): void {
    logger.info('Error recovery action', {
      errorType: context.errorType,
      stepIndex: context.stepIndex,
      stepName: context.stepName,
      action,
      correlationId: context.context.correlationId,
    });
  }
}

/**
 * Navigation Error Handler
 */
export class NavigationRecoveryHandler extends BaseRecoveryHandler {
  canHandle(errorType: ErrorType): boolean {
    return errorType === 'NAVIGATION_ERROR';
  }

  async handle(context: ErrorRecoveryContext): Promise<RecoveryResult> {
    this.logRecovery(context, 'navigation_recovery');
    
    // Navigation errors should pause and prompt user
    if (context.recoveryAction === 'prompt' || context.recoveryAction === 'pause') {
      return {
        success: true,
        action: 'resume', // Will be handled by UI prompt
      };
    }

    // Default: retry
    return {
      success: true,
      action: 'retry',
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Selector Error Handler
 */
export class SelectorRecoveryHandler extends BaseRecoveryHandler {
  canHandle(errorType: ErrorType): boolean {
    return errorType === 'SELECTOR_ERROR';
  }

  async handle(context: ErrorRecoveryContext): Promise<RecoveryResult> {
    this.logRecovery(context, 'selector_recovery');
    
    // Selector errors should prompt user to select element
    if (context.recoveryAction === 'prompt' || context.recoveryAction === 'pause') {
      return {
        success: true,
        action: 'resume', // Will be handled by UI prompt with element selection
      };
    }

    // Default: skip if optional, otherwise retry
    if (context.step.optional) {
      return {
        success: true,
        action: 'skip',
      };
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      action: 'retry',
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Timeout Error Handler
 */
export class TimeoutRecoveryHandler extends BaseRecoveryHandler {
  canHandle(errorType: ErrorType): boolean {
    return errorType === 'TIMEOUT_ERROR';
  }

  async handle(context: ErrorRecoveryContext): Promise<RecoveryResult> {
    this.logRecovery(context, 'timeout_recovery');
    
    // Timeout errors can be retried or skipped
    if (context.recoveryAction === 'retry') {
      return {
        success: true,
        action: 'retry',
      };
    }

    if (context.step.optional || context.recoveryAction === 'skip') {
      return {
        success: true,
        action: 'skip',
      };
    }

    // Default: prompt user
    return {
      success: true,
      action: 'resume',
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Validation Error Handler
 */
export class ValidationRecoveryHandler extends BaseRecoveryHandler {
  canHandle(errorType: ErrorType): boolean {
    return errorType === 'VALIDATION_ERROR';
  }

  async handle(context: ErrorRecoveryContext): Promise<RecoveryResult> {
    this.logRecovery(context, 'validation_recovery');
    
    // Validation errors typically should not be skipped automatically
    if (context.recoveryAction === 'skip' && context.step.optional) {
      return {
        success: true,
        action: 'skip',
      };
    }

    // Default: abort or prompt
    return {
      success: false,
      action: 'abort',
      error: 'Validation error requires user intervention',
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Recovery Handler Registry
 */
export class RecoveryHandlerRegistry {
  private handlers: RecoveryHandler[] = [];

  constructor() {
    // Register default handlers
    this.register(new NavigationRecoveryHandler());
    this.register(new SelectorRecoveryHandler());
    this.register(new TimeoutRecoveryHandler());
    this.register(new ValidationRecoveryHandler());
  }

  register(handler: RecoveryHandler): void {
    this.handlers.push(handler);
  }

  getHandler(errorType: ErrorType): RecoveryHandler | null {
    return this.handlers.find(h => h.canHandle(errorType)) ?? null;
  }

  async handleError(context: ErrorRecoveryContext): Promise<RecoveryResult> {
    const handler = this.getHandler(context.errorType);
    if (!handler) {
      logger.warn('No recovery handler found', { errorType: context.errorType });
      return {
        success: false,
        action: 'abort',
        error: `No recovery handler for error type: ${context.errorType}`,
      };
    }

    return handler.handle(context);
  }
}

/**
 * Classify error type from error message/error object
 */
export function classifyError(error: Error, step: RecipeStep): ErrorType {
  const message = error.message.toLowerCase();
  const name = error.name.toLowerCase();

  // Navigation errors
  if (
    message.includes('navigation') ||
    message.includes('goto') ||
    message.includes('url') ||
    step.type === 'goto'
  ) {
    return 'NAVIGATION_ERROR';
  }

  // Selector errors
  if (
    message.includes('selector') ||
    message.includes('element not found') ||
    message.includes('locator') ||
    message.includes('not visible') ||
    ['click', 'fill', 'type', 'assertVisible', 'extract'].includes(step.type)
  ) {
    return 'SELECTOR_ERROR';
  }

  // Timeout errors
  if (
    message.includes('timeout') ||
    message.includes('timed out') ||
    name.includes('timeout')
  ) {
    return 'TIMEOUT_ERROR';
  }

  // Validation errors
  if (
    message.includes('validation') ||
    message.includes('assert') ||
    message.includes('expected') ||
    step.type === 'assertVisible' ||
    step.type === 'validateFolder' ||
    step.type === 'validateFile'
  ) {
    return 'VALIDATION_ERROR';
  }

  return 'UNKNOWN_ERROR';
}
