                    (nestedStep.locator.selector?.includes(
                      '.patient-name'
                    ) ||
                      nestedStep.locator.selector?.includes(
                        'edit-encounter-link'
                      ))) ||
                  (nestedStep.locator?.by === 'role' &&
                    nestedStep.locator.role === 'tab');
                if (
                  isPatientPanelClick &&
                  context.variables?.patientFolder
                ) {
                  const patientFolder = String(
                    context.variables.patientFolder
                  );
                  const baseFolderForPaths =
                    typeof context.variables.baseFolder === 'string'
                      ? context.variables.baseFolder
                      : '';
                  metadata.expectedFilePaths = {
                    profileHtml: baseFolderForPaths
                      ? `${baseFolderForPaths}/${patientFolder}/profile.html`
                      : `${patientFolder}/profile.html`,
                    medicalHistoryHtml: baseFolderForPaths
                      ? `${baseFolderForPaths}/${patientFolder}/medical-history.html`
                      : `${patientFolder}/medical-history.html`,
                    allergiesHtml: baseFolderForPaths
                      ? `${baseFolderForPaths}/${patientFolder}/allergies.html`
                      : `${patientFolder}/allergies.html`,
                  };
                }
              }

              onStepProgress({
                stepIndex: i,
                stepName: `${stepName} > ${nestedStepName}`,
                stepType: nestedStep.type,
                status: 'completed',
                metadata:
                  Object.keys(metadata).length > 0 ? metadata : undefined,
              });
            }
          } catch (error) {
            if (error instanceof BreakLoopError) {
              logger.info('Breaking loop due to breakIf condition', {
                stepName: `${stepName} > ${nestedStepName}`,
                stepType: nestedStep.type,
                message: error.message,
              });
              shouldBreakLoop = true;
              break;
            }
            // Check if this is a SkipIterationError - if so, skip the entire loop iteration
            if (error instanceof SkipIterationError) {
              logger.info('Skipping loop iteration due to skipIf condition', {
                stepName: `${stepName} > ${nestedStepName}`,
                stepType: nestedStep.type,
                message: error.message,
              });
              // Break out of nested steps loop and continue to next loop iteration
              break;
            }

            const errorMessage =
              error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);

            // Report nested step failure
            if (
              onStepProgress &&
              typeof __DEV__ !== 'undefined' &&
              __DEV__
            ) {
              onStepProgress({
                stepIndex: i,
                stepName: `${stepName} > ${nestedStepName}`,
                stepType: nestedStep.type,
                status: 'failed',
                error: errorMessage,
              });
            }

            // If step is optional, log warning and continue
            if (nestedStep.optional === true) {
              logger.warn('Optional step failed, continuing', {
                stepName: `${stepName} > ${nestedStepName}`,
                error: errorMessage,
              });

              // For optional extract steps, set a default value based on extractKey
              if (nestedStep.type === 'extract') {
                const extractKey = getExtractKey(nestedStep);
                if (extractKey) {
                  applyOptionalExtractDefault(
                    extractKey,
                    context,
                    extractedData,
                    options
                  );
                }
              }

              continue; // Skip this step and continue with next
            }

            // Before returning failure, try to save checkpoint if this was a saveCheckpoint step
            // This ensures partial data is preserved even if recipe fails
            if (
              nestedStep.type === 'saveCheckpoint' &&
              nestedStep.checkpointId
            ) {
              try {
                const substitutedCheckpointId = substituteVariables(
                  nestedStep.checkpointId,
                  context,
                  options
                );
                const substitutedCheckpointMetadata = nestedStep.metadata
                  ? substituteVariablesInObject(
                      nestedStep.metadata,
                      context,
                      options
                    )
                  : {};
                await runtime.saveCheckpoint(
                  substitutedCheckpointId,
                  substitutedCheckpointMetadata
                );
                logger.info('Saved checkpoint before nested step failure', {
                  checkpointId: substitutedCheckpointId,
                  stepName: `${stepName} > ${nestedStepName}`,
                });
              } catch (checkpointError) {
                logger.warn(
                  'Failed to save checkpoint before nested step failure',
                  checkpointError as Error,
                  {
                    stepName: `${stepName} > ${nestedStepName}`,
                  }
                );
              }
            }

            return {
              success: false,
              error: errorMessage,
              stepIndex: i,
              stepName: `${stepName} > ${nestedStepName}`,
              data:
                Object.keys(extractedData).length > 0
                  ? extractedData
                  : undefined,
            };
          }
        }

        if (shouldBreakLoop) {
          if (typeof __DEV__ !== 'undefined' && __DEV__) {
            logger.info('Breaking out of loop after breakIf condition', {
              variable: step.variable,
              loopIndex,
              total: maxIterations,
            });
          }
          break;
        }

        if (persistVariables.length > 0 && context.variables) {
          for (const key of persistVariables) {
            if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(context.variables, key)) {
              preLoopVariables[key] = context.variables[key];
            } else {
              delete preLoopVariables[key];
            }
          }
        }

        // Calculate expected file paths at end of iteration for comparison
        const expectedPathsAtEnd: Record<string, string> = {};
        const baseFolderForPathsEnd =
          typeof context.variables?.baseFolder === 'string'
            ? context.variables.baseFolder
            : '';

        if (context.variables?.patientFolder) {
          const patientFolder = String(context.variables.patientFolder);
          expectedPathsAtEnd.profileHtml = baseFolderForPathsEnd
            ? `${baseFolderForPathsEnd}/${patientFolder}/profile.html`
            : `${patientFolder}/profile.html`;
          expectedPathsAtEnd.medicalHistoryHtml = baseFolderForPathsEnd
            ? `${baseFolderForPathsEnd}/${patientFolder}/medical-history.html`
            : `${patientFolder}/medical-history.html`;
          expectedPathsAtEnd.allergiesHtml = baseFolderForPathsEnd
            ? `${baseFolderForPathsEnd}/${patientFolder}/allergies.html`
            : `${patientFolder}/allergies.html`;
          expectedPathsAtEnd.homeMedsHtml = baseFolderForPathsEnd
            ? `${baseFolderForPathsEnd}/${patientFolder}/home-meds.html`
            : `${patientFolder}/home-meds.html`;
          expectedPathsAtEnd.diagnosesHtml = baseFolderForPathsEnd
            ? `${baseFolderForPathsEnd}/${patientFolder}/diagnoses.html`
            : `${patientFolder}/diagnoses.html`;
        }

        if (context.variables?.encounterFolder) {
          const encounterFolder = String(context.variables.encounterFolder);
          expectedPathsAtEnd.encounterListHtml = baseFolderForPathsEnd
            ? `${baseFolderForPathsEnd}/${encounterFolder}/encounter-list.html`
            : `${encounterFolder}/encounter-list.html`;
          expectedPathsAtEnd.encounterUrlJson = baseFolderForPathsEnd
            ? `${baseFolderForPathsEnd}/${encounterFolder}/url.json`
            : `${encounterFolder}/url.json`;
        }

        // After iteration completes, log variable state for debugging
        logger.info('Loop iteration END', {
          variable: step.variable,
          index: loopIndex,
          iterationNumber: loopIndex + 1,
          variablesAtEnd: {
            patientName: context.variables?.patientName,
            patientId: context.variables?.patientId,
            patientSlug: context.variables?.patientSlug,
            patientFolder: context.variables?.patientFolder,
            pageFolder: context.variables?.pageFolder,
            patientRowIndex: context.variables?.patientRowIndex,
            baseFolder: context.variables?.baseFolder,
          },
          variablesAtStart: {
            patientName: iterationStartVariables.patientName,
            patientId: iterationStartVariables.patientId,
            patientSlug: iterationStartVariables.patientSlug,
            patientFolder: iterationStartVariables.patientFolder,
            pageFolder: iterationStartVariables.pageFolder,
            patientRowIndex: iterationStartVariables.patientRowIndex,
            baseFolder: iterationStartVariables.baseFolder,
          },
          allVariableKeysAtStart: Object.keys(iterationStartVariables),
          allVariableKeysAtEnd: Object.keys(context.variables || {}),
          expectedFilePathsAtEnd:
            Object.keys(expectedPathsAtEnd).length > 0
              ? expectedPathsAtEnd
              : undefined,
          pathValidation: {
            expectedPathsCount: Object.keys(expectedPathsAtEnd).length,
            pathsShouldMatchExpected: true,
          },
        });
      }

        return null;
      } finally {
        if (loopGuardEnabled && loopGuardPrefix && context.variables) {
          context.variables[loopGuardActivePageKey] = '';
          context.variables[loopGuardCompletedPageKey] = loopGuardPageIdentity;
          context.variables[loopGuardLastEventKey] = 'finished';
          context.variables[loopGuardFinishedAtKey] = new Date().toISOString();

          logger.info('Loop invocation finished', {
            stepName,
            loopVariable: step.variable,
            pageIdentity: loopGuardPageIdentity,
            invocationCount: Number(
              context.variables[loopGuardInvocationKey] ?? 0
            ),
          });
        }
      }
    };

    while (i < processedSteps.length) {
      await waitForResume(context);
      assertNotCancelled(context);
      const step = processedSteps[i];
      const stepName = getStepDisplayName(step, `${step.type} (step ${i + 1})`);

      // Report step start
      if (onStepProgress && typeof __DEV__ !== 'undefined' && __DEV__) {
        onStepProgress({
          stepIndex: i,
          stepName,
          stepType: step.type,
          status: 'starting',
        });
      }

      try {
        // Use step timeout if explicitly provided, otherwise let executeStepWithTimeout calculate type-based timeout
        // Pass undefined when no explicit timeout so the function knows it's type-based
        const stepTimeout = step.timeout;

        // For optional steps, skip retries and circuit breaker - fail gracefully immediately
        let stepResult: unknown;
        // Loop steps are handled explicitly below (they execute nested steps and manage their own flow).
        if (step.type === 'loop') {
          stepResult = undefined;
        } else if (step.optional === true) {
          // Check abort signal before executing optional steps (especially important for pagination steps)
          assertNotCancelled(context);
          try {
            // Execute step without retries for optional steps
            const stepPromise = executeStep(
              step,
              runtime,
              context,
              options,
              onStepProgress
            );
            const timeoutDisabled = isStepTimeoutDisabled(stepTimeout);
            const effectiveTimeout = timeoutDisabled
              ? undefined
              : stepTimeout ?? getExpectedTimeoutForStepType(step.type, step);
            stepResult = timeoutDisabled
              ? await stepPromise
              : await Promise.race([
                  stepPromise,
                  new Promise<never>((_, reject) => {
                    setTimeout(() => {
                      const stepName = step.description ?? step.type;
                      reject(
                        new Error(
                          `Step "${stepName}" (${step.type}) timed out after ${effectiveTimeout}ms`
                        )
                      );
                    }, effectiveTimeout);
                  }),
                ]);
          } catch (optionalError) {
            // Optional step failed - log and continue with default value handling
            const errorMessage =
              optionalError instanceof Error
                ? optionalError.message
                : String(optionalError);
            logger.warn('Optional step failed, continuing', {
              stepName,
              stepType: step.type,
              error: errorMessage,
            });

            // Handle default values for optional extract steps
            if (step.type === 'extract') {
              const extractKey = getExtractKey(step);
              if (extractKey) {
                applyOptionalExtractDefault(
                  extractKey,
                  context,
                  extractedData,
                  options
                );
              }
            }

            // Continue to next step
            i++;
            continue;
          }
        } else {
          // Non-optional steps use normal retry logic with circuit breaker
          stepResult = await executeStepWithTimeout(
            step,
            runtime,
            context,
            stepTimeout,
            recipeCircuitBreaker,
            options,
            onStepProgress
          );
        }

        // Handle loop steps specially - they execute nested steps
        if (step.type === 'loop') {
          const loopResult = await executeLoopStep(step, stepName);
          if (loopResult) {
            return loopResult;
          }
          i++;
          continue;
        }

        // stepResult is already assigned above (line 673-725)
        // Process the result for non-loop steps
        // If step extracted data, store it - log ALL extract steps for observability
        if (step.type === 'extract') {
          const extractKey = getExtractKey(step);
          if (!extractKey) {
            throw new Error('extract step requires extractKey');
          }
          if (
            stepResult !== undefined &&
            stepResult !== null &&
            stepResult !== ''
          ) {
            extractedData[extractKey] = stepResult;
            // Also store in context.variables for variable substitution
            if (!context.variables) {
              context.variables = {};
            }
            context.variables[extractKey] = stepResult;

            // Log successful extract
            logger.info('Variable set from extract (top-level)', {
              extractKey,
              value:
                typeof stepResult === 'string'
                  ? stepResult.length > 100
                    ? `${stepResult.substring(0, 100)}...`
                    : stepResult
                  : stepResult,
              stepName,
            });
          } else {
            // Log failed/missing extract for observability
            // For jobId, this is critical but we'll continue - checkpoint conversion will use fallback
            const logLevel = 'warn';
            logger[logLevel](
              `${extractKey === 'jobId' ? '⚠️ ' : '⚠️ '}Extract step returned empty/null/undefined value (top-level)`,
              {
                extractKey,
                extractAttribute: step.extractAttribute,
                locator: step.locator,
                result: stepResult,
                resultType: typeof stepResult,
                stepName,
                isOptional: step.optional === true,
                note:
                  extractKey === 'jobId'
                    ? 'jobId missing - checkpoint conversion will use fallback ID if jobTitle is present'
                    : undefined,
              }
            );

            // Still set empty value for debugging (checkpoint conversion will handle it)
            if (!context.variables) {
              context.variables = {};
            }
            context.variables[extractKey] = stepResult ?? '';
          }
        }

        // Report step completion with metadata for critical steps
        // Always include variableState when onStepProgress is provided (not just in dev mode)
        // This allows UI components to display execution state like validRowIndices
        if (onStepProgress) {
          // Build metadata for critical steps
          const metadata:
            | {
                variableState?: Record<string, unknown>;
                expectedPath?: string;
                actualPath?: string;
                targetUrl?: string;
                pathValidation?: {
                  matches: boolean;
                  expected: string;
                  actual: string;
                };
                expectedFilePaths?: Record<string, string>;
                operation?: string;
              }
            | undefined = {};

          // Add variable state for all steps - include all variables from context
          const allVariables: Record<string, unknown> = {};
          if (context.variables) {
            for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(context.variables)) {
              if (value !== undefined && value !== null) {
                allVariables[key] = value;
              }
            }
          }
          metadata.variableState = allVariables;

          // Add step-specific metadata
          if (step.type === 'captureHtml' && step.filename) {
            metadata.operation = 'captureHtml';
            const substitutedFilename = substituteVariables(
              step.filename,
              context,
              options
            );
            const baseFolderForPaths =
              typeof context.variables?.baseFolder === 'string'
                ? context.variables.baseFolder
                : '';
            metadata.expectedPath = baseFolderForPaths
              ? `${baseFolderForPaths}/${substitutedFilename}`
              : substitutedFilename;
            if (stepResult && typeof stepResult === 'string') {
              metadata.actualPath = stepResult;
              metadata.pathValidation = {
                matches:
                  stepResult === metadata.expectedPath ||
                  stepResult.endsWith(substitutedFilename),
                expected: metadata.expectedPath || '',
                actual: stepResult,
              };
            }
          } else if (step.type === 'setVariable' && step.variable) {
            metadata.operation = 'setVariable';
            const varValue = context.variables?.[step.variable];
            if (
              step.variable === 'patientFolder' &&
              typeof varValue === 'string'
            ) {
              const baseFolderForPaths =
                typeof context.variables?.baseFolder === 'string'
                  ? context.variables.baseFolder
                  : '';
              metadata.expectedFilePaths = {
                profileHtml: baseFolderForPaths
                  ? `${baseFolderForPaths}/${varValue}/profile.html`
                  : `${varValue}/profile.html`,
              };
            }
          } else if (step.type === 'goto') {
            const targetUrl = resolveGotoTargetUrl(step, context, options);
            if (targetUrl) {
              metadata.operation = 'goto';
              metadata.targetUrl = targetUrl;
            }
          } else if (step.type === 'click' && step.locator) {
            metadata.operation = 'click';
            // Check if this is a patient panel click
            const isPatientPanelClick =
              (step.locator.by === 'css' &&
                (step.locator.selector?.includes('.patient-name') ||
                  step.locator.selector?.includes('edit-encounter-link'))) ||
              (step.locator.by === 'role' && step.locator.role === 'tab');
            if (isPatientPanelClick && context.variables?.patientFolder) {
              const patientFolder = String(context.variables.patientFolder);
              const baseFolderForPaths =
                typeof context.variables.baseFolder === 'string'
                  ? context.variables.baseFolder
                  : '';
              metadata.expectedFilePaths = {
                profileHtml: baseFolderForPaths
                  ? `${baseFolderForPaths}/${patientFolder}/profile.html`
                  : `${patientFolder}/profile.html`,
                medicalHistoryHtml: baseFolderForPaths
                  ? `${baseFolderForPaths}/${patientFolder}/medical-history.html`
                  : `${patientFolder}/medical-history.html`,
                allergiesHtml: baseFolderForPaths
                  ? `${baseFolderForPaths}/${patientFolder}/allergies.html`
                  : `${patientFolder}/allergies.html`,
              };
            }
          }

          onStepProgress({
            stepIndex: i,
            stepName,
            stepType: step.type,
            status: 'completed',
            metadata: Object.keys(metadata).length > 0 ? metadata : undefined,
          });
        }
      } catch (error) {
        const errorMessage =
          error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
        
        // Check if this is a pause error (login failure pause)
        const isPauseError = error instanceof Error && 
          errorMessage.startsWith('PAUSED_LOGIN_FAILURE:');
        
        if (isPauseError) {
          logger.info('Execution paused due to login failures', {
            stepIndex: i,
            stepName,
            stepType: step.type,
            pauseReason: (error as any).pauseReason,
            pauseCheckpointId: (error as any).pauseCheckpointId,
            correlationId: context.correlationId,
          });
          
          // Report pause status
          if (onStepProgress) {
            onStepProgress({
              stepIndex: i,
              stepName,
              stepType: step.type,
              status: 'paused',
              error: errorMessage,
              metadata: {
                pauseReason: (error as any).pauseReason,
                pauseCheckpointId: (error as any).pauseCheckpointId,
              },
            });
          }
          
          // Return paused result instead of failure
          return {
            success: false,
            paused: true,
            pauseReason: (error as any).pauseReason || 'login_failure',
            pauseCheckpointId: (error as any).pauseCheckpointId || 'patients-export-v4-paused-login',
            error: errorMessage,
            stepIndex: i,
            stepName,
            data: Object.keys(extractedData).length > 0 ? extractedData : undefined,
          };
        }

        // Report step failure
        if (onStepProgress && typeof __DEV__ !== 'undefined' && __DEV__) {
          onStepProgress({
            stepIndex: i,
            stepName,
            stepType: step.type,
            status: 'failed',
            error: errorMessage,
          });
        }

        // If step is optional, log warning and continue
        if (step.optional === true) {
          logger.warn('Optional step failed, continuing', {
            stepName,
            stepType: step.type,
            error: errorMessage,
          });

          // For optional extract steps, set a default value based on extractKey
          if (step.type === 'extract') {
            const extractKey = getExtractKey(step);
            if (extractKey) {
              applyOptionalExtractDefault(
                extractKey,
                context,
                extractedData,
                options
              );
            }
          }

          i++; // Move to next step
          continue;
        }

        // Before returning failure, ensure any pending checkpoints are saved
        // This ensures partial data is preserved even if recipe fails
        if (step.type === 'saveCheckpoint' && step.checkpointId) {
          try {
            const substitutedCheckpointId = substituteVariables(
              step.checkpointId,
              context,
              options
            );
            const substitutedCheckpointMetadata = step.metadata
              ? substituteVariablesInObject(step.metadata, context, options)
              : {};
            await runtime.saveCheckpoint(
              substitutedCheckpointId,
              substitutedCheckpointMetadata
            );
            logger.info('Saved checkpoint before recipe failure', {
              checkpointId: substitutedCheckpointId,
              stepIndex: i,
            });
          } catch (checkpointError) {
            logger.warn(
              'Failed to save checkpoint before recipe failure',
              checkpointError as Error,
              {
                stepIndex: i,
              }
            );
          }
        }

        return {
          success: false,
          error: errorMessage,
          stepIndex: i,
          stepName,
          data:
            Object.keys(extractedData).length > 0 ? extractedData : undefined,
        };
      }

      i++;
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      data: Object.keys(extractedData).length > 0 ? extractedData : undefined,
    };
  } catch (error) {
    // Ensure any pending checkpoints are saved even on catastrophic failure
    // Try to save the last checkpoint if we have the context
    try {
      const lastStep = processedSteps[processedSteps.length - 1];
      if (
        lastStep?.type === 'saveCheckpoint' &&
        lastStep.checkpointId &&
        context
      ) {
        const substitutedCheckpointId = substituteVariables(
          lastStep.checkpointId,
          context,
          options
        );
        const substitutedCheckpointMetadata = lastStep.metadata
          ? substituteVariablesInObject(lastStep.metadata, context, options)
          : {};
        await runtime.saveCheckpoint(
          substitutedCheckpointId,
          substitutedCheckpointMetadata
        );
        logger.info('Saved checkpoint before catastrophic failure', {
          checkpointId: substitutedCheckpointId,
        });
      }
    } catch (checkpointError) {
      // Ignore checkpoint save errors during catastrophic failure
      logger.debug(
        'Could not save checkpoint during catastrophic failure',
        checkpointError as Error
      );
    }

    return {
      success: false,
      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
      data: Object.keys(extractedData).length > 0 ? extractedData : undefined,
    };
  }
}

export function createExecuteRecipe(options?: RecipeExecutorOptions) {
  return (
    recipe: Recipe,
    runtime: FlowRuntime,
    context: ExecutionContext,
    onStepProgress?: StepProgressCallback
  ) => executeRecipe(recipe, runtime, context, onStepProgress, options);
}

/**
 * Get expected timeout for a step type based on historical execution data
 * Returns timeout in milliseconds with 40% buffer added to expected duration
 */
function getExpectedTimeoutForStepType(
  stepType: StepType,
  step?: RecipeStep
): number {
  // Expected durations based on analysis of execution logs (in milliseconds)
  // These represent typical execution times observed in production
  const expectedDurations: Record<StepType, number> = {
    // Navigation and page loading
    goto: 10000, // Navigation can take up to 10s including post-load checks
    waitFor: 15000, // waitFor can vary widely: load (2s), selector (1-12s), networkidle (varies)
    waitForPagination: 5000, // Pagination waits typically 1-5s

    // UI interactions
    click: 12000, // Click actions may include built-in retries and visibility waits
    fill: 1000, // Form filling is fast: 0.5-1s
    type: 2000, // Typing can take longer: 1-2s
    selectDropdown: 6000, // Dropdown selection can be slow (animations + option rendering)

    // Data extraction and validation
    extract: 2000, // DOM extraction: 0.5-2s
    assertVisible: 6000, // Visibility checks can take longer on complex pages

    // File operations (can take longer due to Chrome downloads API)
    captureHtml: 5000, // HTML capture + download: 2-4s typically
    saveUrl: 3000, // URL saving: 1-2s
    validateFile: 6000, // File validation with polling: 1-5s
    validateFolder: 6000, // Folder validation with polling: 1-5s
    ensureFolder: 2000, // Folder creation: 0.5-1s

    // Variable and state management
    // setVariable with extract needs longer timeout (same as extract)
    // setVariable with static value is instant
    setVariable: 100, // Default for static values (will be overridden if extract is present)
    saveCheckpoint: 3000, // Checkpoint saving: increased from 500ms to handle concurrent tab writes to chrome.storage
    restoreCheckpoint: 2000, // Checkpoint restore: increased from 1s to handle concurrent reads

    // Navigation
    navigateBack: 2000, // Navigation back: 1-2s

    // Loops (timeout applies to loop setup, not iterations)
    loop: 5000, // Loop initialization: 1-3s
  };

  const expectedDuration = expectedDurations[stepType] ?? 10000; // Default 10s for unknown types

  // Apply 40% buffer: expectedDuration * 1.4
  return Math.ceil(expectedDuration * 1.4);
}

/**
 * Get retry configuration from environment or use defaults
 */
function getRetryConfig(): {
  maxRetries: number;
  baseDelayMs: number;
  maxDelayMs: number;
  maxConsecutiveFailures: number;
} {
  return {
    maxRetries: Number(process.env.RECIPE_MAX_RETRIES || 3),
    baseDelayMs: Number(process.env.RECIPE_RETRY_BASE_DELAY_MS || 500),
    maxDelayMs: Number(process.env.RECIPE_RETRY_MAX_DELAY_MS || 5000),
    maxConsecutiveFailures: Number(
      process.env.RECIPE_MAX_CONSECUTIVE_FAILURES || 3
    ),
  };
}

/**
 * Calculate exponential backoff delay with jitter
 */
function calculateBackoffDelay(
  attempt: number,
  baseDelayMs: number,
  maxDelayMs: number
): number {
  const exponentialDelay = Math.min(
    baseDelayMs * Math.pow(2, attempt),
    maxDelayMs
  );
  // Add jitter (random 0-20% of delay) to prevent thundering herd
  const jitter = Math.random() * exponentialDelay * 0.2;
  return Math.floor(exponentialDelay + jitter);
}

function applyJitterToTimeout(
  stepType: StepType,
  timeoutMs: number
): { jitteredTimeout: number; jitterMs: number } {
  const jitterRanges: Partial<Record<StepType, { minMs: number; maxMs: number }>> = {
    waitFor: { minMs: 1000, maxMs: 3000 },
    waitForPagination: { minMs: 2000, maxMs: 5000 },
    extract: { minMs: 1000, maxMs: 2000 },
    click: { minMs: 500, maxMs: 1500 },
    type: { minMs: 500, maxMs: 1500 },
  };

  const range = jitterRanges[stepType];
  if (!range) {
    return { jitteredTimeout: timeoutMs, jitterMs: 0 };
  }

  const jitterMs =
    Math.floor(Math.random() * (range.maxMs - range.minMs + 1)) + range.minMs;
  return { jitteredTimeout: timeoutMs + jitterMs, jitterMs };
}

function isStepTimeoutDisabled(timeoutMs?: number): boolean {
  return timeoutMs !== undefined && timeoutMs <= 0;
}

/**
 * Execute a step with timeout protection and retry logic with circuit breaker
 * If step takes longer than timeoutMs, it will fail with a timeout error
 * Uses step-type-specific timeouts with 40% buffer if no explicit timeout is provided
 * Retries on failure up to maxRetries times with exponential backoff
 * Circuit breaker stops retries if same error occurs maxConsecutiveFailures times
 */
async function executeStepWithTimeout(
  step: RecipeStep,
  runtime: FlowRuntime,
  context: ExecutionContext,
  timeoutMs?: number,
  circuitBreaker?: CircuitBreaker,
  options?: RecipeExecutorOptions,
  onStepProgress?: StepProgressCallback
): Promise<unknown> {
  assertNotCancelled(context);
  const retryConfig = getRetryConfig();
  const breaker =
    circuitBreaker || new CircuitBreaker(retryConfig.maxConsecutiveFailures);
  const maxRetryAttempts = step.disableRetries === true ? 0 : retryConfig.maxRetries;

  // Use explicit timeout if provided, otherwise calculate based on step type
  // For setVariable with extract, use extract timeout instead of default setVariable timeout
  let typeBasedTimeout = getExpectedTimeoutForStepType(step.type, step);
  const jitterType =
    step.type === 'setVariable' && step.extract ? 'extract' : step.type;
  if (step.type === 'setVariable' && step.extract) {
    // setVariable with extract should use extract timeout
    typeBasedTimeout = getExpectedTimeoutForStepType('extract');
  }
  const timeoutDisabled = isStepTimeoutDisabled(timeoutMs);
  const effectiveTimeout = timeoutDisabled
    ? undefined
    : timeoutMs ?? typeBasedTimeout;
  const timeoutConfig = effectiveTimeout
    ? applyJitterToTimeout(jitterType, effectiveTimeout)
    : { jitteredTimeout: 0, jitterMs: 0 };
  const { jitteredTimeout, jitterMs } = timeoutConfig;
  const timeoutSource = timeoutDisabled
    ? 'disabled'
    : timeoutMs !== undefined
      ? 'explicit'
      : 'type-based';

  // Log timeout configuration for debugging
  if (typeof __DEV__ !== 'undefined' && __DEV__) {
    logger.debug('Step timeout configuration', {
      stepType: step.type,
      stepDescription: step.description,
      explicitTimeout: timeoutMs,
      typeBasedTimeout,
      effectiveTimeout,
      jitterMs,
      jitteredTimeout,
      timeoutSource,
      maxRetries: maxRetryAttempts,
      retriesDisabled: step.disableRetries === true,
    });
  }

  let lastError: Error | null = null;

  // Retry loop
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt <= maxRetryAttempts; attempt++) {
    try {
      assertNotCancelled(context);
      const stepPromise = executeStep(
        step,
        runtime,
        context,
        options,
        onStepProgress
      );
      const result = timeoutDisabled
        ? await stepPromise
        : await Promise.race([
            stepPromise,
            new Promise<never>((_, reject) => {
              setTimeout(() => {
                const stepName = step.description ?? step.type;
                reject(
                  new Error(
                    `Step "${stepName}" (${step.type}) timed out after ${jitteredTimeout}ms (${timeoutSource})`
                  )
                );
              }, jitteredTimeout);
            }),
          ]);

      // Success - reset circuit breaker and return
      breaker.recordSuccess();

      if (attempt > 0) {
        logger.info('Step succeeded after retry', {
          stepType: step.type,
          stepDescription: step.description,
          attempt: attempt + 1,
          totalAttempts: attempt + 1,
        });
      }

      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      lastError = error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error));
      const errorMessage = lastError.message;

      if (step.disableRetries === true) {
        logger.error('Step failed (retries disabled)', {
          stepType: step.type,
          stepDescription: step.description,
          error: errorMessage,
        });
        throw lastError;
      }

      // Check circuit breaker
      const shouldBreak = breaker.recordError(errorMessage);

      if (shouldBreak) {
        logger.error('Circuit breaker triggered - stopping retries', {
          stepType: step.type,
          stepDescription: step.description,
          error: errorMessage,
          attempt: attempt + 1,
          circuitBreakerState: breaker.getState(),
        });
        throw lastError;
      }

      // If this was the last attempt, throw the error
      if (attempt >= maxRetryAttempts) {
        logger.error('Step failed after all retries', {
          stepType: step.type,
          stepDescription: step.description,
          error: errorMessage,
          totalAttempts: attempt + 1,
          circuitBreakerState: breaker.getState(),
        });
        throw lastError;
      }

      // Calculate backoff delay
      const delayMs = calculateBackoffDelay(
        attempt,
        retryConfig.baseDelayMs,
        retryConfig.maxDelayMs
      );

      logger.warn('Step failed, retrying', {
        stepType: step.type,
        stepDescription: step.description,
        error: errorMessage,
        attempt: attempt + 1,
        maxRetries: maxRetryAttempts + 1,
        delayMs,
        circuitBreakerState: breaker.getState(),
      });

      // Wait before retrying
      assertNotCancelled(context);
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, delayMs));
    }
  }

  // Should never reach here, but TypeScript needs it
  throw lastError || new Error('Step execution failed');
}

async function executeStep(
  step: RecipeStep,
  runtime: FlowRuntime,
  context: ExecutionContext,
  options?: RecipeExecutorOptions,
  onStepProgress?: StepProgressCallback
): Promise<unknown> {
  switch (step.type) {
    case 'goto':
      if (step.url === null || step.url === undefined || step.url === '')
        throw new Error('goto step requires url');

      // Ensure URL is substituted (defensive check - should already be done in processedSteps)
      // This is a safety net in case substitution didn't happen in processedSteps
      let finalUrl =
        step.url.includes('{') && context.variables
          ? substituteVariables(step.url, context, options)
          : step.url;

      if (options?.transformGotoUrl) {
        finalUrl = options.transformGotoUrl(finalUrl, context, step);
      }

      await runtime.goto(finalUrl);
      return undefined;

    case 'waitFor':
      if (step.state === null || step.state === undefined) {
        const legacySelector = (step as any).selector ?? step.locator;
        if (legacySelector) {
          await runtime.waitFor({
            state: 'selector',
            selector: legacySelector,
            timeoutMs: step.timeout,
          });
          return undefined;
        }
        throw new Error('waitFor step requires state');
      }

      if (typeof step.state === 'string') {
        const legacySelector = (step as any).selector ?? step.locator;
        if (step.state === 'selector' && legacySelector) {
          await runtime.waitFor({
            state: 'selector',
            selector: legacySelector,
            timeoutMs: step.timeout,
          });
          return undefined;
        }
        if (step.state === 'notVisible' && legacySelector) {
          await runtime.waitFor({
            state: 'notVisible',
            selector: legacySelector,
            timeoutMs: step.timeout,
          });
          return undefined;
        }
        await runtime.waitFor(step.state);
        return undefined;
      }

      if (typeof step.state === 'object' && step.state !== null) {
        // Substitute variables in the state object (including selectors)
        const stateWithSubstitutions = substituteVariablesInObject(
          step.state as Record<string, unknown>,
          context,
          options
        );
        const normalizedState =
          step.timeout !== null &&
          step.timeout !== undefined &&
          !('timeoutMs' in stateWithSubstitutions)
            ? { ...stateWithSubstitutions, timeoutMs: step.timeout }
            : stateWithSubstitutions;
        await runtime.waitFor(normalizedState as any);
        return undefined;
      }
      return undefined;

    case 'assertVisible':
      if (step.locator === null || step.locator === undefined)
        throw new Error('assertVisible step requires locator');
      // Substitute variables in locator before using it
      const assertVisibleLocator = substituteVariablesInLocator(
        step.locator,
        context,
        options
      );
      await runtime.assertVisible(assertVisibleLocator);
      return undefined;

    case 'click':
      if (step.locator === null || step.locator === undefined)
        throw new Error('click step requires locator');
      // Substitute variables in locator before using it
      const clickLocator = substituteVariablesInLocator(
        step.locator,
        context,
        options
      );
      // Get loop index from step metadata or context variables
      const clickIndex =
        (step as any).__loopIndex ??
        (context.variables?.patientRowIndex as number | undefined) ??
        (context.variables?.encounterRowIndex as number | undefined) ??
        (context.variables?.prescriptionRowIndex as number | undefined);

      // Detect if this is a patient panel click (based on locator patterns)
      const isPatientPanelClick =
        (clickLocator.by === 'css' &&
          (typeof clickLocator.selector === 'string' &&
            (clickLocator.selector.includes('.patient-name') ||
              clickLocator.selector.includes('edit-encounter-link')))) ||
        (clickLocator.by === 'role' && clickLocator.role === 'tab');

      // If this is a patient panel click, log expected file paths before navigation
      if (isPatientPanelClick && context.variables?.patientFolder) {
        const patientFolder = String(context.variables.patientFolder);
        const baseFolder =
          typeof context.variables.baseFolder === 'string'
            ? context.variables.baseFolder
            : '';
        const expectedPaths = {
          profileHtml: baseFolder
            ? `${baseFolder}/${patientFolder}/profile.html`
            : `${patientFolder}/profile.html`,
          medicalHistoryHtml: baseFolder
            ? `${baseFolder}/${patientFolder}/medical-history.html`
            : `${patientFolder}/medical-history.html`,
          allergiesHtml: baseFolder
            ? `${baseFolder}/${patientFolder}/allergies.html`
            : `${patientFolder}/allergies.html`,
          homeMedsHtml: baseFolder
            ? `${baseFolder}/${patientFolder}/home-meds.html`
            : `${patientFolder}/home-meds.html`,
          diagnosesHtml: baseFolder
            ? `${baseFolder}/${patientFolder}/diagnoses.html`
            : `${patientFolder}/diagnoses.html`,
        };

        logger.info('Pre-navigation: Expected file paths', {
          action: 'click',
          locator: clickLocator,
          isPatientPanelClick: true,
          clickIndex,
          variableState: getFilteredVariableState(context.variables),
          expectedFilePaths: expectedPaths,
          iterationContext: {
            loopIndex: clickIndex,
            hasLoopIndex: clickIndex !== undefined,
          },
        });
      }

      const clickLoopLocator = (step as any).__loopLocator
        ? substituteVariablesInLocator(
            (step as any).__loopLocator,
            context,
            options
          )
        : undefined;
      await runtime.click(clickLocator, clickIndex, clickLoopLocator);
      return undefined;

    case 'fill':
      if (step.locator === null || step.locator === undefined)
        throw new Error('fill step requires locator');
      if (step.value === undefined) throw new Error('fill step requires value');
      // Substitute variables in locator and value
      const fillLocator = substituteVariablesInLocator(
        step.locator,
        context,
        options
      );
      const fillValue = substituteVariables(step.value, context, options);
      await runtime.fill(fillLocator, fillValue);
      return undefined;

    case 'type':
      if (step.locator === null || step.locator === undefined)
        throw new Error('type step requires locator');
      if (step.value === undefined) throw new Error('type step requires value');
      // Substitute variables in locator and value
      const typeLocator = substituteVariablesInLocator(
        step.locator,
        context,
        options
      );
      const typeValue = substituteVariables(step.value, context, options);
      await runtime.type(typeLocator, typeValue);
      return undefined;

    case 'extract':
      if (step.locator === null || step.locator === undefined)
        throw new Error('extract step requires locator');
      const extractKey = getExtractKey(step);
      if (!extractKey) throw new Error('extract step requires extractKey');

      // Substitute variables in locator before using it
      const extractLocator = substituteVariablesInLocator(
        step.locator,
        context,
        options
      );

      // Ensure context.variables exists
      if (!context.variables) {
        context.variables = {};
      }

      // Get loop index from step metadata or context variables
      // Check for various loop index variable names (patientRowIndex, jobCardIndex, etc.)
      const extractIndex =
        (step as any).__loopIndex ??
        (context.variables?.patientRowIndex as number | undefined) ??
        (context.variables?.encounterRowIndex as number | undefined) ??
        (context.variables?.prescriptionRowIndex as number | undefined) ??
        (context.variables?.jobCardIndex as number | undefined) ??
        (context.variables?.jobCard as number | undefined);

      // Log extraction details for debugging
      if (typeof __DEV__ !== 'undefined' && __DEV__) {
        logger.debug('Extract step executing', {
          extractKey,
          attribute: step.extractAttribute ?? 'textContent',
          extractIndex,
          loopIndexFromStep: (step as any).__loopIndex,
          jobCardIndex: context.variables?.jobCardIndex,
          jobCard: context.variables?.jobCard,
          patientRowIndex: context.variables?.patientRowIndex,
          encounterRowIndex: context.variables?.encounterRowIndex,
          prescriptionRowIndex: context.variables?.prescriptionRowIndex,
          locator: extractLocator,
          hasLoopLocator: !!(step as any).__loopLocator,
        });
      }

      const extractLoopLocator = (step as any).__loopLocator
        ? substituteVariablesInLocator(
            (step as any).__loopLocator,
            context,
            options
          )
        : undefined;
      const extracted = await runtime.extract(extractLocator, {
        key: extractKey,
        multiple: step.extractMultiple ?? false,
        attribute: step.extractAttribute ?? 'textContent',
        index: extractIndex,
        loopLocator: extractLoopLocator,
        optional: step.optional ?? false,
      });

      // Validate extracted value for critical fields
      if (
        extractKey === 'patientId' &&
        (!extracted || String(extracted).trim() === '')
      ) {
        // Log warning but allow recipe to continue - patient slug will use format: -{patientName}
        logger.warn(
          'Patient ID extraction returned empty value - recipe will continue',
          {
            extractIndex,
            attribute: step.extractAttribute ?? 'textContent',
            locator: step.locator,
            note: 'Patient slug will use format: -{patientName} instead of {patientId}-{patientName}',
            impact:
              'Folder names will not include patient ID prefix, but recipe can still complete successfully',
          }
        );
        // Continue with empty patientId - slug will be -patient-name format
      }

      if (
        extractKey === 'patientName' &&
        (!extracted || String(extracted).trim() === '')
      ) {
        logger.warn('Patient name extraction returned empty value', {
          extractIndex,
          attribute: step.extractAttribute ?? 'textContent',
          locator: step.locator,
        });
      }

      // Log extraction result - ALWAYS log for observability
      const isEmpty = !extracted || String(extracted).trim() === '';
      const logLevel = isEmpty ? 'warn' : 'info';
      const logMessage = isEmpty
        ? '⚠️ Extract step returned empty value'
        : '✅ Extract step completed';

      logger[logLevel](logMessage, {
        extractKey,
        extractedValue:
          typeof extracted === 'string'
            ? extracted.length > 100
              ? `${extracted.substring(0, 100)}...`
              : extracted
            : extracted,
        extractedValueLength:
          typeof extracted === 'string' ? extracted.length : 'N/A',
        extractIndex,
        isEmpty,
        extractAttribute: step.extractAttribute ?? 'textContent',
        locator: step.locator,
        isOptional: step.optional === true,
      });

      // Store extracted value in context.variables for variable substitution
      if (extractKey === 'jobId') {
        const existingJobId = context.variables[extractKey];
        const existingNonEmpty =
          typeof existingJobId === 'string' && existingJobId.trim() !== '';
        const nextIsEmpty =
          extracted === null ||
          extracted === undefined ||
          String(extracted).trim() === '';

        if (existingNonEmpty && nextIsEmpty) {
          logger.warn('Preserving existing jobId (new extraction empty)', {
            existingJobId,
            extractAttribute: step.extractAttribute ?? 'textContent',
            locator: step.locator,
          });
        } else {
          context.variables[extractKey] = extracted;
        }
      } else {
        context.variables[extractKey] = extracted;
      }

      return extracted;

    case 'loop':
      if (step.locator === null || step.locator === undefined)
        throw new Error('loop step requires locator');
      if (step.variable === null || step.variable === undefined)
        throw new Error('loop step requires variable');
      if (step.steps === null || step.steps === undefined)
        throw new Error('loop step requires steps');
      // Substitute variables in locator before using it
      const loopLocator = substituteVariablesInLocator(
        step.locator,
        context,
        options
      );
      let resolvedMaxIterations: number | undefined;
      if (typeof step.maxIterations === 'string') {
        const substituted = substituteVariables(
          step.maxIterations,
          context,
          options
        );
        const parsed = Number(substituted);
        if (Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed > 0) {
          resolvedMaxIterations = parsed;
        }
      } else if (typeof step.maxIterations === 'number' && step.maxIterations > 0) {
        resolvedMaxIterations = step.maxIterations;
      }
      await runtime.executeLoop(
        loopLocator,
        step.variable,
        step.steps,
        resolvedMaxIterations
      );
      return undefined;

    case 'captureHtml':
      if (step.filename === null || step.filename === undefined)
        throw new Error('captureHtml step requires filename');

      // Get iteration context for logging
      const captureLoopIndex =
        (step as any).__loopIndex ??
        (context.variables?.patientRowIndex as number | undefined) ??
        (context.variables?.encounterRowIndex as number | undefined) ??
        (context.variables?.prescriptionRowIndex as number | undefined);

      // Substitute variables in filename at execution time
      const substitutedFilename = substituteVariables(
        step.filename,
        context,
        options
      );

      // Calculate expected full path (including baseFolder)
      const baseFolder =
        typeof context.variables?.baseFolder === 'string'
          ? context.variables.baseFolder
          : '';
      const expectedFullPath = baseFolder
        ? `${baseFolder}/${substitutedFilename}`
        : substitutedFilename;

      // Log expected file path BEFORE executing captureHtml
      logger.info('Pre-capture: Expected file path', {
        action: 'captureHtml',
        originalFilename: step.filename,
        substitutedFilename,
        expectedFullPath,
        baseFolder: baseFolder || '(not set)',
        variableState: getFilteredVariableState(context.variables),
        iterationContext: {
          loopIndex: captureLoopIndex,
          hasLoopIndex: captureLoopIndex !== undefined,
        },
        pathValidation: {
          expectedPath: expectedFullPath,
          willValidateAfterCapture: true,
        },
      });

      // Log detailed information about the capture operation
      logger.info('captureHtml step executing', {
        originalFilename: step.filename,
        substitutedFilename,
        expectedFullPath,
        variableState: getFilteredVariableState(context.variables),
        expectedDownloadPath: substitutedFilename,
        pathValidation: {
          expectedPath: expectedFullPath,
          willValidateAfterCapture: true,
        },
      });

      const actualPath = await runtime.captureHtml(
        substitutedFilename,
        step.locator,
        step.diffCheck ?? false
      );

      // Validate actual path matches expected path
      const pathMatches =
        actualPath === expectedFullPath ||
        actualPath.endsWith(substitutedFilename);
      if (!pathMatches) {
        logger.warn('Path validation mismatch', {
          expectedPath: expectedFullPath,
          actualPath,
          substitutedFilename,
          mismatch: true,
          variableState: getFilteredVariableState(context.variables),
        });
      } else {
        logger.info('Path validation passed', {
          expectedPath: expectedFullPath,
          actualPath,
          pathMatches: true,
        });
      }

      return actualPath;

    case 'saveUrl':
      if (step.filename === null || step.filename === undefined)
        throw new Error('saveUrl step requires filename');
      // Substitute variables in filename at execution time
      const substitutedSaveUrlFilename = substituteVariables(
        step.filename,
        context
      );
      // Substitute variables in metadata object recursively
      const substitutedMetadata = step.metadata
        ? substituteVariablesInObject(step.metadata, context, options)
        : undefined;
      await runtime.saveUrl(substitutedSaveUrlFilename, substitutedMetadata);
      return undefined;

    case 'setVariable':
      // Check abort signal before setting variables (especially important for pagination counters)
      assertNotCancelled(context);
      if (step.variable === null || step.variable === undefined)
        throw new Error('setVariable step requires variable');

      // Ensure context.variables exists
      if (!context.variables) {
        context.variables = {};
      }

      // Preserve initial variables when locked (e.g., UI-provided baseFolder/resume inputs)
      if (Array.isArray(context.lockedVariables)) {
        const lockedSet = new Set(context.lockedVariables);
        if (lockedSet.has(step.variable)) {
          logger.debug('Skipping setVariable for locked variable', {
            variable: step.variable,
          });
          return undefined;
        }
      }

      // Capture variable state before modification
      const beforeValue = context.variables[step.variable];
      const beforeVariableState = {
        patientName: context.variables?.patientName,
        patientId: context.variables?.patientId,
        patientSlug: context.variables?.patientSlug,
        patientFolder: context.variables?.patientFolder,
        pageFolder: context.variables?.pageFolder,
        patientRowIndex: context.variables?.patientRowIndex,
        baseFolder: context.variables?.baseFolder,
      };

      // Get iteration context for logging
      const loopIndex =
        (step as any).__loopIndex ??
        (context.variables?.patientRowIndex as number | undefined) ??
        (context.variables?.encounterRowIndex as number | undefined) ??
        (context.variables?.prescriptionRowIndex as number | undefined);

      if (step.value !== undefined && step.value !== null) {
        // Static value - already substituted in processedSteps, but ensure TIMESTAMP is handled
        // Convert to string and substitute any remaining placeholders
        const valueStr = String(step.value);
        let finalValue = substituteVariables(valueStr, context, options);
        
        // CRITICAL: If substitution failed and we still have placeholders, try one more pass
        // This handles cases where array indexing needs the index variable to be resolved first
        if (finalValue.includes('{') && finalValue.includes('}')) {
          // Check if this is an array indexing pattern that failed
          const arrayIndexPattern = /\{([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)\[([^\]]+)\]\}/g;
          const arrayMatches = Array.from(finalValue.matchAll(arrayIndexPattern));
          
          if (arrayMatches.length > 0) {
            // Try to resolve array indexing more aggressively
            for (const match of arrayMatches) {
              const [, arrayName, indexExpr] = match;
              const trimmedIndex = String(indexExpr).trim();
              
              // Check if array exists
              if (!context.variables || !(arrayName in context.variables)) {
                logger.error('setVariable: Array variable not found for array indexing', {
                  variable: step.variable,
                  arrayName,
                  indexExpr: trimmedIndex,
                  availableVariables: context.variables ? Object.keys(context.variables) : [],
                });
                continue;
              }
              
              const arrayValue = context.variables[arrayName];
              if (!Array.isArray(arrayValue)) {
                logger.error('setVariable: Variable is not an array for array indexing', {
                  variable: step.variable,
                  arrayName,
                  arrayType: typeof arrayValue,
                  indexExpr: trimmedIndex,
                });
                continue;
              }
              
              // Resolve index
              let index: number;
              const numericIndex = Number(trimmedIndex);
              if (!isNaN(numericIndex) && isFinite(numericIndex)) {
                index = Math.floor(numericIndex);
              } else {
                // Try to resolve as variable
                if (!context.variables || !(trimmedIndex in context.variables)) {
                  logger.error('setVariable: Index variable not found for array indexing', {
                    variable: step.variable,
                    arrayName,
                    indexExpr: trimmedIndex,
                    availableVariables: context.variables ? Object.keys(context.variables) : [],
                  });
                  continue;
                }
                const indexValue = context.variables[trimmedIndex];
                const parsedIndex = Number(indexValue);
                if (isNaN(parsedIndex) || !isFinite(parsedIndex)) {
                  logger.error('setVariable: Invalid index value for array indexing', {
                    variable: step.variable,
                    arrayName,
                    indexExpr: trimmedIndex,
                    indexValue,
                  });
                  continue;
                }
                index = Math.floor(parsedIndex);
              }
              
              // Bounds check
              if (index < 0 || index >= arrayValue.length) {
                logger.error('setVariable: Index out of bounds for array indexing', {
                  variable: step.variable,
                  arrayName,
                  index,
                  arrayLength: arrayValue.length,
                });
                continue;
              }
              
              // Get element and substitute
              const element = arrayValue[index];
              if (element === null || element === undefined) {
                finalValue = finalValue.replace(match[0], '');
              } else {
                const elementStr = String(element);
                // Recursively substitute if element contains variables
                const substitutedElement = elementStr.includes('{') && elementStr.includes('}')
                  ? substituteVariables(elementStr, context, options)
                  : elementStr;
                finalValue = finalValue.replace(match[0], substitutedElement);
              }
            }
          }
          
          // Evaluate mathematical expressions BEFORE checking for unsubstituted placeholders
          // This handles expressions like {(pageIterationIndex + 1) * 10}
          // Must happen before error check to allow expression evaluation even if variables aren't substituted yet
        if (finalValue.includes('{') && finalValue.includes('}')) {
          // More flexible pattern that handles whitespace variations
          // Pattern 1: {(variableName operator number) operator number} - before substitution
          const expressionPattern1 = /^\{\(([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)\s*([+\-*/])\s*(\d+)\)\s*([+\-*/])\s*(\d+)\}$/;
          // Pattern 2: {(number operator number) operator number} - after substitution
          const expressionPattern2 = /^\{\((\d+)\s*([+\-*/])\s*(\d+)\)\s*([+\-*/])\s*(\d+)\}$/;
          
          const match1 = finalValue.match(expressionPattern1);
          const match2 = finalValue.match(expressionPattern2);
          
          let result: number | null = null;
          
          if (match1) {
            // Before substitution - need to get variable value
            const [, varName, op1, num1, op2, num2] = match1;
            const varValue = context.variables?.[varName];
            
            if (varValue !== undefined && varValue !== null) {
              const varNum = Number(varValue);
                if (!isNaN(varNum) && isFinite(varNum)) {
                // Evaluate first operation: (variable op1 num1)
                let tempResult: number;
                switch (op1) {
                  case '+':
                    tempResult = varNum + Number(num1);
                    break;
                  case '-':
                    tempResult = varNum - Number(num1);
                    break;
                  case '*':
                    tempResult = varNum * Number(num1);
                    break;
                  case '/':
                    tempResult = varNum / Number(num1);
                    break;
                  default:
                    tempResult = varNum;
                }
                
                // Evaluate second operation: result op2 num2
                switch (op2) {
                  case '+':
                    result = tempResult + Number(num2);
                    break;
                  case '-':
                    result = tempResult - Number(num2);
                    break;
                  case '*':
                    result = tempResult * Number(num2);
                    break;
                  case '/':
                    result = tempResult / Number(num2);
                    break;
                  default:
                    result = tempResult;
                }
                
                  if (result !== null) {
                    finalValue = String(result);
                logger.info('Evaluated mathematical expression (before substitution)', {
                      originalExpression: valueStr,
                  variable: varName,
                  variableValue: varNum,
                  result,
                });
                  }
              } else {
                logger.warn('Variable value is not a number for expression evaluation', {
                  variable: varName,
                  variableValue: varValue,
                  expression: finalValue,
                });
              }
            } else {
              logger.warn('Variable not found for expression evaluation', {
                variable: varName,
                availableVariables: Object.keys(context.variables ?? {}),
                expression: finalValue,
              });
            }
          } else if (match2) {
            // After substitution - all numbers
            const [, num1, op1, num2, op2, num3] = match2;
            
            // Evaluate first operation: (num1 op1 num2)
            let tempResult: number;
            switch (op1) {
              case '+':
                tempResult = Number(num1) + Number(num2);
                break;
              case '-':
                tempResult = Number(num1) - Number(num2);
                break;
              case '*':
                tempResult = Number(num1) * Number(num2);
                break;
              case '/':
                tempResult = Number(num1) / Number(num2);
                break;
              default:
                tempResult = Number(num1);
            }
            
            // Evaluate second operation: result op2 num3
            switch (op2) {
              case '+':
                result = tempResult + Number(num3);
                break;
              case '-':
                result = tempResult - Number(num3);
                break;
              case '*':
                result = tempResult * Number(num3);
                break;
              case '/':
                result = tempResult / Number(num3);
                break;
              default:
                result = tempResult;
            }
            
              if (result !== null) {
                finalValue = String(result);
            logger.info('Evaluated mathematical expression (after substitution)', {
                  originalExpression: valueStr,
              result,
            });
              }
          } else {
            // Try a more general approach: evaluate any expression inside braces
            // This handles cases where substitution didn't fully work
            const generalExpressionPattern = /\{\(([^)]+)\)\s*([+\-*/])\s*(\d+)\}/;
            const generalMatch = finalValue.match(generalExpressionPattern);
            
            if (generalMatch) {
              const [, innerExpr, op, num] = generalMatch;
              // Try to evaluate the inner expression
              // First, try to substitute any remaining variables
              const substitutedInner = substituteVariables(innerExpr, context, options);
              
              // Check if it's a simple arithmetic expression like "1 - 1" or "variable - 1"
              const innerPattern = /^(\d+|[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)\s*([+\-*/])\s*(\d+)$/;
              const innerMatch = substitutedInner.match(innerPattern);
              
              if (innerMatch) {
                const [, left, innerOp, right] = innerMatch;
                let leftNum: number;
                
                // Check if left is a variable or a number
                if (/^\d+$/.test(left)) {
                  leftNum = Number(left);
                } else {
                  const leftVar = context.variables?.[left];
                  if (leftVar !== undefined && leftVar !== null) {
                    leftNum = Number(leftVar);
                  } else {
                    leftNum = NaN;
                  }
                }
                
                  if (!isNaN(leftNum) && isFinite(leftNum)) {
                  let innerResult: number;
                  switch (innerOp) {
                    case '+':
                      innerResult = leftNum + Number(right);
                      break;
                    case '-':
                      innerResult = leftNum - Number(right);
                      break;
                    case '*':
                      innerResult = leftNum * Number(right);
                      break;
                    case '/':
                      innerResult = leftNum / Number(right);
                      break;
                    default:
                      innerResult = leftNum;
                  }
                  
                  // Evaluate outer operation
                  switch (op) {
                    case '+':
                      result = innerResult + Number(num);
                      break;
                    case '-':
                      result = innerResult - Number(num);
                      break;
                    case '*':
                      result = innerResult * Number(num);
                      break;
                    case '/':
                      result = innerResult / Number(num);
                      break;
                    default:
                      result = innerResult;
                  }
                  
                    if (result !== null && !isNaN(result) && isFinite(result)) {
                      finalValue = String(Math.floor(result));
                  logger.info('Evaluated mathematical expression (general pattern)', {
                        originalExpression: valueStr,
                    innerExpression: innerExpr,
                    substitutedInner,
                    result,
                  });
                    }
                }
              }
            }
          }
          
            // If we successfully evaluated the expression, update finalValue
            if (result !== null && !isNaN(result) && isFinite(result)) {
              finalValue = String(Math.floor(result));
            logger.info('Mathematical expression evaluated successfully', {
              originalValue: valueStr,
              evaluatedValue: finalValue,
              result,
            });
          } else if (finalValue.includes('{') && finalValue.includes('}')) {
              // If we still have braces and couldn't evaluate, log detailed diagnostics
              const remainingPlaceholders = finalValue.match(/\{[^}]+\}/g);
            logger.warn('Could not evaluate mathematical expression', {
              originalValue: valueStr,
              finalValue,
                remainingPlaceholders,
              availableVariables: Object.keys(context.variables ?? {}),
                pageIterationIndex: context.variables?.pageIterationIndex,
              });
            }
          }
        }

        // Special handling for totalPages derivation.
        // Prefer explicit pagination button numbers when available.
        let derivedTotalPagesFromButtonNumbers = false;
        if (step.variable === 'totalPages') {
          const rawPageButtons = context.variables?.allPageButtons;
          if (Array.isArray(rawPageButtons) && rawPageButtons.length > 0) {
            const pageNumbers = rawPageButtons
              .map((raw) => String(raw ?? '').trim())
              .filter((value) => value !== '')
              .map((value) => {
                const matches = value.match(/\d+/g);
                if (!matches || matches.length === 0) return NaN;
                // Use the last numeric token so labels like "Go to page 9" resolve to 9.
                return Number(matches[matches.length - 1]);
              })
              .filter((value) => !Number.isNaN(value) && Number.isFinite(value));

            if (pageNumbers.length > 0) {
              const detectedTotalPages = Math.max(...pageNumbers);
              finalValue = String(detectedTotalPages);
              derivedTotalPagesFromButtonNumbers = true;
              logger.info('Calculated totalPages from allPageButtons', {
                allPageButtonsCount: rawPageButtons.length,
                parsedPageNumbers: pageNumbers.slice(0, 20),
                detectedTotalPages,
              });
            }
          }
        }

        // Fallback: derive totalPages from totalPostings when a numeric totalPages
        // has not already been derived from pagination button numbers.
        if (step.variable === 'totalPages' && context.variables?.totalPostings) {
          if (!derivedTotalPagesFromButtonNumbers) {
            const totalPostingsStr = String(context.variables.totalPostings);
            // Extract first numeric group (supports commas) from totalPostings string
            const numberMatch = totalPostingsStr.match(/([\d,]+)/);
            if (numberMatch && numberMatch[1]) {
              const normalizedNumber = numberMatch[1].replace(/[^\d]/g, '');
              const totalPostingsNumber = parseInt(normalizedNumber, 10);
              // Calculate total pages: Math.ceil(totalPostings / 10) since each page has 10 results
              if (!Number.isNaN(totalPostingsNumber)) {
                const calculatedTotalPages = Math.ceil(totalPostingsNumber / 10);
                finalValue = String(calculatedTotalPages);
                logger.info('Calculated totalPages from totalPostings', {
                  totalPostings: totalPostingsStr,
                  extractedNumber: totalPostingsNumber,
                  calculatedTotalPages,
                });
              } else {
                logger.warn('Could not parse number from totalPostings', {
                  totalPostings: totalPostingsStr,
                  extractedNumber: normalizedNumber,
                });
              }
            } else {
              logger.warn('Could not extract number from totalPostings', {
                totalPostings: totalPostingsStr,
              });
            }
          }
        }
        
        // After mathematical expression evaluation and special handling, check for unsubstituted placeholders
        if (finalValue.includes('{') && finalValue.includes('}')) {
          const remainingPlaceholders = finalValue.match(/\{[^}]+\}/g);
          
          // Log detailed diagnostics
          logger.error('setVariable: Variable substitution FAILED - placeholders remain', {
            variable: step.variable,
            originalValue: valueStr,
            substitutedValue: finalValue,
            remainingPlaceholders,
            availableVariables: context.variables ? Object.keys(context.variables) : [],
            variableValues: context.variables ? {
              pageIterationIndex: context.variables.pageIterationIndex,
              jobCardIndex: context.variables.jobCardIndex,
              allJobTitles: Array.isArray(context.variables.allJobTitles) 
                ? `Array(${context.variables.allJobTitles.length})` 
                : context.variables.allJobTitles,
              allCompanyNames: Array.isArray(context.variables.allCompanyNames) 
                ? `Array(${context.variables.allCompanyNames.length})` 
                : context.variables.allCompanyNames,
              allLocations: Array.isArray(context.variables.allLocations) 
                ? `Array(${context.variables.allLocations.length})` 
                : context.variables.allLocations,
              allDatePosted: Array.isArray(context.variables.allDatePosted) 
                ? `Array(${context.variables.allDatePosted.length})` 
                : context.variables.allDatePosted,
              allJobIds: Array.isArray(context.variables.allJobIds) 
                ? `Array(${context.variables.allJobIds.length})` 
                : context.variables.allJobIds,
            } : {},
          });
          
          // For non-optional variables, throw error to prevent setting invalid values
          if (step.optional !== true) {
            throw new Error(
              `Variable substitution failed for required variable '${step.variable}'. ` +
              `Original: '${valueStr}', Final: '${finalValue}'. ` +
              `Remaining placeholders: ${remainingPlaceholders?.join(', ') || 'unknown'}. ` +
              `Available variables: ${context.variables ? Object.keys(context.variables).join(', ') : 'none'}`
            );
          }
        }

        // VALIDATION: Ensure no placeholders remain before setting variable
        if (finalValue.includes('{') && finalValue.includes('}')) {
          const remainingPlaceholders = finalValue.match(/\{[^}]+\}/g);
          logger.error('setVariable: Attempting to set variable with unresolved placeholders', {
            variable: step.variable,
            finalValue,
            remainingPlaceholders,
            availableVariables: context.variables ? Object.keys(context.variables) : [],
          });
          
          // For non-optional variables, throw error
          if (step.optional !== true) {
            throw new Error(
              `Cannot set variable '${step.variable}' with unresolved placeholders: ${remainingPlaceholders?.join(', ') || 'unknown'}`
            );
          }
          
          // For optional variables, log warning but continue (may be set later)
          logger.warn('setVariable: Setting optional variable with unresolved placeholders (may be resolved later)', {
            variable: step.variable,
            finalValue,
          });
        }
        
        // Only clear variables when the recipe explicitly sets an empty string
        const isClearing = finalValue === '' && valueStr === '';

        if (isClearing) {
          // Delete the variable instead of setting to empty string
          runtime.deleteVariable(step.variable);
          // Also delete from context.variables
          delete context.variables[step.variable];
        } else {
          runtime.setVariable(step.variable, finalValue);
          // Also update context.variables so subsequent substitutions can use this variable
          context.variables[step.variable] = finalValue;
        }

        // Log variable operation
        if (isClearing) {
          logger.info('Variable CLEARED', {
            variable: step.variable,
            beforeValue,
            afterValue: '(deleted)',
            iterationContext: {
              loopIndex,
              hasLoopIndex: loopIndex !== undefined,
            },
            variableStateBefore: getFilteredVariableState(beforeVariableState),
            variableStateAfter: getFilteredVariableState(context.variables),
            allVariableKeysBefore: Object.keys(
              getFilteredVariableState(beforeVariableState)
            ),
            allVariableKeysAfter: Object.keys(
              getFilteredVariableState(context.variables || {})
            ),
          });
        } else {
          // Calculate expected file paths if patientFolder-related variables are being set
          const expectedPaths: Record<string, string> = {};
          if (
            step.variable === 'patientFolder' &&
            typeof finalValue === 'string'
          ) {
            expectedPaths.profileHtml = `${finalValue}/profile.html`;
            expectedPaths.medicalHistoryHtml = `${finalValue}/medical-history.html`;
            expectedPaths.allergiesHtml = `${finalValue}/allergies.html`;
            expectedPaths.homeMedsHtml = `${finalValue}/home-meds.html`;
            expectedPaths.diagnosesHtml = `${finalValue}/diagnoses.html`;
          } else if (
            step.variable === 'encounterFolder' &&
            typeof finalValue === 'string'
          ) {
            expectedPaths.encounterListHtml = `${finalValue}/encounter-list.html`;
            expectedPaths.urlJson = `${finalValue}/url.json`;
          } else if (
            step.variable === 'currentEncounterFolder' &&
            typeof finalValue === 'string'
          ) {
            expectedPaths.summaryHtml = `${finalValue}/summary.html`;
            expectedPaths.encounterUrlJson = `${finalValue}/url.json`;
          }
