          logger.info('Variable SET', {
            variable: step.variable,
            beforeValue,
            afterValue: finalValue,
            originalValue: step.value,
            substitutedValue: finalValue,
            iterationContext: {
              loopIndex,
              hasLoopIndex: loopIndex !== undefined,
            },
            variableStateBefore: getFilteredVariableState(beforeVariableState),
            variableStateAfter: getFilteredVariableState(context.variables),
            expectedFilePaths:
              Object.keys(expectedPaths).length > 0 ? expectedPaths : undefined,
            allVariableKeysBefore: Object.keys(
              getFilteredVariableState(beforeVariableState)
            ),
            allVariableKeysAfter: Object.keys(
              getFilteredVariableState(context.variables || {})
            ),
          });
        }
      } else if (step.extract !== null && step.extract !== undefined) {
        // Extract from page
        // Get loop index for setVariable with extract
        const setVarExtractIndex =
          (step as any).__loopIndex ??
          (context.variables?.patientRowIndex as number | undefined) ??
          (context.variables?.encounterRowIndex as number | undefined) ??
          (context.variables?.prescriptionRowIndex as number | undefined);
        const extracted = await runtime.extract(step.extract.locator, {
          key: 'temp',
          attribute: step.extract.attribute ?? 'textContent',
          index: setVarExtractIndex,
        });
        // Substitute variables in extracted value if it's a string
        const extractedStr =
          typeof extracted === 'string'
            ? substituteVariables(extracted, context, options)
            : extracted;
        runtime.setVariable(step.variable, extractedStr);
        // Also update context.variables so subsequent substitutions can use this variable
        context.variables[step.variable] = extractedStr;

        // Calculate expected file paths if patientFolder-related variables are being set
        const expectedPaths: Record<string, string> = {};
        if (
          step.variable === 'patientFolder' &&
          typeof extractedStr === 'string'
        ) {
          expectedPaths.profileHtml = `${extractedStr}/profile.html`;
          expectedPaths.medicalHistoryHtml = `${extractedStr}/medical-history.html`;
          expectedPaths.allergiesHtml = `${extractedStr}/allergies.html`;
          expectedPaths.homeMedsHtml = `${extractedStr}/home-meds.html`;
          expectedPaths.diagnosesHtml = `${extractedStr}/diagnoses.html`;
        } else if (
          step.variable === 'encounterFolder' &&
          typeof extractedStr === 'string'
        ) {
          expectedPaths.encounterListHtml = `${extractedStr}/encounter-list.html`;
          expectedPaths.urlJson = `${extractedStr}/url.json`;
        } else if (
          step.variable === 'currentEncounterFolder' &&
          typeof extractedStr === 'string'
        ) {
          expectedPaths.summaryHtml = `${extractedStr}/summary.html`;
          expectedPaths.encounterUrlJson = `${extractedStr}/url.json`;
        }

        logger.info('Variable SET (from extract)', {
          variable: step.variable,
          beforeValue,
          afterValue: extractedStr,
          extractedValue: extracted,
          substitutedValue: extractedStr,
          extractionIndex: setVarExtractIndex,
          iterationContext: {
            loopIndex: setVarExtractIndex,
            hasLoopIndex: setVarExtractIndex !== undefined,
          },
          variableStateBefore: getFilteredVariableState(beforeVariableState),
          variableStateAfter: getFilteredVariableState(context.variables),
          expectedFilePaths:
            Object.keys(expectedPaths).length > 0 ? expectedPaths : undefined,
          allVariableKeysBefore: Object.keys(
            getFilteredVariableState(beforeVariableState)
          ),
          allVariableKeysAfter: Object.keys(
            getFilteredVariableState(context.variables || {})
          ),
        });
      } else {
        throw new Error(
          'setVariable step requires either value or extract property'
        );
      }
      return undefined;

    case 'saveCheckpoint':
      if (step.checkpointId === null || step.checkpointId === undefined)
        throw new Error('saveCheckpoint step requires checkpointId');

      // Substitute variables in checkpointId
      let substitutedCheckpointId: string;
      try {
        substitutedCheckpointId = substituteVariables(
          step.checkpointId,
          context
        );

        // Log if substitution appears to have failed (still contains placeholders)
        if (
          substitutedCheckpointId.includes('{') &&
          substitutedCheckpointId.includes('}')
        ) {
          const remainingPlaceholders =
            substitutedCheckpointId.match(/\{[^}]+\}/g);
          logger.warn('CheckpointId may contain unsubstituted variables', {
            original: step.checkpointId,
            substituted: substitutedCheckpointId,
            placeholders: remainingPlaceholders,
            availableVariables: context.variables
              ? Object.keys(context.variables)
              : [],
          });
        }
      } catch (error) {
        logger.error(
          'Error substituting variables in checkpointId',
          error as Error,
          {
            checkpointId: step.checkpointId,
          }
        );
        // Use original checkpointId if substitution fails - still save for debugging
        substitutedCheckpointId = step.checkpointId;
      }

      // Substitute variables in metadata object recursively
      let substitutedCheckpointMetadata: Record<string, unknown>;
      try {
        substitutedCheckpointMetadata = step.metadata
          ? substituteVariablesInObject(step.metadata, context, options)
          : {};

        // Check for remaining placeholders in metadata
        const checkForPlaceholders = (
          obj: Record<string, unknown>,
          path: string = ''
        ): string[] => {
          const placeholders: string[] = [];
          for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(obj)) {
            const currentPath = path ? `${path}.${key}` : key;
            if (
              typeof value === 'string' &&
              value.includes('{') &&
              value.includes('}')
            ) {
              const matches = value.match(/\{[^}]+\}/g);
              if (matches) {
                placeholders.push(...matches.map(m => `${currentPath}:${m}`));
              }
            } else if (
              value !== null &&
              typeof value === 'object' &&
              !Array.isArray(value)
            ) {
              placeholders.push(
                ...checkForPlaceholders(
                  value as Record<string, unknown>,
                  currentPath
                )
              );
            }
          }
          return placeholders;
        };

        const remainingPlaceholders = checkForPlaceholders(
          substitutedCheckpointMetadata
        );
        if (remainingPlaceholders.length > 0) {
          // Log detailed variable state for debugging
          const variableValues: Record<string, unknown> = {};
          if (context.variables) {
            for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(context.variables)) {
              // Log all variables to help diagnose substitution issues
              if (typeof value === 'string' && value.length > 100) {
                variableValues[key] = `${value.substring(0, 100)}...`;
              } else if (Array.isArray(value)) {
                variableValues[key] = `Array(${value.length})${value.length > 0 ? `: [${value.slice(0, 3).map(v => String(v).substring(0, 50)).join(', ')}${value.length > 3 ? '...' : ''}]` : ''}`;
              } else {
                variableValues[key] = value;
              }
            }
          }
          
          logger.error('saveCheckpoint: Metadata contains unsubstituted placeholders', {
            checkpointId: substitutedCheckpointId,
            originalCheckpointId: step.checkpointId,
            remainingPlaceholders,
            placeholdersCount: remainingPlaceholders.length,
            metadataSample: Object.fromEntries(
              Object.entries(substitutedCheckpointMetadata).slice(0, 10)
            ),
            availableVariables: context.variables ? Object.keys(context.variables) : [],
            variableValues,
          });
          
          // Check if this is a critical checkpoint (job posting)
          if (substitutedCheckpointId.startsWith('job-')) {
            // For job postings, this is a critical error - variables should be resolved
            logger.error('CRITICAL: Job posting checkpoint has unsubstituted placeholders', {
              checkpointId: substitutedCheckpointId,
              remainingPlaceholders,
              variableValues,
            });
          }
        } else {
          // Log success for debugging
          if (typeof __DEV__ !== 'undefined' && __DEV__) {
            logger.debug('saveCheckpoint: All variables successfully substituted', {
              checkpointId: substitutedCheckpointId,
              metadataKeys: Object.keys(substitutedCheckpointMetadata),
            });
          }
        }
      } catch (error) {
        logger.error(
          'Error substituting variables in checkpoint metadata',
          error as Error,
          {
            checkpointId: step.checkpointId,
            metadataKeys: step.metadata ? Object.keys(step.metadata) : [],
          }
        );
        // Use original metadata if substitution fails - still save for debugging
        substitutedCheckpointMetadata = step.metadata || {};
      }

      if (
        context.recipeKey !== undefined &&
        substitutedCheckpointMetadata.recipeKey === undefined
      ) {
        substitutedCheckpointMetadata.recipeKey = context.recipeKey;
      }
      if (
        context.correlationId !== undefined &&
        substitutedCheckpointMetadata.correlationId === undefined
      ) {
        substitutedCheckpointMetadata.correlationId = context.correlationId;
      }

      // Save checkpoint with substituted values
      try {
        await runtime.saveCheckpoint(
          substitutedCheckpointId,
          substitutedCheckpointMetadata
        );

        logger.info('Checkpoint saved', {
          checkpointId: substitutedCheckpointId,
          metadataKeys: Object.keys(substitutedCheckpointMetadata),
        });
      } catch (error) {
        logger.error('Error saving checkpoint', error as Error, {
          checkpointId: substitutedCheckpointId,
        });
        throw error;
      }

      return undefined;

    case 'restoreCheckpoint':
      if (step.checkpointId === null || step.checkpointId === undefined)
        throw new Error('restoreCheckpoint step requires checkpointId');

      // Substitute variables in checkpointId
      const substitutedRestoreCheckpointId = substituteVariables(
        step.checkpointId,
        context
      );

      const restoredCheckpoint = await runtime.restoreCheckpoint(
        substitutedRestoreCheckpointId
      );

      // If checkpoint was not found, execute fallback steps (if provided).
      // This enables recipes to gracefully recover when checkpoints are missing.
      if (
        (restoredCheckpoint === null || restoredCheckpoint === undefined) &&
        Array.isArray(step.fallbackSteps) &&
        step.fallbackSteps.length > 0
      ) {
        logger.warn('restoreCheckpoint: Checkpoint not found, executing fallback steps', {
          checkpointId: substitutedRestoreCheckpointId,
          fallbackStepsCount: step.fallbackSteps.length,
        });
        for (const fallbackStep of step.fallbackSteps) {
          await executeStepWithTimeout(
            fallbackStep,
            runtime,
            context,
            undefined,
            undefined,
            options,
            onStepProgress
          );
        }
      }

      if (restoredCheckpoint && context.variables) {
        const lockedVariables = new Set(context.lockedVariables ?? []);
        // Merge restored checkpoint metadata into context variables
        for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(restoredCheckpoint)) {
          if (lockedVariables.has(key)) {
            if (typeof __DEV__ !== 'undefined' && __DEV__) {
              logger.debug('Preserving locked variable during checkpoint restore', {
                key,
              });
            }
            continue;
          }
          context.variables[key] = value;
        }
      }

      return restoredCheckpoint;

    case 'ensureFolder':
      if (step.path === null || step.path === undefined)
        throw new Error('ensureFolder step requires path');
      // Substitute variables again at execution time (variables may have been set in previous steps)
      const substitutedPath = substituteVariables(step.path, context, options);
      await runtime.ensureFolder(substitutedPath);
      return undefined;

    case 'selectDropdown':
      if (step.locator === null || step.locator === undefined)
        throw new Error('selectDropdown step requires locator');
      if (step.selectValue === null || step.selectValue === undefined)
        throw new Error('selectDropdown step requires selectValue');
      // Substitute variables in locator and selectValue
      const selectDropdownLocator = substituteVariablesInLocator(
        step.locator,
        context,
        options
      );
      const selectDropdownValue = substituteVariables(
        step.selectValue,
        context,
        options
      );
      await runtime.selectDropdown(selectDropdownLocator, selectDropdownValue);
      return undefined;

    case 'waitForPagination':
      if (step.locator === null || step.locator === undefined)
        throw new Error('waitForPagination step requires locator');
      // Substitute variables in locator
      const waitForPaginationLocator = substituteVariablesInLocator(
        step.locator,
        context,
        options
      );
      await runtime.waitForPagination(
        waitForPaginationLocator,
        step.expectedCount,
        step.timeout
      );
      return undefined;

    case 'navigateBack':
      await runtime.navigateBack(step.fallbackUrl);
      return undefined;

    case 'validateFolder':
      if (!step.validateFolder?.path) {
        throw new Error('validateFolder step requires path');
      }
      const substitutedFolderPath = substituteVariables(
        step.validateFolder.path,
        context,
        options
      );
      const folderExists = await runtime.validateFolderExists(
        substitutedFolderPath,
        step.validateFolder.timeoutMs
      );
      if (!folderExists && step.validateFolder.throwOnFailure !== false) {
        throw new Error(`Folder validation failed: ${substitutedFolderPath}`);
      }
      logger.info('Folder validation completed', {
        path: substitutedFolderPath,
        exists: folderExists,
        timeoutMs: step.validateFolder.timeoutMs,
      });
      return folderExists;

    case 'validateFile':
      if (!step.validateFile?.filePath) {
        throw new Error('validateFile step requires filePath');
      }
      const substitutedFilePath = substituteVariables(
        step.validateFile.filePath,
        context,
        options
      );
      const fileExists = await runtime.validateFileExists(
        substitutedFilePath,
        step.validateFile.timeoutMs
      );
      if (!fileExists && step.validateFile.throwOnFailure !== false) {
        throw new Error(`File validation failed: ${substitutedFilePath}`);
      }
      logger.info('File validation completed', {
        filePath: substitutedFilePath,
        exists: fileExists,
        validatedSlug: context.variables?.patientSlug,
      });
      return fileExists;

    case 'skipIf':
      if (!step.skipIf) {
        throw new Error('skipIf step requires skipIf configuration');
      }
      const varValue = context.variables?.[step.skipIf.variable];
      const shouldSkip = evaluateSkipCondition(
        varValue,
        step.skipIf,
        context,
        options
      );
      if (shouldSkip) {
        if (step.skipIf.action === 'break') {
          throw new BreakLoopError(
            `Breaking loop due to skipIf condition: ${step.skipIf.variable}`
          );
        }
        throw new SkipIterationError(
          `Skipping iteration due to skipIf condition: ${step.skipIf.variable}`
        );
      }
      return undefined;

    case 'recipeReference':
      if (!step.recipeReference) {
        throw new Error('recipeReference step requires recipeReference configuration');
      }
      
      
      // Support both string format ("app:recipeId") and object format ({app, recipeId, ...})
      let app: string;
      let recipeId: string;
      let variableMapping: Record<string, string> | undefined;
      let mergeResults: boolean | undefined;
      
      if (typeof step.recipeReference === 'string') {
        // Parse string format: "app:recipeId"
        const parts = step.recipeReference.split(':');
        if (parts.length !== 2) {
          throw new Error(`Invalid recipeReference string format: "${step.recipeReference}". Expected format: "app:recipeId"`);
        }
        app = parts[0];
        recipeId = parts[1];
        // Variables may be at step level when using string format
        variableMapping = step.variables as Record<string, string> | undefined;
      } else {
        // Object format: {app, recipeId, variables, mergeResults}
        ({ app, recipeId, variables: variableMapping, mergeResults } = step.recipeReference);
      }
      
      
      // Load referenced recipe from registry
      const referencedRecipe = getRecipe(app, recipeId);
      if (!referencedRecipe) {
        throw new Error(`Recipe not found: ${app}:${recipeId}`);
      }

      logger.info('Executing recipe reference', {
        app,
        recipeId,
        referencedRecipeName: referencedRecipe.name,
        correlationId: context.correlationId,
      });

      // Create child execution context with mapped variables
      const childContext: ExecutionContext = {
        ...context,
        variables: { ...context.variables },
      };

      // Map variables from parent context to child context
      if (variableMapping && context.variables) {
        for (const [childVar, parentVarOrTemplate] of Object.entries(variableMapping)) {
          // Handle both direct variable names and template strings (e.g., "{parentVar}")
          let value: unknown;
          if (typeof parentVarOrTemplate === 'string' && parentVarOrTemplate.startsWith('{') && parentVarOrTemplate.endsWith('}')) {
            // Template string: substitute it
            const varName = parentVarOrTemplate.slice(1, -1);
            value = context.variables[varName];
          } else {
            // Direct variable name: look it up
            value = context.variables[parentVarOrTemplate];
          }
          if (value !== undefined) {
            childContext.variables![childVar] = value;
          }
        }
      }

      // Execute referenced recipe
      const childOnStepProgress =
        options?.propagateRecipeReferenceProgress === true
          ? onStepProgress
          : undefined;
      const childResult = await executeRecipe(
        referencedRecipe,
        runtime,
        childContext,
        childOnStepProgress,
        options
      );

      if (!childResult.success) {
        // Special handling for login-check failures: track attempts and pause after 3
        if (app === 'bravado' && recipeId === 'login-check') {
          // Initialize or restore login attempt count
          if (!context.variables) {
            context.variables = {};
          }
          const currentAttempts = Number(context.variables.loginAttemptCount || 0);
          const newAttempts = currentAttempts + 1;
          
          // Update attempt count
          context.variables.loginAttemptCount = newAttempts;
          
          logger.warn('Login check failed - tracking attempt', {
            attempt: newAttempts,
            maxAttempts: 3,
            correlationId: context.correlationId,
          });
          
          // Save attempt count checkpoint
          try {
            await runtime.saveCheckpoint('login-attempts', {
              loginAttemptCount: newAttempts,
            });
          } catch (checkpointError) {
            logger.warn('Failed to save login attempt checkpoint', checkpointError as Error);
          }
          
          // If 3 attempts reached, save pause state and throw pause error
          if (newAttempts >= 3) {
            logger.error('Login check failed 3 times - pausing execution', {
              attempt: newAttempts,
              correlationId: context.correlationId,
            });
            
            // Save pause state checkpoint
            try {
              await runtime.saveCheckpoint('patients-export-v4-paused-login', {
                paused: true,
                pauseReason: 'login_failure',
                loginAttemptCount: newAttempts,
                currentStatus: context.variables.currentStatus,
                currentPage: context.variables.currentPage,
                patientRowIndex: context.variables.patientRowIndex,
                resumePage: context.variables.resumePage || context.variables.currentPage,
                resumeRowIndex: context.variables.resumeRowIndex || context.variables.patientRowIndex,
                resumeStatus: context.variables.resumeStatus || context.variables.currentStatus,
                baseFolder: context.baseDownloadFolder,
                correlationId: context.correlationId,
              });
            } catch (pauseCheckpointError) {
              logger.error('Failed to save pause checkpoint', pauseCheckpointError as Error);
            }
            
            // Throw special pause error
            const pauseError = new Error(
              'PAUSED_LOGIN_FAILURE: Scraping paused after 3 login failures. State saved. Click "Continue where you left off" to resume.'
            );
            (pauseError as any).pauseReason = 'login_failure';
            (pauseError as any).pauseCheckpointId = 'patients-export-v4-paused-login';
            throw pauseError;
          }
          
          // For attempts < 3, throw normal error to allow retry
          throw new Error(
            `Login check failed (attempt ${newAttempts}/3): ${childResult.error ?? 'Login screen detected'}`
          );
        }
        
        // For other recipe failures, throw normal error
        throw new Error(
          `Recipe reference execution failed: ${app}:${recipeId} - ${childResult.error ?? 'Unknown error'}`
        );
      }
      
      // On success, reset login attempt count
      if (app === 'bravado' && recipeId === 'login-check' && context.variables) {
        context.variables.loginAttemptCount = 0;
        try {
          await runtime.saveCheckpoint('login-attempts', {
            loginAttemptCount: 0,
          });
        } catch (checkpointError) {
          logger.warn('Failed to reset login attempt checkpoint', checkpointError as Error);
        }
      }

      // Merge results back to parent context if requested
      if (mergeResults && childResult.data && context.variables) {
        for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(childResult.data)) {
          context.variables[key] = value;
        }
        logger.info('Merged recipe reference results', {
          app,
          recipeId,
          mergedKeys: Object.keys(childResult.data),
        });
      }

      return childResult.data;

    case 'auditDuplicates':
      if (!step.auditDuplicates) {
        throw new Error('auditDuplicates step requires auditDuplicates configuration');
      }

      const {
        allPatientNamesKey = 'allPatientNames',
        existingPatientNamesKey = 'existingPatientNames',
        validRowIndicesKey = 'validRowIndices',
        auditSummaryKey = 'auditSummary',
        configFilePath,
      } = step.auditDuplicates;

      // Get arrays from context
      // Handle case where batch extraction failed (undefined) or returned empty array
      const allPatientNamesRaw = context.variables?.[allPatientNamesKey];
      const allPatientNames = Array.isArray(allPatientNamesRaw) 
        ? allPatientNamesRaw 
        : [];
      
      // If batch extraction failed and we're in non-duplicate mode, warn and skip
      if (allPatientNames.length === 0) {
        const nonDuplicateMode = String(context.variables?.nonDuplicateMode || '').toLowerCase() === 'true';
        
        if (nonDuplicateMode) {
          logger.warn('Batch extraction failed in non-duplicate mode - cannot perform audit', {
            allPatientNamesKey,
            allPatientNamesType: typeof allPatientNamesRaw,
            nonDuplicateMode: true,
          });
          
          // Set empty validRowIndices - loop will handle skipping
          if (!context.variables) {
            context.variables = {};
          }
          context.variables[validRowIndicesKey] = '';
          
          // Return early to skip audit
          return { skipped: true, reason: 'Batch extraction failed' };
        }
      }
      
      const existingPatientNamesStr = String(context.variables?.[existingPatientNamesKey] || '');
      
      // Log batch extraction status
      logger.info('Starting duplicate audit', {
        allPatientNamesCount: allPatientNames.length,
        allPatientNamesType: Array.isArray(allPatientNamesRaw) ? 'array' : typeof allPatientNamesRaw,
        existingPatientNamesCount: existingPatientNamesStr.split(',').filter(n => n.trim()).length,
      });

      // Parse existing patient names into Set for fast lookup
      const existingPatientNamesSet = new Set(
        existingPatientNamesStr
          .split(',')
          .map(name => name.trim().toLowerCase())
          .filter(name => name !== '')
      );

      // Helper function to parse patient name and create slugs
      // Creates first-last format slugs to match folder scanning format
      // Folder scanning extracts: patient-{id}-{index}-uiGrid-{gridId}-cell-{firstname}-{lastname}
      // So we create: {firstname}-{lastname} format (e.g., "FATUMA ABDULLAHI" -> "fatuma-abdullahi")
      // Also compute altSlug in last-first format for backward compatibility with older exports.
      const parseNameAndSlug = (nameText: string): {
        firstName: string;
        lastName: string;
        nameSlug: string;
        altSlug: string;
      } => {
        const trimmed = nameText.trim();
        if (!trimmed) {
          return { firstName: '', lastName: '', nameSlug: '', altSlug: '' };
        }

        // Handle format: "LASTNAME, FIRSTNAME" (with comma) - most common format
        let lastName = '';
        let firstName = '';
        
        if (trimmed.includes(',')) {
          const parts = trimmed.split(',').map(p => p.trim());
          lastName = parts[0] || '';
          firstName = parts.slice(1).join(' ').trim();
        } else {
          // Handle format: "LASTNAME FIRSTNAME" (without comma) - fallback
          const parts = trimmed.split(/\s+/);
          if (parts.length >= 2) {
            lastName = parts[0];
            firstName = parts.slice(1).join(' ');
          } else {
            lastName = trimmed;
          }
        }

        // Create first-last format slug to match folder scanning (primary)
        const nameSlug = firstName && lastName
          ? slugify(`${firstName} ${lastName}`) // "FATUMA ABDULLAHI" -> "fatuma-abdullahi"
          : slugify(trimmed);
        
        // Keep altSlug in last-first format for backward compatibility
        const altSlug = firstName && lastName
          ? slugify(`${lastName} ${firstName}`) // "ABDULLAHI FATUMA" -> "abdullahi-fatuma"
          : '';

        return { firstName, lastName, nameSlug, altSlug };
      };

      // Process each row and determine if it's valid
      const validIndices: number[] = [];
      const invalidIndices: number[] = [];
      const auditDetails: Array<{
        rowIndex: number;
        patientName: string;
        firstName: string;
        lastName: string;
        nameSlug: string;
        isValid: boolean;
        reason?: string;
      }> = [];

      // Audit each row based on name comparison only
      for (let i = 0; i < allPatientNames.length; i++) {
        const rawPatientName = allPatientNames[i];
        
        if (!rawPatientName || String(rawPatientName).trim() === '') {
          invalidIndices.push(i);
          auditDetails.push({
            rowIndex: i,
            patientName: '',
            firstName: '',
            lastName: '',
            nameSlug: '',
            isValid: false,
            reason: 'Missing patient name',
          });
          continue;
        }

        const patientName = String(rawPatientName).trim();
        const { firstName, lastName, nameSlug, altSlug } =
          parseNameAndSlug(patientName);

        if (!nameSlug) {
          invalidIndices.push(i);
          auditDetails.push({
            rowIndex: i,
            patientName,
            firstName,
            lastName,
            nameSlug: '',
            isValid: false,
            reason: 'Could not parse name',
          });
          continue;
        }

        const slugCandidates = [nameSlug, altSlug].filter(Boolean);
        const matchingSlug = slugCandidates.find(slug =>
          existingPatientNamesSet.has(slug.toLowerCase())
        );

        if (matchingSlug) {
          invalidIndices.push(i);
          auditDetails.push({
            rowIndex: i,
            patientName,
            firstName,
            lastName,
            nameSlug,
            isValid: false,
            reason: `Name slug "${matchingSlug}" exists in existing patients`,
          });
        } else {
          validIndices.push(i);
          auditDetails.push({
            rowIndex: i,
            patientName,
            firstName,
            lastName,
            nameSlug,
            isValid: true,
          });
        }
      }

      // Set valid row indices as comma-separated string
      // Always set this variable, even if empty, so loop can detect and fall back to DOM iteration
      if (!context.variables) {
        context.variables = {};
      }
      context.variables[validRowIndicesKey] = validIndices.length > 0 
        ? validIndices.join(',') 
        : '';
      
      logger.info('Audit completed - validRowIndices set', {
        validRowIndicesCount: validIndices.length,
        validRowIndicesStr: validIndices.length > 0 
          ? `${validIndices.slice(0, 10).join(',')}${validIndices.length > 10 ? '...' : ''}` 
          : '(empty - will fall back to DOM iteration)',
        allPatientNamesCount: allPatientNames.length,
      });

      // Create audit summary
      const auditSummary = {
        totalRows: allPatientNames.length,
        validRows: validIndices.length,
        invalidRows: invalidIndices.length,
        validRowIndices: validIndices,
        invalidRowIndices: invalidIndices,
        details: auditDetails,
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        page: context.variables?.currentPage || 'unknown',
        status: context.variables?.currentStatus || 'unknown',
        existingPatientNamesCount: existingPatientNamesSet.size,
      };

      context.variables[auditSummaryKey] = JSON.stringify(auditSummary);

      // Log audit summary
      logger.info('Page duplicate audit completed', {
        totalRows: auditSummary.totalRows,
        validRows: auditSummary.validRows,
        invalidRows: auditSummary.invalidRows,
        validRowIndices: auditSummary.validRowIndices.slice(0, 10), // Log first 10
        page: auditSummary.page,
        status: auditSummary.status,
      });

      // Log detailed summary for user
      const summaryLines = [
        `=== Duplicate Audit Summary (Page ${auditSummary.page}, ${auditSummary.status}) ===`,
        `Total Rows Audited: ${auditSummary.totalRows}`,
        `Valid Rows: ${auditSummary.validRows} (indices: ${validIndices.slice(0, 20).join(', ')}${validIndices.length > 20 ? '...' : ''})`,
        `Invalid Rows (Duplicates): ${auditSummary.invalidRows} (indices: ${invalidIndices.slice(0, 20).join(', ')}${invalidIndices.length > 20 ? '...' : ''})`,
        `Existing Patient Names in Folder: ${auditSummary.existingPatientNamesCount}`,
      ];

      if (invalidIndices.length > 0) {
        summaryLines.push('\nInvalid Row Details (Duplicates):');
        auditDetails
          .filter(d => !d.isValid)
          .slice(0, 10)
          .forEach(detail => {
            summaryLines.push(
              `  Row ${detail.rowIndex}: Name="${detail.patientName}" (${detail.firstName} ${detail.lastName}), Slug="${detail.nameSlug}", Reason=${detail.reason || 'duplicate'}`
            );
          });
        if (invalidIndices.length > 10) {
          summaryLines.push(`  ... and ${invalidIndices.length - 10} more duplicates`);
        }
      }

      if (validIndices.length > 0) {
        summaryLines.push('\nValid Row Details (Will Extract):');
        auditDetails
          .filter(d => d.isValid)
          .slice(0, 5)
          .forEach(detail => {
            summaryLines.push(
              `  Row ${detail.rowIndex}: Name="${detail.patientName}" (${detail.firstName} ${detail.lastName}), Slug="${detail.nameSlug}"`
            );
          });
        if (validIndices.length > 5) {
          summaryLines.push(`  ... and ${validIndices.length - 5} more valid rows`);
        }
      }

      logger.info(summaryLines.join('\n'));

      // Store audit config in variable for logging/export
      // The config can be copied from logs or exported via the auditSummary variable
      if (configFilePath) {
        const configContent = JSON.stringify(auditSummary, null, 2);
        if (!context.variables) {
          context.variables = {};
        }
        // Store full config as JSON string in a variable
        context.variables[`${auditSummaryKey}_config`] = configContent;
        logger.info('Audit config stored in variable', {
          variableName: `${auditSummaryKey}_config`,
          path: configFilePath,
          contentLength: configContent.length,
          summary: {
            totalRows: auditSummary.totalRows,
            validRows: auditSummary.validRows,
            invalidRows: auditSummary.invalidRows,
          },
        });
      }

      // Ensure validRowIndices is stored as a string for easy access in UI
      if (!context.variables) {
        context.variables = {};
      }
      context.variables[validRowIndicesKey] = validIndices.join(',');

      return auditSummary;

    case 'comment':
      // Comment step for observability - log the comment and continue
      const commentValue = (step as any).value || step.description || 'Comment step';
      logger.info(`[Comment] ${commentValue}`, {
        stepType: 'comment',
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      });
      return undefined;

    default:
      throw new Error(`Unknown step type: ${(step as RecipeStep).type}`);
  }
}

/**
 * Evaluate skip condition based on operator and variable value
 *
 * Supports checking if a variable matches a pattern AND another variable has a specific value.
 * This is used for sponsored result filtering: skip if includeSponsored is 'false' AND href contains pattern.
 */
function evaluateSkipCondition(
  varValue: unknown,
  skipIf: {
    variable: string;
    value?: string;
    operator?: string;
    andVariable?: string;
    andValue?: string;
    action?: 'skip' | 'break';
  },
  context: ExecutionContext,
  options?: RecipeExecutorOptions
): boolean {
  const operator = skipIf.operator || 'truthy';
  const valueStr = varValue !== null && varValue !== undefined ? String(varValue) : '';
  const compareValueRaw = skipIf.value || '';
  const compareValue = compareValueRaw.includes('{')
    ? substituteVariables(compareValueRaw, context, options)
    : compareValueRaw;

  // Check primary condition
  let primaryCondition: boolean;
  switch (operator) {
    case 'equals':
      primaryCondition = valueStr === compareValue;
      break;
    case 'notEquals':
      primaryCondition = valueStr !== compareValue;
      break;
    case 'contains':
      // For comma-separated lists, check for exact matches (not substring matches)
      // This prevents false positives like "123" matching "1234"
      if (valueStr.includes(',')) {
        // Split by comma and check for exact match
        const items = valueStr.split(',').map(s => s.trim());
        primaryCondition = items.includes(compareValue.trim());
      } else {
        // Simple substring check for non-comma-separated strings
        primaryCondition = valueStr.includes(compareValue);
      }
      break;
    case 'notContains':
      // For comma-separated lists, check for exact non-match (not substring)
      if (compareValue.includes(',')) {
        // Split by comma and check if valueStr is NOT in the list
        const items = compareValue.split(',').map(s => s.trim());
        primaryCondition = !items.includes(valueStr.trim());
      } else {
        // Simple substring check for non-comma-separated strings
        primaryCondition = !valueStr.includes(compareValue);
      }
      break;
    case 'truthy':
      primaryCondition = Boolean(varValue);
      break;
    case 'falsy':
      primaryCondition = !Boolean(varValue);
      break;
    case 'gte':
      // Greater than or equal - numeric comparison
      const varNum = Number(valueStr);
      const compareNum = Number(compareValue);
      // Special handling: if comparing pageIterationIndex (0-based) to totalPages (1-based),
      // we need to break when we've processed all pages
      // Since pageIterationIndex is 0-based (0, 1, 2...) and totalPages is 1-based (1, 2, 3...),
      // break when pageIterationIndex >= totalPages - 1
      // Example: totalPages = 2, we process index 0 (page 1) and index 1 (page 2), then break
      if (skipIf.variable === 'pageIterationIndex') {
        // Break when we've already processed the last page
        // pageIterationIndex 0 = page 1, so break when index >= totalPages - 1
        primaryCondition = !isNaN(varNum) && !isNaN(compareNum) && varNum >= compareNum - 1;
      } else {
        primaryCondition = !isNaN(varNum) && !isNaN(compareNum) && varNum >= compareNum;
      }
      break;
    case 'gt':
      // Greater than - numeric comparison
      const varNumGt = Number(valueStr);
      const compareNumGt = Number(compareValue);
      primaryCondition = !isNaN(varNumGt) && !isNaN(compareNumGt) && varNumGt > compareNumGt;
      break;
    case 'lte':
      // Less than or equal - numeric comparison
      const varNumLte = Number(valueStr);
      const compareNumLte = Number(compareValue);
      primaryCondition = !isNaN(varNumLte) && !isNaN(compareNumLte) && varNumLte <= compareNumLte;
      break;
    case 'lt':
      // Less than - numeric comparison
      const varNumLt = Number(valueStr);
      const compareNumLt = Number(compareValue);
      primaryCondition = !isNaN(varNumLt) && !isNaN(compareNumLt) && varNumLt < compareNumLt;
      break;
    case 'notIn':
      // Check if value is NOT in comma-separated list (proper membership check)
      const notInListStr = String(compareValue);
      const notInList = notInListStr.split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
      primaryCondition = !notInList.includes(valueStr.trim());
      break;
    case 'in':
      // Check if value IS in comma-separated list (proper membership check)
      const inListStrPrimary = String(compareValue);
      const inListPrimary = inListStrPrimary.split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
      primaryCondition = inListPrimary.includes(valueStr.trim());
      break;
    default:
      logger.warn('Unknown skipIf operator, defaulting to truthy', {
        operator,
        variable: skipIf.variable,
      });
      primaryCondition = Boolean(varValue);
  }

  // If there's an AND condition, check it as well
  if (skipIf.andVariable) {
    const andVarValue = context.variables?.[skipIf.andVariable];
    const andValueStr = andVarValue !== null && andVarValue !== undefined ? String(andVarValue) : '';
    const andCompareValueRaw = skipIf.andValue || '';
    const andCompareValue = andCompareValueRaw.includes('{')
      ? substituteVariables(andCompareValueRaw, context, options)
      : andCompareValueRaw;
    const andOperator = skipIf.andOperator || 'equals';
    
    // Evaluate AND condition based on operator
    let andCondition: boolean;
    switch (andOperator) {
      case 'equals':
        andCondition = andCompareValue !== '' 
          ? andValueStr === andCompareValue
          : Boolean(andVarValue);
        break;
      case 'notEquals':
        andCondition = andCompareValue !== '' 
          ? andValueStr !== andCompareValue
          : !Boolean(andVarValue);
        break;
      case 'contains':
        if (andCompareValue !== '') {
          // For comma-separated lists, check for exact matches (not substring matches)
          if (andValueStr.includes(',')) {
            const items = andValueStr.split(',').map(s => s.trim());
            andCondition = items.includes(andCompareValue.trim());
          } else {
            andCondition = andValueStr.includes(andCompareValue);
          }
        } else {
          andCondition = Boolean(andVarValue);
        }
        break;
      case 'notContains':
        if (andCompareValue !== '') {
          // For comma-separated lists, check for exact non-match (not substring)
          if (andCompareValue.includes(',')) {
            const items = andCompareValue.split(',').map(s => s.trim());
            andCondition = !items.includes(andValueStr.trim());
          } else {
            andCondition = !andValueStr.includes(andCompareValue);
          }
        } else {
          andCondition = !Boolean(andVarValue);
        }
        break;
      case 'truthy':
        andCondition = Boolean(andVarValue);
        break;
      case 'falsy':
        andCondition = !Boolean(andVarValue);
        break;
      case 'gte':
        const andVarNum = Number(andValueStr);
        const andCompareNum = Number(andCompareValue);
        andCondition = !isNaN(andVarNum) && !isNaN(andCompareNum) && andVarNum >= andCompareNum;
        break;
      case 'gt':
        const andVarNumGt = Number(andValueStr);
        const andCompareNumGt = Number(andCompareValue);
        andCondition = !isNaN(andVarNumGt) && !isNaN(andCompareNumGt) && andVarNumGt > andCompareNumGt;
        break;
      case 'lte':
        const andVarNumLte = Number(andValueStr);
        const andCompareNumLte = Number(andCompareValue);
        andCondition = !isNaN(andVarNumLte) && !isNaN(andCompareNumLte) && andVarNumLte <= andCompareNumLte;
        break;
      case 'lt':
        const andVarNumLt = Number(andValueStr);
        const andCompareNumLt = Number(andCompareValue);
        andCondition = !isNaN(andVarNumLt) && !isNaN(andCompareNumLt) && andVarNumLt < andCompareNumLt;
        break;
      case 'notIn':
        // Check if value is NOT in comma-separated list (proper membership check)
        const listStr = String(andCompareValue);
        const list = listStr.split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
        andCondition = !list.includes(andValueStr.trim());
        break;
      case 'in':
        // Check if value IS in comma-separated list (proper membership check)
        const inListStr = String(andCompareValue);
        const inList = inListStr.split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
        andCondition = inList.includes(andValueStr.trim());
        break;
      default:
        logger.warn('Unknown skipIf andOperator, defaulting to equals', {
          andOperator,
          andVariable: skipIf.andVariable,
        });
        andCondition = andCompareValue !== '' 
          ? andValueStr === andCompareValue
          : Boolean(andVarValue);
    }
    
    // Both conditions must be true to skip
    return primaryCondition && andCondition;
  }

  return primaryCondition;
}

import { logger } from '@chrome-ext/core-telemetry';

const STATE_PREFIX = 'recipe_state:';
const CHECKPOINT_PREFIX = 'checkpoint:';
const DEFAULT_STATE_TTL_MS = 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

export type RecipeStatePayload = {
  recipeKey: string;
  correlationId: string;
  checkpointId: string;
  savedAt: string;
  checkpoint: Record<string, unknown>;
};

export type RecipeStateContext = {
  recipeKey?: string;
  correlationId?: string;
};

export class RecipeStateManager {
  static buildStateKey(recipeKey: string, correlationId: string): string {
    return `${STATE_PREFIX}${recipeKey}:${correlationId}`;
  }

  static async saveState(
    context: RecipeStateContext,
    checkpointId: string,
    checkpoint: Record<string, unknown>
  ): Promise<void> {
    const recipeKey = context.recipeKey;
    const correlationId = context.correlationId;
    if (!recipeKey || !correlationId) {
      logger.debug('Skipping state save: missing recipeKey or correlationId', {
        recipeKey,
        correlationId,
        checkpointId,
      });
      return;
    }

    const stateKey = RecipeStateManager.buildStateKey(
      recipeKey,
      correlationId
    );
    const payload: RecipeStatePayload = {
      recipeKey,
      correlationId,
      checkpointId,
      savedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      checkpoint,
    };

    await chrome.storage.local.set({ [stateKey]: payload });
    await RecipeStateManager.cleanupOldCheckpoints(context, checkpointId);
  }

  static async loadState(
    context: RecipeStateContext
  ): Promise<RecipeStatePayload | null> {
    const recipeKey = context.recipeKey;
    const correlationId = context.correlationId;
    if (!recipeKey || !correlationId) {
      return null;
    }

    const stateKey = RecipeStateManager.buildStateKey(
      recipeKey,
      correlationId
    );
    const result = await chrome.storage.local.get(stateKey);
    const payload = result[stateKey];
    if (!payload) {
      return null;
    }
    return payload as RecipeStatePayload;
  }

  static async cleanupOldCheckpoints(
    context: RecipeStateContext,
    keepCheckpointId?: string
  ): Promise<void> {
    const recipeKey = context.recipeKey;
    const correlationId = context.correlationId;
    if (!recipeKey || !correlationId) {
      return;
    }

    const allData = await chrome.storage.local.get(null);
    const keysToRemove: string[] = [];

    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(allData)) {
      if (!key.startsWith(CHECKPOINT_PREFIX)) {
        continue;
      }
      const payload = value as Record<string, unknown>;
      const payloadRecipeKey =
        typeof payload.recipeKey === 'string' ? payload.recipeKey : undefined;
      const payloadCorrelationId =
        typeof payload.correlationId === 'string'
          ? payload.correlationId
          : undefined;
      const payloadCheckpointId =
        typeof payload.id === 'string' ? payload.id : undefined;

      if (
        payloadRecipeKey === recipeKey &&
        payloadCorrelationId === correlationId &&
        payloadCheckpointId !== keepCheckpointId
      ) {
        keysToRemove.push(key);
      }
    }

    if (keysToRemove.length > 0) {
      await chrome.storage.local.remove(keysToRemove);
      logger.info('Cleaned up old checkpoints', {
        recipeKey,
        correlationId,
        removed: keysToRemove.length,
      });
    }
  }

  static async cleanupOldStates(
    maxAgeMs: number = DEFAULT_STATE_TTL_MS
  ): Promise<number> {
    const now = Date.now();
    const allData = await chrome.storage.local.get(null);
    const keysToRemove: string[] = [];

    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(allData)) {
      if (!key.startsWith(STATE_PREFIX)) {
        continue;
      }
      const payload = value as Record<string, unknown>;
      const savedAt =
        typeof payload.savedAt === 'string' ? Date.parse(payload.savedAt) : NaN;
      if (!Number.isNaN(savedAt) && now - savedAt > maxAgeMs) {
        keysToRemove.push(key);
      }
    }

    if (keysToRemove.length > 0) {
      await chrome.storage.local.remove(keysToRemove);
    }

    return keysToRemove.length;
  }
}

/**
 * Recipe Registry
 *
 * Manages recipe registration and retrieval.
 */

import { logger } from '@chrome-ext/core-telemetry';
import type { Recipe, RecipeMetadata, AppId } from './types.js';

// Recipe storage - populated at build time or runtime
const recipes = new Map<string, Recipe>();
const metadata = new Map<string, RecipeMetadata>();
const dependencyGraph = new Map<string, Set<string>>(); // recipeKey -> Set of dependency keys

/**
 * Register a recipe
 */
export function registerRecipe(app: AppId, id: string, recipe: Recipe, dependsOn?: string[]): void {
  const key = `${app}:${id}`;
  recipes.set(key, recipe);
  
  const recipeMetadata: RecipeMetadata = {
    app,
    id,
    name: recipe.name,
    url: recipe.url,
    tags: recipe.tags,
    dependsOn,
  };
  metadata.set(key, recipeMetadata);

  // Build dependency graph
  if (dependsOn && dependsOn.length > 0) {
    dependencyGraph.set(key, new Set(dependsOn));
    // Validate no circular dependencies
    validateDependencies(key, new Set<string>());
  } else {
    dependencyGraph.set(key, new Set());
  }

  logger.debug('Recipe registered', { app, id, name: recipe.name, dependsOn });
}

/**
 * Validate that there are no circular dependencies
 */
function validateDependencies(recipeKey: string, visited: Set<string>): void {
  if (visited.has(recipeKey)) {
    throw new Error(`Circular dependency detected involving recipe: ${recipeKey}`);
  }

  visited.add(recipeKey);
  const dependencies = dependencyGraph.get(recipeKey);
  if (dependencies) {
    for (const dep of dependencies) {
      validateDependencies(dep, new Set(visited));
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Get all dependencies for a recipe (transitive)
 */
export function getRecipeDependencies(recipeKey: string): string[] {
  const visited = new Set<string>();
  const collectDependencies = (key: string): void => {
    if (visited.has(key)) {
      return;
    }
    visited.add(key);
    const deps = dependencyGraph.get(key);
    if (deps) {
      for (const dep of deps) {
        collectDependencies(dep);
      }
    }
  };
  collectDependencies(recipeKey);
  visited.delete(recipeKey); // Remove self
  return Array.from(visited);
}

/**
 * Get a recipe by app and ID
 */
export function getRecipe(app: AppId, id: string): Recipe | null {
  const recipe = recipes.get(`${app}:${id}`) ?? null;
  if (recipe === null || recipe === undefined) {
    logger.warn('Recipe not found', { app, id });
  }
  return recipe;
}

/**
 * List all recipes, optionally filtered by app
 */
export function listRecipes(app?: AppId): RecipeMetadata[] {
  const all = Array.from(metadata.values());
  if (app) {
    return all.filter(r => r.app === app);
  }
  return all;
}

/**
 * Get recipe metadata
 */
export function getRecipeMetadata(
  app: AppId,
  id: string
): RecipeMetadata | null {
  return metadata.get(`${app}:${id}`) ?? null;
}

/**
 * Check if a recipe exists
 */
export function hasRecipe(app: AppId, id: string): boolean {
  return recipes.has(`${app}:${id}`);
}

/**
 * Reset the registry (useful for testing)
 */
export function resetRegistry(): void {
  recipes.clear();
  metadata.clear();
  dependencyGraph.clear();
  logger.debug('Recipe registry reset');
}

/**
 * Get all recipes for an app
 */
export function getRecipesForApp(app: AppId): Recipe[] {
  return Array.from(recipes.entries())
    .filter(([key]) => key.startsWith(`${app}:`))
    .map(([, recipe]) => recipe);
}

/**
 * Selector Fallback Store
 *
 * Stores user-selected fallback selectors for recipe steps.
 */

import type { Locator } from './types.js';
import { logger } from '@chrome-ext/core-telemetry';

export interface SelectorFallback {
  recipeKey: string;
  stepIndex: number;
  originalLocator: Locator;
  fallbackLocator: Locator;
  createdAt: string;
}

const STORAGE_KEY_PREFIX = 'selector-fallback:';

/**
 * Get storage key for a recipe step
 */
function getStorageKey(recipeKey: string, stepIndex: number): string {
  return `${STORAGE_KEY_PREFIX}${recipeKey}:${stepIndex}`;
}

/**
 * Store a fallback selector for a recipe step
 */
export async function storeFallbackSelector(
  recipeKey: string,
  stepIndex: number,
  originalLocator: Locator,
  fallbackLocator: Locator
): Promise<void> {
  const key = getStorageKey(recipeKey, stepIndex);
  const fallback: SelectorFallback = {
    recipeKey,
    stepIndex,
    originalLocator,
    fallbackLocator,
    createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  };

  try {
    await chrome.storage.local.set({ [key]: fallback });
    logger.info('Fallback selector stored', {
      recipeKey,
      stepIndex,
      fallbackLocator,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Failed to store fallback selector', error as Error, {
      recipeKey,
      stepIndex,
    });
    throw error;
  }
}

/**
 * Get fallback selector for a recipe step
 */
export async function getFallbackSelector(
  recipeKey: string,
  stepIndex: number
): Promise<Locator | null> {
  const key = getStorageKey(recipeKey, stepIndex);

  try {
    const result = await chrome.storage.local.get(key);
    const fallback = result[key] as SelectorFallback | undefined;
    if (fallback) {
      return fallback.fallbackLocator;
    }
    return null;
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Failed to get fallback selector', error as Error, {
      recipeKey,
      stepIndex,
    });
    return null;
  }
}

/**
 * Get all fallback selectors for a recipe
 */
export async function getFallbackSelectorsForRecipe(
  recipeKey: string
): Promise<Map<number, Locator>> {
  const fallbacks = new Map<number, Locator>();

  try {
    const allItems = await chrome.storage.local.get(null);
    const prefix = getStorageKey(recipeKey, 0).replace(':0', ':');

    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(allItems)) {
      if (key.startsWith(prefix)) {
        const fallback = value as SelectorFallback;
        if (fallback.recipeKey === recipeKey) {
          fallbacks.set(fallback.stepIndex, fallback.fallbackLocator);
        }
      }
    }
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Failed to get fallback selectors for recipe', error as Error, {
      recipeKey,
    });
  }

  return fallbacks;
}

/**
 * Remove fallback selector for a recipe step
 */
export async function removeFallbackSelector(
  recipeKey: string,
  stepIndex: number
): Promise<void> {
  const key = getStorageKey(recipeKey, stepIndex);

  try {
    await chrome.storage.local.remove(key);
    logger.info('Fallback selector removed', {
      recipeKey,
      stepIndex,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Failed to remove fallback selector', error as Error, {
      recipeKey,
      stepIndex,
    });
    throw error;
  }
}

/**
 * Clear all fallback selectors for a recipe
 */
export async function clearFallbackSelectorsForRecipe(recipeKey: string): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const allItems = await chrome.storage.local.get(null);
    const prefix = getStorageKey(recipeKey, 0).replace(':0', ':');
    const keysToRemove: string[] = [];

    for (const key of Object.keys(allItems)) {
      if (key.startsWith(prefix)) {
        const fallback = allItems[key] as SelectorFallback;
        if (fallback.recipeKey === recipeKey) {
          keysToRemove.push(key);
        }
      }
    }

    if (keysToRemove.length > 0) {
      await chrome.storage.local.remove(keysToRemove);
      logger.info('Cleared fallback selectors for recipe', {
        recipeKey,
        count: keysToRemove.length,
      });
    }
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Failed to clear fallback selectors', error as Error, {
      recipeKey,
    });
    throw error;
  }
}

==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/libs/Google-Chrome-Extension-Library/automation/recipes/src/tests/url-normalization.spec.ts ====
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';

// Import the normalizeUrlForComparison function
// Since it's not exported, we'll test it indirectly through the goto behavior
// or we can export it for testing
// For now, let's test the logic by creating a testable version

/**
 * Test helper that mirrors the normalizeUrlForComparison logic
 * This tests the URL normalization logic that's used in content-runtime.ts
 */
function normalizeUrlForComparison(url: string): string {
  if (!url || url.length === 0) {
    return '';
  }

  try {
    // Handle relative URLs or URLs without protocol
    let fullUrl = url.trim();
    if (!fullUrl.startsWith('http://') && !fullUrl.startsWith('https://')) {
      fullUrl = `https://${fullUrl}`;
    }

    const urlObj = new URL(fullUrl);

    // Normalize protocol (treat http/https as same for comparison)
    const protocol = 'https'; // Always use https for comparison

    // Normalize hostname (lowercase)
    const hostname = urlObj.hostname.toLowerCase();

    // Normalize pathname (remove trailing slash except root)
    let pathname = urlObj.pathname;
    if (pathname.length > 1 && pathname.endsWith('/')) {
      pathname = pathname.slice(0, -1);
    }

    // Preserve hash (critical for SPA routing like #!/app/...)
    const hash = urlObj.hash;

    // Normalize query params (sort for consistent comparison)
    const searchParams = new URLSearchParams(urlObj.search);
    const sortedParams = Array.from(searchParams.entries())
      .sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b))
      .map(([k, v]) => `${k}=${v}`)
      .join('&');

    // Reconstruct normalized URL
    const normalized = `${protocol}://${hostname}${pathname}${hash}${sortedParams ? `?${sortedParams}` : ''}`;

    return normalized;
  } catch (error) {
    // Fallback to original URL if parsing fails (with basic normalization)
    return url.toLowerCase().trim();
  }
}

describe('normalizeUrlForComparison', () => {
  describe('Basic URL normalization', () => {
    it('should normalize protocol (http to https)', () => {
      const url1 = 'http://example.com/page';
      const url2 = 'https://example.com/page';
      expect(normalizeUrlForComparison(url1)).toBe(
        normalizeUrlForComparison(url2)
      );
    });

    it('should normalize hostname to lowercase', () => {
      const url1 = 'https://EXAMPLE.COM/page';
      const url2 = 'https://example.com/page';
      expect(normalizeUrlForComparison(url1)).toBe(
        normalizeUrlForComparison(url2)
      );
    });

    it('should remove trailing slashes from path', () => {
      const url1 = 'https://example.com/page/';
      const url2 = 'https://example.com/page';
      expect(normalizeUrlForComparison(url1)).toBe(
        normalizeUrlForComparison(url2)
      );
    });

    it('should preserve root path trailing slash', () => {
      const url1 = 'https://example.com/';
      const url2 = 'https://example.com/';
      const normalized = normalizeUrlForComparison(url1);
      expect(normalized.endsWith('/')).toBe(true);
    });
  });

  describe('Hash-based routing (SPA)', () => {
    it('should preserve hash fragments for SPA routing', () => {
      const url1 = 'https://ayva.bravadohealth.com/#!/app/patient-encounter/manage-patient';
      const url2 = 'https://ayva.bravadohealth.com/#!/app/patient-encounter/manage-patient';
      expect(normalizeUrlForComparison(url1)).toBe(
        normalizeUrlForComparison(url2)
      );
    });

    it('should distinguish different hash routes', () => {
      const url1 = 'https://example.com/#!/app/page1';
      const url2 = 'https://example.com/#!/app/page2';
      expect(normalizeUrlForComparison(url1)).not.toBe(
        normalizeUrlForComparison(url2)
      );
    });

    it('should normalize hash routes with different protocols', () => {
      const url1 = 'http://example.com/#!/app/page';
      const url2 = 'https://example.com/#!/app/page';
      expect(normalizeUrlForComparison(url1)).toBe(
        normalizeUrlForComparison(url2)
      );
    });
  });

  describe('Query parameters', () => {
    it('should sort query parameters for consistent comparison', () => {
      const url1 = 'https://example.com/page?b=2&a=1';
      const url2 = 'https://example.com/page?a=1&b=2';
      expect(normalizeUrlForComparison(url1)).toBe(
        normalizeUrlForComparison(url2)
      );
    });

    it('should handle URLs with and without query params', () => {
      const url1 = 'https://example.com/page';
      const url2 = 'https://example.com/page?';
      // These should match when comparing without query params
      const normalized1 = normalizeUrlForComparison(url1);
      const normalized2 = normalizeUrlForComparison(url2);
      expect(normalized1.split('?')[0]).toBe(normalized2.split('?')[0]);
    });
  });

  describe('Edge cases', () => {
    it('should handle empty URL', () => {
      expect(normalizeUrlForComparison('')).toBe('');
    });

    it('should handle URL without protocol', () => {
      const url1 = 'example.com/page';
      const url2 = 'https://example.com/page';
      expect(normalizeUrlForComparison(url1)).toBe(
        normalizeUrlForComparison(url2)
      );
    });

    it('should handle URLs with ports', () => {
      const url1 = 'https://example.com:443/page';
      const url2 = 'https://example.com/page';
      // Port 443 is default for HTTPS, so they should normalize similarly
      const normalized1 = normalizeUrlForComparison(url1);
      const normalized2 = normalizeUrlForComparison(url2);
      // Both should have the same hostname and path
      expect(normalized1.split('/').slice(0, 3)).toEqual(
        normalized2.split('/').slice(0, 3)
      );
    });

    it('should handle malformed URLs gracefully', () => {
      const malformed = 'not-a-valid-url';
      const normalized = normalizeUrlForComparison(malformed);
      // Should return lowercase trimmed version as fallback
      expect(typeof normalized).toBe('string');
      expect(normalized.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    });
  });

  describe('Real-world Bravado URL scenarios', () => {
    it('should match Bravado URLs with same hash route', () => {
      const url1 = 'https://ayva.bravadohealth.com/#!/app/patient-encounter/manage-patient';
      const url2 = 'https://ayva.bravadohealth.com/#!/app/patient-encounter/manage-patient';
      expect(normalizeUrlForComparison(url1)).toBe(
        normalizeUrlForComparison(url2)
      );
    });

    it('should match Bravado URLs with different protocols', () => {
      const url1 = 'http://ayva.bravadohealth.com/#!/app/patient-encounter/manage-patient';
      const url2 = 'https://ayva.bravadohealth.com/#!/app/patient-encounter/manage-patient';
      expect(normalizeUrlForComparison(url1)).toBe(
        normalizeUrlForComparison(url2)
      );
    });

    it('should match Bravado URLs with trailing slash in pathname', () => {
      // For hash-based routing, trailing slash in pathname (before hash) should be normalized
      const url1 = 'https://ayva.bravadohealth.com/#!/app/patient-encounter/manage-patient';
      const url2 = 'https://ayva.bravadohealth.com/#!/app/patient-encounter/manage-patient';
      // Note: The hash fragment contains the route, so pathname trailing slashes don't apply
      // Both URLs should normalize the same since the pathname is "/" and hash is the same
      expect(normalizeUrlForComparison(url1)).toBe(
        normalizeUrlForComparison(url2)
      );
    });

    it('should distinguish different Bravado routes', () => {
      const url1 = 'https://ayva.bravadohealth.com/#!/app/patient-encounter/manage-patient';
      const url2 = 'https://ayva.bravadohealth.com/#!/app/dashboard';
      expect(normalizeUrlForComparison(url1)).not.toBe(
        normalizeUrlForComparison(url2)
      );
    });
  });
});

/**
 * URL Validation Utilities
 *
 * Provides utilities for validating URL matches and handling navigation recovery.
 */

export interface UrlMatchResult {
  isMatch: boolean;
  exactMatch: boolean;
  normalizedMatch: boolean;
  partialMatch: boolean;
  hashMatch: boolean;
  pathnameHashMatch: boolean;
  matchType?: string;
}

/**
 * Normalize URL for comparison (remove trailing slashes, normalize protocol, etc.)
 */
export function normalizeUrlForComparison(url: string): string {
  try {
    const urlObj = new URL(url);
    // Normalize protocol to lowercase
    urlObj.protocol = urlObj.protocol.toLowerCase();
    // Normalize hostname to lowercase
    urlObj.hostname = urlObj.hostname.toLowerCase();
    // Remove trailing slash from pathname (except root)
    if (urlObj.pathname.length > 1 && urlObj.pathname.endsWith('/')) {
      urlObj.pathname = urlObj.pathname.slice(0, -1);
    }
    return urlObj.toString();
  } catch {
    // If URL parsing fails, return normalized string
    return url
      .toLowerCase()
      .replace(/\/+$/, '')
      .trim();
  }
}

/**
 * Check if two URLs match using multiple comparison strategies
 */
export function isUrlMatch(currentUrl: string, targetUrl: string): boolean {
  const result = checkUrlMatch(currentUrl, targetUrl);
  return result.isMatch;
}

/**
 * Check URL match with detailed results
 */
export function checkUrlMatch(currentUrl: string, targetUrl: string): UrlMatchResult {
  // Exact match
  const exactMatch = currentUrl === targetUrl;

  // Normalized match (ignores trailing slashes, case differences)
  const normalizedCurrent = normalizeUrlForComparison(currentUrl);
  const normalizedTarget = normalizeUrlForComparison(targetUrl);
  const normalizedMatch = normalizedCurrent === normalizedTarget;

  // Partial match (same origin + pathname, ignoring query/hash)
  let partialMatch = false;
  let hashMatch = false;
  let pathnameHashMatch = false;

  try {
    const currentUrlObj = new URL(currentUrl);
    const targetUrlObj = new URL(targetUrl);

    // Check if origin + pathname match (ignoring query and hash)
    partialMatch =
      currentUrlObj.origin.toLowerCase() === targetUrlObj.origin.toLowerCase() &&
      currentUrlObj.pathname.toLowerCase() === targetUrlObj.pathname.toLowerCase();

    // Hash-based matching (for SPA routes)
    hashMatch = currentUrlObj.hash === targetUrlObj.hash && currentUrlObj.hash !== '';

    // Pathname + hash match (for hash-based routing)
    pathnameHashMatch =
      currentUrlObj.pathname === targetUrlObj.pathname &&
      currentUrlObj.hash === targetUrlObj.hash &&
      currentUrlObj.hash !== '';
  } catch {
    // URL parsing failed, fall back to string comparison
  }

  const isMatch = exactMatch || normalizedMatch || partialMatch || hashMatch || pathnameHashMatch;

  let matchType: string | undefined;
  if (exactMatch) {
    matchType = 'exact';
  } else if (normalizedMatch) {
    matchType = 'normalized';
  } else if (pathnameHashMatch) {
    matchType = 'pathname_hash';
  } else if (hashMatch) {
    matchType = 'hash';
  } else if (partialMatch) {
    matchType = 'partial';
  }

  return {
    isMatch,
    exactMatch,
    normalizedMatch,
    partialMatch,
    hashMatch,
    pathnameHashMatch,
    matchType,
  };
}

/**
 * Validate navigation result
 */
export async function validateNavigation(
  targetUrl: string,
  getCurrentUrl: () => Promise<string>
): Promise<{ success: boolean; currentUrl: string; reason?: string }> {
  const currentUrl = await getCurrentUrl();
  const matchResult = checkUrlMatch(currentUrl, targetUrl);

  if (matchResult.isMatch) {
    return {
      success: true,
      currentUrl,
      reason: matchResult.matchType,
    };
  }

  return {
    success: false,
    currentUrl,
    reason: 'url_mismatch',
  };
}
















==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/libs/Google-Chrome-Extension-Library/automation/recipes/src/validation.ts ====
import type { Recipe, RecipeStep } from './types.js';

export function validateRecipe(recipe: unknown): recipe is Recipe {
  if (recipe === null || recipe === undefined || typeof recipe !== 'object') {
    return false;
  }

  const record = recipe as Record<string, unknown>;

  if (typeof record.name !== 'string' || typeof record.url !== 'string') {
    return false;
  }

  if (!Array.isArray(record.steps)) {
    return false;
  }

  for (const step of record.steps) {
    if (!validateRecipeStep(step)) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  return true;
}

export function validateRecipeStep(step: unknown): step is RecipeStep {
  if (step === null || step === undefined || typeof step !== 'object') {
    return false;
  }

  const record = step as Record<string, unknown>;

  if (typeof record.type !== 'string') {
    return false;
  }

  if (Array.isArray(record.steps)) {
    for (const nested of record.steps) {
      if (!validateRecipeStep(nested)) {
        return false;
      }
    }
  }

  return true;
}

/**
 * Workflow Store
 *
 * Manages storage and retrieval of workflow definitions in chrome.storage.local
 */

import type { Recipe } from './types.js';
import { logger } from '@chrome-ext/core-telemetry';

export interface WorkflowDefinition {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  description?: string;
  recipe: Recipe;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
  version: number;
}

export interface WorkflowStore {
  save(workflow: WorkflowDefinition): Promise<void>;
  load(id: string): Promise<WorkflowDefinition | null>;
  list(): Promise<WorkflowDefinition[]>;
  delete(id: string): Promise<void>;
  clear(): Promise<void>;
}

const STORAGE_KEY = 'recipe-workflows';
const STORAGE_VERSION = 1;

export class ChromeWorkflowStore implements WorkflowStore {
  private async getAllWorkflows(): Promise<Map<string, WorkflowDefinition>> {
    try {
      const result = await chrome.storage.local.get(STORAGE_KEY);
      const workflows = result[STORAGE_KEY] as WorkflowDefinition[] | undefined;
      
      if (!workflows || !Array.isArray(workflows)) {
        return new Map();
      }

      const workflowMap = new Map<string, WorkflowDefinition>();
      for (const workflow of workflows) {
        workflowMap.set(workflow.id, workflow);
      }
      return workflowMap;
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('Error loading workflows from storage', error as Error);
      return new Map();
    }
  }

  private async saveAllWorkflows(workflows: Map<string, WorkflowDefinition>): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const workflowArray = Array.from(workflows.values());
      await chrome.storage.local.set({ [STORAGE_KEY]: workflowArray });
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('Error saving workflows to storage', error as Error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async save(workflow: WorkflowDefinition): Promise<void> {
    const workflows = await this.getAllWorkflows();
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    
    const existing = workflows.get(workflow.id);
    const updatedWorkflow: WorkflowDefinition = {
      ...workflow,
      updatedAt: now,
      createdAt: existing?.createdAt || now,
      version: (existing?.version || 0) + 1,
    };

    workflows.set(workflow.id, updatedWorkflow);
    await this.saveAllWorkflows(workflows);
    
    logger.debug('Workflow saved', { id: workflow.id, name: workflow.name });
  }

  async load(id: string): Promise<WorkflowDefinition | null> {
    const workflows = await this.getAllWorkflows();
    return workflows.get(id) || null;
  }

  async list(): Promise<WorkflowDefinition[]> {
    const workflows = await this.getAllWorkflows();
    return Array.from(workflows.values()).sort((a, b) => 
      new Date(b.updatedAt).getTime() - new Date(a.updatedAt).getTime()
    );
  }

  async delete(id: string): Promise<void> {
    const workflows = await this.getAllWorkflows();
    workflows.delete(id);
    await this.saveAllWorkflows(workflows);
    
    logger.debug('Workflow deleted', { id });
  }

  async clear(): Promise<void> {
    await chrome.storage.local.remove(STORAGE_KEY);
    logger.debug('All workflows cleared');
  }
}

export class MemoryWorkflowStore implements WorkflowStore {
  private workflows = new Map<string, WorkflowDefinition>();

  async save(workflow: WorkflowDefinition): Promise<void> {
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const existing = this.workflows.get(workflow.id);
    const updatedWorkflow: WorkflowDefinition = {
      ...workflow,
      updatedAt: now,
      createdAt: existing?.createdAt || now,
      version: (existing?.version || 0) + 1,
    };
    this.workflows.set(workflow.id, updatedWorkflow);
  }

  async load(id: string): Promise<WorkflowDefinition | null> {
    return this.workflows.get(id) || null;
  }

  async list(): Promise<WorkflowDefinition[]> {
    return Array.from(this.workflows.values()).sort((a, b) => 
      new Date(b.updatedAt).getTime() - new Date(a.updatedAt).getTime()
    );
  }

  async delete(id: string): Promise<void> {
    this.workflows.delete(id);
  }

  async clear(): Promise<void> {
    this.workflows.clear();
  }
}

// Export singleton instance
export const workflowStore = new ChromeWorkflowStore();

==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/libs/Google-Chrome-Extension-Library/automation/recording/src/recipe-exporter.ts ====
/**
 * Recipe exporter for converting recorded steps to recipe JSON format.
 */

import type { RecordedStepWithDescription } from './step-builder.js';

export interface RecipeMetadata {
  name: string;
  url?: string;
  tags?: string[];
  description?: string;
}

export interface RecipeStep {
  type: string;
  locator?: {
    by: string;
    selector: string;
  };
  value?: string;
  description?: string;
  [key: string]: unknown;
}

export interface Recipe {
  name: string;
  url?: string;
  tags?: string[];
  description?: string;
  steps: RecipeStep[];
}

export interface ExportOptions {
  /** Include step descriptions in exported recipe */
  includeStepDescriptions?: boolean;
  /** Include element info in step metadata */
  includeElementInfo?: boolean;
  /** Default URL if not present in steps */
  defaultUrl?: string;
  /** Default tags to add */
  defaultTags?: string[];
}

/**
 * Convert recorded steps to recipe format matching the recipe JSON structure.
 */
export function exportToRecipe(
  steps: RecordedStepWithDescription[],
  metadata: RecipeMetadata,
  options: ExportOptions = {}
): Recipe {
  const {
    includeStepDescriptions = true,
    includeElementInfo = false,
    defaultUrl,
    defaultTags = [],
  } = options;

  // Find the first goto step to extract URL, or use default
  const url = metadata.url || findFirstUrl(steps) || defaultUrl;
  
  // Combine tags
  const tags = [...(metadata.tags || []), ...defaultTags];

  // Convert steps to recipe format
  const recipeSteps: RecipeStep[] = steps.map((step) => {
    const recipeStep: RecipeStep = {
      type: step.type,
    };

    // Add locator if present
    if (step.locator) {
      recipeStep.locator = {
        by: step.locator.by || 'css',
        selector: step.locator.selector || '',
      };
    }

    // Add value if present
    if (step.value !== undefined) {
      recipeStep.value = step.value;
    }

    // Add description (prefer step description, fallback to step description)
    if (includeStepDescriptions) {
      recipeStep.description = step.stepDescription || step.description || '';
    } else {
      recipeStep.description = step.description || '';
    }

    // Add element info as metadata if requested
    if (includeElementInfo && step.elementInfo) {
      recipeStep.elementInfo = step.elementInfo;
    }

    // Copy any additional properties
    if (step.data) {
      Object.assign(recipeStep, step.data);
    }

    return recipeStep;
  });

  return {
    name: metadata.name,
    url,
    tags: tags.length > 0 ? tags : undefined,
    description: metadata.description,
    steps: recipeSteps,
  };
}

/**
 * Validate a recipe before export
 */
export function validateRecipe(recipe: Recipe): { valid: boolean; errors: string[] } {
  const errors: string[] = [];

  if (!recipe.name || recipe.name.trim().length === 0) {
    errors.push('Recipe name is required');
  }

  if (!recipe.steps || recipe.steps.length === 0) {
    errors.push('Recipe must have at least one step');
  }

  recipe.steps?.forEach((step, index) => {
    if (!step.type) {
      errors.push(`Step ${index + 1}: Missing type`);
    }

    const stepTypesRequiringLocator = ['click', 'type', 'extract', 'assertVisible', 'waitFor'];
    if (stepTypesRequiringLocator.includes(step.type) && !step.locator) {
      errors.push(`Step ${index + 1}: Missing locator for ${step.type} action`);
    }

    if (step.type === 'goto' && !step.value && !recipe.url) {
      errors.push(`Step ${index + 1}: Missing URL for goto action`);
    }

    if (step.type === 'type' && step.value === undefined) {
      errors.push(`Step ${index + 1}: Missing value for type action`);
    }
  });

  return {
    valid: errors.length === 0,
    errors,
  };
}

/**
 * Find the first URL from goto steps
 */
function findFirstUrl(steps: RecordedStepWithDescription[]): string | undefined {
  const gotoStep = steps.find(step => step.type === 'goto');
  return gotoStep?.value as string | undefined;
}

/**
 * Export recipe to JSON string
 */
export function exportRecipeToJson(
  steps: RecordedStepWithDescription[],
  metadata: RecipeMetadata,
  options: ExportOptions = {}
): string {
  const recipe = exportToRecipe(steps, metadata, options);
  const validation = validateRecipe(recipe);
  
  if (!validation.valid) {
    throw new Error(`Recipe validation failed: ${validation.errors.join(', ')}`);
  }
  
  return JSON.stringify(recipe, null, 2);
}
