/**
 * DOM interaction recorder for turning user actions into automation steps.
 */

import type { StepSpec } from '@chrome-ext/automation-steps';

export interface RecordedStep extends StepSpec {
  timestamp: number;
  url: string;
}

export interface RecorderOptions {
  document?: Document;
  window?: Window;
  includeClicks?: boolean;
  includeInputs?: boolean;
  includeNavigation?: boolean;
  redactInputs?: boolean;
  redactText?: (value: string) => string;
  maxValueLength?: number;
  onStep?: (step: RecordedStep) => void;
  onEvent?: (event: { type: string; step: RecordedStep }) => void;
}

export interface RecorderController {
  start: () => void;
  stop: () => void;
  clear: () => void;
  isRunning: () => boolean;
  getSteps: () => RecordedStep[];
}

const OVERLAY_ATTR = 'data-autom8-overlay';

export function createRecorder(options: RecorderOptions = {}): RecorderController {
  const doc = options.document ?? document;
  const win = options.window ?? window;
  const steps: RecordedStep[] = [];
  let running = false;
  let lastUrl = win.location.href;
  let observer: MutationObserver | null = null;

  const includeClicks = options.includeClicks ?? true;
  const includeInputs = options.includeInputs ?? true;
  const includeNavigation = options.includeNavigation ?? true;
  const maxValueLength = options.maxValueLength ?? 256;

  const handleClick = (event: MouseEvent) => {
    if (!running || !includeClicks) return;
    const target = event.target as Element | null;
    if (!target || shouldIgnoreTarget(target)) return;

    const locator = buildLocator(target, doc);
    const description = describeElement(target);

    recordStep({
      type: 'click',
      locator,
      description,
    });
  };

  const handleChange = (event: Event) => {
    if (!running || !includeInputs) return;
    const target = event.target as Element | null;
    if (!target || shouldIgnoreTarget(target)) return;

    const value = extractInputValue(target);
    if (value === null) return;

    const sanitized = sanitizeValue(value, options, maxValueLength);
    const locator = buildLocator(target, doc);
    const description = describeElement(target);

    recordStep({
      type: 'type',
      locator,
      value: sanitized,
      description,
    });
  };

  const handleNavigation = () => {
    if (!running || !includeNavigation) return;
    if (win.location.href === lastUrl) return;

    lastUrl = win.location.href;

    recordStep({
      type: 'goto',
      value: lastUrl,
      description: `Navigate to ${lastUrl}`,
    });
  };

  const start = () => {
    if (running) return;
    running = true;

    if (includeClicks) {
      doc.addEventListener('click', handleClick, true);
    }

    if (includeInputs) {
      doc.addEventListener('change', handleChange, true);
    }

    if (includeNavigation) {
      win.addEventListener('popstate', handleNavigation);
      win.addEventListener('hashchange', handleNavigation);
      observer = new MutationObserver(handleNavigation);
      observer.observe(doc, { subtree: true, childList: true });
    }
  };

  const stop = () => {
    if (!running) return;
    running = false;

    doc.removeEventListener('click', handleClick, true);
    doc.removeEventListener('change', handleChange, true);
    win.removeEventListener('popstate', handleNavigation);
    win.removeEventListener('hashchange', handleNavigation);

    if (observer) {
      observer.disconnect();
      observer = null;
    }
  };

  const clear = () => {
    steps.length = 0;
  };

  const getSteps = () => steps.slice();

  const isRunning = () => running;

  function recordStep(step: StepSpec) {
    const recorded: RecordedStep = {
      ...step,
      timestamp: Date.now(),
      url: win.location.href,
    };

    steps.push(recorded);
    options.onStep?.(recorded);
    options.onEvent?.({ type: step.type, step: recorded });
  }

  return {
    start,
    stop,
    clear,
    isRunning,
    getSteps,
  };
}

function shouldIgnoreTarget(target: Element): boolean {
  return Boolean(target.closest(`[${OVERLAY_ATTR}="true"]`));
}

function extractInputValue(target: Element): string | null {
  if (target instanceof HTMLInputElement) {
    if (target.type === 'password') return target.value;
    if (target.type === 'checkbox' || target.type === 'radio') {
      return target.checked ? 'true' : 'false';
    }
    return target.value;
  }

  if (target instanceof HTMLTextAreaElement) {
    return target.value;
  }

  if (target instanceof HTMLSelectElement) {
    return target.value;
  }

  if ((target as HTMLElement).isContentEditable) {
    return (target as HTMLElement).innerText;
  }

  return null;
}

function sanitizeValue(
  value: string,
  options: RecorderOptions,
  maxLength: number
): string {
  let output = value;
  if (options.redactInputs) {
    output = '[REDACTED]';
  }

  if (options.redactText && output !== '[REDACTED]') {
    output = options.redactText(output);
  }

  if (output.length > maxLength) {
    output = `${output.slice(0, maxLength)}...`;
  }

  return output;
}

function describeElement(target: Element): string {
  const label = getElementLabel(target);
  if (label) {
    return `${target.tagName.toLowerCase()} ${label}`;
  }

  return target.tagName.toLowerCase();
}

function getElementLabel(target: Element): string | null {
  const aria = target.getAttribute('aria-label');
  if (aria) return aria.trim();

  const title = target.getAttribute('title');
  if (title) return title.trim();

  if (target instanceof HTMLInputElement || target instanceof HTMLTextAreaElement) {
    const placeholder = target.getAttribute('placeholder');
    if (placeholder) return placeholder.trim();
    if (target.name) return target.name.trim();
  }

  const text = target.textContent?.trim();
  if (text) return text.slice(0, 80);

  return null;
}

function buildLocator(target: Element, doc: Document): StepSpec['locator'] {
  const testId = target.getAttribute('data-autom8') || target.getAttribute('data-testid');
  if (testId) {
    return { by: 'testid', selector: testId };
  }

  if (target.id) {
    return { by: 'id', selector: target.id };
  }

  const name = target.getAttribute('name');
  if (name) {
    return { by: 'name', selector: name };
  }

  const role = target.getAttribute('role');
  if (role) {
    return { by: 'role', selector: role };
  }

  const selector = buildCssPath(target, doc);
  return { by: 'css', selector };
}

function buildCssPath(target: Element, doc: Document): string {
  const segments: string[] = [];
  let current: Element | null = target;

  while (current && current.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE && segments.length < 6) {
    const segment = buildSegment(current);
    segments.unshift(segment);

    const selector = segments.join(' > ');
    if (isUniqueSelector(selector, doc)) {
      return selector;
    }

    current = current.parentElement;
  }

  return segments.join(' > ');
}

function buildSegment(element: Element): string {
  const tag = element.tagName.toLowerCase();
  const classList = Array.from(element.classList)
    .filter(cls => cls && !cls.startsWith('autom8-'))
    .slice(0, 2);

  let segment = tag;
  if (classList.length > 0) {
    segment += `.${classList.map(escapeSelector).join('.')}`;
  }

  if (element.parentElement) {
    const siblings = Array.from(element.parentElement.children).filter(
      sibling => sibling.tagName === element.tagName
    );
    if (siblings.length > 1) {
      const index = siblings.indexOf(element) + 1;
      segment += `:nth-of-type(${index})`;
    }
  }

  return segment;
}

function isUniqueSelector(selector: string, doc: Document): boolean {
  try {
    return doc.querySelectorAll(selector).length === 1;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

function escapeSelector(value: string): string {
  if (typeof (globalThis as { CSS?: { escape?: (val: string) => string } }).CSS?.escape === 'function') {
    return (globalThis as { CSS: { escape: (val: string) => string } }).CSS.escape(value);
  }

  return value.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '\\$&');
}

/**
 * Recording overlay for non-intrusive hover highlighting during recording.
 * 
 * This overlay provides visual feedback when hovering over elements during recording
 * without interfering with CSS positioning, scaling, or user interactions.
 */

import type { GuideElementInfo } from '@chrome-ext/core-guide-overlay';
import { createGuideOverlay } from '@chrome-ext/core-guide-overlay';

export interface RecordingOverlayOptions {
  /** Color for the highlight border */
  highlightColor?: string;
  /** Show tooltip with element information */
  showTooltip?: boolean;
  /** Callback when element is hovered */
  onHover?: (element: Element | null, info?: GuideElementInfo) => void;
  /** Throttle delay for mouse move events (ms) */
  throttleMs?: number;
}

export interface RecordingOverlayController {
  /** Enable the overlay */
  enable: () => void;
  /** Disable the overlay */
  disable: () => void;
  /** Check if overlay is enabled */
  isEnabled: () => boolean;
  /** Destroy the overlay */
  destroy: () => void;
}

/**
 * Create a recording overlay that highlights elements on hover without interfering
 * with page interactions or CSS positioning.
 */
export function createRecordingOverlay(
  doc: Document = document,
  options: RecordingOverlayOptions = {}
): RecordingOverlayController {
  const {
    highlightColor = '#3b82f6',
    showTooltip = true,
    onHover,
    throttleMs = 16, // ~60fps
  } = options;

  const overlay = createGuideOverlay(doc);
  let enabled = false;
  let lastHoverTime = 0;
  let lastHoveredElement: Element | null = null;

  // Throttle hover callback to prevent excessive calls
  const throttledOnHover = (element: Element | null, info?: GuideElementInfo) => {
    const now = Date.now();
    if (now - lastHoverTime >= throttleMs) {
      lastHoverTime = now;
      onHover?.(element, info);
    }
  };

  const enable = () => {
    if (enabled) return;
    enabled = true;

    overlay.enableInspector({
      interceptClicks: false, // Don't intercept clicks - let them through for recording
      tooltipMessage: showTooltip ? undefined : '', // Only show tooltip if enabled
      onHover: (element, info) => {
        if (element !== lastHoveredElement) {
          lastHoveredElement = element;
          throttledOnHover(element, info);
          
          if (showTooltip && element && info) {
            const tooltipText = formatTooltipText(info);
            overlay.showTooltip(element, tooltipText, { placement: 'bottom' });
          } else if (!element) {
            overlay.clear();
          }
        }
      },
    });
  };

  const disable = () => {
    if (!enabled) return;
    enabled = false;
    overlay.disableInspector();
    lastHoveredElement = null;
  };

  const isEnabled = () => enabled;

  const destroy = () => {
    disable();
    overlay.destroy();
  };

  return {
    enable,
    disable,
    isEnabled,
    destroy,
  };
}

/**
 * Format element information for tooltip display
 */
function formatTooltipText(info: GuideElementInfo): string {
  const parts: string[] = [];
  
  if (info.label) {
    parts.push(info.label);
  }
  
  parts.push(`<${info.tag}>`);
  
  if (info.selector && info.selector.length < 60) {
    parts.push(`\n${info.selector}`);
  }
  
  return parts.join(' ');
}

/**
 * Step builder for managing recorded steps with descriptions and metadata.
 */

import type { RecordedStep } from './recorder.js';
import type { GuideElementInfo } from '@chrome-ext/core-guide-overlay';

export interface RecordedStepWithDescription extends RecordedStep {
  /** Optional description for this step */
  stepDescription?: string;
  /** Element information captured during recording */
  elementInfo?: GuideElementInfo;
  /** Step index in the sequence */
  index?: number;
}

export interface StepBuilderOptions {
  /** Maximum number of steps to keep in history for undo/redo */
  maxHistorySize?: number;
  /** Auto-save callback */
  onAutoSave?: (steps: RecordedStepWithDescription[]) => void;
  /** Auto-save interval (number of steps) */
  autoSaveInterval?: number;
}

export interface StepBuilderController {
  /** Add a step */
  addStep: (step: RecordedStep, elementInfo?: GuideElementInfo) => void;
  /** Update step description */
  updateStepDescription: (index: number, description: string) => boolean;
  /** Delete a step */
  deleteStep: (index: number) => boolean;
  /** Get all steps */
  getSteps: () => RecordedStepWithDescription[];
  /** Get a specific step */
  getStep: (index: number) => RecordedStepWithDescription | undefined;
  /** Clear all steps */
  clear: () => void;
  /** Undo last operation */
  undo: () => boolean;
  /** Redo last undone operation */
  redo: () => boolean;
  /** Check if undo is available */
  canUndo: () => boolean;
  /** Check if redo is available */
  canRedo: () => boolean;
  /** Validate all steps */
  validate: () => { valid: boolean; errors: string[] };
}

/**
 * Create a step builder for managing recorded steps with descriptions.
 */
export function createStepBuilder(
  options: StepBuilderOptions = {}
): StepBuilderController {
  const {
    maxHistorySize = 50,
    onAutoSave,
    autoSaveInterval = 10,
  } = options;

  let steps: RecordedStepWithDescription[] = [];
  let history: RecordedStepWithDescription[][] = [];
  let historyIndex = -1;
  let stepCounter = 0;

  const saveToHistory = () => {
    // Remove any history after current index (when undoing and then making new changes)
    history = history.slice(0, historyIndex + 1);
    
    // Add current state to history
    history.push(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(steps))); // Deep clone
    historyIndex++;
    
    // Limit history size
    if (history.length > maxHistorySize) {
      history.shift();
      historyIndex--;
    }
  };

  const addStep = (step: RecordedStep, elementInfo?: GuideElementInfo) => {
    const stepWithDescription: RecordedStepWithDescription = {
      ...step,
      elementInfo,
      index: stepCounter++,
    };
    
    steps.push(stepWithDescription);
    saveToHistory();
    
    // Auto-save if configured
    if (onAutoSave && steps.length % autoSaveInterval === 0) {
      onAutoSave(steps);
    }
  };

  const updateStepDescription = (index: number, description: string): boolean => {
    if (index < 0 || index >= steps.length) {
      return false;
    }
    
    const sanitized = sanitizeDescription(description);
    steps[index] = {
      ...steps[index],
      stepDescription: sanitized || undefined,
    };
    
    saveToHistory();
    return true;
  };

  const deleteStep = (index: number): boolean => {
    if (index < 0 || index >= steps.length) {
      return false;
    }
    
    steps.splice(index, 1);
    // Re-index remaining steps
    steps.forEach((step, i) => {
      step.index = i;
    });
    
    saveToHistory();
    return true;
  };

  const getSteps = (): RecordedStepWithDescription[] => {
    return [...steps];
  };

  const getStep = (index: number): RecordedStepWithDescription | undefined => {
    return steps[index];
  };

  const clear = () => {
    steps = [];
    history = [];
    historyIndex = -1;
    stepCounter = 0;
  };

  const undo = (): boolean => {
    if (historyIndex <= 0) {
      return false;
    }
    
    historyIndex--;
    steps = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(history[historyIndex])); // Deep clone
    return true;
  };

  const redo = (): boolean => {
    if (historyIndex >= history.length - 1) {
      return false;
    }
    
    historyIndex++;
    steps = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(history[historyIndex])); // Deep clone
    return true;
  };

  const canUndo = (): boolean => {
    return historyIndex > 0;
  };

  const canRedo = (): boolean => {
    return historyIndex < history.length - 1;
  };

  const validate = (): { valid: boolean; errors: string[] } => {
    const errors: string[] = [];
    
    if (steps.length === 0) {
      errors.push('No steps recorded');
      return { valid: false, errors };
    }
    
    steps.forEach((step, index) => {
      if (!step.type) {
        errors.push(`Step ${index + 1}: Missing type`);
      }
      
      if (step.type === 'click' || step.type === 'type' || step.type === 'extract') {
        if (!step.locator) {
          errors.push(`Step ${index + 1}: Missing locator for ${step.type} action`);
        }
      }
      
      if (step.type === 'goto' && !step.value) {
        errors.push(`Step ${index + 1}: Missing URL for goto action`);
      }
      
      if (step.type === 'type' && step.value === undefined) {
        errors.push(`Step ${index + 1}: Missing value for type action`);
      }
    });
    
    return {
      valid: errors.length === 0,
      errors,
    };
  };

  return {
    addStep,
    updateStepDescription,
    deleteStep,
    getSteps,
    getStep,
    clear,
    undo,
    redo,
    canUndo,
    canRedo,
    validate,
  };
}

/**
 * Sanitize step description
 */
function sanitizeDescription(description: string): string {
  return description.trim().slice(0, 500); // Max 500 characters
}

/**
 * Step Executor
 *
 * Executes automation steps using registered step handlers.
 */

import type {
  StepSpec,
  StepResult,
  StepExecutor as IStepExecutor,
} from './types.js';
import { clickStep } from './steps/click.js';
import { typeStep } from './steps/type.js';
import { waitStep } from './steps/wait.js';
import { navigateStep } from './steps/navigate.js';
import { commentStep } from './steps/comment.js';
import { logger } from '@chrome-ext/core-telemetry';

export class StepExecutor {
  private handlers = new Map<string, IStepExecutor>();

  constructor() {
    // Register default step handlers
    this.register('click', clickStep);
    this.register('fill', typeStep);
    this.register('type', typeStep);
    this.register('waitFor', waitStep);
    this.register('goto', navigateStep);
    this.register('comment', commentStep);
  }

  /**
   * Register a step handler
   */
  register(type: string, executor: IStepExecutor): void {
    this.handlers.set(type, executor);
  }

  /**
   * Execute a step
   */
  async execute(
    step: StepSpec,
    context: { tabId: number; window: Window; document: Document }
  ): Promise<StepResult> {
    const handler = this.handlers.get(step.type);

    if (!handler) {
      logger.error('Unknown step type', undefined, { stepType: step.type });
      return {
        success: false,
        error: `Unknown step type: ${step.type}`,
      };
    }

    try {
      logger.debug('Executing step', {
        type: step.type,
        description: step.description,
      });

      const result = await handler.execute(step, context);

      if (!result.success) {
        logger.warn('Step execution failed', {
          stepType: step.type,
          error: result.error,
        });
      }

      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('Step execution error', error as Error, {
        stepType: step.type,
      });
      return {
        success: false,
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
      };
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Default step executor instance
 */
export const stepExecutor = new StepExecutor();

/**
 * Click Step Executor
 */

import type {
  StepExecutor,
  StepSpec,
  StepResult,
  ExecutionContext,
} from '../types.js';

export const clickStep: StepExecutor = {
  async execute(
    step: StepSpec,
    context: ExecutionContext
  ): Promise<StepResult> {
    const { document } = context;

    if (!step.locator) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Click step requires locator' };
    }

    try {
      const element = queryElement(document, step.locator);
      if (!element) {
        return {
          success: false,
          error: `Element not found: ${step.locator.selector}`,
        };
      }

      // Scroll into view
      element.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 200));

      // Click
      (element as HTMLElement).click();

      return { success: true };
    } catch (error) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
      };
    }
  },
};

function queryElement(
  document: Document,
  locator: StepSpec['locator']
): Element | null {
  if (!locator) return null;

  switch (locator.by) {
    case 'css':
      return document.querySelector(locator.selector);
    case 'id':
      return document.getElementById(locator.selector);
    case 'name':
      return document.querySelector(`[name="${locator.selector}"]`);
    case 'testid':
      return document.querySelector(`[data-testid="${locator.selector}"]`);
    case 'role':
      // Simplified role query - in production would use aria roles
      return document.querySelector(`[role="${locator.selector}"]`);
    default:
      return null;
  }
}

/**
 * Comment Step Executor
 *
 * Part of the observability pipeline - logs comment messages for debugging and monitoring.
 */

import type {
  StepExecutor,
  StepSpec,
  StepResult,
  ExecutionContext,
} from '../types.js';
import { logger } from '@chrome-ext/core-telemetry';

export const commentStep: StepExecutor = {
  async execute(
    step: StepSpec,
    context: ExecutionContext
  ): Promise<StepResult> {
    // Extract comment value from step
    const commentValue = (step as any).value || step.description || 'Comment step';

    // Log the comment for observability
    logger.info(`[Comment] ${commentValue}`, {
      stepType: 'comment',
      tabId: context.tabId,
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    });

    // Comment steps always succeed - they're for observability only
    return {
      success: true,
      data: {
        comment: commentValue,
      },
    };
  },
};



==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/libs/Google-Chrome-Extension-Library/automation/steps/src/steps/index.ts ====
/**

/**
 * Navigate Step Executor
 */

import type {
  StepExecutor,
  StepSpec,
  StepResult,
  ExecutionContext,
} from '../types.js';

export const navigateStep: StepExecutor = {
  async execute(
    step: StepSpec,
    context: ExecutionContext
  ): Promise<StepResult> {
    const { window } = context;

    if (step.type === 'goto' && step.value) {
      try {
        window.location.href = step.value;
        // Wait for navigation to start
        await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 500));
        return { success: true };
      } catch (error) {
        return {
          success: false,
          error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
        };
      }
    }

    return { success: false, error: 'Navigate step requires URL value' };
  },
};

/**
 * Type/Fill Step Executor
 */

import type {
  StepExecutor,
  StepSpec,
  StepResult,
  ExecutionContext,
} from '../types.js';

export const typeStep: StepExecutor = {
  async execute(
    step: StepSpec,
    context: ExecutionContext
  ): Promise<StepResult> {
    const { document } = context;

    if (!step.locator) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Type step requires locator' };
    }

    if (!step.value) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Type step requires value' };
    }

    try {
      const element = queryElement(document, step.locator) as
        | HTMLInputElement
        | HTMLTextAreaElement
        | null;

      if (!element) {
        return {
          success: false,
          error: `Element not found: ${step.locator.selector}`,
        };
      }

      // Clear if needed
      element.value = '';

      // Type value
      element.value = step.value;
      element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
      element.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));

      return { success: true };
    } catch (error) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
      };
    }
  },
};

function queryElement(
  document: Document,
  locator: StepSpec['locator']
): Element | null {
  if (!locator) return null;

  switch (locator.by) {
    case 'css':
      return document.querySelector(locator.selector);
    case 'id':
      return document.getElementById(locator.selector);
    case 'name':
      return document.querySelector(`[name="${locator.selector}"]`);
    case 'testid':
      return document.querySelector(`[data-testid="${locator.selector}"]`);
    default:
      return null;
  }
}



==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/libs/Google-Chrome-Extension-Library/automation/steps/src/steps/wait.ts ====
/**
 * Wait Step Executor
 */

import type {
  StepExecutor,
  StepSpec,
  StepResult,
  ExecutionContext,
} from '../types.js';

export const waitStep: StepExecutor = {
  async execute(
    step: StepSpec,
    context: ExecutionContext
  ): Promise<StepResult> {
    const { document } = context;
    const timeout = step.timeout || 5000;

    if (!step.locator) {
      // Wait for duration if no locator
      const duration = (step.data as { duration?: number })?.duration || 1000;
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, duration));
      return { success: true };
    }

    try {
      const startTime = Date.now();
      while (Date.now() - startTime < timeout) {
        const element = queryElement(document, step.locator);
        if (element) {
          // Check visibility if needed
          const style = window.getComputedStyle(element);
          if (style.display !== 'none' && style.visibility !== 'hidden') {
            return { success: true };
          }
        }
        await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 100));
      }

      return {
        success: false,
        error: `Timeout waiting for element: ${step.locator.selector}`,
      };
    } catch (error) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
      };
    }
  },
};

function queryElement(
  document: Document,
  locator: StepSpec['locator']
): Element | null {
  if (!locator) return null;

  switch (locator.by) {
    case 'css':
      return document.querySelector(locator.selector);
    case 'id':
      return document.getElementById(locator.selector);
    case 'name':
      return document.querySelector(`[name="${locator.selector}"]`);
    case 'testid':
      return document.querySelector(`[data-testid="${locator.selector}"]`);
    default:
      return null;
  }
}

/**
 * Chrome Action API wrapper
 *
 * Provides type-safe, promise-based wrappers for chrome.action.*
 *
 * @example
 * ```typescript
 * import { action } from '@chrome-ext/core-action';
 *
 * // Set badge text
 * await action.setBadgeText({ text: '42' });
 *
 * // Listen for clicks
 * action.onClicked.addListener((tab) => {
 *   console.log('Action clicked', tab);
 * });
 * ```
 */

/// <reference path="./chrome.d.ts" />

import { logger } from '@chrome-ext/core-telemetry';
import { metrics } from '@chrome-ext/core-telemetry';
import type {
  TabDetails,
  SetIconDetails,
  SetBadgeTextDetails,
  SetBadgeBackgroundColorDetails,
  SetBadgeTextColorDetails,
  SetPopupDetails,
  SetTitleDetails,
  OpenPopupOptions,
  UserSettings,
  UserSettingsChange,
  ActionClickedTab,
  ColorArray,
} from './types.js';
import {
  ActionError,
  ActionNotAvailableError,
  InvalidIconError,
  InvalidColorError,
} from './errors.js';

/**
 * Simple event emitter for Chrome action events
 */
class EventEmitter<T> {
  private listeners = new Set<(data: T) => void>();

  addListener(callback: (data: T) => void): void {
    this.listeners.add(callback);
  }

  removeListener(callback: (data: T) => void): void {
    this.listeners.delete(callback);
  }

  hasListener(callback: (data: T) => void): boolean {
    return this.listeners.has(callback);
  }

  hasListeners(): boolean {
    return this.listeners.size > 0;
  }

  emit(data: T): void {
    for (const listener of this.listeners) {
      try {
        listener(data);
      } catch (error) {
        logger.error('Error in action event listener', error as Error);
        metrics.increment('action_event_listener_error', 1);
      }
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Chrome Action API wrapper class
 */
export class ChromeAction {
  /**
   * Event emitter for action clicked
   */
  readonly onClicked = new EventEmitter<ActionClickedTab>();

  /**
   * Event emitter for user settings changed (Chrome 130+)
   */
  readonly onUserSettingsChanged = new EventEmitter<UserSettingsChange>();

  private initialized = false;

  /**
   * Check if chrome.action API is available
   */
  private checkAvailability(): void {
    if (typeof chrome === 'undefined' || !chrome.action) {
      throw new ActionNotAvailableError();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Setup event listeners
   */
  setup(): void {
    if (this.initialized) {
      return;
    }

    this.checkAvailability();

    // Setup onClicked listener
    chrome.action.onClicked.addListener((tab: ActionClickedTab) => {
      metrics.increment('action_clicked', 1);
      logger.debug('Action clicked', { tabId: tab.id });
      this.onClicked.emit(tab);
    });

    // Setup onUserSettingsChanged listener (Chrome 130+)
    if (chrome.action.onUserSettingsChanged) {
      chrome.action.onUserSettingsChanged.addListener(
        (change: UserSettingsChange) => {
          metrics.increment('action_user_settings_changed', 1);
          logger.debug('Action user settings changed', { change });
          this.onUserSettingsChanged.emit(change);
        }
      );
    }

    this.initialized = true;
    logger.info('Chrome Action API wrapper initialized');
  }

  /**
   * Disable the action for a tab
   */
  async disable(tabId?: number): Promise<void> {
    const stopTimer = metrics.startTimer('action_disable');
    try {
      this.checkAvailability();
      logger.debug('Disabling action', { tabId });
      await chrome.action.disable(tabId);
      metrics.increment('action_disable_success', 1);
    } catch (error) {
      metrics.increment('action_disable_error', 1);
      logger.error('Failed to disable action', error as Error);
      throw new ActionError(
        'Failed to disable action',
        'DISABLE_FAILED',
        error
      );
    } finally {
      stopTimer();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Enable the action for a tab
   */
  async enable(tabId?: number): Promise<void> {
    const stopTimer = metrics.startTimer('action_enable');
    try {
      this.checkAvailability();
      logger.debug('Enabling action', { tabId });
      await chrome.action.enable(tabId);
      metrics.increment('action_enable_success', 1);
    } catch (error) {
      metrics.increment('action_enable_error', 1);
      logger.error('Failed to enable action', error as Error);
      throw new ActionError('Failed to enable action', 'ENABLE_FAILED', error);
    } finally {
      stopTimer();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Check if action is enabled for a tab
   */
  async isEnabled(tabId?: number): Promise<boolean> {
    const stopTimer = metrics.startTimer('action_isEnabled');
    try {
      this.checkAvailability();

      // Chrome 110+
      if (chrome.action.isEnabled) {
        const enabled = await chrome.action.isEnabled(tabId);
        metrics.increment('action_isEnabled_success', 1);
        return enabled;
      }

      // Fallback: try to enable/disable and catch error
      // This is not ideal but works for older Chrome versions
      logger.warn('isEnabled not available, using fallback');
      return true; // Default to enabled
    } catch (error) {
      metrics.increment('action_isEnabled_error', 1);
      logger.error('Failed to check if action is enabled', error as Error);
      throw new ActionError(
        'Failed to check if action is enabled',
        'IS_ENABLED_FAILED',
        error
      );
    } finally {
      stopTimer();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get badge background color
   */
  async getBadgeBackgroundColor(details: TabDetails): Promise<ColorArray> {
    const stopTimer = metrics.startTimer('action_getBadgeBackgroundColor');
    try {
      this.checkAvailability();
      logger.debug('Getting badge background color', { details });
      const color = await chrome.action.getBadgeBackgroundColor(details);
      metrics.increment('action_getBadgeBackgroundColor_success', 1);
      return color as ColorArray;
    } catch (error) {
      metrics.increment('action_getBadgeBackgroundColor_error', 1);
      logger.error('Failed to get badge background color', error as Error);
      throw new ActionError(
        'Failed to get badge background color',
        'GET_BADGE_BG_COLOR_FAILED',
        error
      );
    } finally {
      stopTimer();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get badge text
   */
  async getBadgeText(details: TabDetails): Promise<string> {
    const stopTimer = metrics.startTimer('action_getBadgeText');
    try {
      this.checkAvailability();
      logger.debug('Getting badge text', { details });
      const text = await chrome.action.getBadgeText(details);
      metrics.increment('action_getBadgeText_success', 1);
      return text;
    } catch (error) {
      metrics.increment('action_getBadgeText_error', 1);
      logger.error('Failed to get badge text', error as Error);
      throw new ActionError(
        'Failed to get badge text',
        'GET_BADGE_TEXT_FAILED',
        error
      );
    } finally {
      stopTimer();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get badge text color (Chrome 110+)
   */
  async getBadgeTextColor(details: TabDetails): Promise<ColorArray> {
    const stopTimer = metrics.startTimer('action_getBadgeTextColor');
    try {
      this.checkAvailability();

      if (!chrome.action.getBadgeTextColor) {
        throw new ActionError(
          'getBadgeTextColor not available (requires Chrome 110+)',
          'NOT_AVAILABLE'
        );
      }

      logger.debug('Getting badge text color', { details });
      const color = await chrome.action.getBadgeTextColor(details);
      metrics.increment('action_getBadgeTextColor_success', 1);
      return color as ColorArray;
    } catch (error) {
      metrics.increment('action_getBadgeTextColor_error', 1);
      logger.error('Failed to get badge text color', error as Error);

        'Failed to get badge text color',

    } finally {

    const stopTimer = metrics.startTimer('action_getPopup');
    try {
      this.checkAvailability();
      logger.debug('Getting popup', { details });
      const popup = await chrome.action.getPopup(details);
      metrics.increment('action_getPopup_success', 1);
      return popup;
    } catch (error) {
      metrics.increment('action_getPopup_error', 1);

/**
 * Factory function to create a ChromeAction instance
 */
export function createAction(): ChromeAction {
  const instance = new ChromeAction();
  instance.setup();
  return instance;
}

/**
 * Convenience singleton instance
 */
export const action = createAction();

/**
 * Chrome Extensions API type definitions
 *
 * Basic type definitions for chrome.action API

declare global {

/**
 * Chrome Action API errors
 */

/**
 * Base error class for Action API errors
 */
export class ActionError extends Error {
  constructor(
    message: string,
    public readonly code: string,
    cause?: unknown
  ) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'ActionError';
    if (cause !== null && cause !== undefined) {
      (this as unknown as { cause: unknown }).cause = cause;
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Error thrown when action API is not available
 */
export class ActionNotAvailableError extends ActionError {
  constructor(message = 'Chrome action API is not available') {
    super(message, 'ACTION_NOT_AVAILABLE');
    this.name = 'ActionNotAvailableError';
  }
}

/**
 * Error thrown when invalid icon data is provided
 */
export class InvalidIconError extends ActionError {
  constructor(message = 'Invalid icon data provided') {
    super(message, 'INVALID_ICON');
    this.name = 'InvalidIconError';
  }
}

/**
 * Error thrown when invalid color value is provided
 */
export class InvalidColorError extends ActionError {
  constructor(message = 'Invalid color value provided') {
    super(message, 'INVALID_COLOR');
    this.name = 'InvalidColorError';
  }
}

/**
 * Chrome Action API types
 *
 * Type definitions for chrome.action API
 */

/**
 * Color array in RGBA format [R, G, B, A]
 * Each value is 0-255
 */
export type ColorArray = [number, number, number, number];

/**
 * Color value - can be CSS color string or RGBA array
 */
export type ColorValue = string | ColorArray;

/**
 * Image data for icon - can be ImageData or dictionary of sizes
 */
export type IconImageData = ImageData | Record<number, ImageData>;

/**
 * Icon path - can be string or dictionary of sizes
 */
export type IconPath = string | Record<number, string>;

/**
 * Tab details for querying action state
 */
export interface TabDetails {
  /**
   * The ID of the tab to query state for.
   * If no tab is specified, the non-tab-specific state is returned.
   */
  tabId?: number;
}

/**
 * Set icon details
 */
export interface SetIconDetails {
  /**
   * Either an ImageData object or a dictionary {size -> ImageData} representing icon to be set.
   * If the icon is specified as a dictionary, the actual image to be used is chosen depending on screen's pixel density.
   * At least one image must be specified.
   */
  imageData?: IconImageData;

  /**
   * Either a relative image path or a dictionary {size -> relative image path} pointing to icon to be set.
   * If the icon is specified as a dictionary, the actual image to be used is chosen depending on screen's pixel density.
   * At least one image must be specified.
   */
  path?: IconPath;

  /**
   * Limits the change to when a particular tab is selected.
   * Automatically resets when the tab is closed.
   */
  tabId?: number;
}

/**
 * Set badge text details
 */
export interface SetBadgeTextDetails {
  /**
   * Any number of characters can be passed, but only about four can fit in the space.
   * If an empty string ('') is passed, the badge text is cleared.
   * If tabId is specified and text is null, the text for the specified tab is cleared and defaults to the global badge text.
   */
  text?: string | null;

  /**
   * Limits the change to when a particular tab is selected.
   * Automatically resets when the tab is closed.
   */
  tabId?: number;
}

/**
 * Set badge background color details
 */
export interface SetBadgeBackgroundColorDetails {
  /**
   * An array of four integers in the range [0,255] that make up the RGBA color of the badge.
   * For example, opaque red is [255, 0, 0, 255].
   * Can also be a string with a CSS value, with opaque red being #FF0000 or #F00.
   */
  color: ColorValue;

  /**
   * Limits the change to when a particular tab is selected.
   * Automatically resets when the tab is closed.
   */
  tabId?: number;
}

/**
 * Set badge text color details
 */
export interface SetBadgeTextColorDetails {
  /**
   * An array of four integers in the range [0,255] that make up the RGBA color of the badge text.
   * Can also be a string with a CSS value.
   * Not setting this value will cause a color to be automatically chosen that will contrast with the badge's background color.
   * Colors with alpha values equivalent to 0 will not be set and will return an error.
   */
  color: ColorValue;

  /**
   * Limits the change to when a particular tab is selected.
   * Automatically resets when the tab is closed.
   */
  tabId?: number;
}

/**
 * Set popup details
 */
export interface SetPopupDetails {
  /**
   * The relative path to the HTML file to show in a popup.
   * If set to the empty string (''), no popup is shown.
   */
  popup: string;

  /**
   * Limits the change to when a particular tab is selected.
   * Automatically resets when the tab is closed.
   */
  tabId?: number;
}

/**
 * Set title details
 */
export interface SetTitleDetails {
  /**
   * The string the action should display when moused over.
   */
  title: string;

  /**
   * Limits the change to when a particular tab is selected.
   * Automatically resets when the tab is closed.
   */
  tabId?: number;
}

/**
 * Open popup options
 */
export interface OpenPopupOptions {
  /**
   * The ID of the window to open the action popup in.
   * Defaults to the currently-active window if unspecified.
   */
  windowId?: number;
}

/**
 * User settings for extension action
 */
export interface UserSettings {
  /**
   * Whether the extension's action icon is visible on browser windows' top-level toolbar
   * (i.e., whether the extension has been 'pinned' by the user).
   */
  isOnToolbar: boolean;
}

/**
 * User settings change event
 */
export interface UserSettingsChange {
  /**
   * Whether the extension's action icon is visible on browser windows' top-level toolbar
   * (i.e., whether the extension has been 'pinned' by the user).
   */
  isOnToolbar?: boolean;
}

/**
 * Action clicked event - tab information
 */
export interface ActionClickedTab {
  id?: number;
  index?: number;
  windowId?: number;
  openerTabId?: number;
  highlighted?: boolean;
  active?: boolean;
  pinned?: boolean;
  audible?: boolean;
  discarded?: boolean;
  autoDiscardable?: boolean;
  mutedInfo?: {
    muted: boolean;
    reason?: string;
    extensionId?: string;
  };
  url?: string;
  pendingUrl?: string;
  title?: string;
  favIconUrl?: string;
  status?: string;
  incognito?: boolean;
  width?: number;
  height?: number;
  sessionId?: string;
}

/**
 * CSV utilities
 *
 * Provides lightweight helpers for generating CSV strings and (optionally) triggering downloads in UI contexts.
 *
 * @module @chrome-ext/core-csv
 */

export interface CsvStringifyOptions {
  includeHeaders?: boolean;
  lineEnding?: '\n' | '\r\n';
}

/**
 * Escape a CSV field value (RFC4180-ish).
 */
export function escapeCsvField(value: unknown): string {
  if (value === null || value === undefined) {
    return '';
  }

  const str = String(value);
  if (
    str.includes(',') ||
    str.includes('"') ||
    str.includes('\n') ||
    str.includes('\r')
  ) {
    return `"${str.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;
  }
  return str;
}

/**
 * Convert rows to a CSV string.
 */
export function rowsToCsv(
  headers: string[],
  rows: Array<Array<unknown>>,
  options: CsvStringifyOptions = {}
): string {
  const { includeHeaders = true, lineEnding = '\n' } = options;

  const csvRows: string[] = [];

  if (includeHeaders) {
    csvRows.push(headers.map(escapeCsvField).join(','));
  }

  for (const row of rows) {
    csvRows.push(row.map(escapeCsvField).join(','));
  }

  return csvRows.join(lineEnding);
}

/**
 * Convert objects to CSV via a row mapping function.
 */
export function objectsToCsv<T>(
  headers: string[],
  items: T[],
  mapRow: (item: T) => Array<unknown>,
  options: CsvStringifyOptions = {}
): string {
  return rowsToCsv(headers, items.map(mapRow), options);
}

/**
 * Trigger a CSV download in a DOM context (sidepanel/popup/content script).
 */
export function downloadCsv(csvContent: string, filename: string): void {
  const blob = new Blob([csvContent], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const link = document.createElement('a');
  link.href = url;
  link.download = filename;
  link.style.display = 'none';
  document.body.appendChild(link);
  link.click();
  document.body.removeChild(link);
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
}

export interface DownloadCsvMessage {
  type: 'DOWNLOAD_CSV';
  csv: string;
  filename: string;
}

/**
 * Register a `chrome.runtime.onMessage` listener that triggers CSV downloads.
 * Returns a cleanup function.
 */
export function registerDownloadCsvMessageListener(): () => void {
  // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
  const chromeAny = chrome as any;

  const listener = (msg: unknown): void => {
    if (!msg || typeof msg !== 'object') return;
    const maybe = msg as Partial<DownloadCsvMessage>;
    if (maybe.type !== 'DOWNLOAD_CSV') return;
    if (typeof maybe.csv !== 'string' || typeof maybe.filename !== 'string') {
      return;
    }
    downloadCsv(maybe.csv, maybe.filename);
  };

  chromeAny.runtime.onMessage.addListener(listener);
  return () => chromeAny.runtime.onMessage.removeListener(listener);
}

/**
 * Chrome Declarative Content API wrapper
 *
 * Provides type-safe wrappers for chrome.declarativeContent.*
 *
 * @example
 * ```typescript
 * import { declarativeContent } from '@chrome-ext/core-declarativeContent';
 *
 * // Add page state matcher
 * declarativeContent.onPageChanged.addRules([{
 *   conditions: [new declarativeContent.PageStateMatcher({
 *     pageUrl: { hostContains: 'example.com' }
 *   })],
 *   actions: [new declarativeContent.ShowAction()]
 * }]);
 * ```
 */

import { logger } from '@chrome-ext/core-telemetry';
import { metrics } from '@chrome-ext/core-telemetry';
import type { PageStateMatcher, PageChangedEventDetails } from './types.js';
import {
  DeclarativeContentNotAvailableError,
  DeclarativeContentRuleError,
} from './errors.js';

/**
 * Simple event emitter for Chrome declarative content events
 */
class EventEmitter<T> {
  private listeners = new Set<(data: T) => void>();

  addListener(callback: (data: T) => void): void {
    this.listeners.add(callback);
  }

  removeListener(callback: (data: T) => void): void {
    this.listeners.delete(callback);
  }

  hasListener(callback: (data: T) => void): boolean {
    return this.listeners.has(callback);
  }

  hasListeners(): boolean {
    return this.listeners.size > 0;
  }

  emit(data: T): void {
    for (const listener of this.listeners) {
      try {
        listener(data);
      } catch (error) {
        logger.error(
          'Error in declarative content event listener',
          error as Error
        );
        metrics.increment('declarative_content_event_listener_error', 1);
      }
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Page state matcher class
 */
export class PageStateMatcherClass {
  constructor(public options: PageStateMatcher) {}
}

/**
 * Show action class
 */
export class ShowActionClass {
  type = 'showAction' as const;
}

/**
 * Show page action class (deprecated)
 */
export class ShowPageActionClass {
  type = 'showPageAction' as const;
}

/**
 * Request content script class
 */
export class RequestContentScriptClass {
  type = 'requestContentScript' as const;
  constructor(
    public options: {
      css?: string[];
      js?: string[];
      allFrames?: boolean;
      matchAboutBlank?: boolean;
    }
  ) {}
}

/**
 * Set icon class
 */
export class SetIconClass {
  type = 'setIcon' as const;
  constructor(
    public options: {
      imageData?: ImageData | { [size: string]: ImageData };
      path?: string | { [size: string]: string };
    }
  ) {}
}

/**
 * Chrome Declarative Content API wrapper class
 */
export class ChromeDeclarativeContent {
  /**
   * Event emitter for page changed
   */
  readonly onPageChanged = new EventEmitter<PageChangedEventDetails>();

  /**
   * Page state matcher constructor
   */
  readonly PageStateMatcher = PageStateMatcherClass;

  /**
   * Show action constructor
   */
  readonly ShowAction = ShowActionClass;

  /**
   * Show page action constructor (deprecated)
   */
  readonly ShowPageAction = ShowPageActionClass;

  /**
   * Request content script constructor
   */
  readonly RequestContentScript = RequestContentScriptClass;

  /**
   * Set icon constructor
   */
  readonly SetIcon = SetIconClass;

  private initialized = false;

  /**
   * Check if chrome.declarativeContent API is available
   */
  private checkAvailability(): void {
    if (
      typeof chrome === 'undefined' ||
      chrome.declarativeContent === null ||
      chrome.declarativeContent === undefined
    ) {
      throw new DeclarativeContentNotAvailableError();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Setup event listeners
   */
  setup(): void {
    if (this.initialized) {
      return;
    }

    this.checkAvailability();

    // Note: chrome.declarativeContent.onPageChanged doesn't have a traditional event listener
    // It's used with addRules/removeRules. We'll provide a wrapper for those methods.

    this.initialized = true;
    logger.info('Chrome Declarative Content API wrapper initialized');
  }

  /**
   * Add rules to onPageChanged
   */
  addRules(
    rules: Array<{
      conditions: PageStateMatcherClass[];
      actions: Array<
        | ShowActionClass
        | ShowPageActionClass
        | RequestContentScriptClass
        | SetIconClass
      >;
    }>
  ): void {
    try {
      this.checkAvailability();
      logger.debug('Adding declarative content rules', { count: rules.length });
      chrome.declarativeContent.onPageChanged.addRules(rules);
      metrics.increment('declarative_content_addRules_success', 1);
    } catch (error) {
      metrics.increment('declarative_content_addRules_error', 1);
      logger.error('Failed to add declarative content rules', error as Error);
      throw new DeclarativeContentRuleError(
        'Failed to add declarative content rules',
        error
      );
    }
  }

  /**
   * Remove rules from onPageChanged
   */
  removeRules(ruleIdentifiers?: string[]): void {
    try {
      this.checkAvailability();
      const ruleCount =
        ruleIdentifiers !== null && ruleIdentifiers !== undefined
          ? ruleIdentifiers.length
          : 0;
      logger.debug('Removing declarative content rules', {
        count: ruleCount,
      });
      chrome.declarativeContent.onPageChanged.removeRules(ruleIdentifiers);
      metrics.increment('declarative_content_removeRules_success', 1);
    } catch (error) {
      metrics.increment('declarative_content_removeRules_error', 1);
      logger.error(
        'Failed to remove declarative content rules',
        error as Error
      );
      throw new DeclarativeContentRuleError(
        'Failed to remove declarative content rules',
        error
      );
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get rules from onPageChanged
   */
  getRules(
    callback: (
      rules: Array<{
        id: string;
        conditions: PageStateMatcherClass[];
        actions: Array<
          | ShowActionClass
          | ShowPageActionClass
          | RequestContentScriptClass
          | SetIconClass
        >;
      }>
    ) => void
  ): void {
    try {
      this.checkAvailability();
      logger.debug('Getting declarative content rules');
      chrome.declarativeContent.onPageChanged.getRules(callback);
      metrics.increment('declarative_content_getRules_success', 1);
    } catch (error) {
      metrics.increment('declarative_content_getRules_error', 1);
      logger.error('Failed to get declarative content rules', error as Error);
      throw new DeclarativeContentRuleError(
        'Failed to get declarative content rules',
        error
      );
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Factory function to create a ChromeDeclarativeContent instance
 */
export function createDeclarativeContent(): ChromeDeclarativeContent {
  const instance = new ChromeDeclarativeContent();
  instance.setup();
  return instance;
}

/**
 * Convenience singleton instance
 */
export const declarativeContent = createDeclarativeContent();

/**
 * Chrome Declarative Content API errors
 */

/**
 * Base error class for Declarative Content API errors
 */
export class DeclarativeContentError extends Error {
  constructor(
    message: string,
    public readonly code: string,
    cause?: unknown
  ) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'DeclarativeContentError';
    if (cause !== null && cause !== undefined) {
      (this as unknown as { cause: unknown }).cause = cause;
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Error thrown when declarative content API is not available
 */
export class DeclarativeContentNotAvailableError extends DeclarativeContentError {
  constructor(message = 'Chrome declarative content API is not available') {
    super(message, 'DECLARATIVE_CONTENT_NOT_AVAILABLE');
    this.name = 'DeclarativeContentNotAvailableError';
  }
}

/**
 * Error thrown when rule operation fails
 */
export class DeclarativeContentRuleError extends DeclarativeContentError {
  constructor(message: string, cause?: unknown) {
    super(message, 'RULE_OPERATION_FAILED', cause);
    this.name = 'DeclarativeContentRuleError';
  }
}

/**

 * Provides type-safe, promise-based wrappers for chrome.declarativeNetRequest.*
 *
 * @example
 * ```typescript
 * import { declarativeNetRequest } from '@chrome-ext/core-declarativeNetRequest';
 *
 * // Add dynamic rule
 * await declarativeNetRequest.updateDynamicRules({
 *   addRules: [{
 *     id: 1,
 *     condition: { urlFilter: 'example.com' },
 *     action: { type: 'block' }
 *   }]
 * });
 * ```

import { logger } from '@chrome-ext/core-telemetry';
import { metrics } from '@chrome-ext/core-telemetry';
import type {
  DynamicRule,
  SessionRule,
  UpdateDynamicRulesOptions,
  UpdateSessionRulesOptions,
  UpdateEnabledRulesetsOptions,
  UpdateStaticRulesOptions,
  TestMatchOutcomeDetails,
  MatchOutcome,
  RegexOptions,
  RegexSupportResult,
  RuleMatchedDebugEvent,
} from './types.js';
import {
  DeclarativeNetRequestNotAvailableError,
  RuleOperationError,

/**
 * Simple event emitter for Chrome declarative net request events
 */
class EventEmitter<T> {
  private listeners = new Set<(data: T) => void>();

  addListener(callback: (data: T) => void): void {
    this.listeners.add(callback);
  }

  removeListener(callback: (data: T) => void): void {
    this.listeners.delete(callback);
  }

  hasListener(callback: (data: T) => void): boolean {
    return this.listeners.has(callback);
  }

  hasListeners(): boolean {
    return this.listeners.size > 0;
  }

  emit(data: T): void {
    for (const listener of this.listeners) {
      try {
        listener(data);
      } catch (error) {
        logger.error(
          'Error in declarative net request event listener',
          error as Error
        );
        metrics.increment('declarative_net_request_event_listener_error', 1);
      }
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Chrome Declarative Net Request API wrapper class
 */
export class ChromeDeclarativeNetRequest {
  /**
   * Event emitter for rule matched debug (if available)
   */
  readonly onRuleMatchedDebug = new EventEmitter<RuleMatchedDebugEvent>();

  private initialized = false;

  /**
   * Check if chrome.declarativeNetRequest API is available
   */
  private checkAvailability(): void {
    if (
      typeof chrome === 'undefined' ||
      chrome.declarativeNetRequest === null ||
      chrome.declarativeNetRequest === undefined
    ) {
      throw new DeclarativeNetRequestNotAvailableError();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Setup event listeners
   */
  setup(): void {
    if (this.initialized) {
      return;
    }

    this.checkAvailability();

    // Setup onRuleMatchedDebug listener (if available)
    if (
      chrome.declarativeNetRequest.onRuleMatchedDebug !== null &&
      chrome.declarativeNetRequest.onRuleMatchedDebug !== undefined
    ) {
      chrome.declarativeNetRequest.onRuleMatchedDebug.addListener(
        (details: RuleMatchedDebugEvent) => {
          metrics.increment('declarative_net_request_rule_matched', 1);
          logger.debug('Rule matched', { ruleId: details.rule.ruleId });
          this.onRuleMatchedDebug.emit(details);
        }
      );
    }

    this.initialized = true;
    logger.info('Chrome Declarative Net Request API wrapper initialized');
  }

  /**
   * Update dynamic rules
   */
  async updateDynamicRules(options: UpdateDynamicRulesOptions): Promise<void> {
    const stopTimer = metrics.startTimer(
      'declarative_net_request_updateDynamicRules'
    );
    try {
      this.checkAvailability();
      const addCount =
        options.addRules !== null && options.addRules !== undefined
          ? options.addRules.length
          : 0;
      const removeCount =
        options.removeRuleIds !== null && options.removeRuleIds !== undefined
          ? options.removeRuleIds.length
          : 0;
      logger.debug('Updating dynamic rules', {
        addCount,
        removeCount,
      });
      await chrome.declarativeNetRequest.updateDynamicRules(options);
      metrics.increment(
        'declarative_net_request_updateDynamicRules_success',
        1
      );
    } catch (error) {
      metrics.increment('declarative_net_request_updateDynamicRules_error', 1);
      logger.error('Failed to update dynamic rules', error as Error);
      throw new RuleOperationError('Failed to update dynamic rules', error);
    } finally {
      stopTimer();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get dynamic rules
   */
  async getDynamicRules(): Promise<DynamicRule[]> {
    const stopTimer = metrics.startTimer(
      'declarative_net_request_getDynamicRules'
    );
    try {
      this.checkAvailability();
      logger.debug('Getting dynamic rules');
      const rules = await chrome.declarativeNetRequest.getDynamicRules();
      metrics.increment('declarative_net_request_getDynamicRules_success', 1);
      return rules as DynamicRule[];
    } catch (error) {
      metrics.increment('declarative_net_request_getDynamicRules_error', 1);
      logger.error('Failed to get dynamic rules', error as Error);
      throw new RuleOperationError('Failed to get dynamic rules', error);
    } finally {
      stopTimer();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Update session rules
   */
  async updateSessionRules(options: UpdateSessionRulesOptions): Promise<void> {
    const stopTimer = metrics.startTimer(
      'declarative_net_request_updateSessionRules'
    );

      );

  /**

  async isRegexSupported(

  ): Promise<RegexSupportResult> {
    const stopTimer = metrics.startTimer(

    );
    try {
      this.checkAvailability();
      logger.debug('Checking regex support', { regex: regexOptions.regex });
      const result =
        await chrome.declarativeNetRequest.isRegexSupported(regexOptions);
      metrics.increment('declarative_net_request_isRegexSupported_success', 1);
      return result as RegexSupportResult;
    } catch (error) {
      metrics.increment('declarative_net_request_isRegexSupported_error', 1);
      logger.error('Failed to check regex support', error as Error);
      throw new RuleOperationError('Failed to check regex support', error);
    } finally {
      stopTimer();
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Factory function to create a ChromeDeclarativeNetRequest instance
 */
export function createDeclarativeNetRequest(): ChromeDeclarativeNetRequest {
  const instance = new ChromeDeclarativeNetRequest();
  instance.setup();
  return instance;
}

/**
 * Convenience singleton instance
 */
export const declarativeNetRequest = createDeclarativeNetRequest();

/**
 * Chrome Declarative Net Request API errors
 */

/**
 * Base error class for Declarative Net Request API errors
 */
export class DeclarativeNetRequestError extends Error {
  constructor(
    message: string,
    public readonly code: string,
    cause?: unknown
  ) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'DeclarativeNetRequestError';
    if (cause !== null && cause !== undefined) {
      (this as unknown as { cause: unknown }).cause = cause;
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Error thrown when declarative net request API is not available
 */
export class DeclarativeNetRequestNotAvailableError extends DeclarativeNetRequestError {
  constructor(
    message = 'Chrome declarative net request API is not available (requires Manifest V3)'
  ) {
    super(message, 'DECLARATIVE_NET_REQUEST_NOT_AVAILABLE');
    this.name = 'DeclarativeNetRequestNotAvailableError';
  }
}

/**
 * Error thrown when rule operation fails
 */
export class RuleOperationError extends DeclarativeNetRequestError {
  constructor(message: string, cause?: unknown) {
    super(message, 'RULE_OPERATION_FAILED', cause);
    this.name = 'RuleOperationError';
  }
}

/**
 * Error thrown when rule validation fails
 */
export class RuleValidationError extends DeclarativeNetRequestError {
  constructor(message: string, cause?: unknown) {
    super(message, 'RULE_VALIDATION_FAILED', cause);
    this.name = 'RuleValidationError';
  }
}
