// Download manager - handles hierarchical file organization and HTML capture with diff/archive

import { logger } from '@chrome-ext/core-telemetry';

/**
 * Calculate SHA-256 checksum of content
 */
async function calculateChecksum(content: string): Promise<string> {
  const encoder = new TextEncoder();
  const data = encoder.encode(content);
  const hashBuffer = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', data);
  const hashArray = Array.from(new Uint8Array(hashBuffer));
  return hashArray.map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
}

/**
 * Store checksum in chrome.storage.local for diff comparison
 */
async function storeChecksum(
  filePath: string,
  checksum: string
): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const key = `checksum:${filePath}`;
    await chrome.storage.local.set({ [key]: checksum });
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Failed to store checksum', error as Error, { filePath });
  }
}

/**
 * Get stored checksum for a file path
 */
async function getChecksum(filePath: string): Promise<string | null> {
  try {
    const key = `checksum:${filePath}`;
    const result = await chrome.storage.local.get(key);
    return result[key] ?? null;
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Failed to get checksum', error as Error, { filePath });
    return null;
  }
}

/**
 * Archive existing file by moving it to archive subfolder
 */
async function archiveFile(
  baseFolder: string,
  filePath: string
): Promise<void> {
  try {
    // Search for existing file
    const downloads = await chrome.downloads.search({
      filenameRegex: filePath.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&'),
    });

    if (downloads.length === 0) {
      logger.debug('No existing file to archive', { filePath });
      return;
    }

    // Create archive path: {baseFolder}/archive/{timestamp}-{filename}
    const pathParts = filePath.split('/');
    const filename = pathParts[pathParts.length - 1];
    const timestamp = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, '-');
    const archivePath = `${baseFolder}/archive/${timestamp}-${filename}`;

    // Note: chrome.downloads API doesn't support moving files directly
    // We'll need to download a new file with the archive path
    // The old file will remain, but we track the archive path in metadata
    logger.info('File archived (new version will be downloaded)', {
      originalPath: filePath,
      archivePath,
    });

    // Store archive metadata
    const archiveKey = `archive:${filePath}`;
    await chrome.storage.local.set({
      [archiveKey]: {
        archivedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        archivePath,
      },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Failed to archive file', error as Error, { filePath });
  }
}

/**
 * Convert blob to data URL (fallback when blob URLs aren't available)
 */
async function blobToDataURL(blob: Blob): Promise<string> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onloadend = () => {
      if (typeof reader.result === 'string') {
        resolve(reader.result);
      } else {
        reject(new Error('Failed to convert blob to data URL'));
      }
    };
    reader.onerror = () => reject(new Error('FileReader error'));
    reader.readAsDataURL(blob);
  });
}

/**
 * Create a blob URL with fallback to data URL for service worker context
 * Chrome extension service workers (Manifest V3) don't support URL.createObjectURL,
 * so we fall back to data URLs which work in all contexts
 */
async function createBlobURL(blob: Blob): Promise<string> {
  // Try multiple ways to access URL.createObjectURL for compatibility
  let createObjectURLFn: ((blob: Blob) => string) | undefined;

  // Check self.URL (service worker context)
  if (
    typeof self !== 'undefined' &&
    (self as any).URL &&
    typeof (self as any).URL.createObjectURL === 'function'
  ) {
    try {
      createObjectURLFn = (self as any).URL.createObjectURL.bind(
        (self as any).URL
      );
      // Test if it actually works (some contexts have URL but not createObjectURL)
      const testBlob = new Blob(['test'], { type: 'text/plain' });
      const testUrl = createObjectURLFn(testBlob);
      if (testUrl && testUrl.startsWith('blob:')) {
        // Revoke test URL
        if (typeof (self as any).URL.revokeObjectURL === 'function') {
          (self as any).URL.revokeObjectURL(testUrl);
        }
        return createObjectURLFn(blob);
      }
    } catch {
      // createObjectURL not actually available, fall through to data URL
      createObjectURLFn = undefined;
    }
  }

  // Check global URL (window context or fallback)
  if (
    !createObjectURLFn &&
    typeof URL !== 'undefined' &&
    typeof URL.createObjectURL === 'function'
  ) {
    try {
      createObjectURLFn = URL.createObjectURL.bind(URL);
      // Test if it actually works
      const testBlob = new Blob(['test'], { type: 'text/plain' });
      const testUrl = createObjectURLFn(testBlob);
      if (testUrl && testUrl.startsWith('blob:')) {
        // Revoke test URL
        if (typeof URL.revokeObjectURL === 'function') {
          URL.revokeObjectURL(testUrl);
        }
        return createObjectURLFn(blob);
      }
    } catch {
      // createObjectURL not actually available, fall through to data URL
      createObjectURLFn = undefined;
    }
  }

  // Check globalThis.URL (modern standard)
  if (
    !createObjectURLFn &&
    typeof globalThis !== 'undefined' &&
    (globalThis as any).URL &&
    typeof (globalThis as any).URL.createObjectURL === 'function'
  ) {
    try {
      createObjectURLFn = (globalThis as any).URL.createObjectURL.bind(
        (globalThis as any).URL
      );
      // Test if it actually works
      const testBlob = new Blob(['test'], { type: 'text/plain' });
      const testUrl = createObjectURLFn(testBlob);
      if (testUrl && testUrl.startsWith('blob:')) {
        // Revoke test URL
        if (typeof (globalThis as any).URL.revokeObjectURL === 'function') {
          (globalThis as any).URL.revokeObjectURL(testUrl);
        }
        return createObjectURLFn(blob);
      }
    } catch {
      // createObjectURL not actually available, fall through to data URL
      createObjectURLFn = undefined;
    }
  }

  // Fallback to data URL (works in all contexts including service workers)
  logger.debug(
    'Using data URL fallback (blob URLs not available in service worker)',
    {
      blobType: blob.type,
      blobSize: blob.size,
    }
  );

  return await blobToDataURL(blob);
}

/**
 * Sanitize filename for Chrome downloads API
 * Removes invalid characters and ensures valid path structure
 */
function sanitizeFilename(filename: string): string {
  if (!filename || typeof filename !== 'string') {
    throw new Error(
      `Invalid filename input: ${JSON.stringify(filename)} (type: ${typeof filename})`
    );
  }

  // Chrome downloads API doesn't allow certain characters
  // Replace invalid characters with underscores
  let sanitized = filename
    .replace(/[<>:"|?*\x00-\x1f]/g, '_') // Invalid filename characters
    .replace(/\\/g, '/') // Windows backslashes to forward slashes
    .replace(/\/+/g, '/') // Multiple slashes to single
    .replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, '') // Leading/trailing slashes
    .replace(/\.\./g, '_') // Parent directory references
    .trim(); // Remove whitespace

  // Ensure it's not empty
  if (!sanitized || sanitized === '') {
    throw new Error(
      `Filename cannot be empty after sanitization. Original: "${filename}"`
    );
  }

  return sanitized;
}

/**
 * Check if extension has downloads permission
 */
async function checkDownloadsPermission(): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    // Check if downloads API is available
    if (!chrome.downloads || typeof chrome.downloads.download !== 'function') {
      return false;
    }

    // Try to check permissions (may not be available in all contexts)
    if (
      chrome.permissions &&
      typeof chrome.permissions.contains === 'function'
    ) {
      const hasPermission = await chrome.permissions.contains({
        permissions: ['downloads'],
      });
      return hasPermission;
    }

    // If we can't check, assume we have it (will fail with better error if not)
    return true;
  } catch {
    // If permission check fails, assume we have it
    return true;
  }
}

/**
 * Validate folder path structure (folders are created automatically by Chrome downloads API when files are downloaded)
 * This function validates the path but does not create any files - folders will be created implicitly when files download
 */
export async function ensureFolder(
  baseFolder: string,
  folderPath: string
): Promise<void> {
  // Log input parameters for observability
  logger.info('ensureFolder called', {
    baseFolder: {
      original: baseFolder,
      type: typeof baseFolder,
      length: baseFolder?.length,
    },
    folderPath: {
      original: folderPath,
      type: typeof folderPath,
      length: folderPath?.length,
    },
  });

  try {
    // Check downloads permission
    const hasPermission = await checkDownloadsPermission();
    if (!hasPermission) {
      throw new Error(
        'Extension does not have downloads permission. Please add "downloads" to manifest.json permissions.'
      );
    }

    // Reject absolute paths up-front (safer than silently sanitizing them)
    if (
      (typeof baseFolder === 'string' &&
        (baseFolder.startsWith('/') || baseFolder.startsWith('\\'))) ||
      (typeof folderPath === 'string' &&
        (folderPath.startsWith('/') || folderPath.startsWith('\\')))
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        `Invalid folder path: path starts with slash. Chrome downloads API requires relative paths. baseFolder: "${baseFolder}", folderPath: "${folderPath}"`
      );
    }

    // Sanitize inputs
    const sanitizedBaseFolder = sanitizeFilename(baseFolder);

    // Check if folderPath already includes the baseFolder (common when using variables)
    let sanitizedFolderPath = folderPath ? sanitizeFilename(folderPath) : '';

    // If folderPath starts with baseFolder, remove it to avoid duplication
    // Also check for common variations (with/without slashes, different cases)
    const baseFolderVariations = [
      sanitizedBaseFolder,
      sanitizedBaseFolder + '/',
      sanitizedBaseFolder + '\\',
      baseFolder, // Original unsanitized
      baseFolder + '/',
      baseFolder + '\\',
    ];

    for (const variation of baseFolderVariations) {
      if (
        sanitizedFolderPath.toLowerCase().startsWith(variation.toLowerCase())
      ) {
        sanitizedFolderPath = sanitizedFolderPath
          .substring(variation.length)
          .replace(/^\/+/, '') // Remove leading slashes
          .replace(/^\\+/, ''); // Remove leading backslashes
        logger.debug('Removed baseFolder prefix from folderPath', {
          variation,
          originalFolderPath: folderPath,
          sanitizedFolderPath,
        });
        break;
      }
    }

    logger.debug('Sanitized paths', {
      sanitizedBaseFolder,
      sanitizedFolderPath,
      originalFolderPath: folderPath,
      baseFolderChanged: sanitizedBaseFolder !== baseFolder,
      folderPathChanged: sanitizedFolderPath !== folderPath,
      pathStartsWithBase: folderPath?.startsWith(baseFolder),
    });

    // Construct the folder path that will be used when files are downloaded
    const normalizedPath = sanitizedFolderPath ? `${sanitizedFolderPath}/` : '';
    const folderPrefix = `${sanitizedBaseFolder}/${normalizedPath}`;

    // Validate the path doesn't contain unsubstituted variables
    if (folderPrefix.includes('{') || folderPrefix.includes('}')) {
      const errorMsg = `Invalid folder path: contains unsubstituted variables. Original baseFolder: "${baseFolder}", Original folderPath: "${folderPath}", Final path: "${folderPrefix}"`;
      logger.error('Unsubstituted variables detected', new Error(errorMsg), {
      baseFolder,
      folderPath,
        folderPrefix,
        hasOpenBrace: folderPrefix.includes('{'),
        hasCloseBrace: folderPrefix.includes('}'),
      });
      throw new Error(errorMsg);
    }

    // Validate path structure
    if (folderPrefix.startsWith('/') || folderPrefix.startsWith('\\')) {
      const errorMsg = `Invalid folder path: path starts with slash. Chrome downloads API requires relative paths. Path: "${folderPrefix}"`;
      logger.error('Invalid path structure', new Error(errorMsg), {
        baseFolder,
        folderPath,
        folderPrefix,
      });
      throw new Error(errorMsg);
    }

    logger.info('Folder path validated (will be created when files download)', {
      baseFolder: sanitizedBaseFolder,
      folderPath: sanitizedFolderPath,
      folderPrefix,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    // Enhanced error logging with all context
    const errorContext = {
      baseFolder,
      folderPath,
      baseFolderType: typeof baseFolder,
      folderPathType: typeof folderPath,
      baseFolderValue: String(baseFolder),
      folderPathValue: String(folderPath),
      errorName: error instanceof Error ? error.name : 'Unknown',
      errorMessage: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
      errorStack: error instanceof Error ? error.stack : undefined,
    };

    logger.error('Failed to ensure folder', error as Error, errorContext);

    // Re-throw with enhanced message
    if (error instanceof Error) {
      throw error; // Already has good message
    } else {
      throw new Error(
        `Failed to ensure folder: ${String(error)}\n  Base Folder: "${baseFolder}"\n  Folder Path: "${folderPath}"`
      );
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Update download status in storage
 */
async function updateDownloadStatus(
  recipeKey: string,
  update: Partial<{
    baseFolder: string;
    totalFiles: number;
    downloadedFiles: number;
    currentFile: string;
    status: 'idle' | 'downloading' | 'completed' | 'error';
    error: string;
    startedAt: string;
    completedAt: string;
  }>
): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const statusKey = `download_status:${recipeKey}`;
    const current = await chrome.storage.local.get(statusKey);
    const currentStatus = current[statusKey] || {
      baseFolder: '',
      totalFiles: 0,
      downloadedFiles: 0,
      status: 'idle' as const,
    };

    const updatedStatus = {
      ...currentStatus,
      ...update,
    };

    await chrome.storage.local.set({
      [statusKey]: updatedStatus,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Failed to update download status', error as Error, {
      recipeKey,
    });
  }
}

/**
 * Capture HTML content and save to file with optional diff checking
 */
export async function captureHtml(
  baseFolder: string,
  filePath: string,
  htmlContent: string,
  diffCheck: boolean = false,
  recipeKey?: string
): Promise<string> {
  try {
    const fullPath = `${baseFolder}/${filePath}`;
    const checksum = await calculateChecksum(htmlContent);

    // Update status: current file
    if (recipeKey) {
      await updateDownloadStatus(recipeKey, {
        status: 'downloading',
        currentFile: filePath,
      });
    }

    // Check for existing file and diff if requested
    if (diffCheck) {
      const existingChecksum = await getChecksum(fullPath);
      if (existingChecksum !== null && existingChecksum === checksum) {
        logger.debug('HTML content unchanged, skipping download', {
          filePath: fullPath,
        });
        return fullPath; // No change, return existing path
      }

      // Content changed, archive old file if it exists
      if (existingChecksum !== null) {
        await archiveFile(baseFolder, filePath);
      }
    }

    // Create blob and download
    const blob = new Blob([htmlContent], { type: 'text/html' });
    const url = await createBlobURL(blob);

    // Log the actual filename being passed to Chrome downloads API
    // Log detailed download information for debugging
    // Parse folder structure from filePath
    const pathParts = filePath.split('/');
    const filename = pathParts[pathParts.length - 1];
    const folderPath = pathParts.length > 1 ? pathParts.slice(0, -1).join('/') : '';
    
    // Store expected path for validation
    const expectedPath = fullPath;
    
    logger.info('Pre-download: Expected path validation', {
      action: 'captureHtml',
      expectedFullPath: expectedPath,
      expectedBaseFolder: baseFolder,
      expectedRelativePath: filePath,
      expectedFilename: filename,
      expectedFolderPath: folderPath || '(root)',
      pathValidation: {
        expectedPath: expectedPath,
        willValidateAfterDownload: true,
      },
    });
    
    logger.info('Starting download with detailed path breakdown', {
      filePath: fullPath,
      baseFolder,
      relativePath: filePath,
      blobUrl: url.substring(0, 50) + '...',
      blobSize: blob.size,
      expectedFullPath: fullPath,
      expectedBaseFolder: baseFolder,
      expectedRelativePath: filePath,
      actualFilenameBeingDownloaded: fullPath, // This is what Chrome will use
      downloadPath: fullPath, // Full path that will be passed to Chrome downloads API
      pathComponents: {
        baseFolder,
        folderPath: folderPath || '(root)',
        filename,
        relativePath: filePath,
        fullPath,
      },
      folderStructure: {
        baseFolder,
        nestedFolders: folderPath ? folderPath.split('/') : [],
        filename,
        totalDepth: folderPath ? folderPath.split('/').length + 1 : 1, // baseFolder + nested folders
      },
      // Log what Chrome will create:
      // - baseFolder will be created if it doesn't exist
      // - Each folder in folderPath will be created if it doesn't exist
      // - filename will be saved in the final folder
      chromeWillCreate: {
        baseFolder: baseFolder,
        nestedFolders: folderPath ? folderPath.split('/') : [],
        finalFolder: folderPath ? `${baseFolder}/${folderPath}` : baseFolder,
        fileLocation: fullPath,
      },
      pathValidation: {
        expectedPath: expectedPath,
        willValidateAfterDownload: true,
      },
    });

    // Start download and get download ID
    const downloadId = await chrome.downloads.download({
      url,
      filename: fullPath,
      saveAs: false,
    });

	    logger.info('Download initiated', {
	      downloadId,
	      filePath: fullPath,
	      expectedFilename: fullPath,
	      baseFolder,
	      relativePath: filePath,
	    });

	    const canListenForDownloadCompletion =
	      chrome.downloads?.onChanged &&
	      typeof chrome.downloads.onChanged.addListener === 'function' &&
	      typeof chrome.downloads.onChanged.removeListener === 'function';

	    // Wait for download to complete using onChanged event (skip in test environments)
	    if (canListenForDownloadCompletion) {
	      await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
	      const startTime = Date.now();
	      const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
	        chrome.downloads.onChanged.removeListener(listener);
	        logger.error(
	          'Download timeout',
          new Error(`Download timeout: ${fullPath}`),
          {
            downloadId,
            filePath: fullPath,
            elapsedMs: Date.now() - startTime,
          }
        );
        reject(new Error(`Download timeout: ${fullPath}`));
      }, 30000); // 30 second timeout

      const listener = (delta: {
        id: number;
        state?: { current?: string; previous?: string };
        error?: { current?: string; previous?: string };
        filename?: { current?: string; previous?: string };
      }) => {
        // Only process events for our download
        if (delta.id !== downloadId) {
          return;
        }

        logger.debug('Download state changed', {
          downloadId,
          filePath: fullPath,
          stateChange: {
            previous: delta.state?.previous,
            current: delta.state?.current,
          },
          filenameChange: {
            previous: delta.filename?.previous,
            current: delta.filename?.current,
          },
          error: delta.error?.current,
          elapsedMs: Date.now() - startTime,
        });

        // Check if download completed
        if (delta.state?.current === 'complete') {
          clearTimeout(timeout);
          chrome.downloads.onChanged.removeListener(listener);
          // Parse actual download path to show folder structure
          const completedPathParts = delta.filename?.current 
            ? delta.filename.current.split('/') 
            : [];
          const completedFilename = completedPathParts[completedPathParts.length - 1];
          const completedFolderPath = completedPathParts.length > 1 
            ? completedPathParts.slice(0, -1).join('/') 
            : '';
          const expectedPathParts = filePath.split('/');
          const expectedFilename = expectedPathParts[expectedPathParts.length - 1];
          const expectedFolderPath = expectedPathParts.length > 1 
            ? expectedPathParts.slice(0, -1).join('/') 
            : '';
          
          // Verify the file was saved to the correct location
          const actualPath = delta.filename?.current || '';
          const pathMatches = actualPath === fullPath || actualPath.endsWith(fullPath.split('/').pop() || '');
          
          // Extract folder structure from actual path for verification
          const actualPathParts = actualPath.split('/');
          const actualBaseFolder = actualPathParts[0] || '';
          const actualFolderStructure = actualPathParts.slice(0, -1).join('/');
          const actualFile = actualPathParts[actualPathParts.length - 1] || '';
          
          // Enhanced path validation
          const expectedPathForValidation = fullPath;
          const actualPathForValidation = delta.filename?.current || '';
          const pathValidationMatches = actualPathForValidation === expectedPathForValidation || 
            actualPathForValidation.endsWith(filename) ||
            actualPathForValidation.endsWith(filePath);
          
          if (!pathValidationMatches) {
            logger.warn('Post-download: Path validation FAILED', {
              downloadId,
              expectedPath: expectedPathForValidation,
              actualPath: actualPathForValidation,
              pathMismatch: true,
              pathBreakdown: {
                expected: {
                  fullPath: expectedPathForValidation,
                  baseFolder,
                  folderPath: expectedFolderPath || '(root)',
                  filename: expectedFilename,
                },
                actual: {
                  fullPath: actualPathForValidation,
                  baseFolder: actualBaseFolder,
                  folderPath: actualFolderStructure || '(root)',
                  filename: actualFile,
                },
              },
            });
          } else {
            logger.info('Post-download: Path validation PASSED', {
              downloadId,
              expectedPath: expectedPathForValidation,
              actualPath: actualPathForValidation,
              pathMatches: true,
            });
          }
          
          logger.info('Download completed (via onChanged event) with path breakdown', {
            downloadId,
            filePath: fullPath,
            baseFolder,
            relativePath: filePath,
            finalFilename: delta.filename?.current,
            elapsedMs: Date.now() - startTime,
            expectedFullPath: fullPath,
            actualDownloadPath: delta.filename?.current, // What Chrome actually saved
            pathMatch: pathMatches,
            pathValidation: {
              expectedPath: expectedPathForValidation,
              actualPath: actualPathForValidation,
              matches: pathValidationMatches,
            },
            downloadLocation: {
              expected: fullPath,
              actual: delta.filename?.current,
              matches: pathMatches,
            },
            pathBreakdown: {
              expected: {
                fullPath,
                baseFolder,
                folderPath: expectedFolderPath || '(root)',
                filename: expectedFilename,
              },
              actual: {
                fullPath: delta.filename?.current,
                baseFolder: actualBaseFolder,
                folderPath: actualFolderStructure || '(root)',
                filename: actualFile,
              },
            },
            folderCreation: {
              baseFolderCreated: completedPathParts.includes(baseFolder.split('/').pop() || ''),
              nestedFoldersCreated: expectedPathParts.slice(0, -1).map((folder, idx) => ({
                folder,
                expectedPath: `${baseFolder}/${expectedPathParts.slice(0, idx + 1).join('/')}`,
                created: completedPathParts.some(part => part === folder),
              })),
            },
            verification: {
              pathMatches,
              pathValidationMatches,
              expectedFolderStructure: expectedFolderPath,
              actualFolderStructure,
              folderStructureMatches: actualFolderStructure === expectedFolderPath || actualFolderStructure.endsWith(expectedFolderPath || ''),
            },
          });

          // Small delay to ensure Chrome has indexed the download
          // This is especially important for blob downloads which complete instantly
          // Then verify the download is actually searchable before resolving
          setTimeout(async () => {
            try {
              const verifyDownloads = await chrome.downloads.search({
                id: downloadId,
              });
              const verifyItem = verifyDownloads[0];
              
              // Verify file was saved to correct location
              if (verifyItem?.filename) {
                const actualPath = verifyItem.filename;
                const expectedPath = fullPath;
                const pathMatches = actualPath === expectedPath || 
                                  actualPath.endsWith(filePath.split('/').pop() || '');
                
                // Extract folder structure for verification
                const actualPathParts = actualPath.split('/');
                const expectedPathParts = expectedPath.split('/');
                const actualFolder = actualPathParts.slice(0, -1).join('/');
                const expectedFolder = expectedPathParts.slice(0, -1).join('/');
                
                logger.info('Post-download verification', {
                  downloadId,
                  expectedPath,
                  actualPath,
                  pathMatches,
                  folderVerification: {
                    expectedFolder,
                    actualFolder,
                    folderMatches: actualFolder === expectedFolder || actualFolder.endsWith(expectedFolder.split('/').pop() || ''),
                  },
                  fileVerification: {
                    expectedFile: expectedPathParts[expectedPathParts.length - 1],
                    actualFile: actualPathParts[actualPathParts.length - 1],
                    fileMatches: actualPathParts[actualPathParts.length - 1] === expectedPathParts[expectedPathParts.length - 1],
                  },
                });
              }
              logger.debug('Post-completion verification', {
                downloadId,
                filePath: fullPath,
                found: verifyDownloads.length > 0,
                state: verifyItem?.state,
                filename: verifyItem?.filename,
              });
            } catch (error) {
              logger.warn('Post-completion verification failed', {
                downloadId,
                filePath: fullPath,
                error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
              });
            }
            // Resolve after delay and verification
            resolve();
          }, 500);
        }

        // Check if download was interrupted
        if (delta.state?.current === 'interrupted') {
          clearTimeout(timeout);
          chrome.downloads.onChanged.removeListener(listener);
          logger.error(
            'Download interrupted',
            new Error(
              `Download interrupted: ${delta.error?.current ?? 'Unknown error'}`
            ),
            {
              downloadId,
              filePath: fullPath,
              elapsedMs: Date.now() - startTime,
            }
          );
          reject(
            new Error(
              `Download interrupted: ${delta.error?.current ?? 'Unknown error'}`
            )
          );
        }
      };

      chrome.downloads.onChanged.addListener(listener);

      // Also check current state immediately in case download already completed
      chrome.downloads
        .search({ id: downloadId })
        .then(
          (
            items: Array<{
              state?: string;
              error?: string;
              filename?: string;
              id?: number;
            }>
          ) => {
            const item = items[0];
            logger.debug('Initial download state check', {
              downloadId,
              filePath: fullPath,
              found: items.length > 0,
              state: item?.state,
              filename: item?.filename,
              error: item?.error,
            });

            if (item?.state === 'complete') {
              clearTimeout(timeout);
              chrome.downloads.onChanged.removeListener(listener);
              // Parse actual download path to show folder structure
              const actualPathParts = item.filename ? item.filename.split('/') : [];
              const actualFilename = actualPathParts[actualPathParts.length - 1];
              const actualFolderPath = actualPathParts.length > 1 
                ? actualPathParts.slice(0, -1).join('/') 
                : '';
              
              logger.info('Download already completed (initial check)', {
                downloadId,
                filePath: fullPath,
                baseFolder,
                relativePath: filePath,
                filename: item.filename,
                elapsedMs: Date.now() - startTime,
                expectedFullPath: fullPath,
                actualDownloadPath: item.filename,
                pathMatch: item.filename === fullPath,
                downloadLocation: {
                  expected: fullPath,
                  actual: item.filename,
                  matches: item.filename === fullPath,
                },
                pathBreakdown: {
                  expected: {
                    fullPath,
                    baseFolder,
                    folderPath: filePath.split('/').slice(0, -1).join('/') || '(root)',
                    filename: filePath.split('/').pop(),
                  },
                  actual: {
                    fullPath: item.filename,
                    baseFolder: actualPathParts[0] || 'N/A',
                    folderPath: actualFolderPath || '(root)',
                    filename: actualFilename,
                  },
                },
              });

              // Small delay to ensure Chrome has indexed the download
              // Then verify the download is actually searchable before resolving
              setTimeout(async () => {
                try {
                  const verifyDownloads = await chrome.downloads.search({
                    id: downloadId,
                  });
                  const verifyItem = verifyDownloads[0];
                  logger.debug('Post-completion verification (initial check)', {
                    downloadId,
                    filePath: fullPath,
                    found: verifyDownloads.length > 0,
                    state: verifyItem?.state,
                    filename: verifyItem?.filename,
                  });
                } catch (error) {
                  logger.warn(
                    'Post-completion verification failed (initial check)',
                    {
                      downloadId,
                      filePath: fullPath,
                      error:
                        error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
                    }
                  );
                }
                // Resolve after delay and verification
                resolve();
              }, 500);
            } else if (item?.state === 'interrupted') {
              clearTimeout(timeout);
              chrome.downloads.onChanged.removeListener(listener);
              logger.error(
                'Download already interrupted (initial check)',
                new Error(
                  `Download interrupted: ${item.error ?? 'Unknown error'}`
                ),
                {
                  downloadId,
                  filePath: fullPath,
                  elapsedMs: Date.now() - startTime,
                }
              );
              reject(
                new Error(
                  `Download interrupted: ${item.error ?? 'Unknown error'}`
                )
              );
            } else if (item?.state) {
              logger.debug('Download in progress (initial check)', {
                downloadId,
                filePath: fullPath,
                state: item.state,
                filename: item.filename,
              });
            }
          }
        )
        .catch((error: Error) => {
          logger.error('Error checking initial download state', error, {
            downloadId,
            filePath: fullPath,
	        });
	          // Don't reject here - let the event listener handle it
	        });
	      });
	    } else {
	      logger.debug('chrome.downloads.onChanged unavailable; skipping wait', {
	        downloadId,
	        filePath: fullPath,
	      });
	    }

    // Store checksum for future diff checks
    await storeChecksum(fullPath, checksum);

    // Update status: increment downloaded files
    if (recipeKey) {
      const statusKey = `download_status:${recipeKey}`;
      const current = await chrome.storage.local.get(statusKey);
      const currentStatus = current[statusKey] || {
        downloadedFiles: 0,
        totalFiles: 0,
      };
      await updateDownloadStatus(recipeKey, {
        downloadedFiles: (currentStatus.downloadedFiles || 0) + 1,
      });
    }

    logger.info('HTML captured', {
      filePath: fullPath,
      checksum,
      diffCheck,
    });

    return fullPath;
  } catch (error) {
    // Update status: error
    if (recipeKey) {
      await updateDownloadStatus(recipeKey, {
        status: 'error',
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
      });
    }

    logger.error('Failed to capture HTML', error as Error, {
      baseFolder,
      filePath,
    });
    throw error;
  }
}

/**
 * Save URL and metadata to JSON file
 */
export async function saveUrl(
  baseFolder: string,
  filePath: string,
  url: string,
  metadata?: Record<string, unknown>
): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const fullPath = `${baseFolder}/${filePath}`;
    const urlData = {
      url,
      extractedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      ...metadata,
    };

    const jsonContent = JSON.stringify(urlData, null, 2);
    const blob = new Blob([jsonContent], { type: 'application/json' });
    const blobUrl = await createBlobURL(blob);

    // Start download and get download ID
	    const downloadId = await chrome.downloads.download({
	      url: blobUrl,
	      filename: fullPath,
	      saveAs: false,
	    });

	    const canListenForDownloadCompletion =
	      chrome.downloads?.onChanged &&
	      typeof chrome.downloads.onChanged.addListener === 'function' &&
	      typeof chrome.downloads.onChanged.removeListener === 'function';

	    // Wait for download to complete using onChanged event (skip in test environments)
	    if (canListenForDownloadCompletion) {
	      await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
	      const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
	        chrome.downloads.onChanged.removeListener(listener);
	        reject(new Error(`Download timeout: ${fullPath}`));
	      }, 30000); // 30 second timeout

      const listener = (delta: {
        id: number;
        state?: { current?: string; previous?: string };
        error?: { current?: string; previous?: string };
      }) => {
        // Only process events for our download
        if (delta.id !== downloadId) {
          return;
        }

        // Check if download completed
        if (delta.state?.current === 'complete') {
          clearTimeout(timeout);
          chrome.downloads.onChanged.removeListener(listener);
          resolve();
        }

        // Check if download was interrupted
        if (delta.state?.current === 'interrupted') {
          clearTimeout(timeout);
          chrome.downloads.onChanged.removeListener(listener);
          reject(
            new Error(
              `Download interrupted: ${delta.error?.current ?? 'Unknown error'}`
            )
          );
        }
      };

      chrome.downloads.onChanged.addListener(listener);

      // Also check current state immediately in case download already completed
      chrome.downloads
        .search({ id: downloadId })
        .then((items: Array<{ state?: string; error?: string }>) => {
          const item = items[0];
          if (item?.state === 'complete') {
            clearTimeout(timeout);
            chrome.downloads.onChanged.removeListener(listener);
            resolve();
          } else if (item?.state === 'interrupted') {
            clearTimeout(timeout);
            chrome.downloads.onChanged.removeListener(listener);
            reject(
              new Error(
                `Download interrupted: ${item.error ?? 'Unknown error'}`
              )
            );
	          }
	        });
	      });
	    } else {
	      logger.debug('chrome.downloads.onChanged unavailable; skipping wait', {
	        downloadId,
	        filePath: fullPath,
	      });
	    }

    logger.info('URL saved', {
      filePath: fullPath,
      url,
      metadataKeys: metadata ? Object.keys(metadata) : [],
    });
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Failed to save URL', error as Error, {
      baseFolder,
      filePath,
      url,
    });
    throw error;
  }
}

/**
 * Validate that a folder exists by checking for any files in that folder path
 * Uses chrome.downloads.search to verify folder was created (by checking for files in that path)
 * Polls with configurable timeout to handle delayed file indexing
 */
export async function validateFolderExists(
  baseFolder: string,
  folderPath: string,
  timeoutMs: number = 5000
): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    const sanitizedBaseFolder = sanitizeFilename(baseFolder);
    const sanitizedFolderPath = folderPath ? sanitizeFilename(folderPath) : '';
    const normalizedPath = sanitizedFolderPath ? `${sanitizedFolderPath}/` : '';

    logger.info('Starting folder validation', {
      baseFolder,
      folderPath,
      sanitizedBaseFolder,
      sanitizedFolderPath,
      normalizedPath,
      timeoutMs,
    });

    // Poll for folder existence with timeout
    const startTime = Date.now();
    let attemptCount = 0;

    while (Date.now() - startTime < timeoutMs) {
      attemptCount++;
      // Chrome.downloads.search returns full absolute paths like:
      // /Users/evanmccall/Downloads/Bravado-Patient-Export-2025-12-15/ACTIVE_PATIENTS/page-001/patient--abdullahi-fatuma/profile.html
      // We need to extract the relative portion (after Downloads folder) and compare with our expected folder path
      // This makes it work across different machines with different Downloads folder locations

      // Search for files that contain the baseFolder name (works across different machines)
      // Escape the baseFolder name for regex
      const escapedBaseFolder = sanitizedBaseFolder.replace(
        /[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g,
        '\\$&'
      );
      const downloads = await chrome.downloads.search({
        filenameRegex: `${escapedBaseFolder}`, // Match any file in our base folder
      });

      // Filter to ensure files are actually directly in the target folder (not in subfolders)
      // Extract relative path from absolute path and compare
      // Also verify downloads are complete (not in_progress or interrupted)
      // CRITICAL: Must match EXACT folder path, not just any folder that starts with it
      const filesInFolder = downloads.filter(
        (d: { filename?: string; state?: string; id?: number; startTime?: string }) => {
          const absolutePath = d.filename || '';

	          // Only consider completed downloads (tests may omit state)
	          if (d.state !== undefined && d.state !== 'complete') {
	            return false;
	          }

          // Find where our baseFolder starts in the absolute path
          // This handles different Downloads folder locations
          const baseFolderIndex = absolutePath.indexOf(sanitizedBaseFolder);
          if (baseFolderIndex === -1) {
            return false;
          }

          // Extract relative path: everything after baseFolder
          // Example: /Users/.../Downloads/Bravado-Patient-Export-2025-12-15/page-001/patient-001-xxx/profile.html
          // Relative: page-001/patient-001-xxx/profile.html
          const relativePath = absolutePath.substring(
            baseFolderIndex + sanitizedBaseFolder.length
          );

          // Remove leading slash if present
          const normalizedRelative = relativePath.startsWith('/')
            ? relativePath.substring(1)
            : relativePath;

          // CRITICAL FIX: Check if relative path starts with our folder path EXACTLY
          // Must match the exact folder path, not a parent or sibling folder
          // Pattern: folderPath/filename (no additional path segments before filename)
          if (!normalizedRelative.startsWith(normalizedPath)) {
            return false;
          }

          // Get the part after folderPath
          const afterFolderPath = normalizedRelative.substring(
            normalizedPath.length
          );

	          // Must contain at least one path segment after the folder (i.e., a filename or nested path)
	          if (afterFolderPath.length === 0) {
	            return false;
	          }

          // Additional validation: Ensure the folder path segment matches exactly
          // This prevents matching parent folders (e.g., patient-001 matching patient-001-xxx)
          // Split the relative path to verify folder structure
          const relativeParts = normalizedRelative.split('/');
          const folderParts = normalizedPath.split('/').filter(p => p.length > 0);
          
          // Must have at least folderParts.length + 1 segments (folders + filename)
          if (relativeParts.length < folderParts.length + 1) {
            return false;
          }
          
          // Verify each folder segment matches exactly
          for (let i = 0; i < folderParts.length; i++) {
            if (relativeParts[i] !== folderParts[i]) {
              return false;
            }
          }
          
          // The last segment should be the filename (already verified above)
          return true;
        }
      );

      const exists = filesInFolder.length > 0;

      if (exists) {
        // Extract relative paths for logging to verify we found the right files
        const foundFilePaths = filesInFolder.map((d: { filename?: string }): string => {
          const absolutePath = d.filename || '';
          const baseFolderIndex = absolutePath.indexOf(sanitizedBaseFolder);
          if (baseFolderIndex === -1) return 'N/A';
          const relativePath = absolutePath.substring(
            baseFolderIndex + sanitizedBaseFolder.length
          );
          return relativePath.startsWith('/') ? relativePath.substring(1) : relativePath;
        });
        
        logger.info('Folder validation successful', {
          baseFolder,
          folderPath,
          normalizedPath,
          exists,
          fileCount: filesInFolder.length,
          totalDownloads: downloads.length,
          foundFilePaths, // Show relative paths of files found
          expectedFolderPath: normalizedPath,
          sampleFiles: filesInFolder
            .slice(0, 3)
            .map((d: { filename?: string; state?: string }) => d.filename),
          elapsedMs: Date.now() - startTime,
          validationDetails: {
            expectedFolder: normalizedPath,
            foundFilesInFolder: foundFilePaths,
            allMatchExpectedFolder: foundFilePaths.every((path: string) => path.startsWith(normalizedPath)),
          },
        });
        return true;
      }

      // Log debug info on first attempt
      if (Date.now() - startTime < 500) {
        // Extract relative paths for all downloads to see what we're comparing against
        const allRelativePaths = downloads
          .filter((d: { state?: string }) => d.state === 'complete')
          .map((d: { filename?: string }): string => {
            const absolutePath = d.filename || '';
            const baseFolderIndex = absolutePath.indexOf(sanitizedBaseFolder);
            if (baseFolderIndex === -1) return 'N/A';
            const relativePath = absolutePath.substring(
              baseFolderIndex + sanitizedBaseFolder.length
            );
            return relativePath.startsWith('/') ? relativePath.substring(1) : relativePath;
          });
        
        logger.debug('Folder validation attempt', {
          baseFolder,
          folderPath,
          normalizedPath,
          downloadsFound: downloads.length,
          completedDownloads: downloads.filter((d: { state?: string }) => d.state === 'complete').length,
          expectedFolderPath: normalizedPath,
          allRelativePaths, // Show all relative paths we're comparing against
          sampleDownloadPaths: downloads
            .slice(0, 5)
            .map((d: { filename?: string; state?: string }) => ({
              filename: d.filename,
              state: d.state,
              relativePath: (() => {
                const absolutePath = d.filename || '';
                const baseFolderIndex = absolutePath.indexOf(sanitizedBaseFolder);
                if (baseFolderIndex === -1) return 'N/A';
                const relativePath = absolutePath.substring(
                  baseFolderIndex + sanitizedBaseFolder.length
                );
                return relativePath.startsWith('/') ? relativePath.substring(1) : relativePath;
              })(),
            })),
        });
      }

      // Wait 200ms before retry
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 200));
    }

    // Final search to log what we found
    const escapedBaseFolder = sanitizedBaseFolder.replace(
      /[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g,
      '\\$&'
    );
    const finalDownloads = await chrome.downloads.search({
      filenameRegex: `${escapedBaseFolder}`,
    });

    logger.warn('Folder validation timeout', {
      baseFolder,
      folderPath,
      normalizedPath,
      timeoutMs,
      attempts: attemptCount,
      elapsedMs: Date.now() - startTime,
      totalDownloadsFound: finalDownloads.length,
      allDownloads: finalDownloads.map(
        (d: {
          filename?: string;
          state?: string;
          id?: number;
          startTime?: string;
        }) => ({
          id: d.id,
          filename: d.filename,
          state: d.state,
          startTime: d.startTime,
          relativePath: d.filename
            ? (() => {
                const idx = d.filename.indexOf(sanitizedBaseFolder);
                if (idx === -1) return 'N/A';
                const rel = d.filename.substring(
                  idx + sanitizedBaseFolder.length
                );
                return rel.startsWith('/') ? rel.substring(1) : rel;
              })()
            : 'N/A',
        })
      ),
    });
    return false;
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Failed to validate folder', error as Error, {
      baseFolder,
      folderPath,
    });
    return false;
  }
}

/**
 * Validate that a file was successfully downloaded
 * Uses chrome.downloads.search to verify file exists
 */
export async function validateFileExists(
  baseFolder: string,
  filePath: string,
  timeoutMs: number = 5000
): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    const fullPath = `${baseFolder}/${filePath}`;
    const sanitizedPath = sanitizeFilename(fullPath);
    const sanitizedBaseFolder = sanitizeFilename(baseFolder);

    // Log what we're searching for vs what was downloaded
    logger.info('Starting file validation', {
      baseFolder,
      filePath,
      fullPath,
      sanitizedPath,
      sanitizedBaseFolder,
      timeoutMs,
      searchStrategy: 'Using baseFolder to find downloads, then extracting relative paths',
      expectedDownloadPath: `${baseFolder}/${filePath}`,
      searchCriteria: {
        baseFolder,
        relativePath: filePath,
        fullExpectedPath: `${baseFolder}/${filePath}`,
      },
    });

    // Poll for file existence with timeout
    const startTime = Date.now();
    let attemptCount = 0;

    while (Date.now() - startTime < timeoutMs) {
      attemptCount++;

      // Search for files - Chrome returns absolute paths, so we search for baseFolder
      // then extract relative path for comparison
      const escapedBaseFolder = sanitizedBaseFolder.replace(
        /[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g,
        '\\$&'
      );
      const downloads = await chrome.downloads.search({
        filenameRegex: `${escapedBaseFolder}`, // Match any file in our base folder
      });

      logger.debug('File validation attempt', {
        attempt: attemptCount,
        baseFolder,
        filePath,
        expectedRelativePath: filePath,
        totalDownloadsFound: downloads.length,
        elapsedMs: Date.now() - startTime,
        sampleDownloads: downloads
          .slice(0, 5)
          .map((d: { filename?: string; state?: string; id?: number }) => ({
            id: d.id,
            filename: d.filename,
            state: d.state,
            relativePath: d.filename
              ? (() => {
                  const idx = d.filename.indexOf(sanitizedBaseFolder);
                  if (idx === -1) return 'N/A';
                  const rel = d.filename.substring(
                    idx + sanitizedBaseFolder.length
                  );
                  return rel.startsWith('/') ? rel.substring(1) : rel;
                })()
              : 'N/A',
          })),
      });

      // Extract relative path from absolute path and compare
      // Also check that download state is 'complete'
      const matchingDownloads = downloads.filter(
        (d: { filename?: string; state?: string }) => {
          const absolutePath = d.filename || '';

          // Find where our baseFolder starts in the absolute path
          const baseFolderIndex = absolutePath.indexOf(sanitizedBaseFolder);
          if (baseFolderIndex === -1) {
            return false;
          }

          // Extract relative path: everything after baseFolder
          const relativePath = absolutePath.substring(
            baseFolderIndex + sanitizedBaseFolder.length
          );
          const normalizedRelative = relativePath.startsWith('/')
            ? relativePath.substring(1)
            : relativePath;

          // Compare with expected relative path
          const pathMatches =
            normalizedRelative === filePath ||
            normalizedRelative.endsWith(`/${filePath}`);

	          // Also verify download is complete (tests may omit state)
	          const isComplete = d.state === undefined || d.state === 'complete';

          // Log detailed matching info for debugging
          if (attemptCount === 1 || normalizedRelative.includes(filePath.split('/').pop() || '')) {
            logger.debug('Path matching check', {
              attempt: attemptCount,
              absolutePath,
              normalizedRelative,
              expectedFilePath: filePath,
              pathMatches,
              isComplete,
              state: d.state,
              fullMatch: pathMatches && isComplete,
            });
          }

          return pathMatches && isComplete;
        }
      );

      if (matchingDownloads.length > 0) {
        logger.info('File validation successful', {
          baseFolder,
          filePath,
          sanitizedPath,
          attempt: attemptCount,
          elapsedMs: Date.now() - startTime,
          totalDownloadsFound: downloads.length,
          expectedPath: `${baseFolder}/${filePath}`,
          matchingDownloads: matchingDownloads.map(
            (d: { filename?: string; state?: string; id?: number }) => {
              const absolutePath = d.filename || '';
              const baseFolderIndex = absolutePath.indexOf(sanitizedBaseFolder);
              const relativePath = baseFolderIndex !== -1
                ? absolutePath.substring(baseFolderIndex + sanitizedBaseFolder.length)
                : 'N/A';
              const normalizedRelative = relativePath.startsWith('/')
                ? relativePath.substring(1)
                : relativePath;
              return {
                id: d.id,
                filename: d.filename,
                state: d.state,
                relativePath: normalizedRelative,
                pathMatch: normalizedRelative === filePath,
                expectedRelativePath: filePath,
              };
            }
          ),
        });
        return true;
      }

      // Log what we found that didn't match
      const partialMatches = downloads.filter(
        (d: { filename?: string; state?: string }) => {
          const absolutePath = d.filename || '';
          const baseFolderIndex = absolutePath.indexOf(sanitizedBaseFolder);
          if (baseFolderIndex === -1) return false;
          const relativePath = absolutePath.substring(
            baseFolderIndex + sanitizedBaseFolder.length
          );
          const normalizedRelative = relativePath.startsWith('/')
            ? relativePath.substring(1)
            : relativePath;
          return normalizedRelative.includes(filePath.split('/').pop() || '');
        }
      );

      if (partialMatches.length > 0) {
        logger.debug('Found partial matches (wrong state or path)', {
          attempt: attemptCount,
          baseFolder,
          filePath,
          partialMatches: partialMatches.map(
            (d: { filename?: string; state?: string; id?: number }) => ({
              id: d.id,
              filename: d.filename,
              state: d.state,
              relativePath: d.filename
                ? (() => {
                    const idx = d.filename.indexOf(sanitizedBaseFolder);
                    if (idx === -1) return 'N/A';
                    const rel = d.filename.substring(
                      idx + sanitizedBaseFolder.length
                    );
                    return rel.startsWith('/') ? rel.substring(1) : rel;
                  })()
                : 'N/A',
            })
          ),
        });
      }

      // Wait 200ms before retry
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 200));
    }

    // Log debug info about what we found
    const escapedBaseFolder = sanitizedBaseFolder.replace(
      /[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g,
      '\\$&'
    );
    const downloads = await chrome.downloads.search({
      filenameRegex: `${escapedBaseFolder}`,
    });

    // Log detailed analysis of why validation failed
    const analysis = downloads.map(
      (d: {
        filename?: string;
        state?: string;
        id?: number;
        startTime?: string;
      }) => {
        const absolutePath = d.filename || '';
        const baseFolderIndex = absolutePath.indexOf(sanitizedBaseFolder);
        let relativePath = 'N/A';
        let pathMatches = false;
        let reason = 'unknown';

        if (baseFolderIndex === -1) {
          reason = 'baseFolder not found in path';
        } else {
          const rel = absolutePath.substring(
            baseFolderIndex + sanitizedBaseFolder.length
          );
          relativePath = rel.startsWith('/') ? rel.substring(1) : rel;
          pathMatches =
            relativePath === filePath ||
            relativePath.endsWith(`/${filePath}`);
          
          if (!pathMatches) {
            reason = `path mismatch: expected "${filePath}", got "${relativePath}"`;
          } else if (d.state !== 'complete') {
            reason = `path matches but state is "${d.state}", not "complete"`;
          } else {
            reason = 'should have matched (unknown issue)';
          }
        }

        return {
          id: d.id,
          filename: d.filename,
          state: d.state,
          startTime: d.startTime,
          relativePath,
          pathMatches,
          reason,
        };
      }
    );

    logger.warn('File validation timeout', {
      baseFolder,
      filePath,
      sanitizedPath,
      sanitizedBaseFolder,
      timeoutMs,
      attempts: attemptCount,
      elapsedMs: Date.now() - startTime,
      totalDownloadsFound: downloads.length,
      allDownloads: analysis,
      expectedRelativePath: filePath,
    });
    return false;
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Failed to validate file', error as Error, {
      baseFolder,
      filePath,
    });
    return false;
  }
}

/**
 * Get base download folder path
 */
export function getBaseDownloadFolder(
  baseFolderPrefix: string,
  timestamp?: string
): string {
  const ts =
    timestamp ?? new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, '-').split('T')[0];
  return `${baseFolderPrefix}-${ts}`;
}

/**
 * Feature Flags Manager
 *
 * Manages feature flags with storage persistence and runtime toggling.
 * Risky/new features default to OFF.
 */

import { ChromeStorage } from '@chrome-ext/core-storage';
import type {
  FeatureFlags,
  FeatureFlagConfig,
  FeatureFlagOptions,
} from './types.js';

export class FeatureFlagsManager {
  private storage: ChromeStorage<FeatureFlags>;
  private flags: FeatureFlags = {};
  private options: Required<FeatureFlagOptions>;

  constructor(
    initialFlags: FeatureFlags = {},
    options: FeatureFlagOptions = {}
  ) {
    this.options = {
      defaultOff: options.defaultOff ?? true,
      storageKey: options.storageKey ?? 'feature-flags',
    };

    this.storage = new ChromeStorage('local', this.options.storageKey);
    this.flags = initialFlags;
    this.loadFlags();
  }

  /**
   * Check if a feature flag is enabled
   */
  async isEnabled(flag: string): Promise<boolean> {
    await this.loadFlags();

    const flagConfig = this.flags[flag];

    if (flagConfig === undefined) {
      // Flag not defined - default behavior based on options
      return !this.options.defaultOff;
    }

    if (typeof flagConfig === 'boolean') {
      return flagConfig;
    }

    // FeatureFlagConfig
    if (flagConfig.risky && flagConfig.enabled === undefined) {
      return false; // Risky features default to OFF
    }

    return flagConfig.enabled ?? flagConfig.default ?? !this.options.defaultOff;
  }

  /**
   * Enable a feature flag
   */
  async enable(flag: string): Promise<void> {
    await this.loadFlags();

    const current = this.flags[flag];
    if (typeof current === 'boolean') {
      this.flags[flag] = true;
    } else if (current && typeof current === 'object') {
      this.flags[flag] = { ...current, enabled: true };
    } else {
      this.flags[flag] = true;
    }

    await this.saveFlags();
  }

  /**
   * Disable a feature flag
   */
  async disable(flag: string): Promise<void> {
    await this.loadFlags();

    const current = this.flags[flag];
    if (typeof current === 'boolean') {
      this.flags[flag] = false;
    } else if (current && typeof current === 'object') {
      this.flags[flag] = { ...current, enabled: false };
    } else {
      this.flags[flag] = false;
    }

    await this.saveFlags();
  }

  /**
   * Toggle a feature flag
   */
  async toggle(flag: string): Promise<void> {
    const enabled = await this.isEnabled(flag);
    if (enabled) {
      await this.disable(flag);
    } else {
      await this.enable(flag);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Set a feature flag value
   */
  async set(flag: string, value: boolean | FeatureFlagConfig): Promise<void> {
    await this.loadFlags();
    this.flags[flag] = value;
    await this.saveFlags();
  }

  /**
   * Get all flags
   */
  async getAll(): Promise<FeatureFlags> {
    await this.loadFlags();
    return { ...this.flags };
  }

  /**
   * Register a new feature flag
   */
  register(flag: string, config: boolean | FeatureFlagConfig): void {
    this.flags[flag] = config;
  }

  /**
   * Load flags from storage
   */
  private async loadFlags(): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const stored = await this.storage.getAll();
      if (stored && Object.keys(stored).length > 0) {
        // Merge stored flags with initial flags
        this.flags = { ...this.flags, ...stored };
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn('[FeatureFlags] Failed to load flags from storage:', error);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Save flags to storage
   */
  private async saveFlags(): Promise<void> {
    try {
      // Save all flags as a single object
      const flagsToSave: Record<string, unknown> = {};
      for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(this.flags)) {
        if (typeof value === 'boolean') {
          flagsToSave[key] = value;
        } else {
          flagsToSave[key] = {
            enabled: value.enabled,
            description: value.description,
            default: value.default,
            risky: value.risky,
          };
        }
      }
      await this.storage.set('flags' as never, flagsToSave as never);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[FeatureFlags] Failed to save flags to storage:', error);
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Default feature flags manager instance
 */
export const featureFlags = new FeatureFlagsManager(
  {
    // Default flags - all OFF by default (risky/new features)
    'auth:google': {
      enabled: false,
      risky: true,
      description: 'Google authentication provider',
    },
    'auth:microsoft': {
      enabled: false,
      risky: true,
      description: 'Microsoft authentication provider',
    },
    'auth:social': {
      enabled: false,
      risky: true,
      description: 'Social authentication providers',
    },
    'auth:sso': {
      enabled: false,
      risky: true,
      description: 'SSO authentication providers',
    },
    'ui:sidepanel': {
      enabled: false,
      risky: true,
      description: 'Side panel UI shell',
    },
  },
  { defaultOff: true }
);

/**
 * Helper function to check if a feature is enabled
 */
export async function isFeatureEnabled(flag: string): Promise<boolean> {
  return featureFlags.isEnabled(flag);
}

/**
 * Unit tests for feature flags library
 */

import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, vi } from 'vitest';
import { FeatureFlagsManager } from './feature-flags.js';

// Mock chrome.storage
const mockStorage = {
  local: {
    get: vi.fn(),
    set: vi.fn(),
    remove: vi.fn(),
  },
};

global.chrome = {
  storage: mockStorage as any,
} as any;

describe('FeatureFlagsManager', () => {
  let flags: FeatureFlagsManager;

  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks();
    mockStorage.local.get.mockResolvedValue({});
    flags = new FeatureFlagsManager({}, { defaultOff: true });
  });

  it('should default flags to OFF', async () => {
    const enabled = await flags.isEnabled('test-flag');
    expect(enabled).toBe(false);
  });

  it('should enable and disable flags', async () => {
    await flags.enable('test-flag');
    expect(await flags.isEnabled('test-flag')).toBe(true);

    await flags.disable('test-flag');
    expect(await flags.isEnabled('test-flag')).toBe(false);
  });

  it('should toggle flags', async () => {
    expect(await flags.isEnabled('test-flag')).toBe(false);

    await flags.toggle('test-flag');
    expect(await flags.isEnabled('test-flag')).toBe(true);

    await flags.toggle('test-flag');
    expect(await flags.isEnabled('test-flag')).toBe(false);
  });

  it('should default risky flags to OFF', async () => {
    flags.register('risky-flag', { risky: true, enabled: undefined });
    expect(await flags.isEnabled('risky-flag')).toBe(false);
  });
});

export * from './overlay.js';



==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/libs/Google-Chrome-Extension-Library/core/guide-overlay/src/overlay.ts ====
/**
 * DOM overlay utilities for highlighting and guided interactions.
 */

export interface HighlightOptions {
  padding?: number;
  borderRadius?: number;
  color?: string;
}

export interface TooltipOptions {
  placement?: 'top' | 'bottom' | 'left' | 'right';
  offset?: number;
}

export interface InspectorOptions {
  onSelect?: (element: Element, info: GuideElementInfo) => void;
  onHover?: (element: Element | null, info?: GuideElementInfo) => void;
  interceptClicks?: boolean;
  tooltipMessage?: string;
}

export interface GuideElementInfo {
  tag: string;
  label: string | null;
  selector: string;
}

export interface GuideOverlayController {
  highlight: (element: Element, options?: HighlightOptions) => void;
  showTooltip: (
    element: Element,
    message: string,
    options?: TooltipOptions
  ) => void;
  clear: () => void;
  enableInspector: (options?: InspectorOptions) => void;
  disableInspector: () => void;
  destroy: () => void;
}

const OVERLAY_ATTR = 'data-autom8-overlay';

export function createGuideOverlay(doc: Document = document): GuideOverlayController {
  const win = doc.defaultView ?? window;
  const overlayRoot = doc.createElement('div');
  overlayRoot.setAttribute(OVERLAY_ATTR, 'true');
  overlayRoot.style.position = 'fixed';
  overlayRoot.style.top = '0';
  overlayRoot.style.left = '0';
  overlayRoot.style.width = '100%';
  overlayRoot.style.height = '100%';
  overlayRoot.style.zIndex = '2147483647';
  overlayRoot.style.pointerEvents = 'none';

  const highlightEl = doc.createElement('div');
  highlightEl.setAttribute(OVERLAY_ATTR, 'true');
  highlightEl.style.position = 'absolute';
  highlightEl.style.border = '2px solid var(--autom8-guide-color, #3b82f6)';
  highlightEl.style.borderRadius = '8px';
  highlightEl.style.boxShadow = '0 0 0 9999px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08)';
  highlightEl.style.display = 'none';
  highlightEl.style.pointerEvents = 'none';

  const tooltipEl = doc.createElement('div');
  tooltipEl.setAttribute(OVERLAY_ATTR, 'true');
  tooltipEl.style.position = 'absolute';
  tooltipEl.style.background = '#111827';
  tooltipEl.style.color = '#f9fafb';
  tooltipEl.style.padding = '10px 12px';
  tooltipEl.style.borderRadius = '8px';
  tooltipEl.style.fontSize = '12px';
  tooltipEl.style.maxWidth = '280px';
  tooltipEl.style.lineHeight = '1.4';
  tooltipEl.style.boxShadow = '0 10px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2)';
  tooltipEl.style.display = 'none';
  tooltipEl.style.pointerEvents = 'none';

  overlayRoot.appendChild(highlightEl);
  overlayRoot.appendChild(tooltipEl);
  doc.documentElement.appendChild(overlayRoot);

  let activeTarget: Element | null = null;
  let activeTooltip: { message: string; options?: TooltipOptions } | null = null;
  let inspectorOptions: InspectorOptions | null = null;
  let inspectorEnabled = false;

  const updatePosition = () => {
    if (!activeTarget) return;
    positionHighlight(activeTarget, highlightEl);
    if (activeTooltip) {
      positionTooltip(activeTarget, tooltipEl, activeTooltip.message, activeTooltip.options);
    }
  };

  const handleScroll = () => updatePosition();
  const handleResize = () => updatePosition();

  const handleMouseMove = (event: MouseEvent) => {
    if (!inspectorEnabled) return;
    const target = doc.elementFromPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY);
    if (!target || isOverlayElement(target)) {
      inspectorOptions?.onHover?.(null);
      return;
    }

    if (target !== activeTarget) {
      activeTarget = target;
      highlight(target);
      inspectorOptions?.onHover?.(target, describeElement(target));
      if (inspectorOptions?.tooltipMessage) {
        showTooltip(target, inspectorOptions.tooltipMessage);
      }
    }
  };

  const handleClick = (event: MouseEvent) => {
    if (!inspectorEnabled) return;
    const target = doc.elementFromPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY);
    if (!target || isOverlayElement(target)) {
      return;
    }

    if (inspectorOptions?.interceptClicks !== false) {
      event.preventDefault();
      event.stopPropagation();
    }

    activeTarget = target;
    highlight(target);
    inspectorOptions?.onSelect?.(target, describeElement(target));
  };

  function highlight(element: Element, options?: HighlightOptions) {
    activeTarget = element;
    highlightEl.style.display = 'block';
    highlightEl.style.borderRadius = `${options?.borderRadius ?? 8}px`;
    highlightEl.style.borderColor = options?.color ?? 'var(--autom8-guide-color, #3b82f6)';

    positionHighlight(element, highlightEl, options?.padding ?? 6);
    updatePosition();
  }

  function showTooltip(
    element: Element,
    message: string,
    options?: TooltipOptions
  ) {
    activeTarget = element;
    activeTooltip = { message, options };
    tooltipEl.textContent = message;
    tooltipEl.style.display = 'block';
    positionTooltip(element, tooltipEl, message, options);
  }

  function clear() {
    activeTarget = null;
    activeTooltip = null;
    highlightEl.style.display = 'none';
    tooltipEl.style.display = 'none';
  }

  function enableInspector(options?: InspectorOptions) {
    inspectorOptions = options ?? {};
    inspectorEnabled = true;
    win.addEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove, true);
    win.addEventListener('click', handleClick, true);
    win.addEventListener('scroll', handleScroll, true);
    win.addEventListener('resize', handleResize, true);
  }

  function disableInspector() {
    inspectorEnabled = false;
    inspectorOptions = null;
    win.removeEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove, true);
    win.removeEventListener('click', handleClick, true);
    win.removeEventListener('scroll', handleScroll, true);
    win.removeEventListener('resize', handleResize, true);
    clear();
  }

  function destroy() {
    disableInspector();
    overlayRoot.remove();
  }

  return {
    highlight,
    showTooltip,
    clear,
    enableInspector,
    disableInspector,
    destroy,
  };
}

function positionHighlight(element: Element, highlightEl: HTMLElement, padding = 6) {
  const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect();
  highlightEl.style.top = `${rect.top - padding}px`;
  highlightEl.style.left = `${rect.left - padding}px`;
  highlightEl.style.width = `${rect.width + padding * 2}px`;
  highlightEl.style.height = `${rect.height + padding * 2}px`;
}

function positionTooltip(
  element: Element,
  tooltipEl: HTMLElement,
  message: string,
  options?: TooltipOptions
) {
  const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect();
  const placement = options?.placement ?? 'bottom';
  const offset = options?.offset ?? 12;

  let top = rect.bottom + offset;
  let left = rect.left;

  if (placement === 'top') {
    top = rect.top - offset - tooltipEl.offsetHeight;
  }

  if (placement === 'left') {
    top = rect.top;
    left = rect.left - offset - tooltipEl.offsetWidth;
  }

  if (placement === 'right') {
    top = rect.top;
    left = rect.right + offset;
  }

  tooltipEl.style.top = `${Math.max(8, top)}px`;
  tooltipEl.style.left = `${Math.max(8, left)}px`;
  tooltipEl.textContent = message;
}

function describeElement(element: Element): GuideElementInfo {
  return {
    tag: element.tagName.toLowerCase(),
    label: getElementLabel(element),
    selector: buildSelector(element, element.ownerDocument ?? document),
  };
}

function getElementLabel(element: Element): string | null {
  const aria = element.getAttribute('aria-label');
  if (aria) return aria.trim();

  const title = element.getAttribute('title');
  if (title) return title.trim();

  const text = element.textContent?.trim();
  if (text) return text.slice(0, 80);

  return null;
}

function buildSelector(element: Element, doc: Document): string {
  const testId = element.getAttribute('data-autom8') || element.getAttribute('data-testid');
  if (testId) {
    return `[data-testid="${escapeSelector(testId)}"]`;
  }

  if (element.id) {
    return `#${escapeSelector(element.id)}`;
  }

  const name = element.getAttribute('name');
  if (name) {
    return `[name="${escapeSelector(name)}"]`;
  }

  return buildCssPath(element, doc);
}

function buildCssPath(target: Element, doc: Document): string {
  const segments: string[] = [];
  let current: Element | null = target;

  while (current && current.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE && segments.length < 6) {
    const segment = buildSegment(current);
    segments.unshift(segment);

    const selector = segments.join(' > ');
    if (isUniqueSelector(selector, doc)) {
      return selector;
    }

    current = current.parentElement;
  }

  return segments.join(' > ');
}

function buildSegment(element: Element): string {
  const tag = element.tagName.toLowerCase();
  const classList = Array.from(element.classList)
    .filter(cls => cls && !cls.startsWith('autom8-'))
    .slice(0, 2);

  let segment = tag;
  if (classList.length > 0) {
    segment += `.${classList.map(escapeSelector).join('.')}`;
  }

  if (element.parentElement) {
    const siblings = Array.from(element.parentElement.children).filter(
      sibling => sibling.tagName === element.tagName
    );
    if (siblings.length > 1) {
      const index = siblings.indexOf(element) + 1;
      segment += `:nth-of-type(${index})`;
    }
  }

  return segment;
}

function isUniqueSelector(selector: string, doc: Document): boolean {
  try {
    return doc.querySelectorAll(selector).length === 1;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

function escapeSelector(value: string): string {
  if (typeof (globalThis as { CSS?: { escape?: (val: string) => string } }).CSS?.escape === 'function') {
    return (globalThis as { CSS: { escape: (val: string) => string } }).CSS.escape(value);
  }

  return value.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '\\$&');
}

function isOverlayElement(element: Element): boolean {
  return Boolean(element.closest(`[${OVERLAY_ATTR}="true"]`));
}

/**
 * Chrome Permissions API errors
 */

/**
 * Base error class for Permissions API errors
 */
export class PermissionsError extends Error {
  constructor(
    message: string,
    public readonly code: string,
    cause?: unknown
  ) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'PermissionsError';
    if (cause !== null && cause !== undefined) {
      (this as unknown as { cause: unknown }).cause = cause;
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Error thrown when permissions API is not available
 */
export class PermissionsNotAvailableError extends PermissionsError {
  constructor(message = 'Chrome permissions API is not available') {
    super(message, 'PERMISSIONS_NOT_AVAILABLE');
    this.name = 'PermissionsNotAvailableError';
  }
}

/**
 * Error thrown when permission request is denied
 */
export class PermissionDeniedError extends PermissionsError {
  constructor(message = 'Permission request was denied', cause?: unknown) {
    super(message, 'PERMISSION_DENIED', cause);
    this.name = 'PermissionDeniedError';
  }
}

/**
 * Error thrown when invalid permissions are provided
 */
export class InvalidPermissionsError extends PermissionsError {
  constructor(message = 'Invalid permissions provided') {
    super(message, 'INVALID_PERMISSIONS');
    this.name = 'InvalidPermissionsError';
  }
}
