/**
 * Chrome Extension Permissions API Library
 *
 * Provides type-safe, promise-based wrappers for chrome.permissions.*
 *
 * @module @chrome-ext/core-permissions
 */

export * from './permissions.js';
export * from './types.js';
export * from './errors.js';



==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/libs/Google-Chrome-Extension-Library/core/permissions/src/permissions.ts ====
/**
 * Chrome Permissions API wrapper
 *
 * Provides type-safe, promise-based wrappers for chrome.permissions.*
 *
 * @example
 * ```typescript
 * import { permissions } from '@chrome-ext/core-permissions';
 *
 * // Check if has permission
 * const hasPermission = await permissions.contains({ permissions: ['tabs'] });
 *
 * // Request permission
 * const granted = await permissions.request({ permissions: ['storage'] });
 *
 * // Listen for permission changes
 * permissions.onAdded.addListener((event) => {
 *   console.log('Permissions added', event.permissions);
 * });
 * ```
 */

/// <reference path="./chrome.d.ts" />

import { logger } from '@chrome-ext/core-telemetry';
import { metrics } from '@chrome-ext/core-telemetry';
import type {
  Permissions,
  PermissionsAddedEvent,
  PermissionsRemovedEvent,
} from './types.js';
import {
  PermissionsError,
  PermissionsNotAvailableError,
  PermissionDeniedError,
  InvalidPermissionsError,
} from './errors.js';

/**
 * Simple event emitter for Chrome permissions events
 */
class EventEmitter<T> {
  private listeners = new Set<(data: T) => void>();

  addListener(callback: (data: T) => void): void {
    this.listeners.add(callback);
  }

  removeListener(callback: (data: T) => void): void {
    this.listeners.delete(callback);
  }

  hasListener(callback: (data: T) => void): boolean {
    return this.listeners.has(callback);
  }

  hasListeners(): boolean {
    return this.listeners.size > 0;
  }

  emit(data: T): void {
    for (const listener of this.listeners) {
      try {
        listener(data);
      } catch (error) {
        logger.error('Error in permissions event listener', error as Error);
        metrics.increment('permissions_event_listener_error', 1);
      }
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Chrome Permissions API wrapper class
 */
export class ChromePermissions {
  /**
   * Event emitter for permissions added
   */
  readonly onAdded = new EventEmitter<PermissionsAddedEvent>();

  /**
   * Event emitter for permissions removed
   */
  readonly onRemoved = new EventEmitter<PermissionsRemovedEvent>();

  private initialized = false;

  /**
   * Check if chrome.permissions API is available
   */
  private checkAvailability(): void {
    if (typeof chrome === 'undefined' || !chrome.permissions) {
      throw new PermissionsNotAvailableError();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Validate permissions object
   */
  private validatePermissions(permissions: Permissions): void {
    if (!permissions || (!permissions.permissions && !permissions.origins)) {
      throw new InvalidPermissionsError(
        'Permissions must have permissions or origins'
      );
    }

    if (permissions.permissions && !Array.isArray(permissions.permissions)) {
      throw new InvalidPermissionsError('permissions must be an array');
    }

    if (permissions.origins && !Array.isArray(permissions.origins)) {
      throw new InvalidPermissionsError('origins must be an array');
    }
  }

  /**
   * Setup event listeners
   */
  setup(): void {
    if (this.initialized) {
      return;
    }

    this.checkAvailability();

    // Setup onAdded listener
    chrome.permissions.onAdded.addListener((permissions: Permissions) => {
      metrics.increment('permissions_added', 1);
      logger.debug('Permissions added', { permissions });
      this.onAdded.emit({ permissions });
    });

    // Setup onRemoved listener
    chrome.permissions.onRemoved.addListener((permissions: Permissions) => {
      metrics.increment('permissions_removed', 1);
      logger.debug('Permissions removed', { permissions });
      this.onRemoved.emit({ permissions });
    });

    this.initialized = true;
    logger.info('Chrome Permissions API wrapper initialized');
  }

  /**
   * Check if extension has the specified permissions
   */
  async contains(permissions: Permissions): Promise<boolean> {
    const stopTimer = metrics.startTimer('permissions_contains');
    try {
      this.checkAvailability();
      this.validatePermissions(permissions);

      logger.debug('Checking permissions', { permissions });
      const result = await chrome.permissions.contains(permissions);
      metrics.increment('permissions_contains_success', 1);
      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      metrics.increment('permissions_contains_error', 1);
      logger.error('Failed to check permissions', error as Error);

      if (error instanceof InvalidPermissionsError) {
        throw error;
      }

      throw new PermissionsError(
        'Failed to check permissions',
        'CONTAINS_FAILED',
        error
      );
    } finally {
      stopTimer();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get all permissions granted to the extension
   */
  async getAll(): Promise<Permissions> {
    const stopTimer = metrics.startTimer('permissions_getAll');
    try {
      this.checkAvailability();
      logger.debug('Getting all permissions');
      const permissions = await chrome.permissions.getAll();
      metrics.increment('permissions_getAll_success', 1);
      return permissions as Permissions;
    } catch (error) {
      metrics.increment('permissions_getAll_error', 1);
      logger.error('Failed to get all permissions', error as Error);
      throw new PermissionsError(
        'Failed to get all permissions',
        'GET_ALL_FAILED',
        error
      );
    } finally {
      stopTimer();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Request permissions
   */
  async request(permissions: Permissions): Promise<boolean> {
    const stopTimer = metrics.startTimer('permissions_request');
    try {
      this.checkAvailability();
      this.validatePermissions(permissions);

      logger.debug('Requesting permissions', { permissions });
      const granted = await chrome.permissions.request(permissions);

      if (granted) {
        metrics.increment('permissions_request_success', 1);
        logger.info('Permissions granted', { permissions });
      } else {
        metrics.increment('permissions_request_denied', 1);
        logger.warn('Permissions denied', { permissions });
        throw new PermissionDeniedError('Permission request was denied');
      }

      return granted;
    } catch (error) {
      metrics.increment('permissions_request_error', 1);
      logger.error('Failed to request permissions', error as Error);

      if (
        error instanceof PermissionDeniedError ||
        error instanceof InvalidPermissionsError
      ) {
        throw error;
      }

      throw new PermissionsError(
        'Failed to request permissions',
        'REQUEST_FAILED',
        error
      );
    } finally {
      stopTimer();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Remove permissions
   */
  async remove(permissions: Permissions): Promise<boolean> {
    const stopTimer = metrics.startTimer('permissions_remove');
    try {
      this.checkAvailability();
      this.validatePermissions(permissions);

      logger.debug('Removing permissions', { permissions });
      const removed = await chrome.permissions.remove(permissions);

      if (removed) {
        metrics.increment('permissions_remove_success', 1);
        logger.info('Permissions removed', { permissions });
      } else {
        metrics.increment('permissions_remove_failed', 1);
        logger.warn('Failed to remove permissions', { permissions });
      }

      return removed;
    } catch (error) {
      metrics.increment('permissions_remove_error', 1);
      logger.error('Failed to remove permissions', error as Error);

      if (error instanceof InvalidPermissionsError) {
        throw error;
      }

      throw new PermissionsError(
        'Failed to remove permissions',
        'REMOVE_FAILED',
        error
      );
    } finally {
      stopTimer();
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Factory function to create a ChromePermissions instance
 */
export function createPermissions(): ChromePermissions {
  const instance = new ChromePermissions();
  instance.setup();
  return instance;
}

/**
 * Redaction helpers for PII/PHI and sensitive values.
 */

export interface RedactionProfile {
  enabled?: boolean;
  maskWith?: string;
  email?: boolean;
  phone?: boolean;
  ssn?: boolean;
  creditCard?: boolean;
}

const DEFAULT_PROFILE: Required<RedactionProfile> = {
  enabled: true,
  maskWith: '[REDACTED]',
  email: true,
  phone: true,
  ssn: true,
  creditCard: true,
};

const EMAIL_PATTERN = /[A-Z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Z0-9.-]+\.[A-Z]{2,}/gi;
const PHONE_PATTERN = /(?:(?:\+?\d{1,3}[\s.-]?)?(?:\(\d{3}\)|\d{3})[\s.-]?)?\d{3}[\s.-]?\d{4}/g;
const SSN_PATTERN = /\b\d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4}\b/g;
const CREDIT_CARD_PATTERN = /\b(?:\d[ -]*?){13,19}\b/g;

function mergeProfile(profile?: RedactionProfile): Required<RedactionProfile> {
  return {
    ...DEFAULT_PROFILE,
    ...profile,
  };
}

/**
 * Redact sensitive patterns from a string.
 */
export function redactText(value: string, profile?: RedactionProfile): string {
  const settings = mergeProfile(profile);
  if (!settings.enabled) {
    return value;
  }

  let output = value;
  if (settings.email) {
    output = output.replace(EMAIL_PATTERN, settings.maskWith);
  }
  if (settings.phone) {
    output = output.replace(PHONE_PATTERN, settings.maskWith);
  }
  if (settings.ssn) {
    output = output.replace(SSN_PATTERN, settings.maskWith);
  }
  if (settings.creditCard) {
    output = output.replace(CREDIT_CARD_PATTERN, settings.maskWith);
  }

  return output;
}

/**
 * Redact sensitive values in arrays and objects (string values only).
 */
export function redactObject<T>(value: T, profile?: RedactionProfile): T {
  const seen = new WeakSet<object>();
  return redactAny(value, profile, seen) as T;
}

function redactAny(value: unknown, profile: RedactionProfile | undefined, seen: WeakSet<object>): unknown {
  if (typeof value === 'string') {
    return redactText(value, profile);
  }

  if (value === null || value === undefined) {
    return value;
  }

  if (typeof value !== 'object') {
    return value;
  }

  if (seen.has(value)) {
    return value;
  }

  seen.add(value);

  if (Array.isArray(value)) {
    return value.map(item => redactAny(item, profile, seen));
  }

  const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  for (const [key, entry] of Object.entries(value)) {
    result[key] = redactAny(entry, profile, seen);
  }

  return result;
}

/**
 * Background Service Worker Bootstrap
 *
 * Provides utilities for initializing MV3 background service workers
 * with lifecycle hooks and side panel setup.
 */

import type { BackgroundContext } from './types.js';
import { messageBus } from './messaging.js';
import { logger } from '@chrome-ext/core-telemetry';
import { metrics } from '@chrome-ext/core-telemetry';
import {
  generateCorrelationId,
  setCorrelationId,
} from '@chrome-ext/core-telemetry';

/**
 * Bootstrap background service worker with lifecycle hooks
 */
export function bootstrapBackground(context: BackgroundContext): void {
  // Setup observability
  const correlationId = generateCorrelationId();
  setCorrelationId(correlationId);
  logger.info('Background service worker bootstrapping', { correlationId });

  const shouldSetupMessageBus = context.setupMessageBus ?? true;

  if (shouldSetupMessageBus) {
    // Setup message bus with observability hooks
    messageBus.setObservabilityHooks({
      onMessageSent: (type, _payload) => {
        metrics.increment('message.sent', 1, { type });
        logger.debug('Message sent', { type, correlationId });
      },
      onMessageReceived: (type, _payload) => {
        metrics.increment('message.received', 1, { type });
        logger.debug('Message received', { type, correlationId });
      },
      onError: (error, context) => {
        metrics.increment('message.error', 1, { type: context.type });
        logger.error('Message bus error', error, {
          type: context.type,
          correlationId,
        });
      },
    });

    // Setup message bus
    messageBus.setup();
  } else {
    logger.info('Message bus setup disabled for background', { correlationId });
  }

  // Handle installation
  if (context.onInstalled) {
    chrome.runtime.onInstalled.addListener(async (details: any) => {
      const timer = metrics.startTimer('background.onInstalled');
      try {
        await context.onInstalled!(details);
        logger.info('Extension installed', {
          reason: details.reason,
          correlationId,
        });
      } catch (error) {
        logger.error('Install handler error', error as Error, {
          correlationId,
        });
        throw error;
      } finally {
        timer();
      }
    });
  }

  // Handle startup
  if (context.onStartup) {
    chrome.runtime.onStartup.addListener(async () => {
      const timer = metrics.startTimer('background.onStartup');
      try {
        await context.onStartup!();
        logger.info('Extension started', { correlationId });
      } catch (error) {
        logger.error('Startup handler error', error as Error, {
          correlationId,
        });
        throw error;
      } finally {
        timer();
      }
    });
  }

  // Handle custom message handler
  if (context.onMessage) {
    chrome.runtime.onMessage.addListener(context.onMessage);
  }

  // Handle port connections
  if (context.onConnect) {
    chrome.runtime.onConnect.addListener(context.onConnect);
  }
}

/**
 * Setup side panel behavior (MV3 Chrome 114+)
 *
 * @param options - Side panel configuration
 */
export async function setupSidePanel(options: {
  openPanelOnActionClick?: boolean;
  defaultPath?: string;
}): Promise<void> {
  const stopTimer = metrics.startTimer('sidepanel_setup');

  // Check if sidePanel API is available
  const sidePanel = (
    chrome as unknown as {
      sidePanel?: {
        setPanelBehavior?: (options: {
          openPanelOnActionClick: boolean;
        }) => Promise<void>;
        setOptions?: (options: {
          tabId?: number;
          path?: string;
          enabled?: boolean;
        }) => Promise<void>;
      };
    }
  ).sidePanel;

  if (!sidePanel) {
    logger.warn('Side panel API not available (requires Chrome 114+)');
    metrics.increment('sidepanel_setup_error', 1, {
      error: 'api_not_available',
    });
    return;
  }

  try {
    logger.info('Setting up side panel', {
      openPanelOnActionClick: options.openPanelOnActionClick,
      defaultPath: options.defaultPath,
    });

    // Set default behavior
    if (
      options.openPanelOnActionClick !== undefined &&
      sidePanel.setPanelBehavior
    ) {
      await sidePanel.setPanelBehavior({
        openPanelOnActionClick: options.openPanelOnActionClick,
      });
    }

    // Set default path if provided
    if (options.defaultPath && sidePanel.setOptions) {
      await sidePanel.setOptions({
        path: options.defaultPath,
        enabled: true,
      });
    }

    stopTimer();
    metrics.increment('sidepanel_setup_success', 1);
    logger.info('Side panel setup complete');
  } catch (error) {
    stopTimer();
    metrics.increment('sidepanel_setup_error', 1);
    logger.error('Failed to setup side panel', error as Error);
  }
}

/**
 * Enable side panel for a specific tab
 */
export async function enableSidePanelForTab(
  tabId: number,
  path: string
): Promise<void> {
  const sidePanel = (
    chrome as unknown as {
      sidePanel?: {
        setOptions?: (options: {
          tabId?: number;
          path?: string;
          enabled?: boolean;
        }) => Promise<void>;
      };
    }
  ).sidePanel;

  if (!sidePanel?.setOptions) {
    throw new Error('Side panel API not available');
  }

  await sidePanel.setOptions({
    tabId,
    path,
    enabled: true,
  });
}

/**
 * Open side panel for a specific tab
 */
export async function openSidePanel(tabId?: number): Promise<void> {
  const sidePanel = (
    chrome as unknown as {
      sidePanel?: {
        open?: (options: { tabId?: number }) => Promise<void>;
      };
    }
  ).sidePanel;

  if (!sidePanel?.open) {
    throw new Error('Side panel API not available');
  }

  await sidePanel.open({ tabId });
}

/**
 * Content Script Registration Utilities
 *
 * Provides helpers for ensuring content scripts are loaded and ready.
 */

import { ContentScriptError } from './errors.js';

/**
 * Ping content script to check if it's ready
 */
export async function pingContentScript(
  tabId: number,
  timeoutMs = 15000,
  intervalMs = 250
): Promise<void> {
  const start = Date.now();
  while (true) {
    try {
      const response = await chrome.tabs.sendMessage(tabId, { type: 'PING' });
      if (
        response !== null &&
        response !== undefined &&
        typeof response === 'object' &&
        'ok' in response &&
        response.ok === true
      ) {
        return;
      }
    } catch {
      // Content script not ready yet - ignore
    }

    if (Date.now() - start > timeoutMs) {
      throw new ContentScriptError(
        `Content script ping timeout after ${timeoutMs}ms`
      );
    }

    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, intervalMs));
  }
}

/**
 * Ensure content script is injected and ready
 */
export async function ensureContentScript(
  tabId: number,
  scriptPath: string
): Promise<void> {
  try {
    // Try to ping first
    await pingContentScript(tabId, 1000, 100);
  } catch {
    // If ping fails, inject the script
    try {
      await chrome.scripting.executeScript({
        target: { tabId },
        files: [scriptPath],
      });
      // Wait briefly for script to initialize
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 120));
      // Verify it's ready
      await pingContentScript(tabId);
    } catch (error) {
      throw new ContentScriptError(
        `Failed to inject content script: ${scriptPath}`,
        error
      );
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Wait for tab to be fully loaded
 */
export async function waitForTabLoad(
  tabId: number,
  options: {
    timeout?: number;
    urlTest?: (url?: string) => boolean;
  } = {}
): Promise<void> {
  const { timeout = 30000, urlTest } = options;

  return new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
    const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
      chrome.tabs.onUpdated.removeListener(onUpdated);
      reject(new ContentScriptError('Tab load timeout'));
    }, timeout);

    const onUpdated: Parameters<typeof chrome.tabs.onUpdated.addListener>[0] = (
      id: number,
      info: chrome.tabs.TabChangeInfo,
      tab: chrome.tabs.Tab | undefined
    ) => {
      if (id !== tabId) return;
      const tabUrl = tab !== null && tab !== undefined ? tab.url : undefined;
      const urlTestResult =
        urlTest !== null && urlTest !== undefined ? urlTest(tabUrl) : true;
      if (info.status === 'complete' && urlTestResult) {
        clearTimeout(timeoutId);
        chrome.tabs.onUpdated.removeListener(onUpdated);
        resolve();
      }
    };

    chrome.tabs.onUpdated.addListener(onUpdated);
  });
}

/**
 * Error taxonomy for Chrome Extension operations
 *
 * Defines domain error classes for clear error semantics and disciplined retries.
 */

export class ChromeExtensionError extends Error {
  constructor(
    message: string,
    public readonly code: string,
    public readonly recoverable: boolean = false,
    public readonly cause?: unknown
  ) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'ChromeExtensionError';
    if (
      cause !== null &&
      cause !== undefined &&
      Error.captureStackTrace !== null &&
      Error.captureStackTrace !== undefined
    ) {
      Error.captureStackTrace(this, this.constructor);
    }
  }
}

export class TransientNetworkError extends ChromeExtensionError {
  constructor(message: string, cause?: unknown) {
    super(message, 'TRANSIENT_NETWORK_ERROR', true, cause);
    this.name = 'TransientNetworkError';
  }
}

export class ManifestError extends ChromeExtensionError {
  constructor(message: string, cause?: unknown) {
    super(message, 'MANIFEST_ERROR', false, cause);
    this.name = 'ManifestError';
  }
}

export class MessageBusError extends ChromeExtensionError {
  constructor(message: string, cause?: unknown) {
    super(message, 'MESSAGE_BUS_ERROR', false, cause);
    this.name = 'MessageBusError';
  }
}

export class ContentScriptError extends ChromeExtensionError {
  constructor(message: string, cause?: unknown) {
    super(message, 'CONTENT_SCRIPT_ERROR', false, cause);
    this.name = 'ContentScriptError';
  }
}

export class RuntimeError extends ChromeExtensionError {
  constructor(message: string, code: string, cause?: unknown) {
    super(message, code, false, cause);
    this.name = 'RuntimeError';
  }
}

export class RuntimeNotAvailableError extends RuntimeError {
  constructor(message = 'Chrome runtime API is not available') {
    super(message, 'RUNTIME_NOT_AVAILABLE');
    this.name = 'RuntimeNotAvailableError';
  }
}

import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, vi } from 'vitest';
import { buildManifest, validateManifestConfig } from './manifest-builder.js';
import { ManifestError } from './errors.js';

describe('Manifest Builder', () => {
  describe('buildManifest', () => {
    it('should build a valid MV3 manifest', () => {
      const config = {
        name: 'Test Extension',
        version: '1.0.0',
        permissions: ['storage'],
      };

      const manifest = buildManifest(config);

      expect(manifest.manifest_version).toBe(3);
      expect(manifest.name).toBe('Test Extension');
      expect(manifest.version).toBe('1.0.0');
      expect(manifest.permissions).toContain('storage');
    });

    it('should include side panel when configured', () => {
      const config = {
        name: 'Test Extension',
        version: '1.0.0',
        permissions: [],
        sidePanel: {
          defaultPath: 'sidepanel.html',
        },
      };

      const manifest = buildManifest(config);

      expect(manifest.side_panel).toBeDefined();
      expect(manifest.side_panel?.default_path).toBe('sidepanel.html');
      expect(manifest.permissions).toContain('sidePanel');
    });

    it('should include oauth2 when configured', () => {
      const config = {
        name: 'Test Extension',
        version: '1.0.0',
        permissions: [],
        oauth2: {
          clientId: 'test-client-id',
          scopes: ['openid', 'profile'],
        },
      };

      const manifest = buildManifest(config);

      expect(manifest.oauth2).toBeDefined();
      expect(manifest.oauth2?.client_id).toBe('test-client-id');
      expect(manifest.permissions).toContain('identity');
    });
  });

  describe('validateManifestConfig', () => {
    it('should validate a correct config', () => {
      const config = {
        name: 'Test Extension',
        version: '1.0.0',
      };

      expect(() => validateManifestConfig(config)).not.toThrow();
    });

    it('should throw on missing name', () => {
      const config = {
        version: '1.0.0',
      } as any;

      expect(() => validateManifestConfig(config)).toThrow(ManifestError);
    });

    it('should throw on invalid version', () => {
      const config = {
        name: 'Test Extension',
        version: 'invalid',
      };

      expect(() => validateManifestConfig(config)).toThrow(ManifestError);
    });
  });
});

/**
 * MV3 Manifest Builder
 *
 * Helps build Chrome Extension manifests with proper MV3 structure,
 * optional side panel support, and minimal permissions.
 */

import type { ManifestConfig } from './types.js';
import { ManifestError } from './errors.js';

export interface ManifestV3 {
  manifest_version: 3;
  name: string;
  version: string;
  description?: string;
  action?: {
    default_popup?: string;
    default_title?: string;
    default_icon?: Record<string, string>;
  };
  background?: {
    service_worker: string;
    type: 'module';
  };
  permissions?: string[];
  host_permissions?: string[];
  content_scripts?: Array<{
    matches: string[];
    js: string[];
    css?: string[];
    run_at?: 'document_start' | 'document_end' | 'document_idle';
    world?: 'ISOLATED' | 'MAIN';
    all_frames?: boolean;
  }>;
  side_panel?: {
    default_path: string;
  };
  oauth2?: {
    client_id: string;
    scopes: string[];
  };
  web_accessible_resources?: Array<{
    resources: string[];
    matches: string[];
  }>;
}

/**
 * Builds a Chrome Extension MV3 manifest from configuration
 */
export function buildManifest(config: ManifestConfig): ManifestV3 {
  if (!config.name || !config.version) {
    throw new ManifestError('Manifest requires name and version');
  }

  const manifest: ManifestV3 = {
    manifest_version: 3,
    name: config.name,
    version: config.version,
  };

  if (config.description) {
    manifest.description = config.description;
  }

  // Permissions
  if (config.permissions && config.permissions.length > 0) {
    manifest.permissions = config.permissions;
  }

  if (config.hostPermissions && config.hostPermissions.length > 0) {
    manifest.host_permissions = config.hostPermissions;
  }

  // Background service worker
  manifest.background = {
    service_worker: 'background.js',
    type: 'module',
  };

  // Content scripts
  if (config.contentScripts && config.contentScripts.length > 0) {
    manifest.content_scripts = config.contentScripts.map(cs => ({
      matches: cs.matches,
      js: cs.js,
      css: cs.css,
      run_at: cs.runAt || 'document_idle',
      world: cs.world || 'ISOLATED',
      all_frames: cs.allFrames ?? false,
    }));
  }

  // Side panel (optional)
  if (config.sidePanel) {
    if (!manifest.permissions) {
      manifest.permissions = [];
    }
    if (!manifest.permissions.includes('sidePanel')) {
      manifest.permissions.push('sidePanel');
    }
    manifest.side_panel = {
      default_path: config.sidePanel.defaultPath,
    };
  }

  // OAuth2 (for Google Identity API)
  if (config.oauth2) {
    manifest.oauth2 = {
      client_id: config.oauth2.clientId,
      scopes: config.oauth2.scopes,
    };
    if (!manifest.permissions) {
      manifest.permissions = [];
    }
    if (!manifest.permissions.includes('identity')) {
      manifest.permissions.push('identity');
    }
  }

  // Web accessible resources
  if (
    config.webAccessibleResources &&
    config.webAccessibleResources.length > 0
  ) {
    manifest.web_accessible_resources = [
      {
        resources: config.webAccessibleResources,
        matches: ['<all_urls>'],
      },
    ];
  }

  return manifest;
}

/**
 * Validates manifest configuration
 */
export function validateManifestConfig(config: ManifestConfig): void {
  if (!config.name || config.name.trim().length === 0) {
    throw new ManifestError('Manifest name is required');
  }

  if (!config.version || !/^\d+\.\d+\.\d+/.test(config.version)) {
    throw new ManifestError('Manifest version must be semantic (e.g., 1.0.0)');
  }

  if (config.sidePanel && !config.sidePanel.defaultPath) {
    throw new ManifestError('Side panel requires defaultPath');
  }

  if (config.oauth2 && !config.oauth2.clientId) {
    throw new ManifestError('OAuth2 requires clientId');
  }
}

        response = resp;
      });

      expect(response).toEqual({
        ok: false,
        error: 'No handler for message type: CLEAR_MESSAGE',
      });
    });
  });

  describe('Invalid messages', () => {

      messageBus.setup();

      const listener = messageListeners[0];

      listener({ invalid: 'message' }, {}, (resp: any) => {

        response = resp;
      });

      expect(response).toEqual({
        ok: false,
        error: 'Invalid message format',
      });
    });
  });
});

/**
 * Typed Message Bus for Chrome Extension MV3
 *
 * Provides type-safe messaging between background, content scripts, and UI.
 */

import { MessageBusError } from './errors.js';
import { logger } from '@chrome-ext/core-telemetry';
import { getCorrelationId } from '@chrome-ext/core-telemetry';
import { metrics } from '@chrome-ext/core-telemetry';

export type MessageType = string;
export type MessagePayload = Record<string, unknown>;

export interface TypedMessage<
  T extends MessageType = MessageType,
  P extends MessagePayload = MessagePayload,
> {
  type: T;
  [key: string]: unknown;
}

export type MessageListener<T extends TypedMessage = TypedMessage> = (
  message: T,
  sender: any,
  sendResponse: (response?: unknown) => void
) => boolean | void | Promise<unknown>;

/**
 * Type-safe message bus for Chrome Extension messaging
 */
export class MessageBus {
  private handlers = new Map<MessageType, Set<MessageListener<any>>>();

  // Observability hooks
  private onMessageSent?: (type: MessageType, _payload: unknown) => void;
  private onMessageReceived?: (type: MessageType, _payload: unknown) => void;
  private onError?: (error: Error, context: { type: MessageType }) => void;

  /**
   * Register a message handler
   */
  on<T extends TypedMessage>(
    type: T['type'],
    handler: MessageListener<T>
  ): () => void {
    if (!this.handlers.has(type)) {
      this.handlers.set(type, new Set());
    }
    this.handlers.get(type)!.add(handler);

    // Return unsubscribe function
    return () => {
      this.handlers.get(type)?.delete(handler);
    };
  }

  /**
   * Send a message and wait for response
   */
  async send<T extends TypedMessage, R = unknown>(
    message: T,
    options?: { tabId?: number }
  ): Promise<R> {
    try {
      // Observability hook
      this.onMessageSent?.(message.type, message);

      let result: R;
      if (options?.tabId !== undefined) {
        result = (await chrome.tabs.sendMessage(options.tabId, message)) as R;
      } else {
        result = (await chrome.runtime.sendMessage(message)) as R;
      }

      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      const err = new MessageBusError(
        `Failed to send message: ${message.type}`,
        error
      );
      this.onError?.(err, { type: message.type });
      throw err;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Set observability hooks
   */
  setObservabilityHooks(hooks: {
    onMessageSent?: (type: MessageType, payload: unknown) => void;
    onMessageReceived?: (type: MessageType, payload: unknown) => void;
    onError?: (error: Error, context: { type: MessageType }) => void;
  }): void {
    this.onMessageSent = hooks.onMessageSent;
    this.onMessageReceived = hooks.onMessageReceived;
    this.onError = hooks.onError;
  }

  /**
   * Setup Chrome runtime message listener
   */
  setup(): void {
    chrome.runtime.onMessage.addListener(
      (
        message: unknown,
        sender: chrome.runtime.MessageSender,
        sendResponse: (response?: unknown) => void
      ) => {
        if (
          message === null ||
          message === undefined ||
          typeof message !== 'object' ||
          !('type' in message)
        ) {
          sendResponse({ ok: false, error: 'Invalid message format' });
          return false;
        }

        const type = message.type as MessageType;

        // Observability hook
        this.onMessageReceived?.(type, message);

        const handlers = this.handlers.get(type);

        if (!handlers || handlers.size === 0) {
          const correlationId = getCorrelationId();
          metrics.increment('message_bus_receive_error', 1, { type });
          logger.warn('No handler for message type', { type, correlationId });
          sendResponse({
            ok: false,
            error: `No handler for message type: ${type}`,
          });
          return false;
        }

        // Call all handlers for this message type
        let handled = false;
        const results: unknown[] = [];

        for (const handler of handlers) {
          try {
            const result = handler(message, sender, sendResponse);
            if (result instanceof Promise) {
              result
                .then(value => {
                  results.push(value);
                  if (results.length === handlers.size && !handled) {
                    handled = true;
                    sendResponse({
                      ok: true,
                      data: results.length === 1 ? results[0] : results,
                    });
                  }
                })
                .catch(error => {
                  if (!handled) {
                    handled = true;
                    sendResponse({ ok: false, error: error.message });
                  }
                });
            } else if (result !== undefined) {
              results.push(result);
              if (!handled) {
                handled = true;
                sendResponse({ ok: true, data: result });
              }
            }
          } catch (error) {
            const err =
              error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error));
            this.onError?.(err, { type });
            if (!handled) {
              handled = true;
              sendResponse({
                ok: false,
                error: err.message,
              });
            }
          }
        }

        // Return true to indicate async response
        return true;
      }
    );
  }

  /**
   * Remove all handlers
   */
  clear(): void {
    this.handlers.clear();
  }
}

/**
 * Default message bus instance
 */
export const messageBus = new MessageBus();



==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/libs/Google-Chrome-Extension-Library/core/runtime/src/runtime-api.ts ====
/**
 * Chrome Runtime API wrapper
 *
 * Provides type-safe, promise-based wrappers for chrome.runtime.*
 *
 * @example
 * ```typescript
 * import { runtime } from '@chrome-ext/core-runtime';
 *
 * // Get extension URL
 * const url = runtime.getURL('popup.html');
 *
 * // Listen for install
 * runtime.onInstalled.addListener((details) => {
 *   console.log('Installed:', details.reason);
 * });
 * ```
 */

import { logger } from '@chrome-ext/core-telemetry';
import { metrics } from '@chrome-ext/core-telemetry';
import { RuntimeError, RuntimeNotAvailableError } from './errors.js';

/**
 * Simple event emitter for Chrome runtime events
 */
class EventEmitter<T> {
  private listeners = new Set<(data: T) => void>();

  addListener(callback: (data: T) => void): void {
    this.listeners.add(callback);
  }

  removeListener(callback: (data: T) => void): void {
    this.listeners.delete(callback);
  }

  hasListener(callback: (data: T) => void): boolean {
    return this.listeners.has(callback);
  }

  hasListeners(): boolean {
    return this.listeners.size > 0;
  }

  emit(data: T): void {
    for (const listener of this.listeners) {
      try {
        listener(data);
      } catch (error) {
        logger.error('Error in runtime event listener', error as Error);
        metrics.increment('runtime_event_listener_error', 1);
      }
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Chrome Runtime API wrapper class
 */
export class ChromeRuntime {
  /**
   * Event emitter for extension installed
   */
  readonly onInstalled = new EventEmitter<any>();

  /**
   * Event emitter for extension startup
   */
  readonly onStartup = new EventEmitter<void>();

  /**
   * Event emitter for message received
   */
  readonly onMessage = new EventEmitter<{
    message: unknown;
    sender: any;
    sendResponse: (response?: unknown) => void;
  }>();

  /**
   * Event emitter for connection
   */
  readonly onConnect = new EventEmitter<any>();

  /**
   * Event emitter for connection external
   */
  readonly onConnectExternal = new EventEmitter<any>();

  /**
   * Event emitter for message external
   */
  readonly onMessageExternal = new EventEmitter<{
    message: unknown;
    sender: any;
    sendResponse: (response?: unknown) => void;
  }>();

  /**
   * Event emitter for suspend
   */
  readonly onSuspend = new EventEmitter<void>();

  /**
   * Event emitter for suspend canceled
   */
  readonly onSuspendCanceled = new EventEmitter<void>();

  /**
   * Event emitter for update available
   */
  readonly onUpdateAvailable = new EventEmitter<any>();

  /**
   * Event emitter for browser update available
   */
  readonly onBrowserUpdateAvailable = new EventEmitter<void>();

  /**
   * Event emitter for restart required
   */
  readonly onRestartRequired = new EventEmitter<any>();

  private initialized = false;

  /**
   * Check if chrome.runtime API is available
   */
  private checkAvailability(): void {
    if (
      typeof chrome === 'undefined' ||
      chrome.runtime === null ||
      chrome.runtime === undefined
    ) {
      throw new RuntimeNotAvailableError();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Setup event listeners
   */
  setup(): void {
    if (this.initialized) {
      return;
    }

    this.checkAvailability();

    // Setup onInstalled listener
    chrome.runtime.onInstalled.addListener((details: any) => {
      metrics.increment('runtime_installed', 1);
      logger.debug('Extension installed', { reason: details.reason });
      this.onInstalled.emit(details);
    });

    // Setup onStartup listener
    chrome.runtime.onStartup.addListener(() => {
      metrics.increment('runtime_startup', 1);
      logger.debug('Extension startup');
      this.onStartup.emit();
    });

    // Setup onMessage listener
    chrome.runtime.onMessage.addListener(
      (
        message: unknown,
        sender: any,
        sendResponse: (response?: unknown) => void
      ) => {
        metrics.increment('runtime_message', 1);
        logger.debug('Runtime message received', { sender: sender.tab?.id });
        this.onMessage.emit({ message, sender, sendResponse });
      }
    );

    // Setup onConnect listener
    chrome.runtime.onConnect.addListener((port: any) => {
      metrics.increment('runtime_connect', 1);
      logger.debug('Runtime connection', { name: port.name });
      this.onConnect.emit(port);
    });

    // Setup onConnectExternal listener (if available)
    if (
      chrome.runtime.onConnectExternal !== null &&
      chrome.runtime.onConnectExternal !== undefined
    ) {
      chrome.runtime.onConnectExternal.addListener((port: any) => {
        metrics.increment('runtime_connect_external', 1);
        logger.debug('Runtime external connection', { name: port.name });
        this.onConnectExternal.emit(port);
      });
    }

    // Setup onMessageExternal listener (if available)
    if (
      chrome.runtime.onMessageExternal !== null &&
      chrome.runtime.onMessageExternal !== undefined
    ) {
      chrome.runtime.onMessageExternal.addListener(
        (
          message: unknown,
          sender: any,
          sendResponse: (response?: unknown) => void
        ) => {
          metrics.increment('runtime_message_external', 1);
          logger.debug('Runtime external message', { sender: sender.id });
          this.onMessageExternal.emit({ message, sender, sendResponse });
        }
      );
    }

    // Setup onSuspend listener (if available)
    if (
      chrome.runtime.onSuspend !== null &&
      chrome.runtime.onSuspend !== undefined
    ) {
      chrome.runtime.onSuspend.addListener(() => {
        metrics.increment('runtime_suspend', 1);
        logger.debug('Runtime suspend');
        this.onSuspend.emit();
      });
    }

    // Setup onSuspendCanceled listener (if available)
    if (
      chrome.runtime.onSuspendCanceled !== null &&
      chrome.runtime.onSuspendCanceled !== undefined
    ) {
      chrome.runtime.onSuspendCanceled.addListener(() => {
        metrics.increment('runtime_suspend_canceled', 1);
        logger.debug('Runtime suspend canceled');
        this.onSuspendCanceled.emit();
      });
    }

    // Setup onUpdateAvailable listener (if available)
    if (
      chrome.runtime.onUpdateAvailable !== null &&
      chrome.runtime.onUpdateAvailable !== undefined
    ) {
      chrome.runtime.onUpdateAvailable.addListener((details: any) => {
        metrics.increment('runtime_update_available', 1);
        logger.debug('Runtime update available', { version: details.version });
        this.onUpdateAvailable.emit(details);
      });
    }

    // Setup onBrowserUpdateAvailable listener (if available)
    if (
      chrome.runtime.onBrowserUpdateAvailable !== null &&
      chrome.runtime.onBrowserUpdateAvailable !== undefined
    ) {
      chrome.runtime.onBrowserUpdateAvailable.addListener(() => {
        metrics.increment('runtime_browser_update_available', 1);
        logger.debug('Browser update available');
        this.onBrowserUpdateAvailable.emit();
      });
    }

    // Setup onRestartRequired listener (if available)
    if (
      chrome.runtime.onRestartRequired !== null &&
      chrome.runtime.onRestartRequired !== undefined
    ) {
      chrome.runtime.onRestartRequired.addListener((reason: any) => {
        metrics.increment('runtime_restart_required', 1);
        logger.debug('Runtime restart required', { reason });
        this.onRestartRequired.emit(reason);
      });
    }

    this.initialized = true;
    logger.info('Chrome Runtime API wrapper initialized');
  }

  /**
   * Get the URL for a path relative to the extension
   */
  getURL(path: string): string {
    try {
      this.checkAvailability();
      if (path === null || path === undefined || path === '') {
        throw new RuntimeError('Path cannot be empty', 'INVALID_PATH');
      }
      const url = chrome.runtime.getURL(path);
      logger.debug('Getting URL', { path, url });
      return url;
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('Failed to get URL', error as Error);
      throw new RuntimeError('Failed to get URL', 'GET_URL_FAILED', error);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get the background page (MV2 only, returns null in MV3)
   */
  getBackgroundPage(): Window | null {
    try {
      this.checkAvailability();
      const page = chrome.runtime.getBackgroundPage();
      return page as Window | null;
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('Failed to get background page', error as Error);
      throw new RuntimeError(
        'Failed to get background page',
        'GET_BACKGROUND_PAGE_FAILED',
        error
      );
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get the extension manifest
   */
  getManifest(): any {
    try {
      this.checkAvailability();
      const manifest = chrome.runtime.getManifest();
      return manifest;
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('Failed to get manifest', error as Error);
      throw new RuntimeError(
        'Failed to get manifest',
        'GET_MANIFEST_FAILED',
        error
      );
    }
  }

  /**
   * Set the uninstall URL
   */
  async setUninstallURL(url: string): Promise<void> {
    const stopTimer = metrics.startTimer('runtime_setUninstallURL');
    try {
      this.checkAvailability();
      logger.debug('Setting uninstall URL', { url });
      await chrome.runtime.setUninstallURL(url);
      metrics.increment('runtime_setUninstallURL_success', 1);
    } catch (error) {
      metrics.increment('runtime_setUninstallURL_error', 1);
      logger.error('Failed to set uninstall URL', error as Error);
      throw new RuntimeError(
        'Failed to set uninstall URL',
        'SET_UNINSTALL_URL_FAILED',
        error
      );
    } finally {
      stopTimer();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Open the options page
   */
  async openOptionsPage(): Promise<void> {
    const stopTimer = metrics.startTimer('runtime_openOptionsPage');
    try {
      this.checkAvailability();
      logger.debug('Opening options page');
      await chrome.runtime.openOptionsPage();
      metrics.increment('runtime_openOptionsPage_success', 1);
    } catch (error) {
      metrics.increment('runtime_openOptionsPage_error', 1);
      logger.error('Failed to open options page', error as Error);
      throw new RuntimeError(
        'Failed to open options page',
        'OPEN_OPTIONS_PAGE_FAILED',
        error
      );
    } finally {
      stopTimer();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Send a message
   */
  async sendMessage<T = unknown, R = unknown>(
    message: T,
    options?: { extensionId?: string; targetFrameId?: number }
  ): Promise<R> {
    const stopTimer = metrics.startTimer('runtime_sendMessage');
    try {
      this.checkAvailability();
      logger.debug('Sending runtime message', { hasOptions: !!options });
      const response = await chrome.runtime.sendMessage(message, options);
      metrics.increment('runtime_sendMessage_success', 1);
      return response as R;
    } catch (error) {
      metrics.increment('runtime_sendMessage_error', 1);
      logger.error('Failed to send runtime message', error as Error);
      throw new RuntimeError(
        'Failed to send runtime message',
        'SEND_MESSAGE_FAILED',
        error
      );
    } finally {
      stopTimer();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Send a native message
   */
  async sendNativeMessage(
    application: string,
    message: unknown
  ): Promise<unknown> {
    const stopTimer = metrics.startTimer('runtime_sendNativeMessage');
    try {
      this.checkAvailability();
      logger.debug('Sending native message', { application });
      const response = await chrome.runtime.sendNativeMessage(
        application,
        message
      );
      metrics.increment('runtime_sendNativeMessage_success', 1);
      return response;
    } catch (error) {
      metrics.increment('runtime_sendNativeMessage_error', 1);
      logger.error('Failed to send native message', error as Error);
      throw new RuntimeError(
        'Failed to send native message',
        'SEND_NATIVE_MESSAGE_FAILED',
        error
      );
    } finally {
      stopTimer();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Connect to extension
   */
  connect(connectInfo?: { name?: string; includeTlsChannelId?: boolean }): any {
    try {
      this.checkAvailability();
      logger.debug('Connecting to runtime', { name: connectInfo?.name });
      const port = chrome.runtime.connect(connectInfo);
      metrics.increment('runtime_connect_success', 1);
      return port;
    } catch (error) {
      metrics.increment('runtime_connect_error', 1);
      logger.error('Failed to connect to runtime', error as Error);
      throw new RuntimeError(
        'Failed to connect to runtime',
        'CONNECT_FAILED',
        error
      );
    }
  }

  /**
   * Connect to extension externally (if available)
   */
  connectExternal(connectInfo?: {
    name?: string;
    includeTlsChannelId?: boolean;
  }): any | undefined {
    try {
      this.checkAvailability();

      if (
        chrome.runtime.connectExternal === null ||
        chrome.runtime.connectExternal === undefined
      ) {
        logger.warn('connectExternal not available');
        return undefined;
      }

      logger.debug('Connecting to runtime externally', {
        name: connectInfo?.name,
      });
      const port = chrome.runtime.connectExternal(connectInfo);
      metrics.increment('runtime_connectExternal_success', 1);
      return port;
    } catch (error) {
      metrics.increment('runtime_connectExternal_error', 1);
      logger.error('Failed to connect to runtime externally', error as Error);
      throw new RuntimeError(
        'Failed to connect to runtime externally',
        'CONNECT_EXTERNAL_FAILED',
        error
      );
    }
  }

  /**

   */
  connectNative(application: string): any {
    try {
      this.checkAvailability();
      logger.debug('Connecting to native application', { application });
      const port = chrome.runtime.connectNative(application);
      metrics.increment('runtime_connectNative_success', 1);
      return port;
    } catch (error) {
      metrics.increment('runtime_connectNative_error', 1);
      logger.error('Failed to connect to native application', error as Error);
      throw new RuntimeError(

        'CONNECT_NATIVE_FAILED',

      );
    }
  }

  reload(): void {

      logger.info('Reloading extension');
      chrome.runtime.reload();
      metrics.increment('runtime_reload', 1);
    } catch (error) {
      metrics.increment('runtime_reload_error', 1);
      logger.error('Failed to reload extension', error as Error);
      throw new RuntimeError(
        'Failed to reload extension',
        'RELOAD_FAILED',
        error
      );
    }
  }

  /**
   * Restart the extension (if available)
   */
  restart(): void {
    try {
      this.checkAvailability();

      if (
        chrome.runtime.restart === null ||
        chrome.runtime.restart === undefined
      ) {
        logger.warn('restart not available');
        return;
      }

      logger.info('Restarting extension');
      chrome.runtime.restart();
      metrics.increment('runtime_restart', 1);
    } catch (error) {
      metrics.increment('runtime_restart_error', 1);
      logger.error('Failed to restart extension', error as Error);
      throw new RuntimeError(
        'Failed to restart extension',
        'RESTART_FAILED',
        error
      );
    }
  }

  /**
   * Request update check
   */
  async requestUpdateCheck(): Promise<any> {
    const stopTimer = metrics.startTimer('runtime_requestUpdateCheck');
    try {
      this.checkAvailability();
      logger.debug('Requesting update check');
      const status = await chrome.runtime.requestUpdateCheck();
      metrics.increment('runtime_requestUpdateCheck_success', 1);
      return status;
    } catch (error) {
      metrics.increment('runtime_requestUpdateCheck_error', 1);
      logger.error('Failed to request update check', error as Error);
      throw new RuntimeError(
        'Failed to request update check',
        'REQUEST_UPDATE_CHECK_FAILED',
        error
      );
    } finally {
      stopTimer();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get package directory entry (if available)
   */
  async getPackageDirectoryEntry(): Promise<any> {
    const stopTimer = metrics.startTimer('runtime_getPackageDirectoryEntry');
    try {
      this.checkAvailability();

      if (
        chrome.runtime.getPackageDirectoryEntry === null ||
        chrome.runtime.getPackageDirectoryEntry === undefined
      ) {
        throw new RuntimeError(
          'getPackageDirectoryEntry not available',
          'NOT_AVAILABLE'
        );
      }

      logger.debug('Getting package directory entry');
      const entry = await chrome.runtime.getPackageDirectoryEntry();
      metrics.increment('runtime_getPackageDirectoryEntry_success', 1);
      return entry;
    } catch (error) {
      metrics.increment('runtime_getPackageDirectoryEntry_error', 1);
      logger.error('Failed to get package directory entry', error as Error);

      if (error instanceof RuntimeError && error.code === 'NOT_AVAILABLE') {
        throw error;
      }

      throw new RuntimeError(
        'Failed to get package directory entry',
        'GET_PACKAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_FAILED',
        error
      );
    } finally {
      stopTimer();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get the last error (if any)
   */
  getLastError(): string | undefined {
    try {
      this.checkAvailability();
      return chrome.runtime.lastError?.message;
    } catch {
      return undefined;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get the extension ID
   */
  getId(): string {
    try {
      this.checkAvailability();
      return chrome.runtime.id;
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('Failed to get extension ID', error as Error);
      throw new RuntimeError(
        'Failed to get extension ID',
        'GET_ID_FAILED',
        error
      );
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Factory function to create a ChromeRuntime instance
 */
export function createRuntime(): ChromeRuntime {
  const instance = new ChromeRuntime();
  instance.setup();
  return instance;
}

/**
 * Convenience singleton instance
 */
export const runtime = createRuntime();

/**
 * Chrome Scripting API errors
 */

/**
 * Base error class for Scripting API errors
 */
export class ScriptingError extends Error {
  constructor(
    message: string,
    public readonly code: string,
    cause?: unknown
  ) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'ScriptingError';
    if (cause !== null && cause !== undefined) {
      (this as unknown as { cause: unknown }).cause = cause;
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Error thrown when scripting API is not available
 */
export class ScriptingNotAvailableError extends ScriptingError {
  constructor(message = 'Chrome scripting API is not available') {
    super(message, 'SCRIPTING_NOT_AVAILABLE');
    this.name = 'ScriptingNotAvailableError';
  }
}

/**
 * Error thrown when script injection fails
 */
export class ScriptInjectionError extends ScriptingError {
  constructor(message = 'Failed to inject script', cause?: unknown) {
    super(message, 'SCRIPT_INJECTION_FAILED', cause);
    this.name = 'ScriptInjectionError';
  }
}

/**
 * Error thrown when CSS injection fails
 */
export class CSSInjectionError extends ScriptingError {
  constructor(message = 'Failed to inject CSS', cause?: unknown) {
    super(message, 'CSS_INJECTION_FAILED', cause);
    this.name = 'CSSInjectionError';
  }
}

/**
 * Error thrown when content script registration fails
 */
export class ContentScriptRegistrationError extends ScriptingError {
  constructor(message = 'Failed to register content script', cause?: unknown) {
    super(message, 'CONTENT_SCRIPT_REGISTRATION_FAILED', cause);
    this.name = 'ContentScriptRegistrationError';
  }
}

/**
 * Error thrown when invalid injection target is provided
 */
export class InvalidInjectionTargetError extends ScriptingError {
  constructor(message = 'Invalid injection target provided') {
    super(message, 'INVALID_INJECTION_TARGET');
    this.name = 'InvalidInjectionTargetError';
  }
}

/**
 * Unit tests for Chrome Scripting API wrapper
 */

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';
import { ChromeScripting, createScripting, scripting } from './scripting.js';
import {
  ScriptingNotAvailableError,
  ScriptInjectionError,
  CSSInjectionError,
  ContentScriptRegistrationError,
  InvalidInjectionTargetError,
} from './errors.js';

// Mock chrome API
const mockChrome = {
  scripting: {
    executeScript: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue([{ frameId: 0, result: 'test' }]),
    insertCSS: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue([{ frameId: 0 }]),
    removeCSS: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined),
    registerContentScripts: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined),
    unregisterContentScripts: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined),
    getRegisteredContentScripts: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue([]),
    updateContentScripts: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined),
  },
};

// Setup global chrome mock
(global as unknown as { chrome: typeof mockChrome }).chrome = mockChrome;

describe('ChromeScripting', () => {
  let chromeScripting: ChromeScripting;

  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks();
    chromeScripting = new ChromeScripting();
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    vi.restoreAllMocks();
  });

  describe('executeScript', () => {
    it('should execute script with files', async () => {
      const result = await chromeScripting.executeScript({
        target: { tabId: 123 },
        files: ['script.js'],
      });

      expect(mockChrome.scripting.executeScript).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
        target: { tabId: 123 },
        files: ['script.js'],
      });
      expect(result).toBeDefined();
    });

    it('should execute script with function', async () => {
      const func = () => document.title;
      const result = await chromeScripting.executeScript({
        target: { tabId: 123 },
        func,
      });

      expect(mockChrome.scripting.executeScript).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
        target: { tabId: 123 },
        func,
      });
      expect(result).toBeDefined();
    });

    it('should execute script with function string', async () => {
      const result = await chromeScripting.executeScript({
        target: { tabId: 123 },
        funcString: '() => document.title',
      });

      expect(mockChrome.scripting.executeScript).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
        target: { tabId: 123 },
        funcString: '() => document.title',
      });
      expect(result).toBeDefined();
    });

    it('should throw if no injection method provided', async () => {
      try {
        await chromeScripting.executeScript({
          target: { tabId: 123 },
        });
        expect.fail('Should have thrown');
      } catch (error) {
        expect(error).toBeInstanceOf(ScriptInjectionError);
      }
    });

    it('should throw if invalid target', async () => {
      try {
        await chromeScripting.executeScript({
          target: { tabId: undefined as unknown as number },
          files: ['script.js'],
        });
        expect.fail('Should have thrown');
      } catch (error) {
        expect(error).toBeInstanceOf(InvalidInjectionTargetError);
      }
    });
  });

  describe('insertCSS', () => {
    it('should insert CSS with files', async () => {
      const result = await chromeScripting.insertCSS({
        target: { tabId: 123 },
        files: ['styles.css'],
      });

      expect(mockChrome.scripting.insertCSS).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
        target: { tabId: 123 },
        files: ['styles.css'],
      });
      expect(result).toBeDefined();
    });

    it('should insert CSS with string', async () => {
      const result = await chromeScripting.insertCSS({
        target: { tabId: 123 },
        css: 'body { color: red; }',
      });

      expect(mockChrome.scripting.insertCSS).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
        target: { tabId: 123 },
        css: 'body { color: red; }',
      });
      expect(result).toBeDefined();
    });

    it('should throw if no CSS provided', async () => {
      try {
        await chromeScripting.insertCSS({
          target: { tabId: 123 },
        });
        expect.fail('Should have thrown');
      } catch (error) {
        expect(error).toBeInstanceOf(CSSInjectionError);
      }
    });
  });

  describe('removeCSS', () => {
    it('should remove CSS', async () => {
      await chromeScripting.removeCSS({
        target: { tabId: 123 },
        css: 'body { color: red; }',

        css: 'body { color: red; }',
      });
    });

    it('should register content scripts', async () => {
      const scripts = [
        {
          id: 'test-script',
          matches: ['*://example.com/*'],
          js: ['script.js'],
        },
      ];

      await chromeScripting.registerContentScripts(scripts);

      expect(mockChrome.scripting.registerContentScripts).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        scripts
      );
    });

    it('should throw if no scripts provided', async () => {
      try {
        await chromeScripting.registerContentScripts([]);
        expect.fail('Should have thrown');
      } catch (error) {
        expect(error).toBeInstanceOf(ContentScriptRegistrationError);
      }
    });

    it('should throw if script missing id', async () => {
      try {
        await chromeScripting.registerContentScripts([
          {
            matches: ['*://example.com/*'],
          } as unknown as (typeof scripts)[0],
        ]);
        expect.fail('Should have thrown');
      } catch (error) {
        expect(error).toBeInstanceOf(ContentScriptRegistrationError);
      }
    });
  });

  describe('getRegisteredContentScripts', () => {
    it('should get registered content scripts', async () => {
      const scripts = await chromeScripting.getRegisteredContentScripts();

      expect(
        mockChrome.scripting.getRegisteredContentScripts
      ).toHaveBeenCalledWith(undefined);
      expect(scripts).toEqual([]);
    });

    it('should get registered content scripts with filter', async () => {
      const scripts = await chromeScripting.getRegisteredContentScripts({
        ids: ['test-script'],
      });

      expect(
        mockChrome.scripting.getRegisteredContentScripts
      ).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
        ids: ['test-script'],
      });
      expect(scripts).toEqual([]);
    });
  });

  describe('createScripting', () => {
    it('should create scripting instance', () => {
      const instance = createScripting();

      expect(instance).toBeInstanceOf(ChromeScripting);
    });
  });

  describe('scripting singleton', () => {
    it('should export singleton instance', () => {
      expect(scripting).toBeInstanceOf(ChromeScripting);
    });
  });
});

/**
 * Chrome Extension Scripting API Library
 *
 * Provides type-safe, promise-based wrappers for chrome.scripting.*

export * from './scripting.js';

==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/libs/Google-Chrome-Extension-Library/core/scripting/src/scripting.ts ====
/**
 * Chrome Scripting API wrapper
 *
 * Provides type-safe, promise-based wrappers for chrome.scripting.*
 *
 * @example
 * ```typescript
 * import { scripting } from '@chrome-ext/core-scripting';
 *
 * // Execute script
 * const results = await scripting.executeScript({
 *   target: { tabId: 123 },
 *   func: () => document.title
 * });
 *
 * // Inject CSS
 * await scripting.insertCSS({
 *   target: { tabId: 123 },
 *   css: 'body { background: red; }'
 * });
 * ```
 */

/// <reference path="./chrome.d.ts" />

import { logger } from '@chrome-ext/core-telemetry';
import { metrics } from '@chrome-ext/core-telemetry';
import type {
  ScriptInjection,
  CSSInjection,
  RegisteredContentScript,
  ContentScriptFilter,
  InjectionResult,
  CSSInjectionResult,
} from './types.js';
import {
  ScriptingError,
  ScriptingNotAvailableError,
  ScriptInjectionError,
  CSSInjectionError,
  ContentScriptRegistrationError,
  InvalidInjectionTargetError,
} from './errors.js';

/**
 * Chrome Scripting API wrapper class
 */
export class ChromeScripting {
  /**
   * Check if chrome.scripting API is available
   */
  private checkAvailability(): void {
    if (typeof chrome === 'undefined' || !chrome.scripting) {
      throw new ScriptingNotAvailableError();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Validate injection target
   */
  private validateTarget(target: { tabId: number }): void {
    if (!target || typeof target.tabId !== 'number') {
      throw new InvalidInjectionTargetError('Target must have a valid tabId');
    }
  }

  /**
   * Execute a script in a tab
   */
  async executeScript(injection: ScriptInjection): Promise<InjectionResult[]> {
    const stopTimer = metrics.startTimer('scripting_executeScript');
    try {
      this.checkAvailability();
      this.validateTarget(injection.target);

      // Validate that at least one injection method is provided
      if (!injection.files && !injection.func && !injection.funcString) {
        throw new ScriptInjectionError(
          'Must provide files, func, or funcString'
        );
      }

      logger.debug('Executing script', {
        tabId: injection.target.tabId,
        hasFiles: !!injection.files,
        hasFunc: !!injection.func,
        hasFuncString: !!injection.funcString,
      });

      const results = await chrome.scripting.executeScript(injection);
      metrics.increment('scripting_executeScript_success', 1);
      return results as InjectionResult[];
    } catch (error) {
      metrics.increment('scripting_executeScript_error', 1);
      logger.error('Failed to execute script', error as Error);

      if (
        error instanceof ScriptInjectionError ||
        error instanceof InvalidInjectionTargetError
      ) {
        throw error;
      }

      throw new ScriptInjectionError('Failed to execute script', error);
    } finally {
      stopTimer();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Insert CSS into a tab
   */
  async insertCSS(injection: CSSInjection): Promise<CSSInjectionResult[]> {
    const stopTimer = metrics.startTimer('scripting_insertCSS');
    try {
      this.checkAvailability();
      this.validateTarget(injection.target);

      // Validate that at least one injection method is provided
      if (!injection.files && !injection.css) {
        throw new CSSInjectionError('Must provide files or css');
      }

      logger.debug('Inserting CSS', {
        tabId: injection.target.tabId,
        hasFiles: !!injection.files,
        hasCSS: !!injection.css,
      });

      const results = await chrome.scripting.insertCSS(injection);
      metrics.increment('scripting_insertCSS_success', 1);
      return results as CSSInjectionResult[];
    } catch (error) {
      metrics.increment('scripting_insertCSS_error', 1);
      logger.error('Failed to insert CSS', error as Error);

      if (
        error instanceof CSSInjectionError ||
        error instanceof InvalidInjectionTargetError
      ) {
        throw error;
      }

      throw new CSSInjectionError('Failed to insert CSS', error);
    } finally {
      stopTimer();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Remove CSS from a tab
   */
  async removeCSS(injection: CSSInjection): Promise<void> {
    const stopTimer = metrics.startTimer('scripting_removeCSS');
    try {
      this.checkAvailability();
      this.validateTarget(injection.target);

      logger.debug('Removing CSS', {
        tabId: injection.target.tabId,
        hasFiles: !!injection.files,
        hasCSS: !!injection.css,
      });

      await chrome.scripting.removeCSS(injection);
      metrics.increment('scripting_removeCSS_success', 1);
    } catch (error) {
      metrics.increment('scripting_removeCSS_error', 1);
      logger.error('Failed to remove CSS', error as Error);
      throw new CSSInjectionError('Failed to remove CSS', error);
    } finally {
      stopTimer();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Register content scripts
   */
  async registerContentScripts(
    scripts: RegisteredContentScript[]
  ): Promise<void> {
    const stopTimer = metrics.startTimer('scripting_registerContentScripts');
    try {
      this.checkAvailability();

      if (!scripts || scripts.length === 0) {
        throw new ContentScriptRegistrationError(
          'Must provide at least one script'
        );
      }

      // Validate scripts
      for (const script of scripts) {
        if (!script.id) {
          throw new ContentScriptRegistrationError('Script must have an id');
        }
        if (!script.matches || script.matches.length === 0) {
          throw new ContentScriptRegistrationError('Script must have matches');
        }
      }

      logger.debug('Registering content scripts', {
        count: scripts.length,
        ids: scripts.map(s => s.id),
      });

      await chrome.scripting.registerContentScripts(scripts);
      metrics.increment('scripting_registerContentScripts_success', 1, {
        count: String(scripts.length),
      });
    } catch (error) {
      metrics.increment('scripting_registerContentScripts_error', 1);
      logger.error('Failed to register content scripts', error as Error);

      if (error instanceof ContentScriptRegistrationError) {
        throw error;
      }

      throw new ContentScriptRegistrationError(
        'Failed to register content scripts',
        error
      );
    } finally {
      stopTimer();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Unregister content scripts
   */
  async unregisterContentScripts(filter?: ContentScriptFilter): Promise<void> {
    const stopTimer = metrics.startTimer('scripting_unregisterContentScripts');
    try {
      this.checkAvailability();

      logger.debug('Unregistering content scripts', {
        filter: filter?.ids,
      });

      await chrome.scripting.unregisterContentScripts(filter);
      metrics.increment('scripting_unregisterContentScripts_success', 1);
    } catch (error) {
      metrics.increment('scripting_unregisterContentScripts_error', 1);
      logger.error('Failed to unregister content scripts', error as Error);
      throw new ContentScriptRegistrationError(
        'Failed to unregister content scripts',
        error
      );
    } finally {
      stopTimer();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get registered content scripts
   */
  async getRegisteredContentScripts(
    filter?: ContentScriptFilter
  ): Promise<RegisteredContentScript[]> {
    const stopTimer = metrics.startTimer(
      'scripting_getRegisteredContentScripts'
    );
    try {
      this.checkAvailability();

      logger.debug('Getting registered content scripts', {
        filter: filter?.ids,
      });

      const scripts =
        await chrome.scripting.getRegisteredContentScripts(filter);
      metrics.increment('scripting_getRegisteredContentScripts_success', 1);
      return scripts as RegisteredContentScript[];
    } catch (error) {
      metrics.increment('scripting_getRegisteredContentScripts_error', 1);
      logger.error('Failed to get registered content scripts', error as Error);
      throw new ContentScriptRegistrationError(
        'Failed to get registered content scripts',
        error
      );
    } finally {
      stopTimer();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Update content scripts
   */
  async updateContentScripts(
    scripts: RegisteredContentScript[]
  ): Promise<void> {
    const stopTimer = metrics.startTimer('scripting_updateContentScripts');
    try {
      this.checkAvailability();

      if (!scripts || scripts.length === 0) {
        throw new ContentScriptRegistrationError(
          'Must provide at least one script'
        );
      }

      // Validate scripts
      for (const script of scripts) {
        if (!script.id) {
          throw new ContentScriptRegistrationError('Script must have an id');
        }
      }

      logger.debug('Updating content scripts', {
        count: scripts.length,
        ids: scripts.map(s => s.id),
      });

      await chrome.scripting.updateContentScripts(scripts);
      metrics.increment('scripting_updateContentScripts_success', 1, {
        count: String(scripts.length),
      });
    } catch (error) {
      metrics.increment('scripting_updateContentScripts_error', 1);
      logger.error('Failed to update content scripts', error as Error);

      if (error instanceof ContentScriptRegistrationError) {
        throw error;
      }

      throw new ContentScriptRegistrationError(
        'Failed to update content scripts',
        error
      );
    } finally {
      stopTimer();
    }
  }
}

/**

 *

/**
 * Execution world for scripts
 */
export type ExecutionWorld = 'ISOLATED' | 'MAIN';

/**
 * Injection target
 */
export interface InjectionTarget {
  /**
   * The ID of the tab into which to inject.
   */
  tabId: number;

  /**
   * The IDs of specific frames to inject into.
   */
  frameIds?: number[];

  /**
   * Whether the script should inject into all frames within the tab.
   */
  allFrames?: boolean;

  /**
   * The document IDs of specific documents to inject into.
   */
  documentIds?: string[];

  /**
   * Whether the script should inject into the target of all frames.
   */
  documentIdsAllFrames?: boolean;
}

/**
 * Script injection details
 */
export interface ScriptInjection {
  /**
   * The target into which to inject the script.
   */
  target: InjectionTarget;

  /**
   * The JavaScript files to inject.
   */
  files?: string[];

  /**
   * A JavaScript function to inject.
   */
  func?: () => void;

  /**
   * The arguments to pass to the function.
   */
  args?: unknown[];

  /**
   * The JavaScript code to inject.
   */
  funcString?: string;

  /**
   * The world in which to run the script.
   */
  world?: ExecutionWorld;

  /**
   * Whether the injection should be triggered in the target asynchronously.
   */
  injectImmediately?: boolean;
}

/**
 * CSS injection details
 */
export interface CSSInjection {
  /**
   * The target into which to inject the CSS.
   */
  target: InjectionTarget;

  /**
   * The CSS files to inject.
   */
  files?: string[];

  /**
   * A CSS string to inject.
   */
  css?: string;

  /**
   * The origin of the CSS to inject.
   */
  origin?: 'USER' | 'AUTHOR';
}

/**
 * Content script registration
 */
export interface RegisteredContentScript {
  /**
   * The ID of the content script.
   */
  id: string;

  /**
   * The JavaScript files to inject.
   */
  js?: string[];

  /**
   * The CSS files to inject.
   */
  css?: string[];

  /**
   * Specifies which pages this content script will be injected into.
   */
  matches: string[];

  /**
   * Excludes pages that this content script would otherwise be injected into.
   */
  excludeMatches?: string[];

  /**
   * The list of CSS files to inject into web pages.
   */
  runAt?: 'document_start' | 'document_end' | 'document_idle';

  /**
   * Whether the script should inject into all frames within the tab.
   */
  allFrames?: boolean;

  /**
   * The world in which to run the script.
   */
  world?: ExecutionWorld;

  /**
   * Whether the script should inject into the target of all frames.
   */
  matchOriginAsFallback?: boolean;

  /**
   * Whether the script should inject into the target of all frames.
   */
  persistAcrossSessions?: boolean;
}

 * Content script filter
 */
export interface ContentScriptFilter {
  /**
   * The IDs of the content scripts to filter by.
   */
  ids?: string[];
}

/**
 * Script injection result
 */
export interface InjectionResult {
  /**
   * The frame ID of the frame into which the script was injected.
   */
  frameId: number;

  /**
   * The result of the script execution.
   */
  result?: unknown;

  /**
   * The document ID of the document into which the script was injected.
   */
  documentId?: string;
}

/**

 */
export interface CSSInjectionResult {

   * The frame ID of the frame into which the CSS was injected.
   */
  frameId: number;

  /**
   * The document ID of the document into which the CSS was injected.
   */
  documentId?: string;
}

/**
 * IndexedDB backend for secure storage
 */
const DB_NAME = 'chrome-ext-secure-storage';
const DB_VERSION = 1;
const STORE_NAME = 'encrypted-data';
/**
 * IndexedDB backend implementation
 */
export class IndexedDBBackend {
    db = null;
    initPromise = null;
    async init() {
        if (this.db)
            return;
        if (this.initPromise)
            return this.initPromise;
        this.initPromise = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
            const request = indexedDB.open(DB_NAME, DB_VERSION);
            request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
            request.onsuccess = () => {
                this.db = request.result;
                resolve();
            };
            request.onupgradeneeded = event => {
                const db = event.target.result;
                if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(STORE_NAME)) {
                    db.createObjectStore(STORE_NAME);
                }
            };
        });
        return this.initPromise;
    }
    async get(key) {
        await this.init();
        if (!this.db)
            throw new Error('Database not initialized');
        return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
            const transaction = this.db.transaction([STORE_NAME], 'readonly');
            const store = transaction.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
            const request = store.get(key);
            request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
            request.onsuccess = () => {
                const result = request.result;
                if (!result) {
                    resolve(null);
                    return;
                }
                // Convert ArrayBuffer/Uint8Array back from stored format
                const data = {
                    iv: new Uint8Array(result.iv),
                    ciphertext: new Uint8Array(result.ciphertext),
                    keyVersion: result.keyVersion,
                    createdAt: result.createdAt,
                };
                resolve(data);
            };
        });
    }
    async set(key, data) {
        await this.init();
        if (!this.db)
            throw new Error('Database not initialized');
        return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
            const transaction = this.db.transaction([STORE_NAME], 'readwrite');
            const store = transaction.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
            // Convert Uint8Array to ArrayBuffer for storage
            const stored = {
                iv: data.iv.buffer,
                ciphertext: data.ciphertext.buffer,
                keyVersion: data.keyVersion,
                createdAt: data.createdAt,
            };
            const request = store.put(stored, key);
            request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
            request.onsuccess = () => resolve();
        });
    }
    async remove(key) {
        await this.init();
        if (!this.db)
            throw new Error('Database not initialized');
        return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
            const transaction = this.db.transaction([STORE_NAME], 'readwrite');
            const store = transaction.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
            const request = store.delete(key);
            request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
            request.onsuccess = () => resolve();
        });
    }
    async clear() {
        await this.init();
        if (!this.db)
            throw new Error('Database not initialized');
        return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
            const transaction = this.db.transaction([STORE_NAME], 'readwrite');
            const store = transaction.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
            const request = store.clear();
            request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
            request.onsuccess = () => resolve();
        });
    }
    async keys() {
        await this.init();
        if (!this.db)
            throw new Error('Database not initialized');
        return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
            const transaction = this.db.transaction([STORE_NAME], 'readonly');
            const store = transaction.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
            const request = store.getAllKeys();
            request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
            request.onsuccess = () => {
                resolve(request.result.map(k => String(k)));
            };
        });
    }
}
