/**
 * IndexedDB backend for secure storage
 */

import type { EncryptedData, SecureStorageBackend } from './types.js';

const DB_NAME = 'chrome-ext-secure-storage';
const DB_VERSION = 1;
const STORE_NAME = 'encrypted-data';

/**
 * IndexedDB backend implementation
 */
export class IndexedDBBackend implements SecureStorageBackend {
  private db: IDBDatabase | null = null;
  private initPromise: Promise<void> | null = null;

  private async init(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.db) return;
    if (this.initPromise) return this.initPromise;

    this.initPromise = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const request = indexedDB.open(DB_NAME, DB_VERSION);

      request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
      request.onsuccess = () => {
        this.db = request.result;
        resolve();
      };

      request.onupgradeneeded = event => {
        const db = (event.target as IDBOpenDBRequest).result;
        if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(STORE_NAME)) {
          db.createObjectStore(STORE_NAME);
        }
      };
    });

    return this.initPromise;
  }

  async get(key: string): Promise<EncryptedData | null> {
    await this.init();
    if (!this.db) throw new Error('Database not initialized');

    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const transaction = this.db!.transaction([STORE_NAME], 'readonly');
      const store = transaction.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
      const request = store.get(key);

      request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
      request.onsuccess = () => {
        const result = request.result;
        if (!result) {
          resolve(null);
          return;
        }

        // Convert ArrayBuffer/Uint8Array back from stored format
        const data: EncryptedData = {
          iv: new Uint8Array(result.iv),
          ciphertext: new Uint8Array(result.ciphertext),
          keyVersion: result.keyVersion,
          createdAt: result.createdAt,
        };
        resolve(data);
      };
    });
  }

  async set(key: string, data: EncryptedData): Promise<void> {
    await this.init();
    if (!this.db) throw new Error('Database not initialized');

    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const transaction = this.db!.transaction([STORE_NAME], 'readwrite');
      const store = transaction.objectStore(STORE_NAME);

      // Convert Uint8Array to ArrayBuffer for storage
      const stored = {
        iv: data.iv.buffer,
        ciphertext: data.ciphertext.buffer,
        keyVersion: data.keyVersion,
        createdAt: data.createdAt,
      };

      const request = store.put(stored, key);

      request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
      request.onsuccess = () => resolve();
    });
  }

  async remove(key: string): Promise<void> {
    await this.init();
    if (!this.db) throw new Error('Database not initialized');

    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const transaction = this.db!.transaction([STORE_NAME], 'readwrite');
      const store = transaction.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
      const request = store.delete(key);

      request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
      request.onsuccess = () => resolve();
    });
  }

  async clear(): Promise<void> {
    await this.init();
    if (!this.db) throw new Error('Database not initialized');

    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const transaction = this.db!.transaction([STORE_NAME], 'readwrite');
      const store = transaction.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
      const request = store.clear();

      request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
      request.onsuccess = () => resolve();
    });
  }

  async keys(): Promise<string[]> {
    await this.init();
    if (!this.db) throw new Error('Database not initialized');

    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const transaction = this.db!.transaction([STORE_NAME], 'readonly');
      const store = transaction.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
      const request = store.getAllKeys();

      request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
      request.onsuccess = () => {
        resolve(request.result.map(k => String(k)));
      };
    });
  }
}

/**
 * Integration tests for secure storage module
 * Tests with fake chrome APIs to validate end-to-end behavior
 */

import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, vi } from 'vitest';
import { SecureStorage } from './secure-storage.js';
import { SessionBackend } from './session-backend.js';

// Mock chrome.storage.session
const mockStorage: Record<string, unknown> = {};

global.chrome = {
  runtime: {
    id: 'test-extension-id',
  },
  storage: {
    session: {
      get: vi.fn((keys: string | string[] | null) => {
        if (keys === null) {
          return Promise.resolve(mockStorage);
        }
        const keyArray = Array.isArray(keys) ? keys : [keys];
        const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
        for (const key of keyArray) {
          if (key in mockStorage) {
            result[key] = mockStorage[key];
          }
        }
        return Promise.resolve(result);
      }),
      set: vi.fn((items: Record<string, unknown>) => {
        Object.assign(mockStorage, items);
        return Promise.resolve();
      }),
      remove: vi.fn((keys: string | string[]) => {
        const keyArray = Array.isArray(keys) ? keys : [keys];
        for (const key of keyArray) {
          delete mockStorage[key];
        }
        return Promise.resolve();
      }),
    },
  },
} as any;

// Mock crypto APIs with real-like behavior
let keyCounter = 0;
const keyStore = new Map<string, CryptoKey>();

global.crypto = {
  subtle: {
    digest: vi.fn(async (algorithm: string, data: ArrayBuffer) => {
      // Simple hash simulation
      const view = new Uint8Array(data);
      const hash = new Uint8Array(32);
      for (let i = 0; i < 32; i++) {
        hash[i] = view[i % view.length] ^ i;
      }
      return hash.buffer;
    }),
    importKey: vi.fn(async () => {
      const keyId = `key-${keyCounter++}`;
      const key = { id: keyId } as CryptoKey;
      keyStore.set(keyId, key);
      return key;
    }),
    deriveKey: vi.fn(async () => {
      const keyId = `derived-key-${keyCounter++}`;
      const key = { id: keyId } as CryptoKey;
      keyStore.set(keyId, key);
      return key;
    }),
    encrypt: vi.fn(
      async (algorithm: any, key: CryptoKey, data: ArrayBuffer) => {
        // Simple encryption simulation - just prepend IV and return data
        const iv = new Uint8Array(12);
        crypto.getRandomValues(iv);
        const encrypted = new Uint8Array(data.byteLength + 12);
        encrypted.set(iv, 0);
        encrypted.set(new Uint8Array(data), 12);
        return encrypted.buffer;
      }
    ),
    decrypt: vi.fn(
      async (algorithm: any, key: CryptoKey, data: ArrayBuffer) => {
        // Simple decryption simulation - remove IV and return rest
        const view = new Uint8Array(data);
        return view.slice(12).buffer;
      }
    ),
  },
  getRandomValues: vi.fn((arr: Uint8Array) => {
    for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
      arr[i] = Math.floor(Math.random() * 256);
    }
    return arr;
  }),
} as any;

describe('SecureStorage Integration', () => {

      expect(keys.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(10);

          email: `patient${i}@example.com`,

    });
  });

      vi.mocked(chrome.storage.session.set).mockRejectedValueOnce(

      );
    });

      await storage.set('valid-key', { data: 'valid' });

        keyVersion: 1,

        'Decryption failed'
      );
    });
  });

  describe('Session-only mode', () => {
    it('should use session backend when sessionOnly is true', async () => {
      await storage.init({ sessionOnly: true, passphrase: 'test' });

      const backend = storage as any;
      expect(backend.backend).toBeInstanceOf(SessionBackend);
    });

    it('should persist data in session storage', async () => {
      await storage.init({ sessionOnly: true, passphrase: 'test' });

      await storage.set('session-key', { data: 'session-data' });

      // Verify it was stored in chrome.storage.session
      expect(chrome.storage.session.set).toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
  });

==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/libs/Google-Chrome-Extension-Library/core/secure-storage/src/secure-storage.js ====
/**
 * Secure storage implementation with AES-GCM encryption
 * Supports passphrase-based or OS account secret key derivation
 * HIPAA-compliant storage for PHI data
 */
import { IndexedDBBackend } from './indexeddb-backend.js';
import { SessionBackend } from './session-backend.js';
import { logger } from '@chrome-ext/core-telemetry';
import { metrics } from '@chrome-ext/core-telemetry';
/**
 * Current key version for rotation support
 */
const CURRENT_KEY_VERSION = 1;
/**
 * PBKDF2 iterations for key derivation
 */
const PBKDF2_ITERATIONS = 100000;
/**
 * AES-GCM key length (256 bits)
 */
const AES_KEY_LENGTH = 256;
/**
 * IV length for AES-GCM (96 bits = 12 bytes)
 */
const IV_LENGTH = 12;
/**
 * Secure storage class
 */
export class SecureStorage {
    dataKey = null;
    keyVersion = CURRENT_KEY_VERSION;
    sessionOnly = false;
    backend;
    constructor(backend) {
        this.backend = backend || new IndexedDBBackend();
    }
    /**
     * Initialize secure storage with passphrase or OS secret
     */
    async init(options = {}) {
        const stopTimer = metrics.startTimer('secure_storage_init');
        try {
            this.sessionOnly = options.sessionOnly ?? false;
            // Use session backend if session-only mode
            if (this.sessionOnly) {
                this.backend = new SessionBackend();
            }
            // Derive key from passphrase or OS secret
            if (options.passphrase) {
                this.dataKey = await this.deriveKeyFromPassphrase(options.passphrase);
            }
            else {
                // Attempt to use OS account secret (platform-specific)
                this.dataKey = await this.deriveKeyFromOSSecret();
            }
            const handle = `key-${Date.now()}`;
            metrics.increment('secure_storage_init_success', 1);
            logger.info('Secure storage initialized', {
                sessionOnly: this.sessionOnly,
            });
            stopTimer();
            return handle;
        }
        catch (error) {
            metrics.increment('secure_storage_init_error', 1);
            logger.error('Failed to initialize secure storage', error);
            stopTimer();
            throw error;
        }
    }
    /**
     * Derive encryption key from passphrase using PBKDF2
     */
    async deriveKeyFromPassphrase(passphrase) {
        // Generate salt from extension ID and passphrase
        const salt = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', new TextEncoder().encode(`${chrome.runtime.id}-${passphrase}`));
        // Import passphrase as key material
        const keyMaterial = await crypto.subtle.importKey('raw', new TextEncoder().encode(passphrase), 'PBKDF2', false, ['deriveKey']);
        // Derive AES-GCM key
        return crypto.subtle.deriveKey({
            name: 'PBKDF2',
            salt: new Uint8Array(salt),
            iterations: PBKDF2_ITERATIONS,
            hash: 'SHA-256',
        }, keyMaterial, { name: 'AES-GCM', length: AES_KEY_LENGTH }, false, ['encrypt', 'decrypt']);
    }
    /**
     * Derive encryption key from OS account secret
     * Falls back to extension ID if OS secret unavailable
     */
    async deriveKeyFromOSSecret() {
        // Use extension ID as fallback secret
        // In production, integrate with platform-specific secure storage
        const secret = chrome.runtime.id;
        return this.deriveKeyFromPassphrase(secret);
    }
    /**
     * Encrypt and store data
     */
    async set(key, value) {
        if (!this.dataKey) {
            throw new Error('Secure storage not initialized. Call init() first.');
        }
        const stopTimer = metrics.startTimer('secure_storage_set');
        try {
            // Generate random IV
            const iv = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(IV_LENGTH));
            // Serialize value to JSON
            const plaintext = new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(value));
            // Encrypt with AES-GCM
            const ciphertext = await crypto.subtle.encrypt({ name: 'AES-GCM', iv }, this.dataKey, plaintext);
            // Store encrypted data
            const encryptedData = {
                iv,
                ciphertext: new Uint8Array(ciphertext),
                keyVersion: this.keyVersion,
                createdAt: Date.now(),
            };
            await this.backend.set(key, encryptedData);
            metrics.increment('secure_storage_set_success', 1);
            logger.debug('Secure storage set', { key: this.maskKey(key) });
            stopTimer();
        }
        catch (error) {
            metrics.increment('secure_storage_set_error', 1);
            logger.error('Failed to set secure storage', error, {
                key: this.maskKey(key),
            });
            stopTimer();
            throw error;
        }
    }
    /**
     * Retrieve and decrypt data
     */
    async get(key) {
        if (!this.dataKey) {
            throw new Error('Secure storage not initialized. Call init() first.');
        }
        const stopTimer = metrics.startTimer('secure_storage_get');
        try {
            const encryptedData = await this.backend.get(key);
            if (!encryptedData) {
                stopTimer();
                return null;
            }
            // Check key version for rotation
            if (encryptedData.keyVersion !== this.keyVersion) {
                logger.warn('Key version mismatch, may need rotation', {
                    stored: encryptedData.keyVersion,
                    current: this.keyVersion,
                });
                // Attempt decryption with current key (rotation handled separately)
            }
            // Decrypt
            const plaintext = await crypto.subtle.decrypt({ name: 'AES-GCM', iv: encryptedData.iv }, this.dataKey, encryptedData.ciphertext);
            // Deserialize JSON
            const value = JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(plaintext));
            metrics.increment('secure_storage_get_success', 1);
            logger.debug('Secure storage get', { key: this.maskKey(key) });
            stopTimer();
            return value;
        }
        catch (error) {
            metrics.increment('secure_storage_get_error', 1);
            logger.error('Failed to get secure storage', error, {
                key: this.maskKey(key),
            });
            stopTimer();
            throw error;
        }
    }
    /**
     * Remove data
     */
    async remove(key) {
        const stopTimer = metrics.startTimer('secure_storage_remove');
        try {
            await this.backend.remove(key);
            metrics.increment('secure_storage_remove_success', 1);
            logger.debug('Secure storage remove', { key: this.maskKey(key) });
            stopTimer();
        }
        catch (error) {
            metrics.increment('secure_storage_remove_error', 1);
            logger.error('Failed to remove secure storage', error, {
                key: this.maskKey(key),
            });
            stopTimer();
            throw error;
        }
    }
    /**
     * Clear all data
     */
    async clear() {
        const stopTimer = metrics.startTimer('secure_storage_clear');
        try {
            await this.backend.clear();
            metrics.increment('secure_storage_clear_success', 1);
            logger.info('Secure storage cleared');
            stopTimer();
        }
        catch (error) {
            metrics.increment('secure_storage_clear_error', 1);
            logger.error('Failed to clear secure storage', error);
            stopTimer();
            throw error;
        }
    }
    /**
     * Get all keys
     */
    async keys() {
        return this.backend.keys();
    }
    /**
     * Rotate encryption key
     * Re-encrypts all data with new key
     */
    async rotateKey(newPassphrase) {
        if (!this.dataKey) {
            throw new Error('Secure storage not initialized. Call init() first.');
        }
        const stopTimer = metrics.startTimer('secure_storage_rotate_key');
        try {
            // Derive new key
            const oldKey = this.dataKey;
            if (newPassphrase) {
                this.dataKey = await this.deriveKeyFromPassphrase(newPassphrase);
            }
            else {
                this.dataKey = await this.deriveKeyFromOSSecret();
            }
            // Increment key version
            this.keyVersion++;
            // Re-encrypt all data
            const allKeys = await this.backend.keys();
            for (const key of allKeys) {
                const encryptedData = await this.backend.get(key);
                if (!encryptedData)
                    continue;
                // Decrypt with old key
                const plaintext = await crypto.subtle.decrypt({ name: 'AES-GCM', iv: encryptedData.iv }, oldKey, encryptedData.ciphertext);
                // Re-encrypt with new key
                const value = JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(plaintext));
                await this.set(key, value);
            }
            metrics.increment('secure_storage_rotate_key_success', 1);
            logger.info('Secure storage key rotated', {
                newVersion: this.keyVersion,
            });
            stopTimer();
        }
        catch (error) {
            metrics.increment('secure_storage_rotate_key_error', 1);
            logger.error('Failed to rotate secure storage key', error);
            stopTimer();
            throw error;
        }
    }
    /**
     * Mask sensitive data in logs (PHI protection)
     */
    maskKey(key) {
        // Mask keys that might contain PHI
        if (key.includes('patient') ||
            key.includes('phi') ||
            key.includes('medical')) {
            return `${key.substring(0, 4)}***`;
        }
        return key;
    }
    /**
     * Mask PHI in object for logging
     */
    static maskPHI(obj, options = {}) {
        const maskChar = options.maskChar || '***';
        const maskFields = options.maskFields || [
            'name',
            'email',
            'phone',
            'ssn',
            'dob',
            'address',
            'medicalRecordNumber',
            'patientId',
        ];
        if (typeof obj !== 'object' || obj === null) {
            return obj;
        }
        if (Array.isArray(obj)) {
            return obj.map(item => SecureStorage.maskPHI(item, options));
        }
        const masked = { ...obj };
        for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(masked)) {
            if (maskFields.some(field => key.toLowerCase().includes(field.toLowerCase()))) {
                masked[key] = maskChar;
            }
            else if (typeof value === 'object' && value !== null) {
                masked[key] = SecureStorage.maskPHI(value, options);
            }
        }
        return masked;
    }
}
/**
 * Default secure storage instance
 */
let defaultInstance = null;
/**
 * Get or create default secure storage instance
 */
export function getSecureStorage() {
    if (!defaultInstance) {
        defaultInstance = new SecureStorage();
    }
    return defaultInstance;
}

    deriveKey: vi.fn(),

        },

        patients: [
          { name: 'John Doe', email: 'john@example.com' },
          { name: 'Jane Smith', email: 'jane@example.com' },
        ],
      };

      const masked = SecureStorage.maskPHI(data);
      expect(masked.patients[0].name).toBe('***');
      expect(masked.patients[0].email).toBe('***');
      expect(masked.patients[1].name).toBe('***');
      expect(masked.patients[1].email).toBe('***');
    });

    it('should use custom mask character', () => {
      const data = { name: 'John Doe', email: 'john@example.com' };
      const masked = SecureStorage.maskPHI(data, { maskChar: 'XXX' });
      expect(masked.name).toBe('XXX');
      expect(masked.email).toBe('XXX');
    });

    it('should use custom mask fields', () => {
      const data = { customField: 'sensitive', otherField: 'public' };
      const masked = SecureStorage.maskPHI(data, {
        maskFields: ['customField'],
      });
      expect(masked.customField).toBe('***');
      expect(masked.otherField).toBe('public');
    });

    it('should handle null and undefined values', () => {
      expect(SecureStorage.maskPHI(null)).toBeNull();
      expect(SecureStorage.maskPHI(undefined)).toBeUndefined();
      expect(SecureStorage.maskPHI('string')).toBe('string');
      expect(SecureStorage.maskPHI(123)).toBe(123);
    });
  });

  describe('remove and clear', () => {
    beforeEach(async () => {
      await storage.init({ passphrase: 'test' });
    });

    it('should remove a key', async () => {
      const backend = storage as any;
      backend.backend.remove = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined);

      await storage.remove('test-key');
      expect(backend.backend.remove).toHaveBeenCalledWith('test-key');
    });

    it('should clear all data', async () => {
      const backend = storage as any;
      backend.backend.clear = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined);

      await storage.clear();
      expect(backend.backend.clear).toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it('should get all keys', async () => {
      const backend = storage as any;
      backend.backend.keys = vi
        .fn()
        .mockResolvedValue(['key1', 'key2', 'key3']);

      const keys = await storage.keys();
      expect(keys).toEqual(['key1', 'key2', 'key3']);
    });
  });

  describe('IndexedDB backend', () => {
    it('should use IndexedDB backend by default', () => {
      const storage = new SecureStorage();
      const backend = storage as any;
      expect(backend.backend).toBeInstanceOf(IndexedDBBackend);
    });

    it('should use custom backend when provided', () => {
      const customBackend = new SessionBackend();
      const storage = new SecureStorage(customBackend);
      const backend = storage as any;
      expect(backend.backend).toBe(customBackend);
    });
  });
});



==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/libs/Google-Chrome-Extension-Library/core/secure-storage/src/secure-storage.ts ====
/**
 * Secure storage implementation with AES-GCM encryption
 * Supports passphrase-based or OS account secret key derivation
 * HIPAA-compliant storage for PHI data
 */

import type {
  SecureStorageInitOptions,
  KeyHandle,
  EncryptedData,
  MaskingOptions,
  SecureStorageBackend,
} from './types.js';
import { IndexedDBBackend } from './indexeddb-backend.js';
import { SessionBackend } from './session-backend.js';
import { logger } from '@chrome-ext/core-telemetry';
import { metrics } from '@chrome-ext/core-telemetry';

/**
 * Current key version for rotation support
 */
const CURRENT_KEY_VERSION = 1;

/**
 * PBKDF2 iterations for key derivation
 */
const PBKDF2_ITERATIONS = 100000;

/**
 * AES-GCM key length (256 bits)
 */
const AES_KEY_LENGTH = 256;

/**
 * IV length for AES-GCM (96 bits = 12 bytes)
 */
const IV_LENGTH = 12;

/**
 * Secure storage class
 */
export class SecureStorage {
  private dataKey: CryptoKey | null = null;
  private keyVersion: number = CURRENT_KEY_VERSION;
  private sessionOnly: boolean = false;
  private backend: SecureStorageBackend;

  constructor(backend?: SecureStorageBackend) {
    this.backend = backend || new IndexedDBBackend();
  }

  /**
   * Initialize secure storage with passphrase or OS secret
   */
  async init(options: SecureStorageInitOptions = {}): Promise<KeyHandle> {
    const stopTimer = metrics.startTimer('secure_storage_init');

    try {
      this.sessionOnly = options.sessionOnly ?? false;

      // Use session backend if session-only mode
      if (this.sessionOnly) {
        this.backend = new SessionBackend();
      }

      // Derive key from passphrase or OS secret
      if (options.passphrase) {
        this.dataKey = await this.deriveKeyFromPassphrase(options.passphrase);
      } else {
        // Attempt to use OS account secret (platform-specific)
        this.dataKey = await this.deriveKeyFromOSSecret();
      }

      const handle = `key-${Date.now()}`;
      metrics.increment('secure_storage_init_success', 1);
      logger.info('Secure storage initialized', {
        sessionOnly: this.sessionOnly,
      });
      stopTimer();

      return handle;
    } catch (error) {
      metrics.increment('secure_storage_init_error', 1);
      logger.error('Failed to initialize secure storage', error as Error);
      stopTimer();
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Derive encryption key from passphrase using PBKDF2
   */
  private async deriveKeyFromPassphrase(
    passphrase: string
  ): Promise<CryptoKey> {
    // Generate salt from extension ID and passphrase
    const salt = await crypto.subtle.digest(
      'SHA-256',
      new TextEncoder().encode(`${chrome.runtime.id}-${passphrase}`)
    );

    // Import passphrase as key material
    const keyMaterial = await crypto.subtle.importKey(
      'raw',
      new TextEncoder().encode(passphrase),
      'PBKDF2',
      false,
      ['deriveKey']
    );

    // Derive AES-GCM key
    return crypto.subtle.deriveKey(
      {
        name: 'PBKDF2',
        salt: new Uint8Array(salt),
        iterations: PBKDF2_ITERATIONS,
        hash: 'SHA-256',
      },
      keyMaterial,
      { name: 'AES-GCM', length: AES_KEY_LENGTH },
      false,
      ['encrypt', 'decrypt']
    );
  }

  /**
   * Derive encryption key from OS account secret
   * Falls back to extension ID if OS secret unavailable
   */
  private async deriveKeyFromOSSecret(): Promise<CryptoKey> {
    // Use extension ID as fallback secret
    // In production, integrate with platform-specific secure storage
    const secret = chrome.runtime.id;

    return this.deriveKeyFromPassphrase(secret);
  }

  /**
   * Encrypt and store data
   */
  async set<T>(key: string, value: T): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.dataKey) {
      throw new Error('Secure storage not initialized. Call init() first.');
    }

    const stopTimer = metrics.startTimer('secure_storage_set');

    try {
      // Generate random IV
      const iv = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(IV_LENGTH));

      // Serialize value to JSON
      const plaintext = new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(value));

      // Encrypt with AES-GCM
      const ciphertext = await crypto.subtle.encrypt(
        { name: 'AES-GCM', iv },
        this.dataKey,
        plaintext
      );

      // Store encrypted data
      const encryptedData: EncryptedData = {
        iv,
        ciphertext: new Uint8Array(ciphertext),
        keyVersion: this.keyVersion,
        createdAt: Date.now(),
      };

      await this.backend.set(key, encryptedData);

      metrics.increment('secure_storage_set_success', 1);
      logger.debug('Secure storage set', { key: this.maskKey(key) });
      stopTimer();
    } catch (error) {
      metrics.increment('secure_storage_set_error', 1);
      logger.error('Failed to set secure storage', error as Error, {
        key: this.maskKey(key),
      });
      stopTimer();
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Retrieve and decrypt data
   */
  async get<T>(key: string): Promise<T | null> {
    if (!this.dataKey) {
      throw new Error('Secure storage not initialized. Call init() first.');
    }

    const stopTimer = metrics.startTimer('secure_storage_get');

    try {
      const encryptedData = await this.backend.get(key);

      if (!encryptedData) {
        stopTimer();
        return null;
      }

      // Check key version for rotation
      if (encryptedData.keyVersion !== this.keyVersion) {
        logger.warn('Key version mismatch, may need rotation', {
          stored: encryptedData.keyVersion,
          current: this.keyVersion,
        });
        // Attempt decryption with current key (rotation handled separately)
      }

      // Decrypt
      const plaintext = await crypto.subtle.decrypt(
        { name: 'AES-GCM', iv: encryptedData.iv },
        this.dataKey,
        encryptedData.ciphertext
      );

      // Deserialize JSON
      const value = JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(plaintext)) as T;

      metrics.increment('secure_storage_get_success', 1);
      logger.debug('Secure storage get', { key: this.maskKey(key) });
      stopTimer();

      return value;
    } catch (error) {
      metrics.increment('secure_storage_get_error', 1);
      logger.error('Failed to get secure storage', error as Error, {
        key: this.maskKey(key),
      });
      stopTimer();
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Remove data
   */
  async remove(key: string): Promise<void> {
    const stopTimer = metrics.startTimer('secure_storage_remove');

    try {
      await this.backend.remove(key);
      metrics.increment('secure_storage_remove_success', 1);
      logger.debug('Secure storage remove', { key: this.maskKey(key) });
      stopTimer();
    } catch (error) {
      metrics.increment('secure_storage_remove_error', 1);
      logger.error('Failed to remove secure storage', error as Error, {
        key: this.maskKey(key),
      });
      stopTimer();
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Clear all data
   */
  async clear(): Promise<void> {
    const stopTimer = metrics.startTimer('secure_storage_clear');

    try {
      await this.backend.clear();
      metrics.increment('secure_storage_clear_success', 1);
      logger.info('Secure storage cleared');
      stopTimer();
    } catch (error) {
      metrics.increment('secure_storage_clear_error', 1);
      logger.error('Failed to clear secure storage', error as Error);
      stopTimer();
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get all keys
   */
  async keys(): Promise<string[]> {
    return this.backend.keys();
  }

  /**
   * Rotate encryption key
   * Re-encrypts all data with new key
   */
  async rotateKey(newPassphrase?: string): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.dataKey) {
      throw new Error('Secure storage not initialized. Call init() first.');
    }

    const stopTimer = metrics.startTimer('secure_storage_rotate_key');

    try {
      // Derive new key
      const oldKey = this.dataKey;
      if (newPassphrase) {
        this.dataKey = await this.deriveKeyFromPassphrase(newPassphrase);
      } else {
        this.dataKey = await this.deriveKeyFromOSSecret();
      }

      // Increment key version
      this.keyVersion++;

      // Re-encrypt all data
      const allKeys = await this.backend.keys();
      for (const key of allKeys) {
        const encryptedData = await this.backend.get(key);
        if (!encryptedData) continue;

        // Decrypt with old key
        const plaintext = await crypto.subtle.decrypt(
          { name: 'AES-GCM', iv: encryptedData.iv },
          oldKey,
          encryptedData.ciphertext
        );

        // Re-encrypt with new key
        const value = JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(plaintext));
        await this.set(key, value);
      }

      metrics.increment('secure_storage_rotate_key_success', 1);
      logger.info('Secure storage key rotated', {
        newVersion: this.keyVersion,
      });
      stopTimer();
    } catch (error) {
      metrics.increment('secure_storage_rotate_key_error', 1);
      logger.error('Failed to rotate secure storage key', error as Error);
      stopTimer();
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Mask sensitive data in logs (PHI protection)
   */
  private maskKey(key: string): string {
    // Mask keys that might contain PHI
    if (
      key.includes('patient') ||
      key.includes('phi') ||
      key.includes('medical')
    ) {
      return `${key.substring(0, 4)}***`;
    }
    return key;
  }

  /**
   * Mask PHI in object for logging
   */
  static maskPHI<T>(obj: T, options: MaskingOptions = {}): T {
    const maskChar = options.maskChar || '***';
    const maskFields = options.maskFields || [
      'name',
      'email',
      'phone',
      'ssn',
      'dob',
      'address',
      'medicalRecordNumber',
      'patientId',
    ];

    if (typeof obj !== 'object' || obj === null) {
      return obj;
    }

    if (Array.isArray(obj)) {
      return obj.map(item => SecureStorage.maskPHI(item, options)) as T;
    }

    const masked = { ...obj } as Record<string, unknown>;
    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(masked)) {
      if (
        maskFields.some(field =>
          key.toLowerCase().includes(field.toLowerCase())
        )
      ) {
        masked[key] = maskChar;
      } else if (typeof value === 'object' && value !== null) {
        masked[key] = SecureStorage.maskPHI(value, options);
      }
    }

    return masked as T;
  }
}

/**
 * Default secure storage instance
 */
let defaultInstance: SecureStorage | null = null;

/**
 * Get or create default secure storage instance
 */
export function getSecureStorage(): SecureStorage {
  if (!defaultInstance) {
    defaultInstance = new SecureStorage();
  }
  return defaultInstance;
}

/**
 * Session-only backend using chrome.storage.session
 * Data is cleared when browser session ends
 */
/**
 * Session-only backend implementation
 * Uses chrome.storage.session which is cleared on browser restart
 */
export class SessionBackend {
    prefix = 'secure:';
    getKey(key) {
        return `${this.prefix}${key}`;
    }
    async get(key) {
        const storageKey = this.getKey(key);
        const result = await chrome.storage.session.get([storageKey]);
        const data = result[storageKey];
        if (!data)
            return null;
        // Convert stored format back to EncryptedData
        return {
            iv: new Uint8Array(data.iv),
            ciphertext: new Uint8Array(data.ciphertext),
            keyVersion: data.keyVersion,
            createdAt: data.createdAt,
        };
    }
    async set(key, data) {
        const storageKey = this.getKey(key);
        // Convert Uint8Array to Array for storage
        await chrome.storage.session.set({
            [storageKey]: {
                iv: Array.from(data.iv),
                ciphertext: Array.from(data.ciphertext),
                keyVersion: data.keyVersion,
                createdAt: data.createdAt,
            },
        });
    }
    async remove(key) {
        const storageKey = this.getKey(key);
        await chrome.storage.session.remove([storageKey]);
    }
    async clear() {
        const all = await chrome.storage.session.get(null);
        const keys = Object.keys(all).filter(k => k.startsWith(this.prefix));
        if (keys.length > 0) {
            await chrome.storage.session.remove(keys);
        }
    }
    async keys() {
        const all = await chrome.storage.session.get(null);
        return Object.keys(all)
            .filter(k => k.startsWith(this.prefix))
            .map(k => k.slice(this.prefix.length));
    }
}

/**
 * Session-only backend using chrome.storage.session
 * Data is cleared when browser session ends
 */

import type { EncryptedData, SecureStorageBackend } from './types.js';

/**
 * Session-only backend implementation
 * Uses chrome.storage.session which is cleared on browser restart
 */
export class SessionBackend implements SecureStorageBackend {
  private readonly prefix = 'secure:';

  private getKey(key: string): string {
    return `${this.prefix}${key}`;
  }

  async get(key: string): Promise<EncryptedData | null> {
    const storageKey = this.getKey(key);
    const result = await chrome.storage.session.get([storageKey]);
    const data = result[storageKey];

    if (!data) return null;

    // Convert stored format back to EncryptedData
    return {
      iv: new Uint8Array(data.iv),
      ciphertext: new Uint8Array(data.ciphertext),
      keyVersion: data.keyVersion,
      createdAt: data.createdAt,
    };
  }

  async set(key: string, data: EncryptedData): Promise<void> {
    const storageKey = this.getKey(key);

    // Convert Uint8Array to Array for storage
    await chrome.storage.session.set({
      [storageKey]: {
        iv: Array.from(data.iv),
        ciphertext: Array.from(data.ciphertext),
        keyVersion: data.keyVersion,
        createdAt: data.createdAt,
      },
    });
  }

  async remove(key: string): Promise<void> {
    const storageKey = this.getKey(key);
    await chrome.storage.session.remove([storageKey]);
  }

  async clear(): Promise<void> {
    const all = await chrome.storage.session.get(null);
    const keys = Object.keys(all).filter(k => k.startsWith(this.prefix));
    if (keys.length > 0) {
      await chrome.storage.session.remove(keys);
    }
  }

  async keys(): Promise<string[]> {
    const all = await chrome.storage.session.get(null);
    return Object.keys(all)
      .filter(k => k.startsWith(this.prefix))
      .map(k => k.slice(this.prefix.length));
  }
}

/**
 * Types for secure storage module
 */

/**
 * Secure storage initialization options
 */
export interface SecureStorageInitOptions {
  /**
   * User-provided passphrase for key derivation
   * If not provided, will attempt to use OS account secret
   */
  passphrase?: string;

  /**
   * Enable session-only mode (data not persisted across browser restarts)
   * Default: false
   */
  sessionOnly?: boolean;
}

/**
 * Secure storage key handle (opaque identifier)
 */
export type KeyHandle = string;

/**
 * Encrypted data structure stored in IndexedDB
 */
export interface EncryptedData {
  /** Initialization vector (96 bits for AES-GCM) */
  iv: Uint8Array;
  /** Encrypted ciphertext */
  ciphertext: Uint8Array;
  /** Key version for rotation support */
  keyVersion: number;
  /** Timestamp when data was encrypted */
  createdAt: number;
}

/**
 * PHI masking options
 */
export interface MaskingOptions {
  /** Fields to mask in logs */
  maskFields?: string[];
  /** Replacement string for masked values */
  maskChar?: string;
}

/**
 * Secure storage backend interface
 */
export interface SecureStorageBackend {
  get(key: string): Promise<EncryptedData | null>;
  set(key: string, data: EncryptedData): Promise<void>;
  remove(key: string): Promise<void>;
  clear(): Promise<void>;
  keys(): Promise<string[]>;
}

/**
 * Chrome Side Panel API errors
 */

/**
 * Base error class for Side Panel API errors
 */
export class SidePanelError extends Error {
  constructor(
    message: string,
    public readonly code: string,
    cause?: unknown
  ) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'SidePanelError';
    if (cause !== null && cause !== undefined) {
      (this as unknown as { cause: unknown }).cause = cause;
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Error thrown when side panel API is not available
 */
export class SidePanelNotAvailableError extends SidePanelError {
  constructor(
    message = 'Chrome side panel API is not available (requires Chrome 114+)'
  ) {
    super(message, 'SIDE_PANEL_NOT_AVAILABLE');
    this.name = 'SidePanelNotAvailableError';
  }
}

/**
 * Error thrown when side panel operation fails
 */
export class SidePanelOperationError extends SidePanelError {
  constructor(message: string, cause?: unknown) {
    super(message, 'SIDE_PANEL_OPERATION_FAILED', cause);
    this.name = 'SidePanelOperationError';
  }
}

/**
 * Unit tests for Chrome Side Panel API wrapper
 */

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';
import { ChromeSidePanel, createSidePanel, sidePanel } from './sidePanel.js';
import { SidePanelNotAvailableError } from './errors.js';

// Mock chrome API
const mockChrome = {
  sidePanel: {
    setOptions: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined),
    getOptions: vi
      .fn()
      .mockResolvedValue({ path: 'sidepanel/index.html', enabled: true }),
    setPanelBehavior: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined),
    open: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined),
    close: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined),
  },

(global as unknown as { chrome: typeof mockChrome }).chrome = mockChrome;

  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks();
    chromeSidePanel = new ChromeSidePanel();
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    vi.restoreAllMocks();
  });

  describe('setup', () => {
    it('should setup successfully', () => {
      chromeSidePanel.setup();
      expect(chromeSidePanel).toBeInstanceOf(ChromeSidePanel);
    });

    it('should not setup twice', () => {
      chromeSidePanel.setup();
      chromeSidePanel.setup();
      // Should not throw
      expect(chromeSidePanel).toBeInstanceOf(ChromeSidePanel);
    });
  });

  describe('setOptions', () => {
    it('should set options', async () => {
      chromeSidePanel.setup();
      await chromeSidePanel.setOptions({ path: 'sidepanel/index.html' });

      expect(mockChrome.sidePanel.setOptions).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
        path: 'sidepanel/index.html',
      });
    });

    it('should set options with tabId', async () => {
      chromeSidePanel.setup();
      await chromeSidePanel.setOptions({
        tabId: 123,
        path: 'sidepanel/index.html',
      });

      expect(mockChrome.sidePanel.setOptions).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
        tabId: 123,
        path: 'sidepanel/index.html',
      });
    });

    it('should throw if API not available', async () => {
      (global as unknown as { chrome: any }).chrome = {};

      try {
        await chromeSidePanel.setOptions({ path: 'sidepanel/index.html' });
        expect.fail('Should have thrown');
      } catch (error) {
        expect(error).toBeInstanceOf(SidePanelNotAvailableError);
      }
    });
  });

  describe('getOptions', () => {
    it('should get options', async () => {
      chromeSidePanel.setup();
      const options = await chromeSidePanel.getOptions();

      expect(mockChrome.sidePanel.getOptions).toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(options).toEqual({ path: 'sidepanel/index.html', enabled: true });
    });

    it('should get options for tab', async () => {
      chromeSidePanel.setup();
      await chromeSidePanel.getOptions(123);

      expect(mockChrome.sidePanel.getOptions).toHaveBeenCalledWith(123);
    });
  });

  describe('setPanelBehavior', () => {
    it('should set panel behavior', async () => {
      chromeSidePanel.setup();
      await chromeSidePanel.setPanelBehavior({ openPanelOnActionClick: true });

      expect(mockChrome.sidePanel.setPanelBehavior).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
        openPanelOnActionClick: true,
      });
    });
  });

  describe('open', () => {

      chromeSidePanel.setup();
      await chromeSidePanel.open();

      expect(mockChrome.sidePanel.open).toHaveBeenCalledWith(undefined);
    });

    it('should open side panel for tab', async () => {
      chromeSidePanel.setup();
      await chromeSidePanel.open({ tabId: 123 });

      expect(mockChrome.sidePanel.open).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ tabId: 123 });
    });
  });

      expect(mockChrome.sidePanel.close).toHaveBeenCalledWith(undefined);
    });

/**
 * Chrome Extension Side Panel API Library
 *
 * Provides type-safe, promise-based wrappers for chrome.sidePanel.*
 *
 * @module @chrome-ext/core-sidePanel
 */

export * from './sidePanel.js';
export * from './types.js';
export * from './errors.js';



==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/libs/Google-Chrome-Extension-Library/core/sidePanel/src/sidePanel.ts ====
/**
 * Chrome Side Panel API wrapper
 *
 * Provides type-safe, promise-based wrappers for chrome.sidePanel.*
 *
 * @example
 * ```typescript
 * import { sidePanel } from '@chrome-ext/core-sidePanel';
 *
 * // Set default options
 * await sidePanel.setOptions({ path: 'sidepanel/index.html' });
 *
 * // Open side panel
 * await sidePanel.open({ tabId: 123 });
 * ```
 */

import { logger } from '@chrome-ext/core-telemetry';
import { metrics } from '@chrome-ext/core-telemetry';
import type {
  SetOptions,
  SetPanelBehaviorOptions,
  OpenOptions,
} from './types.js';
import {
  SidePanelNotAvailableError,
  SidePanelOperationError,
} from './errors.js';

/**
 * Chrome Side Panel API wrapper class
 */
export class ChromeSidePanel {
  private initialized = false;

  /**
   * Check if chrome.sidePanel API is available
   */
  private checkAvailability(): void {
    if (
      typeof chrome === 'undefined' ||
      chrome.sidePanel === null ||
      chrome.sidePanel === undefined
    ) {
      throw new SidePanelNotAvailableError();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Setup (no-op for side panel, but kept for consistency)
   */
  setup(): void {
    if (this.initialized) {
      return;
    }

    this.checkAvailability();
    this.initialized = true;
    logger.info('Chrome Side Panel API wrapper initialized');
  }

  /**
   * Set side panel options
   */
  async setOptions(options: SetOptions): Promise<void> {
    const stopTimer = metrics.startTimer('sidepanel_setOptions');
    try {
      this.checkAvailability();

      if (
        chrome.sidePanel.setOptions === null ||
        chrome.sidePanel.setOptions === undefined
      ) {
        throw new SidePanelNotAvailableError('setOptions not available');
      }

      logger.debug('Setting side panel options', {
        tabId: options.tabId,
        path: options.path,
      });
      await chrome.sidePanel.setOptions(options);
      metrics.increment('sidepanel_setOptions_success', 1);
    } catch (error) {
      metrics.increment('sidepanel_setOptions_error', 1);
      logger.error('Failed to set side panel options', error as Error);

      if (error instanceof SidePanelNotAvailableError) {
        throw error;
      }

      throw new SidePanelOperationError(
        'Failed to set side panel options',
        error
      );
    } finally {
      stopTimer();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get side panel options
   */
  async getOptions(tabId?: number): Promise<SetOptions> {
    const stopTimer = metrics.startTimer('sidepanel_getOptions');
    try {
      this.checkAvailability();

      if (
        chrome.sidePanel.getOptions === null ||
        chrome.sidePanel.getOptions === undefined
      ) {
        throw new SidePanelNotAvailableError('getOptions not available');
      }

      logger.debug('Getting side panel options', { tabId });
      const options = await chrome.sidePanel.getOptions(tabId);
      metrics.increment('sidepanel_getOptions_success', 1);
      return options as SetOptions;
    } catch (error) {
      metrics.increment('sidepanel_getOptions_error', 1);
      logger.error('Failed to get side panel options', error as Error);

      if (error instanceof SidePanelNotAvailableError) {
        throw error;
      }

      throw new SidePanelOperationError(
        'Failed to get side panel options',
        error
      );
    } finally {
      stopTimer();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Set panel behavior
   */
  async setPanelBehavior(options: SetPanelBehaviorOptions): Promise<void> {
    const stopTimer = metrics.startTimer('sidepanel_setPanelBehavior');
    try {
      this.checkAvailability();

      if (
        chrome.sidePanel.setPanelBehavior === null ||
        chrome.sidePanel.setPanelBehavior === undefined
      ) {
        throw new SidePanelNotAvailableError('setPanelBehavior not available');
      }

      logger.debug('Setting side panel behavior', {
        openPanelOnActionClick: options.openPanelOnActionClick,
      });
      await chrome.sidePanel.setPanelBehavior(options);
      metrics.increment('sidepanel_setPanelBehavior_success', 1);
    } catch (error) {
      metrics.increment('sidepanel_setPanelBehavior_error', 1);
      logger.error('Failed to set side panel behavior', error as Error);

      if (error instanceof SidePanelNotAvailableError) {
        throw error;
      }

      throw new SidePanelOperationError(
        'Failed to set side panel behavior',
        error
      );
    } finally {
      stopTimer();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Open side panel
   */
  async open(options?: OpenOptions): Promise<void> {
    const stopTimer = metrics.startTimer('sidepanel_open');
    try {
      this.checkAvailability();

      if (
        chrome.sidePanel.open === null ||
        chrome.sidePanel.open === undefined
      ) {
        throw new SidePanelNotAvailableError('open not available');
      }

      logger.debug('Opening side panel', { tabId: options?.tabId });
      await chrome.sidePanel.open(options);
      metrics.increment('sidepanel_open_success', 1);
    } catch (error) {
      metrics.increment('sidepanel_open_error', 1);
      logger.error('Failed to open side panel', error as Error);

      if (error instanceof SidePanelNotAvailableError) {
        throw error;
      }

      throw new SidePanelOperationError('Failed to open side panel', error);
    } finally {
      stopTimer();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Close side panel (if available)
   */
  async close(tabId?: number): Promise<void> {
    const stopTimer = metrics.startTimer('sidepanel_close');
    try {
      this.checkAvailability();

      if (
        chrome.sidePanel.close === null ||
        chrome.sidePanel.close === undefined
      ) {
        logger.warn('close not available in this Chrome version');
        return;
      }

      logger.debug('Closing side panel', { tabId });
      await chrome.sidePanel.close(tabId);
      metrics.increment('sidepanel_close_success', 1);
    } catch (error) {
      metrics.increment('sidepanel_close_error', 1);
      logger.error('Failed to close side panel', error as Error);
      throw new SidePanelOperationError('Failed to close side panel', error);
    } finally {
      stopTimer();
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Factory function to create a ChromeSidePanel instance
 */
export function createSidePanel(): ChromeSidePanel {
  const instance = new ChromeSidePanel();
  instance.setup();
  return instance;
}

/**
 * Convenience singleton instance
 */
export const sidePanel = createSidePanel();

/**
 * Chrome Side Panel API types
 *
 * Type definitions for chrome.sidePanel API
 */

/**
 * Options for setting side panel
 */
export interface SetOptions {
  /**
   * The tab ID to set options for. If not specified, sets default options.
   */
  tabId?: number;

  /**
   * The path to the side panel HTML file relative to the extension root.
   */
  path?: string;

  /**
   * Whether the side panel is enabled. Defaults to true.
   */
  enabled?: boolean;
}

/**
 * Options for setting panel behavior
 */
export interface SetPanelBehaviorOptions {
  /**
   * Whether clicking the action icon opens the side panel.
   */
  openPanelOnActionClick: boolean;
}

/**
 * Options for opening side panel
 */
export interface OpenOptions {
  /**
   * The tab ID to open the side panel for. If not specified, opens for the active tab.
   */
  tabId?: number;
}

/**
 * Namespaced storage wrapper
 *
 * Provides automatic namespacing to prevent key collisions.
 */

import { ChromeStorage } from './storage.js';
import type { StorageArea } from './types.js';

export class NamespacedStorage<T = unknown> extends ChromeStorage<T> {
  constructor(namespace: string, area: StorageArea = 'local') {
    super(area, namespace);
  }
}

/**
 * Create a namespaced storage instance
 */
export function createNamespacedStorage<T = unknown>(
  namespace: string,
  area: StorageArea = 'local'
): NamespacedStorage<T> {
  return new NamespacedStorage<T>(namespace, area);
}



==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/libs/Google-Chrome-Extension-Library/core/storage/src/schema-validator.ts ====
/**
 * Schema validation for storage values
 *
 * Provides runtime validation using Zod-like patterns.
 */

export type Validator<T> = (value: unknown) => value is T;

export interface SchemaValidationError {
  key: string;
  value: unknown;
  error: string;
}

/**
 * Validated storage wrapper
 */
export class ValidatedStorage<T extends Record<string, unknown>> {
  constructor(
    private readonly storage: {
      get: (key: string) => Promise<unknown>;
      set: (key: string, value: unknown) => Promise<void>;
    },
    private readonly validators: Partial<Record<keyof T, Validator<unknown>>>
  ) {}

  /**
   * Get and validate a value
   */
  async get<K extends keyof T>(key: K): Promise<T[K] | undefined> {
    const value = await this.storage.get(String(key));
    if (value === undefined) {
      return undefined;
    }

    const validator = this.validators[key];
    if (validator && !validator(value)) {
      throw new Error(`Validation failed for key: ${String(key)}`);
    }

    return value as T[K];
  }

  /**
   * Set a value with validation
   */
  async set<K extends keyof T>(key: K, value: T[K]): Promise<void> {
    const validator = this.validators[key];
    if (validator && !validator(value)) {
      throw new Error(`Validation failed for key: ${String(key)}`);
    }

    await this.storage.set(String(key), value);
  }
}

/**
 * Create validators
 */
export const validators = {
  string: (value: unknown): value is string => typeof value === 'string',
  number: (value: unknown): value is number => typeof value === 'number',
  boolean: (value: unknown): value is boolean => typeof value === 'boolean',
  object: (value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> =>
    typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value),
  array: (value: unknown): value is unknown[] => Array.isArray(value),
  optional:
    <T>(validator: Validator<T>): Validator<T | undefined> =>
    (value: unknown): value is T | undefined =>
      value === undefined || validator(value),
};

/**
 * Integration tests for chrome.storage wrappers
 * Tests with fake chrome APIs to validate storage operations
 */

import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, vi } from 'vitest';
import { ChromeStorage } from './storage.js';

// Mock chrome.storage APIs
const mockStorage: Record<string, Record<string, unknown>> = {
  local: {},
  sync: {},
  session: {},
};

global.chrome = {
  storage: {
    local: {
      get: vi.fn((keys: string | string[] | null) => {
        if (keys === null) {
          return Promise.resolve(mockStorage.local);
        }
        const keyArray = Array.isArray(keys) ? keys : [keys];
        const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
        for (const key of keyArray) {
          if (key in mockStorage.local) {
            result[key] = mockStorage.local[key];
          }
        }
        return Promise.resolve(result);
      }),
      set: vi.fn((items: Record<string, unknown>) => {
        Object.assign(mockStorage.local, items);
        return Promise.resolve();
      }),
      remove: vi.fn((keys: string | string[]) => {
        const keyArray = Array.isArray(keys) ? keys : [keys];
        for (const key of keyArray) {
          delete mockStorage.local[key];
        }
        return Promise.resolve();
      }),
    },
    sync: {
      get: vi.fn((keys: string | string[] | null) => {
        if (keys === null) {
          return Promise.resolve(mockStorage.sync);
        }
        const keyArray = Array.isArray(keys) ? keys : [keys];
        const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
        for (const key of keyArray) {
          if (key in mockStorage.sync) {
            result[key] = mockStorage.sync[key];
          }
        }
        return Promise.resolve(result);
      }),
      set: vi.fn((items: Record<string, unknown>) => {
        Object.assign(mockStorage.sync, items);
        return Promise.resolve();
      }),
      remove: vi.fn((keys: string | string[]) => {
        const keyArray = Array.isArray(keys) ? keys : [keys];
        for (const key of keyArray) {
          delete mockStorage.sync[key];
        }
        return Promise.resolve();
      }),
    },
    session: {
      get: vi.fn((keys: string | string[] | null) => {
        if (keys === null) {
          return Promise.resolve(mockStorage.session);
        }
        const keyArray = Array.isArray(keys) ? keys : [keys];
        const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
        for (const key of keyArray) {
          if (key in mockStorage.session) {
            result[key] = mockStorage.session[key];
          }
        }
        return Promise.resolve(result);
      }),
      set: vi.fn((items: Record<string, unknown>) => {
        Object.assign(mockStorage.session, items);
        return Promise.resolve();
      }),
      remove: vi.fn((keys: string | string[]) => {
        const keyArray = Array.isArray(keys) ? keys : [keys];
        for (const key of keyArray) {
          delete mockStorage.session[key];
        }
        return Promise.resolve();
      }),
    },
  },
} as any;

interface TestSchema {
  user: string;
  settings: { theme: string };
  data: number;
}

describe('ChromeStorage Integration', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    // Clear all storage areas
    mockStorage.local = {};
    mockStorage.sync = {};
    mockStorage.session = {};
    vi.clearAllMocks();
  });

  describe('Local storage', () => {
    it('should store and retrieve data from local storage', async () => {
      const storage = new ChromeStorage<TestSchema>('local');

      await storage.set('user', 'test-user');
      const user = await storage.get('user');

      expect(user).toBe('test-user');
      expect(chrome.storage.local.set).toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(chrome.storage.local.get).toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it('should handle namespaced keys', async () => {
      const storage = new ChromeStorage<TestSchema>('local', 'myapp');

      await storage.set('user', 'test-user');
      const user = await storage.get('user');

      expect(user).toBe('test-user');
      expect(chrome.storage.local.set).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({ 'myapp:user': 'test-user' })
      );
    });

    it('should get all values in namespace', async () => {
      const storage = new ChromeStorage<TestSchema>('local', 'myapp');

      await storage.set('user', 'user1');
      await storage.set('settings', { theme: 'dark' });
      await storage.set('data', 42);

      const all = await storage.getAll();

      expect(all.user).toBe('user1');
      expect(all.settings).toEqual({ theme: 'dark' });
      expect(all.data).toBe(42);
    });

    it('should clear all values in namespace', async () => {
      const storage = new ChromeStorage<TestSchema>('local', 'myapp');

      await storage.set('user', 'test');
      await storage.set('data', 123);

      await storage.clear();

      const user = await storage.get('user');
      const data = await storage.get('data');

      expect(user).toBeUndefined();
      expect(data).toBeUndefined();
    });

    it('should check if key exists', async () => {
      const storage = new ChromeStorage<TestSchema>('local');

      expect(await storage.has('user')).toBe(false);

      await storage.set('user', 'test');
      expect(await storage.has('user')).toBe(true);
    });

    it('should get keys matching pattern', async () => {
      const storage = new ChromeStorage<TestSchema>('local');

      await storage.set('user', 'test');
      await storage.set('userSettings', { theme: 'dark' });
      await storage.set('data', 123);

      const userKeys = await storage.getKeys('user');
      expect(userKeys).toContain('user');
      expect(userKeys).toContain('userSettings');

      const regexKeys = await storage.getKeys(/^user/);
      expect(regexKeys).toContain('user');
      expect(regexKeys).toContain('userSettings');
      expect(regexKeys).not.toContain('data');
    });
  });

  describe('Sync storage', () => {
    it('should store and retrieve data from sync storage', async () => {
      const storage = new ChromeStorage<TestSchema>('sync');

      await storage.set('user', 'test-user');
      const user = await storage.get('user');

      expect(user).toBe('test-user');
      expect(chrome.storage.sync.set).toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(chrome.storage.sync.get).toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
  });

  describe('Session storage', () => {
    it('should store and retrieve data from session storage', async () => {
      const storage = new ChromeStorage<TestSchema>('session');

      await storage.set('user', 'test-user');
      const user = await storage.get('user');

      expect(user).toBe('test-user');
      expect(chrome.storage.session.set).toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(chrome.storage.session.get).toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
  });

  describe('Namespace isolation', () => {
    it('should isolate namespaces', async () => {
      const storage1 = new ChromeStorage<TestSchema>('local', 'app1');
      const storage2 = new ChromeStorage<TestSchema>('local', 'app2');

      await storage1.set('user', 'user1');
      await storage2.set('user', 'user2');

      expect(await storage1.get('user')).toBe('user1');
      expect(await storage2.get('user')).toBe('user2');
    });

    it('should not interfere with unnamespaced storage', async () => {
      const namespaced = new ChromeStorage<TestSchema>('local', 'app');
      const unnamespaced = new ChromeStorage<TestSchema>('local');

      await namespaced.set('user', 'namespaced');
      await unnamespaced.set('user', 'unnamespaced');

      expect(await namespaced.get('user')).toBe('namespaced');
      expect(await unnamespaced.get('user')).toBe('unnamespaced');
    });
  });

  describe('Remove operations', () => {
    it('should remove a key', async () => {
      const storage = new ChromeStorage<TestSchema>('local');

      await storage.set('user', 'test');
      await storage.remove('user');

      const user = await storage.get('user');
      expect(user).toBeUndefined();
      expect(chrome.storage.local.remove).toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
  });
});

/**
 * Base storage wrapper for chrome.storage APIs
 */

import type { StorageArea, StorageEntry } from './types.js';

export class ChromeStorage<T = unknown> {
  constructor(
    private readonly area: StorageArea,
    private readonly namespace: string = ''
  ) {}

  private getKey(key: string): string {
    return this.namespace ? `${this.namespace}:${key}` : key;
  }

  private getStorageArea(): chrome.storage.StorageArea {
    switch (this.area) {
      case 'local':
        return chrome.storage.local;
      case 'sync':
        return chrome.storage.sync;
      case 'session':
        return chrome.storage.session;
      default:
        return chrome.storage.local;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get a value from storage
   */
  async get<K extends keyof T>(key: K): Promise<T[K] | undefined> {
    const storageKey = this.getKey(String(key));
    const result = await this.getStorageArea().get([storageKey]);
    return result[storageKey] as T[K] | undefined;
  }

  /**
   * Set a value in storage
   */
  async set<K extends keyof T>(key: K, value: T[K]): Promise<void> {
    const storageKey = this.getKey(String(key));
    await this.getStorageArea().set({ [storageKey]: value });
  }

  /**
   * Remove a value from storage
   */
  async remove<K extends keyof T>(key: K): Promise<void> {
    const storageKey = this.getKey(String(key));
    await this.getStorageArea().remove([storageKey]);
  }

  /**
   * Get all values in namespace
   */
  async getAll(): Promise<Partial<T>> {
    const all = await this.getStorageArea().get(null);
    const namespacePrefix = this.namespace ? `${this.namespace}:` : '';
    const result: Partial<T> = {} as Partial<T>;

    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(all)) {
      if (key.startsWith(namespacePrefix)) {
        const unnamespacedKey = this.namespace
          ? key.slice(namespacePrefix.length)
          : key;
        (result as Record<string, unknown>)[unnamespacedKey] = value;
      }
    }

    return result;
  }

  /**
   * Clear all values in namespace
   */
  async clear(): Promise<void> {
    const all = await this.getAll();
    const keys = Object.keys(all).map(k => this.getKey(k));
    if (keys.length > 0) {
      await this.getStorageArea().remove(keys);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Check if a key exists
   */
  async has<K extends keyof T>(key: K): Promise<boolean> {
    const value = await this.get(key);
    return value !== undefined;
  }

  /**
   * Get keys matching a pattern
   */
  async getKeys(pattern?: string | RegExp): Promise<string[]> {
    const all = await this.getAll();
    const keys = Object.keys(all);

    if (!pattern) {
      return keys;
    }

    if (typeof pattern === 'string') {
      return keys.filter(k => k.includes(pattern));
    }

    return keys.filter(k => pattern.test(k));
  }
}

/**
 * Chrome Tabs API errors
 */

/**
 * Base error class for Tabs API errors
 */
export class TabsError extends Error {
  constructor(
    message: string,
    public readonly code: string,
    cause?: unknown
  ) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'TabsError';
    if (cause !== null && cause !== undefined) {
      (this as unknown as { cause: unknown }).cause = cause;
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Error thrown when tabs API is not available
 */
export class TabsNotAvailableError extends TabsError {
  constructor(message = 'Chrome tabs API is not available') {
    super(message, 'TABS_NOT_AVAILABLE');
    this.name = 'TabsNotAvailableError';
  }
}

/**
 * Error thrown when tab is not found
 */
export class TabNotFoundError extends TabsError {
  constructor(tabId: number, message = `Tab ${tabId} not found`) {
    super(message, 'TAB_NOT_FOUND');
    this.name = 'TabNotFoundError';
  }
}

/**
 * Error thrown when invalid tab ID is provided
 */
export class InvalidTabIdError extends TabsError {
  constructor(message = 'Invalid tab ID provided') {
    super(message, 'INVALID_TAB_ID');
    this.name = 'InvalidTabIdError';
  }
}

/**
 * Chrome Extension Tabs API Library
 *
 * Provides type-safe, promise-based wrappers for chrome.tabs.*
 *
 * @module @chrome-ext/core-tabs
 */

export * from './tabs.js';
export * from './types.js';
export * from './errors.js';



==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/libs/Google-Chrome-Extension-Library/core/tabs/src/tabs.ts ====
/**
 * Chrome Tabs API wrapper
 *
 * Provides type-safe, promise-based wrappers for chrome.tabs.*
 *
 * @example
 * ```typescript
 * import { tabs } from '@chrome-ext/core-tabs';
 *
 * // Query tabs
 * const activeTabs = await tabs.query({ active: true });
 *
 * // Create new tab
 * const tab = await tabs.create({ url: 'https://example.com' });
 *
 * // Listen for updates
 * tabs.onUpdated.addListener((tabId, changeInfo, tab) => {
 *   console.log('Tab updated', tabId);
 * });
 * ```
 */

import { logger } from '@chrome-ext/core-telemetry';
import { metrics } from '@chrome-ext/core-telemetry';
import type {
  Tab,
  QueryInfo,
  CreateProperties,
  UpdateProperties,
  MoveProperties,
  ReloadProperties,
  HighlightInfo,
  CaptureVisibleTabOptions,
  TabCreatedEvent,
  TabUpdatedEvent,
  TabMovedEvent,
  TabActivatedEvent,
  TabHighlightedEvent,
  TabDetachedEvent,
  TabAttachedEvent,
  TabRemovedEvent,
  TabReplacedEvent,
  TabZoomChangeEvent,
} from './types.js';
import {
  TabsError,
  TabsNotAvailableError,
  TabNotFoundError,
} from './errors.js';

/**
 * Simple event emitter for Chrome tabs events
 */
class EventEmitter<T> {
  private listeners = new Set<(data: T) => void>();

  addListener(callback: (data: T) => void): void {
    this.listeners.add(callback);
  }

  removeListener(callback: (data: T) => void): void {
    this.listeners.delete(callback);
  }

  hasListener(callback: (data: T) => void): boolean {
    return this.listeners.has(callback);
  }

  hasListeners(): boolean {
    return this.listeners.size > 0;
  }

  emit(data: T): void {
    for (const listener of this.listeners) {
      try {
        listener(data);
      } catch (error) {
        logger.error('Error in tabs event listener', error as Error);
        metrics.increment('tabs_event_listener_error', 1);
      }
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Chrome Tabs API wrapper class
 */
export class ChromeTabs {
  /**
   * Event emitter for tab created
   */
  readonly onCreated = new EventEmitter<TabCreatedEvent>();

  /**
   * Event emitter for tab updated
   */
  readonly onUpdated = new EventEmitter<TabUpdatedEvent>();

  /**
   * Event emitter for tab moved
   */
  readonly onMoved = new EventEmitter<TabMovedEvent>();

  /**
   * Event emitter for tab activated
   */
  readonly onActivated = new EventEmitter<TabActivatedEvent>();

  /**
   * Event emitter for tab highlighted
   */
  readonly onHighlighted = new EventEmitter<TabHighlightedEvent>();

  /**
   * Event emitter for tab detached
   */
  readonly onDetached = new EventEmitter<TabDetachedEvent>();

  /**
   * Event emitter for tab attached
   */
  readonly onAttached = new EventEmitter<TabAttachedEvent>();

  /**
   * Event emitter for tab removed
   */
  readonly onRemoved = new EventEmitter<TabRemovedEvent>();

  /**
   * Event emitter for tab replaced
   */
  readonly onReplaced = new EventEmitter<TabReplacedEvent>();

  /**
   * Event emitter for tab zoom change
   */
  readonly onZoomChange = new EventEmitter<TabZoomChangeEvent>();

  private initialized = false;

  /**
   * Check if chrome.tabs API is available
   */
  private checkAvailability(): void {
    if (
      typeof chrome === 'undefined' ||
      chrome.tabs === null ||
      chrome.tabs === undefined
    ) {
      throw new TabsNotAvailableError();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Setup event listeners
   */
  setup(): void {
    if (this.initialized) {
      return;
    }

    this.checkAvailability();

    // Setup onCreated listener
    chrome.tabs.onCreated.addListener((tab: Tab) => {
      metrics.increment('tabs_created', 1);
      logger.debug('Tab created', { tabId: tab.id });
      this.onCreated.emit({ tab });
    });

    // Setup onUpdated listener
    chrome.tabs.onUpdated.addListener(
      (tabId: number, changeInfo: unknown, tab: Tab) => {
        metrics.increment('tabs_updated', 1);
        logger.debug('Tab updated', { tabId });
        this.onUpdated.emit({
          tabId,
          changeInfo: changeInfo as TabUpdatedEvent['changeInfo'],
          tab,
        });
      }
    );

    // Setup onMoved listener
    chrome.tabs.onMoved.addListener((tabId: number, moveInfo: unknown) => {
      metrics.increment('tabs_moved', 1);
      logger.debug('Tab moved', { tabId });
      this.onMoved.emit({
        tabId,
        moveInfo: moveInfo as TabMovedEvent['moveInfo'],
      });
    });

    // Setup onActivated listener
    chrome.tabs.onActivated.addListener((activeInfo: unknown) => {
      const info = activeInfo as { tabId: number; windowId: number };
      metrics.increment('tabs_activated', 1);
      logger.debug('Tab activated', { tabId: info.tabId });
      this.onActivated.emit({
        tabId: info.tabId,
        windowId: info.windowId,
      });
    });

    // Setup onHighlighted listener
    chrome.tabs.onHighlighted.addListener((highlightInfo: unknown) => {
      const info = highlightInfo as { windowId: number; tabIds: number[] };
      metrics.increment('tabs_highlighted', 1);
      logger.debug('Tabs highlighted', { windowId: info.windowId });
      this.onHighlighted.emit({
        windowId: info.windowId,
        tabIds: info.tabIds,
      });
    });

    // Setup onDetached listener
    chrome.tabs.onDetached.addListener((tabId: number, detachInfo: unknown) => {
      metrics.increment('tabs_detached', 1);
      logger.debug('Tab detached', { tabId });
      this.onDetached.emit({
        tabId,
        detachInfo: detachInfo as TabDetachedEvent['detachInfo'],
      });
    });

    // Setup onAttached listener
    chrome.tabs.onAttached.addListener((tabId: number, attachInfo: unknown) => {
      metrics.increment('tabs_attached', 1);
      logger.debug('Tab attached', { tabId });
      this.onAttached.emit({
        tabId,
        attachInfo: attachInfo as TabAttachedEvent['attachInfo'],
      });
    });

    // Setup onRemoved listener
    chrome.tabs.onRemoved.addListener((tabId: number, removeInfo: unknown) => {
      metrics.increment('tabs_removed', 1);
      logger.debug('Tab removed', { tabId });
      this.onRemoved.emit({
        tabId,
        removeInfo: removeInfo as TabRemovedEvent['removeInfo'],
      });
    });

    // Setup onReplaced listener
    chrome.tabs.onReplaced.addListener(
      (addedTabId: number, removedTabId: number) => {
        metrics.increment('tabs_replaced', 1);
        logger.debug('Tab replaced', { addedTabId, removedTabId });
        this.onReplaced.emit({
          addedTabId,
          removedTabId,
        });
      }
    );

    // Setup onZoomChange listener
    chrome.tabs.onZoomChange.addListener((zoomChangeInfo: unknown) => {
      const info = zoomChangeInfo as TabZoomChangeEvent;
      metrics.increment('tabs_zoom_changed', 1);
      logger.debug('Tab zoom changed', { tabId: info.tabId });
      this.onZoomChange.emit(info);
    });

    this.initialized = true;
    logger.info('Chrome Tabs API wrapper initialized');
  }

  /**
   * Get a tab by ID
   */
  async get(tabId: number): Promise<Tab> {
    const stopTimer = metrics.startTimer('tabs_get');
    try {
      this.checkAvailability();
      logger.debug('Getting tab', { tabId });
      const tab = await chrome.tabs.get(tabId);
      metrics.increment('tabs_get_success', 1);
      return tab as Tab;
    } catch (error) {
      metrics.increment('tabs_get_error', 1);
      logger.error('Failed to get tab', error as Error);

      const errorMessage = (error as { message?: string }).message;
      if (
        errorMessage !== null &&
        errorMessage !== undefined &&
        errorMessage.includes('No tab with id')
      ) {
        throw new TabNotFoundError(tabId);
      }

      throw new TabsError('Failed to get tab', 'GET_FAILED', error);
    } finally {
      stopTimer();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get the current active tab
   */
  async getCurrent(): Promise<Tab | undefined> {
    const stopTimer = metrics.startTimer('tabs_getCurrent');
    try {
      this.checkAvailability();
      logger.debug('Getting current tab');
      const tab = await chrome.tabs.getCurrent();
      metrics.increment('tabs_getCurrent_success', 1);
      return tab as Tab | undefined;
    } catch (error) {
      metrics.increment('tabs_getCurrent_error', 1);
      logger.error('Failed to get current tab', error as Error);
      throw new TabsError(
        'Failed to get current tab',
        'GET_CURRENT_FAILED',
        error
      );
    } finally {
      stopTimer();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Query tabs
   */
  async query(queryInfo: QueryInfo): Promise<Tab[]> {
    const stopTimer = metrics.startTimer('tabs_query');
    try {
      this.checkAvailability();
      logger.debug('Querying tabs', { queryInfo });
      const tabs = await chrome.tabs.query(queryInfo);
      metrics.increment('tabs_query_success', 1, { count: tabs.length });
      return tabs as Tab[];
    } catch (error) {
      metrics.increment('tabs_query_error', 1);
      logger.error('Failed to query tabs', error as Error);
      throw new TabsError('Failed to query tabs', 'QUERY_FAILED', error);
    } finally {
      stopTimer();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Create a new tab
   */
  async create(createProperties: CreateProperties): Promise<Tab> {

      stopTimer();
    }
  }

  /**

  async update(
    tabId: number | undefined,
    updateProperties: UpdateProperties
  ): Promise<Tab> {

    } catch (error) {

        errorMessage !== null &&

/**
 * Chrome Tabs API types
 *
 * Type definitions for chrome.tabs API
 */

/**
 * Tab status
 */
export type TabStatus = 'loading' | 'complete';

/**
 * Tab window type
 */
export type WindowType = 'normal' | 'popup' | 'panel' | 'app' | 'devtools';

/**
 * Tab muted info
 */
export interface MutedInfo {
  muted: boolean;
  reason?: 'user' | 'capture' | 'extension';
  extensionId?: string;
}

/**
 * Tab object
 */
export interface Tab {
  id?: number;
  index: number;
  windowId: number;
  openerTabId?: number;
  highlighted: boolean;
  active: boolean;
  pinned: boolean;
  audible?: boolean;
  discarded?: boolean;
  autoDiscardable?: boolean;
  mutedInfo?: MutedInfo;
  url?: string;
  pendingUrl?: string;
  title?: string;
  favIconUrl?: string;
  status?: TabStatus;
  incognito: boolean;
  width?: number;
  height?: number;
  sessionId?: string;
  groupId?: number;
  cookieStoreId?: string;
  successorTabId?: number;
}

/**
 * Query info for tabs.query()
 */
export interface QueryInfo {
  /** Whether the tabs are active in their windows. */
  active?: boolean;
  /** Whether the tabs are pinned. */
  pinned?: boolean;
  /** Whether the tabs are highlighted. */
  highlighted?: boolean;
  /** Whether the tabs are audible. */
  audible?: boolean;
  /** Whether the tabs are muted. */
  muted?: boolean;
  /** Whether the tabs are discarded. */
  discarded?: boolean;
  /** Whether the tabs are auto-discardable. */
  autoDiscardable?: boolean;
  /** The ID of the parent window, or windows.WINDOW_ID_CURRENT for the current window. */
  windowId?: number;
  /** The type of window the tabs are in. */
  windowType?: WindowType;
  /** The position of the tabs within their windows. */
  index?: number;
  /** The URL the tabs are navigated to. */
  url?: string | string[];
  /** The title of the tabs. */
  title?: string;
  /** The ID of the tab that opened this tab. */
  openerTabId?: number;
  /** The ID of the tab that opened this tab. */
  cookieStoreId?: string;
  /** The ID of the tab group. */
  groupId?: number;
  /** The ID of the tab that opened this tab. */
  status?: TabStatus;
  /** The ID of the tab that opened this tab. */
  lastFocusedWindow?: boolean;
}

 * Create properties for tabs.create()
 */
export interface CreateProperties {
  /** The window to create the new tab in. Defaults to the current window. */
  windowId?: number;
  /** The position the tab should take in the window. */
  index?: number;
  /** The URL to navigate the tab to initially. */
  url?: string;
  /** Whether the tab should become the active tab in the window. */
  active?: boolean;
  /** Whether the tab should be pinned. */
  pinned?: boolean;
  /** The ID of the tab that opened this tab. */
  openerTabId?: number;
  /** The cookie store to use for the tab. */
  cookieStoreId?: string;
  /** The ID of the tab group. */
  groupId?: number;
  /** Whether the tab should be discarded automatically when its resources are needed. */
  discarded?: boolean;
}

  url?: string;

  active?: boolean;
  /** Whether the tab should be highlighted. */
  highlighted?: boolean;
  /** Whether the tab should be pinned. */
  pinned?: boolean;
  /** Whether the tab should be muted. */
  muted?: boolean;
  /** The ID of the tab group. */
  groupId?: number;

/**
 * Correlation ID management
 *
 * Provides correlation IDs for tracking requests across extension contexts.
 */
let currentCorrelationId;
/**
 * Generate a new correlation ID
 */
export function generateCorrelationId() {
    return `${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 11)}`;
}
/**
 * Get current correlation ID or generate a new one
 */
export function getCorrelationId() {
    if (!currentCorrelationId) {
        currentCorrelationId = generateCorrelationId();
    }
    return currentCorrelationId;
}
/**
 * Set correlation ID
 */
export function setCorrelationId(id) {
    currentCorrelationId = id;
}
/**
 * Clear correlation ID
 */
export function clearCorrelationId() {
    currentCorrelationId = undefined;
}
/**
 * Run a function with a specific correlation ID
 */
export async function withCorrelationId(id, fn) {
    const previous = currentCorrelationId;
    setCorrelationId(id);
    try {
        return await fn();
    }
    finally {
        if (previous) {
            setCorrelationId(previous);
        }
        else {
            clearCorrelationId();
        }
    }
}
