==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/libs/Google-Chrome-Extension-Library/integrations/zoominfo/src/lib/chrome-adapter.ts ====
/**
 * Chrome Extension Adapter for ZoomInfo Client
 *
 * Provides Chrome extension-specific integration with credential storage
 * and chrome.storage.session for credential management.
 */

import { ZoomInfoClient, type ZoomInfoClientConfig } from './client.js';
import { logger } from '@chrome-ext/core-telemetry';

export interface ZoomInfoCredentials {
  username: string;
  password: string;
}

const CREDENTIAL_STORAGE_KEY = 'zoominfo_credentials';

/**
 * Get ZoomInfo credentials from chrome.storage.session
 */
export async function getZoomInfoCredentials(): Promise<ZoomInfoCredentials | null> {
  try {
    const result = await chrome.storage.session.get(CREDENTIAL_STORAGE_KEY);
    return result[CREDENTIAL_STORAGE_KEY] || null;
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Error getting ZoomInfo credentials', error as Error);
    return null;
  }
}

/**
 * Save ZoomInfo credentials to chrome.storage.session
 */
export async function saveZoomInfoCredentials(
  credentials: ZoomInfoCredentials
): Promise<void> {
  try {
    await chrome.storage.session.set({ [CREDENTIAL_STORAGE_KEY]: credentials });
    logger.info('ZoomInfo credentials saved');
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Error saving ZoomInfo credentials', error as Error);
    throw error;
  }
}

/**
 * Create a ZoomInfo client instance with credentials from storage
 */
export async function createZoomInfoClient(
  config?: Omit<ZoomInfoClientConfig, 'username' | 'password'>
): Promise<ZoomInfoClient> {
  const credentials = await getZoomInfoCredentials();
  
  if (!credentials) {
    throw new Error('ZoomInfo credentials not configured. Please configure credentials in Settings.');
  }

  return new ZoomInfoClient({
    ...config,
    username: credentials.username,
    password: credentials.password,
  });
}

/**
 * Enrich contacts using ZoomInfo API with automatic credential management
 */
export async function enrichContactsWithZoomInfo(
  requests: Array<{
    companyName: string;
    jobTitle?: string;
    location?: string;
  }>
): Promise<Array<{
  id?: number;
  email?: string;
  phone?: string;
  directPhone?: string;
  mobilePhone?: string;
  street?: string;
  city?: string;
  state?: string;
  zipCode?: string;
  country?: string;
  jobTitle?: string;
  companyName?: string;
}>> {
  const client = await createZoomInfoClient();
  
  // Authenticate first
  await client.authenticate();

  const results: Array<{
    id?: number;
    email?: string;
    phone?: string;
    directPhone?: string;
    mobilePhone?: string;
    street?: string;
    city?: string;
    state?: string;
    zipCode?: string;
    country?: string;
    jobTitle?: string;
    companyName?: string;
  }> = [];

  // Process requests in batches of 25 (ZoomInfo API limit)
  const batchSize = 25;
  for (let i = 0; i < requests.length; i += batchSize) {
    const batch = requests.slice(i, i + batchSize);
    
    try {
      // Map requests to ZoomInfo matchPersonInput format
      const matchPersonInput = batch.map(req => {
        const input: {
          companyName: string;
          jobTitle?: string;
        } = {
          companyName: req.companyName,
        };
        
        if (req.jobTitle) {
          input.jobTitle = req.jobTitle;
        }
        
        return input;
      });

      // Call enrichment API
      const response = await client.getEnrichedContacts({
        matchPersonInput,
        outputFields: [
          'id',
          'email',
          'phone',
          'street',
          'city',
          'zipCode',
          'state',
          'country',
          'companyPhone',
          'mobilePhone',
        ],
        requiredFields: ['companyName'],
      });

      // Map responses back to results
      // Note: response.data.result is an array where each element corresponds to a matchPersonInput
      // Each result can have multiple data entries (multiple matches for the same input)
      for (let j = 0; j < batch.length; j++) {
        const matchResult = response.data.result[j];
        if (matchResult && matchResult.data && matchResult.data.length > 0) {
          // Use first match if multiple results
          const enriched = matchResult.data[0];
          results.push({
            id: enriched.id,
            email: enriched.email,
            phone: enriched.phone,
            directPhone: enriched.phone,
            mobilePhone: enriched.mobilePhone,
            street: enriched.street,
            city: enriched.city,
            state: enriched.state,
            zipCode: enriched.zipCode,
            country: enriched.country,
            companyName: batch[j].companyName,
            jobTitle: batch[j].jobTitle,
          });
        } else {
          // No match found - return empty result to maintain array order
          results.push({});
        }
      }

      // Rate limiting: wait 1 second between batches
      if (i + batchSize < requests.length) {
        await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 1000));
      }
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('Error enriching batch', error as Error, {
        batchStart: i,
        batchSize: batch.length,
      });
      // Add empty results for failed batch to maintain array order
      for (let j = 0; j < batch.length; j++) {
        results.push({});
      }
    }
  }

  return results;
}



==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/libs/Google-Chrome-Extension-Library/integrations/zoominfo/src/lib/client.ts ====
import { logger } from '@chrome-ext/core-telemetry';
import {
  ZoomInfoAuthRequest,
  ZoomInfoAuthResponse,
  ZoomInfoContactSearchModel,
  ZoomInfoEnrichedContact,
  ZoomInfoGetContactsRequest,
  ZoomInfoGetContactsResponse,
  ZoomInfoGetEnrichedContactsRequest,
  ZoomInfoGetEnrichedContactsResponse,
  ZoomInfoSearchContact,
} from './types.js';
import {
  DEFAULT_ZOOMINFO_API_ROOT,
  DEFAULT_ZOOMINFO_AUTH_ENDPOINT,
  DEFAULT_ZOOMINFO_ENRICH_ENDPOINT,
  DEFAULT_ZOOMINFO_SEARCH_ENDPOINT,
} from './config.js';
import { retryWithBackoff } from './retry.js';

export interface ZoomInfoClientConfig {
  apiRoot?: string;
  authEndpoint?: string;
  searchEndpoint?: string;
  enrichEndpoint?: string;
  username?: string;
  password?: string;
}

/**
 * ZoomInfo API client
 */
export class ZoomInfoClient {
  private _apiRoot: string;
  private _authEndpoint: string;
  private _searchEndpoint: string;
  private _enrichEndpoint: string;
  private _jwt: string | null = null;
  private _username: string;
  private _password: string;

  constructor(config?: ZoomInfoClientConfig) {
    this._apiRoot = config?.apiRoot ?? DEFAULT_ZOOMINFO_API_ROOT;
    this._authEndpoint =
      config?.authEndpoint ?? DEFAULT_ZOOMINFO_AUTH_ENDPOINT;
    this._searchEndpoint =
      config?.searchEndpoint ?? DEFAULT_ZOOMINFO_SEARCH_ENDPOINT;
    this._enrichEndpoint =
      config?.enrichEndpoint ?? DEFAULT_ZOOMINFO_ENRICH_ENDPOINT;
    this._username = config?.username ?? '';
    this._password = config?.password ?? '';

    if (!this._username || !this._password) {
      logger.warn('ZoomInfo credentials not configured', {
        hasUsername: !!this._username,
        hasPassword: !!this._password,
      });
    }
  }

  get isAuthenticated(): boolean {
    return !!this._jwt;
  }

  /**
   * Authenticate with ZoomInfo API and get JWT token
   */
  public async authenticate(username?: string, password?: string): Promise<string> {
    const authUsername = username ?? this._username;
    const authPassword = password ?? this._password;

    if (!authUsername || !authPassword) {
      throw new Error('ZoomInfo username and password are required');
    }

    logger.info('Authenticating with ZoomInfo', {
      apiRoot: this._apiRoot,
      authEndpoint: this._authEndpoint,
      usingProvidedCredentials: !!username || !!password,
      usingConstructorCredentials: !username && !password && !!this._username && !!this._password,
    });

    const url = `${this._apiRoot}${this._authEndpoint}`;
    const request: ZoomInfoAuthRequest = {
      username: authUsername,
      password: authPassword,
    };

    try {
      const response = await retryWithBackoff(
        async () => {
          const res = await fetch(url, {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
              'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            },
            body: JSON.stringify(request),
          });

          if (!res.ok) {
            throw new Error(`ZoomInfo authentication failed: ${res.status} ${res.statusText}`);
          }

          return res.json() as Promise<ZoomInfoAuthResponse>;
        },
        {
          maxRetries: 3,
          baseDelayMs: 1000,
          maxDelayMs: 5000,
        },
      );

      if (response.success) {
        this._jwt = response.jwt;
        logger.info('ZoomInfo authentication successful');
        return response.jwt;
      } else {
        throw new Error('ZoomInfo Authentication Unsuccessful');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('ZoomInfo authentication failed', error as Error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get contacts by page (internal method)
   */
  private async getContactsByPage(
    request: ZoomInfoGetContactsRequest,
  ): Promise<ZoomInfoGetContactsResponse> {
    if (!this._jwt) {
      await this.authenticate();
    }

    const url = `${this._apiRoot}${this._searchEndpoint}`;
    const headers = {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${this._jwt}`,
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    };

    logger.debug('Fetching contacts by page', {
      url,
      request: JSON.stringify(request),
    });

    try {
      const response = await retryWithBackoff(
        async () => {
          const res = await fetch(url, {
            method: 'POST',
            headers,
            body: JSON.stringify(request),
          });

          if (!res.ok) {
            if (res.status === 401) {
              // Token expired, re-authenticate
              this._jwt = null;
              await this.authenticate();
              // Retry with new token
              const retryRes = await fetch(url, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {
                  Authorization: `Bearer ${this._jwt}`,
                  'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                },
                body: JSON.stringify(request),
              });
              if (!retryRes.ok) {
                throw new Error(`ZoomInfo search failed: ${retryRes.status} ${retryRes.statusText}`);
              }
              return retryRes.json() as Promise<ZoomInfoGetContactsResponse>;
            }
            throw new Error(`ZoomInfo search failed: ${res.status} ${res.statusText}`);
          }

          return res.json() as Promise<ZoomInfoGetContactsResponse>;
        },
        {
          maxRetries: 3,
          baseDelayMs: 1000,
          maxDelayMs: 10000,
        },
      );

      return response;
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('Failed to fetch contacts by page', error as Error, {
        request: JSON.stringify(request),
      });
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get company contacts (handles pagination automatically)
   */
  public async getCompanyContacts(
    companyName: string,
    zipCode?: string,
  ): Promise<ZoomInfoSearchContact[]> {
    if (!this._jwt) {
      await this.authenticate();
    }

    const searchModel = new ZoomInfoContactSearchModel(
      companyName.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9 ]/g, ''),
      zipCode,
    );
    let request = searchModel.getNextRequest();

    logger.info('Fetching company contacts', {
      companyName,
      zipCode,
    });

    try {
      let response = await this.getContactsByPage(request);

      searchModel.totalContacts = response.maxResults;
      searchModel.addContacts(response.data);

      while (searchModel.currentPage <= searchModel.totalPages) {
        request = searchModel.getNextRequest();
        response = await this.getContactsByPage(request);
        searchModel.addContacts(response.data);
      }

      logger.info('Company contacts fetched successfully', {
        companyName,
        contactCount: searchModel.contacts.length,
      });

      return searchModel.contacts;
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('Failed to get company contacts', error as Error, {
        companyName,
      });
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get enriched contacts by person IDs or matching criteria
   */
  public async getEnrichedContacts(
    request: ZoomInfoGetEnrichedContactsRequest,
  ): Promise<ZoomInfoGetEnrichedContactsResponse> {
    if (!this._jwt) {
      await this.authenticate();
    }

    const url = `${this._apiRoot}${this._enrichEndpoint}`;
    
    // Format request according to ZoomInfo API spec
    const apiRequest = {
      data: {
        type: 'ContactEnrich',
        attributes: {
          matchPersonInput: request.matchPersonInput,
          outputFields: request.outputFields,
          ...(request.requiredFields && { requiredFields: request.requiredFields }),
        },
      },
    };

    const headers = {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${this._jwt}`,
      'Content-Type': 'application/vnd.api+json',
      Accept: 'application/vnd.api+json',
    };

    logger.debug('Fetching enriched contacts', {
      url,
      matchCount: request.matchPersonInput.length,
    });

    try {
      const response = await retryWithBackoff(
        async () => {
          const res = await fetch(url, {
            method: 'POST',
            headers,
            body: JSON.stringify(apiRequest),
          });

          if (!res.ok) {
            if (res.status === 401) {
              // Token expired, re-authenticate
              this._jwt = null;
              await this.authenticate();
              // Retry with new token
              const retryRes = await fetch(url, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {
                  Authorization: `Bearer ${this._jwt}`,
                  'Content-Type': 'application/vnd.api+json',
                  Accept: 'application/vnd.api+json',
                },
                body: JSON.stringify(apiRequest),
              });
              if (!retryRes.ok) {
                const errorText = await retryRes.text();
                const error = new Error(`ZoomInfo enrich failed: ${retryRes.status} ${retryRes.statusText} - ${errorText}`);
                // Attach status code for circuit breaker detection
                (error as { status?: number }).status = retryRes.status;
                throw error;
              }
              const retryJson = await retryRes.json();
              return this.transformEnrichmentResponse(retryJson, request.outputFields);
            }
            const errorText = await res.text();
            const error = new Error(`ZoomInfo enrich failed: ${res.status} ${res.statusText} - ${errorText}`);
            // Attach status code for circuit breaker detection
            (error as { status?: number }).status = res.status;
            throw error;
          }

          const jsonResponse = await res.json();
          return this.transformEnrichmentResponse(jsonResponse, request.outputFields);
        },
        {
          maxRetries: 3,
          baseDelayMs: 1000,
          maxDelayMs: 10000,
        },
      );

      logger.debug('Enriched contacts fetched successfully', {
        resultCount: response.data.result.length,
      });

      return response;
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('Failed to get enriched contacts', error as Error, {
        request: JSON.stringify(request),
      });
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Transform ZoomInfo API response to our interface format
   */
  private transformEnrichmentResponse(
    jsonResponse: unknown,
    outputFields: string[]
  ): ZoomInfoGetEnrichedContactsResponse {
    // Handle JSON:API format response
    const response = jsonResponse as {
      data?: {
        attributes?: {
          result?: Array<{
            personId?: number;
            data?: ZoomInfoEnrichedContact[];
          }>;
          outputFields?: string[];
        };
      };
      // Also handle direct format
      success?: boolean;
      data?: {
        outputFields?: string[];
        result?: Array<{
          personId: number;
          data: ZoomInfoEnrichedContact[];
        }>;
      };
    };

    // Check if it's already in our format
    if (response.success !== undefined && response.data?.result) {
      return response as ZoomInfoGetEnrichedContactsResponse;
    }

    // Transform from JSON:API format
    if (response.data?.attributes?.result) {
      return {
        success: true,
        data: {
          outputFields: response.data.attributes.outputFields ?? outputFields,
          result: response.data.attributes.result.map(item => ({
            personId: item.personId ?? 0,
            data: item.data ?? [],
          })),
        },
      };
    }

    // Fallback: return empty result
    logger.warn('Unexpected ZoomInfo enrichment response format', {
      responseKeys: Object.keys(response),
    });

    return {
      success: true,
      data: {
        outputFields,
        result: [],
      },
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Retry utility with exponential backoff
 */

export interface RetryOptions {
  maxRetries: number;
  baseDelayMs: number;
  maxDelayMs: number;
}

/**
 * Retry a function with exponential backoff
 */
export async function retryWithBackoff<T>(
  fn: () => Promise<T>,
  options: RetryOptions
): Promise<T> {
  const { maxRetries, baseDelayMs, maxDelayMs } = options;
  let lastError: Error | unknown;

  for (let attempt = 0; attempt <= maxRetries; attempt++) {
    try {
      return await fn();
    } catch (error) {
      lastError = error;

      if (attempt < maxRetries) {
        const delayMs = Math.min(
          baseDelayMs * Math.pow(2, attempt),
          maxDelayMs
        );
        await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, delayMs));
      }
    }
  }

  throw lastError;
}

import { ZoomInfoEnrichedContactOutputFields } from './config.js';

export enum ZoomInfoManagementLevelsEnum {
  BOARD_MEMBER = 'Board Member',
  C_LEVEL_EXEC = 'C Level Exec',
  VP_LEVEL_EXEC = 'VP Level Exec',
  DIRECTOR = 'Director',
  MANAGER = 'Manager',
  NON_MANAGER = 'Non Manager',
}

export enum ZoomInfoDepartmentsEnum {
  C_SUITE = '0',
  IT = '5',
  ENGINEERING_TECH = '6',
}

export interface ZoomInfoSearchContact {
  id: number;
  firstName: string;
  middleName: string;
  lastName: string;
  validDate: string;
  lastUpdatedDate: string;
  jobTitle: string;
  contactAccuracyScore: number;

  hasSupplementalEmail: boolean;
  hasDirectPhone: boolean;
  hasMobilePhone: boolean;
  hasCompanyIndustry: boolean;

  hasCompanyStreet: boolean;
  hasCompanyState: boolean;

  hasCompanyCountry: boolean;

  department: string;
  managementLevel: string;

  zipCode?: string;
  zipCodeRadiusMiles?: string;
}

  currentPage: number;
  data: ZoomInfoSearchContact[];
  maxResults: number;
  totalResults: number;
}

export class ZoomInfoContactSearchModel {
  private _companyName: string;

  private _totalContacts = 0;

  private _page = 1;

  private _rpp = 25;

  private _departments = [
    ZoomInfoDepartmentsEnum.C_SUITE,
    ZoomInfoDepartmentsEnum.ENGINEERING_TECH,
    ZoomInfoDepartmentsEnum.IT,
  ];

  private _managementLevels = [
    ZoomInfoManagementLevelsEnum.C_LEVEL_EXEC,
    ZoomInfoManagementLevelsEnum.DIRECTOR,
    ZoomInfoManagementLevelsEnum.MANAGER,
    ZoomInfoManagementLevelsEnum.VP_LEVEL_EXEC,
  ];

  private _departmentsString: string;

  private _managementLevelsString: string;

  public contacts: ZoomInfoSearchContact[];

  private _zipCode?: string;

  private _zipCodeRadiusMiles = '25';

  constructor(companyName: string, zipCode?: string) {
    this._companyName = companyName;
    this.contacts = [];
    this._departmentsString = `${this._departments.join(',')}`;
    this._managementLevelsString = `${this._managementLevels.join(',')}`;
    if (zipCode !== undefined) {
      this._zipCode = zipCode;
    }
  }

  set totalContacts(total: number) {
    this._totalContacts = total;
  }

  get totalPages(): number {
    return Math.ceil(this._totalContacts / this._rpp);
  }

  get currentPage(): number {
    return this._page;
  }

  public getNextRequest(): ZoomInfoGetContactsRequest {
    let request: ZoomInfoGetContactsRequest;

    if (this._zipCode) {
      request = {
        companyName: this._companyName,
        department: this._departmentsString,
        managementLevel: this._managementLevelsString,
        page: this._page,
        zipCode: this._zipCode,
        zipCodeRadiusMiles: this._zipCodeRadiusMiles,
      };
    } else {
      request = {
        companyName: this._companyName,
        department: this._departmentsString,
        managementLevel: this._managementLevelsString,
        page: this._page,
      };
    }

    this._page++;

    return request;
  }

  public addContacts(contacts: ZoomInfoSearchContact[]): void {
    this.contacts = [...this.contacts, ...contacts];
  }
}

export type ZoomInfoEnrichedContactSearchRequestOutputFields =
  | 'id'
  | 'email'
  | 'phone'
  | 'street'
  | 'city'
  | 'zipCode'
  | 'state'
  | 'country'
  | 'companyPhone'
  | 'mobilePhone'
  | 'isDefunct';

export interface ZoomInfoMatchPersonInput {
  personId?: number;
  fullName?: string;
  firstName?: string;
  lastName?: string;
  emailAddress?: string;
  phone?: string;
  jobTitle?: string;
  hashedEmail?: string;
  externalURL?: string;
  lastUpdatedDateAfter?: string;
  validDateAfter?: string;
  contactAccuracyScoreMin?: string;
  companyId?: number;
  companyName?: string;
}

export interface ZoomInfoGetEnrichedContactsRequest {
  matchPersonInput: ZoomInfoMatchPersonInput[];
  outputFields: string[];
  requiredFields?: string[];
}

export interface ZoomInfoGetEnrichedContactsResponse {
  success: boolean;
  data: {
    outputFields: string[];
    result: {
      personId: number;
      data: ZoomInfoEnrichedContact[];
    }[];
  };
}

export class ZoomInfoEnrichedContactSearchModel {
  private _maxInputsPerRequest = 25;

  public requests: ZoomInfoGetEnrichedContactsRequest[] = [];

  constructor(ids: number[]) {
    let request: ZoomInfoGetEnrichedContactsRequest;
    let requestIds: number[];
    let input: { personId: number };
    let inputs: { personId: number }[];
    const totalPages = Math.ceil(ids.length / this._maxInputsPerRequest);

    for (let p = 0; p < totalPages; p++) {
      inputs = [];
      requestIds = ids.slice(
        p * this._maxInputsPerRequest,
        (p + 1) * this._maxInputsPerRequest,
      );

      for (let i = 0; i < requestIds.length; i++) {
        const personId = requestIds[i];
        if (personId !== undefined) {
          input = {
            personId,
          };

          inputs.push(input);
        }
      }

      request = {
        matchPersonInput: inputs,
        outputFields: ZoomInfoEnrichedContactOutputFields,
      };

      this.requests.push(request);
    }
  }
}

# Chrome Extension Library

A composable, modular Chrome Extension library for MV3 with pluggable authentication providers and a fluid design system.

## Overview

This library provides a foundation for building Chrome Extensions with:

- **Modular architecture** - Pick and choose only the modules you need
- **Pluggable authentication** - Support for Google, Microsoft, Social, SSO, and Email/password
- **MV3 compliant** - Service worker, promises, and modern Chrome APIs
- **Fluid design system** - Responsive typography and spacing using `clamp()` and viewport units
- **Side panel support** - Optional MV3 side panel UI (Chrome 114+)
- **Type-safe** - Full TypeScript support with strict typing
- **Observable** - Structured logging, correlation IDs, and metrics

## Library Structure

```
libs/Google-Chrome-Extension-Library/
├── core/
│   ├── runtime/        # MV3 scaffolding, manifest builder, message bus
│   ├── storage/        # chrome.storage wrappers with namespacing
│   └── telemetry/      # Structured logging, correlation IDs, metrics
├── ui/
│   └── design-tokens/  # Fluid typography/spacing tokens
└── auth/
    ├── base/           # AuthProvider interface and registry
    ├── google/         # Google Identity API provider
    ├── microsoft/      # Azure AD provider
    ├── social/         # OAuth2 social providers
    ├── sso/            # OIDC/SAML providers
    └── email/          # Email/password provider
```

## Quick Start

### Installation

Import the modules you need:

```typescript
import { buildManifest, bootstrapBackground } from '@chrome-ext/core-runtime';
import { ChromeStorage } from '@chrome-ext/core-storage';
import { logger } from '@chrome-ext/core-telemetry';
import { googleProvider } from '@chrome-ext/auth-google';
import { microsoftProvider } from '@chrome-ext/auth-microsoft';
import { registerProviders } from '@chrome-ext/auth-base';
```

### Basic Usage

#### 1. Build Manifest

```typescript
import { buildManifest } from '@chrome-ext/core-runtime';

const manifest = buildManifest({
  name: 'My Extension',
  version: '1.0.0',
  permissions: ['storage', 'identity'],
  sidePanel: {
    defaultPath: 'sidepanel.html',
  },
  oauth2: {
    clientId: 'your-google-client-id',
    scopes: ['openid', 'profile', 'email'],
  },
});
```

#### 2. Setup Background Service Worker

```typescript
import { bootstrapBackground, setupSidePanel } from '@chrome-ext/core-runtime';

bootstrapBackground({
  onInstalled: async (details) => {
    console.log('Extension installed:', details.reason);
    await setupSidePanel({
      openPanelOnActionClick: true,
      defaultPath: 'sidepanel.html',
    });
  },
});
```

#### 3. Setup Authentication

```typescript
import { registerProviders } from '@chrome-ext/auth-base';
import { googleProvider } from '@chrome-ext/auth-google';
import { microsoftProvider } from '@chrome-ext/auth-microsoft';

const providers = registerProviders(
  googleProvider({
    clientId: 'your-google-client-id',
    scopes: ['openid', 'profile', 'email'],
  }),
  microsoftProvider({
    clientId: 'your-microsoft-client-id',
    scopes: ['openid', 'profile', 'email', 'User.Read'],
  }),
);

// Use providers
const googleAuth = providers.find(p => p.id === 'google');
if (googleAuth) {
  const result = await googleAuth.signIn();
  console.log('Signed in:', result.user);
}
```

#### 4. Use Storage

```typescript
import { ChromeStorage } from '@chrome-ext/core-storage';

const storage = new ChromeStorage('local', 'my-namespace');

await storage.set('key', { value: 'data' });
const value = await storage.get('key');
```

#### 5. Use Logging

```typescript
import { logger } from '@chrome-ext/core-telemetry';

logger.info('User signed in', { userId: '123' });
logger.error('Sign-in failed', error, { provider: 'google' });
```

## Design Tokens

Import the CSS file to use fluid design tokens:

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="path/to/tokens.css">
```

Tokens include:
- **Fluid typography** using `clamp()` (H1, H2, H3, body, subtext, caption)
- **Fluid spacing** (8-pt system with clamped values)
- **Safe-area support** for mobile devices
- **Container query units** for resizable panes
- **Touch targets** (minimum 44×44px)

## Authentication Providers

### Google

Uses MV3 Identity API (`chrome.identity.getAuthToken`):

```typescript
import { googleProvider } from '@chrome-ext/auth-google';

const provider = googleProvider({
  clientId: 'your-client-id',
  scopes: ['openid', 'profile', 'email'],
});

const result = await provider().signIn();
```

**Required manifest:**
```json
{
  "oauth2": {
    "client_id": "your-client-id",
    "scopes": ["openid", "profile", "email"]
  },
  "permissions": ["identity"]
}
```

### Microsoft

Uses `chrome.identity.launchWebAuthFlow` with PKCE:

```typescript
import { microsoftProvider } from '@chrome-ext/auth-microsoft';

const provider = microsoftProvider({
  clientId: 'your-client-id',
  tenant: 'common', // or your tenant ID
  scopes: ['openid', 'profile', 'email', 'User.Read'],
});

const result = await provider().signIn();
```

## Module Boundaries

Libraries follow Nx module boundaries:

- `core/*` - Runtime utilities (can be used by all)
- `ui/*` - UI components and tokens (can be used by features)
- `auth/*` - Authentication providers (can be used by features)

## Testing

Each library includes test configuration:

```bash
nx test chrome-ext-core-runtime
nx test chrome-ext-auth-google
```

## Contributing

When adding new providers or modules:

1. Follow the existing structure
2. Implement the `AuthProvider` interface for auth providers
3. Export through `src/index.ts`
4. Add proper TypeScript types
5. Include tests

# Batch UI Components Usage Example

This document shows how to use the batch operation UI components together in a React sidepanel.

## Components Overview

- **BatchRunSummaryBanner**: Displays overall batch run statistics
- **BatchControls**: Provides start/pause/resume/abort/resume deferred buttons
- **BatchStatusPill**: Shows individual task status in a DataTable
- **useBatchRunStatus**: Hook for subscribing to batch run status updates

## Complete Example

```typescript
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import {
  BatchRunSummaryBanner,
  BatchControls,
  BatchStatusPill,
  useBatchRunStatus,
  DataTable,
} from '@chrome-ext/ui-shared-components';
import type { BatchTask } from '@chrome-ext/automation-batch';

interface RecordRow {
  id: string;
  patientKey: string;
  encounterId: string;
  url: string;
  batchStatus?: 'queued' | 'running' | 'succeeded' | 'failed' | 'deferred';
  batchError?: string;
  batchAttempts?: number;
  batchUpdatedAt?: string;
}

export function RecordsTab() {
  const [runId, setRunId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [selectedRows, setSelectedRows] = useState<string[]>([]);

  // Subscribe to batch run status
  const { snapshot, isLoading, refetch } = useBatchRunStatus({
    runId,
    operationId: 'record-detail-scrape',
    appId: 'pmhnp-administration-summerysky',
    pollIntervalMs: 2000,
    enabled: !!runId,
  });

  // Start batch from selected rows
  const handleStartBatch = async () => {
    const response = await chrome.runtime.sendMessage({
      type: 'START_RECORD_DETAIL_BATCH',
      taskUrls: selectedRows.map((id) => {
        // Get URL from row data
        return { rowId: id, url: getRowUrl(id) };
      }),
    });

    if (response?.ok && response.runId) {
      setRunId(response.runId);
    }
  };

  // Handle batch control actions
  const handleBatchAction = async (action: 'pause' | 'resume' | 'abort' | 'resumeDeferred') => {
    if (!runId) return;

    const messageType = {
      pause: 'PAUSE_RECORD_DETAIL_BATCH',
      resume: 'RESUME_RECORD_DETAIL_BATCH',
      abort: 'ABORT_RECORD_DETAIL_BATCH',
      resumeDeferred: 'RESUME_DEFERRED_RECORD_DETAIL_BATCH',
    }[action];

    await chrome.runtime.sendMessage({
      type: messageType,
      runId,
    });

    // Refetch status after action
    setTimeout(() => refetch(), 500);
  };

  // Get batch status for a specific row
  const getRowBatchStatus = (rowId: string) => {
    // In a real implementation, you'd fetch this from storage or state
    // This is a simplified example
    return snapshot?.taskStates?.find((ts) => ts.taskId === rowId)?.status;
  };

  return (
    <div>
      {/* Batch Run Summary Banner */}
      {snapshot && (
        <BatchRunSummaryBanner
          snapshot={snapshot}
          onViewLogs={() => {
            // Open logs viewer
            chrome.runtime.sendMessage({
              type: 'OPEN_BATCH_LOGS',
              runId: snapshot.runId,
            });
          }}
        />
      )}

      {/* Batch Controls */}
      <div style={{ marginBottom: '16px' }}>
        <BatchControls
          status={snapshot?.status ?? 'pending'}
          isLoading={isLoading}
          onStart={handleStartBatch}
          onPause={() => handleBatchAction('pause')}
          onResume={() => handleBatchAction('resume')}
          onAbort={() => handleBatchAction('abort')}
          onResumeDeferred={() => handleBatchAction('resumeDeferred')}
          disabled={selectedRows.length === 0 && !runId}
        />
      </div>

      {/* DataTable with Batch Status Column */}
      <DataTable
        columns={[
          { key: 'patientKey', label: 'Patient Key' },
          { key: 'encounterId', label: 'Encounter ID' },
          {
            key: 'batchStatus',
            label: 'Batch Status',
            render: (row: RecordRow) => (
              <BatchStatusPill
                status={row.batchStatus ?? 'queued'}
                error={row.batchError}
                attempts={row.batchAttempts}
              />
            ),
          },
          { key: 'batchUpdatedAt', label: 'Last Updated' },
        ]}
        rows={records}
        selectedRows={selectedRows}
        onSelectionChange={setSelectedRows}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Message Handler Setup

In your service worker, use `createBatchMessageHandlers`:

```typescript
import { createBatchMessageHandlers } from '@chrome-ext/automation-batch';
import { PMHNPCaptchaPolicy, PMHNPRecordTaskExecutor, PMHNPRecordRowSink } from './batch-adapters.js';

const batchHandlers = createBatchMessageHandlers({
  operationId: 'record-detail-scrape',
  appId: 'pmhnp-administration-summerysky',
  executorFactory: (context, recipeKey, correlationId, recipeId, onStepProgress) => {
    return new PMHNPRecordTaskExecutor(context, recipeKey, correlationId, recipeId, onStepProgress);
  },
  sinkFactory: (correlationId) => {
    return new PMHNPRecordRowSink(correlationId);
  },
  getBatchRunner: (runId) => {
    return getBatchRunnerInstance(runId);
  },
  defaultOptions: {
    maxConcurrency: 2,
    closeTabsOnComplete: true,
    focusTabs: false,
    phiMode: true,
  },
});

// Register handlers
chrome.runtime.onMessage.addListener((msg, sender, sendResponse) => {
  if (msg.type === 'START_RECORD_DETAIL_BATCH') {
    return batchHandlers.start(msg, sender, sendResponse);
  }
  if (msg.type === 'PAUSE_RECORD_DETAIL_BATCH') {
    return batchHandlers.pause(msg, sender, sendResponse);
  }
  // ... etc
});
```

## Key Patterns

### 1. Status Subscription
Use `useBatchRunStatus` to automatically poll for updates and listen to runtime messages.

### 2. Task Status in DataTable
Use `BatchStatusPill` in your DataTable columns to show per-row status.

### 3. Run Controls
Use `BatchControls` with the current run status to show appropriate action buttons.

### 4. Summary Banner
Display `BatchRunSummaryBanner` when a run is active to show overall progress.

## PHI-Safe Logging

When implementing batch operations in PHI-aware modules:

- Never log raw patient keys, names, or MRNs
- Use truncated/hashed identifiers in logs
- Store sensitive data only in encrypted storage
- Use `phiMode: true` in batch options

Example:
```typescript
logger.info('Batch task started', {
  taskId: hashTaskId(task.id), // Hashed, not raw
  patientKey: patientKey.substring(0, 16) + '...', // Truncated
  // Never log: full patientKey, name, DOB, MRN
});
```

/**
 * Base Tab Component
 *
 * Generic tab component with common structure and functionality.
 * Provides hero section, filter panel, actions, and content areas.
 */

import React from 'react';

export interface BaseTabProps {
  title: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  filterPanel?: React.ReactNode;
  actions?: React.ReactNode;
  content: React.ReactNode;
  className?: string;
}

/**
 * Base tab component with common structure
 */
export function BaseTab({
  title,
  subtitle,
  filterPanel,
  actions,
  content,
  className,
}: BaseTabProps): React.ReactElement {
  return (
    <div className={className || 'content-container'}>
      <div className="hero-section">
        <h1 className="hero-title">{title}</h1>
        {subtitle && <p className="hero-subtitle">{subtitle}</p>}
      </div>

      {filterPanel && (
        <div style={{ marginBottom: 'var(--space-16)' }}>{filterPanel}</div>
      )}

      {actions && (
        <div className="modern-card" style={{ marginBottom: 'var(--space-16)' }}>
          {actions}
        </div>
      )}

      {content}
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * Batch Controls Component
 *
 * Provides start/pause/resume/abort/resume deferred controls for batch operations.
 */

import React, { useState } from 'react';

export interface BatchControlsProps {
  runId: string | null;
  isRunning?: boolean;
  isPaused?: boolean;
  hasDeferred?: boolean;
  onStart: () => void | Promise<void>;
  onPause: () => void | Promise<void>;
  onResume: () => void | Promise<void>;
  onAbort: () => void | Promise<void>;
  onResumeDeferred: () => void | Promise<void>;
  startLabel?: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
}

export function BatchControls({
  runId,
  isRunning = false,
  isPaused = false,
  hasDeferred = false,
  onStart,
  onPause,
  onResume,
  onAbort,
  onResumeDeferred,
  startLabel = 'Start Batch',
  disabled = false,
}: BatchControlsProps) {
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);

  async function handleAction(action: () => void | Promise<void>) {
    if (isLoading || disabled) return;
    setIsLoading(true);
    try {
      await action();
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  }

  if (!runId) {
    return (
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 'var(--space-8)', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
        <button
          className="primary-button"
          onClick={() => handleAction(onStart)}
          disabled={isLoading || disabled}
        >
          {isLoading ? 'Starting...' : startLabel}
        </button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 'var(--space-8)', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
      {!isRunning && !isPaused && (
        <button
          className="primary-button"
          onClick={() => handleAction(onStart)}
          disabled={isLoading || disabled}
        >
          {isLoading ? 'Starting...' : startLabel}
        </button>
      )}
      {isRunning && !isPaused && (
        <button
          className="secondary-button"
          onClick={() => handleAction(onPause)}
          disabled={isLoading || disabled}
        >
          {isLoading ? 'Pausing...' : 'Pause'}
        </button>
      )}
      {isPaused && (
        <button
          className="primary-button"
          onClick={() => handleAction(onResume)}
          disabled={isLoading || disabled}
        >
          {isLoading ? 'Resuming...' : 'Resume'}
        </button>
      )}
      {(isRunning || isPaused) && (
        <button
          className="secondary-button"
          onClick={() => handleAction(onAbort)}
          disabled={isLoading || disabled}
          style={{ color: 'var(--color-error, #ef4444)' }}
        >
          {isLoading ? 'Aborting...' : 'Abort'}
        </button>
      )}
      {hasDeferred && (
        <button
          className="secondary-button"
          onClick={() => handleAction(onResumeDeferred)}
          disabled={isLoading || disabled}
        >
          {isLoading ? 'Resuming...' : 'Resume Deferred'}
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/libs/Google-Chrome-Extension-Library/ui/shared-components/src/components/BatchRunSummaryBanner/BatchRunSummaryBanner.tsx ====
/**
 * Batch Run Summary Banner
 *
 * Displays summary statistics for a batch run (total/processed/succeeded/failed/deferred).
 */

import React from 'react';
import type { BatchRunSnapshot } from '@chrome-ext/automation-batch';

export interface BatchRunSummaryBannerProps {
  snapshot: BatchRunSnapshot | null;
  title?: string;
  showDetails?: boolean;
  onViewLogs?: (runId: string, correlationId?: string) => void;
}

export function BatchRunSummaryBanner({
  snapshot,
  title = 'Batch Operation Status',
  showDetails = true,
  onViewLogs,
}: BatchRunSummaryBannerProps) {
  if (!snapshot) {
    return (
      <div className="modern-card" style={{ padding: 'var(--space-16)' }}>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--font-sm)', color: 'var(--muted-foreground)' }}>
          No active batch operation
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const { metrics, status, runId, correlationId } = snapshot;
  const {
    totalTasks = 0,
    completedTasks = 0,
    failedTasks = 0,
    deferredTasks = 0,
  } = metrics;

  const processedTasks = completedTasks + failedTasks;
  const succeededTasks = completedTasks;
  const progressPercent =
    totalTasks > 0 ? Math.round((processedTasks / totalTasks) * 100) : 0;

  const getStatusColor = (): string => {
    if (status === 'running') return 'var(--color-info, #2563eb)';
    if (status === 'completed') return 'var(--color-success, #16a34a)';
    if (status === 'failed' || status === 'aborted') return 'var(--color-error, #ef4444)';
    if (status === 'paused') return 'var(--color-warning, #f59e0b)';
    return 'var(--muted-foreground)';
  };

  const getStatusLabel = (): string => {
    if (status === 'running') return 'Running';
    if (status === 'completed') return 'Completed';
    if (status === 'failed') return 'Failed';
    if (status === 'aborted') return 'Aborted';
    if (status === 'paused') return 'Paused';
    return 'Pending';
  };

  return (
    <div className="modern-card" style={{ display: 'grid', gap: 'var(--space-12)' }}>
      <div
        style={{
          display: 'flex',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
          alignItems: 'center',
        }}
      >
        <div style={{ fontWeight: 600, fontSize: 'var(--font-base)' }}>{title}</div>
        <span
          style={{
            fontSize: 'var(--font-xs)',
            fontWeight: 600,
            color: getStatusColor(),
            textTransform: 'uppercase',
          }}
        >
          {getStatusLabel()}
        </span>
      </div>

      {showDetails && (
        <>
          <div style={{ display: 'grid', gap: 'var(--space-8)' }}>
            <div
              style={{
                display: 'grid',
                gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(120px, 1fr))',
                gap: 'var(--space-12)',
              }}
            >
              <div>
                <div
                  style={{
                    fontSize: 'var(--font-xs)',
                    color: 'var(--muted-foreground)',
                    marginBottom: 'var(--space-4)',
                  }}
                >
                  Total
                </div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--font-lg)', fontWeight: 600 }}>
                  {totalTasks}
                </div>
              </div>
              <div>
                <div
                  style={{
                    fontSize: 'var(--font-xs)',
                    color: 'var(--muted-foreground)',
                    marginBottom: 'var(--space-4)',
                  }}
                >
                  Processed
                </div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--font-lg)', fontWeight: 600 }}>
                  {processedTasks}
                </div>
              </div>
              <div>
                <div
                  style={{
                    fontSize: 'var(--font-xs)',
                    color: 'var(--muted-foreground)',
                    marginBottom: 'var(--space-4)',
                  }}
                >
                  Succeeded
                </div>
                <div
                  style={{
                    fontSize: 'var(--font-lg)',
                    fontWeight: 600,
                    color: 'var(--color-success, #16a34a)',
                  }}
                >
                  {succeededTasks}
                </div>
              </div>
              <div>
                <div
                  style={{
                    fontSize: 'var(--font-xs)',
                    color: 'var(--muted-foreground)',
                    marginBottom: 'var(--space-4)',
                  }}
                >
                  Failed
                </div>
                <div
                  style={{
                    fontSize: 'var(--font-lg)',
                    fontWeight: 600,
                    color: 'var(--color-error, #ef4444)',
                  }}
                >
                  {failedTasks}
                </div>
              </div>
              {deferredTasks > 0 && (
                <div>
                  <div
                    style={{
                      fontSize: 'var(--font-xs)',
                      color: 'var(--muted-foreground)',
                      marginBottom: 'var(--space-4)',
                    }}
                  >
                    Deferred
                  </div>
                  <div
                    style={{
                      fontSize: 'var(--font-lg)',
                      fontWeight: 600,
                      color: 'var(--color-warning, #f59e0b)',
                    }}
                  >
                    {deferredTasks}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {totalTasks > 0 && (
              <div>
                <div
                  style={{
                    display: 'flex',
                    justifyContent: 'space-between',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    marginBottom: 'var(--space-4)',
                  }}
                >
                  <div
                    style={{
                      fontSize: 'var(--font-xs)',
                      color: 'var(--muted-foreground)',
                    }}
                  >
                    Progress
                  </div>
                  <div
                    style={{
                      fontSize: 'var(--font-xs)',
                      fontWeight: 600,
                    }}
                  >
                    {progressPercent}%
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div
                  style={{
                    width: '100%',
                    height: '8px',
                    backgroundColor: 'var(--muted-background)',
                    borderRadius: '4px',
                    overflow: 'hidden',
                  }}
                >
                  <div
                    style={{
                      width: `${progressPercent}%`,
                      height: '100%',
                      backgroundColor: getStatusColor(),
                      transition: 'width 0.3s ease',
                    }}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {onViewLogs && (
            <div>
              <button
                className="secondary-button"
                onClick={() => onViewLogs(runId, correlationId)}
                style={{ fontSize: 'var(--font-xs)' }}
              >
                View Logs
              </button>
            </div>
          )}
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * Batch Status Pill Component
 *
 * Displays a status badge for batch task status (queued/running/succeeded/failed/deferred).
 */

import React from 'react';

export type BatchTaskStatus =
  | 'pending'
  | 'queued'
  | 'running'
  | 'completed'
  | 'succeeded'
  | 'failed'
  | 'deferred';

export interface BatchStatusPillProps {
  status: BatchTaskStatus;
  error?: string;
  attempts?: number;
  size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';
  showError?: boolean;
}

export function BatchStatusPill({
  status,
  error,
  attempts,
  size = 'md',
  showError = false,
}: BatchStatusPillProps) {
  const getStatusConfig = (): {
    label: string;
    color: string;
    bgColor: string;
  } => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'pending':
      case 'queued':
        return {
          label: 'Queued',
          color: 'var(--muted-foreground)',
          bgColor: 'var(--muted-background)',
        };
      case 'running':
        return {
          label: 'Running',
          color: 'var(--color-info, #2563eb)',
          bgColor: 'rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.1)',
        };
      case 'completed':
      case 'succeeded':
        return {
          label: 'Completed',
          color: 'var(--color-success, #16a34a)',
          bgColor: 'rgba(22, 163, 74, 0.1)',
        };
      case 'failed':
        return {
          label: 'Failed',
          color: 'var(--color-error, #ef4444)',
          bgColor: 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.1)',
        };
      case 'deferred':
        return {
          label: 'Deferred',
          color: 'var(--color-warning, #f59e0b)',
          bgColor: 'rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.1)',
        };
      default:
        return {
          label: 'Unknown',
          color: 'var(--muted-foreground)',
          bgColor: 'var(--muted-background)',
        };
    }
  };

  const getFontSize = (): string => {
    switch (size) {
      case 'sm':
        return 'var(--font-xs)';
      case 'lg':
        return 'var(--font-sm)';
      default:
        return 'var(--font-xs)';
    }
  };

  const getPadding = (): string => {
    switch (size) {
      case 'sm':
        return 'var(--space-4) var(--space-8)';
      case 'lg':
        return 'var(--space-8) var(--space-12)';
      default:
        return 'var(--space-6) var(--space-10)';
    }
  };

  const config = getStatusConfig();

  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 'var(--space-4)' }}>
      <span
        style={{
          display: 'inline-block',
          fontSize: getFontSize(),
          fontWeight: 600,
          color: config.color,
          backgroundColor: config.bgColor,
          padding: getPadding(),
          borderRadius: 'var(--radius-full)',
          textTransform: 'uppercase',
          letterSpacing: '0.025em',
        }}
      >
        {config.label}
        {attempts !== undefined && attempts > 1 && ` (${attempts})`}
      </span>
      {showError && error && (
        <div
          style={{
            fontSize: 'var(--font-xs)',
            color: 'var(--color-error, #ef4444)',
            maxWidth: '200px',
            overflow: 'hidden',
            textOverflow: 'ellipsis',
            whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
          }}
          title={error}
        >
          {error}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * Base Card Component
 *
 * Provides shared card styling and structure with overridable styles via CSS variables
 */

import React, { CSSProperties } from 'react';

export interface BaseCardProps {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  selected?: boolean;
  onClick?: () => void;
  className?: string;
  style?: CSSProperties;
  'aria-label'?: string;
}

/**
 * Base card component with overridable styles
 * Uses CSS custom properties for easy theming
 */
export function BaseCard({
  children,
  selected = false,
  onClick,
  className = 'patient-card',
  style,
  'aria-label': ariaLabel,
}: BaseCardProps): React.ReactElement {
  return (
    <div
      className={className}
      style={{
        cursor: onClick ? 'pointer' : 'default',
        backgroundColor: selected ? 'var(--accent)' : undefined,
        ...style,
      }}
      onClick={onClick}
      aria-label={ariaLabel}
    >
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * Posting Card Component
 *
 * Displays a single job posting with enrichment status indicator
 */

import React from 'react';
import { BaseCard } from './BaseCard.js';

export interface Posting {
  id: string;
  jobTitle: string;
  companyName: string;
  location: string;
  datePosted: string;
  link: string;
  dateSearched?: string;
  summary?: string;
}

export interface EnrichmentStatus {
  enriched: boolean;
  enrichedAt?: string;
}

export interface PostingCardProps {
  posting: Posting;
  selected: boolean;
  onToggle: () => void;
  enrichmentStatus?: EnrichmentStatus;
}

export function PostingCard({
  posting,
  selected,
  onToggle,
  enrichmentStatus,
}: PostingCardProps): React.ReactElement {
  // Check if posting has diagnostics (unsubstituted placeholders)
  const hasDiagnostics = (posting as unknown as { _diagnostics?: unknown })
    ._diagnostics;
  const diagnostics = hasDiagnostics
    ? (posting as unknown as { _diagnostics: Record<string, unknown> })
        ._diagnostics
    : null;

  // Format enrichment timestamp
  const formatEnrichmentDate = (dateString?: string): string => {
    if (dateString === undefined || dateString === '') return '';
    try {
      const date = new Date(dateString);
      return date.toLocaleString('en-US', {
        month: 'short',
        day: 'numeric',
        year: 'numeric',
        hour: 'numeric',
        minute: '2-digit',
      });
    } catch {
      return dateString;
    }
  };

  // Format date posted
  const formatDatePosted = (dateString: string): string => {
    try {
      // Handle "X days ago" format
      if (dateString.includes('days ago') || dateString.includes('day ago')) {
        return dateString;
      }
      // Handle diagnostic strings
      if (
        dateString.startsWith('[UNSUBSTITUTED:') ||
        dateString.startsWith('[MISSING:')
      ) {
        return dateString;
      }
      const date = new Date(dateString);
      if (isNaN(date.getTime())) {
        return dateString;
      }
      return date.toLocaleDateString();
    } catch {
      return dateString;
    }
  };

  return (
    <BaseCard
      selected={selected}
      onToggle={onToggle}
      style={{
        border: hasDiagnostics ? '2px solid orange' : undefined,
      }}
    >
      {hasDiagnostics && (
        <div
          style={{
            backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 165, 0, 0.1)',
            padding: 'var(--space-8)',
            marginBottom: 'var(--space-8)',
            borderRadius: 'var(--radius)',
            fontSize: 'var(--font-xs)',
          }}
        >
          <div
            style={{
              fontWeight: 600,
              marginBottom: 'var(--space-4)',
            }}
          >
            ⚠️ Variable Substitution Issues Detected
          </div>
          <div style={{ color: 'var(--muted-foreground)' }}>
            {Object.entries(diagnostics || {}).map(([key, value]) => (
              <div key={key} style={{ marginBottom: 'var(--space-2)' }}>
                <strong>{key}:</strong> {String(value)}
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 'var(--space-12)' }}>
        <input
          type="checkbox"
          checked={selected}
          onChange={onToggle}
          onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}
          aria-label={`Select ${posting.jobTitle} at ${posting.companyName}`}
        />
        <div style={{ flex: 1 }}>
          <div
            style={{
              display: 'flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              gap: 'var(--space-8)',
              marginBottom: 'var(--space-4)',
            }}
          >
            <div
              style={{
                fontWeight: 600,
                fontSize: 'var(--font-lg)',
                color: posting.jobTitle.startsWith('[UNSUBSTITUTED:')
                  ? 'orange'
                  : undefined,
              }}
            >
              {posting.jobTitle}
            </div>
            {enrichmentStatus && (
              <div
                style={{
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  gap: 'var(--space-4)',
                }}
                title={
                  enrichmentStatus.enriched
                    ? `Enriched: ${formatEnrichmentDate(enrichmentStatus.enrichedAt)}`
                    : 'Not enriched'
                }
              >
                <span
                  style={{
                    fontSize: 'var(--font-lg)',
                    color: enrichmentStatus.enriched
                      ? 'var(--success)'
                      : 'var(--destructive)',
                  }}
                  aria-label={
                    enrichmentStatus.enriched
                      ? `Enriched on ${formatEnrichmentDate(enrichmentStatus.enrichedAt)}`
                      : 'Not enriched'
                  }
                >
                  ●
                </span>
                {enrichmentStatus.enriched === true &&
                  enrichmentStatus.enrichedAt !== undefined &&
                  enrichmentStatus.enrichedAt !== '' && (
                    <span
                      style={{
                        fontSize: 'var(--font-xs)',
                        color: 'var(--muted-foreground)',
                      }}
                    >
                      Enriched:{' '}
                      {formatEnrichmentDate(enrichmentStatus.enrichedAt)}
                    </span>
                  )}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
          <div
            style={{
              color: 'var(--muted-foreground)',
              fontSize: 'var(--font-sm)',
              marginBottom: 'var(--space-4)',
            }}
          >
            {posting.companyName || '[No company]'} •{' '}
            {posting.location || '[No location]'}
          </div>
          <div
            style={{
              color: 'var(--muted-foreground)',
              fontSize: 'var(--font-xs)',
              marginBottom: 'var(--space-4)',
            }}
          >
            <strong>ID:</strong> {posting.id} | <strong>Posted:</strong>{' '}
            {formatDatePosted(posting.datePosted)}
          </div>
          {posting.summary !== undefined && posting.summary !== '' && (
            <div
              style={{
                color: 'var(--muted-foreground)',
                fontSize: 'var(--font-xs)',
                marginBottom: 'var(--space-4)',
                fontStyle: 'italic',
              }}
            >
              {posting.summary.substring(0, 100)}
              {posting.summary.length > 100 ? '...' : ''}
            </div>
          )}
          <a
            href={posting.link}
            target="_blank"
            rel="noopener noreferrer"
            onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}
            style={{
              color: 'var(--primary)',
              fontSize: 'var(--font-sm)',
              textDecoration: 'none',
              marginTop: 'var(--space-4)',
              display: 'inline-block',
            }}
          >
            View on Indeed →
          </a>
        </div>
      </div>
    </BaseCard>
  );
}
