==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/libs/Google-Chrome-Extension-Library/ui/shared-components/src/components/RecordingTab/RecordingTab.tsx ====
/**
 * Shared Recording Tab Component
 * 
 * Full-featured recording control panel for capturing user interactions
 * and converting them to recipe format.
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
import { logger } from '@chrome-ext/core-telemetry';
import type { RecordedStepWithDescription } from '@chrome-ext/automation-recording';
import type { RecipeMetadata } from '@chrome-ext/automation-recording';

export interface RecordingState {
  isRecording: boolean;
  isPaused: boolean;
  steps: RecordedStepWithDescription[];
  taskDescription?: string;
}

export interface RecordingTabProps {
  /** Current recording state */
  state: RecordingState;
  /** Callback when recording starts */
  onStartRecording: () => Promise<void>;
  /** Callback when recording stops */
  onStopRecording: () => Promise<void>;
  /** Callback when recording pauses */
  onPauseRecording?: () => Promise<void>;
  /** Callback when recording resumes */
  onResumeRecording?: () => Promise<void>;
  /** Callback when recording is cleared */
  onClearRecording: () => Promise<void>;
  /** Callback to update step description */
  onUpdateStepDescription?: (index: number, description: string) => Promise<void>;
  /** Callback to delete a step */
  onDeleteStep?: (index: number) => Promise<void>;
  /** Callback to update task description */
  onUpdateTaskDescription?: (description: string) => Promise<void>;
  /** Callback to export recipe */
  onExportRecipe?: (metadata: RecipeMetadata) => Promise<string>;
  /** Callback to import recording */
  onImportRecording?: (data: string) => Promise<void>;
  /** Error message to display */
  error?: string | null;
  /** App name for display */
  appName?: string;
  /** Storage key for persistence */
  storageKey?: string;
}

export function RecordingTab({
  state,
  onStartRecording,
  onStopRecording,
  onPauseRecording,
  onResumeRecording,
  onClearRecording,
  onUpdateStepDescription,
  onDeleteStep,
  onUpdateTaskDescription,
  onExportRecipe,
  onImportRecording,
  error: externalError,
  appName = 'Recording',
  storageKey = 'recording-state',
}: RecordingTabProps): JSX.Element {
  const [taskDescription, setTaskDescription] = useState(state.taskDescription || '');
  const [editingStepIndex, setEditingStepIndex] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [editingStepDescription, setEditingStepDescription] = useState('');
  const [exportMetadata, setExportMetadata] = useState<RecipeMetadata>({
    name: '',
    description: '',
    tags: [],
  });
  const [showExportDialog, setShowExportDialog] = useState(false);
  const [isExporting, setIsExporting] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(externalError || null);
  const [notification, setNotification] = useState<{ message: string; type: 'success' | 'error' } | null>(null);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  // Sync external error
  useEffect(() => {
    setError(externalError || null);
  }, [externalError]);

  useEffect(() => {
    setTaskDescription(state.taskDescription || '');
  }, [state.taskDescription]);

  // Auto-save task description
  useEffect(() => {
    if (taskDescription && storageKey) {
      const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
        try {
          chrome.storage.local.set({
            [`${storageKey}:taskDescription`]: taskDescription,
          });
        } catch (err) {
          logger.warn('Failed to save task description', err);
        }
      }, 500);
      return () => clearTimeout(timeout);
    }
  }, [taskDescription, storageKey]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!onUpdateTaskDescription) {
      return;
    }
    const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
      onUpdateTaskDescription(taskDescription).catch(err => {
        logger.warn('Failed to sync task description', err);
      });
    }, 500);
    return () => clearTimeout(timeout);
  }, [taskDescription, onUpdateTaskDescription]);

  // Load saved task description
  useEffect(() => {
    if (storageKey) {
      chrome.storage.local.get([`${storageKey}:taskDescription`]).then(result => {
        const saved = result[`${storageKey}:taskDescription`];
        if (saved && !taskDescription) {
          setTaskDescription(saved);
        }
      }).catch(err => {
        logger.warn('Failed to load task description', err);
      });
    }
  }, [storageKey]);

  // Keyboard shortcuts
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      // Don't handle shortcuts when typing in inputs
      if (event.target instanceof HTMLInputElement || event.target instanceof HTMLTextAreaElement) {
        return;
      }

      // Ctrl/Cmd + R: Start/Stop recording
      if ((event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey) && event.key === 'r') {
        event.preventDefault();
        if (state.isRecording) {
          handleStopRecording();
        } else {
          handleStartRecording();
        }
      }

      // Esc: Cancel editing or stop recording
      if (event.key === 'Escape') {
        if (editingStepIndex !== null) {
          setEditingStepIndex(null);
          setEditingStepDescription('');
        } else if (state.isRecording) {
          handleStopRecording();
        }
      }

      // Ctrl/Cmd + Z: Undo (if supported)
      if ((event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey) && event.key === 'z' && !event.shiftKey) {
        // Undo would be handled by step builder if implemented
      }

      // Ctrl/Cmd + Shift + Z: Redo
      if ((event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey) && event.key === 'z' && event.shiftKey) {
        // Redo would be handled by step builder if implemented
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [state.isRecording, editingStepIndex]);

  const handleStartRecording = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      setError(null);
      await onStartRecording();
      logger.info('Recording started', { appName });
      showNotification('Recording started', 'success');
    } catch (err) {
      const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to start recording';
      setError(message);
      logger.error('Failed to start recording', err);
      showNotification(message, 'error');
    }
  }, [onStartRecording, appName]);

  const handleStopRecording = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      setError(null);
      await onStopRecording();
      logger.info('Recording stopped', { stepCount: state.steps.length });
      showNotification('Recording stopped', 'success');
    } catch (err) {
      const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to stop recording';
      setError(message);
      logger.error('Failed to stop recording', err);
      showNotification(message, 'error');
    }
  }, [onStopRecording, state.steps.length]);

  const handlePauseRecording = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!onPauseRecording) return;
    try {
      setError(null);
      await onPauseRecording();
      logger.info('Recording paused');
      showNotification('Recording paused', 'success');
    } catch (err) {
      const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to pause recording';
      setError(message);
      logger.error('Failed to pause recording', err);
      showNotification(message, 'error');
    }
  }, [onPauseRecording]);

  const handleResumeRecording = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!onResumeRecording) return;
    try {
      setError(null);
      await onResumeRecording();
      logger.info('Recording resumed');
      showNotification('Recording resumed', 'success');
    } catch (err) {
      const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to resume recording';
      setError(message);
      logger.error('Failed to resume recording', err);
      showNotification(message, 'error');
    }
  }, [onResumeRecording]);

  const handleClearRecording = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!confirm('Are you sure you want to clear all recorded steps? This cannot be undone.')) {
      return;
    }
    try {
      setError(null);
      await onClearRecording();
      setTaskDescription('');
      setEditingStepIndex(null);
      logger.info('Recording cleared');
      showNotification('Recording cleared', 'success');
    } catch (err) {
      const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to clear recording';
      setError(message);
      logger.error('Failed to clear recording', err);
      showNotification(message, 'error');
    }
  }, [onClearRecording]);

  const handleEditStep = useCallback((index: number) => {
    const step = state.steps[index];
    setEditingStepIndex(index);
    setEditingStepDescription(step.stepDescription || '');
  }, [state.steps]);

  const handleSaveStepDescription = useCallback(async (index: number) => {
    if (!onUpdateStepDescription) return;
    try {
      await onUpdateStepDescription(index, editingStepDescription);
      setEditingStepIndex(null);
      setEditingStepDescription('');
      showNotification('Step description updated', 'success');
    } catch (err) {
      const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to update step description';
      setError(message);
      showNotification(message, 'error');
    }
  }, [onUpdateStepDescription, editingStepDescription]);

  const handleDeleteStep = useCallback(async (index: number) => {
    if (!onDeleteStep) return;
    if (!confirm(`Delete step ${index + 1}?`)) {
      return;
    }
    try {
      await onDeleteStep(index);
      showNotification('Step deleted', 'success');
    } catch (err) {
      const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to delete step';
      setError(message);
      showNotification(message, 'error');
    }
  }, [onDeleteStep]);

  const handleExport = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!onExportRecipe) return;
    if (!exportMetadata.name.trim()) {
      setError('Recipe name is required');
      return;
    }
    try {
      setIsExporting(true);
      setError(null);
      const json = await onExportRecipe({
        ...exportMetadata,
        description: taskDescription || exportMetadata.description,
      });
      
      // Download as file
      const blob = new Blob([json], { type: 'application/json' });
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = url;
      a.download = `${exportMetadata.name.replace(/[^a-z0-9]/gi, '-').toLowerCase()}.json`;
      document.body.appendChild(a);
      a.click();
      document.body.removeChild(a);
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      
      setShowExportDialog(false);
      showNotification('Recipe exported successfully', 'success');
      logger.info('Recipe exported', { name: exportMetadata.name, stepCount: state.steps.length });
    } catch (err) {
      const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to export recipe';
      setError(message);
      showNotification(message, 'error');
      logger.error('Failed to export recipe', err);
    } finally {
      setIsExporting(false);
    }
  }, [onExportRecipe, exportMetadata, taskDescription, state.steps.length]);

  const handleImport = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!onImportRecording) return;
    fileInputRef.current?.click();
  }, [onImportRecording]);

  const handleFileSelect = useCallback(async (event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = event.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file || !onImportRecording) return;
    
    try {
      const text = await file.text();
      await onImportRecording(text);
      showNotification('Recording imported successfully', 'success');
      logger.info('Recording imported', { fileName: file.name });
    } catch (err) {
      const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to import recording';
      setError(message);
      showNotification(message, 'error');
      logger.error('Failed to import recording', err);
    } finally {
      if (fileInputRef.current) {
        fileInputRef.current.value = '';
      }
    }
  }, [onImportRecording]);

  const showNotification = useCallback((message: string, type: 'success' | 'error') => {
    setNotification({ message, type });
    setTimeout(() => setNotification(null), 3000);
  }, []);

  const formatStepType = (type: string): string => {
    return type.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + type.slice(1);
  };

  const formatStepDescription = (step: RecordedStepWithDescription): string => {
    return step.stepDescription || step.description || formatStepType(step.type);
  };

  return (
    <div className="content-container" role="main" aria-label="Recording Control Panel">
      {/* Notification */}
      {notification && (
        <div
          className="modern-card"
          style={{
            position: 'fixed',
            top: '12px',
            right: '12px',
            zIndex: 1000,
            background: notification.type === 'error' ? 'var(--destructive)' : 'var(--success)',
            color: 'white',
            padding: 'var(--space-12)',
            borderRadius: 'var(--radius-md)',
            boxShadow: '0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.15)',
            maxWidth: '300px',
          }}
          role="alert"
        >
          {notification.message}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Error Display */}
      {error && (
        <div className="modern-card" style={{ marginBottom: 'var(--space-24)', background: 'var(--destructive)', color: 'white' }}>
          <p style={{ margin: 0 }}>{error}</p>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Recording Controls */}
      <div className="modern-card">
        <h2 className="section-heading">Recording Controls</h2>
        <p style={{ color: 'var(--muted-foreground)', marginBottom: 'var(--space-16)' }}>
          Record user interactions in the active tab. Actions within the extension are not recorded.
        </p>

        {/* Status Indicator */}
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--space-12)', marginBottom: 'var(--space-16)' }}>
          <div
            style={{
              width: '12px',
              height: '12px',
              borderRadius: '50%',
              background: state.isRecording
                ? (state.isPaused ? 'var(--warning)' : 'var(--destructive)')
                : 'var(--muted-foreground)',
              animation: state.isRecording && !state.isPaused ? 'pulse 2s infinite' : 'none',
            }}
            aria-label={state.isRecording ? (state.isPaused ? 'Recording paused' : 'Recording') : 'Not recording'}
          />
          <span style={{ fontWeight: 500 }}>
            {state.isRecording
              ? state.isPaused
                ? 'Recording Paused'
                : 'Recording...'
              : 'Not Recording'}
          </span>
          {state.steps.length > 0 && (
            <span style={{ color: 'var(--muted-foreground)', marginLeft: 'auto' }}>
              {state.steps.length} step{state.steps.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Control Buttons */}
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 'var(--space-12)', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          {!state.isRecording ? (
            <button
              className="cta-button"
              onClick={handleStartRecording}
              aria-label="Start recording (Ctrl+R)"
            >
              Start Recording
            </button>
          ) : (
            <>
              <button
                className="cta-button cta-button-running"
                onClick={handleStopRecording}
                aria-label="Stop recording (Ctrl+R)"
              >
                Stop Recording
              </button>
              {onPauseRecording && onResumeRecording && (
                <>
                  {!state.isPaused ? (
                    <button
                      className="cta-button"
                      onClick={handlePauseRecording}
                      aria-label="Pause recording"
                    >
                      Pause
                    </button>
                  ) : (
                    <button
                      className="cta-button"
                      onClick={handleResumeRecording}
                      aria-label="Resume recording"
                    >
                      Resume
                    </button>
                  )}
                </>
              )}
            </>
          )}
          {state.steps.length > 0 && (
            <button
              className="cta-button"
              onClick={handleClearRecording}
              aria-label="Clear all recorded steps"
            >
              Clear Steps
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Task Description */}
      <div className="modern-card" style={{ marginTop: 'var(--space-24)' }}>
        <h3 className="section-heading">Task Description</h3>
        <textarea
          value={taskDescription}
          onChange={e => setTaskDescription(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="Describe what this automation does..."
          rows={3}
          style={{
            width: '100%',
            padding: 'var(--space-8)',
            marginTop: 'var(--space-8)',
            borderRadius: 'var(--radius-sm)',
            border: '1px solid var(--border)',
            background: 'var(--input-background)',
            color: 'var(--foreground)',
            fontFamily: 'inherit',
            fontSize: 'var(--font-body)',
          }}
          aria-label="Task description"
        />
      </div>

      {/* Recorded Steps */}
      <div className="modern-card" style={{ marginTop: 'var(--space-24)' }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 'var(--space-16)' }}>
          <h3 className="section-heading">Recorded Steps</h3>
          {state.steps.length > 0 && (
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 'var(--space-8)' }}>
              {onExportRecipe && (
                <button
                  className="cta-button"
                  onClick={() => setShowExportDialog(true)}
                  aria-label="Export recipe"
                >
                  Export Recipe
                </button>
              )}
              {onImportRecording && (
                <>
                  <button
                    className="cta-button"
                    onClick={handleImport}
                    aria-label="Import recording"
                  >
                    Import
                  </button>
                  <input
                    ref={fileInputRef}
                    type="file"
                    accept=".json"
                    style={{ display: 'none' }}
                    onChange={handleFileSelect}
                    aria-label="Import recording file"
                  />
                </>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {state.steps.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="empty-state">
            <p>No steps recorded yet. Start recording to capture interactions.</p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <ol
            style={{
              paddingLeft: 'var(--space-24)',
              lineHeight: 'var(--line-height-relaxed)',
              listStyle: 'decimal',
            }}
            aria-label="Recorded steps list"
          >
            {state.steps.map((step, index) => (
              <li
                key={`${step.timestamp}-${index}`}
                style={{
                  marginBottom: 'var(--space-12)',
                  padding: 'var(--space-8)',
                  borderRadius: 'var(--radius-sm)',
                  background: editingStepIndex === index ? 'var(--accent)' : 'transparent',
                }}
              >
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'flex-start', gap: 'var(--space-8)' }}>
                  <div style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 'var(--space-8)', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 'var(--space-4)' }}>
                      <strong>{formatStepType(step.type)}</strong>
                      {step.locator && (
                        <code
                          style={{
                            fontSize: 'var(--font-subtext)',
                            padding: '2px 6px',
                            background: 'var(--muted)',
                            borderRadius: 'var(--radius-sm)',
                          }}
                        >
                          {step.locator.selector.slice(0, 50)}
                          {step.locator.selector.length > 50 ? '...' : ''}
                        </code>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    {editingStepIndex === index ? (
                      <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 'var(--space-8)', marginTop: 'var(--space-8)' }}>
                        <input
                          type="text"
                          value={editingStepDescription}
                          onChange={e => setEditingStepDescription(e.target.value)}
                          placeholder="Step description..."
                          style={{
                            flex: 1,
                            padding: 'var(--space-8)',
                            borderRadius: 'var(--radius-sm)',
                            border: '1px solid var(--border)',
                            background: 'var(--input-background)',
                            color: 'var(--foreground)',
                          }}
                          onKeyDown={e => {
                            if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                              handleSaveStepDescription(index);
                            } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                              setEditingStepIndex(null);
                              setEditingStepDescription('');
                            }
                          }}
                          autoFocus
                          aria-label="Step description input"
                        />
                        <button
                          className="cta-button"
                          onClick={() => handleSaveStepDescription(index)}
                          aria-label="Save step description"
                        >
                          Save
                        </button>
                        <button
                          className="cta-button"
                          onClick={() => {
                            setEditingStepIndex(null);
                            setEditingStepDescription('');
                          }}
                          aria-label="Cancel editing"
                        >
                          Cancel
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    ) : (
                      <>
                        <p style={{ margin: 'var(--space-4) 0', color: 'var(--foreground)' }}>
                          {formatStepDescription(step)}
                        </p>
                        {step.value !== undefined && (
                          <span style={{ color: 'var(--muted-foreground)', fontSize: 'var(--font-subtext)' }}>
                            Value: {String(step.value).slice(0, 100)}
                            {String(step.value).length > 100 ? '...' : ''}
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 'var(--space-4)' }}>
                    {onUpdateStepDescription && editingStepIndex !== index && (
                      <button
                        onClick={() => handleEditStep(index)}
                        aria-label={`Edit step ${index + 1} description`}
                        style={{
                          padding: 'var(--space-4) var(--space-8)',
                          border: '1px solid var(--border)',
                          background: 'var(--background)',
                          borderRadius: 'var(--radius-sm)',
                          cursor: 'pointer',
                          fontSize: 'var(--font-subtext)',
                        }}
                      >
                        Edit
                      </button>
                    )}
                    {onDeleteStep && (
                      <button
                        onClick={() => handleDeleteStep(index)}
                        aria-label={`Delete step ${index + 1}`}
                        style={{
                          padding: 'var(--space-4) var(--space-8)',
                          border: '1px solid var(--destructive)',
                          background: 'var(--background)',
                          color: 'var(--destructive)',
                          borderRadius: 'var(--radius-sm)',
                          cursor: 'pointer',
                          fontSize: 'var(--font-subtext)',
                        }}
                      >
                        Delete
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ol>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Export Dialog */}
      {showExportDialog && onExportRecipe && (
        <div
          style={{
            position: 'fixed',
            top: 0,
            left: 0,
            right: 0,
            bottom: 0,
            background: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)',
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'center',
            zIndex: 1000,
          }}
          onClick={() => setShowExportDialog(false)}
          role="dialog"
          aria-label="Export recipe dialog"
        >
          <div
            className="modern-card"
            style={{
              maxWidth: '500px',
              width: '90%',
              maxHeight: '90vh',
              overflow: 'auto',
            }}
            onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}
          >
            <h3 className="section-heading">Export Recipe</h3>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 'var(--space-12)' }}>
              <label style={{ fontSize: 'var(--font-subtext)' }}>
                Recipe Name *
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={exportMetadata.name}
                  onChange={e => setExportMetadata({ ...exportMetadata, name: e.target.value })}
                  placeholder="My Recipe"
                  style={{
                    width: '100%',
                    padding: 'var(--space-8)',
                    marginTop: 'var(--space-8)',
                    borderRadius: 'var(--radius-sm)',
                    border: '1px solid var(--border)',
                    background: 'var(--input-background)',
                    color: 'var(--foreground)',
                  }}
                  aria-required="true"
                  aria-label="Recipe name"
                />
              </label>
              <label style={{ fontSize: 'var(--font-subtext)' }}>
                Description
                <textarea
                  value={exportMetadata.description || ''}
                  onChange={e => setExportMetadata({ ...exportMetadata, description: e.target.value })}
                  placeholder="Recipe description..."
                  rows={3}
                  style={{
                    width: '100%',
                    padding: 'var(--space-8)',
                    marginTop: 'var(--space-8)',
                    borderRadius: 'var(--radius-sm)',
                    border: '1px solid var(--border)',
                    background: 'var(--input-background)',
                    color: 'var(--foreground)',
                  }}
                  aria-label="Recipe description"
                />
              </label>
              <label style={{ fontSize: 'var(--font-subtext)' }}>
                Tags (comma-separated)
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={exportMetadata.tags?.join(', ') || ''}
                  onChange={e =>
                    setExportMetadata({
                      ...exportMetadata,
                      tags: e.target.value.split(',').map(t => t.trim()).filter(Boolean),
                    })
                  }
                  placeholder="tag1, tag2, tag3"
                  style={{
                    width: '100%',
                    padding: 'var(--space-8)',
                    marginTop: 'var(--space-8)',
                    borderRadius: 'var(--radius-sm)',
                    border: '1px solid var(--border)',
                    background: 'var(--input-background)',
                    color: 'var(--foreground)',
                  }}
                  aria-label="Recipe tags"
                />
              </label>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 'var(--space-8)', justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}>
                <button
                  className="cta-button"
                  onClick={() => setShowExportDialog(false)}
                  disabled={isExporting}
                  aria-label="Cancel export"
                >
                  Cancel
                </button>
                <button
                  className="cta-button"
                  onClick={handleExport}
                  disabled={isExporting || !exportMetadata.name.trim()}
                  aria-label="Export recipe"
                >
                  {isExporting ? 'Exporting...' : 'Export'}
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      <style>{`
        @keyframes pulse {
          0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
          50% { opacity: 0.5; }
        }
      `}</style>
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * Hook for subscribing to batch run status updates
 */

import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import type { BatchRunSnapshot } from '@chrome-ext/automation-batch';

export interface UseBatchRunStatusOptions {
  runId: string | null;
  operationId: string;
  appId: string;
  pollIntervalMs?: number;
  enabled?: boolean;
}

export interface UseBatchRunStatusResult {
  snapshot: BatchRunSnapshot | null;
  isLoading: boolean;
  error: Error | null;
  refetch: () => Promise<void>;
}

/**
 * Hook to fetch and subscribe to batch run status
 */
export function useBatchRunStatus({
  runId,
  operationId,
  appId,
  pollIntervalMs = 2000,
  enabled = true,
}: UseBatchRunStatusOptions): UseBatchRunStatusResult {
  const [snapshot, setSnapshot] = useState<BatchRunSnapshot | null>(null);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<Error | null>(null);

  const fetchStatus = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!runId || !enabled) {
      setSnapshot(null);
      return;
    }

    setIsLoading(true);
    setError(null);

    try {
      const response = await chrome.runtime.sendMessage({
        type: `GET_${operationId.toUpperCase().replace(/-/g, '_')}_BATCH_STATUS`,
        runId,
      });

      if (response?.ok && response.snapshot) {
        setSnapshot(response.snapshot);
      } else {
        setError(new Error(response?.error ?? 'Failed to fetch batch status'));
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err : new Error('Unknown error'));
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  }, [runId, operationId, enabled]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!runId || !enabled) {
      return;
    }

    // Initial fetch
    fetchStatus();

    // Set up polling
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      fetchStatus();
    }, pollIntervalMs);

    // Also listen for runtime messages
    const listener = (msg: any) => {
      if (
        msg.type === 'BATCH_RUN_STARTED' ||
        msg.type === 'BATCH_RUN_COMPLETED' ||
        msg.type === 'BATCH_RUN_ERROR'
      ) {
        if (msg.runId === runId) {
          fetchStatus();
        }
      }
    };

    chrome.runtime.onMessage.addListener(listener);

    return () => {
      clearInterval(interval);
      chrome.runtime.onMessage.removeListener(listener);
    };
  }, [runId, enabled, pollIntervalMs, fetchStatus]);

  return {
    snapshot,
    isLoading,
    error,
    refetch: fetchStatus,
  };
}










==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/libs/Google-Chrome-Extension-Library/ui/shared-components/src/hooks/useDebounce.ts ====
/**
 * Custom hook for debouncing values
 *
 * Useful for reducing re-renders and API calls when user is typing
 */

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';

/**
 * Debounce a value with specified delay
 * @param value - The value to debounce
 * @param delay - Delay in milliseconds (default: 300ms)
 * @returns Debounced value
 */
export function useDebounce<T>(value: T, delay = 300): T {
  const [debouncedValue, setDebouncedValue] = useState<T>(value);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handler = setTimeout(() => {
      setDebouncedValue(value);
    }, delay);

    return () => {
      clearTimeout(handler);
    };
  }, [value, delay]);

  return debouncedValue;
}










==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/libs/Google-Chrome-Extension-Library/ui/shared-components/src/hooks/useExecutionStatus.ts ====
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';

const EXECUTION_STATUS_STORAGE_KEY = 'recipe_execution_status';
const EXECUTION_LOGS_STORAGE_KEY = 'recipe_execution_logs';

export type ExecutionStatus = {
  running: boolean;
  success: boolean | null;
  paused?: boolean;
  error?: string;
  progress?: string;
  correlationId?: string;
  lastUpdate?: string;
};

export type ExecutionStatusMap = Record<string, ExecutionStatus>;

type UseExecutionStatusOptions = {
  recipeKeys?: string[];
};

type ExecutionSelection = {
  key: string | null;
  status: ExecutionStatus | null;
};

type ExecutionStatusResult = {
  statusMap: ExecutionStatusMap;
  logs: string[];
  lastLog: string | null;
  selectedKey: string | null;
  selectedStatus: ExecutionStatus | null;
};

function pickLatestStatus(
  statusMap: ExecutionStatusMap,
  recipeKeys?: string[]
): ExecutionSelection {
  const entries = (recipeKeys && recipeKeys.length > 0
    ? recipeKeys.map(key => [key, statusMap[key]])
    : Object.entries(statusMap)
  ).filter((entry): entry is [string, ExecutionStatus] => {
    const status = entry[1];
    return Boolean(status);
  });

  const runningEntry = entries.find(([, status]) => status.running === true);
  if (runningEntry) {
    return { key: runningEntry[0], status: runningEntry[1] };
  }

  let latest: ExecutionSelection = { key: null, status: null };
  let latestTimestamp = 0;

  for (const [key, status] of entries) {
    const timestamp = status.lastUpdate ? Date.parse(status.lastUpdate) : 0;
    if (timestamp >= latestTimestamp) {
      latestTimestamp = timestamp;
      latest = { key, status };
    }
  }

  return latest;
}

export function useExecutionStatus(
  options: UseExecutionStatusOptions = {}
): ExecutionStatusResult {
  const [statusMap, setStatusMap] = useState<ExecutionStatusMap>({});
  const [logs, setLogs] = useState<string[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof chrome === 'undefined' || !chrome.storage?.local) {
      return;
    }

    const loadInitial = async () => {
      try {
        const result = await chrome.storage.local.get([
          EXECUTION_STATUS_STORAGE_KEY,
          EXECUTION_LOGS_STORAGE_KEY,
        ]);
        const status = result[EXECUTION_STATUS_STORAGE_KEY];
        const storedLogs = result[EXECUTION_LOGS_STORAGE_KEY];
        if (status && typeof status === 'object') {
          setStatusMap(status as ExecutionStatusMap);
        }
        if (Array.isArray(storedLogs)) {
          setLogs(storedLogs);
        }
      } catch {
        // Ignore storage errors to keep UI responsive
      }
    };

    void loadInitial();

    const handleChange = (
      changes: Record<string, chrome.storage.StorageChange>,
      areaName: string
    ) => {
      if (areaName !== 'local') return;
      if (changes[EXECUTION_STATUS_STORAGE_KEY]) {
        const nextStatus = changes[EXECUTION_STATUS_STORAGE_KEY]
          .newValue as ExecutionStatusMap;
        setStatusMap(nextStatus ?? {});
      }
      if (changes[EXECUTION_LOGS_STORAGE_KEY]) {
        const nextLogs = changes[EXECUTION_LOGS_STORAGE_KEY]
          .newValue as string[];
        setLogs(Array.isArray(nextLogs) ? nextLogs : []);
      }
    };

    chrome.storage.onChanged.addListener(handleChange);
    return () => {
      chrome.storage.onChanged.removeListener(handleChange);
    };
  }, []);

  const selection = useMemo(
    () => pickLatestStatus(statusMap, options.recipeKeys),
    [statusMap, options.recipeKeys]
  );
  const lastLog = logs.length > 0 ? logs[logs.length - 1] : null;

  return {
    statusMap,
    logs,
    lastLog,
    selectedKey: selection.key,
    selectedStatus: selection.status,
  };
}



==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/libs/Google-Chrome-Extension-Library/ui/shared-components/src/hooks/useTableState.ts ====
/**
 * Custom hook for managing table state with persistence
 *
 * Handles pagination and sorting state with chrome.storage persistence
 */

import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { logger } from '@chrome-ext/core-telemetry';

export interface TableState {
  currentPage: number;
  itemsPerPage: number;
  sortField: string;
  sortDirection: 'asc' | 'desc';
}

const DEFAULT_STATE: TableState = {
  currentPage: 1,
  itemsPerPage: 25,
  sortField: '',
  sortDirection: 'desc',
};

/**
 * Hook for managing table state with persistence
 * @param storageKey - Key for chrome.storage.local persistence
 * @param defaultSortField - Default field to sort by
 * @param defaultSortDirection - Default sort direction
 * @returns Table state and setters
 */
export function useTableState(
  storageKey: string,
  defaultSortField = '',
  defaultSortDirection: 'asc' | 'desc' = 'desc'
): {
  state: TableState;
  setCurrentPage: (page: number) => void;
  setItemsPerPage: (items: number) => void;
  setSortField: (field: string) => void;
  setSortDirection: (direction: 'asc' | 'desc') => void;
  resetState: () => void;
} {
  const [state, setState] = useState<TableState>({
    ...DEFAULT_STATE,
    sortField: defaultSortField,
    sortDirection: defaultSortDirection,
  });

  // Load persisted state on mount
  useEffect(() => {
    async function loadPersistedState() {
      try {
        const result = await chrome.storage.local.get(storageKey);
        const persisted = result[storageKey] as Partial<TableState> | undefined;
        if (persisted) {
          setState(prev => ({
            ...prev,
            ...persisted,
            sortField: persisted.sortField ?? defaultSortField,
            sortDirection: persisted.sortDirection ?? defaultSortDirection,
          }));
          logger.debug('Loaded persisted table state', {
            storageKey,
            state: persisted,
          });
        }
      } catch (error) {
        logger.error('Error loading persisted table state', error as Error, {
          storageKey,
        });
      }
    }
    loadPersistedState();
  }, [storageKey, defaultSortField, defaultSortDirection]);

  // Persist state when it changes
  useEffect(() => {
    async function persistState() {
      try {
        await chrome.storage.local.set({ [storageKey]: state });
        logger.debug('Persisted table state', {
          storageKey,
          state,
        });
      } catch (error) {
        // Handle quota exceeded gracefully
        if (error instanceof Error && error.message.includes('QUOTA')) {
          logger.warn('Storage quota exceeded, cannot persist table state', {
            storageKey,
          });
        } else {
          logger.error('Error persisting table state', error as Error, {
            storageKey,
          });
        }
      }
    }
    persistState();
  }, [state, storageKey]);

  const setCurrentPage = useCallback((page: number) => {
    setState(prev => ({ ...prev, currentPage: page }));
  }, []);

  const setItemsPerPage = useCallback((items: number) => {
    setState(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      itemsPerPage: items,
      currentPage: 1, // Reset to first page when page size changes
    }));
  }, []);

  const setSortField = useCallback((field: string) => {
    setState(prev => ({ ...prev, sortField: field }));
  }, []);

  const setSortDirection = useCallback((direction: 'asc' | 'desc') => {
    setState(prev => ({ ...prev, sortDirection: direction }));
  }, []);

  const resetState = useCallback(() => {
    setState({
      ...DEFAULT_STATE,
      sortField: defaultSortField,
      sortDirection: defaultSortDirection,
    });
  }, [defaultSortField, defaultSortDirection]);

  return {
    state,
    setCurrentPage,
    setItemsPerPage,
    setSortField,
    setSortDirection,
    resetState,
  };
}

  // add methods during Phase 4+ as needed

==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/libs/web-documentation/README.md ====
# Web Documentation Scraper

A TypeScript library for scraping documentation websites and converting them to clean Markdown format.

## Features

- **HTTP Scraping**: Robust web page fetching with retry logic and timeouts
- **HTML to Markdown**: Intelligent conversion preserving structure and formatting
- **File Output**: Batch writing of documentation files with customizable naming
- **CLI Tool**: Command-line interface for easy usage
- **TypeScript**: Full type safety and modern ES modules

## Installation

This library is part of the monorepo. To use it:

```bash
# Build the library
pnpm nx build web-documentation

# Run the CLI
pnpm nx run web-documentation:scrape -- <urls...>
```

## Usage

### CLI Usage

```bash
# Basic usage
pnpm nx run web-documentation:scrape -- https://docs.example.com/api

# Multiple URLs with custom output directory
pnpm nx run web-documentation:scrape -- \
  https://docs.example.com/api \
  https://docs.example.com/guide \
  --output-dir ./documentation

# With numbered filenames
pnpm nx run web-documentation:scrape -- \
  https://docs.example.com/api \
  --output-dir ./docs \
  --numbered

# Use browser automation for dynamic API documentation
pnpm nx run web-documentation:scrape -- \
  https://api.example.com/docs \
  --browser \
  --headed \
  --output-dir ./api-docs
```

### Programmatic Usage

```typescript
import { DocumentationScraper, MarkdownConverter, FileWriter } from '@mm/web-documentation';

// Initialize components
const scraper = new DocumentationScraper({
  userAgent: 'My-Scraper/1.0.0',
  timeout: 30000,
});

const converter = new MarkdownConverter({
  includeCodeExamples: true,
  includeApiReference: true,
  includeToc: true,
});

const writer = new FileWriter();

// Scrape, convert, and save
const urls = [
  'https://docs.zoominfo.com/reference/overview',
  'https://docs.zoominfo.com/reference/searchinterface_searchcontact',
];

const pages = await scraper.scrapePages(urls);
const docs = pages.map(page => converter.convert(page));
await writer.writeFiles(docs, './documentation-3rd-party/Zoom-Info-API');
```

## API Reference

### DocumentationScraper

```typescript
class DocumentationScraper {
  constructor(options?: ScraperOptions);

  scrapePage(url: string): Promise<DocumentationPage>;
  scrapePages(urls: string[]): Promise<DocumentationPage[]>;
}
```

### MarkdownConverter

```typescript
class MarkdownConverter {
  constructor(options?: ConverterOptions);

  convert(page: DocumentationPage): ScrapedDocumentation;
}
```

### FileWriter

```typescript
class FileWriter {
  writeFile(doc: ScrapedDocumentation, outputPath: string): Promise<void>;
  writeFiles(docs: ScrapedDocumentation[], outputDir: string, filenamePattern?: Function): Promise<void>;
}
```

## Configuration Options

### ScraperOptions

- `userAgent?: string` - Custom user agent string
- `timeout?: number` - Request timeout in milliseconds (default: 30000)
- `maxRetries?: number` - Maximum retry attempts (default: 3)
- `retryDelay?: number` - Base delay between retries in milliseconds (default: 1000)
- `useBrowser?: boolean` - Use browser automation for dynamic content (default: false)
- `browserWaitTime?: number` - Wait time for dynamic content in milliseconds (default: 5000)
- `headless?: boolean` - Run browser in headless mode (default: true)

### ConverterOptions

- `includeCodeExamples?: boolean` - Include code blocks in output (default: true)
- `includeApiReference?: boolean` - Include API reference sections (default: true)
- `includeToc?: boolean` - Generate table of contents (default: true)
- `frontmatter?: object` - Additional frontmatter metadata

## Output Format

Each scraped page is converted to Markdown with frontmatter:

```markdown
---
title: "Contacts"
url: "https://docs.zoominfo.com/reference/searchinterface_searchcontact"
scrapedAt: "2025-12-19T10:00:00.000Z"
lastModified: "2025-12-19T09:00:00.000Z"
---

# Contacts

## Overview

This endpoint allows you to search for contacts...
```

## ZoomInfo API Documentation

This library was specifically designed to scrape ZoomInfo API documentation. The following URLs are commonly scraped:

- `https://docs.zoominfo.com/reference/overview` - API Overview
- `https://docs.zoominfo.com/reference/searchinterface_searchcontact` - Contacts Search
- `https://docs.zoominfo.com/reference/enrichinterface_enrichcontact` - Contacts Enrichment
- `https://docs.zoominfo.com/reference/lookupinterface_lookup` - Data Lookup
- `https://docs.zoominfo.com/reference/userinterface_userusage` - Usage Data

### Example Command

```bash
pnpm nx run web-documentation:scrape -- \
  https://docs.zoominfo.com/reference/overview \
  https://docs.zoominfo.com/reference/searchinterface_searchcontact \
  https://docs.zoominfo.com/reference/enrichinterface_enrichcontact \
  https://docs.zoominfo.com/reference/lookupinterface_lookup \
  https://docs.zoominfo.com/reference/userinterface_userusage \
  --output-dir documentation-3rd-party/Zoom-Info-API \
  --numbered
```

This will create files like:
- `001-overview.md`
- `002-searchinterface_searchcontact.md`
- `003-enrichinterface_enrichcontact.md`
- `004-lookupinterface_lookup.md`
- `005-userinterface_userusage.md`

## Dependencies


## Error Handling

The scraper includes robust error handling:

- **Network failures**: Automatic retries with exponential backoff
- **Invalid HTML**: Graceful fallback to basic text extraction
- **Missing content**: Clear error messages for debugging
- **Rate limiting**: Respects delays between requests

==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/libs/web-documentation/src/cli.ts ====
#!/usr/bin/env tsx

/**
 * CLI for Web Documentation Scraper
 *
 * Usage:
 *   tsx libs/web-documentation/src/cli.ts <urls...> [options]
 *
 * Options:
 *   --output-dir <dir>     Output directory (default: ./output)
 *   --include-code         Include code examples (default: true)
 *   --include-api          Include API reference (default: true)
 *   --include-toc          Include table of contents (default: true)
 *   --numbered             Use numbered filenames (001-filename.md)
 *   --help                 Show this help message
 */

import { DocumentationScraper } from './scraper.js';
import { MarkdownConverter } from './converter.js';
import { FileWriter } from './writer.js';
import type { ScrapedDocumentation } from './types.js';
import { join } from 'path';

interface CliOptions {
  urls: string[];
  outputDir: string;
  includeCode: boolean;
  includeApi: boolean;
  includeToc: boolean;
  numbered: boolean;
  useBrowser: boolean;
  headed: boolean;
}

function parseArgs(): CliOptions {
  const args = process.argv.slice(2);

  if (args.length === 0 || args.includes('--help') || args.includes('-h')) {
    printHelp();
    process.exit(0);
  }

  const options: CliOptions = {
    urls: [],
    outputDir: './output',
    includeCode: true,
    includeApi: true,
    includeToc: true,
    numbered: false,
    useBrowser: false,
    headed: false,
  };

  for (let i = 0; i < args.length; i++) {
    const arg = args[i];

    switch (arg) {
      case '--output-dir':
        options.outputDir = args[++i];
        break;
      case '--include-code':
        options.includeCode = true;
        break;
      case '--no-code':
        options.includeCode = false;
        break;
      case '--include-api':
        options.includeApi = true;
        break;
      case '--no-api':
        options.includeApi = false;
        break;
      case '--include-toc':
        options.includeToc = true;
        break;
      case '--no-toc':
        options.includeToc = false;
        break;
      case '--numbered':
        options.numbered = true;
        break;
      case '--browser':
        options.useBrowser = true;
        break;
      case '--headed':
        options.headed = true;
        break;
      default:
        if (arg.startsWith('--')) {
          console.error(`Unknown option: ${arg}`);
          process.exit(1);
        } else {
          options.urls.push(arg);
        }
    }
  }

  if (options.urls.length === 0) {
    console.error('Error: No URLs provided');
    printHelp();
    process.exit(1);
  }

  return options;
}

function printHelp(): void {
  console.log(`
Web Documentation Scraper

Usage:
  tsx libs/web-documentation/src/cli.ts <urls...> [options]

Options:
  --output-dir <dir>     Output directory (default: ./output)
  --include-code         Include code examples (default: true)
  --no-code              Exclude code examples
  --include-api          Include API reference (default: true)
  --no-api               Exclude API reference
  --include-toc          Include table of contents (default: true)
  --no-toc               Exclude table of contents
  --browser              Use browser automation for dynamic content
  --headed               Show browser window (for debugging)
  --numbered             Use numbered filenames (001-filename.md)
  --help, -h             Show this help message

Examples:
  tsx libs/web-documentation/src/cli.ts https://docs.example.com/api
  tsx libs/web-documentation/src/cli.ts url1 url2 --output-dir ./docs --numbered
`);
}

async function main(): Promise<void> {
  const options = parseArgs();

  console.log('🚀 Starting web documentation scraper...');
  console.log(`📁 Output directory: ${options.outputDir}`);
  console.log(`🔗 URLs to scrape: ${options.urls.length}`);

  try {
    // Initialize components
    const scraper = new DocumentationScraper({
      useBrowser: options.useBrowser,
      headless: !options.headed,
      timeout: options.useBrowser ? 45000 : 30000, // Longer timeout for browser
      browserWaitTime: 3000, // Reduced wait time
    });
    const converter = new MarkdownConverter({
      includeCodeExamples: options.includeCode,
      includeApiReference: options.includeApi,
      includeToc: options.includeToc,
    });
    const writer = new FileWriter();

    // Scrape pages with progress tracking (parallel execution)
    console.log('📄 Scraping documentation pages...');
    const scrapeStart = Date.now();

    // For browser mode, run sequentially to avoid resource conflicts
    // For HTTP mode, run in parallel with concurrency limit
    const concurrencyLimit = options.useBrowser ? 1 : 3;
    const pages: any[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < options.urls.length; i += concurrencyLimit) {
      const batch = options.urls.slice(i, i + concurrencyLimit);
      const batchStart = Date.now();

      console.log(`📦 Processing batch ${Math.floor(i/concurrencyLimit) + 1}/${Math.ceil(options.urls.length/concurrencyLimit)} (${batch.length} URLs)...`);

      const batchPromises = batch.map(async (url, batchIndex) => {
        const urlStart = Date.now();
        const globalIndex = i + batchIndex;
        console.log(`  [${globalIndex + 1}/${options.urls.length}] ${url}...`);

        try {
          const page = await scraper.scrapePage(url);
          const urlTime = Date.now() - urlStart;
          console.log(`  ✅ [${globalIndex + 1}/${options.urls.length}] Completed in ${urlTime}ms (${page.html.length} chars)`);
          return page;
        } catch (error) {
          console.error(`  ❌ [${globalIndex + 1}/${options.urls.length}] Failed: ${error.message}`);
          return null; // Will be filtered out later
        }
      });

      const batchResults = await Promise.all(batchPromises);
      pages.push(...batchResults.filter(result => result !== null));

      const batchTime = Date.now() - batchStart;
      console.log(`📦 Batch completed in ${batchTime}ms`);
    }

    const scrapeTime = Date.now() - scrapeStart;
    console.log(`✅ Scraped ${pages.length}/${options.urls.length} pages in ${scrapeTime}ms (${(scrapeTime/options.urls.length).toFixed(0)}ms avg per URL)`);

    if (pages.length === 0) {
      throw new Error('No pages were successfully scraped');
    }

    // Convert to Markdown
    console.log('📝 Converting to Markdown...');
    const docs = pages.map(page => converter.convert(page));
    console.log(`✅ Converted ${docs.length} documents`);

    // Write files
    console.log('💾 Writing files...');

    if (options.numbered) {
      await writer.writeFiles(docs, options.outputDir, (doc: ScrapedDocumentation, index: number) => {
        const num = (index + 1).toString().padStart(3, '0');
        const urlParts = doc.url.split('/').filter(Boolean);
        const lastPart = urlParts[urlParts.length - 1] || 'index';
        const filename = lastPart.replace(/\.html?$/, '').replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9-_]/g, '-');
        return `${num}-${filename}.md`;
      });
    } else {
      await writer.writeFiles(docs, options.outputDir);
    }

    console.log(`✅ Successfully wrote ${docs.length} files to ${options.outputDir}`);

    // Summary
    console.log('\n📊 Summary:');
    docs.forEach((doc, index) => {
      const filename = options.numbered
        ? `${(index + 1).toString().padStart(3, '0')}-${doc.title.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9-_]/g, '-')}.md`
        : `${doc.title.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9-_]/g, '-')}.md`;
      console.log(`  ${filename}`);
    });

  } catch (error) {
    console.error('❌ Error:', error);
    process.exit(1);
  }
}

// Run CLI if called directly
if (process.argv[1]?.includes('cli.ts')) {
  main().catch(error => {
    console.error('❌ Error:', error);
    process.exit(1);
  });
}


==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/libs/web-documentation/src/converter.ts ====
/**
 * HTML to Markdown Converter
 *
 * Converts documentation HTML to clean, readable Markdown format.
 */

import { JSDOM } from 'jsdom';
import type { DocumentationPage, ConverterOptions, ScrapedDocumentation } from './types.js';

const DEFAULT_OPTIONS: Required<ConverterOptions> = {
  includeCodeExamples: true,
  includeApiReference: true,
  includeToc: true,
  frontmatter: {},
};

export class MarkdownConverter {
  private options: Required<ConverterOptions>;

  constructor(options: ConverterOptions = {}) {
    this.options = { ...DEFAULT_OPTIONS, ...options };
  }

  /**
   * Convert a documentation page to Markdown
   */
  convert(page: DocumentationPage): ScrapedDocumentation {
    const dom = new JSDOM(page.html);
    const document = dom.window.document;

    // Clean up the document
    this.cleanDocument(document);

    // Extract main content
    const mainContent = this.extractMainContent(document);
    if (!mainContent) {
      throw new Error('Could not extract main content from document');
    }

    // Convert to Markdown
    const markdown = this.htmlToMarkdown(mainContent);

    // Generate frontmatter
    const frontmatter = this.generateFrontmatter(page);

    return {
      url: page.url,
      title: page.title,
      markdown,
      frontmatter,
      scrapedAt: new Date(),
    };
  }

  private cleanDocument(document: Document): void {
    // For API documentation, be more conservative with cleaning
    const body = document.body;
    if (!body) return;

    // Only remove obvious non-content elements
    const scripts = body.querySelectorAll('script, style');
    scripts.forEach(el => el.remove());

    // Remove navigation elements that are clearly not content
    const navElements = body.querySelectorAll('nav[class*="nav"], header[class*="header"], footer[class*="footer"]');
    navElements.forEach(el => el.remove());

    // Remove empty or very small elements
    const allElements = body.querySelectorAll('*');
    allElements.forEach(el => {
      const text = el.textContent?.trim() || '';
      if (text.length < 3 && el.children.length === 0 && el.tagName !== 'BR' && el.tagName !== 'HR') {
        el.remove();
      }
    });
  }

  private extractMainContent(document: Document): Element {
    if (!document.body) {
      throw new Error('Document has no body element');
    }

    // For API documentation pages, try to find content areas more specifically
    const apiSelectors = [
      // Common API documentation selectors
      '.api-content',
      '.endpoint-content',
      '.reference-content',
      '.documentation-content',
      '[data-testid*="content"]',
      '[data-testid*="api"]',
      '[data-testid*="reference"]',
      // Generic content areas
      'main',
      '.main-content',
      '.content',
      '.page-content',
      // Documentation specific
      '.doc-content',
      '.api-reference',
      '.endpoint-docs',
    ];

    for (const selector of apiSelectors) {
      const element = document.body.querySelector(selector);
      if (element && element.textContent && element.textContent.length > 100) {
        console.log(`Found API content with selector: ${selector}`);
        return element;
      }
    }

    // If no specific content area found, try to find the largest content div
    const contentDivs = Array.from(document.body.querySelectorAll('div'))
      .filter(div => {
        const text = div.textContent || '';
        const className = div.className || '';
        return text.length > 200 && // Has substantial content
               !className.includes('nav') &&
               !className.includes('header') &&
               !className.includes('footer') &&
               !className.includes('sidebar') &&
               !className.includes('menu');
      })
      .sort((a, b) => (b.textContent?.length || 0) - (a.textContent?.length || 0));

    if (contentDivs.length > 0) {
      const bestDiv = contentDivs[0];
      console.log(`Selected largest content div with ${bestDiv.textContent?.length} characters`);
      return bestDiv;
    }

    console.log('Falling back to body element');
    return document.body;
  }

  private htmlToMarkdown(element: Element): string {
    let markdown = '';

    // Add title if not already in content
    const title = this.extractTitle(element);
    if (title) {
      markdown += `# ${title}\n\n`;
    }

    // Convert content
    markdown += this.convertElement(element);

    return this.cleanMarkdown(markdown);
  }

  private extractTitle(element: Element): string | null {
    const titleSelectors = ['h1', '.title', '[data-testid*="title"]'];
    for (const selector of titleSelectors) {
      const titleEl = element.querySelector(selector);
      if (titleEl?.textContent?.trim()) {
        return titleEl.textContent.trim();
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  private convertElement(element: Element): string {
    let result = '';

    Array.from(element.childNodes).forEach(child => {
      if (child.nodeType === 3) { // Text node
        result += child.textContent || '';
      } else if (child.nodeType === 1) { // Element node
        const el = child as Element;
        result += this.convertHtmlElement(el);
      }
    });

    return result;
  }

  private convertHtmlElement(element: Element): string {
    const tagName = element.tagName.toLowerCase();
    const className = element.className || '';
    const textContent = element.textContent?.trim() || '';

    // Skip elements that are likely navigation or non-content
    if (className.includes('nav') || className.includes('menu') || className.includes('sidebar') ||
        className.includes('header') || className.includes('footer') || className.includes('search') ||
        textContent === 'Jump to Content' || textContent.includes('Start typing to search')) {
      return '';
    }

    switch (tagName) {
      case 'h1':
        return `# ${textContent}\n\n`;
      case 'h2':
        return `## ${textContent}\n\n`;
      case 'h3':
        return `### ${textContent}\n\n`;
      case 'h4':
        return `#### ${textContent}\n\n`;
      case 'h5':
        return `##### ${textContent}\n\n`;
      case 'h6':
        // Skip small headings that are likely navigation
        if (textContent.length < 10) return '';
        return `###### ${textContent}\n\n`;
      case 'p':
        return `${textContent}\n\n`;
      case 'br':
        return '\n';
      case 'strong':
      case 'b':
        return `**${textContent}**`;
      case 'em':
      case 'i':
        return `*${textContent}*`;
      case 'code':
        return `\`${textContent}\``;
      case 'pre':
        const codeEl = element.querySelector('code');
        if (codeEl) {
          const lang = this.detectLanguage(element);
          return `\`\`\`${lang}\n${codeEl.textContent?.trim()}\n\`\`\`\n\n`;
        }
        return `\`\`\`\n${textContent}\n\`\`\`\n\n`;
      case 'a':
        const href = element.getAttribute('href');
        if (href && !href.startsWith('#') && textContent) {
          return `[${textContent}](${href})`;
        }
        return textContent;
      case 'ul':
        return this.convertList(element, '- ');
      case 'ol':
        return this.convertList(element, '1. ');
      case 'li':
        return `- ${textContent}\n`;
      case 'blockquote':
        return `> ${textContent}\n\n`;
      case 'table':
        return this.convertTable(element);
      case 'hr':
        return '---\n\n';
      case 'div':
      case 'span':
      case 'section':
        // Check for code blocks or special content
        if (className.includes('code') || className.includes('highlight') || className.includes('pre')) {
          return this.convertElement(element);
        }
        // Skip empty or navigation divs
        if (!textContent || textContent.length < 5) return '';
        return textContent + ' ';
      default:
        // Skip unknown elements that don't have meaningful content
        if (!textContent || textContent.length < 3) return '';
        return this.convertElement(element);
    }
  }

  private convertList(element: Element, prefix: string): string {
    let result = '';
    const items = element.querySelectorAll('li');
    items.forEach(item => {
      result += `${prefix}${item.textContent?.trim()}\n`;
    });
    return result + '\n';
  }

  private convertTable(element: Element): string {
    const rows = element.querySelectorAll('tr');
    if (rows.length === 0) return '';

    let markdown = '';
    const headers: string[] = [];
    const data: string[][] = [];

    rows.forEach((row, index) => {
      const cells = row.querySelectorAll('th, td');
      const rowData = Array.from(cells).map(cell => cell.textContent?.trim() || '');

      if (index === 0 && element.querySelector('th')) {
        headers.push(...rowData);
      } else {
        data.push(rowData);
      }
    });

    if (headers.length > 0) {
      markdown += '| ' + headers.join(' | ') + ' |\n';
      markdown += '| ' + headers.map(() => '---').join(' | ') + ' |\n';
    }

    data.forEach(row => {
      markdown += '| ' + row.join(' | ') + ' |\n';
    });

    return markdown + '\n';
  }

  private detectLanguage(element: Element): string {
    const classes = element.className || '';
    const langMatch = classes.match(/language-(\w+)/);
    if (langMatch) return langMatch[1];

    // Common language detection
    const text = element.textContent || '';
    if (text.includes('function') || text.includes('const') || text.includes('let')) return 'javascript';
    if (text.includes('def ') || text.includes('import ')) return 'python';
    if (text.includes('<?php')) return 'php';
    if (text.includes('public class') || text.includes('System.out')) return 'java';

    return '';
  }

  private cleanMarkdown(markdown: string): string {
    return markdown
      // Fix spacing issues
      .replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n')
      // Fix list formatting
      .replace(/^- ([^-])/gm, '- $1')
      // Clean up extra whitespace
      .replace(/[ \t]+$/gm, '')
      // Ensure proper line endings
      .trim();
  }

  private generateFrontmatter(page: DocumentationPage): Record<string, any> {
    const frontmatter: Record<string, any> = {
      title: page.title,
      url: page.url,
      scrapedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      ...this.options.frontmatter,
    };

    if (page.lastModified) {
      frontmatter.lastModified = page.lastModified.toISOString();
    }

    return frontmatter;
  }
}

export { DocumentationScraper } from './scraper.js';

==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/libs/web-documentation/src/scraper.ts ====
/**
 * Documentation Scraper
 *
 * Fetches documentation pages from the web using HTTP requests.
 */

import { JSDOM } from 'jsdom';
import { chromium } from 'playwright';
import type { ScraperOptions, DocumentationPage } from './types.js';

const DEFAULT_OPTIONS: Required<ScraperOptions> = {
  userAgent: 'Web-Documentation-Scraper/1.0.0',
  timeout: 30000,
  maxRetries: 3,
  retryDelay: 1000,
  useBrowser: false,
  browserWaitTime: 2000, // Reduced from 5000ms
  headless: true,
};

export class DocumentationScraper {
  private options: Required<ScraperOptions>;

  constructor(options: ScraperOptions = {}) {
    this.options = { ...DEFAULT_OPTIONS, ...options };
  }

  /**
   * Fetch a single documentation page
   */
  async scrapePage(url: string): Promise<DocumentationPage> {
    if (this.options.useBrowser) {
      return this.scrapePageWithBrowser(url);
    }

    let lastError: Error | null = null;

    for (let attempt = 0; attempt <= this.options.maxRetries; attempt++) {
      try {
        const response = await this.fetchWithTimeout(url);

        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`);
        }

        const html = await response.text();
        const dom = new JSDOM(html);
        const document = dom.window.document;

        // Extract title
        const title = this.extractTitle(document, url);

        // Extract last modified if available
        const lastModified = this.extractLastModified(response);

        return {
          url,
          title,
          html,
          lastModified,
          statusCode: response.status,
        };
      } catch (error) {
        lastError = error as Error;
        console.warn(`Attempt ${attempt + 1} failed for ${url}:`, error);

        if (attempt < this.options.maxRetries) {
          await this.delay(this.options.retryDelay * Math.pow(2, attempt));
        }
      }
    }

    throw new Error(`Failed to scrape ${url} after ${this.options.maxRetries + 1} attempts: ${lastError?.message}`);
  }

  /**
   * Fetch a documentation page using browser automation for dynamic content
   */
  private async scrapePageWithBrowser(url: string): Promise<DocumentationPage> {
    const startTime = Date.now();
    let browser;
    let page;

    try {
      console.log(`🚀 Starting browser scrape for ${url}`);

      // Launch browser with optimized settings
      const launchStart = Date.now();
      browser = await chromium.launch({
        headless: this.options.headless,
        args: [
          '--no-sandbox',
          '--disable-setuid-sandbox',
          '--disable-dev-shm-usage',
          '--disable-accelerated-2d-canvas',
          '--no-first-run',
          '--no-zygote',
          '--single-process', // <- this might help with stability
          '--disable-gpu'
        ]
      });
      console.log(`⏱️ Browser launch: ${Date.now() - launchStart}ms`);

      const context = await browser.newContext({
        userAgent: this.options.userAgent,
        viewport: { width: 1280, height: 720 }
      });

      page = await context.newPage();
      page.setDefaultTimeout(this.options.timeout);

      // Monitor page events for debugging
      page.on('console', msg => {
        if (msg.type() === 'error') {
          console.warn(`⚠️ Page console error: ${msg.text()}`);
        }
      });

      page.on('pageerror', error => {
        console.warn(`⚠️ Page error: ${error.message}`);
      });

      // Navigate to page
      const navStart = Date.now();
      console.log(`📄 Navigating to ${url}...`);

      const response = await page.goto(url, {
        waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', // Faster than networkidle
        timeout: this.options.timeout
      });

      console.log(`⏱️ Navigation: ${Date.now() - navStart}ms, status: ${response?.status()}`);

      // Quick wait for initial render
      await page.waitForTimeout(1000);

      // Try to expand documentation sections (optimized)
      const expandStart = Date.now();
      await this.expandApiDocumentationOptimized(page);
      console.log(`⏱️ Content expansion: ${Date.now() - expandStart}ms`);

      // Wait a bit more for dynamic content (reduced wait time)
      await page.waitForTimeout(Math.min(this.options.browserWaitTime, 1500));

      // Extract content
      const extractStart = Date.now();
      const [title, html] = await Promise.all([
        page.title(),
        page.content()
      ]);
      console.log(`⏱️ Content extraction: ${Date.now() - extractStart}ms, HTML size: ${html.length}`);

      const totalTime = Date.now() - startTime;
      console.log(`✅ Browser scrape completed for ${url} in ${totalTime}ms`);

      return {
        url,
        title: title || this.extractTitleFromUrl(url),
        html,
        statusCode: response?.status() || 200,
      };
    } catch (error) {
      const totalTime = Date.now() - startTime;
      console.error(`❌ Browser scraping failed for ${url} after ${totalTime}ms:`, error);
      throw error;
    } finally {
      if (page) {
        try {
          await page.close();
        } catch (e) {
          console.warn('Warning: failed to close page:', e);
        }
      }
      if (browser) {
        try {
          await browser.close();
        } catch (e) {
          console.warn('Warning: failed to close browser:', e);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Attempt to expand API documentation sections to reveal full content (highly optimized)
   */
  private async expandApiDocumentationOptimized(page: any): Promise<void> {
    const expandStart = Date.now();

    try {
      // Quick check if page has expandable content
      const expandableCount = await page.locator('[aria-expanded="false"], button[data-testid*="expand"]').count();

      if (expandableCount === 0) {
        console.log('ℹ️ No expandable elements detected, skipping expansion');
        return;
      }

      console.log(`🔍 Expanding ${expandableCount} API documentation sections...`);

      // Fast expansion using page.evaluate for better performance
      const result = await page.evaluate(() => {
        let expanded = 0;
        const maxExpansions = 20; // Limit to prevent infinite loops

        // Target only the most important expandable elements
        const selectors = [
          '[aria-expanded="false"]',
          'button[data-testid*="expand"]',
          'button[class*="expand"]'
        ];

        for (const selector of selectors) {
          if (expanded >= maxExpansions) break;

          const elements = document.querySelectorAll(selector);
          for (const element of elements) {
            if (expanded >= maxExpansions) break;

            try {
              (element as HTMLElement).click();
              expanded++;
            } catch (e) {
              // Continue
            }
          }
        }

        return expanded;
      });

      console.log(`📂 Expanded ${result} elements in browser context`);

      // Minimal wait for content to appear
      if (result > 0) {
        await page.waitForTimeout(500);
      }

      console.log(`✅ Content expansion completed in ${Date.now() - expandStart}ms`);

    } catch (error) {
      console.warn(`⚠️ API documentation expansion failed after ${Date.now() - expandStart}ms:`, error.message);
      // Don't throw - content extraction can still work
    }
  }

  /**
   * Fetch multiple documentation pages concurrently
   */
  async scrapePages(urls: string[]): Promise<DocumentationPage[]> {
    const promises = urls.map(url => this.scrapePage(url));
    return Promise.all(promises);
  }

  private async fetchWithTimeout(url: string): Promise<Response> {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), this.options.timeout);

    try {
      const response = await fetch(url, {
        signal: controller.signal,
        headers: {
          'User-Agent': this.options.userAgent,
          'Accept': 'text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,*/*;q=0.8',
          'Accept-Language': 'en-US,en;q=0.5',
          'Accept-Encoding': 'gzip, deflate',
          'Connection': 'keep-alive',
          'Upgrade-Insecure-Requests': '1',
        },
      });
      return response;
    } finally {
      clearTimeout(timeoutId);
    }
  }

  private extractTitle(document: Document, url: string): string {
    // Try different title selectors
    const selectors = [
      'title',
      'h1',
      '[data-testid="page-title"]',
      '.page-title',
      '.doc-title',
    ];

    for (const selector of selectors) {
      const element = document.querySelector(selector);
      if (element?.textContent?.trim()) {
        return element.textContent.trim();
      }
    }

    // Fallback to URL-based title
    const urlParts = url.split('/').filter(Boolean);
    const lastPart = urlParts[urlParts.length - 1] || 'index';
    return lastPart.replace(/[-_]/g, ' ').replace(/\b\w/g, l => l.toUpperCase());
  }

  private extractLastModified(response: Response): Date | undefined {
    const lastModified = response.headers.get('last-modified');
    if (lastModified) {
      return new Date(lastModified);
    }
    return undefined;
  }

  private delay(ms: number): Promise<void> {
    return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
  }

  private extractTitleFromUrl(url: string): string {
    const urlParts = url.split('/').filter(Boolean);
    const lastPart = urlParts[urlParts.length - 1] || 'index';
    return lastPart.replace(/[-_]/g, ' ').replace(/\b\w/g, l => l.toUpperCase());
  }
}

/**
 * Types for the Web Documentation Scraper
 */

export interface ScraperOptions {
  /** User agent string for HTTP requests */
  userAgent?: string;
  /** Timeout for HTTP requests in milliseconds */
  timeout?: number;
  /** Maximum number of retries for failed requests */
  maxRetries?: number;
  /** Delay between retries in milliseconds */
  retryDelay?: number;
  /** Use browser automation for dynamic content */
  useBrowser?: boolean;
  /** Browser wait time for dynamic content in milliseconds */
  browserWaitTime?: number;
  /** Headless mode for browser */
  headless?: boolean;
}

export interface ConverterOptions {
  /** Include code examples in the output */
  includeCodeExamples?: boolean;
  /** Include API reference sections */
  includeApiReference?: boolean;
  /** Include table of contents */
  includeToc?: boolean;
  /** Custom frontmatter to add to the Markdown */
  frontmatter?: Record<string, any>;
}

export interface DocumentationPage {
  /** URL of the documentation page */
  url: string;
  /** Title of the page */
  title: string;
  /** Raw HTML content */
  html: string;
  /** Last modified timestamp */
  lastModified?: Date;
  /** Status code of the response */
  statusCode: number;
}

export interface ScrapedDocumentation {
  /** Original URL */
  url: string;
  /** Page title */
  title: string;
  /** Converted Markdown content */
  markdown: string;
  /** Frontmatter metadata */
  frontmatter: Record<string, any>;
  /** Scraping timestamp */
  scrapedAt: Date;
}

/**
 * File Writer
 *
 * Handles writing scraped documentation to the filesystem.
 */

import { promises as fs } from 'fs';
import { join, dirname } from 'path';
import type { ScrapedDocumentation } from './types.js';

export class FileWriter {
  /**
   * Write a single documentation file
   */
  async writeFile(doc: ScrapedDocumentation, outputPath: string): Promise<void> {
    const content = this.generateMarkdownContent(doc);

    await fs.mkdir(dirname(outputPath), { recursive: true });
    await fs.writeFile(outputPath, content, 'utf-8');
  }

  /**
   * Write multiple documentation files
   */
  async writeFiles(docs: ScrapedDocumentation[], outputDir: string, filenamePattern?: (doc: ScrapedDocumentation, index: number) => string): Promise<void> {
    const promises = docs.map((doc, index) => {
      const filename = filenamePattern ? filenamePattern(doc, index) : this.generateFilename(doc);
      const outputPath = join(outputDir, filename);
      return this.writeFile(doc, outputPath);
    });

    await Promise.all(promises);
  }

  private generateMarkdownContent(doc: ScrapedDocumentation): string {
    let content = '';

    // Add frontmatter
    if (Object.keys(doc.frontmatter).length > 0) {
      content += '---\n';
      for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(doc.frontmatter)) {
        content += `${key}: ${JSON.stringify(value)}\n`;
      }
      content += '---\n\n';
    }

    // Add content
    content += doc.markdown;

    return content;
  }

  private generateFilename(doc: ScrapedDocumentation): string {
    // Extract meaningful filename from URL or title
    const urlParts = doc.url.split('/').filter(Boolean);
    const lastPart = urlParts[urlParts.length - 1] || 'index';

    // Clean up filename
    let filename = lastPart
      .replace(/\.html?$/, '') // Remove .html extension
      .replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9-_]/g, '-') // Replace special chars with dashes
      .replace(/-+/g, '-') // Replace multiple dashes with single
      .replace(/^-|-$/g, ''); // Remove leading/trailing dashes

    if (!filename) {
      // Fallback to title-based filename
      filename = doc.title
        .toLowerCase()
        .replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9-_]/g, '-')
        .replace(/-+/g, '-')
        .replace(/^-|-$/g, '');
    }

    return `${filename}.md`;
  }
}

    count=$((count + 1))
    echo "[$count] Processing: $patient" >> "$LOG_FILE"
