==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/scripts/parse-patient-html.ts ====
#!/usr/bin/env tsx

import * as fs from 'fs'
import * as path from 'path'
import * as cheerio from 'cheerio'
import * as csvWriter from 'csv-writer'
import { fileURLToPath } from 'url'

const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)
const __dirname = path.dirname(__filename)

interface PatientRecord {
  lastName: string
  firstName: string
  fullName: string
  sex: string
  dob: string
  age: string
  lastVisit: string
  provider: string
  status: 'ACTIVE' | 'INACTIVE'
  sourceFile: string
}

const ACTIVE_PATIENTS_DIR = path.join(__dirname, '..', 'apps', 'html-records-processing', 'data', 'bravado', 'active-patients')
const INACTIVE_PATIENTS_DIR = path.join(__dirname, '..', 'apps', 'html-records-processing', 'data', 'bravado', 'in-active-patients')
const OUTPUT_DIR = path.join(__dirname, '..', 'output')

// Ensure output directory exists
if (!fs.existsSync(OUTPUT_DIR)) {
  fs.mkdirSync(OUTPUT_DIR, { recursive: true })
}

function getHtmlFiles(dirPath: string): string[] {
  return fs.readdirSync(dirPath)
    .filter(file => file.endsWith('.html'))
    .sort() // Sort to ensure consistent order
}

function parsePatientData(htmlContent: string, status: 'ACTIVE' | 'INACTIVE', sourceFile: string): PatientRecord[] {
  const $ = cheerio.load(htmlContent)
  const patients: PatientRecord[] = []

  // Find all patient rows - they have the class "ui-grid-row ng-scope"
  const rows = $('.ui-grid-row.ng-scope')
  console.log(`Found ${rows.length} rows in ${sourceFile}`)

  rows.each((index, row) => {
    const $row = $(row)

    // Extract patient name - it's in the first column with class "name-cell"
    const nameCell = $row.find('.name-cell .patient-name').first().text().trim()
    if (!nameCell) {
      return // Skip if no name found
    }

    // Parse name format: "LASTNAME, FIRSTNAME"
    const nameMatch = nameCell.match(/^([^,]+),\s*(.+)$/)
    if (!nameMatch) {
      console.log(`  Skipping row ${index} - invalid name format: "${nameCell}"`)
      return
    }

    const [, lastName, firstName] = nameMatch

    // Extract sex from gender cell
    const sex = $row.find('.gender-cell').text().trim()

    // Extract DOB and age from age cell
    const dobCell = $row.find('.age-cell .second-row')
    const dob = dobCell.find('.dob-text').text().trim()
    const ageText = dobCell.text().replace(dob, '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim()
    const age = ageText.replace(' Years', '')

    // Extract last visit date
    const lastVisit = $row.find('.last-visit-cell').text().trim()

    // Extract provider
    const provider = $row.find('.provider-cell').text().trim()

    console.log(`  Row ${index}: ${lastName}, ${firstName} - DOB: ${dob} - Age: ${age} - Provider: ${provider}`)

    if (lastName && firstName && dob) {
      patients.push({
        lastName,
        firstName,
        fullName: `${firstName} ${lastName}`.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(),
        sex,
        dob,
        age,
        lastVisit,
        provider,
        status,
        sourceFile
      })
    }
  })

  return patients
}

async function generateSummaryReport(
  allRecords: PatientRecord[],
  under18Records: PatientRecord[],
  seniorRecords: PatientRecord[],
  maleRecords: PatientRecord[],
  femaleRecords: PatientRecord[]
): Promise<void> {
  const reportPath = path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, 'patient-summary-report.txt')

  const totalPatients = allRecords.length
  const activePatients = allRecords.filter(r => r.status === 'ACTIVE').length
  const inactivePatients = allRecords.filter(r => r.status === 'INACTIVE').length

  // Age statistics
  const ages = allRecords
    .map(r => parseInt(r.age))
    .filter(age => !isNaN(age))
    .sort((a, b) => a - b)

  const avgAge = ages.length > 0 ? (ages.reduce((sum, age) => sum + age, 0) / ages.length).toFixed(1) : 'N/A'
  const medianAge = ages.length > 0 ? ages[Math.floor(ages.length / 2)] : 'N/A'
  const minAge = ages.length > 0 ? ages[0] : 'N/A'
  const maxAge = ages.length > 0 ? ages[ages.length - 1] : 'N/A'

  // Recent visits analysis (last 30 days from today - using current date)
  const today = new Date()
  const thirtyDaysAgo = new Date(today.getTime() - (30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000))

  const recentVisits = allRecords.filter(r => {
    try {
      const visitDate = new Date(r.lastVisit)
      return visitDate >= thirtyDaysAgo
    } catch {
      return false
    }
  }).length

  const report = `
PATIENT DATA SUMMARY REPORT
Generated on: ${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}

=== OVERVIEW ===
Total Patients: ${totalPatients}
Active Patients: ${activePatients} (${((activePatients / totalPatients) * 100).toFixed(1)}%)
Inactive Patients: ${inactivePatients} (${((inactivePatients / totalPatients) * 100).toFixed(1)}%)

=== DEMOGRAPHICS ===
Gender Distribution:
- Male: ${maleRecords.length} (${((maleRecords.length / totalPatients) * 100).toFixed(1)}%)
- Female: ${femaleRecords.length} (${((femaleRecords.length / totalPatients) * 100).toFixed(1)}%)
- Unknown: ${totalPatients - maleRecords.length - femaleRecords.length}

Age Statistics:
- Average Age: ${avgAge} years
- Median Age: ${medianAge} years
- Age Range: ${minAge} - ${maxAge} years

Age Groups:
- Under 18: ${under18Records.length} patients
- 18-29: ${allRecords.filter(r => { const age = parseInt(r.age); return !isNaN(age) && age >= 18 && age < 30 }).length} patients
- 30-39: ${allRecords.filter(r => { const age = parseInt(r.age); return !isNaN(age) && age >= 30 && age < 40 }).length} patients
- 40-49: ${allRecords.filter(r => { const age = parseInt(r.age); return !isNaN(age) && age >= 40 && age < 50 }).length} patients
- 50-64: ${allRecords.filter(r => { const age = parseInt(r.age); return !isNaN(age) && age >= 50 && age < 65 }).length} patients
- 65+: ${seniorRecords.length} patients

=== PROVIDER ANALYSIS ===
All patients are managed by: Hernandez, Roberto

=== RECENT ACTIVITY ===
Patients with visits in last 30 days: ${recentVisits}

=== DATA SOURCES ===
Active Patients Files: 4 (400 records total)
Inactive Patients Files: 5 (462 records total)
Total Source Files: 9

=== OUTPUT FILES GENERATED ===
- all-patients.csv: Complete dataset (${totalPatients} records)
- active-patients.csv: Active patients only (${activePatients} records)
- inactive-patients.csv: Inactive patients only (${inactivePatients} records)
- patients-under-18.csv: Patients under 18 (${under18Records.length} records)
- patients-65-plus.csv: Patients 65 and older (${seniorRecords.length} records)
- male-patients.csv: Male patients (${maleRecords.length} records)
- female-patients.csv: Female patients (${femaleRecords.length} records)
`

  fs.writeFileSync(reportPath, report.trim())
  console.log(`Generated summary report: ${reportPath}`)
}

async function generateCsv(records: PatientRecord[], filename: string): Promise<void> {
  const csvPath = path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, filename)

  const csv = csvWriter.createObjectCsvWriter({
    path: csvPath,
    header: [
      { id: 'lastName', title: 'Last Name' },
      { id: 'firstName', title: 'First Name' },
      { id: 'fullName', title: 'Full Name' },
      { id: 'sex', title: 'Sex' },
      { id: 'dob', title: 'Date of Birth' },
      { id: 'age', title: 'Age' },
      { id: 'lastVisit', title: 'Last Visit' },
      { id: 'provider', title: 'Provider' },
      { id: 'status', title: 'Status' },
      { id: 'sourceFile', title: 'Source File' }
    ]
  })

  await csv.writeRecords(records)
  console.log(`Generated CSV: ${csvPath} (${records.length} records)`)
}

function sanitizeForDrive(name: string): string {
  // Google Drive disallows '/' in names and treats leading/trailing spaces oddly.
  return name
    .replace(/[\/]/g, '-')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .trim()
}

async function generateDriveFoldersCsv(records: PatientRecord[], filename = 'google-drive-folders.csv'): Promise<void> {
  const csvPath = path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, filename)

  type DriveRow = { FolderPath: string }
  const rows: DriveRow[] = records.map(r => {
    const lastUpper = sanitizeForDrive((r.lastName || '').toUpperCase())
    const firstUpper = sanitizeForDrive((r.firstName || '').toUpperCase())
    const patientSegment = `${lastUpper} ${firstUpper}`.trim()

    const segments = [
      'Patient Records, Notes, Form, Documentation',
      'Patient records',
      'Digital Records',
      'Audit-Proof-Initiative',
      r.status,
      patientSegment
    ]

    const folderPath = segments.map(sanitizeForDrive).join('/')

    return {
      FolderPath: folderPath
    }
  })

  const csv = csvWriter.createObjectCsvWriter({
    path: csvPath,
    header: [
      { id: 'FolderPath', title: 'FolderPath' }
    ]
  })

  await csv.writeRecords(rows)
  console.log(`Generated Drive folders CSV: ${csvPath} (${rows.length} rows)`)
}

function analyzeData(records: PatientRecord[]): void {
  console.log('\n=== DATA ANALYSIS ===')

  // Total counts
  const totalRecords = records.length
  const activeRecords = records.filter(r => r.status === 'ACTIVE').length
  const inactiveRecords = records.filter(r => r.status === 'INACTIVE').length

  console.log(`Total Patients: ${totalRecords}`)
  console.log(`Active Patients: ${activeRecords}`)
  console.log(`Inactive Patients: ${inactiveRecords}`)

  // Provider analysis
  const providerCounts = records.reduce((acc, record) => {
    acc[record.provider] = (acc[record.provider] || 0) + 1
    return acc
  }, {} as Record<string, number>)

  console.log('\n=== PROVIDER DISTRIBUTION ===')
  Object.entries(providerCounts)
    .sort(([, a], [, b]) => b - a)
    .forEach(([provider, count]) => {
      console.log(`${provider}: ${count} patients`)
    })

  // Age distribution
  const ageGroups = records.reduce((acc, record) => {
    const age = parseInt(record.age)
    if (isNaN(age)) return acc

    if (age < 18) acc['<18'] = (acc['<18'] || 0) + 1
    else if (age < 30) acc['18-29'] = (acc['18-29'] || 0) + 1
    else if (age < 40) acc['30-39'] = (acc['30-39'] || 0) + 1
    else if (age < 50) acc['40-49'] = (acc['40-49'] || 0) + 1
    else if (age < 65) acc['50-64'] = (acc['50-64'] || 0) + 1
    else acc['65+'] = (acc['65+'] || 0) + 1

    return acc
  }, {} as Record<string, number>)

  console.log('\n=== AGE DISTRIBUTION ===')
  Object.entries(ageGroups)
    .sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b))
    .forEach(([group, count]) => {
      console.log(`${group}: ${count} patients`)
    })

  // Gender distribution
  const genderCounts = records.reduce((acc, record) => {
    const gender = record.sex || 'Unknown'
    acc[gender] = (acc[gender] || 0) + 1
    return acc
  }, {} as Record<string, number>)

  console.log('\n=== GENDER DISTRIBUTION ===')
  Object.entries(genderCounts)
    .forEach(([gender, count]) => {
      console.log(`${gender}: ${count} patients`)
    })
}

async function main(): Promise<void> {
  console.log('Starting HTML patient data parsing...')

  const allRecords: PatientRecord[] = []

  // Process active patients
  console.log('\nProcessing active patients...')
  const activeFiles = getHtmlFiles(ACTIVE_PATIENTS_DIR)
  console.log(`Found ${activeFiles.length} active patient files:`, activeFiles)

  for (const file of activeFiles) {
    const filePath = path.join(ACTIVE_PATIENTS_DIR, file)
    console.log(`Processing: ${file}`)

    const htmlContent = fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf-8')
    const records = parsePatientData(htmlContent, 'ACTIVE', file)
    console.log(`  Extracted ${records.length} patients from ${file}`)
    allRecords.push(...records)
  }

  // Process inactive patients
  console.log('\nProcessing inactive patients...')
  const inactiveFiles = getHtmlFiles(INACTIVE_PATIENTS_DIR)
  console.log(`Found ${inactiveFiles.length} inactive patient files:`, inactiveFiles)

  for (const file of inactiveFiles) {
    const filePath = path.join(INACTIVE_PATIENTS_DIR, file)
    console.log(`Processing: ${file}`)

    const htmlContent = fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf-8')
    const records = parsePatientData(htmlContent, 'INACTIVE', file)
    console.log(`  Extracted ${records.length} patients from ${file}`)
    allRecords.push(...records)
  }

  // Generate main CSV
  console.log('\nGenerating CSV files...')
  await generateCsv(allRecords, 'all-patients.csv')

  // Generate separate CSVs for active/inactive
  const activeRecords = allRecords.filter(r => r.status === 'ACTIVE')
  const inactiveRecords = allRecords.filter(r => r.status === 'INACTIVE')

  await generateCsv(activeRecords, 'active-patients.csv')
  await generateCsv(inactiveRecords, 'inactive-patients.csv')

  // Analyze data
  analyzeData(allRecords)

  // Generate additional processed CSV files
  console.log('\nGenerating additional processed CSV files...')

  // Patients under 18
  const under18Records = allRecords.filter(r => {
    const age = parseInt(r.age)
    return !isNaN(age) && age < 18
  })
  await generateCsv(under18Records, 'patients-under-18.csv')

  // Patients 65 and over
  const seniorRecords = allRecords.filter(r => {
    const age = parseInt(r.age)
    return !isNaN(age) && age >= 65
  })
  await generateCsv(seniorRecords, 'patients-65-plus.csv')

  // Male patients
  const maleRecords = allRecords.filter(r => r.sex === 'M')
  await generateCsv(maleRecords, 'male-patients.csv')

  // Female patients
  const femaleRecords = allRecords.filter(r => r.sex === 'F')
  await generateCsv(femaleRecords, 'female-patients.csv')

  // Generate summary report
  await generateSummaryReport(allRecords, under18Records, seniorRecords, maleRecords, femaleRecords)

  // Generate Google Drive folders CSV
  await generateDriveFoldersCsv(allRecords)

  console.log('\n=== PROCESSING COMPLETE ===')
  console.log(`Total records processed: ${allRecords.length}`)
  console.log(`Output files created in: ${OUTPUT_DIR}`)
}

main().catch(console.error)



==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/scripts/README-rules-generator.md ====
# Rules Generator Tool

A comprehensive tool for archiving existing rules and generating new rules files from JSON input for the Freshsales Intake Guard application.

## Overview

This tool provides:
- **Archiving**: Automatically backs up existing rules before generation
- **Validation**: JSON schema validation for input files
- **Generation**: Creates MDC, MD, JSON, and YAML rule files
- **Flexibility**: Supports multiple file formats and frontmatter configurations

## Files

- `rules-schema.json` - JSON Schema for rule definitions
- `generate-rules-from-json.sh` - Main generation script
- `sample-rules-input.json` - Example input file
- `README-rules-generator.md` - This documentation

## Usage

### Basic Usage

```bash
# Generate rules from JSON file
./scripts/generate-rules-from-json.sh input-rules.json

# Generate to custom directory
./scripts/generate-rules-from-json.sh input-rules.json /path/to/custom/rules
```

### Input JSON Structure

The input JSON must follow the schema defined in `rules-schema.json`. Here's the basic structure:

```json
{
  "rules": [
    {
      "id": "rule-identifier",
      "title": "Rule Title",
      "description": "Brief description of the rule",
      "category": "typescript|react|security|etc",
      "priority": "critical|high|medium|low",
      "justification": "Why this rule is important",
      "content": [
        {
          "heading": "Section Heading",
          "level": 2,
          "content": [
            {
              "type": "paragraph",
              "text": "Regular text content with **bold** formatting"
            },
            {
              "type": "list",
              "items": [
                "First bullet point",
                "**Bold item** with formatting",
                "Regular item"
              ]
            },
            {
              "type": "code",
              "language": "typescript",
              "caption": "Code example caption",
              "code": "const example = 'hello world';"
            },
            {
              "type": "note",
              "text": "Important information to highlight"
            }
          ]
        }
      ],
      "examples": [
        {
          "title": "Example Title",
          "language": "typescript",
          "code": "console.log('example');",
          "description": "What this example demonstrates"
        }
      ],
      "relatedRules": ["other-rule-id"],
      "tags": ["tag1", "tag2"],
      "fileMetadata": {
        "filename": "rule-identifier.mdc",
        "frontmatter": {
          "alwaysApply": true,
          "globs": ["**/*.ts"],
          "description": "Short description"
        }
      },
      "status": "active",
      "reviewCycle": "quarterly"
    }
  ],
  "metadata": {
    "version": "1.0.0",
    "component": "freshsales-app"
  }
}
```

## Content Structure

Rules can include rich structured content with multiple sections, each containing different types of content blocks:

### Content Sections
- **heading**: Section title (e.g., "Authentication Requirements")
- **level**: Heading level (1-6, default: 2)
- **content**: Array of content blocks within the section

### Content Block Types

#### Paragraph
```json
{
  "type": "paragraph",
  "text": "Regular text content with **bold** and *italic* formatting"
}
```

#### List
```json
{
  "type": "list",
  "items": [
    "First bullet point",
    "**Bold item** with formatting",
    "Regular item"
  ]
}
```

#### Code Block
```json
{
  "type": "code",
  "language": "typescript",
  "caption": "Optional code block title",
  "code": "const example = 'hello world';",
  "references": [
    {
      "type": "citation",
      "index": 8
    }
  ]
}
```

#### Notes, Warnings, Tips
```json
{
  "type": "note",
  "text": "Important information to highlight"
}
```

#### Examples
```json
{
  "type": "example",
  "text": "Detailed example explanation",
  "caption": "Example title"
}
```

### Content References
References can be added to any content block:
```json
"references": [
  {
    "type": "citation",
    "index": 8
  },
  {
    "type": "link",
    "url": "https://example.com",
    "text": "Example Link"
  }
]
```

## Rule Categories

Supported categories:
- `architecture` - System architecture patterns
- `coding-standards` - Code style and conventions
- `security` - Security practices and requirements
- `performance` - Performance optimization rules
- `testing` - Testing methodologies and requirements
- `documentation` - Documentation standards
- `deployment` - Deployment and release processes
- `monitoring` - Logging and monitoring requirements
- `accessibility` - Accessibility compliance
- `development-workflow` - Development processes and tools
- `freshworks-integration` - Freshworks-specific integration rules
- `typescript` - TypeScript language requirements
- `react` - React framework requirements
- `node` - Node.js runtime requirements
- `database` - Database interaction patterns
- `api` - API design and usage patterns
- `ui-ux` - User interface and experience guidelines
- `error-handling` - Error handling and recovery
- `logging` - Logging and debugging practices
- `configuration` - Configuration management

## File Types

### MDC Files (Cursor Rules)
- Include YAML frontmatter for Cursor IDE integration
- Support `alwaysApply`, `globs`, and `description` frontmatter
- Automatically formatted with rule structure

### Markdown Files (MD)
- Standard markdown format
- Include metadata sections
- No frontmatter support

### JSON/YAML Files
- Store rule data as structured data
- Useful for programmatic access
- Include full rule metadata

## Rule ID Format

Rule IDs must follow these rules:
- Lowercase alphanumeric characters only
- Use hyphens as separators
- No spaces or special characters
- Examples: `api-validation`, `typescript-strict`, `error-boundary-usage`

## Examples

### Generating Freshworks API Rules

```bash
# Create input JSON for Freshworks API validation rules
cat > freshworks-rules.json << 'EOF'
{
  "rules": [
    {
      "id": "freshworks-api-auth",

        "filename": "typescript-strict.mdc",

./scripts/generate-rules-from-json.sh typescript-rules.json
```

## Validation

The tool validates:
- JSON syntax
- Schema compliance (if `ajv-cli` is installed)
- Rule ID format (lowercase alphanumeric with hyphens)
- Required fields

Install schema validator:
```bash
npm install -g ajv-cli
```

## Archiving

Before generating new rules, the tool automatically:
- Creates timestamped archive directory in `.cursor/rules-archive/`
- Copies all existing rule files to archive
- Reports number of archived files

## Output Structure

Generated files are placed in the output directory with appropriate naming:

```
.cursor/rules/
├── freshworks-api-validation.mdc
├── typescript-strict-mode.mdc
├── error-boundary-usage.mdc
└── ...
```

## Integration with AI

This tool is designed to work with AI language models for rule generation:

1. **Schema First**: Use `rules-schema.json` to define expected structure
2. **Structured Input**: AI generates JSON following the schema
3. **Validation**: Tool validates AI-generated content
4. **Flexible Output**: Multiple file formats for different use cases

### Example AI Prompt

```
Generate rules for Freshworks CRM integration following this JSON schema:

[Include rules-schema.json content]

Create rules for:
1. API authentication and authorization
2. Data validation for CRM entities
3. Error handling for API failures
4. Rate limiting and retry logic

Output as valid JSON matching the schema structure.
```

## Troubleshooting

### Common Issues

**Invalid JSON**
```
Error: Invalid JSON file 'input.json'
```
- Check JSON syntax with `jq empty input.json`
- Validate against schema with `ajv validate -s rules-schema.json -d input.json`

**Invalid Rule ID**
```
Error: Invalid rule ID format: 'Invalid-Rule_ID'
```
- Use only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens
- Examples: `api-validation`, `typescript-config`, `error-handling`

**Missing Required Fields**
```
Error: missing required field 'title'
```
- Ensure all required fields from schema are present
- Check `rules-schema.json` for required fields list

### Dependencies

Required tools:
- `jq` - JSON processing
- `bash` - Shell environment

Optional tools:
- `ajv-cli` - JSON schema validation
- `python3` - YAML conversion (for YAML output)

Install dependencies:
```bash
# macOS
brew install jq

# Ubuntu/Debian
sudo apt-get install jq

# Schema validation
npm install -g ajv-cli
```

## Best Practices

1. **Use Descriptive IDs**: Rule IDs should be descriptive but concise
2. **Include Examples**: Always provide code examples for implementation rules
3. **Link Related Rules**: Use `relatedRules` to create rule relationships
4. **Categorize Properly**: Choose appropriate categories for better organization
5. **Test Generated Rules**: Review generated files before committing
6. **Version Control**: Archive previous rules before major changes

## Schema Reference

See `rules-schema.json` for complete field definitions and validation rules.

==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/scripts/run-notaryresume-headed.sh ====
#!/usr/bin/env bash

set -euo pipefail

workspace_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
har_path="${1:-$workspace_root/archived/apps/notaryresume-automation/data/www.notaryresume.com-login-jobboard-acceptorder-refreshpage.har}"

if [[ ! -f "$har_path" ]]; then
  echo "HAR file not found: $har_path"
  exit 1
fi

eval "$(
  HAR_PATH="$har_path" python3 - <<'PY'
import json
import os
import pathlib
import shlex
import urllib.parse

har_path = pathlib.Path(os.environ["HAR_PATH"])
obj = json.loads(har_path.read_text())

username = ""
password = ""
for entry in obj.get("log", {}).get("entries", []):
    request = entry.get("request", {})
    if request.get("method") != "POST":
        continue
    if request.get("url") != "https://www.notaryresume.com/admin/login":
        continue
    body = ((request.get("postData") or {}).get("text") or "")
    parsed = urllib.parse.parse_qs(body)
    username = (parsed.get("email") or [""])[0]
    password = (parsed.get("password") or [""])[0]
    break

if not username or not password:
    raise SystemExit("Could not extract login credentials from HAR")

print("export NOTARYRESUME_USERNAME=" + shlex.quote(username))
print("export NOTARYRESUME_PASSWORD=" + shlex.quote(password))
PY
)"

export NOTIFY_PROVIDER="${NOTIFY_PROVIDER:-telegram}"
export POLL_INTERVAL_MS="${POLL_INTERVAL_MS:-10000}"
export NOTARYRESUME_EXECUTION_MODE="${NOTARYRESUME_EXECUTION_MODE:-browser}"

# Prefer npm exec so we don't require `pnpm` to be on PATH.
exec "$workspace_root/scripts/run-with-zsh-login.sh" npm exec nx run notaryresume-automation:serve



==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/scripts/run-with-zsh-login.sh ====
#!/usr/bin/env bash

set -euo pipefail

if [[ $# -eq 0 ]]; then
  echo "Usage: $0 <command...>"
  echo "Example: $0 pnpm exec nx run notaryresume-automation:typecheck"
  exit 1
fi

workspace_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
workspace_root_escaped="$(printf '%q' "$workspace_root")"
command_escaped="$(printf '%q ' "$@")"
command_escaped="${command_escaped% }"

exec /bin/zsh -lic "cd ${workspace_root_escaped} && ${command_escaped}"

#!/usr/bin/env node
/* eslint-disable no-console */
const http = require('http')
const { spawn, execSync } = require('child_process')

const PORT = Number(process.env.CURSOR_FLOW_PORT || 4488)
const READY_PATH = '/'
const MAX_ATTEMPTS = Number(process.env.CURSOR_FLOW_ATTEMPTS || 40)
const INTERVAL_MS = Number(process.env.CURSOR_FLOW_INTERVAL_MS || 500)

let bridgeProc = null
let appProc = null

function sleep(ms) {
  return new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms))
}

async function waitUntilReady() {
  for (let i = 1; i <= MAX_ATTEMPTS; i++) {
    const isReady = await new Promise(resolve => {
      const req = http.get({ host: 'localhost', port: PORT, path: READY_PATH, timeout: 1000 }, res => {
        res.resume()
        resolve(res.statusCode === 200)
      })
      req.on('error', () => resolve(false))
      req.on('timeout', () => {
        try { req.destroy() } catch {}
        resolve(false)
      })
    })
    if (isReady) return true
    await sleep(INTERVAL_MS)
  }
  return false
}

function cleanup() {
  if (appProc && !appProc.killed) {
    try { process.kill(appProc.pid) } catch {}
  }
  if (bridgeProc && !bridgeProc.killed) {
    try { process.kill(bridgeProc.pid) } catch {}
  }
}

process.on('SIGINT', () => { cleanup(); process.exit(130) })
process.on('SIGTERM', () => { cleanup(); process.exit(143) })
process.on('exit', () => { cleanup() })

;(async () => {
  console.log(`🌉 Starting Cursor Flow bridge on http://localhost:${PORT} ...`)
  bridgeProc = spawn(process.execPath, ['tools/cursor/feature-bridge.cjs'], {
    env: { ...process.env, CURSOR_FLOW_PORT: String(PORT), CURSOR_FLOW_APP: 'bravado' },
    stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'],
    detached: false,
  })
  bridgeProc.stdout.on('data', d => process.stdout.write(`[bridge] ${d}`))
  bridgeProc.stderr.on('data', d => process.stderr.write(`[bridge] ${d}`))

  const ready = await waitUntilReady()
  if (!ready) {
    console.error(`❌ Cursor Flow bridge did not become ready on port ${PORT}`)
    process.exit(1)
  }
  console.log('✅ Cursor Flow bridge is ready')

  console.log('🔍 Quick verification before starting Bravado...')

  // Run verification before starting the app
  try {
    const verificationResult = execSync('node verify-cursor-flow-fix.cjs', {
      encoding: 'utf8',
      stdio: 'pipe'
    })

    if (verificationResult.includes('🎉 Verification complete!')) {
      console.log('✅ Pre-flight checks passed!')
    } else {
      console.log('⚠️  Some pre-flight checks failed, but continuing...')
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.log('⚠️  Pre-flight verification failed, but continuing with startup...')
    console.log('Error:', error.message)
  }

  console.log('🏥 Starting Bravado with Cursor Flow enabled...')
  appProc = spawn('pnpm', ['exec', 'nx', 'run', 'bravado:serve'], {
    env: { ...process.env, CURSOR_FLOW: 'true' },
    stdio: 'inherit',
  })

  // Wait a bit for the app to initialize, then run verification
  setTimeout(async () => {
    try {
      console.log('\n🔍 Running Cursor Flow integration verification...')

      // Run the verification script
      const verificationResult = execSync('node verify-cursor-flow-fix.cjs', {
        encoding: 'utf8',
        stdio: 'pipe'
      })

      console.log(verificationResult)

      // Check if verification passed
      if (verificationResult.includes('🎉 Verification complete!')) {
        console.log('✅ Cursor Flow integration verified successfully!')
      } else {
        console.log('⚠️  Some verification checks failed, but continuing...')
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.log('⚠️  Verification script failed, but continuing with startup...')
      console.log('Error:', error.message)
    }
  }, 3000) // Wait 3 seconds for app to initialize

  appProc.on('exit', code => {
    console.log(`Bravado exited with code ${code}`)
    cleanup()
    process.exit(code ?? 0)
  })
})().catch(err => {
  console.error('Fatal error in start-cursorflow-bravado', err)
  cleanup()
  process.exit(1)
})

==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/scripts/unify-patient-folders.py ====
#!/usr/bin/env python3
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import re
import shutil
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Dict, Iterable, List, Optional, Tuple

DEFAULT_PRESCRIPTIONS_ROOT = Path("output/Bravado-Prescrption/by-patient")
DEFAULT_POST_PROCESSED_ROOT = Path("output/Bravado-Patient-Records-Post-Processed")
DEFAULT_OUTPUT_ROOT = Path("output/Bravado-Unified-Patient-Folders")

FOLDER_SLUG_RE = re.compile(r"^patient-\d+-\d+-uiGrid-[^-]+-cell-(.+)$")


def slugify(value: str) -> str:
    value = value.strip().lower()
    value = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", value)
    value = re.sub(r"-+", "-", value).strip("-")
    return value


def parse_folder_slug(folder_name: str) -> Optional[str]:
    match = FOLDER_SLUG_RE.match(folder_name)
    if not match:
        return None
    return match.group(1)


def find_latest_master_root(post_processed_root: Path) -> Optional[Path]:
    if not post_processed_root.exists():
        return None
    candidates = [
        p
        for p in post_processed_root.iterdir()
        if p.is_dir() and p.name.startswith("master-no-encounters-")
    ]
    if not candidates:
        return None
    candidates.sort(key=lambda p: p.stat().st_mtime, reverse=True)
    return candidates[0]


@dataclass
class PatientMatch:
    folder_path: Path
    folder_slug: Optional[str]
    master_json_path: Optional[Path]
    name_slug: Optional[str]
    prescription_dir: Optional[Path]


def load_master_name_slug(master_json_path: Path) -> Optional[str]:
    try:
        data = json.loads(master_json_path.read_text())
    except Exception:
        return None
    demo = data.get("demographics", {})
    name = demo.get("name", {})
    first = name.get("first")
    last = name.get("last")
    if first and last:
        return f"{slugify(last)}-{slugify(first)}"
    full = name.get("full")
    if isinstance(full, str) and "," in full:
        last_part, first_part = [p.strip() for p in full.split(",", 1)]
        if last_part and first_part:
            return f"{slugify(last_part)}-{slugify(first_part.split()[0])}"
    return None


def build_prescription_index(prescriptions_root: Path) -> Dict[str, Path]:
    index: Dict[str, Path] = {}
    if not prescriptions_root.exists():
        return index
    for entry in prescriptions_root.iterdir():
        if not entry.is_dir():
            continue
        key = slugify(entry.name)
        index[key] = entry
    return index


def iter_master_folders(master_root: Path) -> Iterable[Path]:
    for entry in master_root.iterdir():
        if entry.is_dir() and entry.name.startswith("patient-"):
            yield entry


def build_patient_match(
    folder: Path, prescriptions_index: Dict[str, Path]
) -> PatientMatch:
    folder_slug_raw = parse_folder_slug(folder.name)
    folder_slug = slugify(folder_slug_raw or "") if folder_slug_raw else None
    master_json_path = folder / "master.json"
    name_slug = None
    if master_json_path.exists():
        name_slug = load_master_name_slug(master_json_path)

    candidates = [s for s in [name_slug, folder_slug] if s]
    prescription_dir = None
    for slug in candidates:
        if slug in prescriptions_index:
            prescription_dir = prescriptions_index[slug]
            break

    return PatientMatch(
        folder_path=folder,
        folder_slug=folder_slug,
        master_json_path=master_json_path if master_json_path.exists() else None,
        name_slug=name_slug,
        prescription_dir=prescription_dir,
    )


def copy_prescriptions(
    prescription_dir: Path,
    output_dir: Path,
    include_dated: bool,
    dry_run: bool,
) -> None:
    all_csv = None
    for entry in prescription_dir.glob("*-all.csv"):
        all_csv = entry
        break

    if all_csv:
        target = output_dir / "prescriptions-all.csv"
        if not dry_run:
            shutil.copy2(all_csv, target)

    if include_dated:
        dated_dir = output_dir / "prescriptions-dated"
        if not dry_run:
            dated_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        for entry in prescription_dir.glob("*.csv"):
            if entry.name.endswith("-all.csv"):
                continue
            target = dated_dir / entry.name
            if not dry_run:
                shutil.copy2(entry, target)


def ensure_dir(path: Path, dry_run: bool) -> None:
    if dry_run:
        return
    path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Unify patient master.json and prescription CSVs into a single folder."
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--prescriptions-root",
        type=Path,
        default=DEFAULT_PRESCRIPTIONS_ROOT,
        help="Root folder for per-patient prescription CSVs",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--post-processed-root",
        type=Path,
        default=DEFAULT_POST_PROCESSED_ROOT,
        help="Root folder containing master-no-encounters-* directories",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--master-root",
        type=Path,
        default=None,
        help="Explicit master-no-encounters-* directory (overrides auto-detect)",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--output-root",
        type=Path,
        default=DEFAULT_OUTPUT_ROOT,
        help="Where unified folders should be created",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--include-dated",
        action="store_true",
        help="Copy per-date prescription CSVs into prescriptions-dated/",
    )
    parser.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    prescriptions_root: Path = args.prescriptions_root
    post_processed_root: Path = args.post_processed_root

    master_root = args.master_root
    if master_root is None:
        master_root = find_latest_master_root(post_processed_root)
    if master_root is None or not master_root.exists():
        raise SystemExit(
            "Could not locate master-no-encounters-* directory. "
            "Pass --master-root to specify it explicitly."
        )

    prescriptions_index = build_prescription_index(prescriptions_root)

    total_patients = 0
    matched_prescriptions = 0

    for folder in iter_master_folders(master_root):
        total_patients += 1
        match = build_patient_match(folder, prescriptions_index)

        output_dir = args.output_root / folder.name
        ensure_dir(output_dir, args.dry_run)

        if match.master_json_path:
            if not args.dry_run:
                shutil.copy2(match.master_json_path, output_dir / "master.json")

        if match.prescription_dir:
            matched_prescriptions += 1
            copy_prescriptions(
                match.prescription_dir,
                output_dir,
                include_dated=args.include_dated,
                dry_run=args.dry_run,
            )

    print(
        "Unified folders created. "
        f"Patients: {total_patients}, matched prescriptions: {matched_prescriptions}. "
        f"Output: {args.output_root}"
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/bin/bash
# Verification script for Nx workspace setup

set -e

export NVM_DIR="${NVM_DIR:-$HOME/.nvm}"
[ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && \. "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"
export PATH="$PATH:$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/v20.18.1/bin"

echo "🔍 Verifying Nx workspace setup..."
echo ""

# Choose package manager for running local Nx.
# Some IDE environments don't inherit shell PATH, so pnpm may not be available.
if command -v pnpm &> /dev/null; then
  PACKAGE_MGR="pnpm"
  echo "✅ pnpm found: $(which pnpm)"
  echo "   Version: $(pnpm --version)"
elif command -v npm &> /dev/null; then
  PACKAGE_MGR="npm"
  echo "✅ npm found: $(which npm)"
  echo "   Version: $(npm --version)"
else
  echo "❌ Neither pnpm nor npm is available in PATH"
  exit 1
fi

# Nx respects the workspace "packageManager" field. Follow it to avoid
# "This project is configured to use X" errors.
WORKSPACE_PACKAGE_MGR="$(node -e "const fs=require('fs');const pkg=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json','utf8'));process.stdout.write(pkg.packageManager||'');")"
if [[ "$WORKSPACE_PACKAGE_MGR" == npm@* ]]; then
  if command -v npm &> /dev/null; then
    PACKAGE_MGR="npm"
  else
    PACKAGE_MGR="pnpm"
  fi
elif [[ "$WORKSPACE_PACKAGE_MGR" == pnpm@* ]]; then
  if command -v pnpm &> /dev/null; then
    PACKAGE_MGR="pnpm"
  else
    PACKAGE_MGR="npm"
  fi
fi

echo "✅ Using package manager for Nx: ${PACKAGE_MGR}"

# Run Nx through the selected package manager.
# IMPORTANT: when using `npm exec`, pass `--` so options like `--status` go to `nx`, not to `npm`.
run_nx() {
  if [ "${PACKAGE_MGR}" = "npm" ]; then
    npm exec -- nx "$@"
  else
    pnpm exec nx "$@"
  fi
}

# Check Nx
if command -v nx &> /dev/null || run_nx --version &> /dev/null; then
  echo "✅ Nx found"
else
  echo "❌ Nx not found"
  exit 1
fi

# Check daemon status
echo ""
echo "🔍 Checking Nx daemon status..."
if run_nx daemon --status &> /dev/null; then
  echo "✅ Nx daemon is running"
  run_nx daemon --status
else
  echo "⚠️  Nx daemon is not running"
  echo "   Attempting to start..."
  run_nx daemon --start
  sleep 2
  if run_nx daemon --status &> /dev/null; then
    echo "✅ Nx daemon started successfully"
  else
    echo "❌ Failed to start Nx daemon"
    exit 1
  fi
fi

# Test project graph
echo ""
echo "🔍 Testing project graph access..."
if run_nx show projects &> /dev/null; then
  PROJECT_COUNT=$(run_nx show projects --json | jq 'length' 2>/dev/null || echo "unknown")
  echo "✅ Project graph accessible (found $PROJECT_COUNT projects)"
else
  echo "⚠️  Project graph access failed"
fi

echo ""
echo "🎉 Nx workspace setup verified!"

==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/tools/cursor/feature-bridge.cjs ====
#!/usr/bin/env node
/* eslint-disable no-console */
const http = require('http')
const { spawn } = require('child_process')
const fs = require('fs')
const path = require('path')

const PORT = Number(process.env.CURSOR_FLOW_PORT || 4488)
const APP_NAME = process.env.CURSOR_FLOW_APP || 'bravado'
const LOG_DIR = path.join(__dirname, '../../logs', APP_NAME, 'cursor-flow')
const SESSION_DIR = path.join(LOG_DIR, 'sessions')
const LOG_FILE = path.join(LOG_DIR, `${new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, '-')}.log`)
const SESSION_STATE_FILE = path.join(SESSION_DIR, 'current-session.json')
const FLOWS_DIR = path.join(process.cwd(), 'apps/bravado/flows')

// Ensure directories exist
if (!fs.existsSync(LOG_DIR)) {
  fs.mkdirSync(LOG_DIR, { recursive: true })
}
if (!fs.existsSync(SESSION_DIR)) {
  fs.mkdirSync(SESSION_DIR, { recursive: true })
}
if (!fs.existsSync(FLOWS_DIR)) {
  fs.mkdirSync(FLOWS_DIR, { recursive: true })
}

// Flow management functions
function loadFlows() {
  const flows = {};
  try {
    if (fs.existsSync(FLOWS_DIR)) {
      const items = fs.readdirSync(FLOWS_DIR);
      for (const item of items) {
        if (item.endsWith('.json')) {
          const flowName = item.replace('.json', '');
          const flowPath = path.join(FLOWS_DIR, item);
          try {
            const flowContent = fs.readFileSync(flowPath, 'utf8');
            flows[flowName] = JSON.parse(flowContent);
          } catch (err) {
            console.log(`Error loading flow ${flowName}:`, err.message);
          }
        }
      }
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log('Error reading flows directory:', err.message);
  }
  return flows;
}

function saveFlow(flowName, flowData) {
  try {
    const flowPath = path.join(FLOWS_DIR, `${flowName}.json`);
    fs.writeFileSync(flowPath, JSON.stringify(flowData, null, 2), 'utf8');
    console.log(`Flow ${flowName} saved successfully`);
    return { success: true, path: flowPath };
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error saving flow ${flowName}:`, err.message);
    return { success: false, error: err.message };
  }
}

// Session state management
let sessionState = {
  sessionId: new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, '-'),
  submissions: [],
  lastActivity: new Date().toISOString(),
  status: 'active'
}

function loadSessionState() {
  try {
    if (fs.existsSync(SESSION_STATE_FILE)) {
      const data = fs.readFileSync(SESSION_STATE_FILE, 'utf8')
      sessionState = { ...sessionState, ...JSON.parse(data) }
      console.log(`Loaded previous session: ${sessionState.sessionId}`)
      logToFile(`Resumed session: ${sessionState.sessionId} with ${sessionState.submissions.length} previous submissions`)
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.log('No previous session found, starting fresh')
  }
}

function saveSessionState() {
  try {
    sessionState.lastActivity = new Date().toISOString()
    fs.writeFileSync(SESSION_STATE_FILE, JSON.stringify(sessionState, null, 2))
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to save session state:', error)
  }
}

function addSubmission(submission) {
  sessionState.submissions.push({
    id: Date.now().toString(),
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    ...submission
  })
  saveSessionState()
  logToFile(`New submission added: ${submission.type || 'unknown'} - ${submission.description || 'no description'}`)
}

// Create log stream
const logStream = fs.createWriteStream(LOG_FILE, { flags: 'a' })

function logToFile(message) {
  const timestamp = new Date().toISOString()
  const logEntry = `[${timestamp}] ${message}\n`
  logStream.write(logEntry)
}

// Cleanup on exit
process.on('exit', () => {
  sessionState.status = 'ended'
  saveSessionState()
  logStream.end()
})

process.on('SIGINT', () => {
  sessionState.status = 'interrupted'
  saveSessionState()
  logStream.end()
  process.exit(0)
})

process.on('SIGTERM', () => {
  sessionState.status = 'terminated'
  saveSessionState()
  logStream.end()
  process.exit(0)
})

/** @type {Set<import('http').ServerResponse>} */
const clients = new Set()

function broadcast(message) {
  const line = typeof message === 'string' ? message : JSON.stringify(message)
  logToFile(line)
  for (const res of clients) {
    try {
      res.write(`data: ${line}\n\n`)
    } catch {}
  }
}

// Flow execution handlers
async function handleFlowOperation(operation, data) {
  const { flow, model } = data;
  
  switch (operation) {
    case 'flowsUpdated':
      console.log(`Flows updated for ${data.app}`);
      logToFile(`Flows updated: ${data.flows?.length || 0} flows`);
      break;
      
    case 'flowStaged':
      console.log(`Flow staged: ${flow.name}`);
      logToFile(`Flow staged: ${flow.name} (${flow.id})`);
      // Save to staged flows directory
      const stagedPath = path.join(FLOWS_DIR, 'staged', `${flow.name}.json`);
      if (!fs.existsSync(path.dirname(stagedPath))) {
        fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(stagedPath), { recursive: true });
      }
      fs.writeFileSync(stagedPath, JSON.stringify(flow, null, 2));
      break;
      
    case 'flowPromoted':
      console.log(`Flow promoted: ${flow.name} v${flow.version}`);
      logToFile(`Flow promoted: ${flow.name} v${flow.version}`);
      // Move from staged to promoted
      const promotedPath = path.join(FLOWS_DIR, 'promoted', `${flow.name}.json`);
      if (!fs.existsSync(path.dirname(promotedPath))) {
        fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(promotedPath), { recursive: true });
      }
      fs.writeFileSync(promotedPath, JSON.stringify(flow, null, 2));
      break;
      
    case 'testFlow':
      console.log(`Testing flow: ${flow.name}`);
      logToFile(`Testing flow: ${flow.name} with ${flow.steps.length} steps`);
      // Simulate test execution
      broadcast(JSON.stringify({
        type: 'testStarted',
        flow: flow.name,
        steps: flow.steps.length
      }));
      
      // Simulate step-by-step execution
      for (let i = 0; i < flow.steps.length; i++) {
        const step = flow.steps[i];
        await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 500));
        broadcast(JSON.stringify({
          type: 'stepTested',
          stepId: step.id,
          success: Math.random() > 0.2,
          message: `Step ${i + 1}: ${step.type} - ${step.description || 'No description'}`
        }));
      }
      
      broadcast(JSON.stringify({
        type: 'testCompleted',
        flow: flow.name,
        success: true
      }));
      break;
      
    case 'generateFlow':
      console.log(`Generating flow with ${model}: ${flow.name}`);
      logToFile(`AI Generation requested: ${flow.name} using ${model}`);
      
      // Simulate AI generation
      broadcast(JSON.stringify({
        type: 'generationStarted',
        flow: flow.name,
        model: model
      }));
      
      // Simulate processing time
      setTimeout(() => {
        broadcast(JSON.stringify({
          type: 'generationCompleted',
          flow: flow.name,
          model: model,
          success: true,
          message: 'Flow generated successfully with AI assistance'
        }));
      }, 3000);
      break;
      
    default:
      console.log(`Unknown flow operation: ${operation}`);
  }
}

function sse(req, res) {
  res.writeHead(200, {
    'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream',
    'Cache-Control': 'no-cache',
    Connection: 'keep-alive',
    'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
  })
  res.write('\n')
  clients.add(res)
  req.on('close', () => clients.delete(res))
}

function runCursor(prompt) {
  const args = ['-p', '--force', '--output-format', 'stream-json', '--model', 'gpt-5', prompt]
  const child = spawn('cursor-agent', args, { stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'] })
  child.stdout.on('data', d => broadcast(`CURSOR: ${d.toString().trimEnd()}`))
  child.stderr.on('data', d => broadcast(`CURSOR-ERR: ${d.toString().trimEnd()}`))
  child.on('close', code => broadcast(`CURSOR EXIT: ${code}`))
}

function runNx(cmd) {
  const parts = cmd.split(' ')
  const child = spawn(parts[0], parts.slice(1), { stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'] })
  child.stdout.on('data', d => broadcast(d.toString().trimEnd()))
  child.stderr.on('data', d => broadcast(d.toString().trimEnd()))
  child.on('close', code => broadcast(`NX EXIT: ${code}`))
}

async function handlePost(req, res, body) {
  try {
    const data = JSON.parse(body || '{}')
    const type = data.type || data.event

    // Handle new flow operations from the comprehensive editor
    if (data.event) {
      await handleFlowOperation(data.event, data.payload || data);
      res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*' })
      return res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: true, sessionId: sessionState.sessionId }))
    }

    // Track submission
    addSubmission({
      type: type,
      selector: data.selector,
      description: data.description,
      app: data.app
    })

    if (type === 'cursor.apply') {
      const app = data.app || 'kareo'
      const selector = data.selector || ''
      const description = data.description || ''
      const prompt = [
        'Goal: Apply a small, typed, SRP-compliant change in Web Automation Workspace.',
        `App: ${app}`,
        `Selector: ${selector}`,
        `Description: ${description}`,
        'Constraints: TS strict, robust selectors, tests updated, idempotent edits.',
        'Likely files: apps/' + app + '/src/**, libs/**, tools/**.',
      ].join('\n')
      runCursor(prompt)
      res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain', 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*' })
      return res.end('apply started')
    }
    if (type === 'cursor.test') {
      const app = data.app || 'kareo'
      runNx(`nx run ${app}:test`)
      res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain', 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*' })
      return res.end('test started')
    }
    if (type === 'cursor.promote') {
      const branch = `feat/cursor-${Date.now()}`
      // Use shell=true for compound command simplicity here
      const child = spawn('bash', ['-lc', `git switch -c ${branch} && git add -A && git commit -m "feat: Cursor-driven feature" || true`], { stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'] })
      child.stdout.on('data', d => broadcast(d.toString().trimEnd()))
      child.stderr.on('data', d => broadcast(d.toString().trimEnd()))
      child.on('close', () => broadcast(`BRANCH: ${branch}`))
      res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain', 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*' })
      return res.end('promote started')
    }
    if (type === 'executeFlow') {
      const flowName = data.flowName
      if (!flowName) {
        res.writeHead(400, { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain', 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*' })
        return res.end('flowName required')
      }

      // This would need to be handled by the application
      // For now, we'll just broadcast that flow execution was requested
      broadcast(`FLOW EXECUTION REQUESTED: ${flowName}`)
      res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain', 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*' })
      return res.end(`Flow execution requested: ${flowName}`)
    }
    if (type === 'saveFlow') {
      const flowName = data.flowName
      const flowData = data.flowData
      if (!flowName || !flowData) {
        res.writeHead(400, { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain', 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*' })
        return res.end('flowName and flowData required')
      }

      const result = saveFlow(flowName, flowData)
      if (result.success) {
        broadcast(`FLOW SAVED: ${flowName}`)
        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain', 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*' })
        return res.end(`Flow ${flowName} saved successfully`)
      } else {
        res.writeHead(500, { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain', 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*' })
        return res.end(`Failed to save flow: ${result.error}`)
      }
    }
    if (type === 'generateFlow') {
      const flowName = data.flowName
      const flowData = data.flowData
      if (!flowName || !flowData) {
        res.writeHead(400, { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain', 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*' })
        return res.end('flowName and flowData required')
      }

      // Save to staging first
      const stagingPath = path.join(FLOWS_DIR, '..', 'staging', `${flowName}.json`)
      try {
        fs.writeFileSync(stagingPath, JSON.stringify(flowData, null, 2), 'utf8')
        broadcast(`FLOW STAGED: ${flowName} - Ready for Cursor processing`)

        // TODO: Trigger Cursor CLI with the staged flow
        // This would involve calling the Cursor CLI with the appropriate prompt and flow data

        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain', 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*' })
        return res.end(`Flow ${flowName} staged for generation`)
      } catch (error) {
        res.writeHead(500, { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain', 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*' })
        return res.end(`Failed to stage flow: ${error.message}`)
      }
    }
    res.writeHead(400, { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain', 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*' })
    res.end('unknown type')
  } catch (e) {
    res.writeHead(500, { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain', 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*' })
    res.end('error')
  }
}

const server = http.createServer((req, res) => {
  const { method, url } = req
  if (method === 'GET' && url === '/events') return sse(req, res)
    if (method === 'GET' && url === '/session') {
      res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*' })
      return res.end(JSON.stringify(sessionState, null, 2))
    }
    if (method === 'GET' && url === '/flows') {
      const flows = loadFlows();
      res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*' })
      return res.end(JSON.stringify(flows, null, 2))
    }
  if (method === 'GET' && url === '/') {
    res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/html', 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*' })
    return res.end('<!doctype html><meta charset="utf-8"><title>Cursor Flow</title><pre id=log></pre><script>var es=new EventSource("/events");var log=document.getElementById("log");es.onmessage=function(e){log.textContent+=e.data+"\n";log.scrollTop=log.scrollHeight;};</script>')
  }
  if (method === 'POST' && url === '/post') {
    let body = ''
    req.on('data', chunk => (body += chunk))
    req.on('end', () => handlePost(req, res, body))
    return
  }
  if (method === 'OPTIONS') {
    res.writeHead(204, {
      'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
      'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'GET,POST,OPTIONS',
      'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type',
    })
    return res.end()
  }
  res.writeHead(404, { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain', 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*' })
  res.end('not found')
})

// Load previous session state
loadSessionState()

server.listen(PORT, () => {
  console.log(`Cursor Flow bridge listening on http://localhost:${PORT}`)
  console.log(`Session ID: ${sessionState.sessionId}`)
  console.log(`Previous submissions: ${sessionState.submissions.length}`)
  logToFile(`Cursor Flow bridge started on http://localhost:${PORT}`)
  logToFile(`Session ID: ${sessionState.sessionId}`)
  logToFile(`Previous submissions: ${sessionState.submissions.length}`)
  logToFile(`Logs will be saved to: ${LOG_FILE}`)
})

server.on('error', (err) => {
  if (err.code === 'EADDRINUSE') {
    console.error(`❌ Port ${PORT} is already in use.`)
    console.error(`💡 Try one of these solutions:`)
    console.error(`   1. Kill existing process: lsof -ti:${PORT} | xargs kill -9`)
    console.error(`   2. Use different port: CURSOR_FLOW_PORT=4489 npm run ...`)
    console.error(`   3. Check if another Cursor Flow instance is running`)
    process.exit(1)
  } else {
    console.error('Bridge server error:', err)
    process.exit(1)
  }
})

==== FILE: /Users/evanmccall/Workspaces/Web Automation Workspace/tools/flows/to-playwright.ts ====
import fs from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'
import { FlowSpec, FlowStep } from './flow-types'

const ROOT = process.cwd()

function roleArgs(target: string): string {
  const [, roleAndRest] = target.split('role=')
  const [rolePart, ...restParts] = roleAndRest.split('[')
  const role = rolePart.trim()
  if (!restParts.length) return JSON.stringify(role)
  const rest = restParts.join('[').replace(/\]$/, '')
  const nameMatch = rest.match(/name\s*=\s*(.+)$/i)
  if (!nameMatch) return JSON.stringify(role)
  const nameRaw = nameMatch[1].trim()
  return `${JSON.stringify(role)}, { name: ${nameRaw} }`
}

function locatorExpr(target: string | undefined): string {
  if (!target) return ''
  if (target.startsWith('role=')) {
    return `page.getByRole(${roleArgs(target)})`
  }
  if (target.startsWith('testid=')) {
    return `page.getByTestId(${JSON.stringify(target.slice('testid='.length))})`
  }
  return `page.locator(${JSON.stringify(target)})`
}

function emitStep(step: FlowStep): string {
  const L = locatorExpr(step.target)
  const v = step.value
  switch (step.action) {
    case 'goto':
      return `await page.goto(${JSON.stringify(v)});`
    case 'click':
      return `await ${L}.click();`
    case 'fill':
      return `await ${L}.fill(${JSON.stringify(v ?? '')});`
    case 'expectVisible':
      return `await expect(${L}).toBeVisible();`
    case 'expectText':
      return `await expect(${L}).toHaveText(${v ?? '""'});`
    case 'waitForNavigation':
      return `await Promise.all([ page.waitForNavigation(), ${L ? `${L}.click()` : '/* trigger nav */'} ]);`
    case 'waitForTimeout':
      return `await page.waitForTimeout(${Number(v) || 500});`
    case 'selectOption':
      return `await ${L}.selectOption(${JSON.stringify(v ?? '')});`
    case 'check':
      return `await ${L}.check();`
    case 'uncheck':
      return `await ${L}.uncheck();`
    case 'press':
      return `await ${L}.press(${JSON.stringify(v ?? 'Enter')});`
    case 'upload':
      return `await ${L}.setInputFiles(${JSON.stringify(v ?? '')});`
    default:
      return `/* unsupported action: ${step.action} */`
  }
}

function tagHeader(tags: string[] | undefined): string {
  if (!tags?.length) return ''
  return `[@${tags.join(' @')}]`
}

function buildSpec(flow: FlowSpec): string {
  const banner = `// generated from flow: ${flow.name}`
  const name = `${tagHeader(flow.tags)} ${flow.name}`.trim()
  const steps = flow.steps.map(emitStep).join('\n  ')
  const baseNav = flow.baseUrl
    ? `const base = ${JSON.stringify(flow.baseUrl)};`
    : `const base = process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL || '';`
  return `import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';
// ${banner}
test('${name}', async ({ page }) => {
  ${baseNav}
  ${steps.replaceAll(`page.goto("/`, `page.goto(base + "/`)}
});
`
}

export function generateSpecFor(flowFile: string) {
  const raw = fs.readFileSync(flowFile, 'utf-8')
  const flow = JSON.parse(raw) as FlowSpec
  const outDir = path.join(ROOT, 'apps', flow.app, 'e2e', 'generated')
  fs.mkdirSync(outDir, { recursive: true })
  const safeName = flow.name
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '.')
    .replace(/\.+/g, '.')
    .replace(/^\.+|\.+$/g, '')
  const outPath = path.join(outDir, `${safeName}.spec.ts`)
  fs.writeFileSync(outPath, buildSpec(flow), 'utf-8')
  return outPath
}

export function generateAll() {
  const appsDir = path.join(ROOT, 'apps')
  const apps = fs
    .readdirSync(appsDir)
    .filter(d => fs.statSync(path.join(appsDir, d)).isDirectory())
  const out: string[] = []
  for (const app of apps) {
    const flowsDir = path.join(appsDir, app, 'flows')
    if (!fs.existsSync(flowsDir)) continue
    const files = fs
      .readdirSync(flowsDir)
      .filter(f => f.endsWith('.flow.json'))
    for (const f of files) out.push(generateSpecFor(path.join(flowsDir, f)))
  }
  return out
}

if (process.argv[1] && process.argv[1].endsWith('to-playwright.ts')) {
  const written = generateAll()
  console.log(`Generated ${written.length} spec(s):`)
  for (const w of written) console.log('  -', path.relative(ROOT, w))
}
