#!/usr/bin/env tsx
/**
 * Patient Data Audit and De-duplication Tool
 *
 * Audits patient folders in Bravado export directories to verify:
 * 1. Expected HTML files exist
 * 2. HTML files contain information about the patient named in the folder
 * 3. Identifies duplicate patient folders
 * 4. Provides interactive de-duplication
 *
 * Usage:
 *   tsx tools/patient-audit/audit-patient-data.ts <export-directory> [--output <report-path>] [--dedupe] [--delete-invalid] [--dry-run] [--yes]
 *
 * Example:
 *   tsx tools/patient-audit/audit-patient-data.ts output/Bravado-Patient-Export-2025-12-23
 *   tsx tools/patient-audit/audit-patient-data.ts output/Bravado-Patient-Export-2025-12-23 --dedupe --output audit-report.txt
 *   tsx tools/patient-audit/audit-patient-data.ts output/Bravado-Patient-Export-2025-12-23 --delete-invalid --dry-run
 *   tsx tools/patient-audit/audit-patient-data.ts output/Bravado-Patient-Export-2025-12-23 --delete-invalid --yes
 */

import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';
import * as readline from 'readline';

// ============================================================================
// Type Definitions
// ============================================================================

interface PatientFolderInfo {
  folderPath: string;
  folderName: string;
  patientId: string | null;
  nameSlug: string;
  status: 'ACTIVE_PATIENTS' | 'INACTIVE_PATIENTS' | 'FLAT';
  page: string | null;
}

interface PatientNameVariants {
  lastName: string;
  firstName: string;
  fullNameLastFirst: string; // "AADLAND, DANIEL"
  fullNameFirstLast: string; // "DANIEL AADLAND"
}

interface PatientAuditResult {
  folderPath: string;
  patientName: string;
  expectedFiles: string[];
  missingFiles: string[];
  filesWithPatientName: string[];
  filesWithoutPatientName: string[];
  isValid: boolean;
  completenessScore: number; // 0-100
}

interface DuplicateGroup {
  nameSlug: string;
  folders: PatientFolderInfo[];
  bestFolder: PatientFolderInfo | null;
  foldersToDelete: PatientFolderInfo[];
}

interface AuditSummary {
  totalPatients: number;
  validPatients: number;
  invalidPatients: number;
  duplicateGroups: number;
  patientsNeedingRedownload: PatientAuditResult[];
  duplicates: DuplicateGroup[];
  results: PatientAuditResult[];
}

// ============================================================================
// Constants
// ============================================================================

const EXPECTED_FILES = [
  'profile.html',
  'allergies.html',
  'diagnoses.html',
  'home-meds.html',
  'medical-history.html',
];

const OPTIONAL_FILES = ['encounter-history/url.json'];

const STATUS_FOLDERS: Array<'ACTIVE_PATIENTS' | 'INACTIVE_PATIENTS'> = [
  'ACTIVE_PATIENTS',
  'INACTIVE_PATIENTS',
];

// ============================================================================
// Utility Functions
// ============================================================================

/**
 * Parse patient folder name to extract metadata
 * Pattern: patient-{id}-{index}-uiGrid-{gridId}-cell-{nameSlug}
 */
function parsePatientFolderName(folderName: string): {
  patientId: string | null;
  nameSlug: string;
} {
  const gridMatch = folderName.match(
    /^patient-(\d+)-\d+-uiGrid-[^-]+-cell-(.+)$/
  );
  if (gridMatch) {
    return {
      patientId: gridMatch[1],
      nameSlug: gridMatch[2].toLowerCase(),
    };
  }

  if (folderName.startsWith('patient-')) {
    const remainder = folderName.replace(/^patient-/, '');
    const parts = remainder.split('-');
    if (parts.length > 1) {
      return {
        patientId: parts[0],
        nameSlug: parts.slice(1).join('-').toLowerCase(),
      };
    }
    return { patientId: parts[0] || null, nameSlug: '' };
  }

  return { patientId: null, nameSlug: folderName.toLowerCase() };
}

/**
 * Extract patient name slug from folder name
 * Format: patient-{timestamp}-{index}-uiGrid-{gridId}-cell-{firstname}-{lastname}
 * Returns: {firstname}-{lastname} -> "aadland-daniel"
 */
function extractPatientNameFromFolder(folderName: string): string | null {
  const match = folderName.match(/patient-[\d]+-[\d]+-uiGrid-[\w]+-cell-(.+)/);
  if (!match || !match[1]) {
    return null;
  }
  return match[1]; // Returns "aadland-daniel"
}

/**
 * Convert folder name format to HTML format for matching
 * Folder: "aadland-daniel" -> HTML: "AADLAND, DANIEL"
 */
function normalizePatientNameForMatching(
  folderName: string
): PatientNameVariants {
  const parts = folderName.split('-');
  if (parts.length < 2) {
    return {
      lastName: '',
      firstName: '',
      fullNameLastFirst: '',
      fullNameFirstLast: '',
    };
  }

  const firstName = parts[parts.length - 1] || ''; // "daniel"
  const lastName = parts.slice(0, -1).join('-') || ''; // "aadland"

  return {
    lastName: lastName.toUpperCase(),
    firstName: firstName.toUpperCase(),
    fullNameLastFirst: `${lastName}, ${firstName}`, // "AADLAND, DANIEL"
    fullNameFirstLast: `${firstName} ${lastName}`, // "DANIEL AADLAND"
  };
}

/**
 * Check if HTML file contains patient name
 */
function fileContainsPatientName(
  filePath: string,
  patientName: PatientNameVariants
): boolean {
  try {
    const content = fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf-8');
    const upperContent = content.toUpperCase();

    // Check for "LASTNAME, FIRSTNAME" format (most common in Bravado HTML)
    if (upperContent.includes(patientName.fullNameLastFirst)) {
      return true;
    }

    // Check for "FIRSTNAME LASTNAME" format
    if (upperContent.includes(patientName.fullNameFirstLast)) {
      return true;
    }

    // Check for individual name parts (less strict, but catches partial matches)
    if (patientName.lastName && upperContent.includes(patientName.lastName)) {
      if (patientName.firstName && upperContent.includes(patientName.firstName)) {
        return true;
      }
    }

    return false;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(`Error reading file ${filePath}:`, error);
    return false;
  }
}

/**
 * Calculate completeness score for a patient folder (0-100)
 */
function calculateCompletenessScore(
  result: PatientAuditResult
): number {
  const totalFiles = result.expectedFiles.length;
  const presentFiles = totalFiles - result.missingFiles.length;
  const filesWithName = result.filesWithPatientName.length;
  
  // File presence: 60% weight
  const fileScore = (presentFiles / totalFiles) * 60;
  
  // Patient name matching: 40% weight
  const nameScore = presentFiles > 0 
    ? (filesWithName / presentFiles) * 40 
    : 0;
  
  return Math.round(fileScore + nameScore);
}

// ============================================================================
// Directory Scanning
// ============================================================================

/**
 * Recursively find all patient folders in export directory
 */
function findAllPatientFolders(rootDir: string): PatientFolderInfo[] {
  const patientFolders: PatientFolderInfo[] = [];

  for (const status of STATUS_FOLDERS) {
    const statusPath = path.join(rootDir, status);
    if (!fs.existsSync(statusPath)) {
      continue;
    }

    try {
      const entries = fs.readdirSync(statusPath, { withFileTypes: true });

      for (const entry of entries) {
        if (!entry.isDirectory() || !entry.name.startsWith('page-')) {
          continue;
        }

        const pagePath = path.join(statusPath, entry.name);
        const page = entry.name;

        try {
          const patientEntries = fs.readdirSync(pagePath, {
            withFileTypes: true,
          });

          for (const patientEntry of patientEntries) {
            if (
              !patientEntry.isDirectory() ||
              !patientEntry.name.startsWith('patient-')
            ) {
              continue;
            }

            const patientPath = path.join(pagePath, patientEntry.name);
            const { patientId, nameSlug } = parsePatientFolderName(
              patientEntry.name
            );

            patientFolders.push({
              folderPath: patientPath,
              folderName: patientEntry.name,
              patientId,
              nameSlug,
              status,
              page,
            });
          }
        } catch (error) {
          console.error(`Error reading page directory ${pagePath}:`, error);
        }
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(`Error reading status directory ${statusPath}:`, error);
    }
  }

  try {
    const rootEntries = fs.readdirSync(rootDir, { withFileTypes: true });
    for (const entry of rootEntries) {
      if (!entry.isDirectory() || !entry.name.startsWith('patient-')) {
        continue;
      }
      const patientPath = path.join(rootDir, entry.name);
      const { patientId, nameSlug } = parsePatientFolderName(entry.name);
      patientFolders.push({
        folderPath: patientPath,
        folderName: entry.name,
        patientId,
        nameSlug,
        status: 'FLAT',
        page: null,
      });
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(`Error reading export root directory ${rootDir}:`, error);
  }

  return patientFolders;
}

// ============================================================================
// Patient Folder Validation
// ============================================================================

/**
 * Audit a single patient folder
 */
function auditPatientFolder(
  folderPath: string,
  folderName: string
): PatientAuditResult | null {
  const patientNameSlug = extractPatientNameFromFolder(folderName);

  if (!patientNameSlug) {
    console.warn(`⚠️  Could not extract patient name from folder: ${folderName}`);
    return null;
  }

  const patientName = normalizePatientNameForMatching(patientNameSlug);
  const missingFiles: string[] = [];
  const filesWithPatientName: string[] = [];
  const filesWithoutPatientName: string[] = [];

  // Check for expected files
  for (const expectedFile of EXPECTED_FILES) {
    const filePath = path.join(folderPath, expectedFile);
    if (!fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
      missingFiles.push(expectedFile);
    } else {
      // Check if file contains patient name
      if (fileContainsPatientName(filePath, patientName)) {
        filesWithPatientName.push(expectedFile);
      } else {
        filesWithoutPatientName.push(expectedFile);
      }
    }
  }

  // Check for optional encounter-history/url.json
  const encounterUrlPath = path.join(folderPath, 'encounter-history', 'url.json');
  const hasEncounterUrl = fs.existsSync(encounterUrlPath);

  const isValid =
    missingFiles.length === 0 && filesWithoutPatientName.length === 0;

  const result: PatientAuditResult = {
    folderPath,
    patientName: patientNameSlug,
    expectedFiles: EXPECTED_FILES,
    missingFiles,
    filesWithPatientName,
    filesWithoutPatientName,
    isValid,
    completenessScore: 0, // Will be calculated below
  };

  result.completenessScore = calculateCompletenessScore(result);

  return result;
}

// ============================================================================
// Duplicate Detection
// ============================================================================

/**
 * Extract patient name from HTML file content
 * Tries to find patient name in common HTML patterns
 */
function extractPatientNameFromHtml(filePath: string): string | null {
  try {
    const content = fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf-8');
    
    // Pattern 1: Look for "LASTNAME, FIRSTNAME" format in common locations
    // Common patterns: <h1>LASTNAME, FIRSTNAME</h1>, <div>LASTNAME, FIRSTNAME</div>
    const namePattern1 = /(?:<h[1-6][^>]*>|<div[^>]*class="[^"]*name[^"]*"[^>]*>|<span[^>]*class="[^"]*patient[^"]*name[^"]*"[^>]*>)([A-Z][A-Z\s,]+[A-Z])(?:<\/h[1-6]>|<\/div>|<\/span>)/i;
    const match1 = content.match(namePattern1);
    if (match1 && match1[1]) {
      const name = match1[1].trim().toUpperCase();
      if (name.includes(',') && name.length > 3) {
        return name;
      }
    }
    
    // Pattern 2: Look for patient name in data attributes or IDs
    const namePattern2 = /data-patient-name="([^"]+)"|id="[^"]*patient[^"]*name[^"]*"[^>]*>([A-Z][A-Z\s,]+[A-Z])/i;
    const match2 = content.match(namePattern2);
    if (match2 && (match2[1] || match2[2])) {
      const name = (match2[1] || match2[2]).trim().toUpperCase();
      if (name.length > 3) {
        return name;
      }
    }
    
    return null;
  } catch (error) {
    return null;
  }
}

/**
 * Normalize patient name for comparison
 * Converts "LASTNAME, FIRSTNAME" or "lastname-firstname" to normalized format
 */
function normalizeNameForComparison(name: string): string {
  return name
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/\s+/g, '-')
    .replace(/,/g, '')
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9-]/g, '')
    .replace(/-+/g, '-')
    .replace(/^-|-$/g, '');
}

/**
 * Get normalized patient name from folder (from slug or HTML)
 * Returns both the slug-based name and HTML-based name for comparison
 */
function getNormalizedPatientNames(
  folder: PatientFolderInfo,
  auditResults: Map<string, PatientAuditResult>
): { slugName: string | null; htmlName: string | null } {
  const slugName = folder.nameSlug ? normalizeNameForComparison(folder.nameSlug) : null;
  
  // Try to get from HTML (most reliable)
  let htmlName: string | null = null;
  const profilePath = path.join(folder.folderPath, 'profile.html');
  if (fs.existsSync(profilePath)) {
    const extractedHtmlName = extractPatientNameFromHtml(profilePath);
    if (extractedHtmlName) {
      htmlName = normalizeNameForComparison(extractedHtmlName);
      
      // Verify HTML name matches folder slug (to avoid false positives)
      // Allow some flexibility (e.g., "smith-john" vs "smith-john-jr")
      if (slugName && htmlName) {
        // Check if HTML name contains slug name or vice versa
        const htmlMatchesSlug = htmlName.includes(slugName) || slugName.includes(htmlName);
        // Or if they're very similar (within 2 characters difference)
        const similarity = Math.abs(htmlName.length - slugName.length);
        if (!htmlMatchesSlug && similarity > 3) {
          // HTML name doesn't match slug - might be wrong extraction, use slug instead
          htmlName = null;
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  return { slugName, htmlName };
}

/**
 * Find duplicate patient folders grouped by name slug AND normalized HTML name
 * This catches duplicates even when patient IDs differ (e.g., status transfers)
 */
function findDuplicates(
  patientFolders: PatientFolderInfo[],
  auditResults: Map<string, PatientAuditResult>
): Map<string, PatientFolderInfo[]> {
  // Group by exact name slug (existing behavior - most reliable)
  const slugToFolders = new Map<string, PatientFolderInfo[]>();
  for (const folder of patientFolders) {
    if (!folder.nameSlug) {
      continue;
    }
    
    const existing = slugToFolders.get(folder.nameSlug) || [];
    existing.push(folder);
    slugToFolders.set(folder.nameSlug, existing);
  }
  
  // Group by HTML-extracted name (for cross-status detection)
  // Only group if HTML name matches folder slug (to avoid false positives)
  const htmlNameToFolders = new Map<string, PatientFolderInfo[]>();
  for (const folder of patientFolders) {
    const { slugName, htmlName } = getNormalizedPatientNames(folder, auditResults);
    
    // Only use HTML name if it matches the slug (validates it's the correct patient)
    if (htmlName && slugName && (htmlName === slugName || htmlName.includes(slugName) || slugName.includes(htmlName))) {
      const existing = htmlNameToFolders.get(htmlName) || [];
      existing.push(folder);
      htmlNameToFolders.set(htmlName, existing);
    }
  }
  
  // Combine results
  const allDuplicates = new Map<string, PatientFolderInfo[]>();
  
  // Add exact slug groups (existing behavior)
  for (const [nameSlug, folders] of slugToFolders.entries()) {
    if (folders.length > 1) {
      allDuplicates.set(nameSlug, folders);
    }
  }
  
  // Add HTML name groups that catch cross-status duplicates
  // (same patient name but different patient IDs due to status transfer)
  for (const [htmlName, folders] of htmlNameToFolders.entries()) {
    if (folders.length > 1) {
      // Check if folders have different slugs (indicating cross-status duplicate)
      const uniqueSlugs = new Set(folders.map(f => f.nameSlug).filter(Boolean));
      if (uniqueSlugs.size > 1) {
        // Different slugs but same HTML name = likely status transfer duplicate
        const key = `cross-status:${htmlName}`;
        // Only add if not already covered by exact slug match
        const alreadyCovered = folders.every(f => {
          const slugGroup = slugToFolders.get(f.nameSlug || '');
          return slugGroup && slugGroup.length > 1;
        });
        
        if (!alreadyCovered) {
          allDuplicates.set(key, folders);
        } else {
          // Merge with existing slug groups
          for (const folder of folders) {
            const slugGroup = slugToFolders.get(folder.nameSlug || '');
            if (slugGroup && slugGroup.length > 1) {
              // Add other folders from HTML group that aren't already in slug group
              for (const otherFolder of folders) {
                if (otherFolder.folderPath !== folder.folderPath && 
                    !slugGroup.some(f => f.folderPath === otherFolder.folderPath)) {
                  slugGroup.push(otherFolder);
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  return allDuplicates;
}

// ============================================================================
// Best Folder Selection
// ============================================================================

/**
 * Select the best folder from duplicates
 * Priority: First folder found that has all required files AND patient name matches
 */
function selectBestFolder(
  duplicates: PatientFolderInfo[],
  auditResults: Map<string, PatientAuditResult>
): PatientFolderInfo | null {
  if (duplicates.length === 0) {
    return null;
  }

  // Find first folder that is valid (all files + patient name matches)
  for (const folder of duplicates) {
    const auditResult = auditResults.get(folder.folderPath);
    if (auditResult?.isValid) {
      return folder;
    }
  }

  // If none are valid, return the first one (for manual review)
  return duplicates[0];
}

/**
 * Process duplicate groups and select best folders
 */
function processDuplicateGroups(
  duplicateGroups: Map<string, PatientFolderInfo[]>,
  auditResults: Map<string, PatientAuditResult>
): DuplicateGroup[] {
  const processed: DuplicateGroup[] = [];

  for (const [nameSlug, folders] of duplicateGroups.entries()) {
    const bestFolder = selectBestFolder(folders, auditResults);
    const foldersToDelete = bestFolder
      ? folders.filter((f) => f.folderPath !== bestFolder.folderPath)
      : [];

    processed.push({
      nameSlug,
      folders,
      bestFolder,
      foldersToDelete,
    });
  }

  return processed;
}

// ============================================================================
// Report Generation
// ============================================================================

/**
 * Generate audit report
 */
function generateAuditReport(
  summary: AuditSummary,
  outputPath?: string
): string {
  const lines: string[] = [];

  lines.push('='.repeat(80));
  lines.push('PATIENT DATA AUDIT REPORT');
  lines.push('='.repeat(80));
  lines.push('');
  lines.push(`Generated: ${new Date().toISOString()}`);
  lines.push(`Total Patients Scanned: ${summary.totalPatients}`);
  lines.push(`Valid Patients: ${summary.validPatients}`);
  lines.push(`Invalid Patients: ${summary.invalidPatients}`);
  lines.push(
    `Success Rate: ${
      summary.totalPatients > 0
        ? ((summary.validPatients / summary.totalPatients) * 100).toFixed(2)
        : 0
    }%`
  );
  lines.push(`Duplicate Groups Found: ${summary.duplicateGroups}`);
  lines.push('');
  lines.push('='.repeat(80));
  lines.push('');

  // Group by validity
  const validResults = summary.results.filter((r) => r.isValid);
  const invalidResults = summary.results.filter((r) => !r.isValid);

  if (invalidResults.length > 0) {
    lines.push('❌ PATIENTS NEEDING RE-DOWNLOAD');
    lines.push('-'.repeat(80));
    lines.push('');

    for (const result of invalidResults) {
      lines.push(`Folder: ${result.folderPath}`);
      lines.push(`Patient Name: ${result.patientName}`);
      lines.push(`Completeness Score: ${result.completenessScore}/100`);
      lines.push('');

      if (result.missingFiles.length > 0) {
        lines.push(`  Missing Files (${result.missingFiles.length}):`);
        for (const file of result.missingFiles) {
          lines.push(`    - ${file}`);
        }
        lines.push('');
      }

      if (result.filesWithoutPatientName.length > 0) {
        lines.push(
          `  Files Without Patient Name (${result.filesWithoutPatientName.length}):`
        );
        for (const file of result.filesWithoutPatientName) {
          lines.push(`    - ${file}`);
        }
        lines.push('');
      }

      if (result.filesWithPatientName.length > 0) {
        lines.push(
          `  ✓ Files With Patient Name (${result.filesWithPatientName.length}): ${result.filesWithPatientName.join(', ')}`
        );
        lines.push('');
      }

      lines.push('-'.repeat(80));
      lines.push('');
    }
  }

  if (validResults.length > 0) {
    lines.push('✅ VALID PATIENTS');
    lines.push('-'.repeat(80));
    lines.push(`Total: ${validResults.length}`);
    lines.push('');

    // Show first 10 valid patients as examples
    const examples = validResults.slice(0, 10);
    for (const result of examples) {
      lines.push(
        `  ✓ ${result.patientName} (${result.filesWithPatientName.length}/${result.expectedFiles.length} files verified, score: ${result.completenessScore}/100)`
      );
    }

    if (validResults.length > 10) {
      lines.push(`  ... and ${validResults.length - 10} more valid patients`);
    }
    lines.push('');
  }

  if (summary.duplicates.length > 0) {
    lines.push('🔄 DUPLICATE PATIENT FOLDERS');
    lines.push('-'.repeat(80));
    lines.push(`Total Duplicate Groups: ${summary.duplicates.length}`);
    lines.push('');

    for (const dup of summary.duplicates) {
      lines.push(`Patient: ${dup.nameSlug}`);
      lines.push(`  Found ${dup.folders.length} duplicate folders:`);
      for (const folder of dup.folders) {
        const audit = summary.results.find(
          (r) => r.folderPath === folder.folderPath
        );
        const marker = folder.folderPath === dup.bestFolder?.folderPath ? '✓ KEEP' : '✗ DELETE';
        const status = audit?.isValid ? 'VALID' : 'INVALID';
        const folderLabel =
          folder.status === 'FLAT'
            ? folder.folderName
            : `${folder.status}/${folder.page ?? ''}/${folder.folderName}`;
        lines.push(`    ${marker} [${status}] ${folderLabel}`);
      }
      lines.push('');
    }
  }

  lines.push('='.repeat(80));
  lines.push('END OF REPORT');
  lines.push('='.repeat(80));

  const report = lines.join('\n');

  if (outputPath) {
    fs.writeFileSync(outputPath, report, 'utf-8');
    console.log(`\n📄 Report saved to: ${outputPath}`);
  }

  return report;
}

/**
 * Generate de-duplication report
 */
function generateDedupeReport(
  duplicates: DuplicateGroup[],
  outputPath?: string
): string {
  const lines: string[] = [];

  lines.push('='.repeat(80));
  lines.push('DE-DUPLICATION REPORT');
  lines.push('='.repeat(80));
  lines.push('');
  lines.push(`Generated: ${new Date().toISOString()}`);
  lines.push(`Total Duplicate Groups: ${duplicates.length}`);
  lines.push('');

  let totalFoldersToDelete = 0;
  let totalSpaceSaved = 0;

  for (const dup of duplicates) {
    lines.push(`Patient: ${dup.nameSlug}`);
    lines.push(`  Duplicate Folders: ${dup.folders.length}`);
    
    if (dup.bestFolder) {
      lines.push(`  ✓ Keeping: ${dup.bestFolder.folderPath}`);
    } else {
      lines.push(`  ⚠️  No valid folder found - manual review needed`);
    }

    if (dup.foldersToDelete.length > 0) {
      lines.push(`  Folders to delete (${dup.foldersToDelete.length}):`);
      for (const folder of dup.foldersToDelete) {
        lines.push(`    - ${folder.folderPath}`);
        try {
          const stats = fs.statSync(folder.folderPath);
          totalSpaceSaved += stats.size;
        } catch {
          // Ignore errors
        }
      }
      totalFoldersToDelete += dup.foldersToDelete.length;
    }
    lines.push('');
  }

  lines.push('-'.repeat(80));
  lines.push(`Summary:`);
  lines.push(`  Total folders to delete: ${totalFoldersToDelete}`);
  lines.push(`  Estimated space savings: ${(totalSpaceSaved / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(2)} MB`);
  lines.push('='.repeat(80));

  const report = lines.join('\n');

  if (outputPath) {
    fs.writeFileSync(outputPath, report, 'utf-8');
  }

  return report;
}

// ============================================================================
// Interactive De-duplication
// ============================================================================

/**
 * Create readline interface for user input
 */
function createReadlineInterface(): readline.Interface {
  return readline.createInterface({
    input: process.stdin,
    output: process.stdout,
  });
}

/**
 * Prompt user for confirmation
 */
function promptConfirmation(
  rl: readline.Interface,
  question: string
): Promise<boolean> {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    rl.question(question, (answer) => {
      resolve(answer.toLowerCase() === 'y' || answer.toLowerCase() === 'yes');
    });
  });
}

/**
 * Calculate folder size recursively
 */
function getFolderSize(folderPath: string): number {
  let size = 0;
  try {
    const stats = fs.statSync(folderPath);
    if (stats.isFile()) {
      return stats.size;
    }
    if (stats.isDirectory()) {
      const entries = fs.readdirSync(folderPath);
      for (const entry of entries) {
        size += getFolderSize(path.join(folderPath, entry));
      }
    }
  } catch {
    // Ignore errors
  }
  return size;
}

/**
 * Delete folder recursively
 */
function deleteFolder(folderPath: string): void {
  try {
    if (fs.statSync(folderPath).isDirectory()) {
      const entries = fs.readdirSync(folderPath);
      for (const entry of entries) {
        deleteFolder(path.join(folderPath, entry));
      }
      fs.rmdirSync(folderPath);
    } else {
      fs.unlinkSync(folderPath);
    }
  } catch (error) {
    throw new Error(`Failed to delete ${folderPath}: ${error}`);
  }
}

/**
 * Interactive deletion of invalid patient folders
 */
async function interactiveDeleteInvalid(
  invalidPatients: PatientAuditResult[],
  dryRun: boolean = false,
  autoConfirm: boolean = false
): Promise<void> {
  if (invalidPatients.length === 0) {
    console.log('✅ No invalid patient folders found.');
    return;
  }

  console.log(`\n❌ Found ${invalidPatients.length} invalid patient folder(s)`);
  console.log('='.repeat(80));

  const deletedFolders: string[] = [];
  const skippedFolders: string[] = [];
  const rl = autoConfirm ? null : createReadlineInterface();

  try {
    // Group by issue type for better organization
    const missingFilesOnly = invalidPatients.filter(
      (p) => p.missingFiles.length > 0 && p.filesWithoutPatientName.length === 0
    );
    const wrongPatientName = invalidPatients.filter(
      (p) => p.filesWithoutPatientName.length > 0
    );
    const bothIssues = invalidPatients.filter(
      (p) => p.missingFiles.length > 0 && p.filesWithoutPatientName.length > 0
    );

    if (missingFilesOnly.length > 0) {
      console.log(`\n📋 Missing Files Only (${missingFilesOnly.length}):`);
      for (const patient of missingFilesOnly.slice(0, 5)) {
        console.log(`  - ${patient.patientName}`);
        console.log(`    ${patient.folderPath}`);
        console.log(`    Missing: ${patient.missingFiles.join(', ')}`);
      }
      if (missingFilesOnly.length > 5) {
        console.log(`  ... and ${missingFilesOnly.length - 5} more`);
      }
    }

    if (wrongPatientName.length > 0) {
      console.log(`\n📋 Wrong Patient Name (${wrongPatientName.length}):`);
      for (const patient of wrongPatientName.slice(0, 5)) {
        console.log(`  - ${patient.patientName}`);
        console.log(`    ${patient.folderPath}`);
        console.log(`    Files without name: ${patient.filesWithoutPatientName.join(', ')}`);
      }
      if (wrongPatientName.length > 5) {
        console.log(`  ... and ${wrongPatientName.length - 5} more`);
      }
    }

    if (bothIssues.length > 0) {
      console.log(`\n📋 Both Issues (${bothIssues.length}):`);
      for (const patient of bothIssues.slice(0, 5)) {
        console.log(`  - ${patient.patientName}`);
        console.log(`    ${patient.folderPath}`);
        console.log(`    Missing: ${patient.missingFiles.join(', ')}`);
        console.log(`    Wrong name: ${patient.filesWithoutPatientName.join(', ')}`);
      }
      if (bothIssues.length > 5) {
        console.log(`  ... and ${bothIssues.length - 5} more`);
      }
    }

    console.log('');

    if (dryRun) {
      const totalSize = invalidPatients.reduce(
        (sum, patient) => sum + getFolderSize(patient.folderPath),
        0
      );
      const sizeMB = (totalSize / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(2);
      console.log(
        `[DRY RUN] Would delete ${invalidPatients.length} invalid folder(s) (~${sizeMB} MB)`
      );
      skippedFolders.push(...invalidPatients.map((p) => p.folderPath));
    } else {
      const totalSize = invalidPatients.reduce(
        (sum, patient) => sum + getFolderSize(patient.folderPath),
        0
      );
      const sizeMB = (totalSize / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(2);

      let confirmed = autoConfirm;
      if (!autoConfirm && rl) {
        confirmed = await promptConfirmation(
          rl,
          `Delete ${invalidPatients.length} invalid patient folder(s) (~${sizeMB} MB)? [y/N]: `
        );
      } else if (autoConfirm) {
        console.log(`Auto-confirming deletion of ${invalidPatients.length} invalid folder(s) (~${sizeMB} MB)...`);
      }

      if (confirmed) {
        console.log('\nDeleting invalid folders...');
        for (const patient of invalidPatients) {
          try {
            deleteFolder(patient.folderPath);
            deletedFolders.push(patient.folderPath);
            console.log(`  ✓ Deleted: ${patient.patientName} (${patient.folderPath})`);
          } catch (error) {
            console.error(
              `  ✗ Failed to delete ${patient.folderPath}:`,
              error
            );
          }
        }
      } else {
        console.log('Skipped deletion of invalid folders');
        skippedFolders.push(...invalidPatients.map((p) => p.folderPath));
      }
    }
  } finally {
    if (rl) {
      rl.close();
    }
  }

  console.log('\n' + '='.repeat(80));
  console.log('Invalid Folder Deletion Summary:');
  console.log(`  Deleted: ${deletedFolders.length} folder(s)`);
  console.log(`  Skipped: ${skippedFolders.length} folder(s)`);
  if (dryRun) {
    console.log('  Mode: DRY RUN (no files were deleted)');
  }
  console.log('='.repeat(80));
}

/**
 * Interactive de-duplication flow
 */
async function interactiveDedupe(
  duplicates: DuplicateGroup[],
  auditResults: Map<string, PatientAuditResult>,
  dryRun: boolean = false,
  autoConfirm: boolean = false
): Promise<void> {
  if (duplicates.length === 0) {
    console.log('✅ No duplicate folders found.');
    return;
  }

  console.log(`\n🔄 Found ${duplicates.length} duplicate group(s)`);
  console.log('='.repeat(80));

  const deletedFolders: string[] = [];
  const skippedFolders: string[] = [];
  const rl = autoConfirm ? null : createReadlineInterface();

  try {
    for (const dup of duplicates) {
      console.log(`\nPatient: ${dup.nameSlug}`);
      console.log(`  Found ${dup.folders.length} duplicate folders:`);
      console.log('');

      // Show audit results for each folder
      for (const folder of dup.folders) {
        const audit = auditResults.get(folder.folderPath);
        const isBest = folder.folderPath === dup.bestFolder?.folderPath;
        const status = audit?.isValid ? '✅ VALID' : '❌ INVALID';
        const marker = isBest ? '✓ KEEP' : '✗ DELETE';
        const score = audit ? ` (score: ${audit.completenessScore}/100)` : '';

        console.log(
          `  ${marker} [${status}]${score}`
        );
        console.log(`    ${folder.folderPath}`);
        if (audit) {
          if (audit.missingFiles.length > 0) {
            console.log(`      Missing: ${audit.missingFiles.join(', ')}`);
          }
          if (audit.filesWithoutPatientName.length > 0) {
            console.log(
              `      No patient name: ${audit.filesWithoutPatientName.join(', ')}`
            );
          }
        }
        console.log('');
      }

      if (dup.foldersToDelete.length === 0) {
        console.log('  ⚠️  No folders to delete (all are needed for review)');
        continue;
      }

      if (dryRun) {
        console.log(
          `  [DRY RUN] Would delete ${dup.foldersToDelete.length} folder(s)`
        );
        skippedFolders.push(...dup.foldersToDelete.map((f) => f.folderPath));
        continue;
      }

      const totalSize = dup.foldersToDelete.reduce(
        (sum, folder) => sum + getFolderSize(folder.folderPath),
        0
      );
      const sizeMB = (totalSize / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(2);

      let confirmed = autoConfirm;
      if (!autoConfirm && rl) {
        confirmed = await promptConfirmation(
          rl,
          `  Delete ${dup.foldersToDelete.length} duplicate folder(s) (~${sizeMB} MB)? [y/N]: `
        );
      } else if (autoConfirm) {
        console.log(`  Auto-confirming deletion of ${dup.foldersToDelete.length} duplicate folder(s) (~${sizeMB} MB)...`);
      }

      if (confirmed) {
        for (const folder of dup.foldersToDelete) {
          try {
            deleteFolder(folder.folderPath);
            deletedFolders.push(folder.folderPath);
            console.log(`    ✓ Deleted: ${folder.folderPath}`);
          } catch (error) {
            console.error(`    ✗ Failed to delete ${folder.folderPath}:`, error);
          }
        }
      } else {
        console.log('  Skipped');
        skippedFolders.push(...dup.foldersToDelete.map((f) => f.folderPath));
      }
    }
  } finally {
    if (rl) {
      rl.close();
    }
  }

  console.log('\n' + '='.repeat(80));
  console.log('De-duplication Summary:');
  console.log(`  Deleted: ${deletedFolders.length} folder(s)`);
  console.log(`  Skipped: ${skippedFolders.length} folder(s)`);
  if (dryRun) {
    console.log('  Mode: DRY RUN (no files were deleted)');
  }
  console.log('='.repeat(80));
}

// ============================================================================
// Main Audit Function
// ============================================================================

/**
 * Main audit function
 */
async function auditExportDirectory(
  exportDir: string,
  options: {
    outputPath?: string;
    dedupe?: boolean;
    deleteInvalid?: boolean;
    dryRun?: boolean;
    yes?: boolean;
  } = {}
): Promise<void> {
  console.log(`🔍 Scanning export directory: ${exportDir}`);

  if (!fs.existsSync(exportDir)) {
    console.error(`❌ Error: Directory does not exist: ${exportDir}`);
    process.exit(1);
  }

  // Find all patient folders
  console.log('📁 Scanning for patient folders...');
  const patientFolders = findAllPatientFolders(exportDir);
  console.log(`   Found ${patientFolders.length} patient folders`);

  // Audit each folder
  console.log('🔎 Auditing patient folders...');
  const auditResults = new Map<string, PatientAuditResult>();
  const results: PatientAuditResult[] = [];

  for (const folder of patientFolders) {
    const result = auditPatientFolder(folder.folderPath, folder.folderName);
    if (result) {
      auditResults.set(folder.folderPath, result);
      results.push(result);
    }
  }

  // Find duplicates
  console.log('🔄 Detecting duplicates (by name slug and HTML-extracted names)...');
  const duplicateGroups = findDuplicates(patientFolders, auditResults);
  const processedDuplicates = processDuplicateGroups(
    duplicateGroups,
    auditResults
  );

  // Create summary
  const summary: AuditSummary = {
    totalPatients: results.length,
    validPatients: results.filter((r) => r.isValid).length,
    invalidPatients: results.filter((r) => !r.isValid).length,
    duplicateGroups: processedDuplicates.length,
    patientsNeedingRedownload: results.filter((r) => !r.isValid),
    duplicates: processedDuplicates,
    results,
  };

  // Print summary to console
  console.log('\n' + '='.repeat(80));
  console.log('AUDIT SUMMARY');
  console.log('='.repeat(80));
  console.log(`Total Patients: ${summary.totalPatients}`);
  console.log(`✅ Valid: ${summary.validPatients}`);
  console.log(`❌ Invalid: ${summary.invalidPatients}`);
  console.log(
    `Success Rate: ${
      summary.totalPatients > 0
        ? ((summary.validPatients / summary.totalPatients) * 100).toFixed(2)
        : 0
    }%`
  );
  console.log(`🔄 Duplicate Groups: ${summary.duplicateGroups}`);

  // Generate audit report
  const auditReport = generateAuditReport(summary, options.outputPath);
  if (!options.outputPath) {
    console.log('\n' + auditReport);
  }

  // Handle de-duplication
  if (options.dedupe) {
    if (options.dryRun) {
      console.log('\n🔍 DRY RUN MODE - No files will be deleted');
    }
    if (options.yes) {
      console.log('✅ Auto-confirm mode enabled - skipping interactive prompts');
    }
    await interactiveDedupe(
      processedDuplicates,
      auditResults,
      options.dryRun,
      options.yes || false
    );

    // Generate de-duplication report
    const dedupeReportPath = options.outputPath
      ? options.outputPath.replace(/\.txt$/, '-dedupe.txt')
      : undefined;
    generateDedupeReport(processedDuplicates, dedupeReportPath);
  }

  // Handle deletion of invalid folders
  if (options.deleteInvalid) {
    if (options.dryRun) {
      console.log('\n🔍 DRY RUN MODE - No files will be deleted');
    }
    if (options.yes) {
      console.log('✅ Auto-confirm mode enabled - skipping interactive prompts');
    }
    await interactiveDeleteInvalid(
      summary.patientsNeedingRedownload,
      options.dryRun,
      options.yes || false
    );
  }
}

// ============================================================================
// CLI Interface
// ============================================================================

/**
 * Parse command line arguments
 */
function parseArgs(args: string[]): {
  exportDir: string;
  outputPath?: string;
  dedupe: boolean;
  deleteInvalid: boolean;
  dryRun: boolean;
  yes: boolean;
} {
  let exportDir = '';
  let outputPath: string | undefined;
  let dedupe = false;
  let deleteInvalid = false;
  let dryRun = false;
  let yes = false;

  for (let i = 0; i < args.length; i++) {
    const arg = args[i];
    if (arg === '--dedupe') {
      dedupe = true;
    } else if (arg === '--delete-invalid') {
      deleteInvalid = true;
    } else if (arg === '--dry-run') {
      dryRun = true;
    } else if (arg === '--yes' || arg === '-y') {
      yes = true;
    } else if (arg === '--output' && i + 1 < args.length) {
      outputPath = args[i + 1];
      i++;
    } else if (!arg.startsWith('--') && !exportDir) {
      exportDir = arg;
    }
  }

  return { exportDir, outputPath, dedupe, deleteInvalid, dryRun, yes };
}

// CLI entry point
// Run CLI when script is executed directly
(async () => {
  const args = process.argv.slice(2);

  if (args.length === 0 || args[0] === '--help' || args[0] === '-h') {
    console.log('Patient Data Audit and De-duplication Tool');
    console.log('');
    console.log('Usage:');
    console.log('  tsx audit-patient-data.ts <export-directory> [options]');
    console.log('  or');
    console.log('  node audit-patient-data.ts <export-directory> [options]');
    console.log('');
    console.log('Options:');
    console.log('  --output <path>      Save report to file');
    console.log('  --dedupe             Enable interactive de-duplication');
    console.log('  --delete-invalid     Enable deletion of invalid patient folders');
    console.log('  --dry-run            Dry run mode (no deletions)');
    console.log('  --yes, -y            Auto-confirm all deletions (non-interactive)');
    console.log('');
    console.log('Examples:');
    console.log('  tsx tools/patient-audit/audit-patient-data.ts output/Bravado-Patient-Export-2025-12-23');
    console.log('  tsx tools/patient-audit/audit-patient-data.ts output/Bravado-Patient-Export-2025-12-23 --output audit-report.txt');
    console.log('  tsx tools/patient-audit/audit-patient-data.ts output/Bravado-Patient-Export-2025-12-23 --dedupe');
    console.log('  tsx tools/patient-audit/audit-patient-data.ts output/Bravado-Patient-Export-2025-12-23 --delete-invalid');
    console.log('  tsx tools/patient-audit/audit-patient-data.ts output/Bravado-Patient-Export-2025-12-23 --delete-invalid --dry-run');
    console.log('  tsx tools/patient-audit/audit-patient-data.ts output/Bravado-Patient-Export-2025-12-23 --dedupe --delete-invalid --yes');
    process.exit(0);
  }

  const { exportDir, outputPath, dedupe, deleteInvalid, dryRun, yes } = parseArgs(args);

  if (!exportDir) {
    console.error('❌ Error: Export directory is required');
    console.error('Usage: tsx tools/patient-audit/audit-patient-data.ts <export-directory> [options]');
    process.exit(1);
  }

  auditExportDirectory(exportDir, { outputPath, dedupe, deleteInvalid, dryRun, yes }).catch(
    (error) => {
      console.error('❌ Fatal error:', error);
      process.exit(1);
    }
  );
})();

export {
  auditExportDirectory,
  auditPatientFolder,
  findAllPatientFolders,
  findDuplicates,
  generateAuditReport,
  generateDedupeReport,
  interactiveDeleteInvalid,
};
